You will design and ship systems that coordinate media processing, AI-generated audio and video assets, captions, localization, publishing, and quality control. You will help shape the platform architecture, make difficult trade-offs explicit, and build mechanisms that allow partner teams and content creators to move faster with less operational risk. 

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership. 

What You'll Accomplish

- Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories. 
 - Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents. 
 - Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short-term and long-term trade-offs. 
 - Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing. 
 - Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features, contributing to Hinge Health's AI-driven care platform. 
 - Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team's features, and contribute to the team's overall architecture and developer tooling. 
 - Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference. 

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week. 

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA. 

- Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e. g. , 8am in San Francisco is 8: 30pm in Bengaluru). 
 - Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT). 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
 - 10+ years of non-internship full time professional software development experience
 - 4+ years of experience with at least one software programming language
 - 4+ years of experience in the full software development life cycle
 - 3+ years of work experience with react JS and Node JS/ Typescript
 - 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making
 - Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, LangChain, LangGraph
 - Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment. 
 - Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e. g. , Python, Java, JavaScript, etc. ). 

Preferred Qualifications

- A platform-as-product mindset: understanding internal users and consumers, defining clear contracts, improving developer experience and adoption, and measuring platform outcomes. 
 - Strong backend and distributed-systems fundamentals, including latency, throughput, availability, capacity, backpressure, consistency, resilience, and failure-mode analysis. 
 - Experience integrating large language models or generative AI services into production workflows with appropriate evals, validation, observability, and failure handling. 
 - Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service-health metrics, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability. 
 - Experience improving observability through metrics, structured logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with practical knowledge of cache design and invalidation, database performance KPIs, query and index tuning, connection pools, and capacity management
 - Experience with headless CMS integrations, webhook-driven systems, vendor adapters, content delivery networks, or publishing pipelines. 
 - Experience with durable workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal, or comparable workflow technology. 
 - Experience with media processing tools such as ffmpeg, adaptive bitrate video, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, or caption formats such as WebVTT. 
 - Experience with event streaming, such as Kafka, and CI/CD automation, such as GitHub Actions. 
 - Experience working in healthcare, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or otherwise high-trust environments. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers or serving as a technical lead for a platform, migration, or cross-functional launch. 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we're using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare - starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1. 7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care - from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation - through personalized, evidence-based care. 

As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2, 550 employers. The company headquartered is in San Francisco California. Learn more at http: //www. hingehealth. com. 

What You'll Love About Us

- Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA). 
 - Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally. 
 - Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions. 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter. 

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy. 

Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth. com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth. com.

Description & Requirements

About the Team: 

- The Sell-Side Pre-Trade and Execution (SSPTE) group builds and supports Bloomberg's global, multi-asset Sell-Side execution management systems (EMSes), including TOMS, ETOMS, and Broadway. These systems are relied upon daily by thousands of fixed income traders and salespeople at the world's leading financial institutions. We focus on the trader workflows starting from advertising an intention to trade to executing transactions with clients and other dealers in the market. In these workflows, we're often dealing in microsecond latencies and at high throughput. 
 - Our SSPTE Data Acquisition team plays a critical role in the success of our business. We are responsible for acquiring and normalizing market data and reference data into a common schema feeding the core of our trading systems with the material that connects workflows. 
 - This data provides the trading system with a complete, real-time view of tradeable securities, markets, trading history and market activity, enabling integration of trading strategies, pricing models, analytics, and custom workflows. Crucially, EMS applications rely on consuming such market and reference data seamlessly, so that they can efficiently execute advanced EMS workflows, which often require microsecond latency. 

What's In It For You

- The team, originally based in Hyderabad, joined Bloomberg through the Broadway acquisition. Having recently moved to Pune, their primary focus for the upcoming year will be to integrate with Bloomberg's industry-leading Market and Reference data technologies and tools, such as Enterprise Data License and BPIPE. 
 - Joining the team offers a unique opportunity to make your mark on these high-profile projects early on. You will help the team in making sound technical decisions when faced with complex challenges. These include efficiently ingesting millions of rows of Reference Data within strict SLAs, and deploying new software releases that update critical Market Data information, while prioritizing correctness, stability, and reliability. This position will also provide invaluable insight into various Sell-Side EMS workflows, as the Market and Reference data managed by the team are central to numerous EMS applications. 

We'll Trust You To

- Collaborate effectively with a team of talented individuals, fostering a culture of innovation and high performance

And so is managing office space in a hybrid world. And so is improving the customer and guest experience. We exist to make each of these things easier. We exist to bring harmony to our customers. 

And we do that at enterprise scale. Our omnichannel employee communications, customer communications, and workplace experience platform is trusted by over 6, 000 organisations today, reaching more than 35M employees and delivering content to 500, 000+ digital signs. 

We know there's no such thing as a "perfect" candidate - we're all a work in progress and are growing new skills and capabilities all the time. We encourage you to apply for a position with Poppulo even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements. We believe in fostering an environment where there is a diversity of perspectives, in hopes that we can all succeed. 

Job Summary

The Senior Software Development Engineer is responsible for the design, development and long-term technical health of business-critical applications and services. This role delivers complex technical solutions, provides technical leadership within the team, and contributes to architectural decisions and engineering best practices. 

The Senior Software Development Engineer leads technical design and implementation within their area, mentors other engineers, and helps ensure the systems they work on remain scalable, secure, reliable and maintainable.

Software Development & Architecture

 - Lead the delivery of complex features and solutions across multiple contributors. 
 - Contribute to architectural decisions and identify technical risks.

Product & System Ownership

- Own the design, delivery and ongoing technical health of assigned systems and services. 
 - Drive improvements in application scalability, performance and reliability. 
 - Lead investigation and root-cause analysis of complex production issues. 
 - Partner with DevOps and Platform teams to improve reliability, monitoring and observability.

Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence

Collaboration

Education / Experience

 - Strong TypeScript fluency with significant experience building production web applications and services. 
 - Strong experience with full-stack application development, including Node. Js, TypeScript/JavaScript, React

Who We Are

We are a values-driven organisation that encourages our employees to bring their authentic selves to work every day and empowers everyone to make a tangible impact on our products, clients, and culture. We offer a dynamic environment with driven, fun, and flexible individuals who thrive on challenge and responsibility.  - See it. Own it. Solve it. We proactively innovate and solve for our customers and each other. We set an example with high standards for our work. We foster a culture of learning, acknowledging our successes and our failures. 
 - Together We're Better We value and celebrate our diversity. We learn from others, respecting their expertise, and focus on building trust. That's what makes us a team. 

Named a Great Place to Work in 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, and 2021, we are a fast-growing global technology company, with offices in Ireland, the US, and the UK.

Who We Are & Why Join Us

Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale. 

Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives. 

Learn more at: avathon. com

Work Location: Bangalore

Five Days onsite

At Avathon, we are building cutting-edge AI solutions that transform operations across asset-intensive industries such as Supply Chain, Logistics, Energy, Mining, Aerospace, and Industrial Manufacturing. Avathon is an enterprise-grade native AI and data platform designed to unify multiple complex applications under a single pane of glass. We are moving beyond legacy monoliths into a highly scalable, decoupled Micro Front-End (MFE) architecture powered by a Central Knowledge Graph (CKG). 

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Platform team, you will be instrumental in building our core infrastructure and commercializing specialized domain apps. You will leverage modern AI coding tools to maintain high developer velocity, ensuring architectural consistency across the ecosystem. 

You Will

- Architecting the Platform: Building and scaling decoupled applications using our standard MFE architecture (Webpack 5 Module Federation) and Django/PostgreSQL microservices. Impact: This reduces DevOps overhead and ensures independent, scalable deployments. 
 - Driving High-Impact Integrations: Leading strategic initiatives, such as integrating the DMA Government application into the commercial Avathon Platform as a standardized MFE and Microservice. Impact: This standardizes our tech stack, eliminates redundant code, and accelerates our commercial go-to-market strategy. 
 - Building AI-Grounded Features: Developing features that interact seamlessly with our AI Model Garden APIs and Central Knowledge Graph (CKG). 
 - Maximizing Developer Velocity: Utilizing reusable platform patterns and heavily leveraging AI development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc. ) to rapidly take products from prototype to production. 
 - Collaborating Globally: Working with cross-functional teams to extend our foundational backend data tier, including robust identity/access control and event-driven webhooks. 

You'll Have

- BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, with a strong foundation in system design and data structures. 
 - 4+ years of experience building and deploying scalable full-stack applications. (Startup experience is a plus). 
 - Frontend Expertise: Deep experience with React 18, TypeScript, and modern state/form management tools like Redux Toolkit, React Router v7, and React Hook Form + Zod. 
 - Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python, Django 5. x, and PostgreSQL, with experience designing both REST APIs and GraphQL endpoints. 
 - AI-Assisted Development: Proven experience utilizing AI tools (e. g. , Copilot, Claude) to accelerate coding, debugging, and test generation. 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile software development tools. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with Micro Front-End (MFE) architectures or migrating monoliths to decoupled services. 
 - Experience with Graph databases or utilizing a Central Knowledge Graph for spatial/relational querying. 
 - Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems like Keycloak (OIDC/OAuth2) and implementing strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). 
 - Experience with modern CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS. 
 - Experience building event-driven systems, asynchronous message queues, or webhook dispatchers. 

Interview Process

As part of the interview process, you will be asked to complete a technical case study assessment. Expect atleast two-three rounds of Technical interviewing rounds and one onsite round. 

Avathon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

Avathon is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us to discuss how we can assist you.

data.title: Software Engineer III, Frontend
data.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. 

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver. 

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. 

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. 
 - Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
 - Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. 

THE ROLE

Software Engineer III, Frontend

We're looking for a Software Engineer III, Frontend to design, build, and maintain high-quality frontend applications that deliver exceptional experiences for Quince customers. 

In this role, you'll take ownership of frontend features and technical problems, work closely with cross-functional teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions, and contribute to the quality, performance, and maintainability of our frontend systems. You'll also play an active role in code reviews, technical decision-making, and mentoring junior engineers. 

The ideal candidate has strong frontend fundamentals, hands-on experience with modern web technologies, and the ability to independently solve complex technical problems while raising the engineering bar across the team. 

Responsibilities

Frontend Development: 

- Design, develop, and maintain high-quality frontend applications using modern web technologies. 
 - Own frontend features and modules from requirements through implementation, testing, and production. 
 - Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and well-documented code. 
 - Build reusable components and frontend patterns that improve development efficiency and consistency. 
 - Make thoughtful technical decisions around architecture, implementation, and trade-offs. 

Performance & Reliability

- Identify and resolve frontend performance bottlenecks and technical issues. 
 - Apply performance optimization techniques to improve application responsiveness, scalability, and user experience. 
 - Debug and troubleshoot complex technical issues across development and production environments. 
 - Contribute to improving frontend reliability, maintainability, and overall application quality. 

Quality & Engineering Practices

- Develop and maintain comprehensive test cases to ensure high-quality and reliable code. 
 - Participate actively in code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to peers. 
 - Establish and follow frontend engineering best practices around code quality, testing, debugging, and maintainability. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve development workflows, tooling, and engineering practices. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Collaborate with Product, Design, Backend, and other engineering teams to define requirements and implement scalable solutions. 
 - Translate product and business requirements into well-designed technical solutions. 
 - Communicate technical decisions, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs effectively. 
 - Work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative engineering environment. 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Mentor and guide junior engineers through technical discussions, code reviews, and day-to-day problem solving. 
 - Contribute to technical design discussions and help establish frontend development standards. 
 - Stay current with emerging frontend technologies, frameworks, and best practices. 
 - Evaluate and recommend technologies and approaches that can improve Quince applications. 

Qualifications

Required

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. 
 - 5-8 years of professional experience in frontend development. 
 - Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and related web technologies. 
 - Strong experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue. js. 
 - Proficiency in debugging tools and techniques. 
 - Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and asynchronous programming. 
 - Knowledge of web security principles and techniques. 
 - Experience with frontend performance optimization techniques. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently as well as part of a team. 
 - Experience mentoring or guiding junior engineers. 

Preferred

- Experience building consumer-facing or high-scale web applications. 
 - Strong understanding of frontend architecture and reusable component design. 
 - Experience with frontend testing frameworks and automated testing practices. 
 - Experience with browser performance profiling and optimization. 
 - Familiarity with modern frontend build tools, CI/CD, and deployment workflows. 
 - Experience working closely with Product, Design, and Backend engineering teams. 
 - Experience in fast-paced, high-growth technology or ecommerce environments. 

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. 

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

data.description:

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in testing Salesforce solutions, with a particular focus on Salesforce CPQ functionality, expertise in QA automation, and a solid understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud. Key Responsibilities

- Prepare and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scripts for Salesforce applications, with a primary focus on Salesforce CPQ and Sales Cloud.

 - Define test environment and test data requirements, and collaborate with development teams to ensure test readiness. 
 - Validate Salesforce CPQ business processes, including product configuration, pricing and product rules, quoting, approvals, amendments, renewals, and order management.

 - Conduct sanity testing to ensure applications are production-ready before deployment. 
 - Track, prioritize, and report defects using Jira or similar tools, ensuring timely resolution. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes and automation practices. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Minimum 5 years of experience in functional and automation testing of Salesforce applications. 
 - At least 2 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce CPQ functionality testing. 
 - Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud business processes and functionality. 
 - Expertise in at least one QA automation tool, such as Playwright, Provar, Selenium, or an equivalent automation framework. 
 - Experience in preparing test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test cases. 
 - Hands-on experience with API testing (REST/SOAP) and integration validation. 
 - Strong understanding of the Salesforce data model, security model, and platform customizations. 
 - Experience with regression test automation and test execution. 
 - Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience using Jira or similar defect management tools. 
 - Experience working in client-facing roles with strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Exposure to Salesforce Billing functionality and testing. 
 - Experience conducting load and performance testing. 
 - Knowledge of Revenue Cloud processes. 
 - Experience validating Salesforce integrations with external applications. 

Desirable Skills

- Exposure to Salesforce Service Cloud. 
 - Exposure to Salesforce Experience Cloud. 
 - Knowledge of Salesforce automation frameworks such as TestNG.

API & System Integration

- Proficient with Linux/Unix & Cloud environments, including shell scripting, command-line tooling, and system-level automation. 
 - Experience supporting virtualized environments such as VMware and Hyper-V for automated deployment and validation of virtual network components. 
 - Understanding of containerized network instances (Kubernetes/Docker). 

Data & Test Validation

- Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and Vertica, including writing SQL queries for data validation, reporting, and test data management. 

Automation Testing & Operations

- Experience developing automated test scenarios for networking platforms, including network traffic packet capture analysis (Wireshark/tcpdump), traffic validation, configuration verification, and performance testing. 
 - Support operational automation for network maintenance activities such as migrations, upgrades, and validation of deployment. 

CICD and Version Control

- Knowledge of version control systems like Git and Bitbucket. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD principles and tools like GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions. 

Additional Knowledge/Technical Skillset Preferences

- Deep Packet Inspection (DPI): Experience with Sandvine/AppLogic infrastructure components (PTS, ActiveLogic, Maestro). 
 - SD-WAN Excellence: Architecture and operational management awareness with at least one major vendor platform (Cisco, Kognitive). 
 - Routing & Switching: Awareness of service provider routing protocols, specifically BGP, OSPF, MPLS, and Carrier-Grade NAT (CGNAT). 
 - Linux & Cloud Environments: Strong foundation in Linux networking, packet capture analysis (Wireshark/tcpdump), shell scripting, and an understanding of containerized network instances (Kubernetes/Docker). 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology with 5+ years of experience in automation development, network testing, or infrastructure automation. 

-

Global Logistics Operations | SCM

Function

Logistics

Pune, India

India and global regions

Leadership and Behavioral Competencies

- Role Purpose Lead a logistics operations team of 8-15 members and ensure safe, compliant, accurate and timely execution of export, import, planning, documentation, order management and customer-service activities. The role is accountable for daily delivery, team capability, stakeholder coordination, KPI performance, issue resolution and continuous improvement across India and assigned global regions. 
 - Key Responsibilities A. Team Leadership and People Management
 - Plan and allocate work, set daily priorities and balance team capacity to meet operational commitments and service levels. 
 - Supervise, coach and motivate team members; provide regular feedback and create a collaborative, accountable and healthy work environment. 
 - Monitor individual and team performance, identify skill gaps and implement training, cross-training, backup and development plans. 
 - Manage attendance, shift coverage, workload continuity and succession readiness for critical processes. 
 - Listen to team feedback and resolve operational issues or conflicts promptly; escalate material risks to the Associate Lead / Senior Team Lead. 
 - Support onboarding, knowledge transfer and process transitions while ensuring adequate documentation and stabilization. 
 - Oversee end-to-end export execution across air, ocean and rail, from cargo readiness and booking through customs clearance, loading, shipment tracking and bill of lading release. 
 - Ensure shipment planning is aligned with customer orders, Incoterms, inventory availability, plant readiness and dispatch targets. 
 - Coordinate with plants, planners, dispatch, quality, customer service, sales, finance, warehouses and inventory teams to ensure smooth order fulfilment. 
 - Liaise with customs brokers, transporters, freight forwarders, shipping lines, CFS, third-party inspection agencies and other service partners. 
 - Provide advance container and shipment-volume forecasts to logistics service providers and monitor bookings, vessel space, gate-in and loading progress. 
 - Resolve shipment exceptions involving documentation, customs, carriers, ports, warehouses or allied agencies and minimize customer impact. 
 - Ensure accurate and timely preparation, verification and retention of pre-shipment, post-shipment, commercial and customs documents. 
 - Oversee customer order and sales order-purchase order activities, sales contracts, returns, open-order tracking and inventory-related coordination where assigned. 
 - Ensure timely and accurate SAP transactions, including shipment-status updates, STO, goods receipt, BOL creation, PGI/PGR, production or stock postings and related logistics entries. 
 - Validate shipment and customs information such as product details, tariff classification, duties and commercial invoice data; drive closure of missing or incorrect documents. 
 - Ensure customers and internal stakeholders receive timely and accurate shipment-status updates. 
 - Ensure adherence to applicable EXIM policy, customs rules, Incoterms, payment terms, UCP rules, hazardous-cargo requirements and destination-country regulations. 
 - Maintain process controls, SOP compliance, documentation discipline and audit readiness across assigned activities. 
 - Monitor international trade and compliance changes relevant to operations and support timely implementation of required controls. 
 - Manage escalations through structured root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive action (RCA/CAPA), with clear ownership and closure tracking. 
 - Lead operational governance reviews with stakeholders and service providers, track actions and communicate risks, decisions and support requirements. 
 - Monitor KPIs and service levels covering dispatch achievement, documentation turnaround, delivery performance, shipment cost, transaction accuracy, backlog and customer satisfaction. 
 - Prepare accurate MIS, dashboards and management presentations; use data analysis to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities. 
 - Drive continuous improvement, standardization, automation and process-control initiatives to improve productivity, quality, cost and customer experience. 
 - Proactively manage operational constraints and develop recovery plans to protect business continuity and monthly targets. 
 - Support new process transitions and stabilization for India and global regions, including knowledge capture, training and performance tracking. 
 - Internal: Associate Lead / Senior Team Lead, Global Operations Lead, plants, planning, dispatch, QC, customer service, sales, commercial, finance, inventory, warehouses, IT and compliance teams. 
 - External: Customs brokers/CHAs, transporters, freight forwarders, shipping lines, CFS/ports, warehouses, vendors and third-party inspection agencies. 
 - Bachelor's degree with relevant experience; MBA in Supply Chain Management, International Business or Operations is preferred. 
 - Diploma or certification in EXIM, logistics or supply chain management is desirable. 
 - Typically 8-12 years of relevant experience in logistics, EXIM, supply chain or global operations, including at least 2-4 years of team-leading or supervisory experience. 
 - Experience in a manufacturing organization with comparable global logistics activities is preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of end-to-end export/import processes, international transportation, customs regulations, Incoterms, payment terms and UCP rules. 
 - Working knowledge of hazardous-cargo handling and shipment requirements. 
 - Hands-on experience with SAP logistics transactions and shipment/order tracking. 
 - Advanced working proficiency in Excel; ability to prepare clear MIS, dashboards and management presentations. 
 - Strong data-analysis, problem-solving, RCA/CAPA and process-improvement capability. 
 - Fluent written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate effectively across regions and time zones. 
 - People leadership, coaching and performance management 
 - Stakeholder and customer management 
 - Ownership, proactive execution and sound decision-making 
 - Planning, prioritization and time management 
 - Collaboration, conflict resolution and interpersonal effectiveness 
 - Ability to remain composed and deliver in a dynamic, high-pressure environment 
 - Continuous-improvement and transformation mindset 
 - High standards of ethics, compliance, accuracy and accountability

This role includes developing department talent, defining and executing V&V department strategy, engineering process management, provide technical guidance, mentoring, drive consistent design practices and common global processes for projects implementation and provide technical solution that meets the needs of NPI, Product Care and Project Delivery. 

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities: 

- Providing strategic and tactical direction for Verification and Validation of HVDC Control and Protection System in collaboration with Grid and HVDC technology groups. 
 - Accountable for establishing process to assess, review and record the testing needs and boundaries of each project to ensure that the control system is verified to the maximum extent possible before leaving the factory. 
 - Leading the generation of plans, procedures and specifications for the Development of Integration System Tests, Full System Tests, and Factory Acceptance Tests and Commissioning Tests at site. 
 - Accountable for developing, maintaining and Preparing Test Management Plans & Solutions. 
 - Accountable for the coordination of HVDC testing and validation process steps from Lab Testing, Factory System Testing and Site System testing leading to the Customer acceptance of HVDC Control & Protection System. 
 - Maintain a clear overview of the HVDC NTI-NPI-Project life cycles thereby de-risking the product development by clearly defining the testing needs to validate the requirements. 
 - Accountable for technical validation of processes and test specifications. 
 - Accountable for defining and executing Continuous Improvement for V&V department in collaboration with other HVDC Control & Protection Engineering teams. 
 - Ensure sufficient de-risking is included in Product plans, such that quality problems due to the introduction of new technologies are avoided when the new technologies are deployed on Projects. 
 - The Enforcement of engineering discipline and set processes across all work tasks and adherence to company policies, quality procedures and work instructions (e. g. through training, technical reviews). 
 - Reviewing the validation and verification department's skills, identifying any shortfalls or skills gaps to ensure the necessary training, guidance and mentoring of Engineers is in place. 
 - Serve as approver for technical reviews and quality gates / project milestones. 
 - Lead V&V team to identify opportunities for new IP development. 
 - Lead and mentor V&V team in customer communications to define quality and testing expectation from the project kick-off till final sign off. 
 - Develop and mentor V&V team members so that they can be represent the business in various Industry working groups as a key content contributor. 
 - Will be accountable in defining strategies and roadmap for development of New Engineers in the department. 

Qualifications & Requirements

- Degree in Electronics / Electrical engineering or related field. 
 - Significant and demonstrated years of experience in power generation, systems design, development and operation of Control System
 - Exceptional interpersonal and technical leadership skills. 
 - Experienced within Verification & Validation of HVDC Control System. 
 - Competent in HVDC Control, Protection, Sequencing strategy and HVDC Dynamic Performance Studies. 
 - Competent in PSCAD / MATLAB-SIMULINK and RTDS applications. 
 - Proactively serves on cross functional leadership teams; Makes decisions independently. 
 - Knowledge of Control and Protection cubicle Circuit Diagram, field cabling protection relays, HV/MV/LV switchgear, IED's and Distributed control system. 
 - Knowledge of Test-Driven Design techniques (e. g. CI / Continuous Integration, Unit Testing, Automated Regression testing). 
 - Competent in Requirements Management and Test Traceability Matrix. 
 - Knowledge of Change Control and issue tracking (e. g. CCB, Jira). 
 - Advanced oral and written communication skills with fluency in English language. 
 - Ability to understand and communicate customer requirements, ownership of technical discussions with customers and capable of developing client relationships. 

Desired Characteristics

 - Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. 
 - Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.

data.description:
Recruitment Scam Notice: Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as "name@cvent. com" email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. For more information, visit Cvent's Recruitment Fraud Notice. https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. 

About Cvent: 

www. cvent. com

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5, 500+ employees and ~30, 000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we're transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection. 

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4. 6B in 2023. 

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. 

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection. 

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. 

Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Role Overview

Splash is Cvent's event marketing platform. We are standing up a new engineering team in Bengaluru with a single charter: build the AI-powered features that will define the next generation of Splash. You will build this team from zero, then lead it as a peer to the established Splash engineering and product teams in Bengaluru, North America, and Spain, who own adjacent parts of the platform and with whom you will plan, design, and ship. 

This is an AI-first role in two senses. The team ships AI into the product, and the team builds software with AI: agentic coding tools, spec-driven development, and disciplined review of AI-generated output are the default way of working here, not an experiment. We are looking for a manager whose value comes from engineering judgment and a high quality bar rather than from the volume of code they personally write. You will decide what gets built and how, set the standard for what is good enough to ship, and hold the team to it. 

Reporting line: Director of Engineering, Splash India. Team size: 4-5 engineers by the end of the first year, hired by you. 

In This Role, You Will: 

Build the team (your main job in year one)

- Hire the founding team from 0 to 4-5: define the roles and levels, run the hiring loop end to end, close candidates, and onboard them to be productive quickly. 
 - Establish the team's engineering standards, operating rhythm, and ways of working from day one, including how AI tools are used, reviewed, and measured. 
 - Create a culture where engineers own outcomes, learn fast, and hold a high bar for quality. 

Lead delivery of AI features for Splash

- Own execution of the AI feature roadmap for Splash in partnership with Product, Design, and the Splash teams in Bangalore, North America, and Spain. 
 - Make architecture and technology decisions for the team's services and front ends; ensure what ships meets non-functional requirements (security, scalability, resiliency, accessibility, performance) and responsible-AI expectations. 
 - Run the team across time zones: coordinate dependencies, manage production issues and incidents, and keep stakeholders informed with clear, honest status. 

Set the engineering bar in an AI-native workflow

- Define how the team works with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development: what a good spec looks like, when to delegate to an agent, and what must be verified by a human. 
 - Be the quality gate. Review designs, AI-generated code, tests, and evaluations for correctness, security, and maintainability, and teach the team to do the same. 
 - Keep the team's tooling and practices current as the AI development landscape changes, and share what works with the wider Splash organization. 

Grow people

- Coach engineers, set goals, give direct and timely feedback, and run performance reviews and career development. 

Here's What You Need: 

These are requirements, not nice-to-haves. We expect candidates to meet all of them. 

- People management and hiring. 12+ years of software engineering experience, with depth in backend systems and 3+ years managing software engineers, with a track record of hiring, onboarding, and growing strong engineers, and the appetite to do that here from the ground up. 
 - Depth in our stack. Java with Spring Boot for backend services; React or Next. js with TypeScript on the front end; GraphQL APIs; relational and NoSQL databases; event-driven microservices on AWS. 
 - Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development. You use tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot agents in your own work: writing specs an agent can execute, reviewing and correcting its output, and knowing where these tools fail. This must be lived experience, not familiarity with the concepts. 
 - Strong engineering judgment. You can evaluate a design or a change for correctness, security, scalability, and maintainability without having written it yourself, and you have a track record of owning non-functional requirements for production systems. 
 - Experience shipping AI product features. You have taken LLM-powered functionality to production (for example retrieval, agents, or structured generation) and understand evaluation, prompt and model lifecycle, cost, latency, and failure modes. 
 - Cross-geography collaboration. Proven ability to work as a peer with engineering, product, design, and SRE teams in other regions and time zones, including in a matrixed or distributed organization. 
 - Clear communication. You write specs, decisions, and status updates that people in other time zones can act on without a meeting, and you can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience forming a team from scratch (0 to N): defining roles and levels, standing up the hiring loop, and establishing norms rather than inheriting an existing team. 
 - Experience in event, marketing, or martech products, or other B2B SaaS with high-volume customer-facing workflows. 
 - Experience building evaluation frameworks or observability for LLM features in production.

Product 2: Handling mobile data sessions, doing protocol conversion, session correlation, hiding network topology. 

Product 3: Sending notifications to subscribers via SMS, email, push and other protocol, based on incoming requests, remote servers availability. 

All these products are designed for network intensive communication, are based on event driven application server and handle tens of thousands operations per second. 

What will your job look like?

As the Non Functional Testing Lead, you will own the quality and reliability of the products under real world telecom workloads. You will design, drive, and evolve the full non functional test strategy across performance, scalability, resilience, stability, and resource efficiency.

 - Design and Execute NFT Scenarios

 - Simulate complex operator environments including network latencies, bandwidth constraints, and protocol interactions. 
 - Identify and Analyze Performance Issues
 - Detect bottlenecks in production or staging environments. 
 - Localize issues (high CPU load, memory leaks, locked threads, DB-related, network-related), reproduce them in controlled test setups, and collaborate with developers to resolve them. 
 - Measure & Optimize System Behavior
 - Track KPIs such as throughput, latency, CPU/memory usage, GC performance, DB query performance, and network I/O efficiency. 
 - Provide tuning recommendations across Java, databases, OS, hardware, and configuration layers. 
 - Own and Improve NFT Tooling & Automation
 - Maintain and optimize the non functional regression suite.

 - Enhance observability through metrics, logs, dumps, and monitoring dashboards.

About Us: 

Marriott International Inc. , headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine-seat A&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 10, 000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories. 

From such humble beginnings to becoming the world's largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At Marriott Tech Accelerator center (MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. Marriott Tech Accelerator is an ANSR entity incorporated exclusively for providing services to Marriott International.

We are looking for a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead the architecture, design, and development of large-scale enterprise applications and Loyalty platforms. This role requires a hands-on technology leader who can drive engineering excellence, influence technical strategy, mentor senior engineers, and collaborate with product, business, and architecture teams to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure solutions. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in Java and cloud-native technologies with strong leadership skills and a passion for solving complex business challenges. Partner with MI Infrastructure, Cloud, and DevOps teams to drive the adoption of enterprise DevOps strategy, architecture, best practices, and standards across the Loyalty Engineering organization. Contribute to the continuous improvement and optimization of scalable, cloud-native platforms, encompassing APIs and microservices that support customer and loyalty capabilities.

 - Familiarity with version control systems (e. g. , Git) and collaborative development workflows 
 - Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, design patterns

Who We Are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking a Performance Test Engineer to deliver performance and non-functional testing services within VOIS across telecommunications platforms, services and components. You will develop performance test strategies, plans, scripts and scenarios, execute tests and analyse results against agreed quality standards, milestones and service levels. 

The role requires practical experience in performance testing within multinational environments and the ability to work across Cloud, CRM and Middleware domains. You will collaborate with application teams, product owners, IT Operations, developers and multiple vendors to identify performance issues, communicate findings and continuously improve testing practices. 

What You'll Do

- Understand telecommunications technology stacks, delivery approaches and strategic initiatives to define appropriate performance testing strategies 
 - Plan, script, execute and coordinate performance and non-functional testing activities 
 - Develop dynamic scripts and realistic performance test scenarios using tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter and SOAP UI 
 - Analyse non-functional requirements (NFRs), workloads and volumetric requirements to establish appropriate test coverage 
 - Analyse performance test results and communicate findings clearly in both technical and business language 
 - Develop and maintain the NFT test strategy, reflecting changes in risks, schedules and testing processes 
 - Collaborate with application teams to investigate and resolve performance issues 
 - Monitor application and infrastructure behaviour using APM and diagnostic tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, HP Diagnostics and CA Wily 
 - Support performance analysis across Java/JVM architecture, garbage collection, class loading, thread dumps and Oracle and SQL Server databases 
 - Work within CI/CD and cloud-based environments using technologies such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Gatling, GitHub and Maven 
 - Support testing across Kubernetes, microservices, AWS Cloud and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure environments 
 - Use C, Java, SQL, shell scripting and VB macros where appropriate to customise test scripts and automate processes 
 - Increase test automation and promote reusable assets, including scripts and input datasets 
 - Maintain testing deliverables in accordance with agreed methodologies and industry standards 
 - Identify, document and support the resolution of defects through the agreed defect management process 
 - Identify lessons learnt, recommend best practices and implement continuous improvements to testing processes 
 - Communicate risks and issues to project teams, test management and other relevant stakeholders 
 - Provide regular and ad-hoc progress reporting to the Test Team Lead

Who You Are

- You have proven experience delivering performance software testing solutions across multinational and distributed environments 
 - You have practical experience with performance testing tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter and SOAP UI, including Web HTTP and other relevant protocols 
 - You understand performance test scripting, execution, analysis and performance bottleneck identification 
 - You have experience working with CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and microservices 
 - You understand Java/JVM performance concepts, databases and application/server performance metrics 
 - You have experience using application performance monitoring and profiling tools 
 - You can analyse NFRs and volumetric requirements and translate them into effective performance tests 
 - You have knowledge of C, Java, SQL, shell scripting and automation techniques 
 - Experience with supporting diagnostic tools such as Fiddler, browser developer tools, HAR files and Lighthouse would be advantageous 
 - You understand testing standards and structured defect management practices 
 - You communicate effectively with product owners, developers, IT Operations, testing professionals and other stakeholders 
 - You take a thorough, quality-focused and methodical approach to your work 
 - You can collaborate effectively within a changing, multicultural and matrix organisation 
 - You are fluent in English and able to communicate technical information to technical and business audiences 
 - You are able to travel to Europe intermittently where required

Not a perfect fit?

Worried that you don't meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity. 

What's In It For You

Opportunity to work on performance engineering within a large-scale telecommunications technology environment. 

Exposure to Cloud, CRM, Middleware, microservices and CI/CD ecosystems. 

Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, product owners, developers, IT Operations and multiple vendors in an international environment. 

Opportunity to influence performance testing practices through automation, reusable assets and continuous improvement. 

Exposure to projects spanning multiple technologies and geographies.

- Advanced performance testing and analysis across telecommunications applications and services

 - CI/CD-integrated performance testing and greater test automation 
 - Deeper application and infrastructure performance analysis using APM and diagnostic tooling 
 - Performance troubleshooting across Java/JVM and database technologies 
 - Stakeholder communication and performance reporting within multinational technology programmes 
 - Development of reusable non-functional testing approaches, assets and continuous improvement practices

approval workflow, payment, notification and certificate issue.

actual results; verify fixes.

Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply or message us directly with your CV.

data.title: Associate Engineer - Stores [T500-29972]
data.description:
About Officeworks: 

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". We are Australia's leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create and Geeks2U. We begin with customers-our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia, from households, students, small to large-sized businesses, governments, and schools. 

Role Summary: 

The Associate Engineer - Stores builds, tests, and supports software solutions across Officeworks store systems, encompassing point of sale (POS), mobile POS, store handheld devices (PDTs), and supporting middleware. Operating within a delivery pod, the role delivers assigned work packages within patterns and designs established by senior engineers. 

The role builds technical and domain depth across front-end, back-end, database, and device platforms while contributing to system availability, code quality, and resolution of operational issues. By growing capability across the Stores application suite, the role supports in-store team members and trading continuity. 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 2+ years of experience in software engineering, inclusive of internship or practical project experience. 
 - Core Technologies: Foundational capability in at least one of C#, . NET, Node. js, or JavaScript frameworks (React, HTML, CSS). 
 - Data and Cloud: Exposure to Microsoft SQL Server, AWS services, and REST/SOAP integration architectures. 
 - Engineering Tools: Working familiarity with Git-based version control, CI/CD deployment pipelines, and secure coding principles. 
 - Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound technical fundamentals and high attention to detail. 
 - Continuous Support: Exposure to ITIL-aligned incident and problem management, with an understanding of root cause remediation. 
 - Collaboration: Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work within a pod-based agile team across distributed locations. 

Preferred: 

- Retail Domain: Exposure to retail technology systems where downtime has direct revenue impact, including POS, payment flows, or store device fleets. 
 - Mobile and Device Platforms: Exposure to mobile and device application frameworks (e. g. Cordova, React Native or native Android/iOS). 
 - Modern Tooling: Experience working with AI-assisted engineering tools and automated test frameworks. 

In this role you will: 

Software Engineering and Technical Delivery: 

- Design, build, test, and release changes to Stores applications and integrations for assigned work packages, meeting agreed quality standards and delivery timeframes. 
 - Write clean, maintainable code following patterns, designs, and architectural standards established by senior engineers. 
 - Contribute to detailed technical designs for assigned work packages and participate constructively in design reviews. 
 - Build working knowledge of the Stores application suite and how changes flow through to store trading. 

Production Stability and Operational Support: 

- Investigate, triage, and resolve incidents and defects across Stores systems, contributing to root cause analysis and escalating promptly with full operational context where the cause is unclear. 
 - Maintain operational health of assigned components, recognizing that Stores system downtime directly impacts retail trading. 
 - Participate in the team on-call roster as technical capability allows, providing after-hours support and incident response as required. 
 - Maintain disaster recovery plans and operational documentation across assigned Stores applications and integrations. 

Quality Engineering and Secure Development: 

- Develop and maintain automated tests for changes delivered, treating test coverage as an integral component of delivery rather than a separate phase. 
 - Follow pod release and testing standards to minimize change failure rates and defect escapes. 
 - Participate in peer code reviews as both an author and reviewer to uphold code quality and consistency across application repositories. 
 - Apply Officeworks secure coding, cybersecurity, and privacy standards across all engineering deliverables, remediating identified vulnerabilities under senior guidance. 

Collaboration and Capability Building: 

- Participate actively in pod planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and agile delivery ceremonies, contributing to shared operational ownership. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools as standard practice during code generation, test automation, and refactoring, maintaining rigorous human peer review as the commit gate. 
 - Cross-skill across front-end, back-end, database, and device technologies outside primary specializations to support flexible pod capacity. 
 - Actively seek coaching, pair programming, and code feedback from Engineers and Senior Engineers to build retail domain depth. 
 - Contribute to the pod's Definition of Done, and document Stores systems, architecture, and operational procedures as learning progresses.

About Us: 

ClearRoute is an engineering consultancy bridging Quality Engineering, Cloud Platforms and Developer Experience. We help enterprises reliably bring high-impact digital products to market faster, cheaper, and safer, working with technology leaders facing complex business challenges. 

We take as much pride in our people, culture and work-life balance as we do in making better software. We're not just making better software. We're making the making of software better. Our values challenge us to do the best we can for ClearRoute, our customers and most importantly our team. - Monitor the health, latency, availability and error rates of AI services, model endpoints and supporting infrastructure. 
 - Triage, investigate and resolve incidents, from failed API calls and rate limiting to degraded model output quality. 
 - Run root-cause analysis and write clear, blameless post-incident reviews with follow-up actions. 
 - Take part in a shared on-call rota for production AI services. Platform reliability and observability
 - Build and maintain dashboards, alerts and logging for LLM workloads, including token usage, latency, cost and evaluation metrics. 
 - Maintain and improve deployment pipelines for models, prompts, agents and RAG components. 
 - Manage vector databases, embedding pipelines and data ingestion jobs. 
 - Automate repetitive support tasks and runbooks. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Act as the escalation point for AI platform issues raised by delivery teams and client users. 
 - Write and maintain runbooks, knowledge-base articles and user guidance. 
 - Feed recurring issues and improvement ideas back to engineering and product owners. 
 - Help onboard new teams and clients onto the platform. 

Required Experience: 

- 3+ years in platform support, site reliability engineering, DevOps or production support for cloud-hosted services. 
 - Hands-on experience supporting applications built on LLM APIs (for example OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI). 
 - Strong working knowledge of at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP). 
 - Comfortable with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Scripting and automation in Python plus Bash or PowerShell. 
 - Experience with observability tooling such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch or Azure Monitor. 
 - CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code experience (for example GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Terraform). 
 - Solid grasp of REST APIs, authentication, networking basics and log analysis. 
 - Proven incident management experience, including writing post-incident reviews. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical aud

Desirable Experience:

 - ITIL, Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD) or cloud certifications. 
 - Experience in a consultancy or client-facing delivery environment, ideally in regulated sectors such as energy or financial services. 

Working at ClearRoute

We have grown from six founders to 180+ people across five countries in three years, and what sets us apart isn't the pace, it's how we grow. 

- Real flexibility, in practice. We trust you to perform at your best and still have a life outside of work, with genuine hybrid working, a home office budget, an open feedback culture where your voice shapes decisions, and time off when life needs it (birthday included). 
 - When ClearRoute wins, you win. We offer profit share so success is shared, meaningful recognition for great work, and benefits that look after you and your family, including private healthcare, competitive salary benchmarking, and a confidential employee assistance program covering counselling, mental health support, and financial wellbeing. 
 - A community you'll genuinely want to be part of. Interest based communities like running and book clubs, Women in Tech group, monthly socials, and cross regional events bring people together across the company. An inclusive, collaborative culture where you don't need to conform to succeed, where people support one another and feel comfortable being themselves. 
 - Where meaningful work meets real growth. You will tackle complex, real world problems at the forefront of platform engineering, AI, security, and scalable systems. Your growth is supported by learning budgets, Udemy access, a clear career framework, internal mobility, and thought leadership opportunities that take your impact beyond ClearRoute. 

At ClearRoute, we believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes, and inclusion creates the conditions for everyone to thrive. We are proud to have built a family friendly working environment and have many employees who have caring responsibilities alongside work. We welcome applications from people who require flexibility and will be happy to discuss needs on an individual basis. 

We are committed to fostering a culture where all team members feel respected, supported, and empowered to do their best work. We celebrate individuality and our differences and understand that some differences may mean that you require changes made to the interview process. We are happy to cater to your needs to make the interview accessible, if this is something you require please let us know by emailing us at join@clearroute. io

You will shape architecture and investment across backend services, telemetry platforms, data pipelines, metrics, and diagnostic workflows; grow senior technical and management talent; and drive coordinated execution that improves Windows health at scale.

Job type: Full-time

About Aangee

Aangee is a masterbatch and polymer manufacturer based in Ahmedabad. We are hiring a hands-on QC Manager to own quality across incoming material, in-process checks and final batch release at our Moraiya plant. Know more: https: //aangee. com

📍 Location: B 65/66, Akshar Industrial Park 2, Opp. Zydus Cadila, Moraiya, Ahmedabad 382213

🕘 Work hours: 9 am - 7 pm (Sunday working, Tuesday weekly off)

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Incoming material checks

- Ensure MFI, moisture, ash and colour are tested against the COA for every incoming lot of resin, pigment, filler and additive

- Take the clear-or-hold decision on each lot before it goes to production

- Inform purchase of any off-spec material

In-process checks

- Ensure CPG (count program), bulk density, MFI and FPV are run on every batch at the set frequency

- Authorise stoppage of any line when readings fall outside limits

Colour and batch release

- Ensure shade is matched on the spectrophotometer against the approved standard

- Check appearance (PA) of the masterbatch and of the article (chips or film)

- Approve or reject each batch and sign the COA

Complaints and rejections

- Lead the investigation into customer complaints and establish root cause

- Ensure complaints are closed with corrective action within a fixed timeline

Lab, records and team

- Keep instruments calibrated and the lab stocked

- Maintain test SOPs and records for ISO and customer audits

- Supervise and train QC staff across shifts

- Set the release specification for every new grade before it is sold

- Report monthly on rejection %, rework % and complaints

WHO YOU ARE

- Education: B. E. /B. Tech in Polymer or Plastics Engineering, Chemistry or Chemical Engineering (CIPET diploma acceptable with strong experience)

- Experience: 5-10 years in QC in masterbatch, compounding or polymer processing, with 2-3 years handling a team

- Hands-on with MFI, bulk density, FPV, ash and moisture testing

- Able to operate a spectrophotometer and judge colour shade by eye, not only by ΔE

- Understands how extrusion settings affect dispersion and colour, so faults can be traced back to the line

- Languages: Fluent in Hindi and Gujarati; English sufficient for COAs, complaint replies and audits

HOW TO APPLY

 - Support User Experience Through Backend Excellence: Ensure backend systems enable smooth, intuitive, and reliable experiences in customer-facing applications. 
 - Foster Innovation & Experimentation: Encourage prototyping, instrumentation, and data-driven experimentation to validate ideas and drive platform improvements.

Technology You'll Encounter

🚀 About Joveo

Joveo builds AI-powered recruiting technology. We are building a team to deliver specialist human data and AI evaluation programs, with expert judgment at the centre of the work.

🌟 About the role

Build the function that turns specialist human expertise into AI data and evaluations customers can rely on. 

You will work with Joveo leadership to shape the offering, hire the managers who deliver it and establish the standards we commit to. Your remit includes customer delivery and portfolio economics, with influence over the tools and capabilities we develop. 

For someone who has already led complex AI programs, this is an opportunity to put that experience to work across an entire function. You will help decide which opportunities we pursue, what a successful pilot must demonstrate and how we grow without losing control of quality or cost. 

🧠 What you'll do

- Shape the offering with leadership. Identify the customer problems we can solve well, define the deliverables and acceptance standards, and establish what we need to prove before expanding a service. 
 - Build the delivery leadership team. Hire and develop program managers and specialist leads. Give them clear accountability and decision rights, and plan expert capacity around qualified demand. 
 - Establish quality standards across programs. Set expectations for expert qualification, calibration, adjudication and measurement. Work with technical specialists to challenge weak metrics and keep evaluation conclusions defensible. 
 - Lead senior customer conversations. Translate technical needs into realistic commitments, resolve difficult escalations and use customer feedback to improve the offering. Help turn successful pilots into repeat programs. 
 - Own delivery economics across the portfolio. Understand the full cost of expert supply, technical integration and rework. Partner with commercial teams on pricing, scope changes and capacity decisions. 
 - Shape tooling priorities with engineering. Turn recurring delivery problems into reusable capabilities, make deliberate choices about automation and maintain strong practices for customer data protection and traceability. 

🎯 What we're looking for

- You have built or led a delivery, operations or technical program function in AI data, evaluation, applied AI or a closely related field. 
 - You have hired or developed managers and held responsibility for complex customer outcomes. You can build a team that makes good decisions without every issue reaching you. 
 - You are credible in both a technical review and a commercial discussion. You can challenge an evaluation design, identify weak acceptance criteria and work through the implications for delivery and cost. 
 - You have made consequential operating decisions: narrowing an offering, resetting a customer commitment, changing a quality system or rebuilding a team. You can explain your reasoning and the results. 
 - Experience launching a service, turning pilots into repeat programs or operating expert contributor networks is especially relevant. We will look at the scope you have carried and the judgment you have developed. Your record of building a function matters more than the title you currently hold. 

✨ Why join Joveo

You will help shape this capability while its operating choices are still taking form. Your decisions will influence the work we pursue, the leaders we hire and the standards customers experience. 

This role brings technical delivery and commercial responsibility together. If you have strong convictions about how complex AI programs should run, you will have the scope to build an organisation around them.

You'll own technical direction, team growth, and delivery for a group of 10-15 engineers working at the intersection of LLMs, orchestration, and production infrastructure, building this platform from the ground up. 

What You'll Do

- Lead and grow a team of AI & Forward Deployed Engineers building agent orchestration, tool-use frameworks, and evaluation pipelines from zero
 - Set technical strategy for agent architecture: planning loops, memory, tool calling, multi-agent coordination, and guardrails
 - Drive the implementation of an AIDLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) approach, replacing traditional PDLC/SDLC practices across the org
 - Own the Observability and Evals strategy for agentic systems - tracing, monitoring, and eval frameworks for non-deterministic, multi-step workflows
 - Partner with product managers to translate ambiguous problems into shippable agentic features
 - Own reliability and safety practices for autonomous systems (evals, sandboxing, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, rollback strategies)
 - Drive hiring, mentorship, and career growth for your team
 - Balance hands-on technical involvement (architecture reviews, code reviews) with people management
 - Report on team velocity, system performance, and risk to leadership
 - Sketch out engineering estimations

What We're Looking For

- 12+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years managing engineering teams 
 - Direct experience building or operating LLM-powered systems (agents, RAG, tool-calling, orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom stacks)
 - Proven track record of delivering an AIDLC implementation that successfully replaced PDLC/SDLC within an engineering organisation
 - Cloud: AWS - excellent knowledge with Bedrock AgentCore, Step Functions (ASL), and related agent-hosting/orchestration services
 - Strong knowledge of Harness engineering 
 - Strong experience with Observability and Evals for non-deterministic systems (tracing, eval harnesses, monitoring, drift/regression detection)
 - Backend services: experience with Python and FastAPI
 - Frontend: working knowledge of React. js, Tailwind, and Solstice (JLL design system)
 - Track record of shipping ambiguous, fast-moving products under real constraints
 - Excellent communicator who can translate technical tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders

Nice to Have

- Experience in delivering autonomous agent safety/guardrail design
