data.title: Platform Engineer
data.description:
Role: Platform Development Engineer (RCP)

Experience: 6-12 Years

Focus: Enterprise-Scale Kubernetes, Kernel/RAN Optimization, and Release Reliability

Location- Bangalore

Why should you choose us?

Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry's pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security. 

Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit: Rakuten Symphony | Intelligent Growth. 

Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan's newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global. 

To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business - from sales to engineering, support functions to product development. 

Let's build the future of mobile telecommunications together!

About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30, 000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https: //global. rakuten. com/corp/. 

Role Overview

As an RCP Engineer, you will provide technical leadership in the design, implementation, and operation of an enterprise-scale Kubernetes platform across highly regulated on-premises environments. This role requires deep L3-level expertise in both Linux systems engineering and Kubernetes architecture. You will define the strategic direction for virtualization and OS lifecycle management, platform reliability, and advanced Linux management, working closely with security and development teams to deliver a secure, observable, and highly performant platform at extreme scale. You will also own the platform release lifecycle, ensuring that updates are stable, backward compatible, and rigorously validated. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Platform Development & Kernel Engineering (60-70%)

- Kernel-Level Fine-Tuning: Conduct deep-dive performance tuning using , , and to optimize RHEL for real-time (RT) workloads. 
 - Red Hat Expertise: Deep proficiency in RHEL 8/9, including RHEL for Real Time; manage the end-to-end OS lifecycle, including patching and upgrading the OS stack. 
 - RAN Workload Optimization: Configure and tune vCU and vDU components, ensuring efficient resource allocation for high-speed 5G network demands. 
 - Latency & Determinism: Implement CPU isolation (), IRQ affinity balancing, and NUMA alignment to achieve deterministic performance for vDU signal processing. 
 - Networking Acceleration: Optimize packet processing using DPDK (Data Plane Development Kit) and SR-IOV to bypass kernel bottlenecks for high-throughput RAN traffic. 
 - Advanced Troubleshooting: Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for high-severity incidents, utilizing tracing tools like , , and to diagnose kernel-space latencies. 
 - Automation & Infrastructure: Develop and maintain complex Ansible playbooks to automate kernel hardening and performance profile deployments across large-scale RAN clusters. 
 - Kernel Subsystems: Leverage in-depth knowledge of process scheduling (, ), memory management, and I/O schedulers. 
 - Virtualization & Containers: Manage KVM/QEMU, Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization, and containerized vDU pods in Kubernetes environments. 
 - Hardware-Software Interaction: Utilize Intel RDT (Resource Director Technology), CAT (Cache Allocation Technology), and BIOS-level tuning (e. g. , C-states, P-states). 
 - Monitoring & Hardware: Expert use of , , , , and hardware-specific utilities like ; manage hardware via Supermicro, Dell iDRAC, and HP interfaces. 2. Platform Release, QA & Reliability (30-40%)

- Release Stability & Governance: Own the platform release lifecycle, ensuring new features are backward compatible. Define the "Definition of Done" for all platform releases. 
 - Automated Validation Pipelines: Design CI/CD gates that incorporate automated testing for infrastructure-as-code and K8s manifests to ensure zero-touch, stable deployments. 
 - Performance & Chaos Testing: Establish performance baselines using tools like or to prevent latency regressions; implement resilience testing (Chaos Mesh/LitmusChaos) to validate platform stability under failure scenarios. 
 - Compliance & Vulnerability Management: Integrate security scanning (OpenSCAP) and policy enforcement (OPA/Kyverno) into the release pipeline to maintain hardened security standards. 
 - SRE Practices: Apply SRE principles at scale: perform major incident leadership, develop capacity/scalability strategies, and execute advanced change management. 

Mandatory Requirements

- Experience: 8 to 12 years of relevant telco industry experience in infrastructure engineering or SRE, with a proven track record of managing large-scale, complex environments. 
 - Kubernetes & Virtualization: Strong knowledge in bare metal Kubernetes deployments and Virtualization in development/production environments. 
 - Networking: Expertise in host-level networking, DNS/DHCP architecture, TLS management, load balancing strategies, and advanced container networking. 
 - SRE & Incident Management: Proven application of SRE practices at scale, including major incident leadership and capacity strategy development. 
 - Security Architecture: In-depth knowledge of security hardening principles, advanced RBAC models, pod security mechanisms, and secret management infrastructure. Technical Stack: 

- Core: Kubernetes, Linux (RHEL/Rocky), Docker, Helm, Git. 
 - Automation: Ansible (mandatory), Python and Shell (good to have). 
 - Certifications: RHEL Certification, CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator)

Why This Role Matters

In the era of 5G, the performance of the radio access network (RAN) is directly tied to the determinism and stability of the underlying infrastructure. As a Platform Development Engineer (RCP), you are the architect of the "digital foundation" upon which mission-critical telco workloads run. Your work ensures that the platform is not only capable of handling extreme-scale traffic with sub-millisecond latency but is also resilient, secure, and maintainable. By bridging the gap between low-level kernel optimization and high-level platform release engineering, you ensure that our network remains a competitive advantage-delivering the reliability of legacy telecommunications with the agility of modern cloud-native development. 

RAKUTEN SHUGI PRINCIPLES: 

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success. 

- Always improve, always advance. Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen. 
 - Be passionately professional. Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best. 
 - Hypothesize - Practice - Validate - Shikumika. Use the Rakuten Cycle to success in unknown territory. 
 - Maximize Customer Satisfaction. The greatest satisfaction for workers in a service industry is to see their customers smile. 
 - Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! Always be conscious of time. Take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer (SRE) - Business Intelligence
data.description:
Overview

Business Intelligence today spans a portfolio of Tier 1 and Tier 2 assets whose reliability, resiliency, and cost posture are owned ad hoc across individual app teams. We're hiring a dedicated SRE to be the single accountable owner for the health, availability, and operational excellence of these assets end-to-end - closing the gap between "best effort" reliability and a proven, tested, continuously improving one. This role sits horizontally across all BI scrum teams, partners tightly with our DBA, and is expected to build the automation and self-serve tooling that reduces the manual toil currently driving our incidents. 

Responsibilities

Reliability Ownership

- Serve as the single accountable owner for the health, availability, and completeness of all Tier 1/Tier 2 BI assets, replacing today's diffused, ad hoc ownership across app teams. 
 - Keep asset health and resiliency practices current as CI/CD evolves - progressive rollouts, canary deployments, and failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA). 
 - Partner closely with the DBA to ensure system health is covered end to end (app layer + data layer), not siloed. 

Incident Readiness

- Design and run mock incidents / game days across BI assets to surface gaps proactively, before they become customer-facing. 
 - Own disaster recovery (DR) for every asset in the BI org: plan it, test it on a recurring cadence, and produce evidence it actually works (not theoretical DR). 
 - Build automation that removes manual, error-prone operational steps - the primary source of today's incidents and customer impact. 

Engineering Excellence & Cost

- Own cloud resiliency, performance engineering, and security posture as a standing discipline across BI, not a side-of-desk responsibility for app teams. 
 - Establish and enforce operational and cost-optimization patterns across all assets (e. g. , Splunk log volume/retention hygiene, right-sizing compute). 
 - Build reusable, self-serve libraries and tooling so individual teams stop re-solving the same reliability/ops problems independently. 
 - Track Intuit-wide platform and tooling initiatives (e. g. , IKS, AIR) and drive horizontal adoption across BI so each team isn't independently absorbing migration cost. 

Qualifications

Required

- 5+ years in an SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure/platform engineering role, ideally supporting data/BI or analytics platforms. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of production reliability for multiple services/assets - on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on remediation. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and executing disaster recovery plans (not just documenting them) - including recovery testing and validation. 
 - Experience with progressive delivery practices: canary deployments, blue/green rollouts, feature-flag-gated releases. 
 - Proficiency building automation/tooling (scripting or full software engineering) to eliminate manual operational toil. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure cost management - right-sizing, log/data volume hygiene, resource tagging and chargeback. 
 - Experience with observability stacks (e. g. , Splunk or equivalent) for both incident diagnosis and cost/volume management. 
 - Strong cross-team collaboration skills - this role influences without direct authority across multiple scrum teams and a DBA function. 

Preferred

- Experience running game days / chaos engineering exercises. 
 - Familiarity with FMEA or similar systematic risk-assessment methodologies. 
 - Exposure to Intuit-specific platforms (IKS, AIR) or comparable enterprise Kubernetes/AI infra migrations. 
 - Security posture / cloud security engineering background. 
 - Experience building self-serve internal developer platforms or shared libraries consumed by multiple teams. 

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

data.title: RAMS Manager
data.description:
Hitachi Rail is looking for an enthusiastic self-motivated RAMS Manager / System Assurance Manager who thrives in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate is comfortable performing a wide range of tasks from administrative to strategic. The position is based in Bangalore, India. 

About the Position: 

The Hitachi Rail SRS RAMS Function ensures proper implementation of the Hitachi Rail SRS RAMS Policy in accordance with company and industry specific standards and best practices, provides support to enable SRS to execute its business, provides governance and guarantees segregation of duties with the aim of ensuring the safety of the solutions developed and deployed by Hitachi Rail SRS and compliance to safety principles, industry specific standards and best practices for the development and deployment of safety-critical systems. 

The RAMS Manager / System Assurance Manager coordinates the project and Product RAMS activities with SRS Business Segment RAMS so that the solutions (whether for testing or deployment to a customer for trial operations or revenue) are safe for their intended scope and purpose and is responsible to demonstrate that the solutions comply with the relevant processes, policies, legislation, standards and regulations. 

Key Accountabilities: 

- Ensure delivery of transportation solution systems in compliance with RAMS guidelines and quality standards, and in accordance with time and budget constraints
 - Provide support for RAMS/System Assurance Planning, including, Safety Management system development, Project Safety / RAMS plan development, Operational Safety / RAMS plan development, Safety Management System implementation. 
 - Ensure Safety Case development and RAM parameters performance demonstration
 - Ensure delivery of project RAMS analysis and documents at system and subsystem level in cooperation with the other technology functions, Operation & Maintenance and external suppliers. 
 - Undertaking and assessment of Qualitative and Quantitative risk assessment
 - Implementation and checking of detailed analysis including, FMECA, FTA / ETA, Root Cause Analysis, Reliability / Availability modelling

You Are

You have spent years at the intersection of digital and analog verification, and you know that the hardest part of any SerDes project is not just proving the logic works, but proving it works when the analog world throws noise, jitter, and timing chaos at it. You think in test plans, not test cases. You understand that a good verification strategy catches the corner case at block level, not during customer bring-up six months later. 

Leading a team is not new to you. You have been the person who turns a group of talented engineers into a unit that ships on time without cutting corners. You know when to dive into a waveform yourself and when to step back and let your team own the debug. You have debugged enough mixed-signal simulations to know that the answer is usually hiding in the handoff between domains, and you are comfortable living in that space. 

High-speed interfaces like PCIe, Ethernet, and USB3. 1 are not buzzwords to you, they are protocols you have verified, debugged, and shipped. You ask the right questions during architecture reviews because you have seen what happens when assumptions go unchecked. At Synopsys, you will lead verification for SerDes IP that powers the chips inside everything from data centers to autonomous vehicles. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead a verification team working on current and next-generation SerDes products, setting direction, reviewing test plans, and ensuring coverage closure across digital and mixed-signal domains
 - Modify and extend existing UVM and VMM SystemVerilog testbenches to co-simulate mixed-signal designs, bridging digital logic with analog models in tools like AMS Designer or Xcelium
 - Analyze and verify high-speed SerDes functionality including clock data recovery, equalization, and link training across protocols like PCIe Gen5/6, 400G Ethernet, and USB3. 1
 - Define verification test plans with clear coverage goals, track progress against milestones, and drive closure on functional, code, and assertion coverage
 - Debug simulation failures that span both analog waveforms and digital logic, working with mixed-signal engineers to isolate root cause and validate fixes
 - Manage customer escalations on verification quality, silicon bugs, or testbench issues, and lead pre-sales technical discussions to support customer evaluations and design wins

The Impact You Will Have

- Ensure SerDes IP used in data centers, automotive, and AI infrastructure ships with the quality and performance customers depend on
 - Drive verification methodology improvements that reduce simulation time, increase coverage efficiency, and catch bugs earlier in the design cycle
 - Build and mentor a verification team that delivers consistently, owns their work, and raises the bar on quality with every tapeout
 - Shape the verification strategy for next-generation SerDes products, influencing architecture decisions before RTL is written
 - Reduce customer-found issues by tightening verification rigor and improving handoff quality between digital, analog, and system teams
 - Contribute to Synopsys IP leadership by ensuring our SerDes portfolio remains best-in-class for performance, reliability, and time-to-market

What You'll Need

- MTech or BTech with 15+ years of hands-on verification experience in ASIC development, with significant time spent on mixed-signal or SerDes designs
 - Deep knowledge of the full ASIC development flow from architecture specification through digital design, verification, physical implementation, and hardware bring-up
 - Extensive experience building and running UVM testbenches, including writing constrained random tests, developing scoreboards, and managing coverage-driven verification closure
 - Practical experience with digital/analog co-simulation methodologies using tools like Cadence AMS Designer, Synopsys VCS AMS, or equivalent mixed-signal simulation environments
 - Strong understanding of high-speed interface protocols such as PCIe (Gen3 or higher), Ethernet (10G/25G/50G/100G/400G), USB3. 1, or similar SerDes-based standards
 - Proven ability to lead technical teams, manage customer escalations, and communicate complex verification issues clearly to both engineering teams and external stakeholders
 - Experience debugging at the boundary between digital logic and analog circuits, including familiarity with reading SPICE netlists, interpreting analog waveforms, and understanding signal integrity concepts is a strong plus

Who You Are

- You can walk into a design review, ask three questions, and identify the verification risk everyone else missed because you have seen that failure mode before
 - You lead by example, you will debug a tough simulation failure alongside your team at 9pm if that is what it takes, but you also know when to delegate and trust your engineers to own the solution
 - You are comfortable telling a senior architect that their assumption needs a directed test because you have learned that undocumented corner cases become customer bugs
 - You manage multiple priorities without losing track of details, you know which bug needs to be fixed today and which one can wait until after the next milestone
 - You communicate trade-offs clearly, whether you are explaining coverage gaps to your manager or walking a customer through a testbench limitation in a pre-sales call
 - You build teams that stay, people work for you because you make them better engineers, not because you micromanage their every move

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer - Quality Platform
data.description:
About the company

Founders today are building global companies from day one - but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!

We're building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building. 

Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment. 

Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50, 000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J. P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we're building for the next generation of global companies. 

About the role

Software quality and code volume are increasingly an engineering and AI problem. Leading teams now use agents to generate tests, detect coverage gaps before merge, and enforce quality through infrastructure rather than manual processes. 

At Aspire, we're already building this infrastructure. We have a merge guardrail in production that reads live product specs and blocks PRs when coverage gaps are detected. We are building an LLM pipeline that generates tests directly from specs, and a live traceability matrix that keeps specs, code, and test results in sync, along with AI-assisted code review. 

We are hiring a software engineer who builds AI systems and has a strong understanding of coding, testing and quality. You will design, build, and ship the AI tooling that makes quality automatic across Aspire's engineering organisation. 

What you'll own: 

- The AI test generation pipeline. Build the LLM system that assesses product specs for gaps and testability, and converts them into automated tests. You will take it from POC to production, owning context retrieval across specs and codebases, prompt and agent design, evaluation frameworks for generation accuracy, and feedback loops based on live test results. 
 - The merge guardrail. The guardrail is live and blocks merges when coverage is missing or critical bugs are detected. You will improve its precision, scale it across all engineering tribes, and integrate it with the generation pipeline so it creates missing tests rather than only blocking for them. 
 - Reliable automation tooling. Build the intelligence layer behind our automation, including synthetic test data generation, AI agents that explore and verify flows, automated failure classification, and risk-based test selection, so that every alert is accurate and actionable. 
 - Quality platform ownership. Understand the spec, the code, and the failure modes, and build that understanding into systems. Contribute at the design stage, not after release. In a regulated fintech serving 50, 000+ businesses, quality gaps directly impact customers. Work closely with QA engineers to embed AI-assisted practices and use quality data (coverage, escape rates, flakiness) to drive decisions. 
 - Security regression in CI. Design and build automated security regression tests for our highest-risk API endpoints, ensuring every auth boundary is verified at merge. This is a MAS Singapore requirement and will be built from scratch. 

What we're looking for: 

- Proven experience shipping AI systems. You have built and deployed an LLM application, agent, developer tool, or automation that replaced real manual work. You understand common failure modes such as hallucinations, context limits, and evaluation gaps, and how to address them. 
 - Strong software engineering with a quality mindset. You write production code, design systems, and build tools used by other engineers. You understand test architecture, coverage, and failure analysis well enough to define what good testing looks like. 
 - High standards. You address root causes rather than symptoms and treat production defects and flaky tests as system-level problems to eliminate. 
 - Ownership and initiative. You identify problems, validate them with data, and propose solutions without waiting to be assigned. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity. You are motivated by an evolving roadmap that starts with quality and extends to wider engineering workflows as we learn what works, and you want to help shape its direction. 

Technical skills: 

- Strong software engineering in TypeScript and/or Python, with experience building production services, internal tools, or developer platforms
 - Hands-on experience building LLM applications, including prompt engineering, RAG or context retrieval, agents or tool use, and output evaluation. Side projects, internal tools, or POCs count if they were shipped. 
 - Strong day-to-day use of AI coding tools and agentic workflows. 
 - Solid understanding of test automation and test architecture; Playwright experience is a strong plus
 - CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), including building tooling that integrates at PR and merge stages
 - Ability to read and reason about backend code, API contracts, and service boundaries
 - 5+ years in software engineering with meaningful exposure to development, testing, quality, or developer tooling, preferably including a fintech or regulated-environment project
 - Experience owning a system or product domain end-to-end
 - Familiarity with financial workflows such as payments, KYB/KYC, and transaction processing is a strong plus

What this role is NOT: 

- Building AI prototypes that never reach production. 
 - Waiting at the end of the delivery pipeline for a build. 
 - Maintaining a regression suite without evaluating its value. 
 - Treating quality as another team's responsibility. 

In your first 90 days, you'll probably: 

- Become the go-to engineer for building quality into development workflows. 
 - Challenge at least one existing practice with data and propose a better approach. 
 - Review the codebase and identify the three biggest quality gaps based on data, propose solutions, and build tooling for at least one. 
 - Deliver a measurable improvement in quality via the test-generation pipeline, the merge guardrail, automation reliability, code review etc.

Company Description

Assent is the leading solution for supply chain sustainability tailored for the world's top-tier, sustainability-driven manufacturers. Hidden risks riddle supply chains, many of which weren't built with sustainability in mind. That's where we step in. With insights from experts, Assent is the tool manufacturers trust for comprehensive sustainability. 

We are proud to announce that Assent has crossed the US$100M ARR milestone, granting us Centaur Status. This accomplishment, reached just 8 years following our Series A, makes us the first and only Certified B Corporation in North America's SaaS sustainability industry to celebrate this milestone. 

Our journey from $5 million to US$100M ARR in just eight years has been marked by significant growth and achievements. With our $350 million US funding led by Vista Equity Partners, we're poised for even greater expansion and are on the lookout for outstanding team members to join our mission. 

Hybrid Work Model

At Assent, we proudly embrace a remote-first work model, valuing the flexibility and autonomy it provides our team. We also acknowledge the intangible benefits of occasional in-person workdays. For team members situated within 50 kms/31 miles of our five global offices in Ottawa, Eldoret, Penang, Columbus, Pune and Amsterdam, you can expect to come into the office at least one day a week. Similarly, those near our co-working spaces in Nairobi and Toronto are encouraged to work onsite once a month. 

Job Description

Position Summary

We are looking for a quality-first Software Developer in Test (SDET) who brings a strong QA Analyst mindset to software delivery. 

This role goes beyond writing automated tests. You will act as a bridge between Product and Engineering - deeply understanding what and why we are building before engineering how to validate it. You are analytical, user-focused, and risk-aware, using automation as a powerful enabler of quality - not the only tool in your toolbox. 

If you enjoy asking the right questions, thinking critically about business impact, and building scalable test solutions that protect customer value, this role is for you. 

What You Will Do

- Own Quality Through Analysis
 - Collaborate early with Product, Development, and Data teams during discovery and refinement. 
 - Review and challenge requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure they are testable, complete, and reflect real customer journeys. 
 - Identify risks, edge cases, and coverage gaps before they become production issues. 
 - Lead exploratory testing and business-flow simulations in complex or ambiguous areas. 
 - Translate business requirements into meaningful test strategies and risk assessments. 
 - Translate business requirements into meaningful test strategies and risk assessments. 
 - Engineer Robust Automation
 - Design and implement automated tests across API, UI, performance, and end-to-end layers. 
 - Develop automated coverage using tools such as C#, Playwright, NBomber, and JMeter. 
 - Work closely with developers to strengthen test coverage in the upper layers of the test pyramid. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements and automation environment setup. 
 - Maintain meaningful test metrics focused on escapes, performance, and coverage trends. 
 - Drive Defect Prevention & Release Confidence
 - Perform triage and root cause analysis for test failures and production defects. 
 - Partner with Support and Engineering to prevent repeat issues. 
 - Lead reviews of test results and outstanding risks to assess release readiness. 
 - Maintain traceability and test evidence aligned with ISO9001 and SOC2 standards. 

Qualifications

Your Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

We strongly value your talent, energy and passion. It will also be valuable to Assent if you have the following qualifications, 

- 3+ years of experience in software testing or development with strong automation experience. 
 - Experience writing automated API and UI tests (C#, Playwright, or similar tools). 
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as NBomber or JMeter. 
 - Strong understanding of Agile/SCRUM methodologies and test lifecycle practices. 
 - Experience testing SaaS web applications across multiple browser platforms. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring/log analysis tools (ElasticStack, DataDog, New Relic, etc. ). 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to review and challenge requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure they are testable, complete, and reflect real customer journeys and business outcomes. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - A proactive, user-centric approach to quality. 

Nice to Have

- Experience working with AWS environments. 
 - Knowledge of data architecture patterns (e. g. , medallion architecture). 

Technology Environment

Our Automated Testing team works within a modern, cloud-native platform environment. You'll have the opportunity to work with the following tools and technologies: 

- Cloud: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
 - Version Control & CI/CD: GitHub
 - API Testing: C# with Postman or custom test harnesses
 - UI Testing: Playwright (C#/TypeScript)
 - Performance Testing: NBomber
 - Test Management & Traceability: Zephyr, Jira

Experience with some or all of these tools is helpful-but we value mindset over tool mastery. If you are curious, analytical, and motivated to grow, we'll support you in learning what you don't know yet. 

Additional Information

Life at Assent

Wellness: We believe that you and your family's well being is important. As a result, we offer vacation time that increases with tenure, comprehensive benefits packages (details vary by country), life leave days and more. 

Financial Benefits: It's not all about the money - well, it's a little about the money. We understand that financial health is important and we offer a competitive base salary, a corporate bonus program, retirement savings options and more. 

Life at Assent: There is purpose beyond your work. We provide our team members with flexible work options, volunteer days and opportunities to get involved in corporate giving initiatives. 

Lifelong Learning: At Assent, curiosity is not only valued but encouraged. You will receive professional development days that are available to you the day you start. 

At Assent, we are committed to growing and sustaining an environment where our team members feel included, valued, and heard. Our diversity and equal opportunity practices are guided and championed by our Diversity and Inclusion Working Group and our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion includes recruiting and retaining team members from diverse backgrounds and experiences, and fostering a culture of belonging where all team members are included, treated with dignity and respect, promoted on their merits, and placed in positions to contribute to business success. 

If you require assistance or accommodation throughout any part of the interview and selection process, please contact talent@assent. com and we will be happy to help. 

We use AI to support parts of our recruitment process, such as note-taking and initial shortlisting based on job-related qualifications. AI does not make hiring decisions. All candidates will speak with a real person, and final decisions are always made by our recruitment team.

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Observability & Debuggability

Snapshot of the Day!

Responsible for the design, development, implementation, operation, and maintenance of instrument/electrical systems. Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

- Govern process design, configuration, and customizations across platforms to protect stability, auditability, and upgrade paths, ensuring financial and operational systems remain reliable through peak-season demand. 
 - Oversee UAT, release management, and production support with minimal disruption during high-volume periods, targeting zero critical incidents attributable to systems failure. 
 - Ensure financial and operational controls, audit readiness (SOX), and data integrity across all owned systems, protecting the integrity of every transaction that touches the fan experience. 
 - Drive functional stability and incident resolution, including structured root cause analysis for recurring issues, so business operations and customer-facing platforms remain uninterrupted. 

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

- Drive AI-augmented delivery by identifying manual and repetitive workflows across the team and leading their replacement with AI-assisted approaches - AI-generated specs, Copilot-assisted code, AI-powered test generation, and anomaly detection.

 - Evaluate new financial technology platforms and AI tools, making build-vs-buy recommendations grounded in total cost of ownership and strategic fit. 
 - Measure and report AI impact by tracking productivity gains, error reduction, and time savings attributable to AI adoption, and present results and recommendations to senior leadership. 

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

- Own the technology roadmap for financial and operational systems - ERP, order management platforms, procurement, payment systems, and the integrations that connect them - aligned to business priorities and peak-season readiness. 
 - Balance speed, scalability, and controls with a product-oriented mindset, triaging competing demands across stability, delivery, and strategic initiatives without losing team focus. 
 - Deliver at least two AI-augmented workflows into production within twelve months - such as AI-assisted reconciliation, Copilot-generated integration specs, or AI-powered UAT. 
 - Thrive in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments, demonstrating strong project management and process optimization instincts across functions, time zones, and organizational layers. 

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: 

- Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
 - Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
 - Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
 - Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

 - Proven ability to lead automations leveraging cloud ERP native capabilities, low-code/no-code platforms, or AI-native tooling, with familiarity in AI risk, governance, and compliance considerations in enterprise financial systems.

🚀 Why Exasol? Why Now?

At Exasol, we believe that speed is the key to turning data into impact. Our in-memory, massively parallel processing (MPP) database is one of the fastest in the world, built from the ground up for analytics at scale. We help financial institutions, retailers, governments, and defense organizations make better decisions faster, by turning complex data into actionable insights in seconds, not hours. 

This is a pivotal moment for Exasol. As we double down on our growth in Germany and across Europe, we are building a commercial team that thrives on curiosity, grit, and action. 

💼 Overview (Role Purpose)

We are looking for an experienced Staff DevOps Engineer / Team Lead that can lead the DevOps team in supporting our development teams. You'll thrive in this role if you love both leading other engineers to deliver valuable systems and getting hands on with design and implementation. You will be responsible for maintaining our Linux-based build and test infrastructure, which runs thousands of tests every hour supporting our development teams. You will drive the design, development, and migration to a modern CICD pipeline with automated quality gates, working closely with development, testing, and IT teams to understand requirements and develop efficient solutions. 

🎯 Responsibilities

Lead DevOps team, mentoring and growing senior DevOps engineers, as together you accomplish the following: 

- Collaborate with development, quality engineering, and IT teams to design, implement, and maintain a scalable, secure, and high-availability Linux-based build and test infrastructure
 - Work with development and testing teams to maintain and improve the test orchestration and scheduling tool chain
 - Proactively optimize system performance and troubleshoot issues as they arise to ensure smooth operations
 - Handle system updates, upgrades, and patch management to keep the environment secure and up to date
 - Set up monitoring tools to track system performance, application metrics, and infrastructure health
 - Utilize configuration management tools (e. g. , Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Salt) to automate provisioning and installations
 - Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting guides✅ Required Qualifications

- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. This role needs to align priorities with development teams and IT department, and this requires active stakeholder engagement. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
 - 10+ years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
 - 2+ years managing other engineers and high impact projects
 - Strong proficiency in Linux system administration and shell scripting
 - Strong proficiency in Python development
 - Proficient in configuration management tools (e. g. , Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Salt)
 - Hands-on experience with containerization technologies (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes, Nomad)
 - Experience with monitoring and alerting tools
 - Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
 - Experience with C++ is a plus
 - Experience with workload manager software (Nomad, Slurm, etc. ) is a plus
 - Experience with cloud technology is a plus (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP)
 - Experience with OpenStack is a plus
 - Fluent in English💡 Preferred Qualifications (if applicable)

- Familiarity with Exasol or other analytics databases
 - Experience with OpenStack or workload managers (Nomad, Slurm)📆 A Day in the Life

Your day may begin by reviewing the performance of the Linux-based build and test infrastructure and ensuring CI/CD pipelines are running smoothly. You collaborate with development, QA, and IT teams to improve automation, optimize system performance, and resolve infrastructure issues. As a team lead, you mentor DevOps engineers, guide technical decisions, and work on improving scalable and reliable infrastructure that supports development teams. 

📈 What's in It for You

- Competitive compensation and benefits
 - Flexible and remote-first working environment
 - Monthly home office allowance and flexible working hours
 - Opportunities to work on cutting-edge cloud infrastructure
 - Continuous learning through internal knowledge sharing and technical sessions
 - A collaborative global team where your contributions truly matterLocation Requirements

Chennai, India (Hybrid)

About Exasol

Take the next step in your career journey. Visit www. exasol. com to explore our current job openings and follow us on LinkedIn to see what it is like to work at Exasol. 

Exasol is a proud equal opportunities employer. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive working environment and therefore base all our employment selection decisions, within all aspects of our business, on experience, skill, and integrity. We strongly encourage applicants from all walks to life to apply for our positions, irrespective of age, sex, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, etc.

data.title: Technical Lead - Backend
data.description:
About Us

Netcore. ai is a leading AI-powered B2B SaaS Customer Experience and Marketing Technology platform, helping 6, 500+ brands across 20+ countries deliver personalized customer experiences at scale. Our engineering teams build highly scalable, cloud-native products that process billions of customer interactions every day. 

Team: Engineering | Location: Thane, MH

Role Summary

As a Technical Lead - Backend, you will design, build, and lead the development of scalable backend systems that power Netcore's high-volume customer engagement platform. You will be hands-on with architecture, development, debugging, and technical problem-solving while leading a small team of engineers. 

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving complex backend problems, building highly available and fault-tolerant systems, and working across engineering and product teams to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions. 

What we look for

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science/IT, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10-14 years of experience in backend software development, with strong hands-on experience in Java and/or Python. 
 - Strong understanding of backend engineering principles, object-oriented programming, data structures, multithreading, concurrency, caching, fault tolerance, and API design. 
 - Strong experience building scalable, highly available, and performance-oriented backend systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis or similar technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of messaging and streaming systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar queue-based technologies. 
 - Experience designing application modules and services that can handle high-volume data and traffic reliably. 
 - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify and resolve complex production issues. 
 - Good understanding of software engineering best practices, version control, CI/CD, and agile development methodologies. 
 - Experience working with cloud environments and distributed systems. 
 - Ability to work closely with Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. 
 - Prior experience leading a small team of engineers, including technical mentoring, task ownership, code/design reviews, and delivery. 
 - Comfortable being hands-on while also driving technical direction and helping the team solve complex engineering challenges. 

Good to Have

- Exposure to high-throughput systems, real-time data processing, or distributed systems. 
 - Experience with additional backend languages such as Golang. 
 - Experience working in a product/ B2B SaaS environment. 
 - Experience with AI-native products/technology. 

Why Join Us?

- Build products used by 6, 500+ global brands. 
 - Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI/ML projects impacting millions of users. 
 - Be part of a collaborative, innovation-driven team in a fast-growing MarTech company. 
 - Competitive compensation and growth opportunities in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Thrive in a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous learning. 

We'd love to hear how your background can contribute to building the next generation of intelligent marketing solutions. 

Global Recognitions

- Leader in Commerce Search and Product Discovery in the Forrester Wave 2023. 
 - The only Forrester-rated global vendor in Product Discovery, Cross Channel Marketing Hubs and Email. 
 - Leader in Marketing Platforms in G2's Winter 2024 Grid
 - Top 20 global Google Cloud Partner
 - Appraised at Level 3 of ISACA's CMMI® by Equalitas Certifications Limited
 - Great Place to Work® for six consecutive years in India

Know More About Us

- Agentic Marketing Platform: Co-Marketer
 - LinkedIn
 - Our Growth Story: *The Proficorn Playbook - How Netcore Built a $100M+ ARR Business Without VC Funding*
 - Life at Netcore: Explore our culture, and employee experiences

data.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering, Missionforce
data.description:
Description

About Salesforce

We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too - driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good- you've come to the right place. 

Role Description

The Engineering Manager demonstrates deep business, industry, and product knowledge to ensure the success of our customers by effectively managing a team of Engineers and Architects. In this role, the Engineering Manager will specialize in one or more lines of business, a specific cloud or industry to speak the customer language and ensure customer value realization. They are aligned by cloud strategy, building and encouraging positive relationships to help customers progress on their digital journey. 

Salesforce is looking for technically strong, energetic, highly collaborative, and passionate leaders to lead our software engineering teams! You will run and lead a team/teams of outstanding developers and keep quality in mind. We work in a collaborative environment, and we value open communication and feedback, code reviews, and making learning fun!

Your Impact

- Drive the execution and delivery of features by collaborating with many multi-functional teams, architects, product owners and engineer
 - Make critical decisions that attribute to the success of the product
 - Proactive in foreseeing issues and resolving it before it happens
 - Daily management of stand-ups as the Scrum Master for engineering teams
 - Partner with PO to align with objectives, priorities, tradeoffs, and risk
 - Ensuring teams have clear priorities and adequate resources
 - Empowering the delivery team to self coordinate
 - Be a multiplier and have a passion for team and team members' success
 - Providing technical guidance, career development, and mentoring to team members
 - Maintaining high morale and motivating the delivery team to go above and beyond
 - Vocally advocating for technical excellence and helping the teams make good decisions
 - Participating in architecture discussions and planning
 - Participating in multi-functional coordination, planning, and reviews with leads from other engineering teams
 - Maintaining and encouraging our culture by interviewing and hiring only the most qualified individuals
 - Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code. 
 - Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale. 
 - Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably. 
 - Critically evaluate code (Human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance. 
 - Occasionally chipping in to development tasks such as coding and feature verifications to assist teams with release commitments, to gain an understanding of the deeply technical product as well as to keep your technical skill sharp

Minimum Requirements

- A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering. Using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty. 
 - Experience using AI tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc. ) in development workflows. 
 - Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready. 
 - A related technical degree required
 - 3 + years of proven track record leading software engineering teams with a distinguished track record on technically fast paced projects
 - Experience leading large scale distributed systems, working with microservices and/or distributed architecture
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills, organizational and time management skills
 - Ability to be flexible, proactive, comfortable working with minimal specifications
 - Experience with short release cycles, the full software lifecycle, and experience working on a product that's been released for public consumption
 - Experience in hiring, mentoring and leading engineers
 - Working experience of software engineering best practices including coding standards, code reviews, SCM, CI, build processes, testing, and operations
 - Experience with Agile development methodologies. Scrum Master experience required
 - Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and product management to understand requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs

Preferred Requirements

- Strong knowledge of Salesforce product and platform features, capabilities, and best use of it
 - Able to articulate the importance and value of Governance to Business and IT executives
 - A good understanding of enterprise architecture principles is strongly preferred
 - Ability to quickly grasp and distinctly explain technological and business concepts
 - Serve as a trusted advisor, with a deep curiosity to understand your customers, their motivations and needs, and how to approach ensuring their success
 - Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e. g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc. )

Benefits & Perks

- Comprehensive benefits package including well-being reimbursement, generous parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility benefits, and more!
 - World-class enablement and on-demand training with Trailhead. com
 - Exposure to executive thought leaders and regular 1: 1 coaching with leadership
 - Volunteer opportunities and participation in our 1: 1: 1 model for giving back to the community
 - For more details, visit https: //www. salesforcebenefits. com/

data.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

Salesforce Professional Services - Global Delivery Centre (GDC) focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and execution of change programs. We are the trusted delivery partner for Salesforce Professional Services that ensures end to end multi-cloud delivery capabilities across all Salesforce technologies and scales with agility for successful customer outcomes! We at GDC strive to foster growth & innovation and enable for Salesforce Professional Services with focus on performance, productivity & impact. 

Role Overview

Salesforce is currently seeking a Director, Technical Consulting (in the Architects' Practice) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. The Director, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in enabling, deploying, and building the careers of our technical architects team. 

Responsibilities

- You'll be responsible for planning capacity, hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Architects, as well as guide them on their CTA journey and their upskilling path across modern AI platforms. 
 - Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value. 
 - Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects' consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community's overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology within the practice. 
 - Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs. 
 - Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI environments, and establish a program architectural roadmap. 
 - Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying. 
 - Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Industries Clouds, ensuring teams leverage developer assistants (e. g. , Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery and enforce platform security. 
 - Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to establish evaluation frameworks that measure AI performance and business value. 
 - Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders. 
 - Establish trust with the customer's leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with SFI and Salesforce. 
 - Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion. 

Minimum Requirements

- 18+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects. 
 - Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills. 
 - Expertise in one or multiples of → Salesforce Industries Cloud, Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, and Vlocity OmniStudio, as well as familiarity with Agentforce. 
 - Expertise in one or multiple domains of → Financial Services, Health & Life Sciences, Manufacturing and Automotive, Retail and Consumer Goods, etc. 
 - Integration Architecture (Must have)
 - Platform Security (Must have)
 - Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
 - Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
 - Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
 - Architectural Design Patterns
 - Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
 - Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others). 
 - Proficiency in English. 

Preferred Requirements

- CTA
 - Salesforce Certifications (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, System and Application Architect). 
 - OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
 - Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks. 
 - Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience. 
 - A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles. 
 - Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration. 
 - Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems. 
 - Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others. 
 - Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation frameworks, and outcomes. 

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. 

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications - without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

The Technology department at Oaktree Capital Management delivers secure, scalable, and innovative solutions that power the firm's global investment and business operations. Through strong partnerships across the company, we drive digital transformation, advance operational efficiency, and provide a trusted data foundation to create measurable impact for Oaktree's teams, clients, and partners. 

Collaborative Innovation: We foster a deeply collaborative environment where cross-functional teams from engineering to product to business partner to bring groundbreaking ideas to life. Your voice and ideas are critical to our success. 

Forward-Thinking Technology: You will work with a state-of-the-art, cloud-based ecosystem and have the opportunity to experiment with and implement cutting-edge AI and machine learning solutions to drive tangible business outcomes. 

Commitment to Growth: Your development is a priority. We support your career journey with a dedicated professional development budget, active mentorship programs, and clear pathways for advancement. We believe in promoting from within. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a technically grounded Vice President, to serve as a hands-on delivery leader for our Finance and Treasury technology portfolio. This role bridges deep domain expertise with modern engineering - owning end-to-end solution design, delivery, and operations while partnering closely with various business stakeholders. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable in a whiteboard architecture session as in a business requirements workshop. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Delivery & Solution Design

Own end-to-end technical delivery of Finance and Treasury application initiatives - from requirements through design, build, testing, and go-live

Architect scalable solutions leveraging cloud-native services (Azure), microservices patterns, and API-first integration design

Define and enforce technical standards, code quality practices, and architecture governance within the team

Stakeholder Engagement & Business Partnering

Engage with digital products & business leadership to align system roadmaps with business strategy and regulatory obligations

Facilitate design workshops, solution walkthroughs, and executive-level status updates with clarity and confidence

Manage expectations, risks, and delivery timelines transparently across business and technology stakeholders

Team Leadership & Mentorship

Provide technical guidance and hands-on mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers on design patterns, best practices, and problem-solving

Drive career development, performance management, and capacity planning for the team

Operations, Governance & Compliance

Ensure finance systems meet audit, SOX, and regulatory requirements through embedded controls and governance frameworks

Oversee data governance, access controls, and security posture across the finance application landscape

Define and monitor SLAs, KPIs, and operational health metrics; lead incident resolution and RCAs

Manage vendor relationships, SaaS lifecycle, and contract performance for key finance platforms

Qualifications

Domain & Functional Expertise

15+ years of experience spanning finance systems, with strong working knowledge of financial close, treasury operations, general ledger, allocations, and forecasting processes

Hands-on functional experience with ERP/EPM platforms (e. g. , Oracle, Workday, SAP, OneStream, Anaplan) and Treasury Management Systems

Understanding of financial controls, audit requirements, and regulatory compliance (SOX, GAAP) as they apply to systems and data

Technical Expertise

Strong foundation in cloud architecture (AWS or Azure) including managed services, data pipelines, and security best practices

Experience designing and delivering microservices-based and API-driven integrations between finance systems and enterprise data platforms

Proficiency in data modeling, ETL/ELT patterns, and finance data lake architectures

Familiarity with modern DevOps practices - CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and release management

Working knowledge of AI/ML applications in finance contexts (e. g. , anomaly detection, variance analysis, predictive modeling) is a plus

Leadership & Communication

Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technical teams and deliver complex programs on time and within scope

Proven track record as a trusted business partner - able to engage finance executives and translate their needs into scalable technology solutions

Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior leadership and navigating ambiguity

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field

MBA or advanced degree preferred

What We're Looking For

A leader who is technically credible and business-savvy - someone who earns trust with engineering teams through sound design judgment, and earns trust with finance stakeholders by deeply understanding their domain. You are delivery-focused, intellectually curious, and thrive in environments that require both strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
BHN is looking for an accomplished Staff Software Engineer to join our engineering organization and help shape the next generation of digital gifting and stored-value experiences. This is a frontend-leaning role for a hands-on technical leader who can build intuitive, scalable web applications while also contributing deeply to the Python/Django and MySQL backend that powers them. 

You will serve as a technical anchor across the product stack, partnering with product managers, designers, business analysts, QA, operations, and infrastructure teams. You will drive frontend architecture and engineering excellence, influence backend and API design, and help deliver secure, reliable, and highly performant solutions for BHN customers, partners, and internal users. 

The ideal candidate brings strong experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development, along with solid Python/Django, REST API, and relational database expertise. You are comfortable moving between user interface design decisions, service integration, performance optimization, and architectural leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

Frontend Architecture and Development

- Lead the design and implementation of scalable, maintainable web applications using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS, and modern frontend engineering practices. 
 - Define reusable component patterns, frontend architecture standards, state-management approaches, and coding practices across applications. 
 - Build accessible, responsive, and high-performing user experiences for complex workflows and enterprise use cases. 
 - Drive frontend modularization, code reusability, testability, and incremental modernization of existing applications. 
 - Partner with product and design teams to translate business requirements and user journeys into intuitive technical solutions. 

Full-Stack and Backend Engineering

- Design and implement backend services and APIs using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework. 
 - Define secure, reliable RESTful interfaces and service-oriented integrations between frontend applications, internal platforms, and external partners. 
 - Collaborate on schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and data integrity for MySQL databases. 
 - Diagnose and resolve performance, scalability, reliability, and production issues across the frontend, API, and database layers. 
 - Contribute to asynchronous processing, concurrency, caching, and fault-tolerant system design where appropriate. 

Technical Leadership and Architecture

- Provide technical direction for complex initiatives and act as a trusted advisor to engineers across the team. 
 - Lead architectural decisions, design reviews, code reviews, and technical documentation for cross-functional projects. 
 - Establish engineering standards for automated testing, code coverage, observability, security, accessibility, and maintainability. 
 - Ensure solutions align with Blackhawk Network enterprise architecture principles and platform standards. 
 - Identify technical risks, reduce ambiguity, and guide teams toward pragmatic, scalable solutions. 

Collaboration and Delivery

- Coordinate technical deliverables across engineering, QA, operations, infrastructure, product, and business analysis teams. 
 - Work closely with Business Analysts and Product Managers to clarify requirements, identify dependencies, and improve delivery predictability. 
 - Champion Agile/Scrum practices, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and iterative delivery of customer value. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, design discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Participate in production support, incident analysis, and continuous improvement of engineering processes. 

Innovation and AI-Enabled Engineering

- Evaluate and responsibly adopt AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, test creation, documentation, and operational workflows. 
 - Identify opportunities to automate repetitive development and support activities while maintaining appropriate security, privacy, and quality controls. 
 - Share effective engineering practices and measurable productivity improvements with the broader team. 

Required Qualifications and Experience

- 7-9 years of professional software development experience, including experience leading significant technical initiatives or operating in a Staff-level capacity. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building production web applications with React and modern JavaScript or TypeScript. 
 - Solid understanding of frontend architecture, component design, state management, responsive design, browser behavior, web performance, and accessibility. 
 - Strong backend development experience with Python and Django, including Django REST Framework. 
 - Experience designing and consuming secure, scalable RESTful APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services. 
 - Advanced working knowledge of MySQL, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, transaction management, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong Object-Oriented Design skills and a deep understanding of software architecture and design patterns. 
 - Understanding of asynchronous programming, concurrency, multithreading, caching, and distributed-system fundamentals. 
 - Experience with automated testing across frontend and backend layers, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Proficiency with Git and automated CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Extensive experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions across a matrixed organization. 
 - A self-starter mindset with the ability to manage multiple complex priorities and deliver high-quality results under tight timelines. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in fintech, payments, stored-value products, gift cards, digital gifting, or card services. 
 - Experience with TypeScript, modern frontend build tools, frontend testing frameworks, and design systems. 
 - Familiarity with legacy UI technologies such as ExtJS or jQuery for migration and integration efforts. 
 - Experience with frontend observability, web application security, accessibility standards, and performance monitoring. 
 - Experience working with cloud platforms, containers, message queues, or event-driven architectures. 
 - Demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or LLM-based tools for refactoring, test generation, documentation, and developer productivity.

 - Asynchronous and Event Processing: Integrate and maintain high-throughput background processing, queuing, and caching mechanisms using Redis and Kafka. 
 - Security and Clean Architecture: Enforce strict authentication/authorization workflows (OAuth2, JWT, RBAC) while maintaining modular code structure, automated test coverage, and clean software engineering principles. 
 - Infrastructure Collaboration: Deploy and manage microservices in cloud environments, ensuring operational reliability and continuous deployment efficiency. 

Requirements: 

- Core Language Expertise: 4+ years of dedicated professional backend experience in Python.

Multi-Database Proficiency: 

- SQL: Complex queries, schema design, indexing, and performance tuning (PostgreSQL/MySQL).

 - Caching and Messaging Systems: Hands-on experience with Redis (caching, pub/sub) and Kafka (event streaming, consumer groups, topic partitioning). 
 - Security and Auth: Strong grasp of secure API design, OAuth2, JWT, rate limiting, and RBAC strategies.

Junior Software Engineer
data.description:
Cedric · 0-2 years of experience

Most people don't need another tool to manage. They need help getting through the work they already have. 

That's what we're building at Cedric. An AI assistant that connects with everyday work tools, follows conversations and helps move things forward. Meeting follow-ups, task updates, recurring workflows and the small jobs that quietly eat up the day. 

We're looking for a junior developer who wants to build useful software and take an active role in an early-stage product. 

The role

You'll work directly with our CTO and a small team to build features, develop integrations and improve how Cedric works for users. 

The work spans the application, external APIs and AI workflows. You might spend one day improving onboarding and the next figuring out why an integration failed or how to make an AI action more reliable. 

You'll have guidance, regular feedback and room to take on more responsibility as you develop. 

What you'll work on

- Product features: Build and improve the interfaces and backend services people use to interact with Cedric. 
 - Integrations: Connect Cedric with communication, calendar, project management and other work tools. 
 - AI workflows: Help turn user requests into actions, with clear approval steps and sensible handling when something goes wrong. 
 - Reliability: Investigate bugs, handle API failures and improve the consistency of recurring tasks. 
 - User experience: Reduce friction in onboarding and make features easier to understand and use. 
 - Engineering quality: Write readable code, contribute to code reviews and test the changes you ship. 

What we're looking for

You're early in your career, but you've already spent time building things. You can explain your decisions, work through a problem and ask for help when you need it. 

You should have: 

- Solid programming fundamentals and experience with at least one modern programming language. 
 - Some experience building web applications through personal projects, university work, internships or employment. 
 - A working understanding of APIs, databases and Git. 
 - An interest in how AI products work beyond the chat interface. 
 - Good written and spoken English. 
 - The ability to organise your work and communicate clearly in a remote team. 
 - Attention to detail, especially when your code affects a user's data or triggers an action.

The Manager - Quality Assurance will oversee product and material quality across Skechers India's apparel and accessories sourcing operations, with particular focus on the kitting program, accessories and fabric quality.

Role: Quality Assurance

Department: Category - Apparel & Accessories Sourcing

Location: Delhi NCR

Experience: 8-12 years

Reporting to: Senior Manager - QA

Role type: Individual Contributor

Key Responsibilities

Quality Standards & Process Control

- Implement company quality policies, specifications and standard operating procedures across manufacturing partners. 
 - Establish and maintain QA/QC procedures, inspection checklists and defect classification standards for apparel, accessories and kitting. 
 - Monitor quality at each production stage and recommend improvements to manufacturing practices and process efficiency. 

Factory Audits & Product Inspections

- Conduct factory quality audits, inline inspections, pre-final audits and final inspections. 
 - Verify garment measurements, fit, construction, workmanship and finishing against approved samples and specifications. 
 - Identify non-conformances, communicate corrective actions to factory teams and verify closure before shipment.

- Manage quality checks for fabrics, trims, accessories, packaging components and labels. 
 - Verify incoming materials against approved specifications and coordinate required testing with suppliers and laboratories.
