data.title: Group Manager - Quality Control
data.description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

Every day, everything we do is driven by an unwavering commitment to delivering safe and effective products to patients. Our quality culture, which is both science and risk-based, is flexible, innovative, and customer-oriented. Whether you are engaged in development, maintenance, compliance, or analysis through research programs, your contribution will have a direct impact on patients. Our dedication to quality and safety ensures that we consistently meet the highest standards, making a real difference in the lives of those we serve. Join us in our mission to improve patient outcomes through excellence in every aspect of our work. 

What You Will Achieve

In this role, you will: 

- Leadership & People Management
 - Lead, coach, and manage Quality Control teams through goal setting, performance reviews, feedback, development planning, and succession readiness. 
 - Identify development needs, foster teamwork, inclusion, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. 
 - Manage workforce planning, leave management, and performance appraisal cycles. 
 - Actively share knowledge, encourage innovation, and support risk‐based decision making. 
 - Quality Control & Laboratory Operations
 - Plan, manage, and oversee analytical activities related to: 
 - In‐process, finished product, stability, process validation, exhibit batch, market complaint, and retention sample testing
 - Stability sample pulling, testing, protocol approval, compilation reports, and annual stability report submissions
 - Visual inspection of retention samples per approved schedules
 - Ensure timely review, approval, and completion of all QC activities in alignment with site KPIs. 
 - Review and approve, Laboratory investigations, QC documentation including raw data, protocols, reports, and SOPs in compliance with cGMP. 
 - Equipment Qualification, Calibration & Lifecycle Management
 - Ensure equipment qualification and lifecycle compliance for QC laboratory instruments, including IQ/OQ/PQ activities. 
 - Oversee calibration, preventive maintenance, and requalification of QC equipment in accordance with approved schedules and regulatory requirements. 
 - Ensure Equipment Qualification protocols, reports, deviations, and change controls are reviewed and approved. 
 - Collaborate with Engineering, Validation, and QA to support: 
 - New equipment introduction
 - Decommissioning and replacement activities
 - Qualification impact assessments for changes
 - Ensure data integrity, ALCOA+ principles, and computerized system compliance for analytical instrumentation. 
 - Stability Management
 - Approve and manage stability and retention sample requests, protocols, reports, and annual submissions. 
 - Ensure sponsor‐site stability samples, review of shipment temperature excursions, and execution of stability studies at site. 
 - Ensure PRQ and qualification of stability chambers as per approved schedules. 
 - Compliance, Audits & Quality Systems
 - Ensure alignment with cGMP, regulatory requirements, and Pfizer Quality Standards across all QC activities. 
 - Represent CQ during internal, external, customer, and regulatory audits and inspections. 
 - Support timely investigation and closure of Incidents, Deviations, CAPAs, and Change Controls, including cross‐functional impact assessments. 
 - Ensure personnel safety, safe material handling, and adherence to EHS requirements within QC laboratories. 
 - Continuous Improvement & Technical Excellence
 - Guide analysts in the application of continuous improvement tools such as standard work, visual management, LEAN, and Six Sigma methodologies. 
 - Drive simplification, digitization, and efficiency improvement initiatives across CQ processes. 
 - Provide technical expertise in troubleshooting analytical methods, instruments, and laboratory issues. 
 - Support method transfers from R&D to QC and ensure readiness for routine testing. 
 - Collaboration & Business Partnership
 - Partner with Manufacturing, QA, Engineering, R&D, Supply Chain, and external customers to support site objectives and timelines. 
 - Establish and monitor departmental performance metrics to drive operational effectiveness. 
 - Communicate complex technical concepts clearly, solicit feedback, and influence stakeholders using sound scientific and business rationale. 
Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

- Education: B. Pharm / M. Pharm / M. Sc. 
 - Experience: Minimum 10+ years of pharmaceutical industry experience with a strong background in Quality Control. 
 - Extensive knowledge of cGMP compliance for Quality Control laboratories, including, testing, stability management, lab investigations, equipment qualification, and data integrity. 
 - Demonstrated experience in: 
 - Analytical testing, stability management, and retention samples
 - Equipment qualification, calibration, and maintenance oversight
 - Audit handling and regulatory inspections
 - Incident, CAPA, Change Control management
 - People leadership and performance management
 - Proficiency in a wide range of analytical techniques and QC instrumentation. 

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)

- Master's degree
 - Knowledge in the application of statistical tools, root cause analysis, and/or six sigma methodologies
 - Experience with environmental testing, utility monitoring, analytical testing, microbial identification, and sterility testing
 - Expertise in QC instrumentation, qualification, and troubleshooting
 - Experience in setting requirements for the transfer of methodology from Research and Development (R&D)
 - Ability to manage projects and ongoing work activities of moderate complexity
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 - Ability to foster teamwork and colleague development
 - Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance productivity. Demonstrated curiosity for exploring how these tools can improve outcomes and understanding of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use

Work Location Assignment: On Premise

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA/QC Manager - Civil with a strong civil engineering background and a minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in quality assurance and quality control for large-scale construction projects. 

The ideal candidate should have proven experience working on PMC projects and high-rise buildings, with strong expertise in implementing quality management systems, reviewing construction activities, ensuring compliance with approved drawings and specifications, and coordinating with consultants, contractors, and project teams.

 - Lead and mentor the QA/QC team and coordinate quality activities across multiple contractors and work fronts. 
 - Provide regular quality reports, dashboards and updates to senior project management. Required Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized institution. 
 - Minimum 15 years of overall experience in civil construction and QA/QC. 
 - Strong experience in high-rise residential, commercial, mixed-use or large-scale building projects. 
 - Mandatory experience working on PMC / Project Management Consultancy projects. 
 - Experience in managing QA/QC activities for major construction projects from excavation through finishing and handover. 
 - Strong knowledge of QA/QC systems, ITPs, Method Statements, NCRs, audits and quality documentation. 
 - Good knowledge of RCC, structural works, waterproofing, masonry and finishing works. 
 - Familiarity with relevant IS Codes, specifications and quality standards. 
 - Strong communication, coordination, leadership and problem-solving skills.

data.title: Software Development Engineer (R&D) (Embedded/Electronics Domain) || 4 Year+ || Gurgaon || Only Immediate Joiner
data.description:
Role: Software Development Engineer( R&D Engineer)- QA

Experience: 3- 5 Year

Location: Gurugram

Function: Research & Development - Software Quality Engineering

Background: CS/ECE

About the Role

We are looking for an R&D QA Engineer to own the integration and testing of high-performance measurement and data-handling software. You will work embedded in an R&D team, partnering with developers to design, automate, and execute functional and non-functional testing of C/C++ and . NET APIs and the applications that consume them, on systems that move data at high speed across FPGA, network, storage, and GPU paths. 

This is a hands-on engineering role - you will spend most of your time exercising low-level APIs, building automation, and validating data integrity and throughput on real hardware-in-the-loop setups. 

Responsibilities

- Perform functional and non-functional testing (performance, throughput, load, stress, reliability, stability, and resource/memory usage) on C/C++ APIs and consuming applications. 
 - Develop test suites and automation against C/C++ APIs; build and maintain GTest-based suites. 
 - Design test strategies and cases from API contracts and acceptance criteria (positive, negative, boundary, edge). 
 - Set up and manage test environments across Linux and Windows (including Embedded Linux), with Conan package installation/build workflows. 
 - Investigate failures to root cause, file precise reproducible defects, and verify fixes. 
 - Track and report quality metrics, drive continuous quality improvements and minimize production escapes

Required Skills & Experience

- Bachelor's/Master's in CS or Electronics & Communications Engineering (or closely related). 
 - 3-5 years in software QA/test engineering. 
 - C/C++ API testing and application/automation development. 
 - Hands-on with GTest (Google Test), PyTest, NUnit, or similar testing frameworks. 
 - Basic networking understanding (TCP/IP, sockets, protocols). 
 - Familiarity with modern C++ build/package management tools (Conan, CMake, etc. )
 - Comfortable working across Linux and Windows. 
 - Solid test design (equivalence partitioning, boundary analysis, negative/edge cases) and strong debugging/root-cause skills. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication. Good to Have

- Basic FPGA understanding. 
 - Experience testing high-throughput data transfer systems is preferred. Knowledge of DMA/RDMA concepts is a plus. 
 - Storage technologies and GPU exposure. 
 - Embedded Linux experience. 
 - Understanding of IQ waveform data handling - capture, formats, basic signal/measurement concepts. 
 - Broader high-speed communication interfaces/standards knowledge. 
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and Git. 
 - Test management/reporting tooling (Zephyr, Jira/Confluence). What Success Looks Like

- Functional and non-functional coverage of the APIs and consuming applications is thorough, automated, and reliable in CI. 
 - High-speed data paths (DMA/RDMA) are validated for integrity and throughput. 
 - Defects are caught before release; predictability, accuracy, and consistency are the norm.

Description

As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will be involved throughout the development lifecycle of Infor Birst development team with responsibility in the quality assurance of software development and deployment with emphasis on development and implementation of test automation. You'll be involved in the creation of business requirements inputting the test scripts and test scenarios to ensure developers understand the business requirements so that they can be effectively tested. 

You will be working closely with developers as they develop code to ensure requirements are being met and to the correct quality, and you will conduct automated (and manual tests where necessary) to ensure the software created is fit for purpose. During testing you will be thinking "outside of the box" to understand the various scenarios and configurations that customers use to ensure customer quality is maintained and through doing so drive regression testing across the products. You will be responsible for defining and driving innovative automated testing strategies and toolsets into our overall development processes that support and enhance the current Quality Assurance processes within Birst. 

We are seeking exceptional QA automation engineers to join our team in Ahmedabad, India to design and execute test suites for our Business Intelligence and Analytics products. In addition to regular quality assurance activities, automating tests using common automation frameworks such as TestNG and Selenium, is a requirement. So, if the thought of automation is exciting and if you can do most of the following then you're going to fit right in with our exciting team here. 

This is not a remote work-position & in-office attendance is required. 

A Typical Day In The Life Includes

- Work as part of cross functional, passionate agile development teams to ensure quality is driven into the heart of the development process from requirements definition through to delivery of highly concurrent system
 - Evangelize new testing methodologies, best practices, and tools with goals to continuously improve test coverage through automation
 - Proactively bringing issues and problems to the attention of the team, generating, proposing, and implementing innovative solutions to solve them

data.title: Performance Analyst
data.description:
Job Summary

The Performance Analyst QTE116 role focuses on designing executing and optimizing performance tests for complex enterprise applications using modern tools and practices. The analyst ensures stable secure and scalable systems by analyzing performance data identifying bottlenecks and partnering with cross functional teams to deliver reliable user experiences in a hybrid work model. 

Responsibilities

- Design comprehensive performance test strategies that align with business goals to ensure applications meet scalability and reliability expectations in production environments. 
 - Develop detailed performance test scripts using Apache Jmeter and Loadrunner to simulate real world user behavior across critical business workflows. 
 - Execute performance load stress and endurance tests for REST Web Services and microservices to validate response times throughput and system stability. 
 - Analyze performance metrics from servers databases and networks using PerfMon and related tools to identify resource bottlenecks and tuning opportunities. 
 - Create reusable Python utilities and automation frameworks to streamline performance test execution data preparation and result validation. 
 - Validate and monitor REST API performance by designing robust test scenarios that cover functional flows error conditions and security constraints. 
 - Investigate performance issues by correlating application logs Splunk dashboards and infrastructure metrics to determine root cause and remediation steps. 
 - Configure and maintain Docker environments to provision repeatable and isolated performance test setups that mirror production like conditions. 
 - Integrate performance tests into Jenkins CI pipelines to enable continuous performance validation with each build and deployment cycle. 
 - Build intuitive Grafana dashboards to visualize key performance indicators enabling stakeholders to track system health and capacity trends over time. 
 - Utilize Fiddler and similar tools to capture and analyze HTTP traffic ensuring accurate test scripting protocol handling and defect triage. 
 - Apply information security awareness and software security principles to design performance tests that respect data protection requirements and secure coding practices. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers architects and operations teams to review test findings recommend tuning actions and validate performance improvements. 
 - Document performance baselines test approaches results and lessons learned in a clear and reusable format to support future releases and audits. 
 - Follow secure practices aligned to OWASP Top Ten to ensure that performance testing does not introduce vulnerabilities and that nonfunctional risks are managed. 
 - Support defect management by providing detailed evidence metrics and reproduction steps to accelerate resolution of performance related issues. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance testing coverage automation observability and reporting maturity. 
 - Mentor peers on performance testing best practices tooling usage and interpretation of performance metrics to uplift overall team capabilities. 
 - Engage in regular review sessions with product and business stakeholders to explain performance behaviors risks and tradeoffs in understandable terms. 
 - Ensure that all test activities align with corporate information security standards and regulatory expectations reinforcing trust in delivered solutions. 
 - Drive proactive capacity planning by using historical performance trends and forecasts to help teams plan scaling strategies and infrastructure investments. 
 - Support integration of Selenium Python scripts where needed to align functional automation with performance scenarios for end to end validation. 
 - Maintain high quality documentation for test environments configurations and data sets to ensure reproducibility and compliance with internal controls. 
 - Participate in hybrid collaboration routines including onsite and remote ceremonies to ensure alignment across distributed delivery teams. 

Qualifications

- Bring three to five years of hands on experience in performance engineering or performance testing roles with a strong focus on enterprise scale systems. 
 - Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Apache Jmeter and Loadrunner with proven experience designing scripting and maintaining complex performance test suites. 
 - Possess strong technical expertise in REST API REST Web Services JAX RS and SQL based database systems along with solid understanding of database tuning fundamentals. 
 - Show solid programming capability in Python including building utilities automation scripts and integration with test frameworks or CI pipelines. 
 - Have practical experience with Docker administration container orchestration concepts and configuration of containerized test environments. 
 - Exhibit proficiency with monitoring and observability tools such as PerfMon Splunk and Grafana to track system performance and troubleshoot issues in real time. 
 - Apply information security awareness OWASP Top Ten secure practices and software security principles in daily work to ensure that performance solutions remain secure by design. 
 - Bring good to have skills in Selenium Python automation and familiarity with Jenkins CI to support integrated quality pipelines across functional and performance domains. 
 - Offer exposu

Certifications Required

Certified Jmeter Performance Test Engineer or equivalent performance testing certification related to Apache Jmeter and Loadrunner

data.title: Product Operation Associate
data.description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day. 

Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant. 

Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top-tier global investors, 60+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category. 

About The Role

We build software for pharmaceutical quality teams - the systems that decide whether a batch ships, whether an auditor walks away satisfied, and whether a deviation gets closed properly. That means every feature we release has to be correct, documented, and defensible to a regulator. Shipping fast and shipping validated are both non-negotiable, and that tension is exactly where this role lives. 

You'll work alongside our Associate Product Manager as the operational backbone of the product function: testing what engineering builds, writing the test cases that define "done, " producing the validation and CSV documentation our customers depend on, and keeping the paper trail clean while the product moves quickly. 

This is not a role where you'll be told what to think about the roadmap on day one. It is a role where you'll see every feature up close, learn a regulated domain most PMs never touch, and build the judgment that makes a strong PM two years from now. If you want to learn product by being in the details of how it actually gets shipped, this is that seat. 

What You'll Do

Test what we build

- Run structured functional test passes on new features before they reach customers - happy paths, edge cases, permissions, and the ugly states nobody designed for
 - File bugs that engineers can act on immediately: clear repro steps, expected vs. actual, environment, severity
 - Verify fixes and run regression sweeps ahead of each release so old bugs stay dead
 - Coordinate and support UAT with internal stakeholders and, occasionally, customers

Write the test cases

- Translate PRDs and user stories into test cases with explicit preconditions, steps, and expected results
 - Maintain and version the test case library as modules evolve - so the suite reflects the product as it is, not as it was two quarters ago
 - Flag gaps in requirements early: if a spec can't be turned into a test case, it isn't finished, and you'll be the one to say so

Own the CSV and validation documentation

- Draft and maintain Computer System Validation deliverables - user and functional requirement specs, traceability matrices, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols, and test scripts
 - Execute validation protocols and capture objective evidence (screenshots, logs, timestamps) to a standard that survives audit scrutiny
 - Compile executed validation packages, log and route deviations, and keep documentation aligned with 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, and ALCOA+ expectations
 - Work with engineering to keep validation artifacts in sync with what actually shipped

Write the documents that surround the product

- Release notes, user guides, in-app help content, and configuration guides
 - Internal enablement material so sales, CS, and implementation teams can speak to new functionality accurately
 - Meeting notes that become action items with owners, not notes that die in a doc

Support the APM on everything else

- Backlog hygiene - grooming tickets, chasing missing detail, keeping the board honest
 - Competitor teardowns, feature research, and quick customer-facing artifacts
 - Demo environment setup and test data preparation
 - Pulling the data needed to answer "did this actually work?"

Requirements

What We're Looking For (Must-Haves)

- 0-2 years of experience - new graduates welcome. What matters is evidence you can be trusted with detail
 - Exceptional written clarity. Most of your output is documents other people act on; ambiguity in your writing becomes rework for someone else
 - Genuine rigor and patience for detail. In this domain, an untested edge case or an undocumented step is a real problem, not a nitpick
 - Comfort using software deeply - you can learn a complex product quickly and reason about how it should behave, not just how it does
 - High agency. You'll often be the person who notices the gap first, and we expect you to raise it rather than route around it
 - Bachelor's degree in engineering, life sciences, pharmacy, computer science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

Good to Have

- Exposure to pharma, biotech, medical devices, or any regulated environment - QA, QC, regulatory affairs, or validation experience is a strong plus
 - Familiarity with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, or CSV/CSA concepts
 - Hands-on QA or test-case-writing experience, manual or automated
 - Comfort with tools like JIRA/Linear, Notion/Confluence, Figma, Postman, or Playwright
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted tools (Claude, Cursor, and similar) to move faster on documentation and testing
 - Basic SQL or spreadsheet fluency for answering simple product questions

Benefits

- Be part of a fast-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting-edge technology
 - Collaborate with a passionate, high-performing team building innovative AI-powered digital solutions
 - Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
 - Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
 - Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
 - Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
 - Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

data.title: Engineering Manager - Ruby on Rails
data.description:
Engineering Manager, WMS

Summary
Anchanto, a leading global B2B SaaS enterprise, seeks an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the critical development and operations of its Warehouse Management System (WMS). This platform is central to the daily operations of brands, retailers, and logistics partners, managing complex workflows including inventory control, order fulfillment, and omnichannel commerce. The Engineering Manager will drive the engineering and quality assurance teams, fostering a culture of outcome ownership rather than mere task oversight. Reporting to the Engineering Head of WMS, this leader is responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and technical excellence of a mission-critical system that supports high-volume, real-time warehouse operations across Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and AWS environments. The role demands a strategic partner who can balance technical innovation with operational stability while guiding the team through a transition to an integrated, AI-first working model. 

Responsibilities

- Delivery Management: Ensure predictable engineering output by managing capacity planning, identifying risks early, and executing recovery strategies to meet 90-day commitments with high accuracy and zero delays. 

- Quality Engineering Leadership: Establish and maintain rigorous standards for code quality, test coverage (including RSpec, integration, and load testing), and deployment frequency. Own the metrics for change failure rates and ensure independent QA sign-off remains unaffected by delivery pressures. 

- System Reliability & Performance: Directly manage service availability and latency, overseeing incident response and root cause analysis to resolve recurring issues. Target 99. 9% uptime for owned services and sub-200ms P95 latency for critical APIs while reducing Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). 

- Technical Architecture & Security: Operate within established architectural and security guardrails to protect multi-tenant isolation and system performance. Enforce secure software development lifecycle practices, including threat modeling, static and dynamic analysis, and compliance with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 standards. 

- Cost Optimization: Monitor and optimize engineering costs related to compute, storage, and AI tooling, ensuring that cost-per-delivered-item and infrastructure expenses trend downward without compromising quality. 

- AI Integration: Drive the adoption of AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot) to shift the team toward spec-driven delivery. Lead the transition of AI-enabled features, such as intelligent slotting and capacity forecasting, from pilot programs to production-grade solutions. 

- Team Development & Staffing: Manage the full lifecycle of team members, including hiring, performance reviews, and career growth planning. Foster a culture of continuous learning that encourages engineers to evolve from specialists into versatile product builders. 

- Hands-on Technical Contribution: Engage directly in solution design, prototyping, and complex implementation tasks where necessary to unblock the team. Gradually increase team autonomy to reduce dependency on the manager for routine decisions. 

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with the Engineering Head, Product Management, Delivery Managers, and other technical leads to align on priorities, manage technical debt, and ensure smooth go-live processes. 

- Stakeholder Alignment: Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, Implementation teams, and Security groups to manage customer commitments, handle escalations, and ensure release readiness. 

Requirements

Requirements: 

- Experience: 9 to 18 years of software engineering background, including a minimum of 4 years in a leadership role managing engineering teams and owning delivery outcomes. 

- Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in Ruby on Rails backend development at scale, with strong knowledge of asynchronous processing (Sidekiq/Redis), PostgreSQL performance tuning, and high-throughput system architectures. 

- Cloud & Infrastructure: Proven experience building distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including EKS/Kubernetes, ECS, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Aurora, S3, API Gateway, and Redis. 

- System Design: Strong capability in designing scalable, multi-tenant architectures with robust handling of idempotency, retries, backpressure, and failure scenarios. 

- Reliability Engineering: Solid background in observability (metrics, logs, traces), SLO/SLI definition, incident management, and maintaining strict on-call discipline. 

- DevOps & Automation: Proficiency with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm), and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, AWS CDK). 

- Quality Assurance: Demonstrated experience leading QA engineers or quality practices, with a focus on maintaining independent sign-off and improving DORA metrics. 

- AI & Modern Tooling: Practical experience utilizing AI coding tools to enhance productivity and a track record of transitioning teams to spec-driven workflows. 

- Security Compliance: Familiarity with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls, GDPR, PII handling, and secure SDLC practices including threat modeling and vulnerability scanning. 

- Leadership Skills: Ability to calibrate performance levels, coach team members, manage underperformance, and guide teams through organizational change. 

- Preferred Qualifications: Experience with monolith-to-microservices migration and domain knowledge in WMS, OMS, TMS, or 3PL logistics. 

- Core Behaviors: A mindset focused on outcome ownership, execution discipline, systems thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a structured leadership framework while maintaining the autonomy to solve problems proactively. 

Benefits

Why Join Anchanto

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business. 

- Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment. 

- Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth. 

- International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets. 

- Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support your health and well-being. 

- Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments. 

- Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution. 

- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities. 

- Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

data.title: MGR II R&D/PRODUCT DVL ENGINEERING - Signal Integrity
data.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. 

Job Overview

TE Connectivity's Signal Integrity Center of Excellence (SI COE) drives research and development to solve critical bandwidth and high-speed interconnect challenges. The SI COE delivers validated signal integrity solutions to product teams and customers through advanced simulation, rigorous analysis, and precision measurement. 

Core capabilities include detailed electrical modeling and simulation across connectors, cables, PCBs, semiconductor packages, and full systems - with a strong emphasis on model validation and correlation. The SI COE also establishes design guidelines, simulation methodologies, model quality standards, and reusable engineering workflows, while providing expert technical guidance to internal design teams and customers where signal integrity performance is paramount. 

Areas of expertise span electromagnetics, microwave/RF engineering, test and measurement, integrated circuits, packaging, and system-level simulation. 

Roles & Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

- Build, develop, and grow a high-performing engineering group aligned with the broader team strategy and organizational objectives
 - Provide active mentorship to team members, helping navigate internal challenges and removing external roadblocks to sustain engineering momentum
 - Manage a geographically distributed and diverse group of design engineers, fostering a culture of independence, accountability, and technical excellence
 - Analyze workforce utilization and optimize workflows to maximize team efficiency and output

Project & Program Management

- Develop and administer project schedules, milestones, and performance requirements to ensure timely delivery
 - Assess and mitigate project risk and ensure compliance across all team initiatives
 - Determine the best course of action to meet delivery schedules and resolve complex technical challenges
 - Plan and execute special projects to expand organizational capability and functional effectiveness

Strategic Influence & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Provide decisive leadership in resolving high-impact issues affecting the SI COE and its customers
 - Evaluate complex, multi-variable situations - including business trends, technical feasibility, and manufacturing capabilities - to inform sound decision-making
 - Drive collaboration across organizational levels, gaining alignment with System Architecture, Advanced Development, Advanced Manufacturing, Strategy, and Product Management teams
 - Champion innovative and non-traditional approaches to enhance engineering performance and accelerate speed to market
 - Build and leverage a strong internal technical network across TE Connectivity
 - Serve as a key point of contact in interactions with customers and suppliers

Education & Experience

What your background should look like

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field
 - 10+ years of product development engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering management experience leading cross-functional or distributed teams

Technical Expertise

- Hands-on experience in the connector and cable assembly industry, with preference for high-speed I/O connectors, high-speed board-to-board connectors, and internal/external cable assemblies
 - Demonstrated participation in the full product development lifecycle - from defining customer requirements through qualification and production release
 - Proficiency with high-speed/high-frequency modeling and simulation tools such as Ansys HFSS, CST Microwave Studio, or Keysight ADS
 - Deep understanding of high-speed signal integrity phenomena and their implications at the system level
 - Familiarity with design-for-manufacturability (DFM) principles, including mechanical, environmental, electrical, and cost considerations

Leadership & Interpersonal Skills

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a clear understanding of cross-functional team roles and dynamics
 - Demonstrated leadership capability with a strong sense of accountability and the ability to influence without direct authority
 - Ability to thrive in a global work environment, with flexibility to collaborate across time zones, including early morning and evening hours as needed

Hi, 

Exp: 3-4 Years

As a DevOps Engineer you'll be responsible for deploying, managing, and troubleshooting our on-prem platform across customer datacentres. We're looking for someone with hands-on experience across self-managed databases, Linux and networking, Kubernetes operations, and Ansible automation. You'll also own production issues and work closely with customer infrastructure, network, and security teams. 

Key Responsibilities: 

· Deploy and upgrade Java/Spring Boot services on Kubernetes clusters inside customer datacentres, using Helm with per-customer value sets. 

· Manage the Kubernetes clusters themselves - installation and version upgrades, node lifecycle and capacity, control-plane and etcd health, certificate rotation, CNI, ingress and storage classes - both on clusters we build and on enterprise distributions the customer provides. 

· Provision, tune and operate self-managed databases on Linux VMs - MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB - including replication, backup, verified point-in-time restore, and version upgrades. 

· Provision and operate the middleware layer on VMs - Redis (Sentinel), Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ - including clustering, authentication and capacity planning. 

· Run OpenSearch as the centralised application log store: shard and heap sizing, index lifecycle and retention policies, cluster health. 

· Automate the full infrastructure build with Ansible - reusable roles plus per-customer inventories, so the same automation installs the stack at every customer without being forked. 

· Own day-2 Kubernetes operations: rollouts, probe and resource tuning, persistent storage, ingress and TLS, and diagnosis of pod, scheduling and networking failures. 

· Troubleshoot production issues across the VM, network, Kubernetes and JVM boundaries - determine whether a fault is infrastructure or application, and drive root-cause analysis. 

· Debug connectivity problems at the command line: routing, firewalls, DNS, MTU, TLS chains and certificate trust, packet capture. 

· Manage certificates, truststores and private container registry (Harbor) content for restricted and air-gapped environments.

Founded in 2011, ReNew, is one of the largest renewable energy companies globally, with a leadership position in India. Listed on Nasdaq under the ticker RNW, ReNew develops, builds, owns, and operates utility-scale wind energy projects, utility-scale solar energy projects, utility-scale firm power projects, and distributed solar energy projects. In addition to being a major independent power producer in India, ReNew is evolving to become an end-to-end decarbonization partner providing solutions in a just and inclusive manner in the areas of clean energy, green hydrogen, value-added energy offerings through digitalisation, storage, and carbon markets that increasingly are integral to addressing climate change. With a total capacity of more than 13. 4 GW (including projects in pipeline), ReNew's solar and wind energy projects are spread across 150+ sites, with a presence spanning 18 states in India, contributing to 1. 9 % of India's power capacity. data.title: Control & Instrumentation Lead (O&M- PSP Hydro)
data.description:
Control & Instrumentation lead is responsible for overseeing the SCADA, automation and instrumentation operation and maintenance works for Hydro and PSP Assets. This role is pivotal in ensuring optimal power generation, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement within the Hydro and pump storage plant. The position aligns with Adani Group's mission to drive sustainable energy solutions and supports PSP Hydro's strategic focus on operational excellence, risk management, and stakeholder collaboration. 

Key Responsibilities

- Ensure reliable, safe and efficient operation of all generating units, auxiliaries, and balance of plant systems. 
 - Ensures full compliance with Statutory HSS, environmental, cybersecurity and technical requirements from central and state governmental bodies (i. e. CEA, CERC, DSA, SCEI, AP/CPCB etc. compliances). 
 - Support and Guide site teams for Operation & Maintenance of OT and IT systems for Plant SCADA and control system. 
 - High level understanding of SCADA and Control System factory and site acceptance testing (FAT and SAT) and its associated documentation. 
 - Implement external interfaces to the plant i. e. RCI, EMI, AGC, interface to SLDC / RLDC over PLCC and Forte etc. Co-ordination for implementation of Remote-Control Interface (RCI) at Plant with central team. 
 - Ensure O&M for C&I systems at Hydro and PSP Assets are aligned and carried out in line with prevailing O&M practices in the organization. 
 - Implement analytical tools, procedures, protocols etc. for ensuring efficient and effective monitoring, cost and performance optimization of C&I systems/works at Hydro and PSP Assets. 
 - Supports site teams in handling all operational emergencies/trouble shootings pertaining to C&I area, for sustainable production. Monitoring critical parameters and render technical help to resolve the anomalies. Analyze the performance and bring operational improvement. 
 - Support and guide site teams to manage inventory of instruments, Plant OT, IT system and maintain all licenses. 
 - Develop and coordinate with site teams for implementation of maintenance procedures for Plant SCADA/control system equipment. 
 - Guide and train site engineers on maintenance and troubleshooting of plant SCADA / control system equipment. 
 - Assist Lead C&I in equipment failure investigations and analysis for C&I part, establish RCA framework and implement performance monitoring, corrective actions and continuous improvement methodology. 
 - Preparation of service contract and contract management for C&I maintenance for works outsourced to external service providers. 
 - Assist Lead C&I in preparing and managing C&I maintenance budget, work to optimize the costs and maximize production. 
 - Assist Lead C&I in establishing Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) at plant level, for C&I systems. 
 - Assist lead C&I in driving plant improvement projects, modernization initiatives, digital transformation, and automation upgrades. 
 - IMS implementation, documentation preparation and updating, pertaining to your area. 
 - Ensures adherence to Cybersecurity requirements and compliance for Plant process control system. Support IT team in documentation and implementation of ISMS 27001 at Hydro and PSP Assets. 
 - Perform any other duties as may be assigned by Lead C&I, from time to time. 

Qualifications and Experience

- B. E/B. Tech in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics/Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering. 
 - 13+ years of experience C&I within hydro power generation sector. 
 - Strong knowledge of statutory and regulatory requirements pertaining to C&I and Cybersecurity for Hydro/PSP Plants. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 104, IEC 101, IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC, and similar control system network protocols. 
 - Experience in IMS implementation for operational Plant. Including ISMS 27001. 
 - Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) for Plant maintenance works. 
 - Proven experience with C&I system, including specification, design, assessment, verification, testing, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of Hydro/PSP Plant SCADA and Control system. 
 - Knowledge of analytics tools for performance optimization and risk assessment.

data.title: Lead Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
About Onit

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions. 

We're a team of innovators using AI at the core to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we're looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech. 

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we'd love to meet you. 

We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Lead Quality Engineer with strong expertise in data quality, analytics/report testing, ETL validation, SQL, and test automation . 

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience testing Tableau, Superset dashboards and reports , validating data across different layers of the data pipeline, and independently verifying business KPIs and metrics by writing SQL queries . 

This role requires a strong understanding of the complete data lifecycle-from source systems through ETL/ELT pipelines and data warehouses to Tableau dashboards and reports . The candidate should be capable of identifying data discrepancies, performing reconciliation, validating transformation logic, and conducting root-cause analysis when reported metrics do not match underlying data. 

This is a technical leadership role. The Lead Quality Engineer will provide guidance and mentorship to other Quality Engineers while remaining actively hands-on with SQL, data validation, automation, troubleshooting, and testing . 

AI-assisted engineering is a mandatory part of this role. The candidate must have practical experience using AI engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude, or equivalent tools as part of their day-to-day work for test development, SQL generation, automation, troubleshooting, test-case creation, and productivity improvement. 

Key Responsibilities

Analytics Testing

- Perform hands-on testing of Tableau Superset dashboards, reports, and analytics capabilities . 
 - Validate dashboard data against underlying databases, data warehouses, and source systems. 
 - Validate Tableau Superset filters, parameters, calculated fields, dimensions, measures, aggregations, and drill-down functionality. 
 - Verify that reports accurately represent underlying business data and reporting requirements. 
 - Validate dashboards across different datasets and business scenarios. 
 - Identify and troubleshoot discrepancies between Tableau Superset reports and underlying data. 

KPI & Data Validation

- Understand business KPIs, metrics, calculations, and reporting definitions . 
 - Independently translate KPI definitions and business rules into SQL validation queries . 
 - Write complex SQL queries to validate metrics displayed in reports and dashboards. 
 - Validate calculations including counts, sums, averages, percentages, ratios, trends, and period-over-period metrics. 
 - Perform data reconciliation between source systems, data warehouses, and reporting layers. 
 - Validate data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, and integrity . 
 - Work closely with Product and Analytics teams to ensure KPI definitions and acceptance criteria are clear, measurable, and testable. 

ETL / ELT & Data Pipeline Validation

- Perform end-to-end ETL/ELT testing and data validation . 
 - Validate data across source → staging → transformation → warehouse → reporting layers. 
 - Validate source-to-target mappings and transformation/business rules. 
 - Verify full loads, incremental loads, historical data loads, and data refresh processes. 
 - Validate handling of null values, duplicates, missing records, incorrect mappings, and data-type issues. 
 - Perform reconciliation of large datasets across different stages of the data pipeline. 
 - Troubleshoot data discrepancies and identify the stage at which data quality issues are introduced. 
 - Validate data pipeline failure, retry, and recovery scenarios. 

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

- Design and implement comprehensive test strategies for analytics, reporting, data pipelines, APIs, and application functionality . 
 - Develop and maintain automated tests for data validation, API testing, and regression testing. 
 - Automate repetitive SQL and data-validation scenarios. 
 - Build reusable automation frameworks and quality-validation utilities. 
 - Integrate automated tests and quality checks into CI/CD pipelines . 
 - Continuously improve regression coverage and reduce dependency on manual testing. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis for production and customer-reported issues. 
 - Drive a quality engineering and defect-prevention mindset throughout the development lifecycle. 

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering

- Use AI-assisted engineering tools as part of day-to-day work . 
 - Leverage AI to accelerate: 
 - Test-case and test-scenario creation 
 - Automation script development 
 - API test creation 
 - Test-data generation 
 - Log analysis and troubleshooting 
 - Identify opportunities to introduce AI-driven automation into existing Quality Engineering processes. 
 - Continuously evaluate new AI tools and techniques that can improve quality, test coverage, and engineering productivity. 
Benefits & Perks That Support You

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond: 

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members. 

Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually. 

Family Support: Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement. 

Income Protection: 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance. 

Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident. 

Tax-Advantaged Accounts: Flexi, NPS. 

Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community. 

Our Commitment to Applicants

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we're looking for. 

Onit Values

Customer First - Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs. 

Purposeful Innovation - Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise. 

Win as One - Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly. 

Intentional Growth - Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer in Test
data.description:
About Druva

Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva's graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence. 

Trusted by nearly 7, 500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world. 

Visit druva. com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook. 

Team & Mission: Druva Product Platform

The Druva Product Platform team builds the shared core SaaS application foundation that every Druva product is built on. Our multi-tenant services, APIs, and control-plane capabilities manage tenant provisioning and lifecycle, Identity & Access Management (IAM/RBAC), distributed job scheduling, usage metering, and platform observability. 

Because every Druva workload depends on this platform, quality and reliability are critical. A bug or latency spike in the platform propagates across the entire Druva ecosystem. Quality Engineering in this team is a pure software engineering discipline: we build scalable automation frameworks, and implement CI/CD quality gates that safeguard billions of operations each year. 

Role Overview

As a Senior Software Engineer (QA / SDET) on the Druva Product Platform team, you will be the technical lead for quality engineering across distributed multi-tenant microservices, high-throughput APIs, and asynchronous event streams. 

You will build test strategies, test automation frameworks in Python or Go, design functional test suites including scale & chaos engineering, partner with developers from day one (Shift-Left), and embed automated quality gates into CI/CD deployment pipelines. 

Key Skills (Must-Haves)

- 5-8+ years of progressive experience in software quality engineering / SDET, with a focus on backend distributed systems and multi-tenant SaaS platforms. 
 - Strong coding skills in Python or Go (Golang) with a deep understanding of data structures, OOP principles, and test automation design patterns. 
 - Extensive experience in developing test automation frameworks from scratch (using frameworks like PyTest, Testify, RestAssured, Playwright, or Selenium). 
 - Advanced expertise in RESTful API and gRPC testing, including API contract validation, schema backward compatibility, and mock services. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS Cloud services (EC2, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, EKS) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Strong proficiency in SQL for data validation, state verification, and synthetic test data generation. 
 - Demonstrated experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) with sub-15 minute execution loops and zero tolerance for flaky tests. 

Desirable Skills (Nice-to-Haves)

- Experience with Chaos Engineering methodologies and tooling (Chaos Mesh, AWS FIS, LitmusChaos) to validate system fault tolerance. 
 - Domain expertise in data protection, backup/recovery, storage systems, virtualization, or cyber resilience. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise SaaS security testing (OWASP Top 10, auth flows, mTLS, RBAC testing). 
 - Experience testing event-driven architectures and streaming pipelines (Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS). 
 - Experience testing Generative AI / LLM workflows and evaluating AI model outputs. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for provisioning ephemeral test environments. 

Role And Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain modular, scalable test automation frameworks in Python or Go for microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, and distributed event pipelines. 
 - Formulate comprehensive end-to-end test strategies and test plans for multi-tenant control plane capabilities, IAM, job orchestration, and metering. 
 - Drive "Shift-Left" quality by actively reviewing architectural RFCs and PRs, defining testability requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria upfront. 
 - Design, automate, and execute large-scale concurrency, and stress test suites to uncover bottlenecks before production releases. 
 - Implement Chaos Engineering experiments simulating node failures, network latency, and service degradation to validate system resilience. 
 - Embed automated regression, API, and integration suites into CI/CD pipelines, providing fast and reliable feedback gates to developers. 
 - Analyze production incidents, reproduce edge-case defects, and build permanent automated regression tests to prevent bug leakage. Track and improve Quality Engineering metrics: Defect Escape Rate, Automation Coverage (>90%), and Flaky Test Ratios (
 - Mentor junior QA engineers and developers in automation framework architecture, clean testing patterns, and quality best practices. 

Qualification

- B. Tech / B. E / M. E / M. Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience

data.title: Flutter Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Scapia! A credit card that's out there to make travel happen for people, by converting their everyday expenses into travel experiences. We're a bunch of passionate people who work together, brainstorm, and debate with each other, and don't stop until we're proud of our work. Customer delight tops everything else! We've worked hard to create an environment of honesty and passion that sets everyone up for success. 

About the Role

We are looking for Flutter Engineers with 4 to 6 years of experience to join the frontend team at Scapia. You will be placed in a pod based on where your strengths fit. You will work across surfaces spanning card onboarding and servicing, UPI and bill payments, travel

search and checkout, rewards, and the shared design system beneath them. You will collaborate closely with design, backend, product and our bank and supplier partner teams to take a surface from spec through to a staged production rollout. 

What You'll Do

Feature Ownership

- Own customer-facing surfaces end to end, from problem definition and technical design through rollout, adoption metrics and the on-call that follows. 
 - Set the technical direction for your surface and make the architecture calls that keep it changeable a year from now. 
 - Partner with design, product and backend to turn ambiguous problem statements into shipped, measured experiences. 

Cards and Payments

- Build and scale the card experience across onboarding, activation, limits, statements, EMI and rewards. 
 - Deliver payment experiences that are fast, reliable and compliant, spanning UPI, bill payments and card transactions. 
 - Shape how the app adapts to multiple bank partners, so that a single change ships safely across every programme. 

Travel Commerce

- Build high-converting search, booking and checkout journeys across flights, stays, trains, buses, visas and experiences. 
 - Create discovery and merchandising surfaces that help customers evaluate options and choose with confidence. 
 - Own post-booking experiences spanning cancellations, refunds, rewards and customer communication. 

App Health and Performance

- Continuously improve app performance, stability and size across ANRs, crashes, startup time and memory. 
 - Strengthen observability through crash reporting, instrumentation and analytics that teams can act on. 
 - Advance release engineering, including staged rollouts, remote kill switches and over-the-air patching on Android and iOS. 

Platform and Craft

- Contribute to the shared design system and widget library that every surface at Scapia is built on. 
 - Champion clean architecture, testing and code quality, from golden tests to end-to-end automation. 
 - Raise the bar for the team through spec reviews, code reviews and the tooling you build along the way. 

How We Build

Every change here starts as a written spec that is reviewed and approved before implementation begins. AI agents do a lot of the work in between: generating implementation from an approved spec, turning Figma components into design system code, and cleaning up dead feature flags. The review bar has not changed. You own the design, you review the diff, and you answer for it in production. 

What We're Looking For

- 2 to 6 years of Flutter experience, with at least one app shipped to a store and supported in production. 
 - Strong Dart fundamentals and real depth in state management with Bloc or Cubit. 
 - Ability to read a crash report or a trace and work backwards to the cause. 
 - Clear written communication. Specs, pull request descriptions and incident notes are a large part of the job. 
 - Comfort with ownership: your own builds, the pager for your surface, and your own production debugging. 

Good to Have

- Native Android (Kotlin) or iOS (Swift) depth for platform channel work. 
 - Experience with a shared SDK or a multi-flavour app where one change affects several products. 
 - Prior experience in fintech, payments, travel or another regulated or transaction-led domain. 
 - Startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and wearing multiple hats.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Automation Test Lead with over 8 years of experience in software quality assurance to spearhead our testing initiatives. In this role, you will define the automation strategy, build robust frameworks, and lead a team of QA engineers. Your primary focus will be optimizing and executing automated regression suites for complex, enterprise-level Salesforce ecosystems using Tricentis Tosca. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business processes and technical execution, ensuring the seamless delivery of high-quality CRM solutions in an Agile environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Strategy & Framework Design: Define, build, and maintain scalable, model-based automation frameworks using Tricentis Tosca optimized for Salesforce. 
 - Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead, mentor, and allocate tasks to a team of QA engineers. Coordinate testing activities across multi-vendor setups and cross-functional Agile teams. 
 - Salesforce End-to-End Validation: Map end-to-end business workflows and validate complex configurations across core Salesforce environments (e. g. , Sales Cloud, Service Cloud). 
 - Test Lifecycle Management: Oversee the creation of detailed test strategies, test plans, and high-coverage automation scripts from business requirements.

data.title: Gen AI Expert
data.description:
GenAI Expert

Role Overview

We're seeking an AI Expert with 8+ years of combined Gen AI and QA/Testing with Test automation expertise. This is a specialized IC role for someone who bridges AI systems engineering with rigorous quality assurance. You'll architect production-grade AI systems (RAG pipelines, fine-tuning, prompt optimization, inference scaling) while simultaneously designing comprehensive testing strategies, test cases, test plans, test automation, and execution frameworks that ensure AI systems behave reliably at scale. You own both the AI implementation and the quality validation end-to-end. 

This role is for someone with deep testing domain knowledge who has evolved into Gen AI, or vice versa, equally strong in both. You're not just implementing off-the-shelf models; you're designing retrieval systems, optimizing inference pipelines, evaluating model trade-offs, and building systems that reliably serve millions of transactions. You understand that GenAI is as much about solving the "why" (business impact) as the "how" (technical implementation)

What We're Looking For (Who You Are)

- AI Systems Architect: 4+ years of experience, and building and shipping LLM systems in production. You understand model selection, RAG architecture, fine-tuning strategies, inference optimization, and cost management. You make pragmatic trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and cost. 
 - Testing Domain Expert: Rigorous QA/testing background atleast 5+ years. You're fluent in test case design, test plan creation, test automation frameworks, test execution strategies, and test reporting. You understand different testing types (unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, regression, smoke, sanity) and when to apply each. You can architect testing strategies from scratch. 
 - Independent Operator: You own AI features end-to-end-from problem definition through evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring. You unblock yourself and make good decisions with incomplete information. 
 - Production-Focused Builder: You've shipped LLM systems at scale. Comfortable with tokenization, context windows, vector database optimization, handling hallucinations and failures. 
 - Team Amplifier: You mentor engineers on AI best practices, participate in code reviews, and help scale GenAI adoption. 
 - Continuous Experimenter: You A/B test approaches, iterate based on production data, and stay current with rapid LLM evolution. 

Technical Stack & Qualifications

Category

Requirement

GenAI Core

- LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face), model trade-offs and selection
 - RAG pipeline architecture, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS)
 - Prompt engineering, fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA), inference optimization
 - Cost and latency management, hallucination detection and mitigation
 - Agentic patterns, multi-step reasoning, reliability under uncertaintyTesting Skills

- Test case design (positive, negative, edge cases, boundary conditions)
 - Test planning and coverage analysis
 - Test types: Unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, regression, smoke, sanity testing
 - Test automation frameworks (pytest, Jest, Selenium, Cypress)
 - Test execution, CI/CD pipeline setup, test reporting and metrics dashboards
 - Defect tracking and root cause analysis
 - AI-specific testing: Evaluation frameworks (accuracy, F1, precision, recall), regression testing for models, hallucination testing, bias detection, A/B testing for AI features, mocking LLM APIs in testing, handling non-deterministic outputs through deterministic test designEducation

Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent professional experience. Practical portfolio or published work demonstrating GenAI/ML implementation is valued highly. 

Responsibilities

- Build: Design and implement end-to-end GenAI systems-RAG pipelines, fine-tuning strategies, prompt optimization. Make pragmatic choices between model options, latency/cost trade-offs, and production constraints. 
 - Ship: Own deployment of AI features. Ensure reliability, scalability, and proper handling of edge cases (hallucinations, rate limits, failures). 
 - Measure: Instrument systems with telemetry. Run experiments comparing approaches. Iterate based on production data and user feedback. 
 - Collaborate: Mentor engineers on AI best practices. Participate in code reviews. Help the team adopt and scale GenAI capabilities

data.title: Software Engineer 1
data.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity

At New Relic, we provide our customers real-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to quickly identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance and get the most of their software and infrastructure. 

The Infrastructure product organization develops New Relic infrastructure instrumentation agents, next generation data processing and management services, vulnerability management, and security testing capabilities for on-prem and cloud customers. We work with data at a scale using a diverse tech stack (Go, Java, JavaScript, React, GraphQL, Kubernetes, many public cloud web services, and more). As a senior backend engineer, you will help us build and extend next generation solutions such as a control plane for customers to manage their data pipelines at scale. 

New Relic is looking for engineers who are interested in building a brand-new observability experience. This high-impact engineering position is a phenomenal opportunity to own and build a set of next generation services and capabilities for the company. We are searching for a motivated engineer who is ready for a career-defining role in their next opportunity. We look forward to talking with you!

What You'll Do

- Design, Build, maintain, and scale back-end services and their support tools. 
 - Participate in architectural definitions with a high degree of innovation and creativity. 
 - Creating automation and tooling to make our systems more scalable and easier to deploy. 
 - Working directly within a multidisciplinary team to help our customers and partners. 
 - Research new tools and services to understand complex scenarios and to also propose new features. 
 - Working in an agile environment with a DevOps approach - teams build and maintain their own software

This role requires

- Bachelor's degree, software development, engineering, or a related technical field
 - 2 to 4 years of experience working as a software engineer working in Java and/or Go with a strong computer science background and an aptitude for learning new languages quickly
 - Demonstrated experience in designing, developing, and maintaining large-scale software systems, utilizing modern programming languages and frameworks
 - Proven ability to mentor a team of software engineers, guiding them towards technical excellence, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality code
 - Strong understanding of scalable distributed systems and microservices architecture, with the ability to design and implement solutions that meet performance and scalability requirements. 
 - Passion for exploring new technologies and finding creative solutions to complex problems, keeping up with industry trends and advancements in observability and related domains
 - Excellent collaboration abilities, with the capacity to work effectively with cross-functional teams, present ideas, and communicate technical concepts clearly
 - Keep up to date with technologies - AWS/Azure/GCP, serverless, Docker, Kubernetes among others. 

Bonus points if you have

- Contribution to open source projects. 
 - Familiarity with the tech stacks mentioned above
 - Understanding the value that build and test automation brings to a development team's efficiency and reliability and are passionate about applying these techniques to your projects. 
 - Experience in technical mentorship and help with leveling up the skills of other colleagues on the team. 
 - Experience with asynchronous programming techniques: streams, event-based flows, task queues, message queues. 

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics' different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us - including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We're looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes. 

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please reach out to resume@newrelic. com. 

We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid. 

Our hiring process

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic. 

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records based on individual circumstances and in accordance with applicable law including, but not limited to, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. 

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic. 

New Relic develops and distributes encryption software and technology that complies with U. S. export controls and licensing requirements. Certain New Relic roles require candidates to pass an export compliance assessment as a condition of employment in any global location. If relevant, we will provide more information later in the application process. 

Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.

Role Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Offshore Delivery Test Head to own the end-to-end quality engineering and testing function for a large multi-geography key client account This is a critical leadership role responsible for developing a scalable, standardized testing organization that safeguards release quality, accelerates delivery velocity, and strengthens client confidence across our eMACH. ai and PF Wealth portfolios. You will work closely with the client to drive usage of AI benefits across testing, unify test strategy, drive automation uptake around methods such as Acceptance Test-Driven Development (ATDD) or Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), and governance across programs, acting as the primary quality custodian between Architecture, Delivery, Engineering, and Client Success. 

Key Mandates

- Unified Test Function Leadership: Enhance and lead a centralized offshore testing organization with an onshore presence in the UK at client site, spanning functional, automation, performance, and regression testing across all delivery programs and capabilities. Owning the onshore/ offshore resourcing model, capacity planning and skill mix ratios across UK and India. 
 - Quality-Led Delivery Governance: Own test strategy and quality gates end-to-end, ensuring releases are defect-free, predictable, and aligned to client SLAs and compliance requirements. 
 - Test Automation & Efficiency: Drive at pace the shift from manual to automation-first testing, optimizing coverage, reducing cycle time and improving defect leakage metrics across programs. 
 - Delivery Integration: Act as the primary quality partner to Architecture, Delivery, Engineering, and Program Management teams to ensure a "One Intellect" approach to release readiness and client sign-off. 
 - Testing & Thought Leadership: Stay current on industry trends and emerging technologies in QA, AI, DevOps, and testing to drive innovation whilst championing and embedding a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement. Owning the innovation/AI roadmap for test delivery (GenAI test generation, self-healing automation, agentic testing tools), evaluate, pilot, and drive adoption; be the technical point of credibility when discussing AI direction with the client counterpart. 

Responsibilities: 

Test Strategy & Governance: 

- Define and own the test strategy, methodology, and quality frameworks across all delivery engagements. 
 - Optimize existing use of automation, standardized test processes, entry/exit criteria, and defect management practices across programs. 
 - Maintain a strong working understanding of AI governance and responsible AI adoption in regulated environments
 - Oversee Test readiness and release sign-off, ensuring cross-functional alignment between Engineering, Delivery, DevOps, Release and Client functions. 
 - Drive and define the Test Strategies for large scale Digital and Salesforce implementations and aligned Mobile Apps across both B2B and B2C channels for native iOS and Android applications covering automation, functional, data focused, usability, performance and security testing. 

Test Execution & Automation Excellence: 

- Lead automation, functional, regression, data, integration, performance, operational acceptance and security testing across a key client account integrating as appropriate with eMACH. ai Wealth and PF Wealth suites. 
 - Drive automation coverage expansion, tooling adoption, and CI/CD-integrated testing pipelines. 
 - Manage test pipeline health by overseeing defect aging, root-cause analysis, and driving resolution for critical/high-severity issues. 

Cross-Functional Orchestration: 

- Delivery Interlock: Work closely with Delivery Heads to ensure test plans, resourcing, and timelines are realistic, scalable, and aligned to project milestones.

 - Client Engagement: Represent the quality function in client governance forums, providing transparent status reporting, risk visibility, and quality metrics. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Experience: 18+ years in Software Testing/Quality Engineering within Banking, Wealth Management, Capital Markets, or FinTech domains, with at least 10+ years in senior leadership roles managing multi geo teams powered by large offshore test centres. 
 - Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the Wealth & Asset Management lifecycle, including Retirements, Investments, overall financial planning, Mortgages and
 - products, Investment platforms and related compliance/regulatory testing needs.

 - Tech Fluency: Strong familiarity with modern test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native testing, performance/load testing tools, and AI-driven test optimization. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Exceptional track record of engaging at CxO and senior client levels, both internally across matrixed organizations and externally with global financial institutions.

 - Thought Leadership: Proven leader who can drive quality engineering best practices and serve in an advisory role to senior customer and internal stakeholders.

 - Test Velocity: Improved test cycle time and automation coverage percentage across programs.
