data.title: Manager, Data Science
data.description:
Job Description

Thomson Reuters is expanding its Data Science and AI organization and is looking for a Manager to lead a team building intelligent products and automation. You will own the full lifecycle of ML and GenAI solutions, from problem framing to production deployment and operation. The work spans traditional machine learning and modern GenAI systems, including LLM applications, RAG, agents, and multi-agent platforms. You will set technical direction, develop your team, and partner with business stakeholders to deliver measurable impact. 

Key Responsibilities

Production deployment and delivery

- Own end-to-end delivery of ML and GenAI solutions from prototype to monitored production systems. 
 - Establish MLOps and LLMOps practices: CI/CD, versioning, testing, observability, drift detection, and cost monitoring. 
 - Define evaluation frameworks for both classical models and LLM/agent systems, covering accuracy, groundedness, safety, and regression testing. 

Technical platform ownership

- Own the architecture, roadmap, and operations of the team's AI platform, including model serving, vector stores, retrieval pipelines, and orchestration layers. 
 - Build reusable agentic capabilities (tools, skills, workflow templates, evaluation harnesses) for adoption across teams and products. 
 - Lead build-versus-buy decisions across models, frameworks, and cloud services. 

Technical thought leadership

- Set direction for agentic AI, RAG, and multi-agent orchestration, and define architecture patterns and standards. 
 - Evaluate emerging models, frameworks, and protocols (e. g. , MCP) and translate them into practical adoption. 
 - Champion responsible AI, security, and governance in all solutions. 

Coaching and mentoring

- Lead, coach, and grow data scientists and AI engineers through feedback, code and design reviews, and career development. 
 - Build a culture of rigor, experimentation, and ownership. 
 - Hire, onboard, and retain strong talent. 

Stakeholder partnership

- Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to prioritize use cases and design solutions. 
 - Apply AI and data science to business problems such as workflow automation, customer retention, cross-sell, segmentation, pricing, and recommendations. 
 - Communicate results and trade-offs clearly to audiences from engineers to senior leadership. 

Required Qualifications

- 8-10 years of experience in data science and machine learning, with models deployed in production. 
 - Experience leading, mentoring, or managing data scientists or ML engineers. 
 - Hands-on experience building LLM applications, including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector search. 
 - Experience designing and shipping agentic systems, including tool use, orchestration, and agent evaluation. 
 - Strong foundation in statistics, machine learning, and hypothesis testing. 
 - Expert Python and strong SQL skills. 
 - Experience with scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), containerization, and CI/CD for model deployment. 
 - Experience applying ML to business problems such as predictive analytics, segmentation, pricing, or recommendations. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Bachelor's degree or higher; a quantitative field is preferred. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building multi-agent platforms with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen. 
 - Experience with MCP and building reusable tools and skills for agents. 
 - Experience with LLMOps tooling, including tracing, evaluation, guardrails, and prompt management. 
 - Experience with advanced RAG techniques such as hybrid search, re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation. 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI practices, including hallucination mitigation, privacy, and governance. 
 - Experience on sales, marketing, or revenue-operations data, or automating business workflows with AI. 
 - Experience owning an AI platform used by multiple teams. 

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. 
 - Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow's challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. 
 - Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. 
 - Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. 
 - Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. 
 - Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. 

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. 

We are powered by the talents of 26, 000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. 

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace. 

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here. 

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here. 

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters. com.

You'll be working with New Product Development - a group that runs on coffee and an infectious passion for building products that have never been built before. Our Flexible Energy Stack consists of the e^pack (battery pack) and e^pump (charging station), which unlock 15-minute rapid charging. 

Our philosophy: 

Break. Believe. Build. 

Break stuff, break assumptions, break the thumb rule. 

Believe in the team, the process, and through failures. 

Build fast, build passionately, build to simplify. 

Own it like you mean it. 

What you'll own: 

We are seeking a Product Integration Quality Engineer to own end-to-end quality for our integrated powertrain products as they come together across battery, motor, and vehicle systems - from design validation through customer-facing performance and reliability. 

The ideal candidate will have strong systems-level thinking, hands-on DFMEA/PFMEA experience, and the ability to trace a performance issue back through multiple interacting subsystems. 

What you'll do: 

Integration Quality Ownership

- Own end-to-end quality for powertrain integration across battery, motor, controller, and supporting systems
 - Lead DFMEA and PFMEA for integration-level builds
 - Define end-of-line and process checkpoints for integration testing

Performance & Failure Analysis

- Analyze product performance (range, drivability, reliability) and lead RCA on performance issues
 - Predict and pre-empt failure modes based on integration-level risk analysis
 - Run preliminary RCA on customer-reported issues and escalate as needed

Service Readiness

- Prepare Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) documentation to support Service diagnosis
 - Identify service requirements - maintenance schedules, SOP gaps - and drive them into development
 - Apply Design-for-Service thinking during development and feed back to design teams

Cross-functional Collaboration

- Interface with battery, motor, and vehicle integration engineering teams
 - Represent quality at integration-stage gate reviews

What you'll bring: 

- Education qualification
 - B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, or Automotive Engineering
 - 4-7 years of experience in vehicle or systems integration quality
 - Strong DFMEA/PFMEA and APQP process experience
 - Ability to analyze vehicle-level performance data and connect it to root cause

Preferred Experience (Good to Have): 

- Experience with EV powertrain or multi-domain systems integration
 - Experience in a fast-scaling startup environment
 - Exposure to customer-facing RCA and service SOP development

What matters to us: 

- Quality of work
 - Structured problem-solving
 - Dissatisfaction with mediocre work
 - Ability to multi-task and handle a dynamic working environment
 - Resilient attitude to bounce back after failing

About Us: 

Exponent is building the energy stack powering commercial EVs in India. Our proprietary battery and charging technology enables safe, reliable 15-minute rapid charging while delivering a 3, 000-cycle battery life warranty using standard lithium-ion cells. Today, our platform powers high-utilisation commercial vehicles - from three-wheelers to intercity buses, making electric mobility rapid, more reliable and more affordable than petroleum. 

Founded by Arun Vinayak (Founding Partner & Former Chief Product Officer, Ather Energy), Exponent is a 250+ member team of passionate builders solving some of the toughest engineering challenges in energy. 

If solving hard engineering problems across mechanics, thermal systems, power electronics, manufacturing, and the charging network, while staying obsessed with customer experience excites you, we'd love to build with you.

data.title: Team Lead- Delphi Developer
data.description:
Team Lead, Delphi Development

Location: India (Remote)

Timings: 11am to 8pm

Position Team Lead, Delphi Development

Summary

APRO develops invoice processing and banking integration software for organisations operating Oracle E-Business Suite. Our on-premise products, APRO Imaging and APRO Banking Gateway, have been in continuous production for more than 25 years at enterprise customers throughout the world. We are seeking a team lead to assume technical ownership of both products. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership position. The role combines senior development work with responsibility for the quality standard, release decisions and production incident management. It is not a people management position and does not represent a transition away from development. 

The products

- APRO Imaging provides document management and invoice processing for Oracle E-Business Suite. The application captures invoices by scanning, email or import, extracts the invoice data using OCR, matches invoices against purchase orders in Oracle E-Business Suite, routes them through approval workflows and posts them to Oracle Payables
 - APRO Banking Gateway provides banking integration for Oracle E-Business Suite. The application transmits SEPA payments to banks over EBICS, receives and processes bank statements in MT940 and CAMT. 053 formats, reconciles transactions against Oracle Receivables and manages SEPA direct debit mandates

Both applications operate directly against the customer's own Oracle database within their Oracle E-Business Suite environment. Each is maintained across two concurrent code lines: a development line on Delphi 12 and a customer release line on Delphi XE5. 

Technology Delphi 12 and Delphi XE5, VCL, DevExpress, ODAC; Oracle 11g to current; Oracle E-Business Suite. 

Areas of responsibility

- Quality standard. Coding standards, review policy and technical direction for both products, with approval authority over what is delivered to customers
 - Release management. Determination of the code line on which each correction is delivered, and whether a backport to a customer release branch is warranted
 - Production incidents. Classification of reported errors as software defects, data issues or configuration problems, and management of these through to resolution with the customer
 - Engineering practice. Definition and implementation of engineering practice for the Delphi codebase, including build automation and test strategy
 - Technical guidance. Support and development of the team, and active distribution of knowledge of the codebases
 - International coordination. Acting as the technical point of reference for departments in the Netherlands, India and the United States

Requirements

- 6+ years hands-on Delphi development experience, across both a legacy version (XE5 generation) and a current version (10. x, 11 or 12), with the intention of remaining technically active
 - A detailed understanding of the Delphi technology stack, Oracle databases, and SQL in Oracle's dialect. The team lead is the final reviewer of both the application and the database components
 - Working knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite, in particular the Payables (AP) and Receivables (AR) data models
 - Experience leading a small development team while continuing to contribute technically
 - A demonstrable record of ownership of release decisions, production incidents and the associated customer communication
 - The judgement to establish a shared technical standard rather than to apply personal preference, including the assessment of when established code should be left unchanged
 - Fluent written and spoken English, and the ability to communicate clearly with departments across several time zones

Preferred Qualifications

- Oracle PL/SQL package development. A substantial proportion of the business logic resides in the database
 - Experience of introducing engineering practice into an environment with limited existing process: documented standards, automated builds and a test practice
 - Experience of supporting multiple concurrent customer versions of a single product
 - Domain experience in European payment processing (SEPA, MT940, CAMT. 053, EBICS) or in accounts payable invoice processing with OCR and purchase order matching

Candidates who meet the principal requirements but not every preferred qualification are encouraged to apply. 

What We Offer

- Opportunity to grow your career with a rapidly growing organisation 
 - Exposure to latest technologies and global teams 
 - People-first organization culture
 - Company-paid group mediclaim insurance
 - Company-paid personal accident insurance
 - Career advancement opportunities 
 - Best-in-industry referral policy
 - 29 paid leaves annually

About The Company

We are a global team of innovators and advocates transforming how financial data is captured, stored, and manipulated with our comprehensive suite of automation technology. Our platform seamlessly integrates with your existing ERP for an unrivaled end-user experience. We do the heavy lifting so accounting, procurement, and fundraising teams can do their best work. 

PairSoft's aspires to be the strongest procure-to-pay platform for the mid-market and enterprise, with close integration to Microsoft Dynamics, Blackbaud, Oracle, SAP, Acumatica and Sage ERPs. 

At PairSoft, we are passionate about innovation, transparency, diversity, and advocating on behalf of our customers and communities we support. We offer exciting career opportunities and a collaborative culture that allows individuals to learn, grow, and create meaningful impact. We are expanding and seeking team players who are eager to jump in and contribute to our rapid growth!

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Why Verifone

For more than 30 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide. 

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third-party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it's developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success. 

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Java Developer Lead to lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, high-performance backend applications. This role combines hands-on engineering with team leadership, overseeing a team of 4-8 developers while actively contributing to coding, architecture, and technical decision-making. The ideal candidate will drive engineering best practices, conduct code reviews, mentor team members, and ensure the delivery of high-quality software. Working closely with Product, QA, and DevOps teams, you will help define technical strategy, solve complex challenges, and deliver reliable, secure, and maintainable solutions that support business growth and operational excellence. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical leadership

- Own the architecture and design of Java-based microservices and backend applications. 
 - Define coding standards, design patterns, and best practices, and enforce them through code reviews. 
 - Evaluate and recommend tools, frameworks, and technologies; drive modernization and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Make sound trade-offs between performance, scalability, security, and maintainability. 

Team leadership and mentoring

- Lead, guide, and mentor a team of developers; run regular 1: 1s and support career growth. 
 - Break down requirements into technical tasks, estimate effort, and assign work. 
 - Take part in hiring: interviews, technical assessments, and onboarding of new engineers. 
 - Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning. 

Hands-on development

- Write clean, efficient, well-tested code using Java 17+ and Spring Boot. 
 - Design and build RESTful APIs and event-driven services (Kafka or similar). 
 - Optimize application and database performance; troubleshoot complex production issues. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with the DevOps team. 

Delivery and collaboration

- Work with product owners and business analysts to refine requirements and define acceptance criteria. 
 - Lead Agile ceremonies with the Scrum Master: sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives. 
 - Track delivery, flag risks early, and keep stakeholders informed of progress. 
 - Ensure releases meet quality, security, and compliance standards. 

What qualifications will you need to be successful?

Required Skills & Experience

- Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
 - 8+ years of Java development, and 2+ years leading or mentoring a development team
 - Technical Expertise
 - Core Java: Java 11/17+, OOP, collections, multithreading and concurrency, JVM tuning, garbage collection
 - Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate
 - Architecture: Microservices, REST API design, design patterns, domain-driven design basics
 - Messaging: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or ActiveMQ
 - Databases: SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle) and at least one NoSQL store (MongoDB, Redis, Cassandra)
 - Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions
 - Testing: JUnit 5, Mockito, integration testing; TDD mindset
 - Tools: Git, Maven or Gradle, Jira, Confluence
 - Practices: Agile/Scrum, code reviews, secure coding (OWASP Top 10). 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in payments, fintech, banking, or other high-volume transaction systems. 
 - Knowledge of reactive programming (Spring WebFlux, Project Reactor). 
 - Experience with observability tools: New Relic, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or the ELK stack. 
 - Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation. 
 - Cloud certification (AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect, or equivalent). 
 - Exposure to frontend frameworks (React or Angular) for full-stack collaboration. 

Soft Skills

- Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking under pressure. 
 - Ability to coach, give constructive feedback, and resolve conflicts within the team. 
 - Ownership mindset: accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. 
 - Comfortable balancing hands-on coding with leadership responsibilities. 

Our Commitment

Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

 - Opportunity to shape the direction of a pioneering open AI platform

data.title: Sr SW Development Engineer
data.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. 

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. 

Meet The Team

We are hiring for a Sr Software Engineer to join our team in Bengaluru (Bangalore), India. In this role, you will be a key contributor to the Data Platforms team and the larger Dexcom Software and Data Organization. You will work with Data Platform Engineers to build the infrastructure to support our data pipelines, storage, and API through which reliable, clean, meaningful data is provided to internal and external stakeholders. At Dexcom, you can use your data engineering skills for the greater good. We develop software for medical devices and systems, adhering to the rigorous requirements of regulatory agencies such as ISO and FDA. If you enjoy connecting the dots, using data-driven engineering decisions, and innovating through the server side of our entire platform stack, you'll enjoy this job. 

Where You Come In

- You will build cloud-based, event-driven software systems with high availability, scalability, and resilience, as part of a multi-disciplinary team that works within an Agile methodology environment. 
 - You will work with the data scientist team to build machine learning pipelines. 
 - You will contribute to software across the development lifecycle, including software design and architecture, code development, functional and performance testing, and documentation and design verification. 
 - You will identify, champion, and work to implement improvements in internal processes, including automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, and optimizing software infrastructure for better scalability, maintainability, and cost efficiency. 
 - You will contribute to code reviews and champion best practices for quality control, software testing, and code development/deployment in an agile environment. 
 - You will participate in on-call rotation for production systems when required. 
 - You will protect the confidentiality and security of client data. 

What Makes You Successful

- You must have strong programming skills in Kotlin, Java, Golang
 - You have experience with message brokers, queues, and buses like Kafka, Azure Service Bus, ZeroMQ, NoSQL databases etc. 
 - You have experience with relational databases like MySQL and NoSQL databases like Cassandra. 
 - You are familiar with using relevant, modern software test tools and equipment. 
 - You have a proven ability to learn new tools and technology. 
 - You have demonstrated the ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment with short deadlines, interruptions, and several simultaneous tasks and projects. 
 - You must have a strong frontend development exposure. 

What You'll Get

- A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community. 
 - A full and comprehensive benefits program. 
 - Growth opportunities on a global scale. 
 - Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. 
 - An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. 

Experience And Education

- Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline and a minimum of 5-8 years related experience or 
 - Master's degree and 2- 5 years' equivalent experience or a PhD and 0-2 years experience

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. 

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that's redefining how money moves across Asia. 

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India's largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. 

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India's unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. 

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia. 

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you're curious, you'll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say "thank you. " Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you'll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future. 

The Role

A Senior Software Development Engineer at Razorpay is well-grounded - smart, quality focussed, product thinker, business conscious - not mere coders, of course, with very good technical context and experience to write and build quality software. Engineering creates a significant impact across different areas, considering the scale of our software product outreach. You're also expected to influence the culture of the company and help shape it in the right way. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Be involved and drive product & design discussions. 
 - Help us scale our payment infrastructure to get every Indian to pay online. 
 - Help us make decisions to shape our REST APIs for developers worldwide. 
 - Contribute to open source as we set the standards for mobile payments. 
 - Be involved and drive product & design discussions. 
 - And, most importantly, brainstorm and create new directions that Razorpay can take in our quest to make online payments easy and accessible to all. 

Mandatory Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in Technology. 
 - A strong product design sense. 
 - Good experience in working with any of the programming languages like PHP, Python, Django, Golang, Java, C++
 - Understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases and come up with effective solutions. 
 - Good understanding of REST APIs and the web in general. 
 - Ability to build a feature from scratch & drive it to completion. 
 - A willingness to learn new technology, whatever lets you deliver the best product. 
 - Have a few weekend side projects up on GitHub. 
 - Have contributed to an open-source project.

The ideal candidate combines deep mechanical design expertise with strong innovation, project leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills. This role will act as a catalyst for continuous improvement, transforming field feedback, quality concerns, operational challenges, and new technology opportunities into tangible product enhancements. 

Product Improvement Leadership

Project Management

Digitalization & Engineering Productivity

Team Leadership

data.title: Quality Assurance & Standards Manager
data.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join

Every day, Airbnb hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. Since our founding, more than 5 million hosts have welcomed over 1. 5 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Airbnb Experiences are completely reimagined experiences, hosted by local people, brands, businesses and content creators who know their city best. Every activity offers guests an authentic way to connect with the place they're in and to meet people with shared interests. 

Fraud & Safety Delivery (FSD) is at the heart of keeping Airbnb safe for the millions of hosts and guests who trust our platform every day. As part of Global Operations, FSD investigates and enforces on fraud and safety cases across the full user lifecycle, from account creation to post-stay, leveraging a team of internal and partner specialists operating 24/7 across the globe. We're entering a new chapter: building AI-native, self-service operational infrastructure that lets our teams move faster, make better decisions, and focus their energy where it matters most. 

This role sits within Scaled Services, the team that owns the foundational capabilities the entire FSD organization depends on: how we launch, how we measure quality, how we build tools, and how we use data. 

The Difference You Will Make

Fraud and Safety Delivery is judgment work at scale. Our specialists weigh incomplete evidence and make consequential calls about accounts, listings, and bookings thousands of times a day, across many risk domains across the globe. Precision matters in both directions: a missed signal puts our community at risk, and an incorrect enforcement affects someone's livelihood or their travel plans. 

As the Senior Program Manager, Quality Assurance & Standards, you'll build FSD's quality program, not an audit function that scores specialists against a checklist, but a measurement system that tells the organization how accurate its decisions are, where quality breaks down, and what to change. You'll design and stand up that framework while running the quality reviews the organization depends on today, reporting to the Senior Manager, Scaled Services. 

You'll Own Three Outcomes For The Org

- A quality framework we can defend: One documented model that measures both workflow adherence and decision quality, with published standards, thresholds, and severity definitions across every risk domain. 
 - Objective, centralized governance: Serve as the impartial quality authority across FSD, setting consistent standards that hold up across domains, sites, and geographies. 
 - Measurable improvement in decision accuracy: Fewer incorrect enforcement outcomes, diagnosed at root cause and fixed at the source, without adding cost or handling time to the operation. 

A Typical Day

Set the direction for quality

- Own the quality program end to end, including quality delivery through our partner sites. 
 - Set the strategy and operating rhythm for how the quality program delivers against FSD's roadmap and goals. 
 - Represent quality in FSD leadership forums, and build credibility with the teams whose work you measure. 

Build the quality framework and standards

- Design a two-layer quality model that measures both workflow adherence and the accuracy of the enforcement decision. 
 - Establish how we determine the correct outcome for judgment-based decisions, through expert review panels, blind double-review, and a library of benchmark cases. 
 - Build a severity-weighted error taxonomy and a risk-weighted sampling methodology that holds up under scrutiny. 
 - Author the quality guidelines and publish the performance bars, thresholds, and escalation paths the organization holds itself to. 
 - Run a calibration program across internal teams and partner sites, and keep standards current as policy, product, and workflow evolve. 

Run the quality operation

- Deliver quality reviews across FSD, internal and partner-delivered, on a consistent methodology and cadence. 
 - Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new launches, ensuring no change scales to the global operation before it meets a quality bar. 
 - Diagnose the root causes behind reversed decisions and report the distribution of drivers, not only the overturn rate. 
 - Produce diagnostic quality reporting that leadership and cross-functional partners can act on. 

Extend quality to AI and close the loop

- Extend quality measurement to decisions made by models and AI agents, and define the accuracy standard required before a decision can be automated. 
 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to feed labeled quality data back into detection models and automated decisioning. 
 - Trace quality findings to their source in workflow, policy, tooling, or training, and drive the fixes with the teams that own them. 
 - Improve decision accuracy without adding handling time or review layers to the operation. 

Your Expertise

- 8+ years of experience in quality assurance, operations, risk, audit, or program management within a high-volume, high-stakes decisioning environment. 
 - Proven experience driving quality delivery through partner or vendor teams you don't directly manage. 
 - Proven experience building a quality program from scratch, not just running one: you've designed sampling methodology, scorecards, error taxonomies, calibration processes, and governance from a blank page. 
 - Demonstrated experience measuring quality in subjective, judgment-based work, with adjacent fields welcome: fraud and financial crime, content moderation, claims review, credit decisioning, regulatory compliance, or trust and safety. 
 - Strong grasp of measurement rigor: you understand sampling design, statistical significance, and inter-rater reliability, and can defend a quality number to a skeptical executive or a partner site that disagrees with it. 
 - Strong data literacy: you can pull and interrogate your own data, work fluently with analytics partners, and build reporting that diagnoses rather than describes. 
 - Exceptional writing skills: your guidelines need to be clear enough that reviewers across regions and partner sites reach the same conclusion. 
 - Strong cross-functional influence skills: you know how to tell teams their workflows, policies, or models are producing the wrong outcomes without losing them as partners. 
 - Experience evaluating model or AI-assisted decision quality is a strong plus. 
 - Experience in Trust, Fraud, or Safety is a plus, but not required, as the right instincts for precision, user impact, and intellectual honesty matter more. 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. 

How We'll Take Care Of You

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. 

India Annual Pay Range

₹3, 850, 000-₹5, 500, 000 INR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. 

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb's hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb's Career's Page at careers. airbnb. com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb. com or @ext. airbnb. com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We'll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. 

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in. 

Available Locations

- Bengaluru, India

About The Role

The Cloudflare Business Development team is the engine driving our expansion across global markets. As part of this high-energy organization, you will lead a critical team focused on the SAARC region, uncovering new opportunities and shaping pipeline strategy. We pride ourselves on being principled in our approach, curious about our customers' challenges, and completely transparent in how we collaborate. The Business Development team sits at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Operations, serving as a vital incubator for top-tier sales talent and a primary catalyst for regional revenue growth. 

We are seeking a strategic, growth-minded Business Development Representative (BDR) Manager to lead, coach, and scale our Business Development team supporting the SAARC region. In this role, you will manage a team of 5 BDR professionals, overseeing day-to-day operations, driving quota performance, and building a sustainable pipeline. You will be responsible for the full talent lifecycle-from recruiting and interviewing to onboarding and continuous professional development. 

This role requires a collaborative leader who can build strong bridges with regional Sales leadership, global Marketing teams, and Sales Operations to optimize lead flows, elevate campaign effectiveness, and continuously improve internal processes. 

Responsibilities

- Team Leadership & Performance Management: Direct daily activities and quota attainment for a team of 5 BDRs, ensuring regional pipeline objectives and performance metrics are consistently met or exceeded. 
 - Talent Development & Coaching: Empower team members through structured 1: 1 coaching, regular skill development, and creative performance incentives. Foster a growth mindset that prepares BDRs for future career advancement. 
 - Talent Acquisition & Onboarding: Manage regional recruiting, interviewing, and hiring to scale the team efficiently. Own the onboarding framework, ensuring new hires ramp quickly through robust training on product knowledge, buyer personas, market competition, and tools. 
 - Strategic Execution: Lead from the front to support regional success; while this is a management role, you are comfortable adopting a "player-coach" mindset where necessary to help the team break into strategic accounts or navigate complex regional roadblocks. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply with key stakeholders across the business: 
 - Sales: Align on qualification criteria, handoff processes, and pipeline quality to ensure seamless lead transitions. 
 - Marketing: Maximize the volume and quality of Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), refine messaging, and optimize campaign follow-ups. 
 - Operations: Analyze metrics and reporting to identify bottlenecks and implement process enhancements. 
 - Data-Driven Optimization: Regularly track and report on individual and team metrics-focusing on lead quality, volume, and revenue impact-to regional Sales leadership. 
 - Operational Excellence: Continuously evaluate and implement industry best practices to improve prospecting efficiency, team productivity, and outbound messaging. 

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience

- Leadership Experience: Demonstrated experience managing, coaching, or leading outbound sales or business development professionals, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or technology environment. 
 - Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the SAARC business ecosystem, localized buying behaviors, and corporate cultural dynamics. 
 - Sales Execution: Proven track record of meeting or exceeding pipeline generation and quota objectives, with a strong understanding of modern prospecting frameworks and methodologies. 
 - Strategic Collaboration: Excellent stakeholder management skills with a history of building productive partnerships across Sales, Marketing, and Enablement teams. 
 - Analytical Mindset: Proficiency with sales tech stacks (e. g. , Salesforce, Outreach) and the ability to leverage data to evaluate team performance, uncover trends, and refine processes. 
 - Communication Skills: Exceptional communication, presentation, and situational coaching abilities

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We're not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We're a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. 

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2, 400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare's enterprise customers--at no cost. 

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 

1. 1. 1. 1: We released 1. 1. 1. 1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here's the deal - we don't store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. 

Sound like something you'd like to be a part of? We'd love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

data.description:
As a Manager in our ISV Practice, you will lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers working directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations. The team builds MongoDB capabilities inside partner products and turns successful engagements into reusable patterns for future partner engagements. 

You will lead the people, priorities, and operating model that enable the team to deliver production-oriented solutions with partners. This role combines people leadership, technical judgment, partner engagement, and cross-functional execution. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 

What you'll do at MongoDB

- Lead, coach, develop, hire, onboard, and retain a team of Forward Deployed Engineers while creating a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture
 - Set priorities and allocate capacity across multiple partner engagements, enabling the team to work effectively in parallel
 - Establish a repeatable engagement model from qualification through build, validation, documentation, and handoff, ensuring partners provide the context, access, technical counterparts, and release path needed for delivery
 - Guide the team in building production MongoDB integrations, application capabilities, migration approaches, deployment patterns, and operational guidance while maintaining a high bar for quality, readiness, security, performance, observability, resilience, and supportability
 - Ensure engagements produce reusable architectures, implementation patterns, tooling, documentation, and lessons learned that accelerate future partner engagements and benefit the wider organization
 - Coordinate with Solutions Architecture, Solution Validation, Technical Services, Sales, Product, Engineering, and partner stakeholders on scope, ownership, technical contribution, validation, handoff, escalation, and support boundaries
 - Engage directly with strategic partners when senior technical or leadership involvement is needed
 - Measure team impact through partner adoption, production outcomes, reusable assets, delivery quality, and progress across strategic motions

As an ideal candidate, you will have

- Strong people-leadership skills, including coaching, feedback, performance management, career development, and the ability to align technical and business stakeholders without relying on formal authority
 - 10+ years of experience in software, systems, platform, product, or solutions engineering, including experience managing senior engineers and delivering complex, multi-month technical initiatives
 - Strong technical understanding of production software, distributed systems, application integration, data platforms, cloud environments, or modernization initiatives, with sufficient depth to review designs, challenge assumptions, and guide engineering decisions
 - Experience working directly with ISVs, partners, customers, or external engineering teams and turning ambiguous technical and business needs into clear priorities, delivery plans, and working solutions
 - Experience building reusable engineering capabilities, reference implementations, integration patterns, or platforms, and improving engineering standards, delivery processes, or operating models
 - Willingness to travel for partner engagements and key team activities

As an ideal candidate, you may also have

- Experience in partner engineering, embedded software, OEM solutions, technical consulting, field engineering, or a similar forward-engineering role
 - Experience with database modernization, data-intensive applications, distributed systems, AI/ML workloads, or complex enterprise environments across a range of industries
 - Experience with MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, or self-managed deployments
 - Experience with performance engineering, benchmarking, resilience, observability, production readiness, or technical assurance
 - MongoDB certification or experience with MongoDB's broader product portfolio

What you will learn

- Grow as a people leader by coaching senior engineers, developing talent, and building a high-performing team
 - Build a broad perspective on ISV product engineering, application modernization, and partner delivery across industries and technology stacks
 - Strengthen your technical judgment, operating-model expertise, and cross-functional influence while helping scale a repeatable partner-engineering capability at MongoDB

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 

With offices worldwide and over 67, 000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. 

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Company Overview: 

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products - BlinkRx and Quick Save - remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. 

BlinkRx is the world's first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can't afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn't have the medication in stock. 

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

About the Role

You are an engineer who, above all, is excited to build products that give our customers the best possible experience purchasing prescription medications. You have professional experience working on a team turning ideas into reliable, maintainable code - and ideally, you are eager to apply AI and machine learning to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and personalized. 

Work Location : Bangalore

Levels : Senior Software Engineer II / Staff / Lead Software Engineer

We believe in using a small number of well-known tools like AWS, Python, Javascript, MySQL/Postgres, and Linux. We are looking for engineers that value simplicity, pragmatism, and a bias toward action, and who are passionate about building products that bring real value to our customers. 

Sr Software Engineers at Blink are responsible for building our world-class products. Your job is to take ownership over one of our hardest problems, envision and refine strategic solutions, and drive execution like an entrepreneur. 

You will collaborate closely with a talented, cross-functional team of designers, product managers, data scientists, marketers, and operators. Through these partnerships, you'll grow our business, build our core platform, and-above all-make sure that our customers have access to the least expensive and highest satisfaction pharmacy experience on earth. 

At Blink, we determine the specific focus of engineering roles through the interview process. Key potential areas of ownership include: 

- Our telemedicine platform
 - Our home delivery experience
 - Our growth team
 - Our core pharmacy platform
 - New product line development
 - AI-powered personalization, automation, and decision-support systems

How to Achieve Success / Acumen

All Blinkers are expected to operate with our value of "Good Giving" in mind. Our culture is infused with the dedication and enthusiasm of employees who continuously strive to make a difference. Here's how you will do that in this role: 

Good Execution - Do your best work

- Design new APIs to power innovative features
 - Fix performance problems and debug production issues
 - Perform peer code and architecture reviews
 - Build new features, write unit tests, and lead the release of these features to production
 - Develop and A/B test new ReactJS components to improve our user experience
 - Design, build, deploy and use AI/ML solutions for telemedicine triage, prescription guidance, fraud detection, personalization, and operational automation

Good Owner - Be the CEO of your role

- Help the team ship new products and features successfully with the right skills, mentorship, and organizational resources to deliver amazing experiences for our patients
 - Coach, mentor, and develop engineers to reach individual goals while fostering cross-functional collaboration and product success
 - Take responsibility for the long-term success of product projects and people
 - Champion responsible adoption of AI across engineering and product teams, ensuring solutions are ethical, reliable, and scalable

Good Learning - Learn something new every day

- Demonstrate curiosity and an interest in learning new techniques and improving upon best practices to stay up-to-date with current and emerging trends
 - Lead by example: put new ideas into action, fail fast, and learn from each experience
 - Stay ahead of advances in AI/ML (including LLMs, NLP, recommendation systems, and predictive analytics) and apply them thoughtfully to our products

Good Feedback - Consider the perspective of others

- Listen actively and respond effectively through a variety of channels
 - Give and receive candid and constructive feedback
 - Promote trust and encourage teamwork to allow the product team to do their best work

Desired Experience

- 3 to 10 years in a software engineering role
 - BE/BTech degree from a top institution
 - You want to work in a highly collaborative environment: we believe a team can be stronger than its individual parts
 - Independent and curious, comfortable owning features from design through delivery to production
 - Experience with one or more modern programming languages (Python, JavaScript, etc. )
 - Willingness to dive into a large code base and contribute immediately
 - Enjoy writing code that is understandable, maintainable, and testable
 - Collaborative and communicative - you love being part of a diverse team, building consensus, and establishing credibility. You are a Class-A communicator: curious, thoughtful, clear, and (mostly) correct. 

AI-Preferred Skills

- Experience with AI/ML frameworks (e. g. , MCP servers, n8n, Google ADK, Vector DBs and Langchain)
 - Familiarity with LLMs, Fine tuning, and generative AI for personalization and patient support and order workflow
 - Experience integrating AI into production-grade systems with measurable business impact
 - Interest in applying AI responsibly in healthcare to maximize patient value and trust

Why Join Us: 

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

data.title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/FastAPI, AI-Native Development)
data.description:
Lead Full Stack Engineer (Python/FastAPI, AI-Native Development)

Remote: India, Pakistan, Vietnam, etc. 

Most developers use AI to autocomplete. We want the one who uses it to ship a feature in a day that used to take a sprint, and who knows exactly where the model is wrong. 

Ventive is a US-based software and AI consultancy and a multiple-time Inc. 5000 honoree, headquartered in Boise, Idaho. We're building an AI-native fintech platform that replaces spreadsheet-driven professional workflows with end-to-end automation. LLMs drive the core of the product: they extract structured data from complex financial documents with multi-model validation, classify financial data, analyze contracts, run graph-based ownership analysis, and generate deliverables that used to take analysts weeks. 

You'll join as a lead engineer and own a major workstream of the platform, working as a peer to our existing team lead. This is a build role, not a maintenance role. 

What you'll do

You'll architect and ship backend services and APIs in Python/FastAPI, and build the Next. js frontends that sit on top of them. You'll design LLM-powered pipelines (document extraction, classification, multi-step agents, consensus validation) and make them reliable and testable in production. You'll turn product specs into working software fast, using AI coding tools as your primary workflow. You'll review code, generated and human-written, with a sharp eye for correctness, security, and maintainability. You'll make architecture decisions and defend them. 

What you bring

- 5+ years of professional software development, with Python and FastAPI as must-haves
 - Strong async Python, SQLAlchemy 2. 0, PostgreSQL, and Alembic migrations
 - Working knowledge of Next. js, React, and TypeScript (TanStack Query, Tailwind, shadcn/Radix, Zod a plus)
 - Daily, serious use of AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar). You can show us how you work. 
 - Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, OpenRouter): prompting, structured outputs, tool use, evaluation
 - Bonus: Neo4j/Cypher, Redis, Celery, Docker, AWS, vector databases, PDF/document processing, QuickBooks or other financial system integrations
 - Working professional English. You don't need to be perfectly fluent, but you need to be clear in writing and on calls. 

Who you are

You're entrepreneurial and you take ownership. You don't wait for tickets, you find problems and solve them. When something breaks at a bad time, you treat it as yours. You're fast without being sloppy, and you'd rather ship and iterate than over-plan. You're curious about the business problem, not just the code. 

The details

- Full-time, remote, long-term. This must be your only full-time role. 
 - $2, 000 to $4, 000+ USD per month, based on experience
 - Your working hours extend to ~midnight your local time, to overlap with the US Mountain Time mornings
 - A small, senior team with direct access to leadership and real influence over the product

Individuals only. We hire directly. No agencies, staffing firms, outsourcing companies, or subcontracting arrangements. Applications submitted on someone else's behalf will be rejected. 

How to apply

Applications without all three of these won't be reviewed: 

- Your GitHub or a link to something you've shipped
 - A short paragraph describing a recent project you built with AI tools: what the AI generated, what you had to fix, and why
 - A 2-minute Loom or video introducing yourself in English
 - A resume if your Linkedin profile isn't complete or detailed.

What do you need for this opportunity?

Must have skills required: 

AI, Conversation AI, Cypress, Financial Services, fintech domain, Gen AI, LLM, Playwright, Automation lead, Qa architect, Quality lead, Golang, Java, JavaScript, Quality Assurance, TypeScript

An enterprise-focused Voice AI company is Looking for: 

Founding QA Lead

Who We Are

At NV, we''''re building the leading voice AI infrastructure company for India. We own the full stack: speech recognition (STT), speech synthesis (TTS), a small language model, and the orchestration layer that holds them together. Our models are built in India from the ground up and run live inside banks, insurers, and lenders, on-prem and in the cloud. 

Since 2018, we''''ve trained on real conversations across 12+ languages and 45+ dialects, because the person on the other end of the line is calling from a small town, switching languages mid-sentence, about their money. When something breaks, there''''s no vendor to point at. It''''s ours. 

The problem you''''''''re here to solve

NV is scaling two fast-growing products: an enterprise AI contact center for highly regulated industries (banks, insurers) and a developer API platform that requires rapid feedback loops. 

Core Challenge: 

Product growth is outpacing the current ability to test reliability, necessitating a dedicated QA function to identify limits before issues reach production. This isn''''t a manual QA role. 

You will build the QA function from scratch, define quality standards for both products, write the foundational testing processes, and build the QA team. The role requires a hybrid approach, combining targeted manual testing where judgment is needed with comprehensive release automation and production observability. 

What Will Be True Because You''''re Here

In your first few months: 

- Nothing reaches a customer untested. Both products have a release bar, and it''''''''s different for an enterprise rollout and a developer-facing update. 
 - Load and scale testing runs before every major release, so we ship knowing exactly how much concurrency and latency headroom we have. 
 - The flows that matter most have automated regression coverage that runs on every release, and manual testing goes where judgment beats scripts. 
 - On the API platform, monitoring tells us something broke before a developer does, and external feedback becomes triaged, fixed issues on a loop the team can see. 

In your first year: 

- We have a test strategy for what clients actually depend on: platform performance and stability under real load, compliance on every release, and the outcomes they bought us for. It covers latency and concurrency at scale, uptime across cloud and on-device deployments, and the regulatory checks our BFSI clients answer to. Agent behaviour is part of it, but a smaller part as long as it aids you to deep dive into platform / feature testing. 
 - You''''''''ve decided how big QA should be at NV, made the first hire or hires, and set the bar they''''''''re held to. 

What You''''''''ll Do

- Test strategy. Own QA across both products: what gets tested, how, and what "ready to ship" means for each. 
 - Performance and scale. Run load, stress and concurrency tests before major releases, and know where the platform breaks before a client campaign finds out. 
 - Automation. Build test automation and wire it into CI/CD so regression runs on every release. 
 - Observability. Set up monitoring, dashboards and alerts on how both products perform in production, and act on what they show. 
 - Compliance and outcomes. Check that every release meets the regulatory requirements our BFSI clients answer to, and that the outcomes they track, like connect rates and dispositions, stay accurate. 
 - Data and pipelines. Verify that post-call data, from transcripts to extracted fields, reaches client systems complete and correct. 
 - Release ownership. Run defect triage, set quality gates and make the final call on release readiness. Then hire and mentor the team that does this with you. 

The honest part

You start as a team of one, with no test plan and no solid framework. You decide, and when something slips, it''''''''s yours. 

You''''ll handle two release speeds. The AI contact center ships on sprint cycles and client timelines. The API platform ships much faster. 

Scale is the hard part. Contact center load comes in regular product cycles and/or when campaigns go live, on-prem deployments that don''''''''t behave like our cloud, and the API platform has to stay up for developers. 

You''''''''ll also have to change habits. A team that has shipped without dedicated QA function will push back on anything that feels like it slows them down. Part of the job is making quality the faster path, not the obstacle. 

We hire for the same five traits on every team. Here''''s what they look like in this role. 

- Self-driven and ambitious. You''''''''ve built a QA practice, or a meaningful piece of one, where none existed. You can name what changed because of it. 
 - Critical of your own work. You can walk us through a bug that got past you, why it did, and what you changed afterwards. 
 - Ownership of outcomes. "Tested" isn''''''''t the end of your story. You followed a release into production and know whether it held. 
 - Care about who you build for. You think about the bank whose campaign can''''''''t go down mid-morning, and the developer whose integration broke at 2am. You test for them, not for the spec. 
 - Long-term over quick wins. You''''''''ve argued to hold a release, with a reason and an alternative, and you can tell us what happened next. 

The bar for this role

Craft. You''''''''re strong at both manual and automated testing, and you know when each is the right call. You''''''''ve built automation frameworks yourself, not only run someone else''''''''s. You''''''''ve load-tested a real system with k6, Locust, JMeter or similar, and you can tell us what broke first and why. You''''''''re comfortable wiring tests into CI and testing APIs directly. You''''''''ve set up monitoring and alerting on a live product, so you know what to watch and what to ignore. 

Quality. We ship into regulated environments where a failed release affects a real person''''''''s money. You treat quality as a habit the whole team practises, not a gate at the end. 

Constant innovation. You''''''''re always looking for better ways to test at scale, including using AI to do it. You expect last year''''''''s QA playbook to need rewriting here, and that excites you. 

What You Don''''t Need

You don''''''''t need prior experience in voice, AI or BFSI. Several of our best people had none. You don''''''''t need a big-company QA title either. Having built quality from scratch once, and knowing what you''''''''d do differently, tells us more than a decade of maintaining someone else''''''''s process. 

How We Hire

We start with a discovery call, where we also discuss compensation so nobody is surprised later. Then come a craft conversation with two people you''''''''d work with and a values conversation with someone outside the team. 

The practical exercise is short: we give you one of our products and ask how you''''''''d test it. It''''''''s scoped to a few days and is never work we''''''''d ship. The whole process takes four to six weeks. 

What we owe you: feedback if we don''''''''t move forward after interviews, straight answers on the business and the equity, and word on any delay instead of silence. 

Why NV

- Remote flexibility
 - Recently raised Series A funding with rapidly scaling team and innovation
 - Culture of transparency and ownership
 - Contribute to building cutting-edge voice technology for India

How to apply for this opportunity?

- Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal. 
 - Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
 - Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

About Uplers: 

Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement. 

(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well). 

So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!
