Position Summary

The SDET II supports software quality assurance across multiple HealthTrust applications through a balanced mix of manual testing and test automation. This role is responsible for executing assigned test plans, performing exploratory testing, contributing to defect triage, and maintaining and expanding automated test coverage within HealthTrust's existing Playwright framework. 

This position supports customer-facing, internal, and third-party integrated applications across varying levels of complexity. Success in this role requires the ability to work independently with limited supervision, learn business workflows and application behavior quickly, and communicate defects, risks, and test outcomes clearly in a distributed team environment. 

In addition to strong manual QA capability, this role is expected to actively maintain automated tests, contribute new Playwright-based automated coverage, and help increase automation adoption over time within existing QA practices. 

Responsibilities

- Execute assigned manual test plans across multiple applications with minimal supervision. 
 - Perform exploratory testing to identify defects, edge cases, and regression risks across customer-facing, internal, and integrated systems. 
 - Create, maintain, and update test cases, test execution results, defect triage, bug reports, and related QA documentation with clarity and precision. 
 - Validate end-to-end workflows across integrated systems, including API behavior, database results, logs, and downstream impacts where appropriate. 
 - Support regression testing efforts and provide reliable coverage of high-risk functional areas. 
 - Maintain and troubleshoot existing automated tests within the current Playwright framework. 
 - Work within established automation patterns, test data approaches, and CI/CD practices to support reliable test execution. 
 - Analyze manual regression areas and identify suitable candidates for automation within the existing framework. 
 - Learn business workflows, application behavior, and system dependencies quickly enough to test effectively across multiple product areas. 
 - Collaborate with developers, QA team members, and engineering partners to clarify expected behavior, reproduce issues, and communicate test results. 
 - Document test risks, gaps, and quality concerns clearly and proactively. 

Education & Experience

- Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, software testing, or SDET-related roles with meaningful hands-on experience in both manual testing and test automation. 
 - Background: Previous experience in web application QA, including exploratory testing, regression testing, defect documentation, and maintaining automated tests in an established framework. Experience supporting multi-application environments and contributing automated coverage in Playwright or a comparable UI automation tool is required. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Must Have Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in manual QA and exploratory testing. 
 - Experience executing assigned test plans with minimal supervision. 
 - Ability to identify meaningful test coverage and reliably cover high-risk regression areas. 
 - Strong defect documentation and bug reporting skills. 
 - Experience contributing to defect triage. 
 - Strong hands-on experience maintaining automated tests in an existing framework. 
 - Hands-on experience creating and updating automated UI tests using Playwright. 
 - Experience with API testing. 
 - Experience validating database results and using SQL or equivalent query skills. 
 - Experience reviewing logs and troubleshooting application behavior. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Ability to test across multiple applications and shift priorities based on sprint demand. 
 - Strong written and collaborative communication skills in a distributed team environment. 
 - Ability to produce clear QA artifacts independently, including test cases, bug reports, documentation, and automation design notes. 

Nice To Have Skills

- Experience improving or extending existing Playwright-based automation suites. 
 - Experience identifying manual regression scenarios that are good candidates for automation. 
 - Experience in healthcare technology environments. 
 - Experience with pricing, contract, or eligibility-related systems. 
 - Experience testing customer-facing applications with third-party integrations. 
 - Experience working with Vue, . NET, React, or Python-based application environments. 
 - Experience working asynchronously with globally distributed teams. 

Licenses, Certifications & Training

N/A

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Behaviors

- Ability to balance manual testing depth with practical automation contribution. 
 - Good judgment in selecting what should remain manual versus what should be automated. 
 - Ability to execute work reliably without requiring high-touch day-to-day guidance. 
 - Ability to recognize risks, unclear requirements, and quality gaps and communicate them appropriately. 
 - Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline. 
 - Ability to learn complex business workflows and systems over time. 
 - Ability to work productively through weak handoffs, partial context, and changing priorities. 
 - Professional and collaborative approach to working with teammates during triage, validation, and release support. 
 - Commitment to producing high-quality defects, accurate test evidence, dependable regression results, and maintainable automation assets. 
 - Executes assigned test plans with minimal supervision. 
 - Produces high-quality defects that are clear, reproducible, and actionable. 
 - Covers high-risk regression areas reliably across supported applications. 
 - Builds working knowledge of business workflows and application behavior across assigned systems. 
 - Maintains existing automated tests effectively and contributes new Playwright-based coverage within the first 3 months. 
 - Demonstrates the ability to expand automation coverage in stable, high-value regression areas over time.

Job Title: SoC Design Director

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated SoC Design Manager to lead a team of engineers responsible for the design and development of next-generation System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in digital design, excellent leadership skills, and a proven track record of delivering complex SoC projects from architecture through silicon.

Technology Background

 - Expertise around handling chip level design challenges around clocking, resets, power domains/distribution is a must
 - Experience of working with DFT, PD, DV teams to solve critical technical challenges of cross-domain nature
 - Experience of working on PCIE, UCIE, UALink, Ethernet products is highly desirable.

- Own the design and development of SoC subsystems from specification through RTL implementation.

Head of R& D - Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

Location: Bangalore

Div: L&T - EPS - Power Electronics and BESS

Role Overview

The Head of R&D - BESS leads the end-to-end research, design, and development of utility-scale and industrial battery energy storage solutions. This role oversees multi-disciplinary engineering teams (electrical, mechanical, thermal, firmware, software, controls, power electronics, cell/pack engineering, and validation) and drives innovation, product roadmap execution, technology strategy, and platform development. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technology Strategy & Roadmap 
 - Define the 3-5-year technology roadmap for BESS products: cells, modules, packs, PCS integration, BMS, EMS, safety, and cooling. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies (LFP/NMC cell innovations, sodium-ion, solid-state, liquid-cooled designs, advanced PCS topologies, hybrid systems). 
 - Lead competitive benchmarking and cost-performance improvement programs. 
 - 2. End-to-End Product Development Leadership 
 - Own the full product lifecycle: concept → design → prototype → validation → certification → release to manufacturing. 
 - Oversee development of utility-scale BESS platforms (1-5 MWh containers) and industrial BESS products. 
 - Drive cell-to-pack development (module structure, pack architecture, thermal pathways, safety features). 
 - Ensure alignment with standards (UL 9540/9540A, UL 1973, IEC 62933, IEEE, CE, BIS). 
 - 3. Cross-Functional Engineering Management 
 - Lead R&D teams across all function -Electrical & Power electronics, Mechanical/Structural design, Thermal & Cooling systems, Battery module/pack engineering, BMS/EMS controls & firmware development, System engineering & safety, Testing & validation 
 - Build strong collaboration with Product Management, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Field Engineering teams. 
 - 4. Innovation, IP, and Advanced Engineering 
 - File patents for thermal management, module designs, battery controls, fire mitigation systems, etc. 
 - Drive cost reduction through advanced materials, liquid cooling, optimized pack designs, and architecture simplification. 
 - Establish partnerships with cell manufacturers, universities, and research institutes. 
 - 5. Testing, Validation & Certification 
 - Set up and manage R&D labs: cell/module test labs, environmental chambers, fire testing, inverter-battery integration labs. 
 - Define test plans for performance, reliability, safety, and life-cycle validation. 
 - Oversee third-party certification and large-scale fire testing (9540A). 
 - 6. Manufacturing & Industrialization Support 
 - Guide Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), and design transfer. 
 - Review production processes (module assembly, pack assembly, wiring harness, leak testing). 
 - Support supplier qualification for cells, cooling components, electronics, and safety equipment. 
 - 7. Leadership & Organizational Development 
 - Build and mentor a world-class R&D organization. 
 - Develop engineering competency frameworks and technical career ladders. 
 - Establish strong project governance, development processes, documentation, and design reviews. 

Required Qualifications

- M. Tech /PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Thermal, Power Electronics, Energy Systems, or related fields. 
 - Experience 
 - 12-20+ years in Energy Storage, Batteries, EV, Renewable R&D, or Power Electronics. 
 - Minimum 5-8 years leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams. 
 - Proven track record of launching Utility-Scale or Industrial BESS products. 
 - Deep understanding of Cell chemistry, aging, safety, SoC/ SoH estimation, Module /pack design 
 - Liquid cooling/air cooling, High-voltage system design (600-1500V) 
 - Power electronics & inverter-battery interactions 
 - EMS/BMS firmware & communication protocols (CAN, Modbus, IEC 61850) 
 - Fire detection & suppression 
 - Knowledge of regulatory standards: UL, IEC, IEEE, IS. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with giga-factory cell supply, cell qualification, and vendor management. 
 - Experience in cost modelling (cell-to-pack, pack-to-system). 
 - Strong program management and cross-functional leadership skills. 
 - Ability to work with global teams and customers. 
 - Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and communication skills. 

KPIs (Key Performance Indicators)

- On-time delivery of product roadmap milestones. 
 - Reduction in cost/kWh and improvement in performance ( Wh /L, Wh /kg, thermal stability). 
 - Successful certifications and zero major field failures. 
 - Patent filings and R&D innovation output. 
 - Team competence development and retention.

data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Director, Software Engineering

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

Payments Network Technology is seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering teams delivering secure, reliable, and scalable payment-network capabilities. The role combines people leadership, technology direction, delivery accountability, and cross-functional partnership. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Lead and develop multiple engineering teams, including managers and senior technical leaders. 
 - Set engineering direction aligned with product priorities, architecture standards, resiliency, security, and operational objectives. 
 - Own delivery outcomes across a portfolio of services, balancing customer commitments, technical investment, risk, and capacity. 
 - Build an inclusive, accountable engineering culture through hiring, coaching, succession planning, and career development. 
 - Partner with Product Management, Architecture, Operations, Security, and dependent programs to resolve priorities and delivery risks. 
 - Establish measurable standards for quality, automation, release readiness, reliability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Communicate portfolio status, risks, trade-offs, and decisions to senior leadership. 

Essential Skills

- Experience leading managers and multiple software engineering teams. 
 - Experience with large-scale, highly available platforms and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Working knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, cloud-native delivery, CI/CD, and observability. 
 - Ability to translate business strategy into executable engineering plans and organizational priorities. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

All About You

- Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Clear communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams. 
 - Experience managing two or more software development teams. 
 - Proven experience leading complex technology solutions from concept through design, delivery, and production adoption. 
 - Experience building resilient, operable solutions, with operational readiness considered from the start of development. 
 - People-management experience covering performance management, conflict resolution, coaching, and career development planning. 
 - Payments or financial-services domain knowledge is preferred. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Modern Checkout is Expedia's next-generation booking platform, replacing legacy checkout systems with a unified, orchestrated experience across Expedia, Hotels. com, Vrbo, and other brands. Team builds and operates customer-facing checkout experiences along with the backend APIs, orchestration, and booking services that support the end-to-end booking journey. Engineers work with technologies such as Kotlin, Spring Boot, GraphQL, gRPC, and React-based services, while partnering closely with product, architecture, and other engineering teams.

Minimum Qualifications

data.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Confluent
data.description:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

About the Role The Confluent Platform Management and Control Center team builds the experiences and services that help customers operate Kafka and Confluent Platform reliably across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will work across Unified Stream Manager (USM) and Confluent Control Center (C3) to make platform management, observability simpler and more dependable for enterprise customers. USM is the strategic, hybrid-first control plane for managing and monitoring Confluent Platform across environments. C3 remains an important local control plane for customers operating in non-hybrid, sovereign, regulated, or air-gapped environments. You will own complex engineering problems from design through production, partnering with engineers, product managers, designers, and teams across Confluent. Your work will help customers manage clusters, connectors, topics, and streaming workloads with greater visibility, confidence, and operational control. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys working across distributed systems and product surfaces, solving ambiguous problems, and building software that is reliable under real-world production conditions. 

What You Will Do

- Design, implement, test, and operate reliable services and product experiences for USM and Control Center. 
 - Own complex projects end to end: clarify the problem, contribute to technical design, break work into milestones, execute with partner teams, and validate the result in production. 
 - Build management and observability capabilities for Kafka and Confluent Platform across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, multi-cluster, and multi-geography environments. 
 - Contribute to USM capabilities that provide consistent management, monitoring, security, and operational workflows across environments. 
 - Improve C3 workflows for customers who require a local control plane, including cluster health, topic and message operations, connector troubleshooting, and other critical day-two workflows. 
 - Write clear design documents, participate in architecture and code reviews, and make pragmatic technical decisions that balance delivery speed, reliability, maintainability, and long-term architecture. 
 - Diagnose and resolve production issues using logs, metrics, traces, and systematic root-cause analysis; participate in on-call and operational readiness practices. 
 - Collaborate with product management, engineering, design, support, and Confluent Cloud teams to understand customer needs and deliver high-quality outcomes. 
 - Raise engineering quality through automated testing, safe rollout practices, documentation, observability, and improvements to development and release processes. 
 - Provide technical guidance and constructive feedback to other engineers, helping the team grow through reviews, pairing, and hands-on collaboration. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- 5+ years of professional software development experience building and operating production systems. 
 - Strong programming and problem-solving skills in a language such as Java, Go, C/C++, or Python. 
 - Experience designing, implementing, and debugging distributed systems or backend services. 
 - A solid understanding of systems fundamentals, including networking, storage, operating systems, concurrency, and performance. 
 - Experience taking ownership of complex projects and delivering them with high quality and predictable execution. 
 - Experience writing technical designs and communicating trade-offs clearly with engineers and cross-functional partners. 
 - Strong engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, observability, documentation, and operational readiness. 
 - Ability to investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes rather than short-term mitigations. 
 - Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and handle customer-impacting issues with urgency, patience, and sound judgment. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Experience with Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect, Confluent Platform, or other streaming and data infrastructure technologies. 
 - Experience building management, monitoring, observability, troubleshooting, or operational tooling for large-scale systems. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, hybrid architectures, or infrastructure automation. 
 - Familiarity with authorization, RBAC, security, auditability, or compliance requirements for enterprise platforms. 
 - Experience working on products that span cloud control planes and customer-managed or on-premises components. 
 - Contributions to open-source projects or interest in technical writing, presentations, and developer advocacy.

data.title: QUALITY MANAGER V Motor
data.description:
Business Unit: EPS Mobility

Role: Quality Manager/Engineer - Motor

The Quality Manager/Engineer is responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining world?class quality systems for EV traction motors -covering stator, rotor, and motor assembly processes. The role ensures IATF 16949 compliance, drives APQP/PPAP , leads problem solving and customer quality , manages SQE , and ensures all products meet safety, reliability, and performance standards. You will champion a culture of zero?defect, customer obsession, and continuous improvement , while guiding cross?functional teams to deliver high first?pass yields, low PPM, robust validation, and stable production. 

Key Responsibilities

Quality Systems, Compliance & Audits

- Ensure full compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and customer?specific requirements. 
 - Lead internal and external audits (IATF, customer, regulatory) and close findings with sustainable actions. 
 - Maintain quality manuals, SOPs, Control Plans, PFMEA, inspection standards, traceability, and document control. 

NPI / APQP / PPAP Ownership

- Lead APQP from concept → DV → PV → PPAP → SOP. 
 - Approve design validation (DV) and production validation (PV) plans including durability, thermal, dielectric, vibration/NVH, and EOL performance. 
 - Oversee PPAP submission: PSW, DFMEA/PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, Run@Rate, and capability (Cp/Cpk). 
 - Validate process readiness before SOP (tools, gages, measurement systems, automation, inspection plans). 

In?Process Quality & Plant Performance

- Own FPY, PPM, scrap, rework, and OEE?quality metrics for stator, rotor, and final assembly lines. 
 - Ensure robust Control Plan deployment, gage calibration, SPC on CTQs (hairpin welds, insulation integrity, press fits, magnet placement). 
 - Monitor and improve EOL test signatures: electrical performance, torque ripple, partial discharge, hipot, run?in vibration/noise. 
 - Lead Layered Process Audits (LPA), gemba walks, and containment for non?conformance issues. 

Supplier Quality Management (SQE)

- Manage supplier quality for magnets, laminations, copper, machined parts, castings, adhesives/resins, sensors, and electronics. 
 - Conduct supplier audits (VDA 6. 3 preferred), approve PPAPs, ensure incoming quality checks, and track supplier PPM/OTD. 
 - Drive supplier corrective actions (8D), dual?sourcing risk plans, and cost?of?poor?quality reduction. 

Customer Quality & Issue Resolution

- Act as the primary interface for OEM/Tier?1 customers for all quality matters. 
 - Lead customer complaint resolution with 8D, root cause analysis, and permanent corrective actions. 
 - Manage warranty data, reliability growth, field returns (tear?down analysis), and customer scorecards. 
 - Own customer audits, QBRs, and new program readiness reviews. 

Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

- Lead structured problem-solving (8D, A3, 5?Why, Fishbone) for line issues and customer complaints. 
 - Support Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen projects focused on yield, scrap, equipment uptime, and process capability. 
 - Enable digital quality dashboards, data analytics (FPY, PPM, Cp/Cpk, warranty), and predictive insights. 

Leadership & Team Management

- Lead a team of Quality Engineers, Technicians, Inspectors, and SQE. 
 - Define skill matrices, training needs, certification levels, and audit competencies. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Science Engineering. 
 - 7-13 years of experience in electric motor design/manufacturing, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership position within a Tier-1 supplier/OEM. 
 - Hands-on experience with motor manufacturing processes: lamination stamping/stacking, hairpin/conventional winding, insulation systems, laser welding etc. 
 - Familiarity with IATF 16949/ISO 9001 systems and production part approval 
 - Strong data analysis experience (Minitab, Power BI, SPC tools) 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management and decision making under ambiguity

L&T Company Overview / About Us

L&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer-focussed approach and the constant quest for top-class quality have enabled L&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades. 

Given L&T's capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well-established capabilities in L&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics & Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design & Manufacturing (ESDM). The focus products under Automotive Electronics are ADAS, Electrification & Connectivity related products.

About The Team

Expo is Walmart's in-house A/B testing and experimentation platform, developed and supported by Walmart Global Tech Data Platforms to meet the scale and unique requirements of Walmart's web and mobile applications. It enables teams to run statistically sound, experimentally valid tests with low lifecycle cost, allowing for data-driven evaluation of new features and changes.

data.title: Principal Digital Engineer (DFT Design)
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

This is an opportunity to join a top-notch Power Management IC Team with Renesas leading Automotive Business Unit. You will be part of a very skilled group of engineers who are helping build world-class automotive PMIC products that will power tomorrow's automobiles. You will design complex chips that includes various analog and digital control circuitry and work very closely with all aspects of chip design - from writing specifications to developing tests for mass production. You will be a key contributor to the digital DFT design team and work closely with the digital design team for meeting TEST requirements for Automobile and work closely with test engineering teams for validating the test patterns and meeting ASIL-B/D requirements. You will have an opportunity to work on new designs, insert Lbist and shape the company's pathway for success. Your responsibilities, depending on your level of experience and skill level, will be a mix of the following: 

- Inserting DFT/Scan on digital logic, ATPG, validating test patterns on pre and post layout gate level netlist. 
 - Delivering test patterns to TEST engineering team and validating them on silicon. 
 - Inserting Logicbist with industry standard tools. 
 - Improving scan coverage and modifying RTL for scan. 
 - Reduce ATE tester time by reducing scan patterns while achieving the required coverage. 
 - Participate in all aspects of digital design flow - Micro-architecture, Design partitioning, RTL Verilog / System Verilog coding, DFT insertion, generating Timing Constraints, Synthesis, Interaction with P&R Team, Timing Analysis, LINT, CDC. 
 - Working closely with Architects, Design, P&R, Test and Silicon validation teams. 
 - Assisting with top level test-bench creation for scan and running gate level simulations. 
 - Debug scan pattern fails on ATE and fix the scan patterns. 
 - Writing detailed design documents and help writing DFT specifications, reviewing the specs with different stake holders and own the design to meet the spec. 
 - Organizing and participating in key design reviews and completion of various checklists. Working on-site for 3 days a week is a must. 

Qualifications

Following are rough guidelines for the qualifications (if you feel you have much more or somewhat less, let that not stop you from applying): 

Required

- Masters plus 12+ years or Bachelors plus 15+ years experience in digital design and DFT implementation. 
 - Must be a team player and yet be an independent thinker with strong digital design and DFT fundamentals
 - Hands on experience in Scan insertion, improving scan coverage, ATPG, experience in Logicbist insertion during synthesis or rtl. 
 - Gate level simulations with test patterns, delivering test patterns to Test engineering team and work closely with them to get the patterns validated. 
 - Must have basic digital RTL coding experience besides synthesis exposure. 
 - Must have experience with at least 8 tapeouts with hands on experience with DFT/Scan. 
 - Ideal candidate will have solid understanding of synthesizable design, timing constraints and exceptions. 
 - Must have experience with industry standard Synopsys, Cadence, Mentor, Siemens for scan, Lbist insertion and ATPG. Tetramax experience is a huge plus. 
 - Attention to detail, accuracy and expertise in DFT required. 
 - Must have good written and verbal cross-functional communication skills
 - Have an analytical mind - be open to new ideas and have capability to persuade others in convincing and implementing better flows and processes. Desirable

- Mixed signal experience highly preferred. 
 - Exposure to automotive test requirements, ASIL, is highly preferred. Education

• BSEE required (MSEE preferred)

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

Overview

ENERPAC - Who we are?

Enerpac Tool Group is a premier industrial tools and services company serving a broad and diverse set of customers in more than 25 countries. The Company's businesses are global leaders in high pressure hydraulic tools, controlled force products and solutions for precise positioning of heavy loads that help customers safely and reliably tackle some of the most challenging jobs around the world. The Company was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin. Enerpac Tool Group trades on the NYSE under the symbol "EPAC". 

Our vision is to be our customer's preferred partner through relentless innovation of industrial tools and services that help them safely and reliably tackle their toughest jobs around the world. 

For further information on Enerpac Tool Group and its businesses, visit the Company's website at https: //www. enerpactoolgroup. com/. 

Summary - Basic Function Of The Role

The QA Engineer - Web & Middleware is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of Enerpac's global digital platforms through comprehensive manual and automated testing. This role partners closely with the Sr. Global eCommerce Marketing Manager, Lead Web Developer, ERP and middleware developers, and global business stakeholders to validate website functionality, integrations, and end-to-end business processes across Enerpac's global web properties. The QA Engineer is responsible for establishing testing standards, developing automated regression testing, and ensuring production-ready releases that minimize customer-impacting defects. 

Shift: Monday - Friday, evenings and weekends may be required

Job Duties And Responsibilities

- Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test cases, and regression test suites for website functionality, middleware integrations, and end-to-end business processes. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, usability, cross-browser, cross-device, accessibility, and performance testing for global websites and ecommerce platforms. 
 - Validate end-to-end ecommerce workflows including product discovery, pricing, inventory availability, promotions, cart, checkout, payments, taxation, shipping, order creation, and customer account functionality. 
 - Test middleware and ERP integrations to validate data integrity and business processes including product catalog, inventory synchronization, pricing, customer data, order processing, shipping, and payment transactions. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar automation technologies to improve release quality and testing efficiency. 
 - Build automated regression suites that execute as part of CI/CD deployment pipelines to identify defects before production releases. 
 - Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, and release planning by providing testing estimates, identifying risks, and validating acceptance criteria. 
 - Collaborate with developers to reproduce issues, perform root cause analysis, validate fixes, and prevent regression defects. 
 - Execute production validation following deployments to ensure business-critical functionality is operating correctly across all supported regions and websites. 
 - Create and maintain reusable QA documentation including test plans, test scripts, defect reports, release validation checklists, and testing standards. 
 - Manage software defects through their lifecycle by documenting issues with sufficient technical detail, prioritizing severity, validating fixes, and confirming successful resolution. 
 - Validate analytics implementations including Google Tag Manager, GA4 events, marketing tags, conversion tracking, and advertising attribution to ensure accurate business reporting. 
 - Perform API testing using tools such as Postman or similar platforms to validate REST and GraphQL services and middleware functionality. 
 - Work closely with web development lead, ERP developers, and third-party vendors to coordinate testing activities and ensure successful delivery of global digital initiatives. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve QA processes, automation coverage, release quality, and overall software development practices through continuous improvement initiatives. 

Skills And Competencies

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes of functional and integration issues. 
 - Excellent attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality software. 
 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple testing efforts across concurrent projects. 
 - Effective verbal and written communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to collaborate across development, business, ERP, infrastructure, and marketing teams. 
 - Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile/SCRUM methodologies, and DevOps practices. 
 - Experience creating comprehensive testing documentation, test strategies, defect reporting, and release validation processes. 
 - Knowledge of ecommerce business processes and customer purchase journeys. 
 - Familiarity with browser developer tools, logging, debugging, and API inspection tools. 
 - Ability to identify process improvements and drive adoption of QA best practices across development teams. 

Education And Experience

- 5-8 years of progressive experience in software quality assurance with demonstrated ownership of testing strategy, test automation, and release validation for enterprise web applications and ecommerce platforms 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related field. 
 - Experience testing modern web applications built using React or similar JavaScript frameworks. 
 - Experience testing ecommerce platforms such as Kibo Commerce, Oracle Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, or equivalent enterprise platforms. 
 - Experience creating and maintaining automated testing frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar automation tools. 
 - Experience testing REST APIs, GraphQL services, and middleware integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent. 
 - Experience with automated UI, API, regression, smoke, and integration testing. 
 - Experience validating ERP integrations involving pricing, inventory, customer, order, payment, and shipping data. 
 - Experience using defect tracking and Agile project management tools such as Trello, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. 
 - Experience working within CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes. 
 - Experience testing cross-browser, responsive, and mobile web applications. 
 - Experience supporting global, multilingual, and multi-currency ecommerce implementations is preferred. 

Physical Demands

Employee may have to lift documents/work materials up to 30 pounds in weight. Employee will have to be able to walk/climb to a variety of primary work locations, including traveling by air/auto to remote sites. Employee will need to listen, understand, and speak with team members in person, telephonically, and electronically at all levels within a diverse workforce and with supported organizations. Employee is able to work in front of a personal computer and telephone for long periods of time. 

Work Environment

Primary work environment is temperature controlled office setting but may also be visiting different manufacturing facilities where following appropriate safety protocols at the location would be required. Occasional regional offices travel to factories, worksites and customer locations.

None

Designation: PLC Programmer / Automation Engineer

Reporting To: Technical Director / Automation Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. Job PurposeThe PLC Programmer will be responsible for developing, modifying, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting Siemens PLC-based automation systems for industrial projects. 

The person should have practical experience in Siemens S7-1200 / S7-1500 PLC, TIA Portal, HMI/SCADA, communication networks, drives and industrial automation, with the ability to independently handle PLC programming from engineering through commissioning. 

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. PLC Programming
 - Develop PLC programs using Siemens TIA Portal / STEP 7. 
 - Work on S7-1200 and S7-1500 PLCs. 
 - Develop programs using: 
 - LAD / Ladder
 - FBD
 - SCL
 - STL, wherever applicable
 - Develop and modify: 
 - OB
 - FB
 - FC
 - DB
 - UDT
 - Create structured, modular and reusable PLC programs. 
 - Prepare PLC tags, data blocks, interlocks, sequences and control logic. 
 - Implement auto/manual operation, permissives, interlocks, alarms and trip logic. 
 - Perform PLC hardware configuration and I/O configuration. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot ET200SP / remote I/O systems. 
 - Perform online monitoring, diagnostics and program troubleshooting. Siemens recommends structured and standardized programming for S7-1200/S7-1500, including readable and maintainable program structures, so programming standards should be followed within Synergie projects. 

B. HMI / SCADA Integration
 - Develop and modify Siemens HMI applications. 
 - Experience with WinCC / WinCC Unified will be preferred. 
 - Develop: 
 - Process screens
 - Alarm screens
 - Trend screens
 - Faceplates
 - Status indications
 - Set-point and parameter screens
 - Establish communication between PLC and HMI/SCADA. 
 - Troubleshoot HMI-PLC communication problems. C. Drives & Automation Integration
 - Interface PLC with Siemens SINAMICS drives. 
 - Basic understanding of: 
 - SINAMICS G120
 - SINAMICS S120
 - SINAMICS DC drives / 6RA80
 - Configure drive commands, references, feedback and status signals. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC-Drive communication and control issues. 
 - Understand basic motor control, speed control, interlocking and protection logic. D. CommunicationHands-on knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as: 

- PROFINET
 - PROFIBUS
 - Modbus TCP/IP
 - Modbus RTU
 - Ethernet communication
 - PLC-to-PLC communicationKnowledge of OPC / higher-level communication will be an advantage. 

E. Panel Testing / FAT
 - Participate in PLC panel testing at Synergie's Taloja workshop. 
 - Perform I/O checking and signal verification. 
 - Check PLC hardware configuration against approved drawings. 
 - Conduct FAT activities with the engineering and testing team. 
 - Verify interlocks, sequences, alarms and permissives. 
 - Prepare and maintain testing records. 
 - Coordinate with electrical panel and design teams for corrections. F. Site Commissioning
 - Travel to customer sites for commissioning and troubleshooting. 
 - Download and test PLC programs at site. 
 - Perform cold commissioning and hot commissioning. 
 - Check field I/O and instrumentation signals. 
 - Conduct machine/plant sequence testing. 
 - Coordinate with customer engineers and other project teams. 
 - Attend breakdowns and resolve PLC-related problems. 
 - Support production trials and performance trials. 
 - Prepare commissioning reports and punch-point closure reports. The candidate must be willing to travel to customer sites as required. 

3. Project DocumentationThe candidate will be responsible for maintaining: 

- PLC software backups
 - PLC program versions
 - I/O lists
 - PLC hardware configuration
 - Communication configuration
 - HMI backup
 - FAT reports
 - SAT/commissioning reports
 - Software modification records
 - As-built documentation
 - Customer handover documentationAll PLC programs must be properly documented and backed up so that another engineer can understand, troubleshoot and maintain the system. 

4. Industry / Application ExperienceExperience in any of the following industries will be preferred: 

- Steel / Metals
 - Rolling Mills
 - Bar Mills
 - Wire Rod Mills
 - TMT Rolling Mills
 - Galvanizing Lines
 - Furnaces
 - Material Handling
 - Pharma
 - Food & Beverage
 - Packaging
 - Water Treatment
 - General Industrial AutomationExperience in rolling mill automation, drives integration and process automation will be a strong advantage for Synergie projects. 

5. Technical Skills - MandatoryThe candidate should have practical hands-on knowledge of: 

PLC

- Siemens S7-1200
 - Siemens S7-1500
 - TIA Portal / STEP 7Programming

- LAD
 - FBD
 - SCL
 - FB / FC / DB / OB
 - Interlocks and sequences
 - Analog signal processing
 - PID basics
 - Alarm handling
 - DiagnosticsHardware

- CPU
 - DI/DO
 - AI/AO
 - ET200SP
 - Remote I/O
 - Industrial Ethernet / PROFINETHMI

- WinCC
 - WinCC Unified - preferredDrives

- SINAMICS G120
 - SINAMICS S120 - preferred
 - Basic understanding of 6RA80 DC drives - preferredCommunication

- PROFINET
 - PROFIBUS
 - Modbus TCP/IP / RTU

6. Educational QualificationMinimum Qualification: 

- Diploma / BE / B. Tech in: 
 - Electrical Engineering
 - Electronics Engineering
 - Electronics & Telecommunication
 - Instrumentation Engineering
 - Industrial Automation

7. ExperiencePreferred Experience: 2-6 years in Siemens PLC programming and industrial automation. 

Candidates with strong hands-on experience in TIA Portal, S7-1200/S7-1500 and commissioning may be considered even if their overall experience differs. 

For Senior PLC Programmer: 

5-10 years of relevant industrial automation experience preferred. 

8. Behavioural & Professional SkillsThe candidate should: 

- Take ownership of assigned projects. 
 - Be willing to work at customer sites when required. 
 - Have good troubleshooting ability. 
 - Be able to understand electrical drawings. 
 - Coordinate effectively with electrical, design, project and commissioning teams. 
 - Maintain proper documentation and backups. 
 - Follow Synergie's engineering and project procedures. 
 - Communicate professionally with customers. 
 - Be able to work under project deadlines. 
 - Have a problem-solving attitude. 
 - Avoid repeated mistakes by documenting root causes and corrective actions. 

9. Key Performance Indicators (KPI)The PLC Programmer will be evaluated on: 

- PLC programming quality. 
 - Timely completion of software development. 
 - Number of programming errors during FAT. 
 - Successful FAT completion. 
 - Successful site commissioning. 
 - Troubleshooting and problem-solving speed. 
 - Reduction of site commissioning time. 
 - Proper PLC/HMI software backup and documentation. 
 - Customer feedback. 
 - Compliance with Synergie engineering standards. 
 - Ability to complete assigned project activities independently. 
 - Coordination with project, electrical and panel teams. 

10. Important ResponsibilityThe PLC Programmer should be capable of taking ownership of the PLC portion of a project from: 

PLC Hardware Configuration → PLC Programming → HMI Integration → Panel Testing → FAT → Site Commissioning → Troubleshooting → Final Handover

The objective is to develop a programmer who can independently execute PLC automation projects, rather than only modify existing PLC programs. 

11. Additional AdvantagePreference will be given to candidates having experience in: 

- Siemens Authorized Partner / System House environment
 - Steel and rolling mill automation
 - SINAMICS drive integration
 - WinCC Unified
 - PCS 7
 - Safety PLC / F-CPU
 - Motion control
 - High-speed counter / technology objects
 - Recipe management
 - SCADA integration
 - PLC migration from S7-300/S7-400 to S7-1500Siemens' current STEP 7 environment supports S7-1200/S7-1500 programming and also covers distributed I/O, motion and safety applications, making these useful additional skills for a project automation role. 

12. Work LocationSynergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd. 

Taloja, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

Working requirement: Primarily Taloja office/workshop with customer-site travel as required for FAT, commissioning and troubleshooting.

data.title: Principal Software Engineering Manager
data.description:

The Windows + Devices Fundamentals team is responsible for the reliability, compatibility, performance, battery life, and sustainability of Windows devices. Our work spans hardware and OEM partners, the operating system, and application layers - helping protect, manage, and enhance the fundamentals of the Windows ecosystem. 

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineering Manager to lead a team shaping the next generation of Windows device optimizations. As advances in AI, silicon, and software create new opportunities, you will define strategy, grow engineering talent, and drive execution that makes exceptional device fundamentals a defining feature of Windows PCs. 

This role is ideal for an experienced engineering leader who combines deep systems expertise with a passion for developing people, setting clear technical direction, and delivering innovations that improve how people live, work, and play. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the team in using telemetry, experimentation, and trace analysis to understand software and hardware behavior, identify systemic opportunities, and measure impact at scale. 
 - Provide technical leadership for complex, cross-stack investigations involving low-level debugging, performance analysis, reliability, and power optimizations. 
 - Define the technical strategy and roadmap for Windows Fundamentals improvements, guiding architecture and aligning investments with customer and business priorities. 
 - Manage the design and delivery of solutions spanning hardware, firmware, operating-system, service, and application layers. 
 - Establish a high engineering bar for quality, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and operational excellence, while ensuring predictable execution. 
 - Use data and customer insights to make portfolio tradeoffs, resolve ambiguity, manage risk, and hold the team accountable for measurable outcomes. 
 - Recruit, coach, and retain a diverse team of engineers while building trusted partnerships with Windows teams, OEMs, silicon vendors, and hardware partners across the ecosystem. 

Technologies

The team works with technologies including: 

- C, C++, C#, Python, scripting and automation tools

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

 - Experience leading the design, development, and optimization of complex system software or platform capabilities.

 - Deep knowledge of Windows internals, performance, reliability, or power optimization. 
 - Experience driving initiatives across hardware, firmware, operating-system, service, and application boundaries. 
 - Experience using large-scale telemetry, experimentation, statistical analysis, or Azure data platforms to guide product and engineering decisions. 
 - Track record of influencing architecture, product strategy, and execution across multiple teams and senior stakeholders.

 - CAPA Methodologies
 - Statistical Process Control (SPC) - mandatory

data.title: Lead Software Engineer (.Net)
data.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day: 

You will act as a hands-on Technical Lead within a single agile development team (with occasional collaboration across teams), combining strong software engineering expertise with team mentoring and technical ownership. You will actively contribute to code while guiding developers in implementing scalable, high-quality solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will spend ~40-60% of your time actively coding and contributing to the codebase. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Design and implement software solutions as a hands-on contributor, actively writing and reviewing code
 - Act as the primary technical point of contact for external stakeholders, taking ownership of implementation decisions
 - Mentor and guide a team of 4-6 developers, supporting their technical growth
 - Help resolve complex technical and functional issues during development
 - Work closely with Product Owners to translate requirements into implementable designs
 - Ensure alignment with defined architecture guidelines within the team
 - Ensure code quality through reviews, best practices, and standards
 - Drive hands-on technical decisions (API design, service design, implementation patterns and code structure) within the team
 - Own code quality and support successful technical delivery within the team
 - Deliver high-quality, scalable, and maintainable code
 - Improve team productivity through technical guidance and mentoring
 - Act as the bridge between requirements and implementation
 - Reduce technical risks and unblock delivery challenges
 - Ensure smooth collaboration with external stakeholders

What You Bring

- Strong hands-on experience in software development (8-12 years)
 - Proven experience as a Tech Lead or Senior Developer in agile teams
 - Expertise in: 
 - Backend-focused with exposure to frontend (C#, . NET, APIs; optional React/Flutter)

- Microservices and APIs
 - Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent), including building and deploying cloud-native applications. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of container and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker, Podman). 
 - Working knowledge of cloud and DevOps ecosystem, including: 
 - Authentication and access control concepts (e. g. Entra ID, RBAC)
 - Basic observability and monitoring practices
 - Messaging and event-driven patterns (e. g. Kafka, MQTT)
 - Ability to troubleshoot and support developers in cloud, deployment, and runtime issues

- Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach; proficiency in one or more languages such as C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, and SQL (Flutter is a plus). 
 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
 - Ability to coach developers and lead by example
 - Comfortable interacting with stakeholders on technical topics
 - Experience on handling Timeseries Data

About The Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining-the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy's mission forward. 

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 98, 000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we're also using our technology to help protect people and the environment. 

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https: //www. siemens-energy. com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character - no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

https: //jobs. siemens-energy. com/jobs .

data.title: Engineering Manager, NIRA
data.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products - we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward. 

The Opportunity: Engineering Manager, Nira

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our NIRA team, owning engineering across product, platform reliability, data infrastructure, and internal tooling. This is a high-impact role where you'll work closely with Product, Data Science, Credit, and Marketing to build, scale, and improve a fast-growing business. 

Location: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)

How You'll Make An Impact

- Own and execute the engineering roadmap across NIRA
 - Raise the bar on engineering practices (CI/CD, testing, reliability, observability)
 - Lead and grow a high-performing team of engineers
 - Drive technical decisions that balance speed, quality, and scalability
 - Partner cross-functionally to deliver meaningful business outcomes

Why you're a great fit

- 7+ years in engineering, with 3+ years in management
 - Experience leading teams in startup or scaling environments
 - Strong track record improving engineering standards and delivery
 - Comfortable operating across product, infrastructure, and data
 - Clear communicator with a bias for action

Our Interview Process

- Initial Recruiter Call: A conversation to learn about your experience and what you're looking for in your next role. 
 - Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper discussion about your experience. 
 - Skills Panel: Meet with Tilt team members to discuss your expertise and problem-solving approach. 
 - Leadership Conversation: A final conversation with a leader to discuss how you'll contribute to Tilt's mission, and how we can help you achieve your career goals along the way. 

Don't meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you. 

What You'll Get At Tilt

- Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You'll get started with a WFH office reimbursement. 
 - Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity. 
 - Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards. 
 - Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team - we're a team where good ideas travel quickly. 
 - Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We've visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few. )
 - Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines. 

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable - brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures. 

You're pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Vanguard India

data.title: Principal Software Engineer — Backend & Infrastructure - Noida / Bengaluru
data.description:
About Level AI

Level AI is a Series C conversational intelligence company headquartered in Mountain View, CA, backed by top-tier VCs and Silicon Valley operators. We help enterprise contact centers understand every customer conversation - using speech AI, NLP/NLU, and retrieval systems to turn millions of unstructured interactions into decisions businesses can act on. 

Why this role exists

We're at the scaling inflection point. The systems that carried us from Series A to Series C won't carry us to the next stage, and we need someone to own that transition - not just build inside it. 

This is a Principal role: you'll set technical direction for backend and ML infrastructure across multiple teams, make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse, and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentorship, and the standards you set by example. You'll report to the VP of Engineering and partner directly with our ML, Product, and Infrastructure leads across both sites. 

You'll work alongside engineers from Amazon, Google, and Meta who chose to build here because the problems are unsolved and the ownership is real. 

What You'll Do

- Own the architecture for real-time data processing at scale. Design and evolve distributed messaging systems that handle high-throughput streaming workloads with strict latency requirements. 
 - Build the ML platform that lets us ship models faster. Define and execute the technical roadmap for training and serving infrastructure as our models grow in size, complexity, and inference cost. 
 - Scale our GPU infrastructure. Own capacity planning, scheduling, and utilization across training and inference fleets - deciding what runs where, how we handle burst demand, and how we keep spend tied to actual throughput rather than idle reservations. 
 - Scale inference. Drive down latency and cost per request as model complexity and traffic grow: batching and routing strategies, quantization and compilation, autoscaling, and caching - without degrading output quality. 
 - Make reliability a property of the system, not a heroic effort. Drive uptime, observability, and incident response for serving systems that enterprise customers depend on in production. 
 - Turn ambiguous business problems into executable technical plans. Partner with Product and GTM to scope large cross-functional initiatives, then break them into work other teams can run with. 
 - Multiply the team. Lead design reviews, mentor senior engineers, and shape the engineering practices that outlast any single project. 
 - Bring the outside in. Evaluate emerging tools and techniques with judgment - adopt what earns its complexity, skip what doesn't. 
 - Security and Compliance - Comply with Level AI's information security, privacy, data protection, and acceptable-use policies. Protect company, customer, and confidential information; use only approved systems and access information strictly based on business need. Complete required security and privacy training and promptly report any suspected security incident, data exposure, or policy violation. 

What Success Looks Like In Your First Year

- 90 days: You've mapped our critical paths and failure modes, shipped a meaningful improvement to a serving or pipeline bottleneck, and earned trust across both sites. 
 - 6 months: You own a published technical roadmap for [messaging / ML infra], with at least one major migration or redesign underway. GPU utilization and inference cost per request are measured, and trending the right way. 
 - 12 months: Our infrastructure scales predictably with customer growth, inference cost stays flat or falls as volume rises, on-call load is down, and other engineers are making better architectural decisions because of standards you established. 

What You'll Bring

- [9-12] years building backend and infrastructure systems, with a track record of owning architecture and design at scale - not just implementing it. 
 - Deep, hands-on experience with large-scale databases, high-throughput messaging systems, and real-time job queues. 
 - Proven ability to navigate large, complex codebases and reason clearly about architectural tradeoffs in systems you didn't build. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and driving technical decisions through influence rather than authority. 
 - Strong written communication-you'll be making technical cases to engineers in two time zones and business cases to executives. 
 - BTech/MTech/PhD in Computer Science or equivalent. At this level we weigh track record well above pedigree. 

Bonus points for

- Production experience with our stack: Django, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud. 
 - Hands-on experience scaling GPU infrastructure and model inference in production - capacity planning, scheduling and utilization, autoscaling, and latency/cost optimization under real traffic. 
 - Depth in specific inference tooling - vLLM, TensorRT, Triton, Ray Serve, or equivalents - and experience benchmarking tradeoffs between them. 
 - Experience scaling a platform through a comparable growth stage (Series C → D, or equivalent), especially at a global product company's India site. 
 - Background in speech, NLP, or information retrieval systems. 

Compensation & Benefits

- Health coverage for you, your spouse, children, and parents. 
 - [home-office and connectivity allowance / annual learning budget / parental leave - trim to what's accurate]. 
 - Real ownership over systems used by enterprises worldwide, with the autonomy to decide how they're built. 

How We Hire

- [4] stages, typically [2] weeks end to end: recruiter screen → technical deep dive → system design → team and leadership conversations → offer. Interviews are conducted from our India team with [one/two] conversations with US-based leadership. We'll tell you where you stand at every step. 

Level AI is an equal opportunity employer. We hire and promote on merit and evaluate all applicants without regard to caste, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or parental status, disability, or any other personal characteristic unrelated to the job. We maintain a zero-tolerance policy on harassment in line with the POSH Act, 2013. If you need any accommodation during the interview process, tell us - we'll arrange it.

data.title: Lead AI Ops Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead AI Ops Engineer

AI Ops

Overview

Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really "finished. " They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. That is the job of AI Ops: making sure each agent's reasoning stays correct, its context stays current, and its behavior stays governed as it learns. 

Role

- Own end to end production monitoring for one or more AI agents, tracking key metrics, KPIs, accuracy, latency, SLA breaches, guardrail triggers, and out of scope rates through dedicated observability dashboards
 - Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live
 - Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors
 - Evaluate whether the agent's reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting
 - Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents
 - Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment
 - Embed governance within the agent's learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact

All About You

- Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices
 - Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns
 - Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing
 - Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus
 - Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent's post launch health
 - Excellent communication skills to translate production signals into clear, prioritized asks for AI Product and AI Engineering teams
 - Comfort working in a fast evolving environment where the process itself, not just the throughput, is what is being continuously operated on and improved

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

About Signant Health

At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support - so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency. 

Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. 

If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health - including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies - you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health. 

About The Role

The Operations Software Engineer creates, enhances, and maintains business applications, configures custom code to support the company's business needs, and moves those configurations through a standard SDLC progression. The Engineer is accountable for project deliverables in line with quality targets and SLAs, while adhering to best practices, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), company processes, and global industry regulations. The ideal candidate has basic product knowledge and basic knowledge of user applications. 

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Function

Application Development / Study Configuration

- Work with Global Project Management and the Solutions team to understand business requirements for assigned tasks
 - Develop and maintain application components and study configurations, following all coding standards

 - Support all phases of verification and testing by efficiently diagnosing and resolving defects
