Essential Requirements

What you'll bring to the role: 

- PhD in Biotechnology, Bioprocess Engineering, or related field (Preferred) / MSc in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Life Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline.

 - Experience in technology transfer and process validation
 - Experience supporting regulatory inspections.

Why Sandoz?

Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world's medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of access to good healthcare. 

With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably. 

Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!

data.title: Lead QA/SDET(Mobile)
data.description:
We are seeking a hands-on Lead QA / SDET to own quality engineering across our iOS and Android applications, backend microservices, APIs, third-party integrations, and end-to-end venue experiences for a major sports team and arena. This person will embed with product and engineering from sprint planning through production release, perform both manual and automated mobile testing, build and expand automation at the unit, integration, API, and mobile UI layers, and lead release readiness with other pod leads. 

The ideal candidate combines strong automation engineering skills with a deliberate break things mindset. They look beyond the happy path, challenge assumptions, probe failure modes and edge cases, and use risk-based testing to prevent defects from reaching fans, staff, and venue operations. They are also AI-fluent and use platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and comparable tools to accelerate test design, automation development, execution, failure analysis, exploratory testing, and regression planning while applying sound engineering judgment. 

What Success Looks Like

- Quality is built into each sprint from planning and refinement through release, rather than treated as a final-stage checkpoint. 
 - Manual and automated tests provide fast, reliable feedback across iOS, Android, unit, integration, API, mobile UI, and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Release decisions are grounded in transparent quality gates, risk assessment, defect status, and cross-pod readiness. 
 - Negative, boundary, resilience, and third-party failure scenarios receive the same rigor as happy-path validation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Embedded Sprint Quality & Test Leadership
 - Work closely with product managers, developers, designers, architects, and pod leads from sprint start to finish, making quality a shared team responsibility. 
 - Actively participate in backlog planning and refinement; provide testability feedback, clarify acceptance criteria, identify dependencies, surface risks, and define the required test approach before development begins. 
 - Translate user stories and technical designs into risk-based test strategies covering functional, integration, regression, usability, reliability, and failure-mode scenarios. 
 - Review feature designs and code changes for quality risks and automation opportunities; partner with developers on unit-test expectations and test data needs. 
 - Test features after developers merge code into the shared branch, validate acceptance criteria, execute targeted exploratory testing, and confirm readiness for broader regression and release. 
 - Lead, mentor, and establish consistent quality practices across QA engineers working within multiple pods such as Ticketing/Identity, Commerce/Payments, and Loyalty. 
 - Manual & Automated Mobile Testing
 - Perform hands-on manual testing across both iOS and Android applications, including functional, exploratory, regression, usability, installation and upgrade, permissions, interruption, device and OS compatibility, and adverse network-condition testing. 
 - Validate mobile experiences on physical devices and emulators/simulators across representative device models, screen sizes, OS versions, application states, and platform-specific behaviors. 
 - Exercise negative and edge cases such as denied permissions, backgrounding and resuming, incoming interruptions, offline and degraded connectivity, session expiration, stale data, failed dependencies, and recovery behavior. 
 - Balance manual and automated testing based on risk, repeatability, feature maturity, and release timing; convert high-value repeatable manual scenarios into maintainable automation where appropriate. 
 - Create and maintain cross-platform mobile automation for Android and iOS using Appium, BrowserStack, Cucumber/Gherkin, Cucumber Pickles, TestNG, and comparable tooling. 
 - Automation Engineering
 - Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation across unit, component, integration, API, contract, mobile UI, and end-to-end layers, with the right tests placed at the lowest practical level. 
 - Partner with developers to improve unit-test coverage, testability, dependency isolation, and fast feedback in pull-request and continuous integration workflows. 
 - Create robust API automation for REST services, including request/response validation, schemas, authentication and authorization, data integrity, error codes, idempotency, timeouts, retries, and downstream dependency failures. 
 - Build integration automation that validates service-to-service behavior, event-driven workflows, data persistence, queues/topics, and third-party contracts across system boundaries. 
 - Use BrowserStack, Cucumber, Gherkin feature specifications, Cucumber Pickles, Appium, TestNG, RestAssured, Allure, Jira, Git/Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, or comparable technologies. 
 - Leverage AI platforms and coding assistants such as OpenAI, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Codex, and comparable tools to generate test scenarios and automation code, identify coverage gaps, create negative and edge-case tests, analyze failures, maintain regression suites, and improve testing speed and effectiveness. 
 - Validate AI-generated tests and code for correctness, maintainability, security, determinism, and alignment with acceptance criteria before incorporating them into the automation suite. 
 - Develop reusable automation components, fixtures, test data utilities, mocks, service virtualization, and environment controls that reduce brittleness and accelerate execution. 
 - Continuously improve automation reliability by eliminating flaky tests, reducing execution time, strengthening diagnostics, and ensuring failures are actionable. 
 - Exploratory, Negative & Resilience Testing
 - Apply a break things mentality: challenge assumptions and intentionally test malformed inputs, permission failures, interrupted flows, concurrency, poor connectivity, stale data, partial completion, dependency outages, and recovery behavior. 
 - Go beyond scripted happy-path cases by using exploratory testing, risk heuristics, boundary analysis, state-transition testing, and production-like scenarios. 
 - Validate API and integration failures such as 400-series and 500-series responses, vendor degradation, duplicate or out-of-order events, latency, retries, and fallback behavior. 
 - Capture defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, evidence, logs, impact, severity, and relevant environment or device details. 
 - Release Management & Quality Governance
 - Lead release management and release readiness in partnership with other pod leads, coordinating cross-pod validation to ensure a high-quality launch. 
 - Own release test planning, entry and exit criteria, manual and automated regression scope, dependency checks, defect triage, risk documentation, stakeholder status, go/no-go recommendations, and post-release validation. 
 - Establish and enforce automated quality gates within CI/CD pipelines for pull requests, builds, environment promotion, and production releases. 
 - Define test certification processes for staging promotion and production deployment, with explicit handling for known defects, ignored tests, coverage debt, and time-bound remediation. 
 - Coordinate production smoke testing, event-day quality support, and post-release or post-event issue analysis; convert findings into preventive automation and process improvements. 
 - Report meaningful quality indicators such as automation coverage by layer, manual test completion, pass/fail trends, escaped defects, flaky tests, unresolved release risk, and defect aging. 
 - Third-Party, Venue & Event-Day Validation
 - Define test strategies for third-party integrations such as Ticketmaster, Chase, and Adobe, including cases where vendor staging environments are limited or unavailable. 
 - Implement contract testing, mocks, stubs, and service virtualization to validate vendor behavior and failure modes without depending on every external system being available. 
 - Plan and execute on-site manual testing for IoT, biometric, ticketing, loyalty, payments, and frictionless commerce scenarios that cannot be fully validated remotely or automated. 
 - Create repeatable test scenarios for smart armrests, cameras, venue devices, and other physical dependencies, including clear evidence and rollback or contingency validation. 
Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in software quality assurance, quality engineering, or SDET roles, including 3+ years leading QA initiatives, release quality, or engineers across delivery teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to design and code maintainable automation frameworks, not only execute prewritten test cases. 
 - Strong hands-on experience performing both manual and automated testing across iOS and Android, including exploratory and regression testing on physical devices and emulators/simulators, Appium automation, and cloud device platforms such as BrowserStack. 
 - Deep understanding of native mobile testing considerations including device and OS fragmentation, permissions, application lifecycle, installation and upgrade paths, interruptions, accessibility, network variability, and platform-specific behavior. 
 - Strong API and integration testing experience using RestAssured or comparable tools, including authentication, schema validation, error handling, data validation, and service dependencies. 
 - Experience with BDD using Cucumber and Gherkin, including feature design, step definitions, tags/hooks, scenario outlines, data tables, and the Cucumber Pickle execution model. 
 - Hands-on experience with a modern quality ecosystem that includes BrowserStack, Appium, Cucumber/Gherkin, Cucumber Pickles, RestAssured, TestNG, Allure, Jira, Git/Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, or comparable technologies. 
 - Demonstrated AI fluency, including practical use of platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and comparable tools to generate, execute, maintain, and improve software tests and test automation. 
 - Working knowledge of unit-testing principles and frameworks, with the ability to collaborate with developers on test design, testability, mocks, and coverage expectations. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of microservices, REST APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures; familiarity with Kafka or comparable messaging platforms. 
 - Experience establishing release quality gates, facilitating defect triage, and communicating release risk and go/no-go recommendations to technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Proficiency with Git-based version control and branching or pull-request workflows. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills. 
 - Bachelor s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on backend engineering or backend test-automation experience, including service-level frameworks, database validation, message/event verification, test containers, mocks, and service virtualization. This is a significant advantage. 
 - Experience applying generative AI to software quality engineering, including test generation, coverage analysis, automation development, defect investigation, and release-readiness activities. 
 - Experience with contract testing tools such as Pact or Spring Cloud Contract. 
 - Experience testing payment processing, tokenization, PCI-sensitive flows, ticketing systems, biometric systems, IoT devices, or hardware integrations. 
 - Experience with performance, load, reliability, or resilience testing using JMeter, Gatling, k6, or similar tools. 
 - Experience using observability platforms such as Datadog or Application Insights to diagnose failures and validate system behavior. 
 - Background in sports, entertainment, venue technology, or other environments where systems must perform reliably during high-visibility live operations. 
 - Experience supporting production releases or live events with high-stakes reliability requirements. 

Benefits

- Health Insurance, Accident Insurance. 
 - The salary will be determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, location, relevant education, qualifications, experience, technical skills, and business needs. 

Additional Responsibilities

- Participate in OP monthly team meetings and participate in team-building efforts. 
 - Contribute to OP technical discussions, peer reviews, etc.

 - Provide status reports to OP Account Management as requested. 

About Us

At OP, we help you harness the power of technology for maximum impact. A technology consulting and solutions company, we offer advisory and managed services, innovative platforms, and staffing solutions across a wide range of fields including AI, cyber security, enterprise architecture, and beyond. For nearly two decades, we ve been challenging the status quo of the consulting industry, serving up fresh, ingenious thinking through a radically lean structure. Together, this strategy delivers unprecedented performance at an unparalleled pace for faster results that propel your business forward.

data.title: QA Engineer 2 -Mobile Apps
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

Role overview

This role combines hands-on manual and exploratory testing with native mobile application automation for PanelSmart. You will assess Android and iOS app changes on representative devices, exercise survey and account workflows, and maintain Appium tests that provide dependable feedback. You will also validate mobile-to-service integration scenarios with the web and backend teams. 

Core technology stack

Core: Appium, Java, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Maven, and Allure. Supporting integration testing: REST-Assured for selected API interactions. 

What you will do

Manual and exploratory mobile testing

- Perform functional and exploratory testing of the PanelSmart mobile app on Android and iOS devices or simulators, as the team's supported matrix requires. 
 - Investigate platform-specific behavior, device and OS differences, permissions, notifications, interruptions, orientation, connectivity, and app lifecycle where relevant. 
 - Test login, password recovery, menus, settings, survey navigation and pause/resume, and questionnaire types and validation rules. 
 - Report reproducible defects with device, OS, app build, setup, steps, expected and actual results, and screenshots or logs; retest fixes. 

Mobile automation

- Build and maintain Appium end-to-end tests in Java using the team's TestNG and Maven framework. 
 - Keep shared driver setup, platform-specific locators, page objects, test data, and utilities readable and reusable. 
 - Automate agreed Android and iOS smoke, sanity, and regression scenarios, including login, menus, survey questions, notifications, and logout. 
 - Use Allure results and captured evidence to diagnose failures and distinguish application defects from device, environment, and test issues. 

Integration and CI

- Validate mobile workflows that depend on backend services, using REST-Assured helpers or API checks where they support the test scenario. 
 - Maintain test data and environment configuration for supported platforms, and coordinate app builds and test readiness with development teams. 
 - Run and maintain the Android and iOS automation workflows, review results, and improve stability, evidence, and feedback. 

Collaboration and quality practices

- Review stories and acceptance criteria for mobile-specific risks, accessibility of controls, and testability across supported platforms. 
 - Use manual and exploratory findings to prioritize new regression automation and focus coverage on high-impact user journeys. 
 - Contribute automation code through Git-based review workflows and communicate quality risks clearly to product and engineering. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Required Experience And Skills

- 3-5 years of hands-on experience with manual functional and exploratory testing of mobile applications. 
 - Experience with Appium-based mobile automation; Java is the primary language in this framework. 
 - Understanding of Android and iOS app behavior, device or simulator testing, and platform-specific test considerations. 
 - Experience with TestNG or a comparable test runner, reusable automation design, and debugging test failures. 
 - Working knowledge of Maven, Git, and collaborative code review practices. 
 - Experience validating API-backed mobile workflows; familiarity with REST-Assured for selected integration tests is useful. 
 - Clear defect reporting and effective collaboration with product, mobile, web, and backend engineering teams. 

Helpful Additional Experience

Experience with device farms, broader mobile CI operations, or approved AI tools for test design and log analysis may be useful as team needs evolve. 

How success is measured

- Manual and exploratory testing identifies platform-specific risks before release. 
 - Agreed critical mobile journeys run reliably on supported Android and iOS targets. 
 - Failures include actionable logs, screenshots, and device and environment details. 
 - Defects and automation failures are triaged promptly, with avoidable flakiness reduced. 
 - Regression automation reflects product changes and priorities across supported platforms.

Overview: Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced Salesforce Technical Lead with mandatory hands-on expertise in Salesforce Commerce Cloud for B2B ecommerce and proven experience building custom websites using Salesforce Experience Cloud. In this role, you will own the technical direction for enterprise B2B ecommerce storefronts and customer-facing digital experiences on the Salesforce platform, leading solution design, development, integration, performance optimization, and delivery across commerce capabilities such as catalogs, pricing, buyer groups, cart, checkout, account management, order workflows, and self-service experiences. You will partner with Product Owners, Technical Architects, UI/UX Leads, and onshore/offshore engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable commerce and Experience Cloud solutions while mentoring developers and enforcing Salesforce engineering best practices. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of scalable Salesforce Commerce Cloud B2B ecommerce solutions and Experience Cloud-based customer portals. 
 - Build and customize Salesforce Experience Cloud websites, storefronts, portals, and self-service experiences using Experience Builder, custom themes, page templates, branding, navigation, and reusable components. 
 - Own solution architecture for B2B commerce capabilities, including product catalogs, pricing, buyer groups, entitlements, cart, checkout, account management, order workflows, and personalized buyer experiences. 
 - Develop and customize commerce and Experience Cloud experiences using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Lightning Web Runtime (LWR), Flow, SOQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SLDS, and Experience Builder. 
 - Integrate Salesforce Commerce Cloud with ERP, payment, tax, search, shipping, inventory, product information, and order management systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, middleware, and event-driven architecture. 
 - Collaborate with Product Owners, Technical Architects, UI/UX Leads, Delivery Leads, QA, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well-architected commerce and Experience Cloud solutions. 
 - Provide technical leadership to onshore and offshore developers through design reviews, code reviews, estimation, troubleshooting, coaching, and delivery planning. 
 - Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards for code quality, security, performance, governor-limit awareness, accessibility, release readiness, and platform governance. 
 - Analyze existing commerce and Experience Cloud implementations and optimize performance, scalability, usability, accessibility, and maintainability across storefront, portal, and backend components. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, integration specifications, data models, deployment notes, website configuration details, and operational support guides. 
 - Stay current with Salesforce Commerce Cloud, B2B Commerce, Experience Cloud, Experience Builder, LWR, and platform release updates, recommending improvements that reduce technical debt and improve customer experience. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Minimum of 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including experience leading technical delivery for enterprise Salesforce implementations. 
 - Must have hands-on experience with Salesforce Commerce Cloud for B2B ecommerce, including storefront configuration, catalog, pricing, cart, checkout, buyer groups, entitlements, and order-related workflows. 
 - Must have proven experience building custom websites, portals, and self-service experiences using Salesforce Experience Cloud, including Experience Builder, custom themes, templates, branding, navigation, and reusable components. 
 - Strong expertise in Salesforce B2B Commerce on Lightning Experience, Experience Cloud, Lightning Web Runtime (LWR), and Commerce storefront development. 
 - Proven experience designing and implementing B2B ecommerce capabilities such as catalogs, price books, buyer groups, entitlements, cart, checkout, reorder, account hierarchy, purchase workflows, and order management integrations. 
 - Advanced proficiency with Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, SOSL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SLDS, Salesforce data models, security, sharing, and governor limits. 
 - Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems such as ERP, PIM, OMS, tax, payment, shipping, inventory, search, identity providers, and middleware platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, JSON/XML, and event-driven patterns. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead developers, run technical design discussions, perform code reviews, estimate work, resolve escalated issues, and guide onshore/offshore teams in Agile delivery. 
 - Strong understanding of scalable architecture, reusable component design, website performance tuning, accessibility, secure coding practices, release management, and Salesforce DevOps. 
 - Proficiency with version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Azure Repos, Salesforce DX, Azure Pipelines, or equivalent DevOps tooling. 
 - Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and tools such as Azure Boards or Jira. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Salesforce B2B Commerce Developer, Experience Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, or System Architect are highly preferred.

At Basware, we deliver mission-critical cloud solutions that empower organizations to unlock their full potential. Our products are designed to bring clear and compelling value to our customers, and we're looking for a talented and forward-thinking developer who can help us shape the future of our technology. 

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Developer - Country Compliance, an experienced software engineer, who will contribute to the solutions that keep our customers compliant with country e-invoicing and tax reporting mandates. Your role will be focused on building the country-specific capabilities that connect invoices, credit notes and purchase orders to government tax portals and clearance networks, using the latest technologies and AI-assisted ways of working to deliver large-scale, high-performance, enterprise-grade solutions. 

This is a hands-on technology role, ideal for candidates seeking opportunities to both build on their existing experience and research new knowledge areas, with a significant share of design and exploratory elements to their day-to-day tasks. Every country mandate brings a different set of rules, formats and deadlines, so no two modules look the same. 

You will be working alongside engineers and developers from the Invoice Lifecycle Management (ILM) Teams, assisted by our AI Engineering team, and in integration with other Basware solutions. The product you will be contributing to is targeted at large, well-known enterprises. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement country extension modules against the platform's shared frameworks and architectural conventions. 
 - Build and maintain REST APIs and service layers that carry compliance traffic to and from government portals. 
 - Implement compliance logic: XML and JSON schema validation, digital signature handling, submission to and status polling from government portals. 
 - Write automated tests as part of a TDD workflow, covering both unit and integration levels. 
 - Participate actively in code and design reviews, and help hold the quality bar across the team. 
 - Work with the Lead Developer and QA to harden the performance, security and resilience of compliance flows. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements and help diagnose and fix production issues. 
 - Use AI coding assistants as part of the daily workflow, critically reviewing and validating what they generate. 

, 

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Strong Java (17+) and Spring Boot experience building production REST services. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding assistants in a professional workflow, understanding their limitations and validating their output. 
 - Familiarity with XML processing, XSD schema validation and secure XML parsing practices. 
 - Practical experience with MongoDB or another NoSQL document database. 
 - Working knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms in web APIs. 
 - Experience deploying and operating applications on AWS cloud infrastructure. 
 - Solid understanding of software design principles and the ability to apply them in day-to-day coding. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Test-Driven Development as a working practice. 
 - Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product, QA and compliance stakeholders. 
 - Strong sense of ownership, collaborative attitude, and willingness to learn new domains and regulations quickly. 
 - Familiarity with e-invoicing standards and networks such as Peppol and EN 16931, or with national clearance models such as Italy's SDI, Poland's KSeF or the French PPF and PDP model. 
 - Experience with digital signatures and certificates (X. 509, XAdES) or secure token and credential handling. 
 - Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems concepts. 
 - Experience with spec-driven AI development, where a written specification drives implementation and tests, and with AI agents and agent skills.

data.company: Talent Corner HR Services Pvt Ltd
data.description:
If interested, share your CV at farheen. akhtar@talentcorner. in or 9036659658

Job Title - Senior Back-End Developer

Location - Bangalore (Whitefield)

Experience - 3 to 5 years

Allocated Budget: 10 - 12 LPA (Non Negotiable)

For This is a senior back-end role - we expect depth in Python and in relational databases, and the ability to run what you build. 

About the Role: 

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Back-End Developer who writes production-grade server-side code. You will design and build the services and data layer behind our applications using Python, with relational databases underneath - all deployed and operated on AWS. This is a builder's role, not a coordinator's. You should be comfortable writing complex SQL by hand, designing REST APIs that other teams depend on, reasoning about performance and failure, and owning your code through testing, deployment and production support. 

What You'll Do: 

• Design, build, and maintain Python (Flask/FastAPI) services and REST APIs consumed by our front ends and partners. 

• Write and optimise advanced SQL - multi-table joins, subqueries, CTEs, and window functions - without leaning on an ORM to do the thinking for you. 

• Model and evolve relational schemas, design indexes, and tune slow queries using EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN ANALYZE. 

• Plan and run schema migrations safely against live data. 

• Handle authentication, authorisation, and the security of the endpoints you expose. 

• Build background jobs, queues, and scheduled work, and make them safe to retry. 

• Write meaningful unit and integration tests for the code and modules you ship. 

• Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot services on AWS, and improve build and release pipelines. 

• Review peers' code, uphold quality standards, and mentor less experienced developers. What

We're Looking: 

• 5+ years of relevant, hands-on back-end development experience. 

• Python - solid backend experience building REST APIs (Flask or FastAPI), not just scripting. 

• SQL - ability to write advanced queries from scratch and reason about how they execute; PostgreSQL and/or MySQL in production. 

• Schema design, indexing, and query optimisation on real data volumes. 

• AWS - practical experience deploying and running workloads (e. g. ECS/Fargate, Lambda, RDS). 

• API security - authentication and authorisation (JWT, OAuth2) and common OWASP risks. 

• Testing - able to write proper unit and integration tests with pytest. 

• Comfort with Git workflows, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. 

This Role Is Not a Fit If. . . 

• You work only in Java and have no Python experience or familiarity. 

• You rely entirely on ORMs and cannot write raw SQL queries yourself. 

• Your Python is scripting and automation only - you have never built and run a production service. • You have never worked with AWS. (Experience on GCP or Azure is a plus, but AWS experience is required. )

• You have never written tests for your own code. 

• You are looking for a role that is mostly front-end work. 

Nice to Have

• Async Python (asyncio) and an understanding of concurrency trade-offs. 

• Queues and background processing - Celery, SQS, or Kafka. 

• Caching strategies with Redis, and knowing when not to cache. 

• Infrastructure as code (Terraform or AWS CDK). 

• Observability - structured logging, metrics, tracing, and useful alerts. 

• NoSQL stores (MongoDB, DynamoDB) alongside relational databases. 

• Enough front-end familiarity (Angular or React) to debug an integration end to end.

data.title: #ACN I&P - GN - SONG - AI & Data - Platforms - AI/ML Engineering - Manager
data.description:
Entity: GN Song

Practice: GN Song - Data & AI

Title: Song Process Excellence | ML/AI Engineering Manager - CL7

Job Location: Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Mumbai/ Hyderabad/ Pune/ Kolkata/ Chennai

About Song - Data & AI

Accenture Song uses AI, proprietary customer data, and product platforms to help clients improve customer experience and drive measurable growth across marketing, sales, commerce, and service. From strategy through execution, Song Data & AI helps organizations build and operationalize advanced capabilities - covering customer data unification, predictive analytics, and Generative AI (including agentic use cases) - to enable smarter decisioning like personalization and "next best action, " faster content and experience delivery, and more effective commerce and customer engagement. 

What's In It For You?

- Join a worldwide network of data scientists, ML/AI engineers, and lifecycle engineering practitioners building practical, trusted, and production-grade AI solutions. 
 - Access world-class training, mentorship, and certifications across machine learning, deep learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, and cloud AI platforms. 
 - Work on high-visibility engagements across Marketing, Sales, Commerce, Customer Service, and Digital Products - taking AI solutions from experimentation through enterprise deployment and continuous improvement. 
 - Contribute to Accenture's internal accelerators, reusable model and agent components, evaluation frameworks, engineering standards, and lifecycle playbooks. 

What You Will Do

As an ML/AI Engineering Manager, you will lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic solutions, combining computational science, software engineering, lifecycle engineering, and consulting leadership. 

- Translate business decisions and user needs into AI/ML problem statements, experimentation plans, solution architectures, success metrics, and prioritized delivery roadmaps. 
 - Architect and lead development of predictive, forecasting, recommendation, optimization, NLP, computer vision, Generative AI, and agentic solutions aligned to the problem context. 
 - Guide feature engineering, algorithm and model selection, training, tuning, experimentation, evaluation, explainability, error analysis, and champion-challenger decisions. 
 - Design foundation-model applications using prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, structured outputs, model adaptation, evaluation, and guardrails. 
 - Architect agentic systems using tool and function calling, planning, memory and context, orchestration, multi-agent patterns, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Define AI lifecycle pipelines covering experiment tracking, data and model versioning, registries, CI/CD and continuous training, promotion, rollback, retraining, and end-of-life controls. 
 - Lead production engineering for modular APIs and services, batch and real-time inference, containers, scalable compute, enterprise integration, and resilient deployment patterns. 
 - Implement monitoring and observability for model quality, drift, safety, latency, reliability, cost, adoption, and business outcomes, with governed learning and improvement loops. 
 - Embed Responsible AI, security, privacy, testing, reproducibility, auditability, and human oversight into model and agent development and operations. 
 - Engage with senior client stakeholders to shape AI strategies, platform roadmaps, operating models, business cases, solution demonstrations, and value realization plans. 
 - Manage delivery governance, resource planning, risk, quality, project economics, and partner coordination across multi-disciplinary AI engagements. 
 - Mentor Consultants and Analysts, and shape internal accelerators, reusable components, evaluation assets, engineering standards, and playbooks across the practice. 

Domain Focus

Candidates should bring hands-on ML/AI solution-building and productionization experience in one or more of the following domains: 

- Marketing - customer propensity, segmentation, personalization, next-best action, content intelligence, media effectiveness, and campaign optimization
 - Sales - demand forecasting, recommendations, revenue intelligence, sales productivity, outlet or customer prioritization, and decision support
 - Commerce - search, recommendations, pricing, promotion, demand and inventory intelligence, and digital commerce optimization
 - Service - conversational AI, contact center intelligence, knowledge assistance, case routing, quality monitoring, and operations automation
 - Design & Digital Products - AI-powered product features, product intelligence, experimentation, personalization, and agile digital product delivery

Who We Are Looking For

Mandatory

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced degree or MBA from a top institution is advantageous. 
 - 8-12 years of progressive experience in machine learning, AI engineering, data science, and/or digital consulting, with significant consulting or enterprise leadership experience. 
 - Strong expertise in Python and SQL, production-quality software engineering, version control, testing, and modular API or service development. 
 - Strong foundations in supervised and unsupervised learning, statistics, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and selection of fit-for-purpose techniques. 
 - Hands-on experience with common ML and deep learning libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated success leading ML/AI solutions from problem framing and experimentation through enterprise deployment, adoption, monitoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Hands-on Generative AI experience with prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, structured outputs, evaluation, guardrails, and model adaptation. 
 - Agentic AI experience with tool and function calling, planning, memory and context, orchestration, and multi-agent patterns using LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, and/or AgentOps practices, including experiment tracking, versioning, model registries, CI/CD, continuous training, promotion, rollback, retraining, and lifecycle governance. 
 - Solid experience with at least one major cloud or AI platform - AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, or Anthropic - and its relevant services for AI development and deployment. 
 - Experience deploying AI through APIs, containers, Kubernetes or managed services, and batch or real-time inference patterns; familiarity with FastAPI, Docker, or equivalent. 
 - Working knowledge of data platforms and pipelines; familiarity with Spark or Databricks, relational and vector databases, unstructured data, and API-based integrations. 
 - Experience defining evaluation and monitoring across accuracy, drift, robustness, safety, latency, reliability, cost, user adoption, and business KPIs. 
 - Awareness of Responsible AI, security, privacy, observability, testing, reproducibility, auditability, and human oversight required for enterprise production. 
 - Proven project leadership capability: solution architecture, estimation, delivery governance, resource planning, project economics, risk management, and partner coordination. 
 - Exceptional stakeholder engagement and communication skills - ability to translate complex AI choices into business strategy, measurable value, and executive decisions. 

What We Are NOT Looking For

- Pure Data Scientists or researchers without production engineering, deployment, monitoring, or lifecycle ownership. 
 - MLOps, DevOps, or infrastructure-only profiles without substantive model development, experimentation, and evaluation capability. 
 - Prompt-engineering-only or LLM-only profiles without strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, and rigorous evaluation. 
 - Pure Delivery or Program Managers with no technical AI architecture, solutioning, or build experience. 
 - Profiles focused purely on presales or platform consulting without demonstrable end-to-end enterprise AI delivery depth. 

Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society and does not discriminate on grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

Practice: GN Song - Data & AI

Title: Song Process Excellence | Full Stack Engineering Manager - CL7

Job Location: Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Mumbai/ Hyderabad/ Pune/ Kolkata/ Chennai

About Song - Data & AI

Accenture Song uses AI, proprietary customer data, and product platforms to help clients improve customer experience and drive measurable growth across marketing, sales, commerce, and service. From strategy through execution, Song Data & AI helps organizations build and operationalize advanced capabilities - covering customer data unification, predictive analytics, and Generative AI (including agentic use cases) - to enable smarter decisioning like personalization and "next best action, " faster content and experience delivery, and more effective commerce and customer engagement. 

What's In It For You?

- Join a worldwide network of digital product, full stack, cloud, data, and AI leaders delivering secure, scalable applications for enterprise transformation. 
 - Access world-class training, mentorship, and certifications across application architecture, cloud-native engineering, DevSecOps, product delivery, data platforms, and AI-enabled experiences. 
 - Lead high-visibility engagements across Marketing, Sales, Commerce, Customer Service, and Digital Products - taking cloud-native and AI-enabled applications from solution design through enterprise adoption. 
 - Shape Accenture's reusable application frameworks, design systems, service components, reference architectures, delivery standards, and AI experience patterns. 

What You Will Do

As a Full Stack Engineering Manager, you will lead the solution design, implementation, and enterprise adoption of cloud-native and AI-enabled applications. You will combine full stack architecture and hands-on technical judgment with consulting and delivery leadership, integrating governed data platforms and ML/AI services into secure, scalable digital products. 

- Translate business and product goals into solution architecture, experience and integration designs, prioritized backlogs, technical roadmaps, delivery estimates, and measurable acceptance criteria. 
 - Architect end-to-end application solutions spanning responsive front ends, back-end services, APIs, workflow or domain services, data stores, messaging, identity, and cloud runtime components. 
 - Lead multidisciplinary teams building accessible user experiences, microservices, real-time workflows, enterprise integrations, and reusable application capabilities. 
 - Define integration patterns for enterprise systems, APIs, event streams, governed data products, lakehouse or warehouse platforms, operational databases, and third-party services. 
 - Lead the design of AI-enabled applications using predictive model endpoints, Generative AI, RAG, vector search, copilots, agents, multimodal services, feedback loops, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Establish engineering practices for modular design, code quality, automated testing, DevSecOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerization, environment promotion, observability, and production support. 
 - Ensure application solutions meet requirements for security, privacy, Responsible AI, accessibility, scalability, performance, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, and cost. 
 - Lead architecture, design, and code reviews; guide technology selection; resolve complex cross-stack issues; and maintain technical integrity through delivery. 
 - Engage senior client stakeholders through discovery workshops, solution presentations, architecture walkthroughs, prototypes, demonstrations, and decision forums - communicating value, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs. 
 - Manage delivery governance, resource planning, estimation, quality, dependencies, risks, issue resolution, release readiness, and project economics across application engagements. 
 - Lead and mentor Consultants and Analysts across front-end, back-end, quality, cloud, data integration, and AI application engineering, while collaborating closely with design, Data Engineering, and ML/AI Engineering teams. 
 - Contribute to proposals, reusable accelerators, reference architectures, design systems, engineering standards, and playbooks that scale full stack and AI application delivery across the practice. 

Domain Focus

Candidates should bring full stack solution leadership and enterprise application delivery experience in one or more of the following domains: 

- Marketing - campaign and content platforms, customer data applications, audience activation, personalization, measurement, and next-best-action experiences
 - Sales - sales productivity, recommendation, forecasting and revenue intelligence applications, customer or outlet prioritization, and route-to-market platforms
 - Commerce - product discovery, search and recommendations, catalog, pricing and promotions, order and inventory experiences, composable commerce, and customer portals
 - Service - conversational interfaces, agent assist, knowledge and case management, contact center applications, self-service, and operations automation
 - Design & Digital Products - enterprise web and mobile products, AI copilots, workflow platforms, experimentation, product analytics, and reusable digital services

Who We Are Looking For

Mandatory

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related discipline. MBA from a top institution is advantageous. 
 - 8-12 years of progressive experience in full stack application engineering and digital product delivery, including significant solution leadership and client-facing accountability. 
 - Strong full stack depth and current hands-on credibility across at least one modern front-end framework and one enterprise back-end stack; able to prototype, review code, and resolve critical engineering issues. 
 - Proven success leading enterprise applications from discovery and architecture through build, integration, testing, release, adoption, and production stabilization. 
 - Strong application architecture foundations covering microservices, modular monoliths, API-first design, event-driven integration, domain-driven design, distributed systems, and reusable platform components. 
 - Solid experience with cloud-native engineering on Azure, AWS, or GCP, including containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns, managed services, infrastructure as code, and environment management. 
 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, caching, search, messaging, object storage, transactional design, data consistency, and application data modelling. 
 - Strong command of software quality and operations - automated testing, code quality, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, SRE principles, release management, incident response, and performance engineering. 
 - Strong knowledge of application and API security, identity and access management, secure coding, privacy, secrets, encryption, threat modelling, and OWASP risks. 
 - Data Engineering know-how sufficient to architect application-to-data-platform integration, including SQL, data models, data contracts, ETL/ELT, batch or streaming patterns, quality, lineage, and lakehouse or warehouse consumption. 
 - ML/AI Engineering know-how sufficient to lead application integration with model and agent services, including inference APIs, RAG, embeddings and vector search, prompts and structured outputs, evaluation, guardrails, versioning, observability, and feedback loops. 
 - Awareness of Responsible AI, AI security, human oversight, failure handling, explainability needs, and user-experience patterns for trustworthy AI-enabled applications. 
 - Strong stakeholder engagement and consulting skills - ability to translate business and user needs into architecture choices, delivery plans, value narratives, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Proven delivery leadership covering estimation, resource planning, delivery governance, dependencies, risks, quality, release readiness, and project economics. 
 - Experience leading multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams, reviewing architecture and code, mentoring engineers, and creating an inclusive high-performance culture. 
 - Experience with Agile and product-centric delivery, backlog prioritization, design collaboration, architecture decision records, and continuous improvement. 
 - . 

What We Are NOT Looking For

- Front-end-only, back-end-only, or packaged-platform specialists without credible end-to-end application architecture and delivery experience. 
 - Pure Delivery or Program Managers without substantive full stack architecture, engineering, integration, code-review, and production problem-solving depth. 
 - Architecture-only profiles that are disconnected from implementation, automated testing, DevSecOps, release management, and operational outcomes. 
 - Pure Data Engineering, Data Science, or ML Engineering leaders without experience turning data and AI capabilities into enterprise-grade digital products. 
 - Low-code, legacy application maintenance, or platform-configuration profiles without modern cloud-native engineering and transformation experience. 

Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society and does not discriminate on grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

data.title: Software Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure
data.description:
A CAREER WITH POINT72'S TECHNOLOGY TEAM

As Point72 reimagines the future of investing, our Technology team is constantly evolving our firm's IT infrastructure and engineering capabilities, positioning us at the forefront of a rapidly evolving technology landscape. We're a team of experts who experiment and work to discover new ways to harness open-source solutions, modern cloud architectures, and sophisticated Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, while embracing enterprise agile methodologies. Our commitment to building and innovating in the AI space provides the framework intended to drive smarter decision making and enhance how we build and operate our platforms and applications. As a member of Point72's Technology team, we encourage and support your professional development from day one-helping you advance your technical skills, contribute innovative ideas, and satisfy your own intellectual curiosity-all while delivering real business impact for our multi-billion-dollar global business. 

What you'll do

- Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes infrastructure on Amazon EKS, including Karpenter-based autoscaling, workload scheduling, and cluster lifecycle management
 - Administer and tune PostgreSQL databases (on RDS) that back platform applications such as Airflow - handling configuration, parameter tuning, maintenance, and reliability, not query optimization
 - Own our Infrastructure as Code using Terraform - provisioning, modifying, and auditing AWS resources including S3, EC2, RDS, EKS, and IAM
 - Manage IAM roles, policies, and access patterns across our AWS environment with a security-first mindset
 - Maintain our artifact registries (ECR, Artifactory) - enforcing retention policies, image versioning standards, and responding to infosec requests around package vulnerabilities and container image remediation
 - Own and evolve our monitoring and observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch) - improving coverage, reducing noise, and evaluating the stack as needs change
 - Support our CI/CD and source control environment across both current (Bitbucket, Jenkins) and target (GitHub, GitHub Actions) tooling as we migrate
 - Collaborate with data engineers to define infrastructure patterns, containerization standards, and deployment best practices
 - Participate in on-call rotation for platform-level incidents

What's Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
 - 4+ years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or DevOps in production environments
 - Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production - ideally Amazon EKS - including autoscaling (Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler), networking, and day-to-day operations
 - Strong proficiency in Terraform for infrastructure as code
 - Solid AWS experience across EKS, EC2, S3, RDS, and IAM
 - Experience administering PostgreSQL or similar relational databases in a cloud environment - configuration, tuning for specific workloads, and operational maintenance
 - Hands-on experience with Helm, ArgoCD, and GitOps delivery workflows
 - Experience with observability tooling - Prometheus, Grafana, and log aggregation (OpenSearch or similar)
 - Familiarity with artifact management, container image lifecycle, and vulnerability remediation workflows
 - Experience with code repository and CI/CD solutions such as Bitbucket, Jenkins, GitHub, and GitHub Actions
 - Scripting and automation proficiency in Python and/or Bash
 - Strong Linux fundamentals and comfort operating cloud-native production systems
 - Commitment to the highest ethical standards

We take care of our people

We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide: 

- Health care benefits
 - Maternity, Adoption & related leave policies
 - Generous paternity and family care leave policies
 - Employee Assistance Program & Mental wellness programs
 - Transportation support
 - Tuition assistance

About Point72

Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry's brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people's long-term growth. For more information, visit https: //point72. com.

data.title: Team Lead, SEO
data.description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5, 500+

employees and ~30, 000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, 

Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event

professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help

them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people

together at events around the world. In short, we're transforming the meetings and events industry

through innovative technology that powers human connection. 

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone

and Vista for $4. 6B in 2023. 

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like

entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and

celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. 

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At

Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our

DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to

experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll

thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering

exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. 

Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, 

iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AIpowered

collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Disclaimer: Beware of Recruitment Scams - Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will always

come from an official 'name@cvent. com' email. We never request any payments or ask for sensitive

personal or financial information via chat or social media platforms. For more information, please

visit: https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. 

Cvent is looking for a Team Lead, SEO to join our growing SEO team and drive organic growth across its websites. This role will contribute to SEO strategy across technical SEO, content optimization, site architecture, internal linking, topical authority, organic conversion, and performance reporting. 

The role will also support Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as a secondary responsibility, helping improve Cvent's visibility, representation, and citations across AI assistants, answer engines, and generative search experiences. 

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy and Roadmap

- Help define and execute Cvent's enterprise SEO strategy and roadmap. 
 - Perform keyword research, search-intent mapping, competitive analysis, opportunity sizing, and forecasting. 
 - Set standards for SEO briefs, metadata, headings, internal linking, content quality, schema, and optimization QA. 
 - Partner with content, product marketing, web, development, analytics, and regional teams to improve organic performance. 
 - Embed SEO into content planning, site launches, migrations, campaigns, and CMS workflows. 

Technical and content SEO

- Audit websites for crawlability, indexation, rendering, page experience, accessibility, structured data, and site architecture. 
 - Improve JavaScript rendering, canonicalization, redirects, XML sitemaps, robots directives, metadata, and internal linking. 
 - Build topic clusters and optimize landing pages, product pages, comparison pages, glossary pages, FAQs, blogs, and thought leadership. 
 - Identify content gaps, decay, cannibalization, duplication, and conversion opportunities. 
 - Work with digital PR and content teams on authority and link-earning initiatives. 

Analytics and reporting

- Use Google Search Console, Google / Adobe Analytics, Screaming Frog, Semrush, and related tools to identify opportunities. 
 - Report on rankings, qualified organic traffic, conversions, assisted conversions, pipeline, and SEO health. 
 - Test and scale technical, content, internal-linking, and conversion improvements. 
 - Present actionable recommendations and business impact to leadership. 

GEO support

- Support GEO efforts with SEO insights, content analysis, and technical recommendations. 
 - Provide relevant search, content, entity, and site-structure inputs for GEO initiatives. 
 - Help evaluate how AI experiences surface Cvent and competitors when requested. 
 - Contribute to GEO reporting and optimization projects while keeping SEO as the primary focus. 
 - Required qualifications
 - 5-7 years of experience in SEO, organic growth, content strategy, or digital marketing. 
 - Strong expertise in technical SEO, on-page SEO, content optimization, structured data, internal linking, search intent, and site architecture. 
 - Experience contributing to SEO roadmaps and influencing cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or large-scale content programs. 
 - Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, modern CMS environments, and web analytics. 
 - Familiarity with generative search, AI assistants, answer engines, and LLM citation behavior. 
 - Strong analytical, communication, prioritization, and stakeholder-management skills. 
Performance measures

- Organic visibility, rankings, qualified sessions, conversions, assisted conversions, and influenced pipeline. 
 - Technical SEO health, indexation quality, issue-resolution velocity, content performance, and authority growth. 
 - Secondary GEO measures: AI visibility, citation share, answer inclusion, and recommendation presence.

Provides intermediate level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases, under general supervision. 

About Vanguard

Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe-directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries. 

Vanguard India

Vanguard's office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients. 

Role Summary

This role provides intermediate-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases and supports backend performance optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure development practices. 

Responsibilites

- Provides intermediate level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.

 - Follows software development methodology. Follows development architecture standards.

 - Understands client business functions and technology needs. Understands Vanguard's tools, technologies, and applications/databases, including those that interface with business area and systems. 
 - Learns and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures. 
 - Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned. 
 - Contribute to optimizing system performance through efficient database design and code enhancements to support scalability. 
 - Support the integration and maintenance of data pipelines between APIs and backend systems, ensuring data accuracy and integrity. 
 - Maintain and update software documentation for backend components, highlighting logic, processes, and architecture. 
 - Apply intermediate knowledge of backend system security and data protection best practices during development. 

Qualifications And Skills

- Minimum 3 years of experience in application development, system analysis, or database management. 
 - Bachelor's degree (B. E. /B. Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor's in Computer Applications (BCA). 
 - Experience with database design, SQL, and data optimization techniques for high-performance applications. 
 - Familiarity with API development, integration, and third-party software integration. 
 - Must have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, SQL queries, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Python (optional). 
 - Proficiency in Agile, Confluence, JIRA. 
 - Aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows. 
 - Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including front-end developers and business stakeholders.

data.title: QA Engineer 2 -Mobile Apps
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

Role overview

This role combines hands-on manual and exploratory testing with native mobile application automation for PanelSmart. You will assess Android and iOS app changes on representative devices, exercise survey and account workflows, and maintain Appium tests that provide dependable feedback. You will also validate mobile-to-service integration scenarios with the web and backend teams. 

Core technology stack

Core: Appium, Java, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Maven, and Allure. Supporting integration testing: REST-Assured for selected API interactions. 

What you will do

Manual and exploratory mobile testing

- Perform functional and exploratory testing of the PanelSmart mobile app on Android and iOS devices or simulators, as the team's supported matrix requires. 
 - Investigate platform-specific behavior, device and OS differences, permissions, notifications, interruptions, orientation, connectivity, and app lifecycle where relevant. 
 - Test login, password recovery, menus, settings, survey navigation and pause/resume, and questionnaire types and validation rules. 
 - Report reproducible defects with device, OS, app build, setup, steps, expected and actual results, and screenshots or logs; retest fixes. 

Mobile automation

- Build and maintain Appium end-to-end tests in Java using the team's TestNG and Maven framework. 
 - Keep shared driver setup, platform-specific locators, page objects, test data, and utilities readable and reusable. 
 - Automate agreed Android and iOS smoke, sanity, and regression scenarios, including login, menus, survey questions, notifications, and logout. 
 - Use Allure results and captured evidence to diagnose failures and distinguish application defects from device, environment, and test issues. 

Integration and CI

- Validate mobile workflows that depend on backend services, using REST-Assured helpers or API checks where they support the test scenario. 
 - Maintain test data and environment configuration for supported platforms, and coordinate app builds and test readiness with development teams. 
 - Run and maintain the Android and iOS automation workflows, review results, and improve stability, evidence, and feedback. 

Collaboration and quality practices

- Review stories and acceptance criteria for mobile-specific risks, accessibility of controls, and testability across supported platforms. 
 - Use manual and exploratory findings to prioritize new regression automation and focus coverage on high-impact user journeys. 
 - Contribute automation code through Git-based review workflows and communicate quality risks clearly to product and engineering. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Required Experience And Skills

- 3-5 years of hands-on experience with manual functional and exploratory testing of mobile applications. 
 - Experience with Appium-based mobile automation; Java is the primary language in this framework. 
 - Understanding of Android and iOS app behavior, device or simulator testing, and platform-specific test considerations. 
 - Experience with TestNG or a comparable test runner, reusable automation design, and debugging test failures. 
 - Working knowledge of Maven, Git, and collaborative code review practices. 
 - Experience validating API-backed mobile workflows; familiarity with REST-Assured for selected integration tests is useful. 
 - Clear defect reporting and effective collaboration with product, mobile, web, and backend engineering teams. 

Helpful Additional Experience

Experience with device farms, broader mobile CI operations, or approved AI tools for test design and log analysis may be useful as team needs evolve. 

How success is measured

- Manual and exploratory testing identifies platform-specific risks before release. 
 - Agreed critical mobile journeys run reliably on supported Android and iOS targets. 
 - Failures include actionable logs, screenshots, and device and environment details. 
 - Defects and automation failures are triaged promptly, with avoidable flakiness reduced. 
 - Regression automation reflects product changes and priorities across supported platforms.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

About Soar and how we build

Soar is building an AI-native home-financing platform for Saudi Arabia, and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. Our product spans origination, credit decisioning, loan management, collections and investor products, all under SAMA regulation. 

We build differently. Our engineers don't hand-write code; they specify, direct and review AI agents that do. If that sounds like where engineering is going, you'll fit here. 

How we work : 

Agents write the code. Engineers own the spec, the context, the tests and the review. DevOps doesn't hand-manage servers either. 

Context engineering is the core skill. Agents work from a shared knowledge graph of business rules, architecture principles and money-movement rules that we keep current. 

We build our own agents. Requirements, DevOps, PM and self-testing agents run on our MCP/A2A framework to automate the SDLC end to end. 

Full stack by default. AI closes skill gaps, so engineers work across backend, frontend and infrastructure, with cross-domain reviewers. 

Regulated means rigorous. Money-movement logic gets human review, every time. KSA data residency shapes which models and tools we use and where they run. 

What every role here needs: you already use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) as your main way of working, not as autocomplete. You can show us real workflows you've built, where they broke, and what you changed. 

Role Summary: We rely heavily on AI throughout engineering and are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who treats AI agents as a core part of how they build software. You will own complex features from design through production, direct agents effectively, and apply strong engineering judgment to everything you ship. You should be equally comfortable accelerating implementation with AI and investigating difficult problems yourself. Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, build, and maintain production features and services, taking ownership of correctness, performance, security, and maintainability. 
 - Use AI agents across planning, coding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, and documentation to accelerate end-to-end delivery. 
 - Provide agents with clear requirements, architecture context, constraints, and acceptance criteria; break complex work into verifiable steps. 
 - Inspect and refine AI-generated code. Detect incorrect assumptions, insecure patterns, unnecessary complexity, and missing edge cases. 
 - Build automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; validate actual user journeys and failure paths before declaring work complete. 
 - Create reusable workflows and tool integrations that help agents access the right context and perform tasks within appropriate permissions. 
 - Own changes through review, deployment, observability, and production troubleshooting; investigate root causes and prevent repeat failures. 
 - Collaborate with Product, QA, and other engineers; mentor teammates and document decisions and validation evidence in pull requests. 

Requirements

Requirements: 

- Typically 5+ years building and shipping production software, or equivalent demonstrated engineering depth and ownership. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one production programming language and experience with application design, APIs, databases, version control, and automated testing. 
 - Substantial hands-on experience delivering software with AI coding tools or agents, supported by concrete examples of shipped work. 
 - Ability to reason about, debug, and explain code independently, including code generated by AI. 
 - Practical understanding of context management, tool use, agent limitations, and the trade-offs between model capability, speed, and cost. 
 - Strong ownership and collaboration, including careful handling of credentials, sensitive data, and permissions in AI workflows. 

Nice to have: Experience with agent orchestration, MCP or API integrations, retrieval systems, evaluation suites, cloud platforms, or financial systems. What success looks like: You ship reliable features with clear validation evidence, catch defects in generated code, improve delivery speed, and create reusable practices that raise the effectiveness of the wider team.

data.description:
Job Requirements

We are looking for experienced engineers to join Server Appliance (SA) engineering teams. SA engineering teams develop the software platform layer that resides between medical applications and the IT infrastructure, supporting both on-premise and virtualized deployments. The SA teams also manage CICD, deployment automation, test automation, and related tooling. 

This is a highly technical role that requires hands-on expertise of virtualization (e. g. , Kubernetes, Docker, VMware, Nutanix), CI/CD and automation/scripting (e. g. , PowerShell, Ansible). Stakeholders in the SA teams' work include other Server Appliance and medical application engineering teams, verification lead(s), Product Management, Project Management, Product Support Engineering, and the Global Customer Service organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develops and maintains CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation (e. g. , PowerShell, Ansible)
 - Develops and maintains Server Appliance test automation and related tooling
 - Reviews pipeline and automated test results, investigates possible failures and ensures each failure is managed accordingly. 
 - Reviews own and other members' code, raises and manages review findings
 - Reviews relevant requirements, specifications and other documentation to clarify and understand expectations. 
 - Writes and updates documentation as needed for information sharing as well as regulatory purposes
 - Participates in maintaining the agile team's work backlog, helps plan and prioritize work
 - Joins the agile team's ceremonies and presents work as needed (daily, sprint planning, sprint review, demo)
 - Presents and shares technical findings and developments with stakeholders. 
 - Raises possible improvement opportunities or concerns for discussion with stakeholders. 

Desired Skills And Experience

- 8+ Years of Hands-on experience of professional software engineering in at least one of the following: DevOps or CICD engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience with each of the following: 
 - Virtualization (e. g. VMware, Nutanix, Azure)
 - Containerization (e. g. , Docker)
 - Container orchestration (e. g. , Kubernetes, RKE2, or similar)
 - CICD, scripting, and deployment automation (e. g. , Ansible, PowerShell)
 - Strong personal work management skills, with reliable delivery and ownership to drive agreed work items to completion in planned timeframe
 - Proactiveness and prioritization as necessary to manage addressing possible business critical problems in team's responsibility areas
 - Strong quality mindset, ensuring high stakeholder satisfaction and minimizing downtime (e. g. , if business critical pipelines are broken) and escalating problems as needed. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, to ensure seamless communication with stakeholders and to produce technical documentation of solutions

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience of Windows Server, including Active Directory and Group Policy
