 - Follow responsible-AI practice without exception. 
 - Windows and application support

 - Support IIS - application pool management, bindings, virtual directories, logs and basic performance troubleshooting. 
 - Perform SSL/TLS certificate tasks: renewal, installation, binding, store management and expiry monitoring.

 - Process and collaboration
 - Work within ITIL incident, problem and change management using ServiceNow; raise and document change requests accurately and complete them within approved windows. 
 - Maintain and improve runbooks, SOPs and knowledge articles - especially after resolving something the documentation didn't cover.

Communication

 - Reliable, organised, and comfortable asking for help early rather than late. 

Technical

- Azure PaaS and IaaS administration, Windows Server administration, IIS administration and SSL certificate handling.

About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Position Summary: 

- Kaseya is looking for a Platform Backend Engineer to build and operate the core platform services powering Fleet, connecting the execution runtime, identity layer, event routing, secret management, and audit infrastructure. This role focuses on high-reliability backend and platform engineering, where correctness, security, scalability, and operational clarity are critical. 
 - Build and operate the platform services that underpin Fleet: API gateway, Kafka-based event routing (PSA webhooks and RMM alerts → Temporal workflow triggers), Zitadel integration for machine identity and capability grant management, and ClickHouse-backed immutable audit ledger writes
 - Implement the Secret Management and KMS abstraction layer: pluggable KEK backends (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP Cloud KMS, BYOK), envelope encryption via AWS Encryption SDK, per-client cryptographic isolation
 - Build the capability grant enforcement pipeline: per-workflow, per-client, per-operation grants issued by Zitadel and validated by the sidecar Identity and Capability Engine on every inbound request
 - Own the GitOps-based automation catalog deployment pipeline: workflow definitions versioned in Git, deployed to per-client Temporal namespaces via CI/CD
 - Build operational tooling for MSP onboarding: Zitadel org provisioning, compliance tier configuration per client org, and per-client KMS setup
 - Contribute to the Safe Connector Layer: vendor API wrapper services (ConnectWise, NinjaOne, M365/CIPP, Datto, IT Glue, CrowdStrike, Huntress) that enforce scope, inject platform-managed credentials, and log every call before execution. 

Required Qualification: 

- Strong backend engineering in Go or Rust; we are moving away from Java-heavy backgrounds for new platform work
 - Experience building event-driven systems: Kafka, event sourcing patterns, at-least-once delivery guarantees
 - Familiarity with Temporal or another durable workflow engine
 - Experience with identity and access management systems: OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, token lifecycle management, fine-grained authorization models
 - Solid understanding of encryption patterns: envelope encryption, key hierarchy design, KMS integrations
 - Comfort operating in multi-tenant, regulated environments where correctness and audit evidence are non-negotiable
 - Strong observability instincts: structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics : you instrument what you build

Preferred Qualification: 

- Experience with Zitadel, Keycloak, or similar identity providers
 - ClickHouse or other columnar/append-only store experience
 - Prior work in MSP tooling, PSA/RMM API integrations, or compliance-adjacent infrastructure (CMMC, HIPAA, SOC 2)

Additional Information

As a Senior Java Developer, you will work on and deliver high-quality applications that meet user needs and business goals. You will be responsible for designing, coding, testing, and maintaining web software using modern technologies and best practices.   

Roles and Responsibilities: 
 - Design and develop high-quality Java applications using modern engineering practices with Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Design and implement scalable microservices and secure REST APIs for customers to send data and retrieve tracking details and reports. 
 - Develop event-driven services and integrations using Apache Kafka for efficient follow-up on shipments, invoices, customs documents, and other data. 
 - Develop and maintain connections with external providers such as logistics companies, customs authorities, middleware solutions, and partner organisations. 
 - Design and optimise PostgreSQL database schemas and queries, including performance tuning. 
 - Deploy and maintain applications on AWS, including containerised deployments using Docker and infrastructure managed via Terraform. 
 - Write clean, efficient, well-documented code adhering to best practices and design patterns. 
 - Participate in architecture discussions and technical design reviews, exercising independent judgment on design and abstraction. 
 - Collaborate with Product Leads, Architects, and DevOps engineers to refine technical solutions and estimate development work. 
 - Mentor and guide junior developers on technical and professional best practices. 
 - Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and troubleshoot and debug complex technical issues. 
 - Collaborate effectively with other developers, testers, product owners, and stakeholders. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , OpenAI Codex, Claude Code) to improve productivity while maintaining engineering quality and depth. Key Requirements: 
 - 6+ years of professional experience as a Software Developer with Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Experience with Spring Data JPA / Hibernate. 
 - Experience with Apache Kafka and event-driven/asynchronous microservices. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL (including AWS RDS PostgreSQL), SQL performance tuning, database design, and normalisation. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS for application deployment, including ECS/ECR, S3, API Gateway, and CloudFront. 
 - Experience with Maven for build/dependency management. 
 - Working knowledge of Git and JIRA in an Agile/Scrum environment.   
 - Experience developing and integrating with third-party APIs (both consuming and creating APIs). 
 - Familiarity with common integration patterns (e. g. , REST, message queues). 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns (e. g. , SOLID principles, hexagonal architecture). 
 - Excellent software design skills with strong abstraction and modelling capability, and the ability to make independent architectural decisions. 
 - Experience already using modern AI development tools (e. g. OpenAI Codex, Claude Code) as part of daily workflow, with genuine depth on configuration, evaluation, and effective use (e. g. , memory/context management, token usage, multi-agent setups) - not just prompt-level usage. 
 - Prior experience with enterprise-scale systems and AWS infrastructure is a major plus. 
 - Having an AWS certification is a plus.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them. 

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself. 

Senior Software Engineer, Salesforce

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll play a pivotal role in designing, building, and delivering innovative technology solutions that fuel Empower's mission to help millions of customers achieve financial freedom. You'll develop high-quality software that adheres to modern design patterns and architectural principles-balancing technical excellence with practical delivery. 

This role combines hands-on engineering with leadership and mentorship responsibilities, helping shape both our systems and our people. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, test, and support scalable, resilient software aligned with Empower's business and architectural strategies. 
 - Develop and enhance complex applications, introducing new features and improving existing systems for performance, scalability, security, and maintainability. 
 - Partner with other developers and architects to evolve our codebase, tools, and development processes. 
 - Provide expert technical support and guidance to end users and internal partners. 
 - Contribute to and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines, improving delivery efficiency and reliability. 
 - Write automated and unit/functional tests and follow modern engineering practices to ensure code quality and maintain high test coverage. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues with speed and precision. 
 - Apply Empower's security controls and disaster recovery principles in all design and implementation efforts. 
 - Drive application resiliency through thoughtful design and robust engineering. 
 - Create prototypes and proof-of-concepts that inspire innovation and shape future technical direction. 
 - Design pragmatic, scalable solutions with clear trade-offs and articulate them effectively to stakeholders. 
 - Produce clear, detailed design documentation to support implementation and estimation. 
 - Contribute to long-term architectural vision emphasizing simplicity, scalability, and maintainability. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional, geographically distributed teams to deliver customer value. 
 - Model and promote best practices across coding standards, architecture, and process - coaching and mentoring peers and junior engineers. 
 - Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies. 
 - Support Lead Developers in oversight, training, and technical guidance of the team. 
 - Perform other duties as needed. 

What You'll Bring

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - 2+ years or professional experience developing solutions in Salesforce Sales, Service, or Industry Clouds (e. g. , Financial Services, Health, Manufacturing). 
 - Strong grasp of object-oriented programming principles and experience with at least one OOP language (Java, Python, etc. ). 
 - Proficiency in working with JSON and XML. 
 - Familiarity with Agile methodologies and iterative delivery. 
 - Continuous learning mindset with a passion for staying current with emerging technologies. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills - able to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. 
 - Experience deploying updates, diagnosing production issues, and implementing integrations that meet customer needs. 

What Will Set You Apart

- 2+ years of Salesforce Omnistudio or Financial Services Cloud experience. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on OOP development experience with modern frameworks and tools. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (preferred). 
 - Experience with or interest in OmniStudio, Copado, and Financial Services Cloud. 
 - Practical experience designing and building scalable solutions for complex enterprise systems and business challenges. 
 - Strong knowledge of modern integration methods.

data.title: Software Engineer II
data.description:
Overview

Are you excited to build reliable, AI-powered experiences that help commercial sellers spend less time navigating systems and more time serving customers? Join us to turn seller needs into practical, secure software used across Microsoft's sales workflows. 

The Commercial Sales Experiences (CSX) Engineering team transforms Microsoft's commercial sales organization through AI-powered experiences that help sellers drive growth and deliver better customer outcomes. We build intelligent platforms and modern applications that bring useful information and actions into the flow of selling. 

As a Software Engineer II, you will build and improve features for commercial seller experiences. You will implement and test code, participate in feature design, collaborate with engineers and product partners, and use customer feedback and service data to improve the software. You will work with AI-powered experiences, Dynamics 365 integrations, web applications, and Azure services while growing your skills in secure, reliable systems. 

This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful product features, learn from experienced engineers, and see the impact of your work in sellers' daily workflows. 

The Commercial Sales Experiences Engineering team builds the platforms, applications, and AI-powered experiences that enable Microsoft's commercial sellers to operate more effectively, make better decisions, and deliver greater value to customers. Through modern engineering practices and intelligent technology solutions, the team drives digital transformation across Microsoft Sales. 

Responsibilities

- Implement, test, and maintain code for product features and services, reusing existing components and patterns where appropriate. 
 - Explore design options for assigned features, identify strengths and trade-offs, and provide feedback on proposed technical approaches. 
 - Work with engineers, architects, and product partners to build or modify features; contribute to design documents, user stories, and product requirements with guidance. 
 - Develop and improve seller-facing experiences, APIs, and integrations across AI-powered workflows, Dynamics 365, and Azure services as needed for the team's priorities. 
 - Write automated tests, investigate defects, and use code reviews and service data to improve quality, accessibility, security, and performance. 
 - Contribute to live-site support by monitoring features, helping investigate incidents, and implementing fixes or follow-up improvements with the team. 
 - Engage with product partners and, where appropriate, customers to understand scenarios and feedback; share findings that help refine features and priorities. 
 - Contribute reusable components and development practices that make the team's work more consistent and efficient. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field and 5+ years of technical engineering experience coding in languages such as C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python; or equivalent experience. 
 - Experience designing, developing, testing, and shipping software features or services in a team environment. 
 - Proficiency in at least one programming language and the ability to learn and work across a modern application stack. 
 - Experience building web applications, backend services, or distributed systems. 
 - Experience working with APIs, data stores, and cloud services. 
 - Working knowledge of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, debugging, automated testing, source control, performance, and secure coding. 
 - Ability to collaborate across disciplines, communicate design choices, and deliver work iteratively. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience taking ownership of a feature area, from technical design through production rollout and follow-up improvements. 
 - Experience building AI-powered applications, Copilot experiences, intelligent agents, or conversational workflows. 
 - Familiarity with Dynamics 365, Dataverse, Power Platform, or similar business application platforms. 
 - Experience developing services with C#, . NET, ASP. NET Core, or a comparable backend stack. 
 - Experience building modern user interfaces with React and TypeScript. 
 - Experience with Azure application hosting, serverless or messaging services, containers, or other cloud services. 
 - Experience working with relational or NoSQL data stores and data integration patterns. 
 - Understanding of identity, authentication, authorization, privacy, and secure software development. 
 - Experience improving developer workflows through reusable components, automation, or platform tooling. 
 - Ability to compare design options, explain trade-offs, and work through cross-team dependencies. 
 - Clear communication and effective collaboration with engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools responsibly and validating their output.

Education & Experience

 - Analyze design inputs, converting them into software design and implementation.

What We Stand For

This is a dual-mandate leadership role at one of Quest Software's most strategic engineering locations. You will have full engineering leadership responsibility for a product within Quest's data management portfolio while serving as Site Leader for our Hyderabad development center of approximately 150 employees.

What Success Looks Li Ke

Company Description Inorbii is building orbital data center infrastructure, creating a new compute tier engineered to operate above Earth's atmosphere. The company focuses on workloads such as frontier AI training, batch inference, scientific simulation, and archival compute that benefit from near-continuous solar power, radiative cooling, and zero terrestrial footprint. Its modular payload integrates solar generation, compute, and radiative cooling into a single, serviceable platform deployed in low-Earth orbit and operated from the ground. Inorbii emphasizes engineering realism, explicitly addressing launch economics, radiation, in-orbit servicing, latency, and debris through modularity, graceful degradation, and radiation-hardened design. The roadmap spans foundational subsystem and mission engineering, an on-orbit demonstrator, and scaling to a production orbital compute fleet with deep collaboration across aerospace, HPC, and infrastructure partners.

This full-time, on-site role in Bengaluru involves owning system architecture for integrated payloads, defining interfaces between solar generation, compute, thermal management, and communications subsystems, and guiding hardware and firmware design decisions. You will oversee engineering teams across aerospace, mechanical, electrical, and embedded domains; review detailed designs, simulations, and test plans; and ensure that reliability, safety, and mission-critical performance requirements are met. Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating with launch and satellite partners, managing technology roadmaps from subsystem prototypes to orbital demonstrators, and building processes for design validation, environmental testing, and in-orbit operations. data.title: Embedded Software Architect
data.description:
Job Title

Embedded Software Architect

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Embedded Software Architect to own the technical architecture for regulated medical device software across the Sleep & Respiratory Care portfolio. This role sits at the center of our engineering organization - defining architecture and design for therapy devices, ventilators and connected-care platforms, and ensuring that what we build is safe, secure, compliant and sustainable. 

You will operate as a hands-on technical authority: making design decisions, resolving complex technical risks, mentoring engineers, and representing software architecture in cross-functional and regulatory forums. This is a role for someone who wants deep technical ownership of products that directly improve patients' ability to breathe and sleep. 

Your Role

Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in C++(preferred) / C / Embedded C; strong grasp of real-time and resource-constrained design. 
 - RTOS concepts, scheduling, concurrency, task frameworks, memory and power optimisation. 
 - Microcontroller/SoC platforms (e. g. ARM Cortex-M / STM32 class), board bring-up and hardware-software integration. 
 - Communication protocols and connectivity - BLE/Bluetooth, cellular/modem, UART/SPI/I2C, and secure firmware update mechanisms. 
 - Software architecture practice - modelling, design patterns, interface design, modularity and platform thinking. 
 - Verification fundamentals: unit verification, static analysis, code coverage, test automation and CI/CD (ADO / GitHub). 
 - Cybersecurity for embedded/connected devices: threat modelling, cryptography fundamentals, secure boot and signed updates. 

Architecture & Technical Design

- Define, document and govern the software architecture for assigned products and platforms, including decomposition, interfaces, data flows and deployment topology. 
 - Produce and maintain architecture artefacts - SAD, SDD, interface specifications and design rationale - to regulated standards. 
 - Drive architectural decisions on real-time behaviour, memory and power constraints, connectivity (BLE/cellular/modem), and hardware-software integration. 
 - Lead design reviews, technical risk assessments and trade-off analyses; ensure decisions are recorded with clear rationale. 
 - Evaluate and drive modernisation, refactoring and reuse across platforms to reduce duplication and improve maintainability. 

Regulated Product Development & Quality

- Ensure architecture and design comply with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971 (risk management) and applicable EU MDR / FDA requirements. 
 - Own end-to-end requirement-to-test traceability for assigned areas, ensuring design elements trace to requirements and verification evidence. 
 - Contribute to software safety classification, hazard analysis, FMEA and risk-control design. 
 - Support CAPA, CAP and DCR activities with root-cause analysis, impact assessment and design remediation. 
 - Ensure adherence to internal QMS processes and design-history-file completeness. 

Security & Secure SDLC

- Embed secure-by-design principles into architecture; support threat modelling and security risk assessment. 
 - Own architecture-level inputs to SBOM, SOUP/OTS assessment, VAR and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Champion secure SDLC adoption within the engineering teams. 

Execution & Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner with Engineering Managers on technical feasibility, effort estimation, sequencing and resource planning. 
 - Represent software architecture with cross-functional partners - Systems, Quality, Regulatory, Product, PMO, Security, Operations and Manufacturing. 
 - Surface technical risks, dependencies and decision points early, with proposed solutions rather than escalations alone. 
 - Provide technical input into release planning, Release Train cadence and sprint execution within an Agile/ADO way of working. 

Capability Building & Technical Leadership

- Mentor and coach engineers; act as buddy/mentor within the competency ramp-up framework and support progression toward independent (L2) execution. 
 - Lead knowledge-transfer for products transitioning ownership into the India organisation. 
 - Drive engineering excellence: code quality, design standards, review discipline, static analysis and unit-verification rigour. 
 - Champion AI-assisted engineering (e. g. GitHub Copilot across the V-model) to improve productivity without compromising quality or compliance. 
 - Contribute to knowledge-sharing sessions, technical forums and reusable engineering assets. 

You're The Right Fit If

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. 
 - 10+ years in embedded software development, with a minimum of 5 years in an architect or lead-architect capacity. 
 - Proven track record architecting embedded products in a regulated domain - medical devices strongly preferred (aerospace, automotive safety or industrial safety-critical also considered). 
 - Demonstrated ownership of a product or platform architecture through full lifecycle, from concept to release and sustaining. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication; can explain complex trade-offs to non-software audiences. 
 - Strong technical influence without authority - able to align cross-functional stakeholders on architecture decisions. 

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. This is an office-based role, which means working in person at least 3 days per week. 

About Philips

Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose. 

If you're interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care. 

#ConnectedCare

data.title: Computer Aided Design Engineer
data.description:
1. Role Purpose

The Manager - CAM owns the complete CAM function: converting approved CAD designs into accurate, machine-ready output (3D-printed resin/wax patterns) on time, at the right quality and at the lowest sustainable cost. The role is accountable for department-level delivery to production, machine capacity and utilisation, CAM-related quality, tooling and consumables cost, process standardisation and building a capable, multi-skilled team. 

2. Key Responsibilities

2. 1 Department Leadership & Capacity Planning

- Lead the CAM department and set daily, weekly and monthly output plans aligned to the PPC and order-delivery schedule. 
 - Plan machine and manpower capacity; flag capacity gaps early and propose shift, outsourcing or investment options. 
 - Allocate jobs across programmers and machines based on complexity, priority and skill; own the department's job-priority board. 
 - Establish clear information flow with CAD, PPC and production so that every job has a committed date, status and owner at all times. 2. 2 Delivery & Production Support

- Own on-time delivery of CAM output to casting and production; track WIP and ageing jobs daily. 
 - Define and enforce turnaround-time (TAT) standards by job category (standard, complex, urgent, sample). 
 - Handle escalations and critical / priority orders; resolve bottlenecks within defined response times. 
 - Conduct daily production review with the team and a weekly performance review with the Production Head. 2. 3 Quality & Accuracy

- Own first-time-right performance and CAM-attributable rejection and rework. 
 - Establish design-for-manufacturability (DFM) checks at the CAD → CAM handover to catch issues before programming. 
 - Ensure weight and dimensional conformance of models against design; work with QC and Casting on root-cause analysis (RCA) and CAPA. 
 - Build first-piece approval and in-process checks for new and complex designs. 2. 4 Machine, Technology & Asset Management

- Maximise utilisation of CNC machines and 3D printers; monitor downtime, failed prints and machine-wise productivity. 
 - Drive preventive maintenance and calibration with the Maintenance team; minimise unplanned breakdowns. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new CAM software modules, machines, resins, cutters and automation; prepare cost-benefit justification for capex. 
 - Ensure licences, software updates and post-processors are current and controlled. 2. 5 Tooling, Consumables & Cost Control

- Prepare and manage the department budget for tooling, resin, wax and consumables; track cost per unit of output. 
 - Standardise parameters, tool libraries and print settings to improve tool life and reduce wastage. 
 - Coordinate with Purchase on vendor evaluation, pricing and lead times for critical consumables. 2. 6 Process Standardisation & New Product Development

- Create and maintain SOPs, standard machining strategies and template programs for recurring design families. 
 - Lead CAM input for NPD, samples and customer approvals; commit and deliver realistic timelines. 
 - Run a structured improvement programme (Kaizen, RCA, cycle-time studies) with measurable savings. 2. 7 People Management

- Recruit, onboard, train and appraise team members; maintain a skill matrix and succession cover for every critical machine and software. 
 - Set individual KPIs for team members that cascade from the department scorecard in this JD. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, safety, discipline and continuous learning. 2. 8 Documentation, MIS & Compliance

- Maintain a controlled program library with version control, revision history and traceability to design and order numbers. 
 - Publish monthly department MIS: output, OTD, TAT, FTR, rejection, utilisation, cost and wastage. 
 - Ensure compliance with company SOPs, EHS norms, machine safety, and internal and external audit requirements; close audit findings within timelines. 3. Decision Authority

- Job allocation, sequencing and priority within the CAM department (in line with PPC commitments). 
 - Machining strategy, parameters, tool selection and program release approval. 
 - Recommend hiring, training, performance ratings and incentive payouts for team members. 
 - Recommend purchase of tooling and consumables within approved budget; recommend capex for approval. 4. Required Skills & Competencies

Technical

- Expert-level CAM programming & Strong working knowledge for jewellery: Chituboax, B9 Creater, OneSlicer, Wax Jet printer, Materialise Magics, 3D Sprint 2025, PowerMill, Mastercam, WorkNC, RhinoCAM or equivalent. 
 - Strong working knowledge of 3D printing (resin/wax) set-up, orientation, supports and print-failure analysis. 
 - Understanding of the full jewellery process chain: CAD, CAM, casting, stone setting, finishing, polishing, and how CAM decisions affect metal weight and downstream yield. 
 - Tooling, cutting parameters, tolerances, surface finish and precious-metal machining. Managerial

- Capacity planning, scheduling and production control; comfort with ERP / MES data and Excel-based MIS. 
 - Problem solving using RCA, 5-Why, Pareto and CAPA. 
 - Team leadership, coaching, conflict resolution and cross-functional coordination. 
 - Cost awareness, budgeting and data-driven decision making. 5. Educational Qualification

- Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - Certification in CAD/CAM/CNC programming preferred; Lean / Six Sigma exposure an advantage. 6. Preferred Background

Gold / precious-metal jewellery manufacturing (strongly preferred), CNC jewellery manufacturing, precision engineering, tool & die, or high-precision CNC machining, with demonstrated team leadership.

To lead the Quality Control function for the Drymix business and ensure consistent, reliable and compliant quality across raw materials, production processes and finished products. 

The role will be responsible for establishing robust quality systems, strengthening laboratory and testing capabilities, reducing quality deviations and customer complaints, driving CAPA and continuous improvement, and building a strong quality culture across manufacturing operations. 

The incumbent will act as the key quality interface between R&D, Production, Procurement, Technical Services, Sales and Management. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1. Quality Control Leadership
 - Lead end-to-end QC activities for the Drymix product portfolio. 
 - Establish and maintain quality standards, specifications, inspection plans and testing protocols. 
 - Ensure effective control of incoming raw materials, in-process materials and finished products. 
 - Ensure batch-wise quality clearance and release as per approved specifications. 
 - Monitor quality trends and proactively identify potential quality risks. 2. Drymix Product QualityEnsure consistent quality and performance of products including: 

- Tile Adhesives
 - Block Jointing Mortars
 - Wall Putty
 - Plasters
 - Grouts
 - Repair Mortars
 - Flooring Products
 - Cementitious Waterproofing
 - Other Drymix Construction Chemical ProductsMonitor critical parameters such as consistency, workability, density, moisture, setting time, water retention, adhesion strength, open time, slip, compressive/flexural strength and other product-specific performance parameters. 

3. Raw Material Quality Management
 - Establish specifications for cement, sand, fillers, polymers, additives, pigments and other critical raw materials. 
 - Develop supplier quality parameters and incoming inspection standards. 
 - Review supplier COAs and test results. 
 - Drive alternate raw-material evaluation in coordination with R&D and Procurement. 
 - Establish supplier quality improvement and rejection-reduction initiatives. 4. Process Quality & Manufacturing Excellence
 - Establish effective in-process quality controls at every critical stage of manufacturing. 
 - Ensure adherence to approved formulations, SOPs and process parameters. 
 - Identify process variation and implement corrective measures. 
 - Work closely with Production to reduce batch rejection, rework and process deviations. 
 - Drive process capability and quality consistency across batches. 5. Quality Systems & Compliance
 - Develop and implement SOPs, inspection plans, control plans and quality manuals. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable IS/BIS, ASTM, EN and ISO standards. 
 - Maintain proper documentation, traceability and quality records. 
 - Lead internal quality audits and support external/customer audits. 
 - Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment. 
 - Strengthen laboratory safety, housekeeping and testing discipline. 6. Customer Complaint & CAPA Management
 - Lead investigation of product-quality complaints.

data.title: Software Quality Assurance / Testing Engineer ServiceNow
data.description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion - it's a place where you can grow, belong and thrive. 

Role Overview

The ServiceNow QA Engineer is a hands-on technical testing role within the NTT DATA ServiceNow Practice, responsible for executing test activities across the full development lifecycle. Working closely with the QA Manager, Business Analysts, and development team, the QA Engineer ensures that all developed functionality is tested thoroughly, accurately, and in line with the quality standards set by the QA Manager and Practice. 

The QA Engineer is an executor - their primary focus is on building and running test cases, contributing to the automated test framework, and providing timely, accurate feedback on quality across sprints and releases. They will cover development from the Practice, ATS, and automations teams, operating as part of the shared QA function. 

Key Responsibilities

- Execute functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing across all ServiceNow development in line with the test plans defined by the QA Manager. 
 - Write clear, well-structured test cases and test scripts based on user stories and acceptance criteria provided by the Business Analyst. 
 - Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test scripts within the ServiceNow ATF (Automated Test Framework), expanding coverage across product domains. 
 - Execute regression testing ahead of each release and platform upgrade, using the automated test suite to validate platform stability. 
 - Log, track, and retest defects accurately and in a timely manner, ensuring developers receive clear, reproducible defect reports. 
 - Support UAT coordination activities - setting up test environments, providing test data, and assisting business stakeholders through test execution. 
 - Maintain test cases and test scripts in the shared test repository, keeping them up to date as platform changes are made. 
 - Contribute to quality reporting by providing accurate test execution status, pass/fail rates, and defect metrics to the QA Manager. 
 - Participate in sprint ceremonies - including backlog grooming and sprint reviews - to ensure testability is considered from story creation through to delivery. 

Essential Experience & Skills

- Proven experience in a QA Engineer or software testing role within a ServiceNow or enterprise platform delivery environment. 
 - Practical experience using ServiceNow ATF (Automated Test Framework) to build and execute automated test scripts. 
 - Strong skills in writing test cases and test scripts from user stories and acceptance criteria. 
 - Experience executing functional, regression, and integration testing within an agile delivery environment. 
 - Ability to write clear, reproducible defect reports and manage defects through to resolution. 
 - Comfortable working across multiple product domains, picking up context quickly and adapting testing approaches accordingly. 

Desirable

- Experience with platform upgrade testing in ServiceNow, including regression test execution during upgrade cycles. 
 - Familiarity with ISTQB Foundation or equivalent testing qualification. 
 - Exposure to broader test automation tools or scripting in addition to ServiceNow ATF. 
 - ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or equivalent product knowledge. 
 - Experience supporting UAT with business stakeholders, including test environment setup and guidance through test execution. 

Behaviours & Competencies

data.title: QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Description

Purpose

Own automated test coverage across backend (API/service/DB layers) and frontend (UI/component/E2E layers), driving toward near-100% automation coverage and ensuring every regression is caught before it reaches production. 

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain a comprehensive automated test suite spanning backend (pytest API/service/contract tests for FastAPI endpoints) and frontend (Vitest/RTL component tests, Playwright/Cypress E2E for Carbon UI flows). 

Establish coverage tracking and gates in CI (GitLab CI), blocking merges that drop coverage below agreed thresholds. 

Design regression suites keyed to historical defects/incidents so every fixed bug gets a permanent automated guard. 

Automate cross-cutting scenarios: JWT access/refresh auth flows, role-based access (manager/admin), pagination/validation edge cases (422s), and DB integrity checks (is_current = true filters, multi-table transactions). 

Build data-driven and contract tests for API responses (success/error envelope, status codes) and schema validation (Pydantic). 

Automate frontend flows for Carbon components, React Query loading/error states, and AG-Grid interactions (pagination/infinite scroll), including accessibility checks. 

Integrate automated tests into GitLab CI pipelines with fast feedback (parallelization, flaky-test quarantine, retries with root-cause triage). 

Maintain synthetic/production-safe test data and fixtures; support performance/load test scripts (k6/Gatling) alongside functional automation. 

Triage automation failures rapidly to distinguish real regressions from flaky/environment issues; drive flaky rate to near zero. 

Partner with developers to shift-left testing (unit tests written alongside features) while owning the E2E/regression safety net. 

Must-Have Skills

Strong pytest skills for backend automation: API/integration tests against FastAPI + PostgreSQL (raw SQL), fixtures, mocking DB/AWS dependencies. 

Strong frontend automation: Vitest + React Testing Library for components, Playwright or Cypress for E2E across Carbon-based UI. 

CI/CD pipeline experience (GitLab CI) - wiring test stages, coverage gates, artifacts, parallel test execution. 

Contract/schema testing experience (Pydantic schemas, OpenAPI) and validation-rule coverage (422 paths). 

Auth-flow automation (JWT access/refresh, RBAC) and multi-tenant/cross-tenant data access test design. 

Ability to read production incident/defect history and reverse-engineer regression tests from it. 

Familiarity with performance/load testing tools (k6/Gatling) to complement functional automation. 

Strong ownership of "automation coverage" as a metric - proactive about closing gaps, not just maintaining existing suites. 

KPIs / Success Measures

Automated test coverage near 100% across both backend (endpoint/service/DB paths) and frontend (component/flow paths). 

100% of confirmed regressions get a corresponding automated test before the fix is merged. 

Escaped defect rate (bugs reaching production undetected by automation) trending to zero. 

Flaky test rate below an agreed threshold; CI automation stage stays green and fast. 

Common Requirements (emphasis for this role)

Emphasis: coverage completeness, regression-proofing, and CI-integrated automation across the full stack. 

Proficient, responsible use of GenAI test-generation assistants to expand coverage quickly, with human review for correctness and security. 

Quality and observability ownership - automation results feed directly into release-readiness decisions.

data.title: Lead Back End Engineer
data.description:
This is a leadership role in our engineering team - not just a cog in the wheel. 

This is not a "maintenance" role. This is engineering leadership-owning the backend architecture of a global, privacy-first communication platform. You'll lead by example, guide a high-calibre team, and ensure our backend systems remain blazing-fast, rock-solid, and uncompromising on security. You'll be at the intersection of code and leadership-mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and setting engineering standards that define how a global product is built. 

Who are we?

We are a young product company scaling fast and outgrowing the startup tag-with global scale in our crosshairs. We don't do "okay. " We give everything we've got to build the best communication platform in the world. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top institutions-people who care deeply about the craft, performance, and purpose. You'll learn more in 6 months here than most engineers do in 3 years elsewhere. We're intense. High-strung. Focused. Our team includes engineers from IIT and other top-tier

backgrounds. But what defines us is not our degrees-it's our refusal to compromise on quality, performance, or privacy. 

What are we building?

WrkTalk is the world's first zero-access, zero-spam enterprise communication product that operates on a structural privacy architecture. One that's already earned the trust of large enterprises like L&T Finance, Adani Group, and Kalyan Jewellers - just to name a few of our enterprise clients. This is not an MVP. This is production-grade software that secures communication for thousands-and soon, millions-of professionals worldwide. 

What's the role?

• Architect backend systems in NestJS and Golang to meet global scale and enterprise-grade performance. 

• Drive design for microservices, real-time comms (WebSockets, WebRTC), and data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Lead code reviews, enforce coding standards, and maintain CI/CD discipline. 

• Mentor and upskill backend engineers. 

• Collaborate cross-functionally with frontend, DevOps, and product leaders. 

• Own technical problem-solving-anticipate bottlenecks, make hard calls, and prevent tech debt from being parked for "later. "

• Manage task allocation, workflow discipline, and ensure smooth collaboration with frontend and DevOps. 

The tech here is serious. 

We work on socket-driven comms infrastructure, distributed control towers, multi-category encryption, root detection, app kill-switches, dynamic guest access, device-level lockout, and OOO/ DND logic layered with smart whitelisting. This is not lightweight app dev. This is protocol-layer decision-making. 

Who should apply?

• 6-8+ years in backend engineering, with at least 2 years in a leadership role. 

• Expertise in Golang and Node. js (NestJS). 

• Strong database tuning skills (PostgreSQL, Redis). 

• Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable deployment. 

• Experience building real-time systems at scale. 

• Proven ability to lead technical discussions and inspire engineering teams. 

• Track record of shipping production-grade, high-performance systems. 

Why should you join?

• Because you want to own backend architecture-not just follow it

• Because you'll work directly with established founders, not buried under layers

• Because you'll ship real, deeply engineered features used by large number of enterprise users

• Because you'll grow 10x faster here-in experience, learning, and impact

• And because if you walk this road with us for 3-4 years, it'll catapult you into a tech orbit or fame and glory you never imagined

Where are we located?

We're based in Navi Mumbai and building for the world.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Summary

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) brings together software and systems engineering to design and operate large-scale, highly distributed, and fault-tolerant systems. As a Site Reliability Engineer III, on the Platform team, you will play a key role in designing, building, and operating the foundational infrastructure that powers Guidewire's SaaS platform. You will focus on automation, reliability, scalability, and operability - ensuring our multi-tenant cloud platform consistently meets both functional and non-functional requirements. You will work closely with product development teams to influence system design, improve resilience, and ensure production readiness, while building the tools and frameworks that enable efficient, global, follow-the-sun operations. 

Job Description

What You'll Do

Drive Reliability, Automation & Scale: 

- Design, build, and operate highly reliable, scalable infrastructure for a multi-tenant SaaS platform. 
 - Automate deployment, provisioning, and operational workflows across cloud infrastructure and applications. 
 - Develop internal tools, services, and frameworks to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. 
 - Participate in a 24x7 follow-the-sun on-call rotation to support critical production systems. 

Improve Platform & Infrastructure: 

- Contribute to core platform systems by building features, resolving issues, and enhancing reliability. 
 - Partner with development teams to ensure systems meet availability, performance, and scalability requirements. 
 - Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and failure modes, and implement solutions before they impact customers. 

Observability, Incident Management & Resilience: 

- Build and maintain observability systems (metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards). 
 - Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and reliability metrics. 
 - Lead or contribute to incident response, root cause analysis, and blameless postmortems. 
 - Drive improvements toward self-healing systems and reduced operational toil. 

Security & Identity: 

- Design and support secure access patterns, including SSO, SAML, and OAuth-based authentication systems. 
 - Ensure platform services meet security and compliance standards. 

Enablement & Collaboration: 

- Collaborate across engineering teams, providing guidance, feedback, and hands-on contributions. 
 - Create and maintain documentation, runbooks, and training materials. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote best practices in reliability engineering and automation. 

Who You Are

Infrastructure Development: 

- 8-12 years of hands-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, or a related platform engineering role, with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating highly available, scalable, and reliable production systems. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python or Go (Java/Spring Boot is a plus). 
 - Deep experience with AWS and building/operating production systems at scale. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, Helm, CNI, and Ingress networking. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes primitives and patterns (deployments, services, operators, etc. ). 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt, or similar). 
 - Solid understanding of Linux systems and networking fundamentals. 

Observability & Operations: 

- Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or CloudWatch. 
 - Familiarity with incident management practices and production support in a microservices environment. 
 - Experience with messaging/streaming systems (e. g. , Kafka, SQS) and relational databases (e. g. , Aurora, RDS) is a plus. 

Security & Identity: 

- Working knowledge of SSO, SAML, OAuth, and identity providers (Okta is a plus). 
 - Experience with AWS IAM (roles, policies, IRSA), VPC security groups, and Kubernetes security primitives (RBAC, network policies, pod security standards, secrets management). 

DevOps & Delivery: 

- Experience with CI/CD and GitOps tools such as GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Jenkins, FluxCD, or Bitbucket. 
 - Comfortable working in agile environments (Scrum, Kanban). 

Mindset & Collaboration: 

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a proactive, systems-thinking mindset. 
 - Passion for automation: "If you have to do it more than once, automate it. "
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to work across distributed teams. 
 - A collaborative team player who can influence, mentor, and lead through technical expertise. 
 - Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and data-driven insights to improve productivity and outcomes. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
 - Experience supporting large-scale SaaS platforms
 - AWS or Kubernetes certifications
 - Exposure to modern platform frameworks such as KubeVela (OAM) or Crossplane
 - Contributions to open-source projects

Why Guidewire?

- Work on a mission-critical global platform used by leading P&C insurers worldwide
 - Solve complex, real-world infrastructure problems at genuine scale
 - Be part of a collaborative, high-impact engineering culture grounded in integrity, rationality, and collegiality
 - Opportunity to shape the future of a rapidly evolving cloud platform
 - A culture of curiosity and innovation where engineers are empowered to leverage AI and emerging technologies. 

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire. 

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation. 

For more information, please visit www. guidewire. com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC. 

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. data.title: Senior Backend Engineer - AI Platform
data.description:
See what we're building: www. cognis-ai. com (product) | www. scalifiai. com (parent company)

About Cognis Ai

Cognis is an AI workspace that puts 20+ frontier models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and more) into a single chat layer - with context that travels across model switches, true branching, chat-layer observability, and an adaptive UI that turns AI replies into working tools instead of walls of text. The platform is live in private beta and being rebuilt for public launch. Backend is Python/Django REST Framework. Built by Scalifi Ai, Gurugram. 

We are not competing with the model vendors. We bundle them and build the layers they don't ship: memory, observability, branching, and execution inside the tools work actually happens in. 

Work mode: In-office at our Gurugram office (Sector 65) - non-negotiable. Candidates should be in NCR or willing to relocate. 

Joining: Immediate to 30-day joiners strongly preferred. 

Why this role is different

You'll join the founding backend team, working directly with the founder (who built the current platform). This is not a maintain-the-legacy role and not a research role - it's an ownership role. The architecture decisions on our biggest roadmap features will be yours to make, defend, and ship. You'll also help interview and mentor our next backend hire. 

What you'll own

- Base tool layer: web search, image generation, video generation as first-class tools inside the agent loop - each with per-step observability
 - Files & media: file and image handling support across providers
 - Memory: our persistent, user-editable memory system - pinning, releasing, compaction, and per-item token accounting
 - RAG & knowledge bases: chunking, retrieval, reranking, and retrieval-quality evaluation, wired into the workspace
 - Execution environments (upcoming): code interpreters for context-efficient, parallel tool calls; sandboxed runtimes and a workspace filesystem for agent file operations
 - Product analytics: deep, Cognis-specific analytics (beyond our generic platform layer)
 - Platform growth work (shared, especially early on): adding new LLM providers and models - message serialization, streaming, tool-call handling - and new third-party integrations on our integrations layer, where OAuth, tool search, and execution are already built. You'll help turn these into runbooks our next hire executes. 

What you'll ship in your first 90 days

- One base tool end-to-end (e. g. , web search with full step-level observability)
 - One new LLM provider - normalized message formats, streaming, tool-call deltas
 - The first version of the memory/compaction architecture, co-designed with the founder

Must-haves

- 3-6 years of backend engineering with strong Python
 - 2+ years building LLM-powered features that real users used in production - not tutorials, not POCs
 - Hands-on with provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) - you can describe what a tool-call delta looks like in a raw streaming response
 - Agent orchestration in production: LangGraph/LangChain, or an equivalent system you built yourself on raw SDKs
 - Context management: message history design, summarization/compaction trade-offs, token economics, prompt caching
 - RAG beyond hello-world: chunking strategy, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and how you evaluated retrieval quality
 - Solid REST API design; streaming via SSE/WebSockets
 - Django/DRF preferred - deep FastAPI/Flask experience with willingness to work in DRF is fine

Strong pluses

- Multi-provider or model-router systems; provider failover
 - Tool-calling ecosystems and integration platforms (e. g. , MCP)
 - Sandboxed code execution - containers, microVMs, or code-interpreter style tooling
 - Vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone) and embedding pipelines
 - Eval tooling and LLM observability
 - Event/analytics pipelines
 - Early-stage startup experience or meaningful open-source work

Stack

Python | Django REST Framework | LangGraph + LangChain (agent orchestration) | PostgreSQL | Redis | WebSockets/SSE | OpenAI/Anthropic/Google SDKs | a unified third-party integrations layer - plus whatever you make the case for. 

What we offer

- Founding-team scope with direct, daily work alongside the founder - zero bureaucracy, weekly shipping
 - Your fingerprints on every major system of an AI product at exactly the moment the category is being defined
 - Competitive compensation, reviewed as the company grows

IMPORTANT - How to apply (read this or your application will not be shortlisted)

At the very top of your resume (or in your cover note / screening answer, if the platform has one), include 4-6 lines about ONE LLM feature you shipped to real users: what it was, the ugliest edge case you hit, and how you handled it. Add your GitHub/portfolio link if you have one. Applications without this will not be shortlisted. 

Keywords: LLM, GenAI, Generative AI, AI Agents, Agentic AI, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, OpenAI, Anthropic, Claude, Gemini, Python, Django, DRF, WebSockets, SSE, PostgreSQL, Redis, Vector Database, Prompt Caching, Code Interpreter, Sandboxing, MCP

data.title: Functional AI Tester
data.description:
We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer focused on testing Generative AI (GenAI) applications with a strong emphasis on Python-based test automation, GenAI evaluation, and ETL/data quality validation. You will design and execute end-to-end test strategies

that ensure our AI solutions are accurate, reliable, safe, and compliant. 

About the Role

You will be involved in QA for GenAI features including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), conversational AI and Agentic

evaluations. 

The role centers on: 

• Systematic GenAI evaluation (qualitative and quantitative metrics)

• ETL and data quality testing for the data flows that feed AI systems

• Python-driven automated testing

This position is hands-on and collaborative, partnering with AI engineers, data engineers, and product teams to define measurable acceptance criteria and ship high-quality AI features. 

Key Responsibilities

• Test strategy and planning

o Define risk-based test strategies and detailed test plans for GenAI features. 

o Establish clear acceptance criteria with stakeholders for functional, safety, and data quality aspects. 

• Python test automation

o Build and maintain automated test suites using Python (e. g. , PyTest, requests). 

o Implement reusable utilities for prompt/response validation, dataset management, and result scoring. 

o Create regression baselines and golden test sets to detect quality drift. 

• GenAI evaluation

o Develop evaluation harnesses covering factuality, coherence, helpfulness, safety, bias, and toxicity etc. 

o Design prompt suites, scenario-based tests, and golden datasets for reproducible measurements. 

o Implement guardrail tests including prompt-injection resilience, unsafe content detection, and PII redaction

checks. 

o Track quality metrics over time. 

• RAG and semantic retrieval testing

o Verify alignment between retrieved sources and generated answers. 

o Verify adversarial tests. 

o Measure retrieval relevance, precision/recall, grounding quality, and hallucination reduction. 

• API and application testing

o Test REST endpoints supporting GenAI features (request/response contracts, error handling, timeouts). 

• ETL and data quality validation

o Test ingestion and transformation logic; validate schema, constraints, and field-level rules. 

o Implement data profiling, reconciliation between sources and targets, and lineage checks. 

o Verify data privacy controls, masking, and retention policies across pipelines. 

• Non-functional testing

o Performance and load testing focused on latency, throughput, concurrency, and rate limits for LLM calls. 

o Cost-aware testing (token usage, caching effectiveness) and timeout/retry behavior validation. 

o Reliability and resilience checks including error recovery and fallback behavior. 

• Share results and insights; recommend remediation and preventive actions. 

Required Qualifications

Experience

o 5+ years in software QA, including test strategy, automation, and defect management. 

o 2+ years testing AI/ML or GenAI features, with hands-on evaluation design. 

o 4+ years testing ETL/data pipelines and data quality. 

Technical skills

o Python: Strong proficiency building automated tests and tooling (PyTest, requests, pydantic or similar). 

o API testing: REST contract testing, schema validation, negative testing. 

o GenAI evaluation: crafting prompt suites, golden datasets, rubric-based scoring, and automated evaluation

pipelines. 

o RAG testing: retrieval relevance, grounding validation, chunking/indexing verification, and embedding checks. 

o ETL/data quality: schema and constraint validation, reconciliation, lineage awareness, data profiling. 

• Quality and governance

o Understanding of LLM limitations and methods to detect/reduce hallucinations. 

o Safety and compliance testing including PII handling and prompt-injection resilience. 

o Strong analytical and debugging skills across services and data flows. 

Soft skills

o Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to translate quality goals into measurable criteria. 

o Collaboration with AI engineers, data engineers, and product stakeholders. 

o Organized, detail-oriented, and outcomes-focused. 

Nice to Have

• Experience with evaluation frameworks or tooling for LLMs and RAG quality measurement. 

• Experience creating synthetic datasets to stress specific behaviors

data.title: Senior RF System Engineering Expert
data.description:
Job Description

Serve as the technical focal point for advanced RF and physical layer (PHY) modem systems, driving the definition, analysis, and hands-on performance verification of next-generation wireless architectures. In this role, you bridge baseband signal processing and analog RF hardware, taking architectural and technical ownership of link performance, system behavior, and end-to-end functionality. 

Job Requirements

Must Have

- Experience: 12+ years of hands-on engineering experience in RF and physical layer (PHY) system design, analysis, or performance engineering for wireless communications. 
 - System & Performance Scope: Proven track record defining and executing system evaluations associated with RF, baseband, PHY, and modem performance. 
 - Programming & Data Analysis: Advanced proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for algorithm validation, data analysis, instrument automation, and custom test script development. 
 - RF Test & Measurement Expertise: Deep practical knowledge in operating high-frequency RF test equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, power meters, and vector network analyzers (VNAs). 
 - System Debugging Intuition: Exceptional deep-dive debugging skills capable of isolating issues across the boundaries of RF, digital hardware, and physical layer software. 
 - RF Principles: Solid understanding of RF chains and parameters, including Noise Figure (NF), third-order intercept point (IP3), return loss (RL), and receiver architectures (Superheterodyne / Zero-IF). 
 - Communication & Documentation: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with a proven ability to author technical system documents and specifications. 

Nice to have

- Digital Communications & Impairments: Practical knowledge of I/Q modulation (QAM, PSK), Digital Predistortion (DPD), Automatic Gain Control (AGC), and Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) characterization. 
 - Cross-Functional Interface: Experience acting as a technical bridge or focal point communicating directly with RFIC design, algorithm, software, and firmware teams. 
 - Engineering Mindset: Strong pragmatic problem-solving skills, broad system-level perspective, and a collaborative approach in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

data.title: QA Tester (Quality Assurance Software Tester)
data.description:
About The Role: 

At Brightrays, as a QA Software Tester, you will test the real web tools and dashboards that power our marketing operations. Many of these tools are built quickly with AI-assisted coding, which can leave hidden gaps: missing validations, broken edge cases, weak access control and flows that only work on the happy path. Your main job is to find those gaps before our users do. You will test complete user flows end to end, think like a real (and sometimes careless or malicious) user, and help turn the most important checks into automated tests that keep protecting us after every release. 

Position Details: 

- Role: QA Software Tester
 - Location: Sector 16 , Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 - Work Model: Onsite, Monday-Friday, 9: 00 AM-5: 00 PM
 - Compensation: ₹3-5LPA (based on experience and portfolio)  
 - Dress Code: Smart Casuals / Semi-Formals

Job Description: 

- Walk through complete user journeys (e. g. sign-up → login → create → save → export → logout) across user roles, browsers and devices, checking every handoff between screens, APIs and data. 
 - Review tickets, specs and designs before development starts to flag unclear, missing or conflicting requirements early. 
 - Write test cases and checklists covering positive, negative, boundary and edge scenarios (empty fields, wrong formats, double clicks, slow networks, expired sessions). 
 - Perform functional, smoke, regression, UI and cross-browser testing on web apps and dashboards before each release. 
 - Convert stable, high-value flows into automated tests with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, and keep them updated as the product changes. 
 - Use Postman to check responses, status codes and error handling, including invalid inputs, missing fields and unauthorised requests. 
 - Test logins, sessions and role-based access (e. g. can a user see someone else's data by changing a URL or ID?) and watch for exposed secrets and basic injection risks. 
 - Test marketing tracking (GTM, pixels, analytics, conversion events) and verify that dashboard numbers match the source data, so clients and teams can trust our reporting. 
 - Use Lighthouse or PageSpeed to flag slow pages and heavy assets that hurt user experience and SEO. 
 -   Log clear, reproducible bugs with steps, screenshots or recordings and severity, retest fixes, give a go/no-go before releases and work closely with developers and the teams who use the tools. 

What We're looking For: 

- Degree in B. Tech, CS, IT or a related field, with minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in software/web application testing and QA. 
 - Manual testing (functional, regression, smoke, cross-browser) and test design techniques such as boundary values, equivalence partitioning and negative testing. 
 - Understanding of how automated UI tests work (locators, assertions, waits) and hands-on experience writing and maintaining tests with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium. 
 - Familiarity with JavaScript, Python and Java. 
 - HTML, CSS, APIs and browser DevTools (Console, Network tab). 
 - Basic understanding of common web risks (OWASP Top 10). 
 - Postman for APIs; Git/GitHub for version control. 
 - Clear written English for bug reports and test cases. 

Preferred Qualification: 

- Basic SQL to check data in a database. 
 - Exposure to running automated tests in a CI pipeline (e. g. GitHub Actions). 
 - Experience with Jira, ClickUp or Trello. 
 - Awareness of where AI-generated code can quietly fail. 
 - Experience testing marketing or analytics tools (GA4, GTM, SEO or CRM dashboards). 
 - ISTQB Foundation certification, or testing / automation projects on GitHub or in a portfolio. 

What will you gain?

- Learn from experienced QA and automation engineers. 
 - Work on real products used by internal teams and the public: Content, SEO, Sales, Publishing and Analytics tools. 
 - A clear path to grow into test automation, security testing and Senior QA roles. 

Interested candidates can share their CV on hiring@brightrays. com

Job Description

Job Summary

Omnissa helps organisations deliver and manage secure digital workspaces. Horizon is our virtual desktop and application platform; our Digital Employee Experience (DEX) products give IT and employees visibility into the quality of that experience and provides monitoring and analytics across that stack. 

We are looking for a skilled Automation Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience to own interoperability testing between DEX and Horizon along with second & third-party integrations. You will design and automate tests that span these products, catch integration issues before they reach customers, and keep that coverage current as Horizon, DEX, and Monitoring solutions evolve. 

This is a hands-on role. You will play a key role in developing scalable and efficient automation frameworks, driving automation strategy, and collaborating with developers and product teams working across. You will write Python test automation, own GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines, and partner with development teams across Horizon, DEX and other second and third-party integrations. As part of a modern engineering workflow, you will use AI-assisted tools to improve productivity in test development and debugging, while maintaining high standards for reliability, determinism, and long-term maintainability. 

Core Responsibilities

- Define and drive the automation testing approach for Horizon and DEX interoperability, aligned with product and program needs
 - Identify areas for automation and prioritise work based on risk, complexity, and business value
 - Design, build, and maintain automated interoperability, integration, and end-to-end tests across Horizon and DEX, primarily in Python
 - Plan and execute compatibility testing across current and previously supported product versions
 - Partner with feature teams from the design phase so new Horizon and DEX work is testable, and automated coverage is in place before it ships into the integrated stack
 - Build and maintain reusable, scalable test frameworks and shared libraries across supported platforms (Windows, Linux, and other supported clients)
 - Standardise processes, tools, and frameworks for automated testing, CI/CD, and quality gates
 - Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions and Jenkins), including pipeline templates, so component, integration, and end-to-end stages are automated, stable, and properly integrated
 - Implement and refine quality gates and reporting dashboards; track coverage, execution stability, and pipeline health
 - Implement and maintain scalable test infrastructure (on-premises, virtualised, and cloud) so environments stay stable, accessible, and usable for automated runs
 - Extend coverage across supported deployment platforms and real-world topologies, including hypervisors and gateway or proxy network paths
 - Work closely with developers so automation is integrated early and tests catch issues at unit, integration, functional, and UI levels where applicable
 - Review test suites for consistency, maintainability, and best practices; refactor scripts and optimise execution time as the suite grows
 - Investigate failures that span Horizon and DEX and drive them to root cause with engineering
 - Engage cross-functionally on end-to-end and interoperability scenarios to improve automation
 - Provide documentation and support so developers can understand and, where appropriate, self-manage test environments
 - Continuously evaluate new tools and technologies to improve automation efficiency and reliability
 - Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate test scaffolding, mock generation, refactoring, and debugging, and apply engineering judgment to review, validate, and harden the output for reliability, security, and maintainability

Qualifications

Required

- 3 to 8 years of experience in test automation for enterprise and/or cloud-hosted platforms (or equivalent experience). 
 - Strong Python skills for test automation (frameworks such as pytest); additional languages (Java, Go, PowerShell) are useful. 
 - Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins (or equivalent: Azure DevOps, GitLab CI). 
 - Experience owning automated tests end to end - not only manual test execution. 
 - Experience with upgrade testing and backward compatibility (mixed-version environments, upgrade paths, agent/client coexistence). 
 - Experience testing cloud deployment and lifecycle scenarios (onboarding, configuration, upgrades), not only API-level functional tests. 
 - Hands-on experience using a major public cloud (Azure preferred) to create and tear down test environments. 
 - Ability to debug issues across multiple layers (on-premises components, cloud service, gateway/edge, network, endpoint) and communicate findings clearly in writing. 

Preferred

- Experience with Omnissa Horizon Suite of products or similar end user computing products/solutions. 
 - Experience with monitoring solutions or telemetry products. 
 - Familiarity working with Hypervisors and Cloud platforms (vSphere, Azure, AWS or other clouds). 
 - Infrastructure-as-code or environment automation (Terraform, Ansible, or similar). 
 - Experience extending an automation framework across new clouds or topologies rather than rewriting it each time.
