data.title: Sr. Embedded Test Engineer
data.description:
Your role

As a Senior Embedded Test Engineer at Atlas Copco Group, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of embedded software across a range of advanced industrial products. Your responsibilities include comprehensive verification of embedded software through manual and automated testing, collaboration with cross-disciplinary engineering teams to refine requirements, and the development of Python-based automation to expand regression coverage and enhance testing efficiency. 

You will be embedded within a multidisciplinary team responsible for cutting-edge products such as PLC controllers utilizing CODESYS and Straton, vacuum pump controllers, industrial communication modules, and EtherCAT-based devices. This role demands hands-on expertise in setting up and executing functional, integration, and system tests, managing test artifacts within tools such as Jira Xray, and advancing automated testing frameworks integrated with continuous integration pipelines like TeamCity and Jenkins. 

Your day-to-day tasks will also include thorough analysis of test failures through logs and system behavior observations, defect tracking and retesting, and contributing to the continuous improvement of QA practices and automation tools. You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, influencing quality standards and methodologies across projects. 

Technical and Product Environment

You will work with embedded operating systems, network stacks, industrial communication protocols (such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen), hardware interfaces, and automated test systems. This environment balances both legacy and modern technologies, providing a stimulating setting for innovation and technical growth. 

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with product owners and developers during sprint planning to ensure test coverage aligns with acceptance criteria. 
 - Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans and cases, both manual and automated, ensuring traceability to requirements. 
 - Develop and enhance Python-based automation frameworks and scripts to increase regression test efficiency and reliability. 
 - Perform embedded system testing on physical hardware and hardware simulators, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing. 
 - Analyze, document, and report identified defects, facilitating resolution through close cooperation with the development team. 
 - Integrate automated tests into continuous integration workflows to provide rapid feedback on software quality. 
 - Provide technical leadership in QA best practices, contributing to process improvements, and coaching junior QA engineers. 
 - Maintain detailed test documentation and contribute to project documentation to support compliance and audit requirements. 

To succeed, you will need

- Minimum five years of experience in software testing, with proven expertise in embedded systems and Python automation. 
 - Strong capability in defining and executing functional, integration, and regression test suites based on user requirements. 
 - Experience with test management tools such as Jira Xray, defect tracking, and continuous integration systems like TeamCity or Jenkins. 
 - Ability to independently lead QA activities, prioritize tasks effectively, and provide technical mentorship. 
 - Familiarity with embedded hardware, communication protocols, and debugging methodologies. 

In return, we offer

- Join a prestigious global industrial leader with a legacy spanning over 150 years, committed to innovation and excellence. 
 - Empower your professional growth through a culture that encourages autonomy in research and development initiatives. 
 - Engage in challenging projects developing next-generation embedded systems using advanced technology. 
 - Experience global exposure and career development opportunities through Atlas Copco's extensive internal mobility network. 
 - Benefit from a workplace culture that emphasizes mutual care, sustainability, and social responsibility. 
 - Enjoy a competitive total rewards program, including comprehensive insurance coverage, educational support, and flexible working arrangements to promote work-life balance. 

Job location

This position is based in Pune, India, with a hybrid working model. You will have the flexibility to work partly from our Atlas Copco Group, GECIA premises, and partly remotely. This arrangement supports a healthy work-life balance while maintaining effective collaboration with the onsite team. 

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

With our global scale and deep expertise, you'll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people's health around the world. Together, we're improving health and improving lives. 

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives. 

Labcorp is seeking a QA Engineer - Salesforce & Enterprise Applications to support quality assurance across Salesforce and integrated enterprise applications to join our team!

Work Schedule: This is an initial one-year contract position, and the role is assigned to a second-shift schedule. with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 12. 30 PM IST - 9. 30 PM IST in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible. 

Job Responsibilities

- Analyze user stories, business requirements, solution designs, and acceptance criteria from a QA perspective to ensure requirements are complete, consistent, and testable.

Technical Oversight

 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives, and provide QA estimates, status updates, and quality risks. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously improve QA processes, test automation, regression coverage, defect prevention, and overall software quality. 

Minimum Qualifications

 - 2 years or more experience performing functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing. 
 - 2 years or more experience with test automation, preferably Copado Robotic Testing, or similar enterprise test automation tools. 
 - 2 years or more experience with data migration, data conversion, or large-scale data validation testing.

Preferred Qualifications

- 1 year or more experience testing REST/SOAP APIs and integration platforms
 - 1 year or more experience with Jira, Salesforce DevOps processes, and version-control practices. 

Certifications

Additional Job Standards

- Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail. 
 - Strong experience analyzing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria and translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect-management, and communication skills. 
 - Strong command of the English language. Fluent in speaking and writing English. 
 - Ability to independently analyze requirements and identify quality risks before testing begins.

WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SMTS Software Quality Engineer to join the HIP Runtime Quality Engineering team within the ROCm ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on defect triage, root‐cause analysis, and scalable test automation for the HIP runtime, ensuring robustness, portability, and performance across AMD and NVIDIA GPU backends. 

The role sits at the intersection of runtime systems, GPU APIs, and CI-driven quality assurance, working closely with HIP runtime developers, compiler teams, and system software engineers to improve test coverage and accelerate issue resolution across a fast-evolving open‐source stack. 

HIP is a C++ runtime API and kernel language designed for CUDA portability and heterogeneous GPU programming in the ROCm platform. 

Key Responsibilities

Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis

- Own end-to-end triage of HIP runtime failures observed in CI, nightly, and release testing pipelines. 
 - Analyze failures across HIP runtime APIs, including memory management, streams, events, kernels, graphs, and device management. 
 - Perform log analysis, repro reduction, and backtrace debugging across Linux and Windows environments. 
 - Correlate failures across: 
 - ROCr system runtime
 - HIP runtime
 - Driver / firmware interfaces
 - Compiler (hipcc / clang) interactions
 - File high‐quality bug reports with clear reproduction steps, root cause hypotheses, and impact assessment. 

Test Automation & Framework Development

- Design, enhance, and maintain automated test frameworks for HIP runtime validation using existing HIP test infrastructure (Catch2-based and custom harnesses). 
 - Expand functional, negative, stress, and regression coverage for: 
 - HIP Runtime APIs
 - Graph APIs
 - Memory copy variants (1D/2D/3D, async/sync)
 - Multi-GPU and peer-to-peer use cases
 - Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines with actionable failure reporting. 
 - Develop Python, C++, and shell-based automation for test execution, result aggregation, and trend analysis. 
 - Drive test flakiness reduction and improve signal-to-noise ratio in large-scale CI. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Partner with HIP runtime developers to: 
 - Review test gaps for new features and APIs
 - Validate bug fixes and performance-sensitive code paths
 - Collaborate with: 
 - Compiler and language runtime teams
 - ROCr system runtime teams
 - Release engineering and CI infrastructure teams
 - Contribute test fixes and enhancements upstream in open-source HIP/ROCm repositories. 

Quality Metrics & Continuous Improvement

- Define and track quality metrics such as failure escape rate, test coverage, and mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR). 
 - Identify systemic issues and propose data-driven quality improvements. 
 - Participate in release readiness assessments for HIP runtime drops. 

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

- Strong experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles. 
 - Solid proficiency in C++ with debugging experience (gdb/lldb). 
 - Working knowledge of HIP or CUDA runtime concepts, including kernels, streams, memory models, and device execution. 
 - Experience with Linux-based development and debugging. 
 - Familiarity with CI systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar). 
 - Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for low-level systems or runtime libraries. 

Debugging & Analysis Skills

- Ability to reason about runtime abstractions, concurrency, and asynchronous execution. 
 - Strong skills in failure reproduction, minimization, and log-driven debugging. 
 - Experience triaging issues across hardware-software boundaries is a plus. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with GPU programming models (HIP, CUDA, OpenCL). 
 - Familiarity with ROCm stack components (HIP, ROCr, compilers, drivers). 
 - Experience testing graph APIs, async execution models, or multi-GPU systems. 
 - Prior contributions to open-source system software or test frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of Python-based test orchestration and reporting tools. 
 - Knowledge and application of AI tools in validation and testing. 

What Success Looks Like

- Faster, higher-quality issue triage with actionable root cause insights. 
 - Improved automation coverage for HIP runtime APIs and edge cases. 
 - Reduced CI noise and faster feedback for developers. 
 - Strong collaboration with runtime and compiler engineers to ship stable, high-quality HIP releases.

data.description:
Founding Engineer , AI Platform Reliability and Scale

Company: Early-Stage Silicon Valley AI Startup (Ex-Apple & Ex-Meta Founders)

Headquarters : San Francisco Bay area, California. 

Role Type: Full-Time (Founding Stage)

About Us

We're an early-stage Silicon Valley AI startup founded by ex-Apple and ex-Meta engineers. Our platform allows anyone to describe an application and have AI build, host, and run it-with zero code to maintain. 

We are live with real users, growing fast, and looking for our next Founding Engineer to make the platform more reliable, faster, and cheaper to run as we scale. If you love finding the root cause of complex systems issues and ensuring they never happen again, let's talk. 

What You'll Work On

- Reliability: Make AI-generated apps work correctly the first time and keep them running smoothly. 
 - Scale: Scale our infrastructure, data layer, and pipelines to match rapid user growth. 
 - Performance & Cost: Drive down AI generation latency and cost without compromising quality. 
 - Observability: Build deep observability systems that pinpoint what is breaking and why. 
 - Continuous Learning: Turn every system failure into a learning loop for the platform. 

How You Think

- Systems First: You trace a problem across multiple layers to its actual root cause and fix it there. 
 - Prevent, Don't Patch: You prefer making a failure impossible over adding temporary band-aids. 
 - Data Before Opinions: You measure the problem, implement the fix, and prove the metrics moved. 
 - Total Ownership: You identify what matters most, tackle unassigned problems, and drive them to production. 
 - AI-Native: You use Claude and coding agents daily, reviewing their output with a critical engineering eye. 

What We're Looking For

- 4+ years of experience building and running backend or distributed systems in production. 
 - End-to-End Ownership: You have owned a production system end-to-end, including leading incident response and post-mortems. 
 - AI Experience: Built or worked on LLM-powered or agentic systems deployed to real users. 
 - Tech Stack: Strong Python proficiency, alongside solid fundamentals in databases, message queues, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Observability: Hands-on comfort with logs, metrics, traces, and alerting. 
 - Pragmatic Judgment: Clear thinking about design patterns, trade-offs, and knowing when not to over-engineer. 
 - Hands-on Coding: You still write code every day and genuinely enjoy it.

- Experience with workflow engines, LLM evals, or model fine-tuning.

data.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world's most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you'll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people's health around the world. Together, we're improving health and improving lives. 

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives. 

Labcorp is seeking a QA Engineer - Salesforce & Enterprise Applications to support quality assurance across Salesforce and integrated enterprise applications to join our team!

Work Schedule: This is an initial one-year contract position, and the role is assigned to a second-shift schedule. with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 12. 30 PM IST - 9. 30 PM IST in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible. 

Job Responsibilities

- Analyze user stories, business requirements, solution designs, and acceptance criteria from a QA perspective to ensure requirements are complete, consistent, and testable. 
 - Identify requirement gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and quality risks early in the software development lifecycle and work with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and Developers to clarify expected behavior. 

Technical Oversight

- Develop and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and test execution documentation. 
 - Perform rigorous functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing for Salesforce applications and related enterprise systems. 
 - Test Salesforce functionality including business processes, Flows, validation rules, objects, fields, permissions, profiles, record types, and other configuration and customization. 
 - Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test cases using Copado Robotic Testing, with a focus on reusable and maintainable regression automation. 
 - Evaluate existing and new test cases to identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, regression coverage, and overall testing effectiveness. 
 - Test integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise applications, including APIs, middleware, scheduled processes, and inbound/outbound interfaces. 
 - Perform data migration and data validation testing, including field mapping, record counts, data completeness, accuracy, transformation, synchronization, and exception handling. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, supporting evidence, and business impact; retest fixes and perform appropriate regression testing. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives, and provide QA estimates, status updates, and quality risks. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously improve QA processes, test automation, regression coverage, defect prevention, and overall software quality. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 8 years or more experience as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer. 
 - 3 years or more experience testing Salesforce platform applications on Sales Cloud or Service Cloud. 
 - 2 years or more experience in Salesforce, Copado, or related QA/test automation certifications. 
 - 2 years or more experience performing functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing. 
 - 2 years or more experience with test automation, preferably Copado Robotic Testing, or similar enterprise test automation tools. 
 - 2 years or more experience with data migration, data conversion, or large-scale data validation testing. 
 - 2 years or more experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 1 year or more experience testing REST/SOAP APIs and integration platforms
 - 1 year or more experience with Jira, Salesforce DevOps processes, and version-control practices. 

Certifications

- Salesforce certifications. Professional certifications such as ISTQB, ASTQB, CSTE, CSQA, CQSE

Additional Job Standards

- Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail. 
 - Strong experience analyzing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria and translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect-management, and communication skills. 
 - Strong command of the English language. Fluent in speaking and writing English. 
 - Ability to independently analyze requirements and identify quality risks before testing begins. 
 - Strong ownership of testing outcomes and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions. 
 - Ability to effectively balance comprehensive testing with Agile delivery timelines. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills across business and technical teams. 
 - Ability to continuously identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, and quality processes.

- The QA Engineer will be responsible for analyzing requirements from a quality perspective, developing and executing comprehensive test scenarios, and building and maintaining automated tests using Copado Robotic Testing. As a Test Engineer L3, you will collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and QA teams to thoroughly understand project requirements, enabling you to design comprehensive test strategies and execute automated testing scripts that cover functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end test scenarios. Your expertise will contribute to integrating automated test suites into continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, thereby streamlining release cycles and improving deployment reliability. 

Key responsibilities include analyzing test results, identifying defects, and working collaboratively with development teams to facilitate timely resolutions. You will also champion improvements in test automation coverage, aiming to reduce manual testing efforts, foster efficiency, and boost overall product quality. Your participation in code reviews will ensure compliance with best practices in automation development. Additionally, maintaining meticulous test documentation and consistently providing stakeholders with clear status updates will be fundamental to your role. 

This position requires a proactive individual with a deep passion for quality assurance, a strong client-centric approach, and a commitment to execution excellence within an agile environment. Join us to be part of a forward-thinking team driving digital transformation at scale. 

͏ Core Areas of Responsibility

- Requirement Analysis and Documentation: Engage with clients through detailed discussions and product demonstrations to gather insights and translate these into precise technical requirement documents that serve as a foundation for testing activities.

 - Test Data and Environment Setup: Design and implement data validation scenarios critical for comprehensive testing; coordinate with client stakeholders to establish and verify appropriate test environments that reflect production settings. 
 - Test Execution and Result Analysis: Conduct thorough functional and regression testing cycles to identify discrepancies, document the outcomes meticulously, and maintain detailed test evidence. Manage defect tracking efficiently by logging issues in the test management system and updating statuses until resolution. 
 - Collaboration and Reporting: Work seamlessly with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on testing goals and progress. Prepare clear and insightful test review documentation for varied audiences within the organization. ͏ Required Skills and Competencies

 - Proficient in integrating automated tests within CI/CD pipelines to support agile delivery models. 
 - Robust understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies including functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.

Description

As a Quality Assurance Analyst at Infor, you will have a critical role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality enterprise applications that meet the evolving needs of our global customers. A Typical Day In The Life Includes

- Design and execute test cases for AI Studio's Orchestrator Agent - verifying that the correct components are selected, the right questions are asked, and assumptions are applied accurately for a given user input. 
 - Validate gap map outputs - confirming that fields are correctly classified as confirmed, assumed, auto-resolved, or missing based on schema contracts and domain defaults. 
 - Test schema and knowledge document submissions through the Content API - verifying structure validation, field type enforcement, controlled vocabulary checks, and embedding generation. 
 - Execute search relevance tests across all six OpenSearch indices - verifying that queries return the expected documents with acceptable relevance scores. 
 - Test multi-agent task packet assembly - confirming that confirmed values, assumed values, upstream context, and output contracts are correctly populated before specialist agents are invoked. 
 - Verify execution tier ordering - ensuring components with blocking dependencies are never dispatched before their upstream dependencies have completed. 
 - Perform tenant isolation testing - confirming that session data, project history, and search results are strictly scoped to the correct tenant across all operations. 
 - Analyse audit logs and search traces to identify the root cause of failures in the multi-agent pipeline and report findings with clear reproduction steps. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. 3-5 years of experience in software quality assurance.

 - Familiarity with search systems - understanding of how relevance scoring works and the ability to design queries that validate expected search behaviour. 
 - Ability to define acceptability criteria for non-deterministic outputs - understanding that LLM-driven responses require semantic evaluation rather than exact-match assertions. 
 - Experience with integration testing across multi-service or distributed architectures - ability to trace a failure across service boundaries to its root cause. 
 - Strong analytical skills and attention to detail - particularly important when validating structured JSON outputs such as task packets, gap maps, and deployment blueprints. 
 - Good written communication skills - ability to write clear, reproducible bug reports and test documentation.

- Exposure to RAG systems, vector search, or LLM-driven applications - either through professional experience or personal projects.

 - Knowledge of JSON Schema validation and the ability to write schema-level assertions against complex nested JSON structures.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:

data.title: Engineering Manager / Team Lead – Hydrology & Drainage

Assystem Safety & Risk delivers an integrated and cost-effective service that includes Safety Case, Human & Organisational Factors (HOF), Risk & Reliability (Including Probabilistic Safety Assessment), Security & Resilience, and Process Safety.

data.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
data.description:

data.title: Director of Engineering, KYX
data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members across UK and India
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - Over 2, 800 Tideans globally
 - Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found. 

You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains. 

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide. 

As Director of Engineering, KYX you will

- Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines. 
 - Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius. 
 - Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring. 
 - Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework. 
 - Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access. 
 - Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member. 
 - Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated. 

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment. 

What We Are Looking For

- Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain. 
 - Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation. 
 - Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live. 
 - Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions, 
 - Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality. 
 - Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap. 
 - Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus. 

What You'll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

- Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options. 
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office. 
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy. 

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

data.description:

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. 

Responsibilities

As a Principal Engineer in Search Platform, you will serve as a technical leader driving the core indexing engines and enterprise-grade trust capabilities that power Atlassian Search and Rovo. 

You will lead the technical vision, architecture and delivery for planetary-scale data ingestion and indexing platforms while ensuring Search meets strict enterprise commitments across multi-cloud (GCP/AWS), isolated cloud, compliance, and encryption. 

Responsibilities

- Lead Enterprise Trust & Compliance: Own technical strategy and delivery for enterprise requirements - multi-cloud (GCP/AWS), Isolated Cloud, FedRAMP, BYOK encryption, and data residency - making Search a platform enterprises can trust. Proactively simplifying architecture and removing
 - Shape the Indexing Platform for AI-era Workloads: Evolve high-throughput, low-latency distributed indexing pipelines to meet the retrieval demands of agentic and AI use cases - freshness, context relevance, and scale across billions of events. 
 - Connect Across Teams and Systems: Work fluidly across ML, Data, Cloud Infrastructure, and product teams - aligning technical direction, unblocking dependencies, and building shared platform capabilities that multiply the impact of teams beyond your own. Help improve support for building and operating systems that deliver true Enterprise Trust through Atlassian-wide platforms, while actively simplifying the architecture and eliminating accumulated complexity.

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. 

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. 

Requirements

 - Distributed Systems Depth: Proven experience designing and operating large-scale distributed data pipelines, search/indexing systems, or streaming platforms (e. g. , Kafka, Flink, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, object-store-backed indexing, vector search).

data.title: QA & Release Engineer
data.description:
MariaDB is making a big impact on the world. Whether you're checking your bank account, buying a coffee, shopping online, making a phone call, listening to music, taking out a loan, or ordering takeout - MariaDB is the backbone of applications used every day. Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500 run MariaDB, touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments, and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development. 

The Opportunity

MariaDB MaxScale is a database proxy that manages traffic between applications and MariaDB server clusters. It functions as an intermediary layer to provide high availability, scalability, and load balancing. Because applications connect to MaxScale as if it were a MariaDB server, complex operations-such as read-write splitting, query limiting, and transparent failover-can be implemented without modifying the application. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an engineer to join our Solution QA team to focus on our QA and release management and secondarily on the maintenance of our build infrastructure. MaxScale consists of multiple configurable components, resulting in a high number of potential configurations that require extensive test coverage. While our developers write system tests in a white-box fashion, this role focuses on black-box testing of complex scenarios, the verification of product documentation, and the management of our packaging and release pipelines. 

As MaxScale and its tests are written in C++, a good working knowledge of the language is expected, along with a solid understanding of SQL. In addition to testing, you will work closely with support engineers and customers to verify and resolve reported problems, and assist in maintaining the automated build system. 

Key Responsibilities

QA & Technical Investigation

● Black-Box Testing: Design and execute tests for complex scenarios to ensure various combinations of MaxScale filters and routers work correctly together. 

● Documentation Verification: Review and verify that product documentation is accurate, exhaustive, and reflects the actual behavior of the software. 

● Customer Issue Verification: Act as a technical point of contact for issues escalated by support engineers. You will interact with support and occasionally customers to verify problems, build reproduction environments, and isolate root causes. 

● Problem Resolution: Create representative test cases to assist the development team in resolving bugs. You may also contribute code fixes as you become more familiar with the MaxScale codebase. 

Build & Release Engineering

● Release Management: Coordinate four maintenance releases per year across five active MaxScale series, ensuring all builds and packages are verified and ready for release on schedule. 

● Build Infrastructure: Monitor and maintain the automated build system. You will troubleshoot build failures across various platforms and manage dependencies within virtual machine environments. 

● Packaging: Manage and troubleshoot the creation of DEB and RPM packages for various Linux distributions.

data.description:
Job Description

- Enable the plant's growth from approximately €250 million to €600 million by 2030 by achieving customer quality targets, securing timely APQP/PPAP and quality-gate approvals, ensuring launch readiness, and maintaining stable serial-production quality and delivery performance.

Ensure effective process controls, equipment and measurement-system capability, soldering and assembly quality, traceability, change control, layered process audits, product audits, quality gates, error-proofing, and rapid containment of deviations. Drive preventive quality and zero-defect thinking with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and R&D.

Build strong partnerships with Plant Management, Production, Engineering, R&D, Purchasing/Supplier Quality, Supply Chain, Sales, Project Management, Maintenance, EHS, and HR. Lead customer escalations, audits, quality reviews, and cross-functional recovery plans. 
 - Lead, coach, and develop the Quality organization. Define roles, objectives, succession plans, and competency matrices; close capability gaps in safety-critical product quality, electronics and SMT process quality, mechanical and motor technologies, auditing, data analysis, and structured problem-solving. Develop future leaders and ensure disciplined performance management.

Support responsible material and process controls, safe handling of electronic manufacturing materials, audit readiness, documented product conformity, and timely escalation of product-safety or compliance risks. 
 - Lead containment and recovery for critical quality incidents, customer line stops, product-safety concerns, major audit findings, and field issues. Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable discipline.

 - Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent structured problem-solving certification desirable.

Hands-on experience establishing or scaling electronics/PCBA and SMT quality controls, safe-launch governance, traceability, audits, and customer approvals. 
 - Proven leadership of a multidisciplinary Quality organization of comparable scale, including managers and technical specialists. Experience setting departmental targets, managing budgets and resources, developing successors, and leading cross-functional teams through customer or product-safety crises. 
 - Experience working with global customers, suppliers, certification bodies, central functions, and international manufacturing or R&D locations. Able to communicate and influence effectively across cultures, functions, and seniority levels. 

Additional Information

- Automotive Quality Management Systems: IATF 16949, VDA 6. 3, internal and customer-specific requirements
 - Quality leadership for highly safety-critical mechatronic products and high-volume manufacturing

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Demand Bidder, Ad Serving Platform
data.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.   

Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U. S. , Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. 

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. 

  

What does the team work on?
Roku's Ad Serving Team builds and operates the real-time advertising platform that powers all of Roku's ad monetization across video, display, and native ad formats. Within Ad Serving, the Demand Bidder team owns the high throughput and low latency systems responsible for serving relevant ads for tens of thousands of campaigns through targeting, scoring, bidding, auctions, measurement and more. Every millisecond and every decision carries direct, measurable revenue impact, and the team operates with the high engineering rigor that this demands. 

  What is the role?  

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help scale and evolve this platform. Demand Bidder is a large, high-throughput system driving our next phase of growth. As we onboard a rapid wave of new businesses, we are actively scaling and advancing our architecture - including our pacing engine, scoring/ML engine, and modularizing for agentic development. You'll work alongside a strong team of engineers tackling meaningful technical challenges at scale. 

How will I use AI at Roku?  
At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain - coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

  What are the responsibilities of the role?
 - Design, build, and contribute to core components of a large-scale, real-time distributed decisioning system with strict latency requirements
 - Own features and drive them end-to-end in partnership with product and other engineering teams
 - Build a working mental model of a highly distributed, complex production system and make meaningful contributions
 - Help identify opportunities to evolve the system and tooling over time
 - Partner with engineers and applied scientists working at the intersection of distributed systems and statistical/ML-driven decision-making
 - Help diagnose and resolve subtle, often timing- or statistics-related issues in a highly concurrent, multi-region distributed system
 - Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and collaborate across engineering, product, and business partners
 - Be an evangelist for best practices across development, testing, and operations  

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?
 - 10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale, low-latency distributed systems
 - Experience owning features or subsystems through design, build, testing, deployment, and iteration based on production feedback
 - Ability to ramp into unfamiliar, complex, large codebases and become productive - you enjoy the "figure it out" part of the job as much as the "build it" part
 - Comfort contributing to live, business-critical systems without compromising uptime or correctness
 - Strong command of Java, with a solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, concurrency/multi-threading, and performance optimization
 - Experience with distributed caching, high-throughput messaging/streaming systems, and SQL/NoSQL datastores
 - Comfort operating in cloud infrastructure (GCP or AWS) at scale
 - Exposure to statistical, control-theory, or ML-driven techniques within production decision-making systems is a plus
 - Real-time bidding / ad-tech domain experience is a plus, but experience in adjacent high-stakes, low-latency domains (trading systems, ranking/recommendation, matchmaking, risk/fraud systems) is equally valued
 - B. S. or M. S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 - Self-motivated, critical thinker, comfortable operating with some ambiguity
 - Low-ego, nonpolitical, and genuinely collaborative
 - You've used AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in real work - deep prior experience isn't required, curiosity is what matters most  

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. 

  

What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. 

  

AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku. com. 

  

What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https: //www. weareroku. com/factsheet. 

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku. com.

What You'll Be Doing (position summary):

The incumbent adds value by providing technical leadership, ensuring compliance, and supporting continuous improvement in testing processes and methodologies. 

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

Defect & Compliance Management

data.title: Sr Manager, Software Engineering
data.description:
JOB ROLE : SENIOR MANAGER, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING

Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)

Department: Product Development

About Ghx

GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the world's largest cloud-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. GHX continues to innovate with intelligent automation and AI-driven capabilities across its product portfolio. 

About The Role

GHX is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a multi-disciplinary engineering team that powers intelligent, AI-augmented automation across multiple product lines with document understanding - extracting structured meaning from unstructured documents and data - as one of its core technical problems. This team spans three areas: a platform engineering team (AI, DevOps, Infra, architecture, business continuity, security etc. ), a set of product-line delivery teams (each building product-specific business logic, validation, and integrations), and a team building the Human-in-the-Loop (HiTL) application along with reporting/analytics capabilities. 

You will lead through team leads or senior engineers rather than running delivery for a single team directly. You will set technical direction for shared platform capabilities that every product-line team depends on, while ensuring each product line independently meets its own functionality, quality, and delivery commitments. You will work directly with business, product, and operations stakeholders across every product line this platform serves, and you will own end-to-end outcomes: people, technical direction, and customer impact across the full teams. 

Responsibilities

Organizational & Engineering Leadership: 

- Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary team spanning platform engineering, product-line delivery teams, and HiTL/analytics, working through team leads and senior engineers rather than direct, single-team execution. 
 - Set technical direction for shared platform capabilities (AI/agents, infra, security, cost optimization, eval pipelines) that multiple product-line teams depend on. 
 - Build and grow leads and senior engineers within each team, developing the next layer of technical leadership, not just individual contributors. 
 - Own the vendor relationship for external development partners: define interface contracts, hold delivery leads accountable across teams, and resolve cross-team dependencies. 
 - Establish org-wide engineering culture, standards, and practices that scale consistently across all three streams. 

Technical Direction & Architecture

- Guide architectural and design decisions across product-line teams to ensure consistency, reuse, and alignment with the shared platform. 
 - Resolve cross-team technical trade-offs - for example, shared platform constraints versus a product line's specific needs. 
 - Engage hands-on selectively, on foundational platform decisions or critical blockers
 - Champion AI-augmented engineering practices (AI-assisted code generation, review, test automation) across all teams, ensuring adoption and responsible use of AI/LLM tooling with appropriate evaluation, monitoring, and human-in-the-loop controls. 

Stakeholder & Delivery Management

- Interface directly with business, product, operations and support stakeholders for each product line to align priorities, resolve conflicts, and ensure each line's functionality, quality, and timelines are independently met. 
 - Balance platform-level priorities, which are shared across all product lines, against individual product-line delivery commitments. 
 - Communicate delivery status, risk, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders at all levels, from individual product owners to senior leadership. 
 - Own the release process across teams: coordinate QA, product, and stakeholders to ship reliably across multiple concurrent product-line commitments. 

Operational Excellence

- Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability standards that scale across the platform and all product-line teams. 
 - Ensure robust testing practices (unit, component, integration) are a baseline across every team, not an afterthought. 
 - Champion CI/CD adoption and optimization across the team. 
 - Coordinate incident response and on-call coverage across the platform and product-line services. 
 - Collaborate with the Security team to resolve findings and complete compliance reviews across all teams in a timely manner. 

Qualifications

Experience: 

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years managing engineering managers, team leads, or senior tech leads - not only individual contributors. 
 - Demonstrated experience running two-three teams with a shared platform layer and independent delivery teams or pods. 
 - Proven track record of building and scaling engineering leadership - developing leads and senior engineers, not just growing headcount. 
 - Experience owning delivery against firm deadlines with external dependencies (vendor teams, APIs, platform dependencies) across multiple concurrent workstreams. 
 - Strong background in cloud-native, microservices-based architecture on AWS or Azure. 
 - Experience building document understanding or intelligent document processing systems - classification, extraction, OCR/layout analysis, or structured-data-from-unstructured-input pipelines - at production scale. 
 - Solid experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into production software - LLM-based pipelines, agentic workflows, or setting up eval pipelines - at a platform level serving multiple consuming teams. 

Technical Breadth

- Backend development: Python/Java, FastAPI. 
 - Frontend familiarity: Angular/React, JavaScript or TypeScript - enough to review and guide UI engineers. 
 - Cloud platforms: AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, S3, SQS, ECS/EKS, API Gateway) or equivalent Azure services. 
 - Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or other relational/NoSQL stores. 
 - CI/CD and infrastructure: GitHub Actions, Bamboo, Terraform, Docker, or similar. 
 - LLM tooling and frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Pydantic, or equivalent orchestration
 - Observability: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting - Datadog, LangSmith, or equivalent. 
 - Testing: Selenium, Playwright, Postman, or similar automation tools. 
 - AI-powered development tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree is a plus but not required. 

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

- Sets technical direction where a clear answer doesn't yet exist - comfortable operating in undefined problem spaces (agentic architecture, cost/latency trade-offs, evaluation methodology). 
 - Leads through leads: develops the layer of technical leadership beneath them rather than relying solely on personal technical authority. 
 - Represents the team to multiple business/product stakeholders simultaneously, each with independent and sometimes competing priorities. 
 - Strong communicator across all levels - explains technical trade-offs to engineers and leads, and business risk and roadmap impact to senior stakeholders, with equal clarity. 
 - Strategic thinker who keeps multi-quarter, cross-team outcomes in focus without losing sight of individual product-line delivery commitments. 
 - Decisive under ambiguity - gathers the right inputs across teams, makes the call, and owns the outcome. 
 - High emotional maturity: handles delivery pressure, stakeholder conflict, and cross-team trade-offs with composure and directness. 

What Success Looks Like In The First 6 Months

- You have built trust with team leads and engineers across all three teams and understand the platform and product-line systems deeply enough to make sound cross-team technical decisions. 
 - Delivery is predictable across every product line - stakeholders are not surprised by slippage, and each team ships on its committed roadmap. 
 - The shared platform (AI/agents, infra, eval pipelines, cost optimization) is visibly maturing and reducing duplicated effort across product-line teams. 
 - You have a clear view of vendor performance and stakeholder relationships across every product line the team serves. 

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare

Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes. 

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions. 

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe. 

Disclaimer

Global Healthcare Exchange, LLC and its North American subsidiaries (collectively, "GHX") provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable law. This EEO policy applies to all terms, conditions, and privileges of employment, including hiring, training and development, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, educational assistance, termination, layoffs, social and recreational programs, and retirement. GHX believes that employees should be provided with a working environment which enables each employee to be productive and to work to the best of his or her ability. We do not condone or tolerate an atmosphere of intimidation or harassment based on race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. GHX expects and requires the cooperation of all employees in maintaining a discrimination and harassment-free atmosphere. Improper interference with the ability of GHX's employees to perform their expected job duties is absolutely not tolerated.

data.title: Director, Tech@Lilly CTI Lilly USA
data.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

Job Title

Director, Lilly USA Tech@Lilly

Job Function

Information Technology

Location: 

India - Bangalore

Reports To

Senior Director, CTI Commercial India, Tech@Lilly

Role Level

M2 (Director)

Role Overview

The Director, LUSA Tech@Lilly will lead a large and growing portfolio of technology delivery from LCCI Bengaluru. This role has been positioned with a primary focus on engineering leadership and business acumen, reflecting the maturity and scale of the portfolio to support Lilly USA affiliate business. The leader will drive technical excellence, AI-forward innovation, and deep partnership with Lilly USA business teams to deliver high-impact technology products across HCP engagement, field enablement, value & access, and customer support programs. 

Portfolio Scope

The Director will own end-to-end engineering delivery for the following current and future areas: 

- Dynamic Targeting & Field-facing Omnichannel: All DT and omnichannel capabilities for the US affiliate, NBE for IBU and Medical
 - AI-Enabled Field Experience Products: iQ, Route Optimizer, and next-generation agentic AI-powered tools that transform the rep and field experience
 - Sales Operations Platforms: SFS 2. 0, IC 2. 0, One DataSpine, and platforms that drive sales operations efficiency
 - Sales & Marketing Data Intelligence: Data products serving this portfolio and Commercial operations & analytics users
 - Value & Access Technology: Technology products supporting Lilly Value & Access programs, including patient affordability, payer engagement, and access enablement platforms
 - Customer Support Programs: Technology solutions for customer support operations, case management, and service delivery
 - In-housing & Build Capabilities: RHM, FRM, and depending on resourcing, Greenhouse and Connected Medicines

Engineering Leadership Expectations

This is first and foremost an engineering leadership role. The Director is expected to: 

- Lead a team of 50+ technology professionals (FTEs and contingent workers) through M1 managers, ensuring engineering rigor in architecture, code quality, testing, CI/CD, security, and compliance
 - Drive modern engineering practices: cloud-native development (AWS), microservices, API-first design, infrastructure-as-code, and platform engineering thinking
 - Champion AI and agentic technology adoption across the portfolio - identifying opportunities where AI agents, LLMs, and machine learning can fundamentally improve products and workflows, not just augment existing approaches
 - Establish and maintain high engineering standards for reliability, scalability, and performance across all products in the portfolio
 - Partner closely with Lilly USA DAA (Data, Analytics & AI), CTI, and other horizontal technology teams within Tech@Lilly to leverage shared platforms and avoid duplication
 - Work across T@L capabilities including strategy, software development, engineering, QA, information security, and compliance to deliver high-quality results

Business Acumen Expectations

- Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the HCP engagement, field experience, value & access, and customer support domains to inform technology decisions
 - Serve as a credible technology partner to US business stakeholders - translating business strategy into engineering roadmaps and delivering outcomes that drive commercial impact
 - Coach M1 leaders to build complex products with strong business context, focused on a variety of field roles and customer touchpoints
 - Coach and develop the team to identify opportunities to build with AI and business context from the start, leveraging expertise across Tech@Lilly and Commercial operations

AI & Agentic Technology Focus

A key differentiator for this role is leading the charge on AI-forward engineering: 

- Drive an AI-first mindset across the engineering team - every new product and feature should be evaluated for AI and agentic opportunities
 - Partner with DAA and enterprise AI teams to integrate LLMs, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation into the portfolio
 - Build engineering team capabilities in AI/ML, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agent orchestration frameworks
 - Identify and execute on opportunities to replace or augment rule-based systems with AI-powered decision-making and agentic workflows

People & Site Leadership

- Coach and elevate the team through M1 leaders to integrate seamlessly with the global team of business area leaders, architects, project managers, designers, and developers
 - Serve as a role model leader in the LCCI ecosystem, driving close collaboration with Enterprise Tech functions at T@L and Commercial services teams
 - Actively lead site initiatives in engagement, communication, recruitment, collaboration, and innovation across Bangalore and Hyderabad

Portfolio Management

- Plan, budget, track, and report financials - be a good steward of Lilly's money
 - Implement continuous improvement initiatives and ideas for positive disruption
 - Understand the big picture and create reusable patterns that solve problems for cross-functional teams

Required

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

data.title: Senior AI Engineer - Quality Platform
data.description:
About The Company

Founders today are building global companies from day one - but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!

We're building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building. 

Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment. 

Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50, 000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J. P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we're building for the next generation of global companies. 

About The Role

Software quality and code volume are increasingly an engineering and AI problem. Leading teams now use agents to generate tests, detect coverage gaps before merge, and enforce quality through infrastructure rather than manual processes. 

At Aspire, we're already building this infrastructure. We have a merge guardrail in production that reads live product specs and blocks PRs when coverage gaps are detected. We are building an LLM pipeline that generates tests directly from specs, and a live traceability matrix that keeps specs, code, and test results in sync, along with AI-assisted code review. 

We are hiring a software engineer who builds AI systems and has a strong understanding of coding, testing and quality. You will design, build, and ship the AI tooling that makes quality automatic across Aspire's engineering organisation. 

What You'll Own

- The AI test generation pipeline. Build the LLM system that assesses product specs for gaps and testability, and converts them into automated tests. You will take it from POC to production, owning context retrieval across specs and codebases, prompt and agent design, evaluation frameworks for generation accuracy, and feedback loops based on live test results. 
 - The merge guardrail. The guardrail is live and blocks merges when coverage is missing or critical bugs are detected. You will improve its precision, scale it across all engineering tribes, and integrate it with the generation pipeline so it creates missing tests rather than only blocking for them. 
 - Reliable automation tooling. Build the intelligence layer behind our automation, including synthetic test data generation, AI agents that explore and verify flows, automated failure classification, and risk-based test selection, so that every alert is accurate and actionable. 
 - Quality platform ownership. Understand the spec, the code, and the failure modes, and build that understanding into systems. Contribute at the design stage, not after release. In a regulated fintech serving 50, 000+ businesses, quality gaps directly impact customers. Work closely with QA engineers to embed AI-assisted practices and use quality data (coverage, escape rates, flakiness) to drive decisions. 
 - Security regression in CI. Design and build automated security regression tests for our highest-risk API endpoints, ensuring every auth boundary is verified at merge. This is a MAS Singapore requirement and will be built from scratch. 

What We're Looking For

- Proven experience shipping AI systems. You have built and deployed an LLM application, agent, developer tool, or automation that replaced real manual work. You understand common failure modes such as hallucinations, context limits, and evaluation gaps, and how to address them. 
 - Strong software engineering with a quality mindset. You write production code, design systems, and build tools used by other engineers. You understand test architecture, coverage, and failure analysis well enough to define what good testing looks like. 
 - High standards. You address root causes rather than symptoms and treat production defects and flaky tests as system-level problems to eliminate. 
 - Ownership and initiative. You identify problems, validate them with data, and propose solutions without waiting to be assigned. 
 - Comfort with ambiguity. You are motivated by an evolving roadmap that starts with quality and extends to wider engineering workflows as we learn what works, and you want to help shape its direction. 

Technical Skills

- Strong software engineering in TypeScript and/or Python, with experience building production services, internal tools, or developer platforms
 - Hands-on experience building LLM applications, including prompt engineering, RAG or context retrieval, agents or tool use, and output evaluation. Side projects, internal tools, or POCs count if they were shipped. 
 - Strong day-to-day use of AI coding tools and agentic workflows. 
 - Solid understanding of test automation and test architecture; Playwright experience is a strong plus
 - CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), including building tooling that integrates at PR and merge stages
 - Ability to read and reason about backend code, API contracts, and service boundaries
 - 5+ years in software engineering with meaningful exposure to development, testing, quality, or developer tooling, preferably including a fintech or regulated-environment project
 - Experience owning a system or product domain end-to-end
 - Familiarity with financial workflows such as payments, KYB/KYC, and transaction processing is a strong plus

What This Role Is NOT

- Building AI prototypes that never reach production. 
 - Waiting at the end of the delivery pipeline for a build. 
 - Maintaining a regression suite without evaluating its value. 
 - Treating quality as another team's responsibility. 

In Your First 90 Days, You'll Probably

- Become the go-to engineer for building quality into development workflows. 
 - Challenge at least one existing practice with data and propose a better approach. 
 - Review the codebase and identify the three biggest quality gaps based on data, propose solutions, and build tooling for at least one. 
 - Deliver a measurable improvement in quality via the test-generation pipeline, the merge guardrail, automation reliability, code review etc. 

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Aspire. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Aspire may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Aspire's Candidate Privacy Notice.
