data.title: Sr./Lead QA Automation Engineer – AI Agent
data.description:
Are you a quality engineer who wants to build confidence in a fast-evolving AI agent - not just execute manual test cases? At SimCorp, we are developing an internal AI agent that supports the software development lifecycle (SDLC): a production-grade, distributed agent hosted in Azure - running 24/7, accessible to everyone in the company, and spanning deep integrations with our engineering systems, secure code execution, and remote development capabilities on user machines. 

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and evolve the quality strategy for this product. The product's risk sits in cross-service behavior - where agent runs, tool calls, external integrations, and cloud infrastructure meet. The role blends hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features and AI behavior with designing and building the automated test system - acceptance, integration, contract, and post-deployment validation - that lets the team ship quickly without breaking critical engineering workflows. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a QA Automation Engineer on this team, you will: 

Test strategy and hands-on testing

- Define and own the product's test strategy across unit, functional, integration, acceptance, post-deployment, and exploratory testing. 
 - Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features, AI-agent behavior, and edge cases before and alongside automation. 
 - Design approaches for testing non-deterministic AI/LLM behavior, tool-use correctness, and prompt regressions. 

Automated coverage

- Build browser-level acceptance tests that cover key user journeys end to end, from the UI down to persistence and background processing. 
 - Create validation for MCP endpoints, including authentication flows, client compatibility, and tool schemas. 
 - Design contract and replay-based tests for critical external integrations where live systems are slow, expensive, or unstable. 
 - Strengthen test coverage for the highest-risk execution surfaces: sandboxed code execution and the agent's remote sessions on user machines. 

Release confidence and test infrastructure

- Add post-deployment smoke tests that catch environment, configuration, and identity failures, giving rollback confidence. 
 - Introduce failure-injection scenarios - service restarts, network loss, expired tokens, rate limits - to prove the product degrades gracefully. 
 - Improve test data, fixtures, fake connectors, and CI test categorization; manage flaky tests and keep pipelines fast and trustworthy. 

Collaboration and quality leadership

- Partner with engineers to make features testable and define acceptance criteria before implementation; mentor the team in testing practices. 
 - Monitor quality signals from CI, static analysis, telemetry, production incidents, and user feedback, and build release-readiness reporting. 

What We Value

- Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We expect you to be strong in several of the following and interested in learning the rest: 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. 
 - 6+ years of experience in quality engineering / test automation for complex web and API platforms. 
 - Strong C#/. NET test development skills: xUnit/NUnit-style frameworks, mocks and fakes, test fixtures, and CI integration. 
 - Solid experience with API and integration testing, including authentication and distributed-system failure modes. 
 - Experience with browser automation such as Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent. 
 - Strong manual and exploratory testing skills, and the ability to design test strategies rather than only execute predefined cases. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, test categorization, flaky-test management, and post-deployment smoke testing. 
 - Ability to investigate failures using logs, traces, telemetry, screenshots, and reproducible minimal scenarios. 
 - Experience testing AI/LLM products, agentic workflows, streaming responses, or other non-deterministic behavior is a strong advantage. 
 - At least 1 year of hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex in your daily work. 
 - Familiarity with open-source agents (e. g. , OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, or similar) and how they behave in practice. 
 - Passion for the AI space and the flexibility to try new technologies: you stay on top of market trends and bring the ecosystem's best practices - better memory, context management, and agent autonomy - into how we build and test the product. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux and containerized environments (Docker), enough to test and investigate sandboxed code execution, is a strong advantage. 
 - Experience with Test containers, contract testing, Azure identity, or Windows automation is a plus. 
 - Proven ability to lead quality direction, influence engineers, and raise the testing bar across a team. 
 - Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture - Inclusive and diverse company culture. 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace. 
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes. 
 - Career & Growth - Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.title: Director, Technology & Engineering for Software and Workflows
data.description:
Summary

Imagine leading the organization that turns emerging technologies, scientific ambition, and bold ideas into software that helps researchers discover medicines faster. 

As Director of Technology & Engineering within Novartis Biomedical Research Data & Digital Software & Workflows, you will shape how high-quality, AI-enabled software solutions are designed, built, and delivered across scientific workflows and laboratory processes. You will lead software engineering and AI engineering leaders, set a clear technical direction, and create the conditions for teams to deliver meaningful outcomes with speed, quality, and confidence. 

This is an opportunity for a curious, learning-oriented technology leader who can navigate complexity, anticipate what is next, and translate strategy into focused execution. You will bring together talented people across engineering, science, architecture, operations, security, and enterprise technology, challenging established approaches, making thoughtful trade-offs, and helping teams learn and grow as they deliver. 

About The Role

Internal job title: Director, Technology & Engineering

Position Location: Hyderabad

The Software & Workflows organization partners with scientists, data experts, and AI specialists across Novartis Biomedical Research to transform scientific workflows and laboratory processes. Our ambition is to make advanced digital and AI capabilities usable, scalable, and impactful, helping teams generate better insights, improve decisions, and accelerate the discovery of innovative medicines. 

You will lead technology and engineering execution across a broad portfolio of time-bound software delivery initiatives. Your role will combine strategic technical leadership with delivery accountability: building a high-performing organization, advancing modern and AI-enabled engineering practices, and ensuring that solutions meet demanding standards for quality, performance, security, compliance, and reliability. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead with purpose: Set a compelling direction for technology and engineering, connecting team priorities and technical choices to scientific impact and organizational strategy. 
 - Shape a learning culture: Encourage curiosity, experimentation, constructive challenge, and learning from outcomes while fostering urgency, trust, clarity, and shared ownership. 
 - Build exceptional teams: Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers, technical leaders, and AI engineering capabilities while creating opportunities for people to grow and thrive. 
 - Accelerate AI-enabled engineering: Champion the responsible integration of AI tools and agents into a robust, modern engineering framework and practices. 
 - Raise the engineering bar: Advance scalable architecture, DevOps, continuous integration and delivery, test automation, observability, and operational excellence. 
 - Protect sustainable value: Ensure engineering approaches align with enterprise strategy, architectural standards, security, compliance, and responsible AI governance. 
 - Influence beyond authority: Build trusted relationships across organizational boundaries and communicate complex technical topics in ways that enable timely, informed decisions. 
 - Create alignment: Partner with delivery, architecture, operations, security, compliance, enterprise technology teams, and software vendors to turn diverse perspectives into clear decisions and coordinated action. 
 - Deliver meaningful outcomes: Own engineering execution across a broad portfolio of initiatives, ensuring high-quality solutions are delivered predictably within agreed scope, budget, and timelines. 
 - Navigate complexity: Apply strategic agility to manage dependencies, risks, resources, and trade-offs, adapting plans as priorities and technologies evolve. 

Essential Requirements

You are an inspiring and pragmatic technology leader who combines strategic perspective with a strong bias for execution. In short, while your expertise is in technology, your passion is with the outcomes. You are energized by complex problems, motivated by scientific impact, and committed to helping people perform at their best. 

You Bring

- Significant experience leading technology functions, engineering managers, technical leaders, and multidisciplinary software teams in a global, matrixed environment. 
 - A strong learning mindset and curiosity, with the ability to explore emerging technologies, seek diverse perspectives, and turn new insights into practical action. 
 - Strategic agility-the ability to connect long-term direction with near-term priorities, simplify complexity, and adapt decisively as circumstances evolve. 
 - A track record of leading large-scale SaaS, commercial, custom-built, on-premises, and cloud-based software solutions with measurable business or scientific impact. 
 - Deep understanding of modern AI-enabled software engineering practices, including DevOps, continuous integration and delivery, test automation, and Agile or Lean delivery. 
 - Experience integrating AI models, agents, or other AI-enabled capabilities into production software and engineering workflows. 
 - Demonstrated success leading complex, time-bound initiatives and improving delivery predictability, quality, and operational performance. 
 - Excellent communication and influencing skills, including the ability to engage senior leaders and translate technical complexity into clear choices and recommendations. 
 - A leadership style grounded in integrity, empowerment, accountability, collaboration, and genuine commitment to developing others. 
 - The courage to challenge the status quo, take thoughtful risks, learn quickly, and help teams turn uncertainty into progress. 

Desirable Requirements

- Experience in the pharmaceutical industry, life sciences, research, or another highly regulated environment. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed teams and collaborating across scientific, technical, vendor, and enterprise functions. 
 - Evidence of building inclusive, high-performing cultures in which people learn from one another and achieve more together. 

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will shape a technical organization known for clarity, learning, and dependable delivery excellence. Teams will understand how their work contributes to scientific outcomes, leaders will grow in capability and confidence, and partners will experience Technology & Engineering as a trusted force for progress. Together, you will turn emerging possibilities into reliable solutions that help advance drug discovery. 

You'll receive: You can find everything you need to know about our benefits and rewards in the Novartis Life Handbook. https: //www. novartis. com/careers/benefits-rewards

Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams' representative of the patients and communities we serve. 

Join our Novartis Network: If this role is not suitable to your experience or career goals but you wish to stay connected to hear more about Novartis and our career opportunities, join the Novartis Network here: 

https: //talentnetwork. novartis. com/network

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients' lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https: //www. novartis. com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Benefits and Rewards: Learn about all the ways we'll help you thrive personally and professionally. 

Read our handbook (PDF 30 MB)

data.title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Position Summary

Renesas Electronics is seeking an experienced Product Engineer ( Senior Staff level) to lead the development, qualification, release, and sustaining of advanced semiconductor power products. This role is responsible for driving product engineering execution across the full lifecycle, from silicon bring-up through high-volume production, with a strong focus on product quality, yield optimization, reliability, and customer success. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in power semiconductor technologies (e. g. , Point of loads (POL), Hotswap/Efuse, Drivers solutions) and demonstrate strong ownership of complex technical challenges while influencing cross-functional teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own product engineering activities across the full lifecycle, including silicon bring-up, characterization, qualification, production release, and sustaining

- Define and execute comprehensive product qualification strategies aligned to JEDEC and industry standards

- Drive reliability stress planning and interpretation, including HTOL, HAST/uHAST, TC, ELFR, and associated qualification methodologies. 

- Lead ESD and latch-up qualification strategy, data analysis, and failure resolution in alignment with product requirements. 

- Lead root cause analysis and resolution of complex product, test, and manufacturing issues

- Drive improvements in yield, test efficiency, product performance, and cost of quality

- Define and execute characterization and qualification strategies to ensure robust product release

- Partner with design and test engineering teams to optimize DFT, test coverage, and correlation (bench vs ATE vs system)

- Lead cross-functional efforts to resolve customer issues and field escalations

- Analyse yield, parametric, and reliability data to identify trends and drive corrective actions

- Influence product, test, and manufacturing decisions through strong technical judgment and data-driven insights

- Serve as a recognized subject matter expert in product engineering, statistical analysis, reliability, and failure analysis. 

- Lead cross-functional efforts across design, applications, reliability, and test teams to resolve highly complex technical challenges. 

- Provide leadership in defining characterization plans, qualification strategies, and analysis methodologies. 

- Communicate complex analytical findings, qualification results, and failure analysis conclusions to diverse stakeholders, including senior leadership. 

- Influence product release decisions through data-driven insight, technical expertise, and sound engineering judgment. 

- Act as a key authority on product readiness, with accountability for decisions impacting product quality and business outcomes. 

- Work on complex, ambiguous problems requiring evaluation of incomplete or conflicting data, applying conceptual and statistical thinking to determine optimal solutions. 

- Anticipate technical risks in product performance, qualification adequacy, and reliability margins, and proactively drive improvements. 

- Contribute to development of best practices in qualification methodology, data analysis, and engineering decision frameworks. 

- Mentor junior engineers in advanced statistical techniques, reliability interpretation, and structured problem solving and contribute to development of best practices

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Microelectronics Engineering

- 10+ years of experience in semiconductor product engineering, test engineering, or related roles

- Strong experience in semiconductor industry, with preference for power / analog / mixed-signal products

- Deep understanding of product lifecycle (NPI through sustaining)

- Strong working knowledge of JEDEC standards (e. g. , JESD47, JESD22 series) and industry qualification practices. 

- Hands-on experience with ESD qualification (HBM, CDM) and latch-up testing/analysis. 

- Experience with reliability stress planning and interpretation (HTOL, HAST, TC, ELFR, etc. ). 

- Proven track record solving complex technical and yield-related issues

- Strong data analysis skills (JMP, Python, MATLAB or similar)

- Demonstrated success driving efficiency improvements in characterization, qualification, and yield analysis workflows. 

- Experience with ATE, silicon characterization, and production environments

- Deep expertise in statistical analysis, including distribution analysis, correlation analysis, and limit optimization. 

- Strong background in product characterization and electrical performance evaluation. 

- Extensive experience in reliability qualification, ESD, and latch-up methodologies. 

- Demonstrated expertise in failure analysis and root cause investigation across multiple failure modes. 

- Proven leadership in solving highly complex technical problems using data-driven approaches. 

- Experience influencing engineering decisions and leading cross-functional technical initiatives. 

- Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Successfully lead on-time product releases with robust characterization and qualification coverage

- Drive measurable improvements in yield, test cost, and product quality

- Achieve timely resolution of critical product and customer issues

- Establish strong correlation between bench, ATE, and system-level performance

- Influence key product and test decisions to improve competitiveness

- Contribute to team capability growth through mentorship and technical leadership

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure-delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud. 

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function. 

Job Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer for DataPelago data processing customer success, you will develop workload assets and automation tools for product validation and product support which will help ensure customers deploy and operate DataPelago data processing products successfully in production. You will apply AI effectively in combination with the knowledge from both product validation and product support to proactively avoid bugs and issues and to drastically reduce time to diagnose, mitigate, and resolve bugs and issues. 

Job Requirements

What You'll Do: 

- Design, Develop synthetic workload queries and datasets for testing DPA-S, which reflect the essential environment and workload characteristics represented in the field. 
 - Develop analysis and diagnostic tools that analyze various logs from DPA-S, Apache Spark, and their deployment environment to aid in pinpointing the root cause of functional and performance anomalies and potential mitigations and resolutions.

data.title: Staff Engineer - Telephony
data.description:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC. 

The Role

Samvaad is a conversational AI platform for enterprises, startups, digital natives, and governments. We are hiring hands-on technical owners who can take ambiguous problems through to reliable production systems. 

At the heart of Sarvam's conversational AI platform sits the system that lets our customers build, configure, deploy, and operate voice agents and campaigns - at scale. The platform currently powers millions of voice calls a day that are deeply personalised and understands the users. 

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to own this system end-to-end. The data model. The APIs. The orchestration. The reliability. The performance. The standards we hold ourselves to. This is an IC role with the scope and authority of one - no people management, just the systems and the bar. 

What You'll Own

- The end-to-end backend for agent, campaign, and user management - from data modeling through API design to deployment, in Python and FastAPI
 - Workflow orchestration with Temporal for complex, long-running, stateful operations
 - Performance and reliability for a multi-tenant SaaS platform operating at sub-second latency SLOs
 - Observability - logging, metrics, tracing - so the team can debug production confidently and quickly
 - Integration testing - the test infrastructure that lets us ship fast without breaking customer-facing systems
 - Close collaboration with the frontend team (Next. js) to deliver an experience worthy of the underlying platform
 - Setting the design-first and documentation-first engineering culture within your team - RFCs before code, decisions written down, no tribal knowledge

What We're Looking For

- 8-12 years building production backend systems, with deep expertise in Python and FastAPI (or Golang)
 - Must-have experience in building telephony infrastructure, primarily SIP / VoIP
 - A track record of full-stack ownership - you've designed systems end-to-end, made the trade-offs, and operated them in production
 - Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration at scale, ideally Temporal
 - Built and operated high-scale distributed systems - multi-tenant, low-latency, resilient under real load
 - Strong PostgreSQL and Redis fundamentals - schema design, query performance, caching strategy
 - The judgment to know when to build vs. buy, when to optimize vs. ship, when to abstract vs. inline

Nice to Have

- Experience building products on top of LLMs or AI/ML systems
 - Time at an early- or growth-stage startup - comfort with ambiguity, speed, and ownership

Founded in 2011, ReNew, is one of the largest renewable energy companies globally, with a leadership position in India. Listed on Nasdaq under the ticker RNW, ReNew develops, builds, owns, and operates utility-scale wind energy projects, utility-scale solar energy projects, utility-scale firm power projects, and distributed solar energy projects. In addition to being a major independent power producer in India, ReNew is evolving to become an end-to-end decarbonization partner providing solutions in a just and inclusive manner in the areas of clean energy, green hydrogen, value-added energy offerings through digitalisation, storage, and carbon markets that increasingly are integral to addressing climate change. With a total capacity of more than 13. 4 GW (including projects in pipeline), ReNew's solar and wind energy projects are spread across 150+ sites, with a presence spanning 18 states in India, contributing to 1. 9 % of India's power capacity. Consequently, this has helped to avoid 0. 5% of India's total carbon emissions and 1. 1% India's total power sector emissions. In the over 10 years of its operation, ReNew has generated almost 1. 3 lakh jobs, directly and indirectly. ReNew has achieved market leadership in the Indian renewable energy industry against the backdrop of the Government of India's policies to promote growth of this sector. ReNew's current group of stockholders contains several marquee investors including CPP Investments, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Goldman Sachs, GEF SACEF and JERA. Its mission is to play a pivotal role in meeting India's growing energy needs in an efficient, sustainable, and socially responsible manner. ReNew stands committed to providing clean, safe, affordable, and sustainable energy for all and has been at the forefront of leading climate action in India.

data.title: SAP Architect
data.description:
Key Responsibilities

Architecture and design authority

- Own and publish the target-state architecture for SAP S/4HANA across FICO, OTC, PTP and the supporting technical stack, and maintain the roadmap that gets Ariat there. 
 - Chair the design authority for all SAP change: approve solution designs, reject designs that create upgrade debt, and hold the line on clean-core principles. 
 - Set the extensibility policy - what may be built in-core, what must move to SAP BTP, and what should be solved through configuration or standard functionality. 
 - Govern the custom ABAP estate: establish coding standards, measure and drive down custom-code footprint, and own the remediation backlog. 

Integration and cross-platform design

- Own the integration architecture between S/4HANA and Centric PLM, Infios WMS, Manhattan Active Omni, the Shopify commerce platform and the Snowflake data platform. 
 - Define the migration path for PI/PO-based interfaces and set the standard for new integration development. 
 - Act as the SAP-side architectural counterpart to the Shopify Architect and the Manhattan POS/OMS Lead on order, inventory, pricing and customer master data flows. 

Controls, risk and operational quality

- Ensure SAP designs satisfy SOX IT general controls, segregation of duties and GRC requirements, and support internal and external audit as the design authority of record. 
 - Set non-functional standards for performance, transport and release governance, environment strategy and disaster recovery. 
 - Partner with Information Security on identity, access and data-protection design across GDPR and CCPA obligations. 

Technical leadership

- Provide technical direction to the SAP build community in Hyderabad - ABAP developers, PI/PO integration engineers, functional analysts across FICO, OTC and PTP, Basis, GRC and QA. 
 - Set the hiring bar for SAP technical roles in Hyderabad and participate directly in interviewing and selection. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and functional analysts toward architecture-level thinking.

data.title: Lead – QMS & ESG
data.description:
Soleos Energy Limited is seeking an experienced Lead - QMS & ESG to establish, implement, manage and continuously improve the company's Quality Management System (QMS) and Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) framework across its operations and projects. 

The incumbent will drive quality systems, process governance, audits, sustainability performance, ESG policies, environmental and social compliance, ESG data and reporting, risk management and continuous improvement. The role requires practical, hands-on experience in both QMS and ESG, along with the ability to work independently with senior management and cross-functional teams. Experience in Solar EPC / IPP / Renewable Energy will be a strong added advantage. 

Key Responsibilities

A. Quality Management System (QMS)

• Own, implement and continuously improve the organisation-wide Quality Management System. 

• Develop, review and maintain Quality Manuals, SOPs, policies, process maps, procedures, checklists, work instructions and departmental quality standards. 

• Establish systems for document control, process compliance, change management, traceability and record keeping. 

• Drive implementation and continual improvement of ISO 9001 and other applicable management-system standards. 

• Develop and monitor departmental and organisational quality KPIs, MIS and management dashboards. 

• Plan and conduct internal process, site, vendor, customer and certification audits, and coordinate closure of audit findings. 

• Establish and manage NCR, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA) systems, with focus on eliminating recurring issues. 

• Guide project teams on Project Quality Plans / QAPs, ITPs, inspection systems, supplier quality and handover documentation, where applicable. 

• Conduct periodic management reviews and report QMS performance, major non-conformities, systemic risks and improvement actions to Management. 

B. ESG & Sustainability

• Develop and implement Soleos's ESG strategy, policies, governance framework and implementation roadmap. 

• Establish measurable ESG objectives, KPIs and reporting mechanisms covering Environmental, Social and Governance parameters. 

• Create systems for collection, validation, consolidation and reporting of ESG-related data across departments, projects and entities. 

• Monitor environmental performance including energy use, greenhouse-gas emissions, water, waste, resource efficiency and environmental compliance. 

• Support development and implementation of Environmental & Social Management Systems (ESMS) for applicable projects. 

• Coordinate ESG / E&S due-diligence requirements of investors, lenders, customers and other stakeholders. 

• Establish and monitor appropriate frameworks relating to workforce practices, health & safety interface, human rights, ethics, governance, grievance mechanisms, community / stakeholder considerations and responsible supply chain. 

• Coordinate ESG assessments, sustainability audits, third-party evaluations and closure of identified gaps. 

• Support preparation of ESG / sustainability disclosures and reports in line with applicable customer, lender, regulatory or recognised reporting requirements. 

• Monitor emerging ESG requirements and translate them into practical actions for the organisation. 

C. Solar EPC / IPP Project QMS & ESG

• Support quality and ESG compliance across project development, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, handover and operations, as applicable. 

• Identify environmental, social and quality risks at project and supply-chain level and ensure appropriate mitigation and monitoring plans. 

• Drive contractor, subcontractor and supplier compliance with applicable project quality and ESG requirements. 

• Support project teams during lender / investor technical, ESG and E&S due diligence, including data-room documentation and action tracking. 

• Support compliance with project-specific environmental and social commitments and internationally accepted E&S standards where applicable. 

D. Audits, Compliance & Management Reporting

• Develop and manage an annual QMS and ESG audit calendar covering functions, projects, vendors and critical processes. 

• Coordinate ISO certification, surveillance and recertification audits and ensure timely closure of observations and non-conformities. 

• Maintain dashboards for QMS performance, ESG performance, audits, NCR / CAPA ageing, recurring issues, key risks and action closures. 

• Conduct periodic management reviews and recommend corrective, preventive and improvement initiatives. 

• Work with department heads to establish clear ownership, timelines and accountability for all QMS and ESG actions.

data.description:
Role : Quality Assurance Lead

Location: Bangalore/ Hyderabad / Mumbai

Role Summary

Every release to a government client must be demonstrably correct, secure and fit for purpose. The Quality Assurance Lead has the end-to-end test strategy for the data and AI platform. They make sure that pipelines, data, reports, AI components and integrations are verified against requirements before they reach business users. 

The role works alongside business analysts, data engineers, the data quality engineer, AI engineers and SUTHERLAND UAT teams. Its job is to provide evidence-based quality sign-off at every phase gate, from System Integration Testing through UAT to production go-live. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test strategy and planning: Define and own the master test strategy, test plans, entry/exit criteria and quality gates across all delivery phases. 
 - Data testing: Lead data validation testing, including source-to-target reconciliation, transformation logic, business rules, SCD behavior, referential integrity and data completeness across the Bronze, Silver and Gold layers. 
 - Test automation: Design and implement automated data and regression test frameworks using SQL, Python/PySpark and tools such as Great Expectations or pytest, integrated into CI/CD. 
 - Report and analytics testing: Verify Power BI reports, KPIs, calculations, filters, row-level security and performance against agreed business definitions. 
 - AI and GenAI testing: Coordinate evaluation of AI components for accuracy, relevance, bias, safety and hallucination, working with the AI engineers. 
 - Non-functional testing: Coordinate performance, security, vulnerability and access-control testing in line with DESC ISR requirements. 
 - UAT support: Partner with the Business Analyst to prepare UAT scenarios, support business testers, and manage defect triage through to sign-off. 
 - Defect management: Run defect lifecycle management, severity classification, root-cause analysis and quality reporting to program governance. 
 - Traceability and evidence: Maintain traceability from requirements to test cases, test results and defects, and produce test summary reports as audit evidence. 
 - Team leadership and knowledge transfer: Lead and mentor the QA team, and transfer test assets and practices to SUTHERLAND teams for ongoing regression assurance. 

Qualifications and Experience

- 7+ years in software and data quality assurance, with at least 3 years leading QA on data platform, data warehouse or analytics programs. 
 - Strong hands-on data testing skills, with advanced SQL and working Python/PySpark. 
 - Experience with test automation frameworks, CI/CD integration and test management tools such as Azure DevOps Test Plans, Jira/Xray or equivalent. 
 - Understanding Lakehouse/Medallion architecture, ETL/ELT, dimensional modelling and data reconciliation. 
 - Experience testing Power BI reports and, ideally, AI/ML or GenAI components. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services and Microsoft Purview. 
 - Certifications such as ISTQB Advanced / Test Manager are an advantage. 
 - Excellent English communication, reporting and stakeholder-management skills; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.

data.title: Senior Enterprise Software Test Engineer
data.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. 

A Day in the Life

The Mazor Robotics Program within Medtronic develops software-enabled technologies that support complex medical device systems used in patient care. This role is part of the Verification and Validation (V&V) function, focused on ensuring product quality through test strategy development, requirements traceability, manual testing, and test automation across complex electro-mechanical systems. 

This position is based in India and follows a Flex work model, combining remote and in-office work. No travel is required for this role. 

This role is responsible for developing and executing verification and validation activities for complex medical device systems. The Senior Enterprise Software Engineer partners with cross-functional engineering teams to translate product requirements into test protocols, establish automated testing solutions, maintain design control documentation, and ensure complete requirements coverage throughout the product development lifecycle. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Develop test protocols and validation strategies based on system and product requirements. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain automated test frameworks and test scenarios. 
 - Execute system-level and software-level verification activities for complex electro-mechanical products. 
 - Perform requirements traceability analysis to ensure complete test coverage. 
 - Create and maintain design control documentation in accordance with Quality Management System requirements. 
 - Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, and quality engineering teams to resolve product issues and testing challenges. 
 - Identify technical risks, limitations, and verification gaps and recommend mitigation strategies. 
 - Support continuous improvement of test methodologies, automation approaches, and product quality practices. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree OR Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or Electrical Engineering with 8+ years of software testing experience. 
 - Experience developing test protocols and executing verification and validation activities for software-based systems. 
 - Experience with software test automation frameworks and automated testing methodologies. 
 - Experience with requirements management tools and configuration management tools. 
 - Experience documenting and maintaining design control artifacts within regulated development environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing medical devices or other regulated products. 
 - Experience with Ranorex, Playwright, Selenium, C#, . NET, and Python. 
 - Knowledge of Food and Drug Administration (FDA) software regulations and guidance. 
 - Knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, and related medical device standards. 
 - Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams in product development environments. 

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 





Recruitment Fraud Alert

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind: 

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic. com email addresses. 

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate. 

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments. 

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic. com. 

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage. 



This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

data.title: Performance Testing
data.description:
About The Opportunity

A dynamic IT services and solutions provider operating across India, we enable enterprises to deliver high-performing, scalable, and resilient digital experiences through advanced testing and quality engineering practices. Our clients span BFSI, telecom, and e-commerce-relying on us to prevent performance bottlenecks before production. We're scaling our performance engineering team to own mission-critical load, stress, and scalability testing for next-gen cloud-native platforms. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Design and execute end-to-end performance test strategies for web, mobile, and API-based applications under varying load conditions. 
 - Script, parameterize, and run performance test scenarios using JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling to simulate real-world user behavior. 
 - Analyze system bottlenecks-CPU, memory, network, DB-using APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics) and deliver actionable optimization recommendations. 
 - Integrate performance testing into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or GitLab CI to enable shift-left performance validation. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps and SRE teams to tune auto-scaling policies, API gateways, and caching layers based on test results. 
 - Prepare comprehensive performance test reports, dashboards, and root cause analyses for stakeholders and engineering leads. 

Skills & Qualifications

- Must-Have
 - JMeter
 - LoadRunner
 - Gatling
 - APM Tools
 - CI/CD Integration
 - Performance Metrics Analysis
 - Cloud Platforms
 - REST API Testing
 - Preferred
 - K6
 - NeoLoad
 - Microservices Performance Tuning

Benefits & Culture Highlights

- On-site hybrid work model with modern infrastructure across major Indian tech hubs. 
 - Direct exposure to Fortune 500 client systems and high-scale transactional environments. 
 - Internal certifications and upskilling programs focused on cloud-native performance engineering. 

Skills: loadrunner, jmeter, performance metrics analysis

data.title: Assistant Manager - SQA
data.description:
Job Purpose

The Quality Engineer is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality systems and processes to ensure products meet internal standards, customer requirements, and industry regulations. This role supports manufacturing operations by analyzing quality data, leading root cause investigations, and driving corrective and preventive actions. The Quality Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams to improve product quality, enhance process efficiency, and ensure compliance with standards such as IATF 16949 and ISO 9001. This position plays a key role in promoting a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence. 

Job Duties And Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and sustain quality management systems in compliance with industry standards such as IATF 16949 and ISO 9001. 
 - Ensure documentation and procedures are up to date and effectively followed. 
 - Investigate product and process non-conformances using structured problem-solving tools (e. g. , 8D, Fishbone, 5 Whys). 
 - Drive the implementation of corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues. 
 - Participate in APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning), PPAP (Production Part Approval Process), and FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) activities to ensure product and process readiness. 
 - Collect and interpret quality metrics, including scrap rates, defect trends, and customer complaints. 
 - Use statistical tools to identify improvement opportunities and support continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Work closely with engineering, production, and supply chain teams to resolve quality issues. 
 - Interface with customers to address concerns, manage quality documentation, and support audits or visits. 

Education And Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or 4+ years of applicable experience 
 - 3+ years of experience

Skills

- Strong working knowledge of automotive quality systems and tools, including APQP, PPAP, FMEA, MSA, SPC, and Control Plans. 
 - Familiarity with ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 standards is essential for ensuring compliance and driving quality assurance throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Ability to analyze complex data sets, identify root causes of quality issues, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Experience with Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, and statistical analysis tools (e. g. , Minitab, Excel) is highly valued.

AI Developer / Architect

About The Company

Our client is building PT, a UK-based public affairs intelligence platform that gives political parties, think tanks, regulators, and large corporates (energy, tobacco, finance) real-time visibility into public opinion, policy shifts, and regulatory changes. Unlike tools that rely on synthetic or model-trained data, Polstream captures real-time human data at scale through a partnership with Peel Spectrum, one of the world''s largest polling aggregators. 

The platform has just launched in Australia and is actively onboarding its first customers, with New Zealand, the UK, and the US as the next target markets. 

The Role

The current Chief Architect has been fully dedicated to PT for 9 months and needs to step back. You will come in as a senior developer/architect who can take significant ownership of the product, technically but, more importantly, conceptually. The Chief Architect will mentor and guide you through the transition, gradually reducing involvement as you grow into the role. 

This is not a role for someone who executes tickets. The core challenge here is not the technology it is the domain. You need to genuinely understand politics, public opinion, regulation, and market research to architect the AI pipelines and data models that power the product. The technology can be learned the domain understanding cannot be skipped.

- Frontend: React

 - Deep understanding of AI architectures, including how to design and architect AI pipelines for real-time, data-dense products
 - Strong written and verbal English. Non-negotiable given client-facing interaction with Australia, UK, and US stakeholders. 
 - Startup mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, focused on outcomes, and willing to wear multiple hats
 - Ability to work independently under mentorship and take ownership of the product

What We Are NOT Looking For

- Developers with 10 or more years of experience who are set in their ways

 - Anyone without awareness of politics, regulation, or public affairs. The domain is essential. 

Nice to Have

- Prior experience in public affairs, market research, political tech, or policy-adjacent products

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Machine Learning
data.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.   

Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U. S. , Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. 

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. 

  

What does the team work on?Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. While we are well-positioned to help shape the future of television - including TV advertising - around the world, continued success relies on its investment in our machine learning capabilities. Roku offers millions of options to our users: movies, episodes, news, sports, and channels from all around the world. The Roku Content Platform is key to onboarding content into the Roku ecosystem, delighting our customers. Building a content knowledge platform that provides insights to downstream systems like Search, Recommendations, Ads, and Voice to shape customers' experiences is why we're actively looking for a Senior Machine Learning / AI Engineering Manager, Content Platform who can drive further innovation. 

  

What is the role?Roku is seeking a Senior Machine Learning / AI Engineering Manager, Content Platform to lead and advance machine learning capabilities within the Content Platform organization. This role is responsible for defining the ML roadmap, guiding model architecture and MLOps infrastructure, and ensuring that ML systems are scalable and production-ready. The Senior ML / AI Engineering Manager will lead a high-performing team of ML Engineers, driving career development, performance management, and a culture of rigorous experimentation. This individual will partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Content Strategy to align ML initiatives with business goals and deliver measurable improvements to the production environment. The ideal candidate combines deep technical ML expertise with strong organizational leadership, serving as the architectural and operational bridge between AI research and fast-paced product delivery. This role also involves integrating Generative AI capabilities and Vision Models to enrich content quality and user engagement across the Roku ecosystem. 

How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. Ideally, you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain - coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. 

What are the responsibilities of the role?
 - Define and own the roadmap for ML within the Content Platform, establishing a multi-year vision and translating it into iterative delivery cycles
 - Provide high-level guidance on model architecture and MLOps infrastructure to ensure models are scalable and production-ready
 - Lead and grow a high-performing team of ML Engineers, including career development, performance management, and fostering a culture of rigorous experimentation
 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and Content Strategy to align ML initiatives with business goals
 - Champion a culture of incremental delivery, balancing long-term R&D with the need to ship measurable improvements to the production environment
 - Integrate Generative AI capabilities and Vision Models to enrich content quality and user engagement
 - Drive the development of a content knowledge platform that provides insights to downstream systems such as Search, Recommendations, Ads, and Voice
What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?
 - 15+ years of total experience in software or ML engineering, with at least 5 years in a dedicated people management leadership role
 - Deep theoretical and practical understanding of Machine Learning
 - Understanding of the streaming business and how ML directly impacts business outcomes
 - Ability to communicate complex model concepts to non-technical stakeholders as effectively as debating architecture with experienced engineers
 - Proven track record of deploying large-scale ML models into production environments
 - Experience with modern ML stacks (e. g. , LLMs, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark, and cloud-native MLOps tools)
 - MS or BS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field  

#LN-DS4 What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. 

  

What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). data.title: Sr Manager, Software Engineering
data.description:
JOB ROLE : SENIOR MANAGER, SOFTWARE ENGINEERING

Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)

Department: Product Development

About Ghx

GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the world's largest cloud-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. GHX continues to innovate with intelligent automation and AI-driven capabilities across its product portfolio. 

About The Role

GHX is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a multi-disciplinary engineering team that powers intelligent, AI-augmented automation across multiple product lines with document understanding - extracting structured meaning from unstructured documents and data - as one of its core technical problems. This team spans three areas: a platform engineering team (AI, DevOps, Infra, architecture, business continuity, security etc. ), a set of product-line delivery teams (each building product-specific business logic, validation, and integrations), and a team building the Human-in-the-Loop (HiTL) application along with reporting/analytics capabilities. 

You will lead through team leads or senior engineers rather than running delivery for a single team directly. You will set technical direction for shared platform capabilities that every product-line team depends on, while ensuring each product line independently meets its own functionality, quality, and delivery commitments. You will work directly with business, product, and operations stakeholders across every product line this platform serves, and you will own end-to-end outcomes: people, technical direction, and customer impact across the full teams. 

Responsibilities

Organizational & Engineering Leadership: 

- Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary team spanning platform engineering, product-line delivery teams, and HiTL/analytics, working through team leads and senior engineers rather than direct, single-team execution. 
 - Set technical direction for shared platform capabilities (AI/agents, infra, security, cost optimization, eval pipelines) that multiple product-line teams depend on. 
 - Build and grow leads and senior engineers within each team, developing the next layer of technical leadership, not just individual contributors. 
 - Own the vendor relationship for external development partners: define interface contracts, hold delivery leads accountable across teams, and resolve cross-team dependencies. 
 - Establish org-wide engineering culture, standards, and practices that scale consistently across all three streams. 

Technical Direction & Architecture: 

- Guide architectural and design decisions across product-line teams to ensure consistency, reuse, and alignment with the shared platform. 
 - Resolve cross-team technical trade-offs - for example, shared platform constraints versus a product line's specific needs. 
 - Engage hands-on selectively, on foundational platform decisions or critical blockers
 - Champion AI-augmented engineering practices (AI-assisted code generation, review, test automation) across all teams, ensuring adoption and responsible use of AI/LLM tooling with appropriate evaluation, monitoring, and human-in-the-loop controls. 

Stakeholder & Delivery Management: 

- Interface directly with business, product, operations and support stakeholders for each product line to align priorities, resolve conflicts, and ensure each line's functionality, quality, and timelines are independently met. 
 - Balance platform-level priorities, which are shared across all product lines, against individual product-line delivery commitments. 
 - Communicate delivery status, risk, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders at all levels, from individual product owners to senior leadership. 
 - Own the release process across teams: coordinate QA, product, and stakeholders to ship reliably across multiple concurrent product-line commitments. 

Operational Excellence: 

- Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability standards that scale across the platform and all product-line teams. 
 - Ensure robust testing practices (unit, component, integration) are a baseline across every team, not an afterthought. 
 - Champion CI/CD adoption and optimization across the team. 
 - Coordinate incident response and on-call coverage across the platform and product-line services. 
 - Collaborate with the Security team to resolve findings and complete compliance reviews across all teams in a timely manner. 

Qualifications

Experience: 

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years managing engineering managers, team leads, or senior tech leads - not only individual contributors. 
 - Demonstrated experience running two-three teams with a shared platform layer and independent delivery teams or pods. 
 - Proven track record of building and scaling engineering leadership - developing leads and senior engineers, not just growing headcount. 
 - Experience owning delivery against firm deadlines with external dependencies (vendor teams, APIs, platform dependencies) across multiple concurrent workstreams. 
 - Strong background in cloud-native, microservices-based architecture on AWS or Azure. 
 - Experience building document understanding or intelligent document processing systems - classification, extraction, OCR/layout analysis, or structured-data-from-unstructured-input pipelines - at production scale. 
 - Solid experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into production software - LLM-based pipelines, agentic workflows, or setting up eval pipelines - at a platform level serving multiple consuming teams. 

Technical Breadth: 

- Backend development: Python/Java, FastAPI. 
 - Frontend familiarity: Angular/React, JavaScript or TypeScript - enough to review and guide UI engineers. 
 - Cloud platforms: AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, S3, SQS, ECS/EKS, API Gateway) or equivalent Azure services. 
 - Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or other relational/NoSQL stores. 
 - CI/CD and infrastructure: GitHub Actions, Bamboo, Terraform, Docker, or similar. 
 - LLM tooling and frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Pydantic, or equivalent orchestration
 - Observability: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting - Datadog, LangSmith, or equivalent. 
 - Testing: Selenium, Playwright, Postman, or similar automation tools. 
 - AI-powered development tools: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar. 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree is a plus but not required. 

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

- Sets technical direction where a clear answer doesn't yet exist - comfortable operating in undefined problem spaces (agentic architecture, cost/latency trade-offs, evaluation methodology). 
 - Leads through leads: develops the layer of technical leadership beneath them rather than relying solely on personal technical authority. 
 - Represents the team to multiple business/product stakeholders simultaneously, each with independent and sometimes competing priorities. 
 - Strong communicator across all levels - explains technical trade-offs to engineers and leads, and business risk and roadmap impact to senior stakeholders, with equal clarity. 
 - Strategic thinker who keeps multi-quarter, cross-team outcomes in focus without losing sight of individual product-line delivery commitments. 
 - Decisive under ambiguity - gathers the right inputs across teams, makes the call, and owns the outcome. 
 - High emotional maturity: handles delivery pressure, stakeholder conflict, and cross-team trade-offs with composure and directness. 

What Success Looks Like In The First 6 Months

- You have built trust with team leads and engineers across all three teams and understand the platform and product-line systems deeply enough to make sound cross-team technical decisions. 
 - Delivery is predictable across every product line - stakeholders are not surprised by slippage, and each team ships on its committed roadmap. 
 - The shared platform (AI/agents, infra, eval pipelines, cost optimization) is visibly maturing and reducing duplicated effort across product-line teams. 
 - You have a clear view of vendor performance and stakeholder relationships across every product line the team serves. 

GHX: It's the way you do business in healthcare

Global Healthcare Exchange (GHX) enables better patient care and billions in savings for the healthcare community by maximizing automation, efficiency and accuracy of business processes. 

GHX is a healthcare business and data automation company, empowering healthcare organizations to enable better patient care and maximize industry savings using our world class cloud-based supply chain technology exchange platform, solutions, analytics and services. We bring together healthcare providers and manufacturers and distributors in North America and Europe - who rely on smart, secure healthcare-focused technology and comprehensive data to automate their business processes and make more informed decisions. 

It is our passion and vision for a more operationally efficient healthcare supply chain, helping organizations reduce - not shift - the cost of doing business, paving the way to delivering patient care more effectively. Together we take more than a billion dollars out of the cost of delivering healthcare every year. GHX is privately owned, operates in the United States, Canada and Europe, and employs more than 1000 people worldwide. Our corporate headquarters is in Colorado, with additional offices in Europe. 

Disclaimer

Global Healthcare Exchange, LLC and its North American subsidiaries (collectively, "GHX") provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable law. This EEO policy applies to all terms, conditions, and privileges of employment, including hiring, training and development, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, educational assistance, termination, layoffs, social and recreational programs, and retirement. GHX believes that employees should be provided with a working environment which enables each employee to be productive and to work to the best of his or her ability. We do not condone or tolerate an atmosphere of intimidation or harassment based on race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. GHX expects and requires the cooperation of all employees in maintaining a discrimination and harassment-free atmosphere. Improper interference with the ability of GHX's employees to perform their expected job duties is absolutely not tolerated.

data.title: Software Engineer L3
data.description:
Who We Are

At Twilio, we're shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. 

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you're part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we're acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. 

Hiring And How We Work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio's next Software Engineer (L3). 

About The Job

The Compliance Experiences team sits at the heart of the Twilio platform, owning two critical domains: Phone Numbers and Compliance (KYC). 

In 2026, "getting a phone number" is no longer a simple API call; it requires sophisticated orchestration across global phone number inventory, real-time identity verification, regulatory compliance, and operational tooling at massive scale. 

Twilio's KYC Platform, the gateway to accessing all of Twilio's communication APIs, enables customers to securely provision and operate communication services globally while navigating complex, constantly evolving regulatory requirements. As a Software Engineer (L3), you will be a key technical contributor driving the feature design, execution, and operational health of platform services that process millions of requests. You will build scalable, high-performance solutions while working closely with engineering partners across Twilio to ensure alignment. You will own end-to-end feature delivery, author technical specs, and build robust APIs, microservices, and tooling relied on by cross-functional stakeholders. 

You will embrace AI-driven development workflows, using LLMs and agentic tools to accelerate code generation, expand automated test coverage, and translate complex business and regulatory requirements into executable logic. Your mission is to turn technical designs and blueprints into reliable, production-grade features. 

Responsibilities

In this role, you'll: 

- DRAW THE OWL: Contribute Significantly to the architecture and long-term technical roadmap for the Phone Numbers Platform, transitioning legacy systems into a modern, distributed microservices architecture that supports global scale. 
 - ACCELERATE WITH AI: Lead by example in using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude, or internal LLMs) to automate boilerplate, generate exhaustive test suites, and perform rapid prototyping. You will be measured on your ability to amplify your own output and the team's velocity through AI augmentation. 
 - BE AN OWNER: Drive technical excellence in the team, making critical architectural decisions that balance rapid feature innovation with world-class reliability and security. 
 - WEAR THE CUSTOMER'S SHOES: Partner with Product Managers to translate complex global telecommunications regulations and customer needs into elegant, developer-first APIs and application workflows. 
 - EMPOWER OTHERS: Mentor and uplift junior and mid level engineers. Foster a culture of technical curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. Teach the team how to move from "writing code" to "reviewing and orchestrating AI-generated logic" without sacrificing security or quality. 
 - RUTHLESSLY PRIORITIZE: Identify and mitigate technical risks early, ranging from scalability bottlenecks to security vulnerabilities and lead the team through complex production incidents with a focus on long-term remediation. 
 - WRITE IT DOWN: Articulate technical designs and system trade-offs clearly to your team and cross-functional partners through high-quality design documents, RFCs, and collaborative discussions. 

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

- Required: 
 - 5+ years of experience designing and developing highly available, high-scale, secure, mission-critical cloud-native enterprise distributed systems. 
 - Strong Proficiency in Java or Python with solid knowledge of AWS ecosystems (Lambda, EKS, DynamoDB, Kafka). 
 - Cloud-Native Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud-native infrastructure (AWS preferred), microservices patterns, and building highly resilient systems. 
 - AI-Augmented Development: Practical experience using AI tools (e. g. , Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to accelerate software delivery. You should be comfortable discussing how you use LLMs for debugging, code synthesis, and prototyping. 
 - API Design: Experience building and maintaining high-volume public-facing APIs with a focus on developer experience. 
 - Data Proficiency: Experience with high-throughput data processing and storage solutions (SQL/NoSQL, Redis, Kafka, or Spark). 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Familiarity with Kubernetes, Terraform, and modern CI/CD paradigms. 
 - Collaboration & Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions within your team through strong communication and technical credibility. 

Desired

- Platform Thinking: Experience building "internal platforms" that enable other developer teams to move faster. 
 - Agentic Systems: Experience building or integrating AI agents into internal developer platforms or automated ops workflows. 

Location

This role will be remote, and based in India . 

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. 

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. 

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values - something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. 

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. 

-

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio. com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps. 

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.
