data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

About Baxter

Baxter provides a broad portfolio of essential renal and hospital products, including home, acute and in-center dialysis; sterile IV solutions; infusion systems and devices; parenteral nutrition; surgery products and anesthetics; and pharmacy automation, software and services. The company's global footprint and the critical nature of its products and services play a key role in expanding access to healthcare in emerging and developed countries. Baxter's employees worldwide

are building upon the company's rich heritage of medical breakthroughs to advance the next generation of healthcare innovations that enable patient care. 

Job Summary

- Job Title - Principal Eng, Test
 - Location - Whitefield, Bangalore

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Lead the verification team to understand fully the design specification; design a verification environment and interact with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios. 
 - Lead the development of tests and the creation of top-level and block-level test-benches, stimulus and coverage metrics. 
 - Coordinate the debug process of failing test cases along with the design team. 
 - Ensure delivery of verified design blocks for sign-off, meeting defined functionality, performance and coverage requirements. Drive improvements in test execution, quality and delivery. 
 - Lead the development and documentation of product test case. 
 - Identifying Testing Risks and own the Risk Mitigation Plans. 
 - Work within Agile team to deliver quality products as one team
 - Guide the team on proper verification approach
 - Assist/guide in authoring, reviewing and execution of verification test cases
 - Provide input to Trace Matrix to ensure the traceability of the requirements to tests is intact
 - Co-ordinate the verification activities during SDLC
 - Compile Verification Test Summary Report at conclusion of formal verification phase for submission

Qualifications

- Ability to lead small to medium sized team technically and raising his/her own performance and others from time to time
 - A demonstrated track record in regulated software development, preferably medical devices or other highly regulated products such as aviation software. 
 - Experience in executing verification strategies including and not limited to functional, non-functional, reliability, performance. 
 - Experience in re-defining test architecture and test automation frameworks
 - Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process
 - Experienced and demonstrated superior global collaboration
 - Demonstrates spirit of innovation
 - Demonstrated risk taking ability and challenging status quo

Desired Characteristics

- Hand's on experience on defining the test strategy and test architecture for software applications
 - Minimum 3+ years practical software QA experience (
 - Excellent planning and organization skills, and committed to delivering on aggressive deadlines
 - Expertise in ALM and JIRA tool
 - Knowledge of Clear Quest, Team Center is preferred
 - Strong communication skills - written & verbal
 - Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work in a collaborative environment as well as independently with minimal supervision
 - Experience in Test Automation with Selenium is preferred
 - Knowledge of medical device software development is highly preferred including knowledge of standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971

Background And/or Experience

Bachelors / Masters in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering or related field and 10+ years of related experience.

data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

We are seeking a Principal Automation Engineer with 10+ years of experience defining automation architecture, technical roadmaps, and engineering standards for API, UI, integration, and end-to-end testing. The ideal candidate is a systems-oriented Quality Engineer who understands how products and services interconnect, sees the broader product architecture, and can decompose requirements to capture use cases holistically. This hands-on role will lead the development of scalable C#/. NET frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, guide cross-team adoption, and resolve complex automation and testability challenges across distributed products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the enterprise-grade automation architecture and roadmap for C#-based REST API, UI, integration, and workflow testing. 
 - Design modular frameworks with reusable libraries for configuration, service clients, page or component objects, test data, parallel execution, retries, logging, reporting, and environment management. 
 - Define coding standards, branching and review practices, framework governance, versioning, documentation, and contribution models. 
 - Establish pipeline strategy for pull-request validation, daily smoke tests, staged regression, release qualification, and automated quality gates. 
 - Guide teams on automation suitability, testability, coverage modelling, risk-based selection, and reduction of flaky or low-value tests. 
 - Lead technical reviews, proofs of concept, framework migrations, tool evaluations, and resolution of complex cross-service failures. 
 - Define dashboards and metrics for coverage, reliability, execution time, defect containment, failure causes, and productivity gains. 
 - Partner with architecture, software, DevOps, cybersecurity, systems, and verification leaders to embed quality throughout delivery.

 - Expertise in API contracts, distributed systems, microservices, event-driven integrations, databases, authentication, authorization, and service virtualization. 
 - Deep experience with Git, CI/CD architecture, parallel execution, automated reporting, and quality gates.

 - Knowledge of SIP infrastructure and media components such as Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, SBCs, registrars, RTP, and WebRTC.

data.description:
Ajaib is Indonesia's leading fintech platform, is seeking a highly skilled Sr. Software Development Engineer in Test II (Sr. SDET II) to drive quality engineering across our rapidly scaling microservices platform. As the technical leader of our QA/SDET function, you'll shape test strategy, build cutting-edge automation frameworks, and mentor SDETs to deliver zero-defect releases at scale. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities - ideal for someone passionate about test architecture, advanced automation, and quality culture, without full-time people management duties. 

What You'll Do

- Own test strategy and automation architecture for multiple squads or product areas spanning backend, frontend, and mobile
 - Design, build, and scale test automation frameworks for API, UI, contract, integration, and performance testing
 - Partner with engineering leads and architects to embed testability and quality gates into designs and CI/CD pipelines
 - Mentor and upskill SDET engineers, review their test designs, and drive best practices across squads
 - Lead cross-functional initiatives on non-functional testing - performance, reliability, security, and chaos engineering
 - Collaborate with DevOps to optimize test pipelines for speed, scalability, and reliability
 - Diagnose complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive systemic fixes
 - Innovate and introduce tools, test data solutions, mocks, and dashboards that improve developer productivity and release confidence. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
 - 6+ years of experience in QA/SDET/software engineering, with at least 2+ years designing frameworks and leading quality initiatives
 - Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript (can design and extend frameworks)
 - Expertise in modern automation tools (WebdriverIO, Cypress, Appium, Selenium, Playwright, REST Assured, etc. )
 - Proven experience testing distributed systems / microservices architectures, including API contract testing and service mocking
 - Solid understanding of performance, load, and security testing (JMeter, Gatling, k6, OWASP)
 - Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc. )
 - Exceptional debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills
 - Strong communicator with experience influencing engineers and stakeholders at multiple levels
 - Experience with AI-assisted automation tools or integrating AI to optimize test coverage and efficiency

Benefits

- Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
 - Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you 
 - Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
 - Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
 - Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
 - Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
 - Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
 - Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer - JL5
data.description:
Roles and Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement the lifecycle of services from conception to inception, including system design, build, and deployment
 - Develop software solutions to enable operability of large-scale distributed systems capable of handling millions of transactions and petabytes of data
 - Manage capacity and performance to help scale the infrastructure both on public and private clouds around the world
 - Define and implement standards and best practices related to: System Architecture, Deployment, metrics, operational tasks
 - Support services through activities such as monitoring availability, system health, and incident response
 - Improve system performance, application delivery and efficiency through automation, process refinement, postmortem reviews, and in-depth configuration analysis
 - Engage in Communications across all areas of the organization
 - Troubleshooting and monitoring production systems to ensure the highest uptimes are maintained
 - Support and improve upon existing high-availability architecture solutions as well as manage the operational activity. 
 - Integrate Generative AI (GenAI) and AIOps tools to automate incident detection, root cause analysis, and resolution workflows (e. g. , self-healing scripts, intelligent runbooks), reducing manual toil and accelerating response times. 
 - Apply Prompt Engineering techniques to enhance interactions with AI-based observability and automation platforms improving accuracy and efficiency of AI responses. 
 - Leverage platform-specific AI capabilities (e. g. , AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI) to architect intelligent SRE solutions tailored to cloud environments. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain AI/ML driven monitoring and alerting systems to proactively detect anomalies and predict potential failures, enabling preemptive remediation. 
 - Develop and train machine learning models using operational telemetry (logs, metrics, events, traces) to support predictive analytics and intelligent automation. 
 - Evaluate and deploy AIOps platforms (e. g. , Moogsoft, Dynatrace, Splunk, BigPanda, Datadog, Elastic) to enhance observability, reduce noise, and accelerate incident resolution. 
 - Experience in one or more high level programming languages like Python or Ruby or GoLang and familiar with Object Oriented Programming.

data.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
data.description:
About KontexIQ

KontexIQ is an AI-powered software delivery intelligence platform that helps teams understand and use the context already present across their software projects. 

KontexIQ connects information such as requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, bugs, test coverage, discussions, and delivery history to help teams identify gaps earlier, understand quality risks, and make more informed testing decisions. 

We are building AI-powered workflows for software delivery teams, and we're looking for a Test Automation Engineer who is excited about combining strong automation engineering practices with emerging AI-assisted testing capabilities. 

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Test Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain reliable automation frameworks and quality engineering workflows. 

You will work across UI and API automation, test framework development, integration testing, regression testing, and CI/CD. You will also contribute to how project context can be used to identify testing gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and improve software quality. 

This role is suited for someone who goes beyond simply executing test cases and enjoys building automation frameworks, testing standards, and scalable quality engineering practices. 

What You'll Do

Design, develop, and maintain scalable UI and API test automation frameworks. 

Build automated test scenarios for web applications and REST APIs. 

Develop reusable automation components, utilities, and test libraries. 

Define and improve automation standards, best practices, and quality engineering processes. 

Create and maintain automated regression, integration, and functional test suites. 

Collaborate with developers, product managers, architects, and QA engineers throughout the software development lifecycle. 

Analyze requirements and acceptance criteria to identify potential gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and quality risks. 

Validate application functionality across UI, APIs, integrations, and backend processes. 

Investigate automation failures and improve test reliability and maintainability. 

Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 

Contribute to test strategies, automation roadmaps, and quality standards. 

Participate in proof-of-concept initiatives involving modern testing approaches and AI-assisted quality engineering. 

Evaluate AI-generated test scenarios and identify opportunities to improve their accuracy, relevance, and coverage. 

Help establish processes for connecting project context with testing and quality decisions. 

What You'll Bring

2+ years of professional experience in software testing or test automation. 

Strong programming experience with TypeScript. 

Hands-on experience developing and maintaining UI automation frameworks. 

Strong experience with API automation testing. 

Experience with Java and API testing frameworks such as Rest Assured. 

Experience testing modern web applications. 

Strong understanding of REST APIs, integration testing, and backend validation. 

Experience designing automation frameworks and reusable testing components. 

Experience defining test strategies, automation approaches, or quality standards. 

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 

Experience working in Agile software development environments. 

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. 

Ability to understand requirements and identify potential testing gaps and risks. 

Strong communication and collaboration skills. 

Good to Have

Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar automation frameworks. 

Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira. 

Experience working on large-scale application migration or modernization projects. 

Experience with specification-driven or behavior-driven development approaches. 

Exposure to backend processing or batch-processing systems. 

Experience with test data management and environment management. 

Exposure to AI-assisted testing, LLMs, RAG, or AI agents. 

Experience evaluating AI-generated test cases or test scenarios. 

Experience with cloud platforms, containers, or modern DevOps tooling. 

Experience building evaluation frameworks for AI-powered applications. 

Why KontexIQ

At KontexIQ, you'll work on more than traditional test automation. 

Our platform uses project context - including requirements, dependencies, existing tests, bugs, and delivery history - to help teams understand what needs to be tested, where the risks are, and what may be missing. 

You'll have the opportunity to combine your expertise in test automation and quality engineering with emerging AI technologies to solve practical problems in software delivery. 

How We Work

Context over assumptions: We use the information already available in the project to make better decisions. 

Evidence-driven: AI recommendations should be supported by relevant project evidence. 

Engineering-first: We care about reliable, maintainable systems-not just prototypes. 

Continuous experimentation: We test, evaluate, learn, and improve. 

Ownership: We expect engineers to take responsibility for the problems they work on and the systems they build. 

Candidate Familiarization

Please visit the KontexIQ website and explore our product before applying. Familiarizing yourself with KontexIQ is a mandatory part of the application process, as we want candidates to understand the product, the problem we're solving, and the type of AI-powered software delivery systems you'll be working on. 

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your experience with UI/API automation, automation framework development, and software quality engineering

data.title: Staff Software Engineer - Frontend
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Software Engineer - Frontend based in India. 

This staff-level engineering role focuses on shaping a high-impact platform that enables highly customized user experiences at global scale. 

You'll help architect robust systems, build scalable interfaces, and improve the underlying runtime and templating capabilities that power complex frontend experiences. 

The role combines frontend and full-stack engineering with platform architecture, operational excellence, and technical leadership. 

You'll work primarily with React, Node. js, TypeScript, and Ruby while applying modern approaches such as microfrontend architecture. 

A major part of the position involves influencing technical direction, improving engineering standards, and collaborating across teams on large-scale initiatives. 

You'll also contribute to production reliability, continuous delivery, operational support strategies, and the development of other engineers. 

This opportunity is ideal for a highly experienced engineer who can tackle complex technical challenges while communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Accountabilities

- Platform architecture: Architect, develop, and maintain the runtime platform that powers customized frontend experiences, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable, maintainable, and performant. 
 - Scalable frontend development: Design and implement sophisticated user interfaces using microfrontend concepts to deliver flexible, high-quality, and intuitive experiences. 
 - Templating systems: Improve and evolve templating capabilities that enable engineering teams to build and customize platform experiences more efficiently and consistently. 
 - Full-stack engineering: Work across React, Node. js, TypeScript, and Ruby to develop platform capabilities and supporting services. 
 - Software quality: Produce clean, efficient, well-tested, and well-documented code while following established engineering standards and best practices. 
 - Technical communication: Explain complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through discussions, presentations, and design documentation. 
 - Cross-team initiatives: Collaborate with engineering teams on large-scale technical initiatives and contribute to the development of a unified, scalable global platform. 
 - Technical standards: Establish and evolve team-level technical standards, engineering practices, and operational processes that improve development effectiveness and system quality. 
 - Production reliability: Provide ongoing support for production UIs and services, including 24/7 operational coverage, with a focus on achieving 99. 99% uptime. 
 - Performance and scalability: Identify and recommend technical investments that improve the stability, performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability of production services. 
 - CI/CD: Build and improve modern Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery systems that enable reliable and deterministic software releases. 
 - Operational strategy: Develop intuitive and scalable operational support strategies that enable new and junior developers to effectively contribute to production support. 
 - Technical leadership: Support engineering leadership in assessing short- and long-term technical priorities, balancing immediate business needs with sustainable platform investments. 
 - Mentorship: Mentor junior developers and help them strengthen both their technical capabilities and professional skills. 

Requirements

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Professional experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience, including test-driven development and UI/API design. 
 - Technology expertise: Strong experience with modern engineering technologies, with React, TypeScript, Node. js, and Ruby on Rails preferred. 
 - Frontend architecture: Strong understanding of scalable frontend architecture and experience with microfrontend concepts or comparable approaches. 
 - Production operations: 5+ years of experience monitoring production systems, tuning alerts, responding to production incidents, and improving service reliability. 
 - Scalability and performance: Demonstrated ability to identify technical investments and architectural improvements that strengthen stability, performance, and scalability. 
 - CI/CD expertise: Experience building or contributing to modern Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery systems that support deterministic and dependable releases. 
 - Technical leadership: Ability to influence architecture, establish technical standards, guide engineering practices, and contribute to complex, organization-wide initiatives. 
 - Problem solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex technical challenges and make sound engineering decisions. 
 - Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strategic thinking: Ability to balance short-term priorities with longer-term technical goals and make recommendations that support sustainable engineering outcomes. 
 - Operational mindset: Ability to create practical, scalable operational support strategies for engineering teams. 
 - Distributed collaboration: Experience working remotely and effectively collaborating with distributed teams.

data.description:
Job Description

Marut Drones is seeking an experienced Senior Lead UAV Engineer to lead the design, development, integration, testing, and deployment of advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) systems. The role involves leading a team of UAV engineers, driving R&D and product innovation, and ensuring the technical performance, safety, reliability, and scalability of drone systems throughout the product lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in the UAV/Drone industry, along with proven expertise in UAV system architecture, flight controls, avionics, propulsion, system integration, testing, and technical leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead UAV Development: Lead the design, development, and integration of UAV systems and subsystems, ensuring performance, safety, reliability, and scalability. Provide technical direction across propulsion, flight control, power, avionics, communication, and payload systems. 
 - Team Leadership: Lead, manage, and mentor a team of UAV engineers. Provide technical guidance, establish engineering best practices, review designs, and foster a collaborative and high-performance engineering environment. 
 - UAV System Integration: Oversee the integration of mechanical, electrical, avionics, software, propulsion, power, communication, flight-control, and payload systems to develop fully functional UAV platforms. 
 - R&D and Innovation: Drive UAV R&D and product innovation by evaluating emerging technologies, developing new features, improving existing systems, and identifying opportunities to enhance UAV performance and capabilities. 
 - Testing and Validation: Lead UAV system testing, ground testing, flight testing, validation, and performance evaluation. Identify technical issues, conduct failure analysis, and implement corrective actions. 
 - Design Optimization: Continuously evaluate and optimize UAV designs to improve flight performance, payload capacity, endurance, reliability, efficiency, and overall system performance using engineering analysis and simulation tools. 
 - Quality, Safety & Compliance: Ensure UAV designs and systems meet applicable safety, quality, regulatory, and certification requirements. Participate in design reviews, technical audits, risk assessments, and safety evaluations. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, manufacturing, production, testing, operations, sales, and other cross-functional teams to ensure UAV products meet technical, production, customer, and business requirements. 
 - Product Lifecycle Management: Oversee engineering activities throughout the product lifecycle, from concept development and prototyping to testing, validation, production, deployment, and continuous improvement. 
 - Technical Documentation & Reporting: Maintain technical documentation including design specifications, engineering reports, test plans, test results, design reviews, and failure analysis reports. Present technical updates and recommendations to senior management. 

Mandatory Skills & Experience

- Mandatory UAV/Drone Industry Experience: 7+ years of professional experience specifically in the UAV/Drone industry, with hands-on experience in UAV design, development, system integration, testing, and deployment. 
 - UAV Design & Development: Strong experience designing and developing multirotor, fixed-wing, or hybrid UAV systems. 
 - UAV System Integration: Proven experience integrating mechanical, electrical, avionics, propulsion, power, communication, flight-control, navigation, and payload systems. 
 - Flight Control & Dynamics: Strong understanding of UAV flight dynamics, stability, navigation, flight-control systems, and autopilot systems. 
 - Avionics & UAV Components: Strong knowledge of flight controllers, motors, ESCs, batteries, GPS/GNSS, sensors, telemetry, communication systems, and other UAV components. 
 - Hardware & Software Integration: Hands-on experience integrating UAV hardware with flight-control software, firmware, sensors, and onboard systems. 
 - Flight Testing & Validation: Practical experience in UAV flight testing, system validation, performance evaluation, troubleshooting, and failure analysis. 
 - R&D and Product Development: Proven experience taking UAV products from concept and prototyping through testing, validation, and deployment. 
 - Technical Leadership: Minimum 2 years of experience leading UAV engineering teams or technical projects, with the ability to mentor engineers and provide technical direction. 
 - Regulatory & Safety Compliance: Working knowledge of applicable UAV regulations, safety standards, certification requirements, and compliance processes. 
 - Engineering & Simulation Tools: Experience with relevant UAV engineering tools such as CAD, MATLAB/Simulink, simulation, analysis, CAM, and PLM tools. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 4- 6 years of professional experience in the UAV/drone industry is mandatory. 
 - 2+ years of experience in a technical leadership role within UAV/Drone engineering is mandatory. 
 - Proven track record of designing, developing, integrating, testing, and deploying UAV systems. 
 - Strong hands-on experience across UAV hardware, avionics, flight control, propulsion, power, navigation, communication, and payload systems. 
 - Experience working with cross-functional teams including R&D, manufacturing, testing, production, and operations. 
 - Experience with UAV regulatory compliance, certification, quality assurance, and safety processes is highly preferred. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with agricultural, industrial, commercial, or other application-specific UAV platforms.

 - Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or other UAV simulation and modelling tools. 
 - Experience with UAV certification and regulatory processes. 
 - Experience with product development, prototyping, and design-for-manufacturing. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and technical communication skills. 

Compensation

Competitive compensation, open to discussion based on experience, technical expertise, and role fit.

Quin | About the Company

Quin is a safety-technology company. Our technology ships inside products from leading global brands across motorcycling, cycling, sport and industrial PPE. We are becoming the primary source of real-world crash data across every protective gear category, and we build the data tools that manufacturers and testing bodies use to engineer safer products and standards. Our engineering and product centre is in Hyderabad, with helmet testing labs in Hyderabad and London, and teams across India, the UK and the US. 

Why this role exists

Our software team builds the apps, cloud services and web tools that turn sensor data from a helmet into a crash alert, a simple NFC tag into a data operations platform for global brands and more. The team has shipped a lot, fast. We are looking to strengthen this team with a leader who will make it consistently excellent: stronger engineers, higher standards and processes that deliver outcomes end to end. 

You will lead the people and the work. You will hire, grow and hold the bar for every software engineer at Quin, and stay hands-on and close to the code. 

What You'll Own

People and performance

- Lead the software team day to day
 - Grow engineers. 
 - Build a culture where everyone owns their work from start to finish, where problem-solving is an obsession, and people and achievements are celebrated. 

Hiring

- Own software hiring with senior leadership: plan the roles, run the technical assessments and make the call. 
 - Raise the bar with every hire. 

Engineering quality

- Set and enforce standards for code review, testing, CI/CD and documentation across mobile, backend and web. 
 - Improve quality aggressively. Move the team from manual testing at the end towards automated testing built in from the start. 
 - Remove single points of failure. Every critical system has a second owner and documentation that someone else can use. 

Hands-on engineering

- Review code and designs every week. Know the codebase well enough to spot risk early. 
 - Step in on hard problems: debug a production issue, unblock a stuck feature, or pair with an engineer on a tricky design. 

Working across Quin

- Work with the TPM on realistic estimates and capacity, so delivery dates are consistently hit. 
 - Work with Product and Design on requirements, playing a key role on what & why, not just how. 
 - Work with the Embedded / Platform Lead where app and cloud meet firmware and BLE. 

Who You Are

- You're a builder of people. 
 - You have grit. 
 - You're optimistic and honest. 
 - You know and can communicate the why. 
 - You're still an engineer. (eg You review code every week and would rather work on a hard bug than write a status report. )
 - You're present. (eg You lead from the floor in Hyderabad, and your team always knows where to find you. )

This role isn't for you if you want to stop being hands-on, you measure success by headcount, or you need a settled, process-heavy environment to do your best work. 

Must-haves

- 7+ years in software engineering, with 3+ years managing engineers directly in a product company. 
 - Strong hands-on background in at least one of: mobile (iOS or Android), backend/cloud, or web. Working knowledge of the others. 
 - A track record of growing engineers, with people you can name who moved up under your leadership. 
 - Experience introducing engineering standards from an early stage: code review, automated testing, CI/CD and documentation. 
 - Hiring experience: you have designed technical assessments and built a team. 
 - Clear, direct written and spoken communication skills without depending on AI polish. You can explain a technical decision to an engineer, a product manager and/or a client. 
 - You use AI tools heavily in your own work and know how to make a team faster with them, but you could do the job without it. 

Strong pluses

- Apps that work with connected hardware: BLE, IoT, wearables or automotive. 
 - Real-time or safety-critical systems, where a missed event matters. 
 - Data-heavy products: streaming sensor data, analytics or ML pipelines. 
 - Moving a team from manual QA to automated testing. 
 - Platforms serving enterprise customers with security and compliance needs (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR). 

How We Work

We are a small team of senior doers who move fast with excellence. Our managers lead by example, not by layers. You will have real ownership of your team and its standards, with very little bureaucracy, and we expect you to use it. 

Our hiring process & AI use

Use AI tools freely on any exercise. The only rule: declare what you used and be ready to defend every decision live. The recruitment process will involve at least 2 interviews and 1 assignment with live debrief.

data.title: Staff AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
data.description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time. 

At Nextiva, we're reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation. 

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it's through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are. 

If you're ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong. 

Location: While this role is open to remote candidates across India, team members located near our Bengaluru office (Wilshire III by MFAR, 492, Hobli, RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048) are expected to work onsite four days per week, with the potential to increase to five days per week to support collaboration, speed, and execution. 

Nextiva is looking for a Staff AI Engineer to help build an internal AI platform that will shape how we work across engineering and the broader organization. 

This is a Staff-level, hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of backend/platform engineering, system architecture, AI, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity. You'll design and build production-grade agentic workflows across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and intelligent automation that improves engineering and business processes across Nextiva. 

Working across Nextiva's technology platform, you'll identify high-value opportunities, architect solutions, and take them from concept through deployment, operationalization, security, observability, and scale. You'll also provide technical leadership and influence across engineering teams. 

We are looking for an engineer who understands that AI is a means to a business outcome-not the outcome itself and can turn promising capabilities into reliable systems that create measurable value. 

Top 3 Outcomes (first 12 months)

- Build and operationalize agentic SDLC capabilities: Architect and deliver production-grade AI workflows that materially improve how Nextiva engineers design, build, test, review, deploy, operate, and maintain software, with measurable improvements in engineering effectiveness. 
 - Establish a scalable internal AI platform: Develop reusable architecture, services, infrastructure, patterns, and guardrails that enable AI-powered workflows to move reliably from experimentation into secure, observable, production-scale operation. 
 - Deliver measurable business impact through AI and automation: Identify and execute high-value automation opportunities across engineering and business processes, establishing clear success metrics and demonstrating tangible improvements in productivity, quality, velocity, cost, or customer outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems and agentic workflows across the SDLC and broader business processes. 
 - Design scalable internal platform capabilities that enable teams across Nextiva to safely and efficiently adopt AI-powered automation. 
 - Own solutions end-to-end-from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment, observability, security, scaling, and ongoing operation. 
 - Build robust integrations between AI models, agents, developer tooling, internal platforms, enterprise systems, APIs, data sources, and engineering workflows. 
 - Apply strong software engineering principles to AI systems, including modular architecture, testing, reliability, performance, maintainability, and fault tolerance. 
 - Design approaches for AI evaluation, observability, quality measurement, failure handling, and continuous improvement in production. 
 - Make pragmatic architectural and technology decisions based on business outcomes, engineering constraints, risk, and total cost of ownership rather than technology trends. 
 - Work deeply within GCP and/or AWS, designing cloud-native architectures and infrastructure capable of supporting secure, reliable, scalable production workloads. 
 - Partner with infrastructure, DevOps, security, architecture, and engineering teams to establish reusable engineering patterns, technical standards, and operational guardrails for AI-powered systems. 
 - Understand complex software systems and large codebases to identify opportunities where AI can improve developer workflows across the end-to-end SDLC. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, agent architectures, and developer technologies to determine where they can create meaningful value for Nextiva. 
 - Provide Staff-level technical leadership through architecture reviews, design decisions, technical mentorship, and influence across engineering teams. 
 - Translate ambiguous business and engineering problems into clear technical strategies and executable solutions, measuring and optimizing impact based on production data, user feedback, and business results. 

Requirements

Must-have

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating complex production-scale systems. 
 - Demonstrable hands-on experience designing and building AI/ML or generative AI solutions that have reached production and/or delivered measurable business outcomes. 
 - Strong software architecture and system design skills, including experience making consequential technical decisions for distributed or large-scale systems. 
 - Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals in one or more production languages such as Java, Python, Go, or equivalent. 
 - Hands-on experience working with LLMs, generative AI, AI agents, or AI-enabled application architectures, beyond simply consuming AI productivity tools. 
 - Experience taking AI solutions beyond prototypes into deployment, operationalization, monitoring, security, reliability, and scale. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with GCP and/or AWS, including designing and operating cloud-native production systems-not solely familiarity with cloud services or consoles. 
 - Strong understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, reliability, and production operations. 
 - Strong understanding of application, infrastructure, data, and AI security considerations and the ability to incorporate appropriate controls into system architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, developer workflows, and the challenges of working within large software systems and codebases. 
 - Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and select technologies based on the problem, desired business outcome, operational requirements, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Strong technical judgment and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, cross-functional problem spaces. 
 - Ability to influence technical direction across teams without relying solely on organizational authority. 

Preferred

- Experience designing or implementing agentic AI systems, multi-step AI workflows, tool-using agents, or autonomous/semi-autonomous engineering workflows. 
 - Experience applying AI to developer productivity, software engineering, code generation, testing, code review, incident management, or other stages of the SDLC. 
 - Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering productivity platforms, or enterprise automation capabilities. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, model/agent observability, prompt and context management, retrieval architectures, and production AI quality measurement. 
 - Experience spanning traditional software engineering and AI engineering-for example, a strong backend, platform, or distributed-systems engineering foundation combined with substantial hands-on AI engineering experience. 
 - Experience driving technical initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, or organizational domains. 

Tools & Tech Stack

The Exact Stack Will Evolve As We Select Technologies Based On The Problems And Outcomes We Are Solving. Relevant Experience May Include

- Cloud: GCP and/or AWS
 - Languages: Java, Python, Go, and/or equivalent production engineering languages
 - AI: LLMs, generative AI, agentic frameworks and architectures, model APIs, evaluation and observability tooling
 - Platform & Infrastructure: Containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, cloud-native services
 - Engineering: APIs, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, observability and developer tooling
 - Security: Cloud security, identity and access management, secrets management, secure application and AI architecture

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

Nextiva's most successful team members share common traits and behaviors: 

- Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go. 
 - Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work. 
 - Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates. 

Total Rewards

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office. 

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses. 

- Medical 🩺 - Medical insurance coverage is available for employees, their spouse, and up to two dependent children with a limit of 500, 000 INR, as well as their parents or in-laws for up to 300, 000 INR. This comprehensive coverage ensures that essential healthcare needs are met for the entire family unit, providing peace of mind and security in times of medical necessity. 
 - Group Term & Group Personal Accident Insurance 💼 - Provides insurance coverage against the risk of death / injury during the policy period sustained due to an accident caused by violent, visible & external means. 
 - Coverage Type - Employee Only
 - Sum Insured - 3 times of annual CTC with minimum cap of INR 10, 00, 000
 - Free Cover Limit - 1. 5 Crore
 - Work-Life Balance ⚖️ - 15 days of Privilege leaves per calendar year, 6 days of Paid Sick leave per calendar year, 6 days of Casual leave per calendar year. Paid 26 weeks of Maternity leaves, 1 week of Paternity leave, a day off on your Birthday, and paid holidays
 - Financial Security💰 - Provident Fund & Gratuity
 - Wellness 🤸 - Employee Assistance Program and comprehensive wellness initiatives
 - Growth 🌱 - Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement

At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career!

Beware of Recruitment Fraud: At Nextiva, we follow a merit-based hiring process and do not charge any fees or require a deposit at any stage. We also do not authorize any third parties to collect payments or sensitive information on our behalf. 

All genuine communications from Nextiva originate from official email addresses ending in "@nextiva. com". Communications received from free email services (such as Gmail, Yahoo, or Hotmail) purporting to be from Nextiva should be treated as fraudulent. If you are contacted by a third-party claiming to represent us, please verify their credentials by writing to talent@nextiva. com. 

We encourage candidates to stay vigilant and verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Nextiva, including unsolicited calls, WhatsApp messages and Telegram communications. While we strive to maintain a secure hiring process, Nextiva is not responsible for any losses arising from fraudulent activities. If you believe that you have been a victim of recruitment fraud, please contact your law enforcement agencies immediately. 

For genuine opportunities, please apply only through our official career sites: Nextiva Careers & Nextiva Jobs on LinkedIn. 

Founded in 2008, Nextiva has grown into a global leader trusted by over 100, 000 businesses and 1M+ users worldwide. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with teams across the globe, we're the future of customer experience and team collaboration through our AI-powered, conversation-centric platform. 

Want to see what life at Nextiva is all about? Connect with us on Instagram, Instagram MX, YouTube, LinkedIn, and the Nextiva Blog.

data.title: Full Stack .NET Developer with C++
data.description:
Experience: 4-6 Years

Location: Chennai

About The Job

We are looking for a Full Stack . NET Developer with strong hands-on expertise in C++, C#, . NET, ASP. NET, MVC, Entity Framework, ADO. NET, LINQ, WCF, Web API, SQL, and JavaScript. 

The role will focus on designing, developing, maintaining, and enhancing scalable web-based applications and enterprise software solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong fundamentals in C++ and Object-Oriented Programming, along with practical experience in full-stack . NET development, RESTful APIs, relational databases, unit testing, and application development. 

The role will contribute across the full SDLC, application development, API development, database integration, testing, debugging, deployment, and application modernization, while collaborating closely with technical and business stakeholders. 

What You'll Do

- 
 - Analyze business and technical requirements and design, develop, test, and maintain scalable C#/. NET applications across the full SDLC. 
 - Develop and maintain web applications using ASP. NET, MVC Framework, HTML, CSS3, and JavaScript. 
 - Apply strong C++ and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts to develop, maintain, and enhance application components. 
 - Design and develop RESTful Web APIs and integrate backend services with web applications and other enterprise systems. 
 - Develop and maintain applications using Entity Framework, ADO. NET, and LINQ for efficient data access and database integration. 
 - Work with SQL databases, including writing complex queries, stored procedures, database objects, and optimizing application/database performance. 
 - Develop and maintain WCF services and support integration with existing enterprise applications where required. 
 - Implement unit testing using frameworks such as xUnit to ensure code quality, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Follow OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean coding practices to build scalable and maintainable solutions. 
 - Perform debugging, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, performance optimization, and production issue resolution. 
 - Work with SSRS to develop, maintain, and support reports and reporting solutions based on business requirements. 
 - Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, deployment, and application support activities. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high-quality technical solutions. 
 - Contribute to application modernization initiatives and support migration toward modern . NET technologies and architectures. 
 - Use Git and Azure DevOps pipelines for source control, build automation, CI/CD, and deployment activities where required. 
What We Seek In You

- 
 - 4-6 years of software development experience with strong hands-on expertise in C#, . NET, and C++. 
 - Strong understanding and practical implementation of C++ and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with ASP. NET and MVC Framework for web application development. 
 - Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS3, and JavaScript for developing and integrating user-facing web applications. 
 - Hands-on experience with Entity Framework, ADO. NET, and LINQ for application development and data access. 
 - Experience developing and consuming RESTful Web APIs. 
 - Hands-on experience with WCF and service-oriented application development. 
 - Strong experience working with SQL databases, including queries, stored procedures, database design, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience with SSRS for report development, maintenance, and integration. 
 - Experience with unit testing frameworks, preferably xUnit. 
 - Strong understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, exception handling, debugging, and problem-solving. 
 - Good understanding of software development methodologies and the full SDLC. 
 - Experience with Git, Visual Studio, and Azure DevOps. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with good communication, collaboration, and ownership. 
Preferred Qualifications

- 
 - Hands-on experience with . NET Core / modern . NET application development. 
 - Experience with Entity Framework Core and modern data-access approaches. 
 - Strong practical understanding of SOLID principles and commonly used design patterns. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines, CI/CD, and deployment automation. 
 - Exposure to modern frontend frameworks such as React. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy ASP. NET/. NET applications into modern architectures. 
 - Experience working with enterprise-scale applications and service-oriented architectures. 
 - Exposure to application performance optimization, security, and deployment best practices. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments and participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and technical discussions. 
Life At Next

At our core, we're driven by the mission of tailoring growth for our customers by enabling them to transform their aspirations into tangible outcomes. We're dedicated to empowering them to shape their futures and achieve ambitious goals. To fulfil this commitment, we foster a culture defined by agility, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to progress. Our organizational framework is both streamlined and vibrant, characterized by a hands-on leadership style that prioritizes results and fosters growth. 

Perks Of Working With Us

- 
 - Clear objectives to ensure alignment with our mission, fostering your meaningful contribution. 
 - Abundant opportunities for engagement with customers, product managers, and leadership. 
 - You'll be guided by progressive paths while receiving insightful guidance from managers through ongoing feedforward sessions. 
 - Cultivate and leverage robust connections within diverse communities of interest. Choose your mentor to navigate your current endeavors and steer your future trajectory. 
 - Embrace continuous learning and upskilling opportunities through Nexversity. 
 - Enjoy the flexibility to explore various functions, develop new skills, and adapt to emerging technologies. Embrace a hybrid work model promoting work-life balance. 
 - Access comprehensive family health insurance coverage, prioritizing the well-being of your loved ones. 
 - Embark on accelerated career paths to actualize your professional aspirations. 
Who We Are

We enable high growth enterprises build hyper personalized solutions to transform their vision into reality. With a keen eye for detail, we apply creativity, embrace new technology and harness the power of data and AI to co-create solutions tailored made to meet unique needs for our customers. 

Join our passionate team and tailor your growth with us!

data.title: Operations Systems & Continuous Improvement Lead
data.description:
Operations Systems & Continuous Improvement Lead

Company: Proof360 (Foreign Venture Group)

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Type: Full-Time

Working Hours: Strong overlap with North American business hours (primarily EST or CST)

Reporting Line: Founder / CEO

About the Role

Proof360 is hiring an Operations Systems & Continuous Improvement Lead to make our Customer Success and Vendor Operations teams measurably better every day. We are looking for someone who combines process excellence, operations, data, and software to find an operational problem, implement an improvement, test it, measure the outcome, and improve the system again. 

This is not an advisory-only Continuous Improvement role, a project-status coordination position, or a pure software-development job. You will sit between operations, technology, and data, turning evidence from calls, transcripts, systems, and frontline workflows into changes that reach implementation and measurable results. 

Technical Standard

You must be able to code. You do not need to be a full-time software engineer, but you must be capable of prototyping, automating, configuring, testing, and carrying work substantially further before deeper platform engineering is required. 

The Mission

Build and continuously improve the operating system behind Proof360's Customer Success and Vendor Operations teams. Every day, operations should know more, perform better, lose less opportunity, create less friction, and require less unnecessary manual work than the day before. 

Your ownership spans daily improvement, real-time call guidance, the customer and vendor lifecycle, reputation and trust, operational intelligence, and technical execution. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Daily Continuous Improvement

- Lead a daily operational improvement review with Customer Success and Vendor Operations leadership. 
 - Use calls, transcripts, outcomes, objections, escalations, conversion data, follow-up failures, quality issues, system behaviour, and repeated manual work to identify friction and opportunity. 
 - Diagnose causes, prioritize useful improvements, implement or package them, test results, and record learnings. 
 - Move changes into implementation and controlled live testing as quickly as responsibly possible. 2. Real-Time Call Guidance & Conversational Intelligence

- Own a disciplined improvement loop for real-time guidance tools and systems rather than treating them as a one-time setup project. 
 - Improve call prompts, dynamic guidance, agent checklists, objection handling, conversation playbooks, moment detection, QA logic, win definitions, and call dispositions. 
 - Improve knowledge grounding, trigger/prompt design, follow-up capture, versioning, and adoption while investigating false positives and false negatives. 
 - Review prior-day calls, test changes before release, observe live performance, measure results, and retain or roll back changes based on evidence. 3. Customer & Vendor Lifecycle Improvement

- Optimize across qualification, active opportunities, service and dispatch, completion, stalled or cold relationships, reactivation, loyalty, referrals, upsell, cross-sell, and repeat relationships. 
 - Identify leakage, failed handoffs, missing data, missed next actions, unsuitable timing, and unnecessary manual work. 
 - Improve operational experience around core product platforms, rewards programs, and relationship workflows. 
 - Ensure cold and stalled relationships have a known reason, a clear owner, an appropriate next action and timing, and a documented outcome. 4. Reputation & Trust

- Own the Continuous Improvement system surrounding customer and vendor reputation. 
 - Monitor review volume, ratings, sentiment, and recurring themes across approved reputation channels. 
 - Identify causes of negative reviews, complaints, and trust failures; route service-recovery actions to appropriate owners and measure resolution. 
 - Turn reputation evidence into improvements to guidance, scripts, SOPs, workflows, training, and systems. 5. Data & Operational Intelligence

- Bridge the gap between Operations and Data; help determine what should be measured, how it should be interpreted, and what action evidence should drive. 
 - Work with Data Intelligence on operational events, funnel and lifecycle stages, conversion, call quality, attribution, failure reasons, cohorts, and intervention outcomes.

Relevant Backgrounds

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Cloud Automation Senior DevOps Engineer based in India.

You will design, deploy, and support cloud-native solutions across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), working at enterprise scale. 

The role combines platform engineering, DevSecOps, infrastructure automation, software development, and Site Reliability Engineering practices. 

You will partner closely with engineering, security, and product teams to improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and cost efficiency. 

A major focus will be on infrastructure as code, CI/CD, GitOps, cloud automation, observability, and operational resilience.

Position - Vice President of FPGA & HW Engineering

Role Summary

Title: Vice President of Engineering

Location: Gurugram / Bangalore, India (Hybrid / On-site)

Reporting To: Chief Operating Officer

Organization Size: ~150 FPGA/Hardware Engineers (Multi-site)

We seek a technical engineering leader to drive product innovation, architectural excellence, and execution discipline across our FPGA-based hardware platforms. This is a pure engineering leadership role - you will define products, architect solutions, lead technical teams, and deliver world-class FPGA platforms on budget and on schedule. 

Core Mandate

The Vice President of Engineering is accountable for: 

- Product Definition: Define technical specifications, system architecture, and feature roadmaps for proprietary FPGA platforms
 - Engineering Execution: Deliver products from concept through production on defined timelines and NRE budgets
 - Technical Innovation: Drive product-level innovation in FPGA architectures, AI/ML acceleration, and advanced interfaces
 - Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and scale a 150-person engineering organization across Gurugram and Bangalore

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Definition & Technical Leadership

System Architecture & Product Vision

Define end-to-end architecture for FPGA-based platforms - from silicon selection and IP strategy to board design, firmware, and system validation. Translate market requirements into technical specifications and multi-year product roadmaps. 

  

Innovation Leadership

Drive product-level innovation in: 

- Heterogeneous FPGA architectures (AMD Versal, Altera Agilex)
 - Deterministic AI/ML inference for edge computing   
 - High-speed interfaces (PCIe Gen6/7, CXL, 200G/400G/800G Ethernet, PQC, etc. )  

Technical Decision Authority

Own all major technical decisions: FPGA device selection, IP vs. custom RTL trade-offs, verification strategy, toolchain selection, and design methodology standards. 

2. Engineering Execution & Delivery

End-to-End Product Delivery

Lead cross-functional engineering teams through full product lifecycle: 

- RTL design, synthesis, place & route, timing closure
 - Board design (high-speed digital, power integrity, thermal)
 - Firmware and embedded software
 - System integration and performance validation
 - Certification and compliance     

Execution Discipline

Establish and enforce engineering rigor: design reviews, verification closure (SystemVerilog/UVM), release gates, and post-silicon validation protocols. Manage NRE budgets and ensure predictable delivery against committed schedules. 

  

Risk Management

Identify and mitigate technical risks early: silicon errata workarounds, timing closure challenges, signal integrity issues, thermal constraints, and supply chain dependencies. 

3. Organization Building & Leadership

Multi-Site Engineering Leadership

Unify Gurugram and Bangalore engineering teams under common design methodologies, verification frameworks, and release processes. Build a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and accountability. 

  

Talent Development

Build and mentor the next generation of technical leaders. Create clear technical career paths from Senior Engineer through Principal/Fellow levels. 

Retention & Culture

Maintain ≥90% retention of Senior Staff+ talent through technical mentorship, challenging problems, IP co-ownership, and a culture that values deep technical expertise. Attract top FPGA talent from across India. 

  

Team Scaling

Scale the engineering organization from 150 to 200+ engineers over 24 months while maintaining quality, velocity, and culture. 

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

- Education: Master's or Ph. D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related discipline
 - Experience: 18+ years in FPGA/hardware engineering, including 8+ years leading engineering teams of 100+ engineers
 - Product Delivery Track Record: Must have led engineering teams that delivered ≥2 FPGA-based products from architecture through volume production (>500 units shipped). Pure design services or consulting experience does not qualify. 

Technical Expertise - Core Requirements

FPGA Mastery

- Deep expertise with AMD/Xilinx (Versal, UltraScale+) and/or Intel/Altera (Agilex, Stratix) device families
 - Advanced proficiency with Vivado, Vitis, Quartus, and High-Level Synthesis (HLS)
 - Hands-on experience with complex FPGA architectures: AI Engines, DSP slices, high-speed transceivers, DDR controllersAI/ML on FPGA

- Practical experience deploying AI/ML inference on FPGAs (Vitis AI, Versal DPU, or custom accelerators)
 - Understanding of model quantization, DPU vs custom RTL trade-offs, and deterministic latency optimization
 - Experience with vision processing, sensor fusion, or real-time packet processing workloadsHigh-Speed Digital Design

- Proven delivery of platforms with PCIe Gen4/5, 100G+ Ethernet, or RF-ADC/DAC 
 - Signal integrity, timing closure, and power integrity at advanced nodes   Verification & Validation

- Strong command of SystemVerilog/UVM, constrained-random verification, and coverage-driven methodologies
 - Experience with HW/SE co-verification, emulation platforms, and FPGA prototypingBoard-Level Systems

- Understanding of complete system design: power architecture, thermal management, PCB layout constraints for high-speed signals
 - Experience with ruggedized or embedded systems for defense/aerospace applications

Leadership Competencies

Technical Leadership at Scale

- Proven ability to lead 100+ engineer organizations across multiple sites in India
 - Experience unifying distributed teams under common methodologies & quality standards
 - Track record of mentoring and developing senior technical leaders   Execution Excellence

- Demonstrated ability to deliver complex hardware products on time and within budget
 - Experience managing multi-year product roadmaps with 8-12 month development cycles
 - Disciplined approach to risk management, schedule estimation, and resource planningCommunication & Influence

- Ability to translate complex technical architectures into clear roadmaps   
 - Comfortable presenting technical designs to customers, partners, and executives 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills for design documentation, architecture specifications, and technical reviews

Why This Role

- Technical Leadership: Focus on engineering excellence, product innovation, and team building   
 - Scale & Impact: Lead one of India's largest dedicated FPGA product engineering teams building platforms that compete globally
 - Innovation Mandate: Work at the cutting edge of FPGA-AI convergence with next-generation Versal and Agilex devices
 - Ownership: Define products, not just implement requirements. Your architectural decisions will shape the company's technical direction
 - Talent Magnet: Build and lead a team of India's best FPGA engineers working on challenging, internationally competitive products
 - Equity Upside: Meaningful ESOP allocation in a company transitioning from bootstrapped to VC-backed growth

Compensation & Benefits

- Base Salary: Negotiable based on experience and location
 - Equity: Significant ESOP allocation   
 - Benefits: Health insurance, and performance bonuses tied to delivery milestones

data.title: Vice President, Software Engineering
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Vice President, Software Engineering

Consumer Data Management (CDM) is a strategic enterprise platform that manages consumer identity, consent, and engagement across Mastercard's ecosystem. As Mastercard advances toward a modern, AI- and data-centric architecture, CDM enables trusted, compliant, and scalable consumer experiences. 

We are seeking a Vice President, Engineering to lead the technology strategy, engineering execution, and operational readiness of CDM across identity, consent lifecycle management, and consumer engagement services. This leader will be accountable for building and scaling secure, resilient, compliant, and reusable platform capabilities that enable Mastercard teams to activate consumer data responsibly and deliver personalized, trusted experiences across channels. 

Role

Engineering Strategy & Platform Modernization

- Define and execute the CDM engineering strategy, evolving identity, consent, consumer data, and engagement services from point solutions into a cohesive, scalable, reusable enterprise platform. 
 - Establish architectural direction, engineering standards, and platform guardrails that improve scalability, reliability, security, developer experience, speed of delivery, and reuse. 
 - Partner with product, architecture, data, security, privacy, and regional stakeholders to translate business priorities into executable engineering roadmaps with KPIs tied to adoption, resilience, quality, cost efficiency, and platform value. 

Architecture, Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Own end-to-end engineering execution across CDM services, including design, development, testing, release management, production readiness, and ongoing operational support. 
 - Ensure CDM platforms are architected and operated for high availability, performance, observability, disaster recovery, security, privacy, regulatory compliance, and SLA commitments. 
 - Strengthen engineering practices across API design, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, data governance, automation, CI/CD, quality engineering, incident management, and vulnerability planning/remediation. 
 - Lead technical engagement with internal platform consumers, regional teams, enterprise architecture, risk, compliance, and third-party providers to manage dependencies, adoption, service quality, and reliable delivery. 
 - Embed privacy-by-design and security-by-design principles across identity, consent, messaging, and consumer data capabilities while building a culture of engineering accountability, operational discipline, and proactive risk management. 

All About You

Engineering Leadership & Domain Expertise

- Extensive experience leading large-scale software engineering organizations, with proven VP/Director+ leadership of distributed, global teams and mission-critical platforms. 
 - Deep technical understanding of distributed systems, APIs, data platforms, event-driven architecture, cloud-native engineering, identity systems, consent management, secure consumer data platforms, and third-party platform integrations. 
 - Experience operating platforms that require strong privacy, security, compliance, vulnerability management, resilience, observability, SLA management, and production support disciplines. 
 - Desirable: experience with customer data platforms, identity resolution, consent and preference management, omnichannel messaging, or engagement platforms such as SMS, RCS, WhatsApp, email, and emerging channels. 

Technical Strategy & Execution

- Ability to translate business, regulatory, and platform strategy into clear engineering priorities, architecture decisions, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes. 
 - Strong judgment in balancing modernization, feature delivery, technical debt, platform reuse, control requirements, operational risk, cost pressure, and SLA commitments. 
 - Experience improving engineering maturity through automation, quality practices, developer productivity, reusable frameworks, technical governance, operational metrics, and familiarity with agentic AI-powered PDLC/SDLC practices. 

Leadership & Influence

- Proven ability to lead in highly matrixed, global organizations while building alignment across engineering, product, architecture, security, privacy, compliance, operations, business stakeholders, and third-party providers. 
 - Strong executive presence and ability to communicate technology strategy, risks, trade-offs, delivery progress, cost implications, and SLA impacts clearly to senior leaders and internal customers, including under pressure. 
 - Demonstrated success hiring, developing, mentoring, and retaining senior engineering talent while aligning teams around shared outcomes, quality, resilience, security, customer impact, and continuous improvement. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, developer productivity, operational readiness, and speed of delivery through modernization, automation, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices. 

Provide technical mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers through design guidance, code review, pairing, knowledge sharing, and modeling strong engineering judgment. 

Navigate ambiguity in complex initiatives by clarifying technical direction, decomposing large problems, identifying risks, and driving alignment across stakeholders. 

Champion a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, ownership, collaboration, and high-quality delivery across the team and partner organizations. 

Ideal Candidate Qualifications

10+ years of software engineering experience delivering scalable, high-performance, and reliable software in an agile environment. 

Strong hands-on experience designing and building distributed systems, microservices, RESTful APIs, and cloud-native applications. 

Strong experience with data-intensive applications and analytics platforms; experience with Databricks is highly desirable. 

Proven expertise leading system architecture, high-level design, detailed design, and end-to-end technical delivery of complex software solutions. 

Experience driving technology modernization initiatives, including cloud adoption, platform transformation, and modernization of legacy applications. 

Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes, observability, and modern software delivery practices. 

Demonstrated technical leadership as an individual contributor, influencing architecture decisions, driving technical strategy, and leading large cross-team initiatives. 

Ability to translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions. 

Proven ability to effectively leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and technologies to enhance software development productivity, code quality, operational efficiency, decision-making, and engineering outcomes, while applying sound technical judgment, security considerations, and responsible AI practices. 

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, data science, QA, and operations teams. 

Experience leading and coordinating technical initiatives across globally distributed teams spanning multiple regions and time zones. 

Passion for mentoring and developing engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. 

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work through ambiguity, make sound technical decisions, and drive results through hands-on execution. 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree is a plus. 

Mastercard is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. Applicants will be considered and treated without regard to gender, gender identity, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disabled status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law
