data.title: Audit Manager
data.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today's risks into tomorrow's opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are-with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody's is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we're advancing AI to move from insight to action-enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence. 

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity. 

Skills And Competencies

- 5+ years of relevant audit experience (preferably in a Big 4 accounting firm and/or a global organization) within an audit, risk or control role
 - Strong knowledge and experience in internal control frameworks and risk standards (e. g. , COSO, ISO, NIST and DORA), financial services regulations, risk assessment processes
 - Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite is required; experience with GRC tools is preferred; fluency in written and spoken English required 
 - Innovative and results-oriented, with strong communication, interpersonal, persuasion, leadership, team and project management, and critical-thinking skills, and the ability to work independently or collaboratively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities simultaneouslyExperience supporting integrated audits, with a solid understanding of IT general controls (ITGCs) and practical knowledge of technology risks and controls
 - Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use

Education

- Bachelor's degree
 - CPA, CA, CIA or equivalent professional qualification required

Responsibilities

Lead and execute risk-based integrated, operational, and regulatory audits across the organization, managing the full audit lifecycle while partnering with senior stakeholders and coaching team members. 

- Plan and execute moderately complex audit projects, from planning to reporting, utilizing a risk-based approach. Prepares and communicates audit testing methodology, develops audit engagement budget and timelines, supervises and/or executes audit fieldwork
 - Demonstrates a strong understanding of risk and controls across a variety of risk areas. Maintains an understanding of the financial, operational, and technology processes, risks and controls related to Moody's business. Ability to identify key risks and leading practices for the area under review. Perform and oversee testing of design and operating effectiveness
 - Develops relationships with audit stakeholders, manages stakeholder expectations and aligns audit projects based on stakeholder objectives of the area under review. Runs meetings with stakeholders and has persuasive conversations around the 'why do we care' for audit issues. Supports team leads in educating stakeholders on best practices in governance, risk and control
 - Continuously expands knowledge of data analytics and use of technology to enhance audit testing, identify opportunities for continuous monitoring and repeatable test plans. Capable of performing intermediate-level data analytics functions within Excel or equivalent applications (e. g. , Power BI, Tableau, etc. )
 - Assists with enhancing the Internal Audit Standards, processes, templates and audit techniques to increase overall efficiency and quality of internal audit delivery
 - Coaches junior staff members through the audit lifecycle, including communicating roles and expectations for the project team at the start of the project, reinforcing accountability of project deliverables, hours, cost and cycle time, developing test steps, reviewing workpapers and providing feedback. Acts as a role model by exemplifying high performance for team members

About The Team

The Moody's Internal Audit team is dedicated to providing independent, objective assurance and advisory services designed to add value and improve the Company's operations and the effectiveness of its control, risk management, and compliance processes. By joining our team, you will be part of a highly collaborative and intellectually rigorous environment that leverages emerging technologies, data analytics, and AI-driven capabilities to advance audit quality across the enterprise. Our team works closely with senior leaders and key stakeholders globally to deliver meaningful insights and drive sustainable improvements across Moody's operations worldwide. 

Moody's is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law. 

Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody's Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

Telence Solutions is building a next-generation AI-driven Network Management System designed to support multi-vendor environments and enable intelligent operations, automation, and closed-loop remediation. We are looking for an experienced AI System Architect to help define the architecture, technology roadmap, and AI strategy for this platform. 

Role Overview

The AI System Architect will provide technical leadership for the design and evolution of our in-house network management platform. This individual will work closely with software developers, network architects, and product leadership to establish a scalable and future-proof architecture while incorporating industry best practices across AI, machine learning, data engineering, and agentic workflows.

 - Mentor developers and AI engineers.

Required Qualifications

 - Strong understanding of:

data.description:
Manager/Team Lead - Agentic AI, ML

Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)

Role Summary

As Manager - AI Engineering, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists delivering GenAI-powered solutions, agentic AI systems, LLM-integrated applications, machine learning models, and retrieval-enabled intelligent products. This role combines technical leadership, people management, delivery accountability, and product ownership. You will be responsible for ensuring that the team delivers scalable, secure, supportable, and business-relevant AI and ML solutions from discovery through production operation and continuous improvement. 

This is not a lightweight line-management role. The successful candidate must be technically strong enough to guide senior engineers, data scientists, and technical leads, make sound architectural and implementation trade-offs, and raise the engineering bar of the team. You are expected to provide hands-on technical direction across LLM-powered systems, agent orchestration, RAG, ML model development, MLOps, cloud-native application delivery, integrations, observability, and SDLC discipline, while also building a culture of accountability, ownership, experimentation rigor, and engineering excellence. 

You will work closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, Lead AI Engineers, Lead Data Scientists, Platform teams, DevOps, Security, and business stakeholders to translate business goals into implementable engineering work and durable product outcomes. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists across varying experience levels, including senior engineers and technical leads, ensuring strong delivery quality, modeling rigor, engineering discipline, and technical growth
 - Own end-to-end delivery of GenAI, agentic AI, and ML-enabled solutions - from discovery, design, and backlog shaping through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement
 - Guide architectural and design decisions across LLM-powered systems, embeddings pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, tool-enabled workflows, ML model pipelines, APIs, and cloud-native application services
 - Oversee the design, development, evaluation, and operationalization of machine learning models for predictive, classification, recommendation, anomaly detection, forecasting, optimization, or other business use cases where applicable
 - Ensure strong practices across feature engineering, experimentation, validation, model performance assessment, explainability, drift awareness, and MLOps readiness
 - Translate business and product priorities into executable engineering and data science plans, technical workstreams, model delivery milestones, and sustainable release outcomes
 - Review and challenge implementation choices to ensure systems and models are scalable, secure, observable, cost-aware, and maintainable
 - Partner with Product Managers and engineering leadership to prioritize work, manage technical dependencies, and align delivery with roadmap goals
 - Establish strong SDLC and build-own-operate practices within the team, including design reviews, code reviews, model reviews, automated testing, release readiness, production support, reliability improvement, and technical debt management
 - Drive reuse and productivity by scaling frameworks, shared components, prompt templates, orchestration patterns, feature templates, modeling utilities, evaluation frameworks, and internal accelerators across the team
 - Promote a culture of responsible AI and operational excellence, emphasizing security, token and cost governance, model safety, quality, observability, reproducibility, and supportability
 - Coordinate with cloud platform, DevOps, Security, Integration, Architecture, and data teams to ensure enterprise readiness of all deployments
 - Own hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance development, and growth plans for both the AI Engineering and Data Science team members
 - Track and communicate KPIs related to delivery, GenAI adoption, model quality, latency, business impact, reliability, experimentation outcomes, and production performance
 - Act as the primary technical and delivery escalation point for the team, helping remove blockers and resolve design, modeling, execution, and operational issues

Required Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, AI / ML engineering, data science, solution engineering, or technology delivery, including strong experience building and operating production-grade intelligent systems
 - 4 to 5 + years of experience delivering or leading AI / ML / GenAI / LLM-powered solutions in enterprise or product environments
 - Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams or technical pods delivering LLM-powered products, agentic AI workflows, machine learning models, or AI-enabled application capabilities, with accountability for both technical quality and delivery outcomes
 - Strong technical depth in Python, modern backend engineering, machine learning solution delivery, API-first architectures, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud-native application delivery
 - Strong hands-on or design-level experience with LLM platforms and orchestration frameworks such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent platforms used for enterprise GenAI delivery
 - Strong experience designing or guiding implementations involving retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings pipelines, vector search, grounding strategies, and retrieval optimization using platforms such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or equivalent
 - Strong understanding of machine learning model development, including feature engineering, model training, validation, tuning, evaluation, performance interpretation, and production-readiness considerations
 - Practical experience guiding or reviewing MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment automation, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, drift detection, retraining readiness, and reproducibility
 - Experience building and deploying AI- and ML-enabled cloud-native services using technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, FastAPI, Docker, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes / AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, MLflow, or equivalent engineering and deployment platforms
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD, containerization, deployment automation, secure delivery practices, and operational readiness for AI-driven and ML-enabled systems
 - Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent-to-agent (A2A) interaction models, memory / context management approaches, and other distributed AI coordination patterns
 - Practical experience with observability and operational tooling such as Application Insights, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry, Log Analytics, Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent platforms, including monitoring of reliability, latency, cost, runtime behavior, and model / workflow health
 - Strong understanding of agentic AI implementation patterns, including multi-step orchestration, tool calling, context management, and workflow decomposition
 - Experience integrating AI- and ML-enabled solutions with REST APIs, enterprise systems, workflow platforms, event-driven services, or downstream business applications
 - Demonstrated ability to translate business and product needs into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI / ML engineering solutions, while guiding teams on implementation trade-offs, experimentation choices, and delivery sequencing
 - Strong SDLC ownership mindset across design, build, testing, deployment, support, reliability improvement, model lifecycle management, and long-term maintainability
 - Proven ability to raise engineering and data science quality through code reviews, model reviews, design guidance, architectural mentoring, coaching of senior engineers and data scientists, and reinforcement of reusable patterns and standards
 - Strong people leadership capability, including coaching, feedback, performance management, capability development, and fostering accountability and engineering excellence
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data science, product, platform, architecture, DevOps, and business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading implementations involving agentic AI workflows, multi-agent coordination, tool-enabled automation, reusable orchestration abstractions, or structured task delegation patterns
 - Experience with AI observability, prompt safety, runtime guardrails, hallucination mitigation, evaluation frameworks, quality monitoring, and enterprise governance practices for GenAI systems
 - Familiarity with broader enterprise AI and ML platforms such as Microsoft AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, PromptFlow, MLflow, Databricks, or equivalent AI / ML lifecycle and experimentation ecosystems
 - Experience leading or supporting teams working on forecasting, optimization, recommender systems, anomaly detection, classification, NLP, or hybrid ML + GenAI solutions
 - Experience contributing to reusable GenAI accelerators, internal SDKs, orchestration templates, prompt frameworks, feature templates, evaluation patterns, modeling utilities, or shared engineering utilities
 - Familiarity with enterprise integration landscapes involving SAP, ServiceNow, API management layers, workflow systems, event buses, and business process platforms
 - Experience with cost-aware AI and ML delivery, including token usage visibility, model selection trade-offs, compute efficiency, scaling considerations, and engineering productivity optimization
 - Ability to communicate complex technical and analytical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and to represent team direction confidently in leadership forums
 - Experience operating in a build-own-operate product environment
 - Knowledge of responsible AI, AI quality engineering, governance-by-design, model risk awareness, and compliance-aware delivery in enterprise environments

data.title: Head of Engineering, Commerce Platform
data.description:
Overview

As the Head of Engineering for the Core Commerce Platform, you will be the primary architect and leader of Atlassian's next-generation monetization engine. This is a high-stakes leadership role at the intersection of engineering excellence, financial integrity, and business transformation. You will lead a department of 50-70 engineers in India, tasked with evolving our legacy billing systems into a world-class, enterprise-scale platform that powers Atlassian's multi-billion dollar revenue stream. 

Your mission is to build a unified, multi-modal billing platform that seamlessly integrates traditional seat-based models with modern, value-based consumption models. This platform is the "monetization backbone" that converts every customer interaction-from a Jira seat to an AI-powered Rovo credit-into accurate, transparent, and compliant revenue. 

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. 

Responsibilities

- Platform Modernization: Transition the Commerce Cloud Platform (CCP) from a seat-centric system to a flexible, meter-agnostic engine capable of handling high-concurrency usage events and complex financial settlements. 
 - Enterprise Readiness: Deliver "hardened" commerce capabilities for our largest customers, including aggregate quoting, threshold-based invoicing, and advanced credit management. 
 - Financial Integrity & Compliance: Ensure 100% accuracy in revenue recognition (MRR/ARR) and downstream finance integrations. You will own the systems that interface with Stripe and internal financial reporting tools. 
 - AI-Native Transformation: Drive the adoption of AI within the platform itself-leveraging AI for automated testing of complex commerce scenarios, anomaly detection in billing, and optimizing the "Usage Event → Invoice" pipeline. 
 - Operational Excellence: Manage Tier 1 external-facing services where downtime directly impacts Atlassian's ability to transact. You will instill a culture of "zero-error" engineering and high-availability architecture. 
 - Executive Influencing: As a key leader in Commerce organization, you will represent the platform's roadmap to C-level stakeholders, ensuring engineering capacity aligns with Atlassian's strategic monetization goals. 

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. 

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. 

- Global Scale Leadership: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5+ years in a senior leadership role at a global, hyper-scale technology organization. You have successfully led large, multi-layered engineering departments (50+ people) through managers and senior technical leaders. 
 - Monetization & Billing Expertise: Deep domain expertise in building and scaling Enterprise-grade Billing, Payments, or Commerce Platforms. You have a proven track record of architecting systems that support diverse pricing models, including Seat-based, Usage/Consumption-based, Ramp, and Flex models. 
 - High-Stakes Execution: Experience managing Tier 1, business-critical services where system reliability and financial accuracy are paramount. You understand the rigor required to manage platforms that power billions in annual revenue with "zero-error" tolerance. 
 - Strategic Platform Transformation: Demonstrated success in leading major organizational and technical shifts, such as transitioning a company's core business model or modernizing legacy monetization infrastructure into a flexible, multi-modal engine. 
 - Education: BS/MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. 

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go. atlassian. com/perksandbenefits . 

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. 

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. 

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go. atlassian. com/crh . 

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

data.title: Director, Engineering
data.description:
About The Team

Zillow's Enterprise Platforms & Technology (EP&T) organization runs the third-party SaaS platforms that power our business: Workday, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and the AI infrastructure that increasingly mediates how Zillow employees experience these systems. Workday powers our HR and Finance operations. ServiceNow runs IT and HR service delivery. The agentic AI layer we're building on top of these platforms is reshaping how employees get help, complete tasks, and navigate their work day. 

We are building a new India-based engineering team to take end-to-end ownership of Workday HR and ServiceNow in 2026, with potential expansion to other enterprise SaaS platforms in the future. This team will own its platform stacks completely - production access, change ownership, on-call rotation, direct stakeholder relationships - not as remote staffing for US-led work, but as a peer engineering organization with its own architectural authority. 

EP&T operates with an AI-native engineering culture. Modern AI coding and agent tooling is baseline practice across our existing US teams. For your India team, that means AI-augmented configuration is the daily reality: designing Workday business processes, generating ServiceNow flows, and writing platform-bounded code with AI as a partner, at a pace that traditional methods can't match. Your team's success proves and scales this operating model. 

This is a team where your technical credibility matters. We are building it from scratch, and the leader who joins now will lay the engineering foundation for Zillow's enterprise-wide shift to invisible, agent-mediated platforms, and define what excellence looks like in this space for years to come. 

Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India. 

About The Role

As Director of Engineering for Enterprise SaaS Platforms (India), you'll build Zillow's India platform engineering organization from the ground up. 

You will report directly to the global leader of Enterprise Platforms & Technology and be one of the first engineering directors based in India. As the sole engineering director in EP&T based in India, you'll partner with your US-based peer leaders in Engineering, Product, and Design, but will have broad latitude to shape culture, hiring practices, and operating norms for the team you build. 

You will personally recruit the senior bench, allowing you to pull talent from your network. You will hold the bar on AI-native engineering practices, partner closely with US-based domain experts and product managers to translate design intent into production reality, and work with Zillow's US-based platform and agentic engineering team to deliver the integration and AI infrastructure that connects your work into the broader enterprise. 

Responsibilities: 

Build the team

- Recruit, hire, and develop an India engineering team and management team
 - Recruit your senior bench, leveraging your network and your reputation to bring in the talent you need to deliver our vision
 - Coach the next layer of India leadership - managers and senior engineers who will be key to the success of your organization
 - Represent Zillow's India engineering presence externally; recruit actively from the Workday and ServiceNow ecosystems

Own the Workday platform

- Drive end-to-end Workday HR delivery: business process configuration, EIB integrations, scripted custom logic, security model, reporting, and production operations

 - Champion AI-augmented configuration patterns as the productivity multiplier on platform engineering and configuration work
 - Directly manage the Workday team and partner with the US-based platform and agentic engineering team on MCP integration and agent capabilities

Own the ServiceNow platform

- Drive end-to-end ServiceNow delivery: HR Service Delivery, IT Service Management, scoped applications, scripted REST endpoints, Integration Hub flows
 - Directly manage the ServiceNow team and partner with the US-based platform and agentic engineering team on MCP integration and agent capabilities

Establish operating norms

- Set the operating cadence with US-based domain experts, product managers, and platform engineering peers, maintaining end-to-end ownership and a tight feedback loop between US-based stakeholders, design partners, and engineering build teams. 
 - Build an engineering culture where AI is the engine of daily work: your team uses AI tooling to design and validate Workday business processes, generate ServiceNow flows, write and review platform-bounded code, and automate documentation and change evidence faster than traditional methods allow
 - Set multi-year strategic direction for India's platform scope, tightly coupled to Zillow's broader business and AI roadmap
 - Own budget, planning, vendor relationships, tooling, and talent decisions for the India organization

Partner across Zillow

- Engage as a peer technical voice with Zillow's HR business partners, IT customers, and engineering leadership
 - Represent the India team in EP&T leadership rituals - staff meetings, planning, monthly business reviews
 - Bridge time zones, cultures, and operating styles so the US-India model works as a single distributed engineering org

This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. 

Who you are

We are looking for a builder, a leader, and a talent magnet. You bring: 

- Team builder and talent magnet: you've built engineering teams from scratch. You recruit senior engineers from your network and selectively from outside, develop them into top performers, and set culture and operating norms early to grow a high-performing team from a blank page. 
 - AI-native posture: you actively use modern AI coding and agent tooling in your own work, and you have championed AI-tooling adoption in teams you've led. You're not someone who's "open to AI", you're already practicing it. 
 - Deep platform expertise with multi-platform breadth: deep expertise in at least one major enterprise SaaS platform (Workday HR strongly preferred), with proven breadth across two or more others (ServiceNow, Workday Financials, Salesforce, or similar). You know what excellence looks like in SaaS platform engineering and have built it more than once. 
 - Distributed engineering leadership: you have led offshore or distributed engineering centers, you have worked closely with US-based companies and leadership teams across the US-India time gap, and you understand how to keep distributed teams in sync on culture, operations excellence, and engineering practices. 
 - Multi-domain leadership: you have run engineering for multiple business domains simultaneously (HR, Support, Finance, Sales) and can context-switch credibly across stakeholder groups. 
 - Engineering leadership across software development and systems administration: you have led both application engineering and platform configuration/administration functions; you understand the differences, the interfaces between them, and how to staff and manage each. Sufficient hands-on background (programming, configuration, or platform certification) to engage credibly with senior individual contributors on architectural decisions. 
 - 15+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS platform engineering, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles managing managers and multi-functional engineering teams. 
 - Exceptional written and verbal English communication: you will be in rooms with senior US leadership regularly. 

Additional differentiating qualifications: 

- Workday Studio, EIB, or scripted integration depth (5+ years)
 - Experience partnering closely with a US-based VP or senior executive (5+ years)
 - ServiceNow platform experience (2+ years)
 - SOX or compliance-driven environment experience (2+ years)
 - Workday Financials experience (1-year or more preferred)
 - Active in the Workday or ServiceNow ecosystem (community, conferences, certifications)

Location

This role will be based in Bangalore, India. The role will require in-person presence at our Zillow Bangalore office and period travel to the US may be required for partnership, planning and leadership offsites. 

Get to know us

At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U. S. , we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. 

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U. S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. 

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together.

data.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced and innovative Controls Engineer to lead the design, development, optimization, and implementation of advanced control systems across critical infrastructure platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring the performance, reliability, and scalability of automation systems, with a strong focus on data center infrastructure, power/energy management, and industrial automation. 

The ideal candidate will serve as a technical leader, driving system architecture, integration, and execution across PLC, IPC-based controls, SCADA/HMI platforms, and enterprise systems including BMS and EPMS. 

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

- Define and own the control system architecture across multiple platforms including PLCs, IPC-based systems, SCADA, BMS, EPMS, and MES, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Lead development and implementation of PLC and IPC-based control systems using platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Beckhoff, and Codesys. 
 - Design and deploy SCADA and HMI systems across multiple platforms (Ignition, WinCC, FactoryTalk, AVEVA, etc. ). 
 - Develop structured, modular, and reusable control logic using IEC 61131-3 programming standards. 
 - Develop detailed control system documentation including Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Sequence of Operations (SOO), I/O lists, Cause & Effect matrices, Alarm matrices, and interface definitions. 
 - Create and review electrical schematics, control diagrams, and Bills of Materials (BOMs). 
 - Define control logic, sensor integration strategies, and communication protocols such as Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, and SNMP. 
 - Integrate control systems with BMS, EPMS, SCADA, MES, and cloud-based platforms to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability. 
 - Lead Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), ensuring system reliability, safety, and performance. 
 - Support commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of control systems in operational environments. 
 - Design and support control systems for mission-critical infrastructure including UPS, generators, switchgear, chillers, liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, and fire protection systems. 
 - Establish design standards, best practices, and reusable frameworks for scalable and consistent implementation. 
 - Lead root cause analysis and resolution of complex control system issues during commissioning and operations. 
 - Drive development and validation of system-level simulations and digital twin models. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies and automation trends to improve system efficiency and performance. 
 - Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, software, and facilities teams to ensure seamless integration with physical infrastructure. 
 - Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to align control system designs with business requirements, schedules, and operational constraints. 
 - Facilitate technical reviews, workshops, and planning sessions to ensure alignment across engineering disciplines. 

Knowledge & Skills

- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills. 
 - Self-motivated, accountable, and able to work independently within a global team. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. 
 - Ability to interpret technical documents, standards, and regulations. 
 - Skilled in writing reports, business correspondence, and procedural guides. 
 - Ability to influence stakeholders and mentor engineering teams. 
 - Familiarity with PLM/design tools (EPLAN, AutoCAD, Windchill, SolidWorks) and DevOps practices is a plus. 
 - Understanding of low and medium voltage electrical systems. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in control system design and implementation. 
 - Deep expertise in PLC/IPC programming (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Schneider, Beckhoff). 
 - Experience with SCADA/HMI development across multiple platforms. 
 - Experience with BMS integration and optimization. 
 - Experience with EPMS systems for real-time energy monitoring and analytics. 
 - Experience with industrial communication protocols (Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP). 
 - Familiarity with NFPA, IEC, and ISO standards related to control systems and safety. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline. 
 - Active Professional Engineer (PE) license. 
 - Experience in hyperscale or colocation data center environments. 
 - Experience with digital twin technologies and predictive maintenance strategies.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

You will be a Principal Engineer (PMTS) leading the Monitoring Cloud Events team in Hyderabad, India. Our team builds systems that handle huge amounts of data for Salesforce. We make sure everything in our cloud runs the way it should. In this role, your job is to guide the team, build great software, and own the services we create from start to finish. 

What You'll Actually Be Doing

- Day-to-day work: You will build and maintain an Observability stack using in-house, open source and cloud managed services and run data pipelines (ETL) and use big data tools. You will check system health and fix problems quickly so our services stay online. 
 - Leading the way: You will teach and mentor other engineers to help them grow and do their best work. 
 - Working together: You will talk to partners and customers all over the world to make sure they get what they need. 
 - Long-term goals & impact: You will make our cloud faster, safer, and easier to use for millions of people. You will learn how to run big, global systems and become a top leader in the tech world. 

Tech Stack: 

- Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments. 
 - Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing. 
 - Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines. 
 - Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage. 
 - Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling. 
 - Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets. 
 - Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage. 
 - Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups. 
 - Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing. 

You're Our Person If. . . 

- You have deep experience building software and leading engineering teams. 
 - You know how to move, store, and work with very large amounts of data. 
 - You are highly skilled at building ETL data pipelines. 
 - You have hands-on experience with open-source tools like Kafka, Flink, and Apache Druid. 
 - You are a kind and helpful mentor to other engineers. 
 - You are a great "service owner, " meaning you care deeply about keeping systems online and running smoothly. 

Even Better If. . . 

- You have worked on an Observability stack before (tools that monitor system health and logs). 
 - You have experience working with global teams across different countries and time zones. 
 - You enjoy talking directly to customers to understand and solve their problems. 

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. data.description:
Description

Amazon's Finance Technology (FinTech) organization is building the next generation of distributed, globally scalable financial systems - and we need your help. As a Software Development Engineer II on the General Ledger team, you will design and develop services that process hundreds of millions of transactions each month, powering accurate financial reporting across Amazon worldwide. 

You will work on greenfield services from the ground up, tackling complex problems in cloud computing, distributed data processing, and high-throughput transaction handling. Collaborating closely with product managers, data engineers, accountants, and principal engineers, you will have direct influence on architecture decisions and the opportunity to grow your technical leadership skills in a high-visibility, mission-critical space. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement software solutions across the full development lifecycle - from requirements and system design through coding, testing, deployment, and operations - in a large-scale distributed environment on AWS. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional partners including product managers, data engineers, and finance stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver the right technical solutions. 
 - Mentor teammates through code reviews and technical guidance, raising the bar on code quality, security, readability, and maintainability across the team. 
 - Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, continuously improving system reliability and the team's operational practices. 
 - Evaluate new technologies and architectural approaches to solve high-scale data processing challenges, making practical recommendations for adoption. 

About The Team

At the heart of FinTech's mission is the General Ledger team, which builds and operates the technologies to account for and post millions of financial transactions daily to support accurate internal and external financial reporting. This team processes on average 371MM+ transactions per month, servicing the accounting needs of Finance, Accounting, and Tax teams worldwide. The work of the General ledger team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 3+ years of full stack development experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

data.title: Delivery Manager-Test Lead
data.description:
Job Purpose

Looking for a Test Lead / Data QA Engineer to drive and oversee data validation, manual testing, and regression testing activities across capital markets data pipelines spanning both legacy and modern platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema verification, data reconciliation, lineage analysis, and automation-led regression testing. 

The ideal candidate combines strong data QA and testing expertise, hands-on automation skills, capital markets domain knowledge, and a proactive ownership mindset to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across environments. 

The successful candidate will lead test delivery, manage and coordinate offshore QA resources, and engage closely with business and technology stakeholders to maintain high-quality data across post-trade and enterprise data ecosystems. Key responsibilities include building reusable Python- and SQL-based validation frameworks, supporting batch and cloud-based execution models, identifying data anomalies, validating end-to-end data flows, and embedding robust data quality controls throughout the development lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end test planning, execution, and delivery for data validation and regression testing initiatives, ensuring quality, schedule, and stakeholder expectations are met. 
 - Manage and mentor offshore/onshore QA teams, including resource planning, task allocation, deliverable reviews, and adherence to testing best practices. 
 - Drive test governance, including test strategy, defect management, risk tracking, quality metrics, status reporting, and release readiness assessments. 
 - Collaborate with business, engineering, and product teams to define requirements, resolve issues, ensure test coverage, and embed quality controls across the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments. 
 - Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance. 
 - Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities. 
 - Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems. 
 - Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows. 
 - Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance. 
 - Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms. 
 - Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions. 
 - Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows. 
 - Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools. 
 - Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments. 
 - Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows. 
 - Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations. 
 - Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context. 
 - Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting. 

Key competencies

- 8-12 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles and proven experience leading QA teams, test planning, estimation, execution, defect management, and end-to-end test delivery across complex data programs. 
 - Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate test status, risks, quality metrics, and release readiness to business and technology leadership. 
 - Experience establishing test strategies, governance frameworks, quality standards, resource planning, and mentoring distributed QA teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, manage competing priorities, mitigate delivery risks, and ensure

successful project outcomes in Agile environments. 

- Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification. 
 - Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets. 
 - Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis. 
 - Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms. 
 - Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities. 
 - Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance. 
 - Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow. 
 - Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios. 
 - Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance. 
 - Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation. 
 - Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Domain Experience (Must Have)
 - Strong experience in Fixed Income Capital Markets domain
 - Good understanding of Fixed Income products, reference data, pricing, securities, positions, settlements, and trade lifecycle concepts
 - Experience working with market data, reference data, and regulatory reporting-related data sets

Nice to Have

- Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms. 
 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms. 
 - Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation. 
 - Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines. 
 - Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform

integrations. 

- Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.

Lead - Quality

Location: Navi Mumbai (Project Site)

Reporting To: Project Director/ Quality Team Lead

Business Title: Manager

We are seeking a Lead - Quality to lead and manage quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) activities for large‐scale electrical Low Side works in hyperscaler data center projects. The scope primarily includes MV and LV systems such as RMUs, Transformers, LV switchboards, UPS systems, batteries, busducts, cabling, earthing, and ELV systems. 

This role is suited for a mid-level to lead EPC professional with strong experience in project quality management, inspections, documentation, and client/PMC interface. The Lead - Quality will ensure that construction, testing, and commissioning activities are executed in full compliance with approved quality plans, project specifications, applicable standards, and hyperscaler requirements. 

The Lead - Quality will be responsible for achieving project quality objectives related to installation compliance, inspection readiness, defect prevention, documentation completeness, and handover quality, while ensuring alignment with defined project quality processes and EHS requirements. 

Key Responsibilities & Tasks

- Develop, implement, and monitor the Project Quality Plan (PQP) in line with contract requirements and client hyperscaler standards. 
 - Lead QA/QC activities for electrical Low Side works including installation, testing, and commissioning phases. 
 - Review and approve ITPs, method statements, checklists, inspection formats, and quality procedures. 
 - Coordinate with construction, commissioning (Cx), engineering, and safety teams to ensure quality requirements are embedded in execution. 
 - Ensure L1-L3 installation quality readiness prior to commissioning and support quality compliance during L4 IST and L5 reliability runs. 
 - Act as the primary interface with client, PMC, and third-party inspectors for inspections, audits, and quality reviews. 
 - Monitor site inspections, NCRs, observations, punch items, and corrective/preventive actions to closure. 
 - Ensure quality compliance of vendor and subcontractor works through audits, inspections, and surveillance. 
 - Support inspection and acceptance of electrical equipment, materials, and Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs) where applicable. 
 - Review and consolidate quality dossiers, inspection records, test certificates, and handover documentation. 
 - Conduct internal quality audits and ensure closeout of audit findings and lessons learned. 

Ideal Candidate Profile: 

Education: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Electrical EngineeringExperience & Competencies

- 12-15 years of experience in EPC projects with strong exposure to quality management and QA/QC execution. 
 - Proven experience as Quality Engineer / Quality Manager / Lead - Quality in data center or mission‐critical projects. 
 - Strong understanding of electrical Low Side systems including LV panels, UPS, batteries, busducts, cabling, earthing, and auxiliary systems. 
 - Experience supporting quality compliance across construction, testing, commissioning, and handover phases. 
 - Familiarity with hyperscaler quality standards, structured inspection processes, and documentation requirements. 
 - Strong capability to interface with clients, PMCs, vendors, and cross‐functional project teams. 
 - Good understanding of EHS integration with quality processes on active construction and energized sites. 
 - Strong leadership, coordination, communication, and documentation skills.

data.title: AI Quality Automation Engineer – Assistant Vice President
data.description:
In this AVP-level role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining automated testing frameworks for AI systems. You will validate model accuracy, data pipelines, and software integrations to ensure high performance, reliability, and ethical compliance across the development lifecycle. 

You will act as a crucial bridge between data science, software engineering, and quality assurance, working closely with data scientists, ML systems engineers, front-end engineers, and business leaders. If you are passionate about operationalizing complex models, creating highly reliable automated validation services, and defining the quality lifecycle for data science workflows at an enterprise scale, this role is a perfect fit. 

Key Responsibilities & Competencies

- Quality Framework Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks specifically tailored for AI/ML systems, including LLMs, RAG pipelines, and traditional ML models. 
 - Model & Output Validation: Design and execute automated evaluation pipelines to measure critical metrics such as hallucination rates, context retention, retrieval precision, semantic similarity, and answer relevance (using tools like RAGAs, DsPy). 
 - Data Pipeline & ETL Auditing: Validate the quality, integrity, and schema compliance of data pipelines and ETL processes (PySpark, Hive, Kafka, Parquet, Iceberg) to ensure clean data flows into AI models. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated AI quality gates into enterprise CI/CD pipelines (using Tekton, Harness, UDeploy, Jenkins) to enable continuous testing and prevent regressions. 
 - Risk Stewardship & Compliance: Lead adversarial testing (Red Teaming) to identify vulnerabilities like prompt injection, jailbreaking, and data leakage. Validate real-time safety guardrails to ensure compliance with ethical AI guidelines, corporate policies, and regulatory standards. 
 - Operational Excellence & Observability: Implement monitoring and observability solutions (using MLFlow, Dagster, Vertex AI, SageMaker) to detect model drift, performance degradation, and latency bottlenecks in production. 
 - Stakeholder Engagement: Demonstrate exceptional communication and diplomacy skills, effectively engaging with cross-functional stakeholders to articulate quality risks, negotiate solutions, and align on quality benchmarks. 

Required Skills & Technical Qualifications

- Experience: 5-8 years of professional experience implementing data-intensive solutions or test automation frameworks using agile methodologies, with at least 2-3 years of direct experience validating AI/ML, Generative AI, or data-intensive systems. 
 - Programming Languages: 
 - Primary: Python, Shell Scripting, Jupyter Notebook Scripting
 - Secondary: Java
 - Machine Learning & AI Evaluation Frameworks: 
 - Core ML: Scikit-learn, Keras, TensorFlow, PyTorch, spaCy, NLTK
 - Advanced NLP & GenAI Evaluation: RAGAs, DsPy, Hugging Face Transformers, RASA, Large Language Models (LLM)
 - MLOps & ML Lifecycle Management: 
 - Platforms: MLFlow, Dagster, Google Cloud Vertex AI, Amazon SageMaker
 - Database Management Systems: 
 - Relational: Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL
 - NoSQL: MongoDB
 - Infrastructure & DevOps: 
 - CI/CD & DevOps Tooling: UDeploy, Harness, Tekton, Jenkins, Maven
 - Version Control: Git, Subversion (SVN)
 - Containerization & Orchestration: Docker, OpenShift, Amazon ECS
 - Data Engineering & Processing: 
 - Messaging & Asynchronous Communication: Kafka, RabbitMQ
 - ETL & Data Warehousing: Sqoop, PySpark, Hive, Hadoop, HDFS
 - File Formats: Avro, Parquet, Iceberg
 - Job Scheduling & Orchestration: Autosys, Cron

Collaborates with development, product, and architecture teams to build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure, monitoring, and operational processes. Drives automation, environment management, incident resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system reliability, performance, and developer productivity. Leverages expertise in Azure/AWS, Infrastructure-as-Code, containers, scripting, and DevOps best practices while supporting enterprise-scale applications and services

Key Responsibilities

- Collaborate with development, product management, and architecture teams to enhance developer platforms and support delivery of critical business applications and services. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain solutions that improve the availability, performance, reliability, and scalability of systems and applications. 
 - Participate in the design, deployment, administration, and support of cloud and on-premises infrastructure. 
 - Develop, maintain, and document DevOps processes, standards, and operational procedures to promote engineering best practices. 
 - Manage and automate the lifecycle of Development, QA, Staging, and Production environments across cloud and on-premises platforms. 
 - Build and maintain infrastructure required for multiple development and testing environments, ensuring consistency, stability, and release readiness. 
 - Implement, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient and reliable software delivery. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve build, deployment, release, and environment-related issues to minimize delivery disruptions. 
 - Evaluate and integrate new tools, technologies, and automation capabilities to improve developer productivity and operational efficiency. 
 - Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools for cloud infrastructure, application deployment, and operational management. 
 - Create monitoring, logging, tracing, deployment, and self-healing solutions to improve system reliability and reduce manual operational effort. 
 - Support incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance platform stability and service availability. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the adoption of DevOps best practices across the engineering organization. 

Essential Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Operations, Infrastructure Engineering, or a related role. 
 - Strong understanding of software development, systems administration, and operational support practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with developers, architects, product managers, and cross-functional teams. 
 - Proven experience driving automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and developer productivity. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues. 
 - Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Sound judgment, ownership mindset, and ability to prioritize and escalate issues when appropriate. 
 - Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments supporting enterprise-scale applications and services. 

Desired Skills And Competencies

 - Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar languages. 
 - Experience designing, implementing, and supporting CI/CD pipelines and release automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms, including infrastructure deployment and management. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (ARM Templates, Bicep, Terraform, or CloudFormation). 
 - Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience deploying and supporting Microsoft technologies such as . NET applications, SQL Server, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure Automation.

 - Experience with monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of cloud-based applications and infrastructure. 
 - Understanding of security, identity management, and access control using Azure AD, AWS IAM, Active Directory, and related technologies. 
 - Experience with test automation frameworks and scripting validation tools is a plus. 
 - Experience in Azure Service Fabric is an added advantage. 

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name. 

Our track record of innovation is no fluke - it's the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

India Benefits include: 

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

It's possible we're hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process. 

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process. 

Find out more: aveva. com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

data.title: Server Performance Architect - Hardware
data.description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life's work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!

NVIDIA is seeking architects to drive architectural performance for its next-generation AI server systems. This position demands a unique capability to bridge deep architectural knowledge, workload analysis, and hands-on silicon investigations. Candidates should be adept at working directly with silicon, high-level models, and simulators. Responsibilities include conducting performance investigations on both NVIDIA and competitive platforms, and developing targeted microbenchmarks to examine specific architectural aspects. The role does not heavily involve modeling tasks (functional or performance), though occasional focused assignments may arise. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Defining and driving server-level performance targets across CPU, GPU, memory, interconnect, networking, and storage subsystems
 - Conducting hands-on workload characterisation and bottleneck analysis on NVIDIA and competitive server platforms using AI training, inference, and HPC benchmarks
 - Leveraging profiling, tracing, and analysis tools to root-cause performance issues and identify optimisation opportunities at the system level
 - Performing trade-off studies on system topology, thermal/power envelopes, and memory hierarchy to guide architectural decisions
 - Collaborating with silicon, platform, firmware, and software teams to identify and close performance gaps from bring-up through production
 - Developing automation and tooling for performance regression tracking and reporting
 - Representing the performance perspective in architecture reviews and cross-functional design discussions
 - Building and maintaining analytical performance models and simulation frameworks for next-generation server platforms
 - Publishing internal performance studies and best-practice guides for partner and customer enablement

What We Need To See

- BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
 - 10+ years of experience in server/system performance architecture or related disciplines
 - Deep understanding of modern server architectures - CPU microarchitecture, PCIe/CXL, DDR/HBM memory subsystems, and coherency protocols
 - Strong hands-on experience with system-level profiling and performance analysis tools on server platform(s)
 - Solid knowledge of GPU-accelerated compute, high-performance networking, or high-performance storage subsystems
 - Proficiency in Python, C/C++, or similar languages for scripting, data analysis, and tool development
 - Comfortable and proficient using AI-powered coding and productivity tools to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation workflows
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to distil complex performance data into actionable architectural recommendations

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience with AI/ML training and inference workloads at data-centre scale
 - Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (Hopper, Blackwell, Rubin) and associated software stacks (CUDA, NCCL)
 - Background in chip-to-chip interconnect performance analysis (C2C, UCIe)
 - Exposure to power/thermal-aware performance optimisation techniques
 - Track record of contributions to industry conferences or published performance studies

data.title: Staff Software Engineer — Active Directory Internals & Directory Services
data.description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13, 600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas' enterprise data protection business, the company's solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe. 

We've been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture. 

Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?

About The Role

We're looking for an engineer who understands Active Directory the way its designers do - not just how to administer it, but how it actually works underneath: how objects replicate, how changes are tracked, how deletions age out, and how identity continuity is preserved across restores. You'll build and harden the core engine that reads, tracks, and safely writes AD state, powering reliable backup, synchronization, and recovery at scale. 

This is a deep-systems role. If you've ever debugged a replication metadata mismatch, reasoned about USN rollback, or cared about SID history surviving a cross-domain restore, you'll be at home here. 

What You'll Do

- Design and implement the directory engine that discovers, tracks, and safely applies changes to Active Directory objects. 
 - Build robust change-tracking pipelines using DirSync, USN cookies, and change notification, handling cursor persistence, catch-up, and re-sync correctly. 
 - Implement correct object lifecycle handling - tombstones, deleted-object lifetime, and Recycle Bin semantics - for accurate backup and recovery. 
 - Guarantee identity continuity across operations: SID, SID history, and GUID preservation and validation. 
 - Implement safe write paths - modify, ModifyDN, and object creation - with idempotency, conflict handling, and integrity guarantees. 
 - Work with AD-integrated DNS and Group Policy internals to ensure complete, consistent capture and restore. 
 - Diagnose and resolve complex replication, consistency, and LDAP edge cases in production environments. 

Required Skills & Experience

You should have hands-on, internals-level expertise across most of the following: 

Schema & Replication

- AD schema, object classes, and linked-value replication
 - Replication metadata, USN semantics, and consistency reasoning

Directory Access

- LDAP search and controls, including paged and persistent search
 - DirSync, USN cookies, and change notification for change tracking

Object Lifecycle

- Tombstones, deleted-object lifetime, and AD Recycle Bin behavior

Identity Continuity

- SID, SID history, and GUID continuity semantics across domains and restores

Group Policy & DNS

- Group Policy internals: GPC / GPT and SYSVOL
 - AD-integrated DNS zones and records

Safe Writes

- Correct and safe modify, ModifyDN, and object-create operations

Nice to Have

- Experience building backup, replication, disaster-recovery, or migration tooling for Active Directory. 
 - Familiarity with Entra ID / Azure AD hybrid environments. 
 - Depth in C/C++, C#, Go; systems-level performance work. 
 - Experience operating against large, multi-domain / multi-forest deployments.

data.title: Director - Front-End Engineering
data.company: BCE Global Tech - A Bell Canada Company
data.description:
Back

Job Description

We are seeking a Director of Front-End Engineering to lead one of the Experience domain groups within Bell's Cornerstones re-platforming program - the federated, module-federation architecture behind bell. ca (the shell, its micro-frontends, and the shared design system and tooling that support them). This is not a staffing or execution role: we are looking for a true engineering partner who takes complete, end-to-end ownership of a business outcome and is accountable for how it is delivered, not just that it is delivered. You will own one or two Experience domains (for example Checkout or Solution Builder) across the program's West, Atlantic, and Central phases, build and run a self-sufficient pod, set the hiring bar for your organization, and represent India as a full partner to the Canada-based Experience leadership with the standing and judgment to disagree, be heard, and then commit. 

Leadership & Management Skills

- Outcome Ownership: Proven ability to take complete ownership of a business outcome end-to-end - understanding the target, debating the technical approach and trade-offs, and once a decision is made, committing to it and being accountable for its delivery, quality, and long-term shelf life in production. 
 - Hiring Accountability: Full accountability for interviewing, vetting, and hiring top engineering talent for your pod(s) - you are personally responsible for the quality of the team you build and the delivery that results from it. 
 - Pod & Delivery Leadership: Ability to stand up and run a pod (or pod of pods) that owns a domain end-to-end: onboarding engineers, running delivery governance that is lightweight rather than bureaucratic, and escalating only the blockers that genuinely need to be bubbled up. 
 - Cross-Geo Partnership: Comfort operating as an extension of the Canada-based team rather than a downstream vendor - attending daily stand-ups, building direct working relationships with Salesforce, integration, and SRE counterparts, and knowing who to call when something crosses a domain boundary. 
 - Architectural Voice: A mandate to bring architectural authority to the table: thought leaders on this team work with delivery so that what is proposed is what actually ships and holds up in production, rather than designs that drift once handed off. 
 - Culture Building: A servant-leader who protects a culture of innovation, delivery, and fun, and who actively resists unnecessary process - the goal is a lean, fast, and simple way of working, not adding heavyweight reporting because "that's how it's always been done. "
 - Talent Magnetism: Ability to attract and retain talent that can compete with Bangalore's startup market - engineers who bring modern technical curiosity and creative problem-solving, not only integration/operations profiles. 

Technical Skills & Acumen

- Module Federation / Micro-Frontend Architecture: Deep working knowledge of federated front-end architecture: a shared shell (navigation, session, layout, analytics) plus independently owned and deployed micro-frontends (MFEs), each mapped to a single business domain (e. g. , Qualification, Product Catalog, Checkout, Billing, Customer Profile). 
 - Stack Fluency: Comfort overseeing modern front-end stacks - React 19, TanStack Router/Query, a shared design system (Brand UI and Product UI), and standardized build/test tooling (Rspack, Vitest browser-mode testing, visual regression) - even without writing the code personally day to day. 
 - Engineering Standards & CI/CD: Understanding of how Guardrails-over-gatekeeping pipelines work (linting, TypeScript, security scanning, live review environments) so standards are enforced by tooling, not by adding process. 
 - Integration & Systems Thinking: Awareness of how the front end integrates with Salesforce, MuleSoft, and other backend/API layers - enough to debate translation and integration approaches with an architectural and cost lens, and to know when a workaround belongs in the API layer rather than the front end. 
 - AI-Assisted Delivery: Experience championing AI-assisted SDLC - planning agents, delivery agents, and AI-assisted testing - to help developers ship faster and with fewer defects. 
 - Observability & Production Readiness: Familiarity with observability and AIOps practices (proactive/reactive tiering, telemetry pipelines, tools such as New Relic and Dynatrace) so your domain's production health is visible and defensible. 
 - Systems Thinking: Ability to look across your domain(s) and adjacent ones to spot reuse opportunities, reduce tech debt, and avoid rebuilding what already exists in the shared platform. 

Qualifications

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role (Director or equivalent) owning delivery for teams of 50+ engineers. 
 - Demonstrated success building and scaling teams in a GCC, global capability center, or global delivery model - ideally one that has moved from staff augmentation to outcome ownership. 
 - Hands-on or recent front-end engineering background (React or comparable modern framework); experience with micro-frontend or federated architectures is a strong plus. 
 - Experience in telecommunications or large-scale digital/retail platforms is a strong plus. 
 - A track record of building trust with distributed stakeholders and operating with autonomy rather than waiting to be told what to do. 

What We Offer

- Professional development and training opportunities
 - A supportive and inclusive work environment
 - Access to cutting-edge technology and tools.
