Overview

Microsoft 365 is the world's leading productivity service, trusted by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. Microsoft 365 Core Platform is at the center of it all, building foundational, secure, and intelligent services that connect enterprise content with Microsoft 365 Copilot and the experiences people use every day. Our work helps customers unlock knowledge across email, documents, messages, and business applications so that people and AI agents can find, understand, and act on the right information. 

The Connectors team is building the extensibility and data-access layer that brings enterprise knowledge into Microsoft 365 Copilot. This includes first-party (1P) Microsoft Graph Connectors that ingest and index high-value content, and Federated Copilot Connectors (FCC) that enable secure, real-time access to external systems. The team's work is critical to expanding Copilot's reach, grounding quality, freshness, and enterprise trust across a broad ecosystem of data sources. 

We are looking for a Software Engineer II who combines solid engineering fundamentals with an AI-native mindset. You will solve well-scoped technical problems, turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable product experiences, and collaborate with partner teams in a co-development model. You are curious, innovative, customer-focused, and motivated to contribute to secure, scalable, and high-quality connector experiences. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

As a Software Engineer II, you will design, build, test, and operate connector capabilities across 1P Graph Connectors and FCC. You will contribute to technical designs and engineering practices, collaborate across team boundaries, and help deliver secure, reliable, and AI-ready integrations using shared platform capabilities.

About Us: 

Marriott International Inc. , headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland, USA, was founded in May 1927 by J. Willard Marriott and Alice S. Marriott with a modest nine-seat A&W root beer stand. Guided by the family's leadership and core principles, Marriott International today has grown into a global hospitality giant, operating approximately 10, 000 properties and over 30 leading brands in more than 140 countries and territories. 

From such humble beginnings to becoming the world's largest hotel company, Marriott International has never stopped searching for inventive ways to serve its customers, provide opportunities for its associates, and grow their business. At Marriott Tech Accelerator center (MTA), Hyderabad, India, Marriott is exploring the world we live in and all its possibilities. At Marriott Tech Accelerator, we are a team of passionate engineering minds dedicated to creating and building cutting-edge solutions that streamline operations and elevate guest experiences. 

Marriott Tech Accelerator is an ANSR entity incorporated exclusively for providing services to Marriott International. 

Role Title: Software Engineer

Experience Range: 2-4 years

Work Location: Hyderabad, India

Work Mode: Hybrid

Position Summary: 

Marriott has an exciting opportunity for a Software Engineer specializing in Search Engine technologies on the Enterprise Commerce Search team. This role focuses on building, tuning, and operating the enterprise search capabilities that power fast, relevant, and reliable discovery experiences across Marriott's digital commerce channels. 

We are looking for a Software Engineer with strong hands-on experience in search technologies, including index design, query construction, analyzers, and relevance tuning on platforms such as Amazon OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Apache Solr, or Lucid works Fusion. The role also requires solid backend engineering skills in Java and Python using Spring WebFlux and FastAPI to expose search capabilities through scalable, production-ready services. 

You will work closely with senior engineers, architects, product partners, QA, SRE, and dependent commerce teams to deliver secure, observable, and high-performing search solutions. The ideal candidate enjoys working with search relevance, indexing pipelines, query performance, distributed systems, and Agile engineering practices. 

Job Responsibilities: 

Technical Contributions & Collaboration: 

- Design, develop, test, and maintain search capabilities for the Enterprise Commerce Search platform, including indexes, mappings, analyzers, and query templates. 
 - Build and enhance search APIs and event-driven integrations using Java with Spring WebFlux and Python with FastAPI. 
 - Implement query processing, filters, facets, autosuggestions, recommendations, multilingual and relevance-tuning enhancements. 
 - Develop and support indexing pipelines and data ingestion flows between source systems and enterprise search engines. 
 - Participate in code reviews, relevance reviews, technical discussions, troubleshooting, and engineering best practices. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Catalog, digital channels, QA, SRE, and platform engineering. 

Delivering Technology: 

- Translate business and functional requirements into effective search schemas, queries, and ranking behaviors. 
 - Build and enhance search APIs, indexing pipelines, data transformations, and platform integrations. 
 - Write unit and integration tests and support functional, relevance, performance, and regression testing. 
 - Participate in CI/CD deployments, index migrations, and reindexing activities across lower and production environments. 
 - Monitor search services, analyze query performance, logs, and distributed traces, and support timely resolution of defects and production issues. 
 - Identify technical risks, dependencies, and operational concerns and communicate them proactively. 

IT Governance: 

- Follow enterprise architecture, development, release, and operational governance standards. 
 - Apply secure coding practices and comply with API security, privacy, and data-protection requirements. 
 - Maintain technical documentation such as index and schema definitions, API specifications, design notes, deployment procedures, and runbooks. 

Skills and Experience: 

Search Technologies: 

- 2-4 years of software development experience, with hands-on work on search technologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with a search platform such as Amazon OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Apache Solr, or Lucid works Fusion. 
 - Working knowledge of search indexes, mappings and schemas, analyzers, tokenizers, and query DSL construction. 
 - Experience with query tuning, filters, facets, sorting, pagination, synonyms, stop words, boosting, and relevance improvement. 
 - Experience building and supporting indexing pipelines, reindexing, and data transformation between source systems and search engines. 

Backend & Microservices: 

- Good proficiency in Java and Python, with working experience using Spring Web Flux and FastAPI to integrate with and expose Amazon OpenSearch and Apache Solr search capabilities. 
 - Experience developing, testing, and troubleshooting search features on OpenSearch and Solr, including query DSL, Solr request handlers, and search components. 
 - Working knowledge of OpenSearch and Solr cluster concepts such as shards, replicas, nodes, index aliases, SolrCloud collections, and ZooKeeper. 
 - Understanding of search features such as typeahead, recommendations, spell check, multilingual, and query rewriting. 
 - Experience analyzing search latency, timeouts, and throughput, and applying query, index, and cluster-level optimizations such as caching, deep pagination strategies, and shard sizing. 

Cloud & DevOps: 

- Hands-on experience with Amazon OpenSearch or Lucidworks Fusion (Solr), including cluster setup and index management. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes. 
 - Familiarity with production monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, including logs, metrics, distributed traces, and search query performance analysis. 

Commerce Engineering: 

- Experience working with eCommerce, digital commerce, content discovery, or customer-facing search platforms is preferred. 

Security & Quality: 

- Knowledge of API security concepts such as OAuth 2. 0, JWT, authentication, and authorization. 
 - Familiarity with OWASP guidance and secure coding standards. 
 - Experience with unit testing and mocking frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito, along with integration testing. 
 - Experience with API documentation and code-quality tools such as Swagger/OpenAPI and SonarQube. 

General: 

- Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills. 
 - Ability to communicate clearly, collaborate across teams, and work effectively with guidance from senior engineers. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments and contributing to sprint planning, estimation, demos, and retrospectives. 
 - Curiosity and willingness to deepen expertise in search engine technologies, microservices, cloud technologies, and commerce platforms. 

Education and Certifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

data.title: UI/UX & Frontend Designer
data.description:
Sententia AILocation:   Remote / Hybrid

Experience:   0-3 years

Type:   Full-time / Internship-to-Full-time

Reporting to:   Founders' Office

About Sententia AISententia AI is building a first-of-its-kind Transaction Intelligence Platform for law firms, private equity and venture capital funds, investment banks, and corporate advisory teams. 

Sententia brings intelligence, structure and execution together across complex transactions - helping professionals analyse deals, structure investments, map transaction flows, identify risks, build deal timelines, and generate  client-ready and execution-ready documents and transaction materials. 

We are building a product for professionals who work on some of the most complex transactions in the world. The product therefore needs to be  intuitive enough to use effortlessly, but sophisticated enough to handle institutional-grade workflows. 

The RoleWe are looking for a  UI/UX & Frontend Designer  to work directly with the  Founders' Office  and take ownership of the visual and product experience of Sententia. 

You will be involved from  concept → user experience → interface design → frontend implementation, working closely with the founders, product and engineering team to turn complex transaction workflows into elegant, intuitive interfaces. 

This is not a role limited to designing screens. 

You will help define  how Sententia looks, feels and works. 

What You Will Work On
 - Design intuitive and high-quality interfaces for Sententia's transaction intelligence platform. 
 - Translate complex legal, financial and transaction workflows into simple, usable product experiences. 
 - Design  deal dashboards, transaction workspaces, investment structures, deal diagrams, timelines, risk intelligence interfaces and document-generation workflows. 
 - Develop user journeys, wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity designs. 
 - Build and maintain a consistent  design system and component library. 
 - Work closely with founders and engineers to translate designs into functional frontend experiences. 
 - Contribute to frontend development using modern web technologies. 
 - Create responsive interfaces for desktop and web-based professional workflows. 
 - Design data-dense interfaces without compromising clarity or usability. 
 - Continuously improve the product based on user feedback, testing and founder/product direction. 
 - Help establish Sententia's visual identity across the product and, where required, its website and marketing interfaces. 
 - Work directly with the Founders' Office on new product concepts, experiments and rapid prototypes. What We're Looking ForDesign

- Strong understanding of UI/UX principles and product design. 
 - Ability to design clean, modern and professional interfaces. 
 - Strong understanding of typography, spacing, hierarchy, grids and visual systems. 
 - Experience with  Figma  or equivalent design tools. 
 - Ability to create high-fidelity prototypes and communicate design decisions clearly. 
 - Strong product thinking - you should be able to understand  why  something should be designed a certain way, not just how it should look. Frontend

- Working knowledge of  HTML, CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript. 
 - Experience with  React / Next. js  is strongly preferred. 
 - Understanding of responsive web design and component-based development. 
 - Ability to convert Figma designs into polished, functional frontend interfaces. 
 - Familiarity with Git and modern frontend development workflows is a plus. You Will Be a Strong Fit If You
 - Are obsessed with building products that  look exceptional and work exceptionally well. 
 - Have an eye for detail and care about the smallest aspects of an interface. 
 - Can make complex information feel simple. 
 - Are comfortable working in an early-stage startup where requirements evolve rapidly. 
 - Enjoy working directly with founders and having significant ownership over your work. 
 - Can move quickly from  idea → prototype → product. 
 - Are interested in  AI, legal technology, financial technology, private markets, investment banking or enterprise software. 
 - Think beyond individual screens and understand the product as a complete experience. What You Can Expect at Sententia
 - Direct exposure to the Founders' Office  and senior decision-making. 
 - Significant ownership over the product's UI/UX direction. 
 - Opportunity to work on a product at the intersection of  AI × Law × Finance × Transactions. 
 - Freedom to experiment with new interaction models and product ideas. 
 - Exposure to real-world workflows used in  M&A, PE/VC, investment banking and legal transactions. 
 - A fast-moving environment where your work can directly influence the product. 
 - Opportunity to grow into a broader  Product Design / Product Engineering  role as Sententia scales. The Mindset We ValueWe are not looking for someone who simply executes design tickets. 

We are looking for someone who can sit with the founders, understand a problem, ask the right questions, sketch a solution, build a prototype and ultimately help ship it. 

If you can look at a complex transaction workflow and think, "There has to be a better way to do this, " - we want to hear from you. 

How to ApplyInterested candidates can  apply directly  or send their application and portfolio to: 

connect@sententia. in

Please include: 

- CV / Resume
 - Portfolio or previous work
 - GitHub / relevant projects, if applicable
 - A brief note explaining why you would like to build Sententia with us
 - Subject:   Application - UI/UX & Frontend Designer | Sententia AI

data.description:
Ascentt is building cutting-edge data analytics & AI/ML solutions for global automotive and manufacturing leaders. We turn enterprise data into real-time decisions using advanced machine learning and GenAI. Our team solves hard engineering problems at scale, with real-world industry impact. We're hiring passionate builders to shape the future of industrial intelligence. 

QA Lead

Location: Indore, Pune

Experience: 8+ years (2+ years leading a QA team)

Work from Office Monday to Friday

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced QA Lead to own test strategy, automation and release quality on a large-scale enterprise platform delivered for a global automotive client. 

The QA Lead will lead an offshore QA team within a distributed onsite/offshore model, partnering daily with US-based technical leads, developers and product stakeholders to ensure every release is well-tested, predictable and delivered on sprint commitments. 

What You Will Do

Define and own the test strategy, test plans, estimates and quality gates for platform releases. 

Design, build and maintain UI and API test automation frameworks (Selenium/Playwright, REST Assured) using Java or Python. 

Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines so that regression runs are fast, repeatable and trusted. 

Lead, mentor and allocate work across the offshore QA team; review test cases and automation code to keep the bar high. 

Drive functional, regression, integration, system and UAT test cycles, including backend and data validation using SQL. 

Run defect triage with developers and product, drive root-cause analysis and track fixes through to closure. 

Track and report quality metrics - coverage, defect leakage, pass rates - and provide clear go/no-go recommendations for releases. 

Participate in Agile ceremonies - sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups and reviews - providing realistic QA estimates and flagging risk early. 

Document test approaches, frameworks and QA processes so that knowledge is transferable across the onsite and offshore team. 

Collaborate proactively across time zones with US-based leads, developers and product, communicating quality status and blockers without needing to be chased. 

A Note on Hands-On Leadership

This is a hands-on lead role. The QA Lead is expected to write and maintain automation alongside the team, not only coordinate testing. Candidates should be able to walk through a framework they personally built or maintained, explain the design choices behind it, and write or debug a test live. 

Required Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

8+ years of software QA experience, including 2+ years leading or mentoring a QA team. 

Proven ability to define test strategy, test plans and estimates for enterprise applications. 

Strong hands-on test automation with Selenium WebDriver, Playwright or Cypress using Java or Python. 

Solid API testing experience with Postman and REST Assured, including microservices-based systems. 

Experience with TestNG/JUnit and BDD frameworks such as Cucumber. 

Good SQL skills for backend and data validation against relational databases. 

Experience integrating tests into CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, with Git-based workflows. 

Experience with defect and test management in Jira (Xray, Zephyr or similar). 

Experience delivering in Agile/Scrum teams within a distributed onsite/offshore model. 

Excellent written and verbal English communication, with the ability to work directly with US-based leads and stakeholders across time zones. 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline. 

Preferred / Differentiating Qualifications

Performance and load testing experience with JMeter, Gatling or k6. 

Mobile test automation experience with Appium. 

Contract testing and microservices test approaches; exposure to Docker/Kubernetes. 

Experience testing on cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. 

Awareness of security testing basics and test data management practices. 

Experience testing large-scale enterprise platforms; ISTQB certification (Foundation or Advanced Test Manager) is a plus. 

Characteristics of the Person We Are Looking For

Genuinely hands-on. Builds and maintains automation, not just test plans. 

A leader. Grows the team, sets standards and holds the quality bar without micromanaging. 

A clear communicator. Explains quality risk plainly in English, in writing and on a call, to onsite leads and non-engineers alike. 

Detail-oriented. Catches the edge cases others miss and insists on evidence before sign-off. 

A strong investigator. Reproduces issues reliably, reasons from logs and data, and pinpoints root cause with developers. 

Proactive across time zones. Surfaces risks and progress early rather than going quiet between stand-ups. 

Pragmatic. Balances test coverage against delivery reality and knows where risk-based testing is the right call. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful QA Lead delivers predictable, well-tested releases with low defect leakage. Automation coverage grows sprint over sprint, regression is fast and trusted, and quality status is clear and credible to onsite leads. The offshore QA team becomes a self-sufficient, high-performing unit rather than a bottleneck.

data.description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world's money. 

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed. 

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. 

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. 

For everyone, everywhere. 

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer. 

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join our Platform Integrations APAC team, where you'll help expand and maintain direct integrations with payment systems and partners across the region. 

What is the Platform Integrations APAC (PI-APAC) team?

The Platform Integrations squad sits within the Platform tribe, which designs, builds and operates the foundational direct integration infrastructure that power the product that moves billions of dollars every month. The Platform Integrations APAC team within PI leads the direct integrations in the APAC region while also supporting integrations all over the world. 

Here's how you'll be contributing to the Team?

- Design, implement and maintain integrations between Wise and complex financial systems. 
 - Develop and design scalable and repeatable architecture with complex regulatory requirements. 
 - Analyse infrastructure to determine inefficiencies and problems, and create automation and optimisation. 
 - Collaborate with our larger platform engineering team and alongside product engineering on globally impactful projects. 
 - Communicate with various stakeholders throughout Wise, plan roadmaps with your team, and work through challenges to determine scope and realistic delivery. 
 - Work with Leads and Engineers to influence the direction and change current technology implementations, as well as advocate for excellence with third parties. 

This Role Will Give You The Opportunity To

- Work in a modern, cloud heavy environment where remote connectivity is a staple of our tech ecosystem
 - Choose your path to impact - we believe people and teams are most empowered when they can act autonomously. So rather than telling you what to do, you'll work with your team to create a vision of your own. Of course, you can always gather feedback from smart, curious people across Wise but you'll have the freedom to make your own calls
 - Grow as an engineer - understand what problems the business needs to solve and why, then proactively resolve them. We shy away from micro management
 - Approach new challenges with the freedom to develop novel and customised solutions
 - Be part of our mission to make money without borders the new normal

Qualifications

Desirable Skills and Experience

- Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals and experience with supporting complex deployments - TCP/IP, routing and switching, traffic load-balancing/ECMP, configuring firewalls, IPSEC, GRE, security policies, Network ACLs, complex routing with BGP
 - Experience in SRE and Network automation - IaaC, Python, Ansible, Netconf, CI/CD, telemetry
 - Excellent candidates would have JNCIS/CCNP-level knowledge and familiarity with networking on Linux for non-trivial tasks (e. g: running routing protocols on Linux, IPSec tunnels). Strong candidates will also have hands-on-experience with cloud networking concepts, preferably with AWS (e. g. VPCs, transit gateways, direct-connect, VPC peering). We welcome candidates who aspire to this level of knowledge if they don't yet have it. 
 - Experience in developing and documenting network designs
 - Ability to translate business requirements into explainable technical solutions for internal and external stakeholders
 - Leading technical projects or small team of engineers would be a great plus

The following is a list of some of the technologies and vendors we use. It is not an exclusive list nor do we expect you to know everything. But it gives a flavour. 

- AWS Networking: VPC, VGW, Transit-GW, Direct-Connect, VPC Peering, Cloud WAN
 - VPNs (we use IPSec heavily)
 - Vendors: Cisco, Juniper and Checkpoints (both Physical & Cloud version)
 - L2 Switching
 - Routing: BGP
 - ISP Peering, DataCenter integrations, cross-connects

Job Purpose

The Performance Management Engineer is responsible for analyzing wind turbine operational data to identify areas for performance improvement. This role uses advanced data analytics tools to assess turbine efficiency, power output, and reliability, conducting root cause analysis on performance deviations and implementing corrective actions. The Engineer participates in testing and validation of performance enhancements, such as control system updates and aerodynamic optimizations, and manages SCADA systems to ensure accurate data collection and monitoring. This role also involves supporting predictive maintenance initiatives by analyzing condition-based data and implementing maintenance strategies that reduce downtime. The Performance Management Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams to align performance enhancement activities with overall product development goals and contributes to continuous improvement by proposing new methodologies and tools to optimize turbine performance. 

Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Performance Monitoring

- Analyze operational data from wind turbines to assess performance against expected benchmarks, including power output, efficiency, and availability. 
 - Use advanced data analytics software (e. g. , MATLAB, Python, R) to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement in turbine performance. 

Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting

- Conduct performance optimization studies, focusing on areas such as blade aerodynamics, control system tuning, and power curve adjustments. 
 - Assist in troubleshooting performance issues on-site, using diagnostic tools to perform root cause analysis and implement corrective measures. 

Testing and Validation of Performance Improvements

- Participate in the testing and validation of performance enhancement initiatives, including prototype testing and field trials. 
 - Collect and analyze test data to validate improvements, providing feedback to engineering teams for further refinement. 

SCADA and Data Acquisition System Management

- Manage SCADA systems and other data acquisition tools, ensuring accurate and reliable data collection for performance analysis. 
 - Set up alarms, thresholds, and monitoring parameters to track key performance indicators in real-time. 

Predictive Maintenance and Condition Monitoring

- Implement predictive maintenance strategies using data analytics to forecast potential failures and schedule proactive maintenance. 
 - Monitor condition-based data, such as vibration and temperature readings, to detect early signs of component wear and prevent performance drops. 

Documentation and Reporting

- Maintain detailed records of performance analysis, tests conducted, and optimization measures implemented. 
 - Prepare performance reports, highlighting key findings, improvement opportunities, and corrective actions taken. 

Compliance with Standards and Procedures

- Ensure all performance management activities comply with relevant industry standards and internal procedures, maintaining high data integrity and accuracy. 
 - Support the preparation of compliance documentation for certification and audits. 

Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams

- Work closely with product improvement, R&D, and operations teams to align performance enhancement activities with overall product development goals. 
 - Provide technical support and performance insights during the design and testing phases of new turbine components. 

Training and Continuous Learning

- Engage in continuous learning and professional development to stay updated on the latest performance optimization techniques and tools. 
 - Participate in internal training programs and knowledge-sharing sessions to enhance skills and contribute to team development. 

Adherence to Ethical Standards

- Adhere to organizational ethical standards in data handling, analysis, and reporting, ensuring transparency and objectivity in performance assessments. 
 - Participate in training on corporate policies, ethics, and compliance to uphold high professional standards.

Key Stakeholders - External

Educational Background: 

- BE in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering.

data.description:
Company Description

SOCRoom by Procain consulting, helps businesses strengthen security operations with continuous monitoring, faster response, and expert SOC support. 

  

We work with organisations that need better visibility, alert handling, incident response, and security operations coverage without building a full SOC in-house. 

  

Our services include Managed SOC, SOC as a Service, SOC Staff Augmentation, Cloud Security Monitoring, threat detection, alert triage, and incident response support. 

  

Built on the principle of Detect. Prevent. Prevail. , SOCRoom by Procain consulting, helps teams move from security alerts to real action - faster, sharper, and with greater operational confidence. 

Key responsibilities

Team leadership and shift operations

- Lead, mentor and schedule a team of L1/L2 analysts to maintain 24x7 coverage and consistent  
 - service quality. 
 - Own shift handovers, ensuring every open incident transfers with current status, next action and  
 - owner. 
 - Conduct quality reviews of closed incidents, verifying verdicts (true positive, benign positive,   
 - false positive) and documentation. 
 - Coach analysts on investigation methodology, KQL and tooling; drive onboarding and structured  
 - skills development. 

Incident detection and response

- Act as the escalation point for high-severity incidents, including lateral movement, privileged  
 - account compromise and data exfiltration. 
 - Direct investigations from initial alert through entity analysis, timeline reconstruction,   
 - containment and closure. 
 - Coordinate containment actions with customer IT and security teams, and with L3 / incident  
 - response specialists where needed. 
 - Lead post-incident reviews and translate lessons learned into detection and process  
 - improvements. 

Microsoft Sentinel platform ownership

- Oversee analytics rule lifecycle: design, testing, tuning, alert grouping, suppression and  
 - retirement of noisy rules. 
 - Develop and review KQL queries, hunting queries, workbooks and watchlists. 
 - Guide automation using playbooks (Logic Apps) and automation rules to reduce manual triage  
 - effort. 
 - Work with engineering teams on data connector onboarding, log source health and ingestion  
 - cost optimization. 

Wazuh operations (where deployed)

- Supervise monitoring of Wazuh-managed customer environments, including agent health, rule  
 - and decoder tuning, and alert triage. 
 - Support integration of Wazuh alerts into central SOC workflows and ticketing. 

Customer engagement and reporting

- Serve as a technical point of contact for customers during incidents and in regular service  
 - reviews. 
 - Produce monthly SOC reports covering incident trends, SLA performance, detection coverage  
 - and recommendations. 
 - Ensure adherence to contractual SLAs for time-to-triage, time-to-escalate and time-to-notify. 
 - Maintain and improve runbooks, escalation matrices and standard operating procedures. 

Required qualifications (mandatory)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security or a related field, or equivalent  professional experience. 
 - 5+ years of experience in a SOC, MSSP or MDR environment, including at least 1-2 years leading  or mentoring analysts. 
 - Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel (minimum 2 years in production), covering  analytics rules, incidents, entity investigation, workbooks, watchlists, UEBA and playbooks. 
 - Strong proficiency in KQL for detection engineering, threat hunting and investigation. 
 - Working knowledge of the Microsoft security ecosystem: Defender XDR (Endpoint, Identity,   Office 365, Cloud Apps), Entra ID and Azure activity logs. 
 - Solid understanding of the incident response lifecycle, the MITRE ATT&CK framework and  common attack techniques. 
 - Good knowledge of networking, Windows and Linux internals, Active Directory and cloud  security fundamentals. 
 - Experience working to customer SLAs in a multi-tenant or managed services environment. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including incident reporting to technical and  executive audiences. 
 - Willingness to work in a 24x7 rotational environment and to be available for on-call escalations. 

Preferred qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Wazuh: agent deployment, custom rules and decoders, active  response, file integrity monitoring and vulnerability detection. 
 - Microsoft certifications such as SC-200 (Security Operations Analyst), AZ-500 or SC-100. 
 - Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, CySA+, BTL1/BTL2, or equivalent incident response  credentials. 
 - Experience with other SIEM/SOAR platforms (Splunk, QRadar, Elastic) and EDR tools  (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne). 
 - Scripting skills in PowerShell or Python for automation and enrichment. 
 - Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, threat hunting programs and detection-as-code  practices. 
 - Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS or NIST CSF. 

Key competencies

- Leadership: builds a motivated, accountable team and develops analysts into senior  contributors. 
 - Analytical judgment: makes sound, timely decisions under pressure with incomplete  information. 
 - Customer focus: communicates clearly and calmly with customers during active incidents. 
 - Continuous improvement: uses data to reduce false positives, improve detection coverage and  streamline workflows.

data.title: Senior Director, AI Engineering
data.description:
We're looking for a Senior Director, AI Engineering This role is Office Based, Hyderabad Office

Senior Director, AI Engineering

Experience: 15+ years in software engineering, including 7+ years leading engineering leaders and teams, and 4+ years delivering production AI/ML or Generative AI systems

Reports to: [VP / SVP, AI Engineering]

Scope: 2-3 engineering teams (~15-30 engineers) in Hyderabad, led through Engineering Managers and Tech Leads, with a mandate to grow

Shift: General shift, with regular evening overlap with US Eastern and Pacific time zones. 

About Cornerstone OnDemand

Cornerstone OnDemand helps organizations of every size develop, engage, and retain their people through a unified talent experience platform. Our software supports more than 7, 000 customers and tens of millions of learners worldwide. The India engineering organization is a core part of Cornerstone's global product engineering, and our AI Engineering organization builds the Workforce AI capabilities and shared platform that power skills intelligence, content intelligence, personalization, and agentic experiences across Cornerstone's products. 

About The Role

We are hiring a Senior Director, AI Engineering to lead Cornerstone's AI Engineering organization in Hyderabad. You will own the people, the technical direction, and the delivery outcomes for multiple AI engineering teams building the Workforce AI models, services, and platform that make Cornerstone's products intelligent - skills inference, recommendations, content understanding, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation, and the agentic workflows layered on top. 

This is a deeply technical leadership role. You will lead through managers and tech leads, but you are expected to be credible in the room: shaping AI architecture, pressure-testing retrieval and evaluation strategy, questioning inference cost and latency trade-offs, and reading a design document or a pull request with real judgment. You will not be writing production features day to day, but the quality of your technical instincts will set the ceiling for the organization. 

You will also be one of Cornerstone's most senior AI voices in India - a genuine peer to AI Engineering leadership in the US, accountable for globally distributed ownership of real product surfaces rather than delegated execution. Building the AI talent bench in Hyderabad, and doing it responsibly with sensitive workforce data, is central to the job. 

In this role you will. . . 

Lead and grow the India AI Engineering organization

- Lead 2-3 AI engineering teams (~15-30 engineers) through Engineering Managers and Tech Leads - setting direction, clarifying ownership, and holding a high bar for both delivery and craft. 
 - Develop the leaders who report to you: coach managers on hiring, performance, feedback, and technical judgment, and build a succession bench so the organization is not dependent on any single person. 
 - Design the team topology - how AI product, platform, and applied research responsibilities are split so teams have clear, durable ownership and minimal hand-off friction. 
 - Create an environment where strong engineers do their best work: focused roadmaps, low process overhead, honest retrospectives, and visible career growth. 

Own the technical direction for Workforce AI in India

- Set and defend the AI architecture and technical strategy for the systems your teams own - model selection and hosting, retrieval and RAG design, vector and feature stores, agent orchestration, and inference patterns. 
 - Establish rigorous evaluation and quality practices for AI systems: offline and online eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression gates, human-in-the-loop review, and quality metrics tied to customer outcomes. 
 - Drive build-vs-buy decisions across foundation models, AWS-native AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker), and third-party tooling - with a clear-eyed view of cost, lock-in, latency, and differentiation. 
 - Own cloud and cost accountability for AI workloads on AWS: inference cost per request, GPU and token spend, caching and model-routing strategy, rightsizing, and FinOps discipline. 
 - Lead architecture and design reviews personally, and raise the standard for how the organization writes design documents, reasons about trade-offs, and validates assumptions before building. 
 - Keep the platform and product layers healthy together - shared services, SDKs, observability, and CI/CD that let AI product teams ship quickly and safely. 

Deliver AI products at scale

- Own end-to-end delivery for your teams' commitments: multi-quarter roadmap, dependency management, realistic sequencing, and predictable shipping without heroics. 
 - Partner with Product Management, Design, Data, Security, and SRE to turn ambiguous problem statements into shipped, measurable AI capabilities. 
 - Move AI work from promising prototype to durable production system - reliability targets, monitoring, graceful degradation, rollback, and on-call ownership. 
 - Make disciplined trade-offs between customer-visible quality, delivery speed, and long-term platform investment, and explain those trade-offs credibly to executives. 

Partner globally with US teams

- Operate as a peer to AI Engineering, product, and architecture leaders in the US - jointly owning strategy rather than receiving it. 
 - Negotiate clear charter and ownership boundaries across sites so India-based teams own meaningful, end-to-end product surfaces and are accountable for outcomes. 
 - Maintain a workable overlap rhythm with counterparts in US Eastern and Pacific time zones, and design async-first practices - written proposals, decision records, recorded demos - so progress does not depend on meeting time. 
 - Represent India AI Engineering in global planning, architecture councils, and executive reviews, and bring back context that helps your teams make better local decisions. 

Build the talent brand and AI bench in Hyderabad

- Own the AI hiring mandate for Hyderabad: workforce planning, sourcing strategy, interview loop design, calibration, and closing senior candidates. 
 - Raise the technical interview bar for AI roles - practical system design, applied ML and LLM depth, evaluation thinking - and train interviewers to assess it consistently. 
 - Strengthen Cornerstone's employer brand as an AI destination in Hyderabad through meetups, conference talks, technical blogs, open-source contributions, and university and intern programs. 
 - Build internal capability alongside external hiring: upskilling paths for engineers moving into AI work, mentorship structures, and a credible senior technical ladder in India. 

Responsible AI, trust, and compliance

- Own responsible AI practice for your organization - bias and fairness testing, explainability, human oversight, model and data documentation, and clear escalation paths. 
 - Ensure AI systems handling sensitive workforce and HR data meet privacy, residency, and security obligations (GDPR, India's DPDP Act, customer contractual commitments, SOC 2 / ISO controls). 
 - Partner with Legal, Security, and Privacy on AI governance, vendor and model risk review, and customer-facing AI transparency commitments. 
 - Build guardrails into the engineering process rather than bolting them on: data-handling standards, prompt and output safety review, tenant isolation, and auditability by default. 

You Have What It Takes If You Have. . . 

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, with 7+ years leading engineering teams, including experience managing managers. 
 - Proven track record of shipping AI/ML or Generative AI systems to production at scale in a product company - not only pilots, POCs, or internal tooling. 
 - Deep, current technical credibility in AI engineering: LLM application architecture, RAG and retrieval design, embeddings and vector search, fine-tuning versus prompting trade-offs, agent orchestration, and model evaluation. 
 - Strong, hands-on-derived expertise in AWS - designing and operating cloud-native and AI workloads (EKS/ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, Bedrock and/or SageMaker). 
 - Solid engineering foundations in Java and/or Python, distributed systems, API-first design (REST/GraphQL), event-driven architectures, and SQL/NoSQL data modeling. 
 - Experience with MLOps and production ML operations: CI/CD for models, feature and vector stores, model monitoring and drift detection, observability, and incident response. 
 - Demonstrated success building and scaling engineering organizations in India, including senior hiring, leveling, performance management, and retention. 
 - Experience operating effectively in a globally distributed engineering model, partnering with counterparts across US Eastern and Pacific time zones. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication - able to write a crisp strategy document, defend a technical position to executives, and explain AI trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Sound judgment on cost, risk, and responsible AI, with a bias toward measurable customer impact over technical novelty. 

Nice To Have

- Experience in HR technology, talent management, learning, or skills intelligence domains, or with taxonomy and ontology-driven products. 
 - Background in multi-tenant enterprise SaaS with strict data isolation, residency, and compliance requirements. 
 - Exposure to applied research collaboration - working with research scientists, publishing, or productizing novel model work. 
 - Experience standing up an AI platform or internal developer platform used by multiple product teams. 
 - Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, or ISO/IEC 42001. 
 - Prior experience as a site or sub-site engineering leader with budget, vendor, and headcount accountability. 
 - Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. 

What success looks like. . 

First 90 days

- You know the systems, the people, and the customer problems well enough to have opinions - and you have earned the trust of your managers, your peers in the US, and your product partners. 
 - You have an honest written assessment of the organization: team topology, technical debt, AI quality gaps, delivery risks, and hiring needs. 

First 6 months

- Delivery is predictable and teams have clear, durable ownership. Roadmap commitments are met without escalation as the default mechanism. 
 - An AI evaluation and quality framework is in place, and system quality is tracked against customer-facing metrics. 
 - Key open roles are filled with strong hires, and the interview loop is calibrated and consistent. 

First 12 months

- India-based teams own significant AI product surfaces end-to-end, and global partners route strategic work here by preference. 
 - Inference cost, latency, and reliability are measured, understood, and trending in the right direction. 
 - Responsible AI practices are embedded in the engineering process, not maintained as a separate checklist. 
 - Cornerstone is a recognized AI engineering destination in Hyderabad, with a strong senior bench and internal leaders ready for more scope. 

Why join us

- Real AI impact. Workforce AI ships to more than 7, 000 customers and tens of millions of learners - your teams' work shapes how people find skills, learning, and opportunity at work. 
 - Genuine ownership. India is a first-class engineering site, not a delivery center. You will own strategy alongside global peers. 
 - Technical leadership, not just management. This role rewards deep technical judgment and gives you the scope to apply it. 
 - Modern AI stack. LLMs and Generative AI on AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker), Java and Python services, EKS, vector and
 - streaming data infrastructure, and a serious evaluation culture. 
 - Build something lasting. A clear mandate to grow the AI organization and the talent brand in Hyderabad. 
 - Core values. Be part of a company that lives by Shattering Boundaries, Sparking Greatness, and Sharing Success. 

Our Culture

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now - is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone - anywhere - to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today. 

Who We Are

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AITM, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People GraphTM, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7, 000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness. 

Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

 - Work on various layers of the infrastructure
 - Interacting with the users in order to understand and characterize their needs and advise them if necessary

- 12+ years of building and running containerized complex web applications in the cloud
 - 12+ years years of programming in a high-level language, e. g. Java, Kotlin, Scala, Javascript
 - experience with and commitment to CICD and DevOps best practices
 - independent reliable working style
 - capability to form opinions and express them in discussions
 - experience with Cloud Platform, preferably GCP, in particular GKE, Cloud Armor, Networking
 - experience with react and Microfrontend architecture (preferably Module Federation)

Nice to have: 

- experience with docker, kubernetes, ArgoCD, Datadog
 - experience with Cassandra, Kafka, Solr
 - experience with terraform, kotlin, typescript
 - experience with running AI Agents, preferably in Production
 - very good fluency in English (written and verbal). 

Additional Information

What we offer at METRO. digital?

- Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment. 

At METRO. digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You'll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup. 

- People development: when you grow so do we!

We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation . . . it ́s time to upskill your career. 

- Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!

We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey. 

Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here. 

Let ́s connect soon. Apply for the role now!

Position grade within our career framework: Fullstack Engineer Grade 4 (Md8).

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Virtualization and Networking)
data.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Associate QA Engineer with hands-on experience in Manual Testing, test case design, defect management, troubleshooting, and enterprise application testing. The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of networking, virtualization, server environments, and software QA processes. 

Key Responsibilities

Understand business and technical requirements and prepare end-to-end test scenarios and test cases. Execute functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing. 

Identify, document, prioritize, track, and close defects. Set up and maintain test environments involving Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, and LDAP. perform testing of Web Services/APIs, client-server applications, desktop applications, and mobile applications. Prepare test reports, QA metrics, defect reports, and testing documentation. Collaborate with Development, Product, and other teams for issue resolution and product releases. Perform troubleshooting of application, networking, configuration, and test-environment issues. Ensure adequate test coverage and contribute to improving QA processes and methodologies. 

Mandatory Skills

Strong understanding of Manual Testing and QA methodologies. 

Hands-on experience in test case design, execution, and test case management. 

Experience in defect management, prioritization, and tracking. 

Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools. 

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 

Good understanding of OSI layers, Routing/Switching, DNS, DHCP, and Firewalls OR VMware/Hyper-V. 

Basic understanding of PKI, Ciphers, Digital Certificates, and certificate-based authentication. 

Good verbal and written communication skills with effective reporting abilities. 

Good to Have

Experience with VMware, Citrix, Nutanix, or Microsoft Hyper-V. 

Knowledge of Automation Testing and test automation frameworks. 

Exposure to JMeter or other performance testing tools. 

Customer support or customer-facing experience. 

Experience with product/build release activities. 

Exposure to Kubernetes and Container technologies. 

Soft Skills

Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 

Proactive and self-motivated approach. 

Strong logical and analytical thinking. 

Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities. 

Good team player with a collaborative mindset. 

Quick learner with adaptability to new technologies and environments. 

Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively. 

Experience & Qualification

Experience: 1+ years of relevant experience in QA/Software Testing, preferably in networking, virtualization, server environments, or enterprise products. 

Qualification: BCA / MCA / BE / B. Tech, preferably in Computer Science or Information Technology.

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital - where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada's largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture. 

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are - all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company. 

Location & Flexibility

India Hybrid: Noida/Hyderabad/Bangalore/Gurgaon

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Noida/Bengaluru (3 to4 times/week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices. 

Job Description: Platform Engineer

Required Qualifications

- Ability to read, write, speak and understand English
 - Strong communication skills with ability to lead across time zones and coordinate with onshore teams
 - Expert-level experience with AWS services: EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, Glue, Athena, EMR, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch
 - Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred, CloudFormation acceptable)
 - Experience with production monitoring, alerting, and incident response at scale
 - Experience with cost monitoring and optimization in AWS environments
 - Experience with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred)
 - Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging systems (e. g. , Kafka, SNS/SQS, EventBridge)
 - Proficiency with Linux-based operating systems and shell scripting
 - Experience managing and mentoring engineering teams
 - Demonstrated ability to make independent technical decisions and triage production issues without escalation
 - Understanding of data pipeline architectures (batch and streaming) and common failure modes
 - Understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, CIDR, NAT, VPC endpoints, firewalls, security groups
 - Proficiency in Python (or a comparable general-purpose language) for building automation, tooling, and applications
 - Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git-based workflows, code review, modular and reusable design, dependency management, and writing maintainable, documented code
 - Experience writing automated tests (unit/integration) for application and infrastructure code, and integrating those tests into CI/CD
 - Ability to write integration code against REST APIs and cloud SDKs (e. g. , AWS SDK / boto3)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Apache Spark (Scala preferred) for distributed and streaming data processing such as Spark Streaming or structured streaming.

 - Experience with Airflow or similar workflow orchestration platforms
 - Experience with graph databases (AWS Neptune, Neo4j)
 - Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements (model serving, token cost monitoring, artifact management)
 - Experience in the telecommunications industry or other large-scale network operations environments
 - Experience with LLM/agent deployment infrastructure and observability
 - AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or similar)
 - Experience developing and operating small services or APIs (e. g. , FastAPI/Flask) in a production environment

data.description:
ABOUT TEAM : ORCHESTRATION FOUNDATION

Global Tech Platform (GTP) delivers the core infrastructure and engineering capabilities that every product and engineering team at Walmart depends on. Runtime Platforms (RTP) sits at the center of GTP, providing the compute, orchestration, traffic, and operational fabric that powers Walmart Cloud Native Platform (WCNP) and the broader application estate across private cloud, public cloud (Azure, GCP), and store-edge environments. 

Responsibilities

Orchestration Foundation is the team within Runtime Platforms responsible for the workload orchestration layer across Walmart's entire compute estate. Key products include: 

- Kubernetes Platform (WCNP): Multi-cluster lifecycle management across cloud, private data center, and store-edge. 
 - OneOps (VM Orchestration): VM-based workload platform covering OS and Java lifecycle automation. 
 - Device Orchestration Platform (DOP): Automates store device deployments (POS, CoSTL devices) with policy-based, wave-controlled rollouts across US and international markets. 
 - Process Orchestration: Conductor based workflow Orchestration engine at scale. 

What You'll Do

- Own the roadmap and deliver outcomes: Define the multi-year technical roadmap for Orchestration Foundation. Translate customer and platform problems into clear requirements, measurable goals, and delivery plans. Own outcomes across WCNP Kubernetes, OneOps, DOP, continuous profiling, cost optimization, and autonomous operations. 
 - Drive platform architecture and design: Lead architecture decisions for the orchestration layer. Ensure systems are designed for the right tenancy model, scale, decoupling, extensibility, and operational simplicity. Own the platform design from first principles, not by incremental patching. 
 - Go deep on the technology: Stay technically grounded in Kubernetes internals, cluster lifecycle management, VM orchestration, device deployment platforms, and workflow orchestration engines. Engage directly with architects and engineers on the most complex design and operational problems. 
 - Improve availability, performance, and efficiency: Set and deliver on reliability targets for WCNP, OneOps, and DOP. Drive engineering programs for latency, throughput, and availability improvements. Lead cloud resource utilization optimization through continuous profiling, right-sizing, ARM64 compute adoption, and workload rationalization to reduce infrastructure costs year-over-year. 
 - Eliminate waste and automate manual work: Identify manual, high-overhead operations across the team's platforms and build automation to eliminate them. Advance autonomous and agentic operations via Kubie, Wibey, and Forma, reducing MTTR and manual intervention for common platform problems. 
 - Set up mechanisms and run the program: Establish OKRs, metrics, and execution rhythms across Orchestration Foundation. Run a structured program with clear milestones, cross-team dependency management, and stakeholder alignment. Maintain visibility for GTP leadership on roadmap progress and risks. 
 - Manage cross-team dependencies and stakeholders: Partner with Runtime Platform peers, GTP leadership, security, finance, and application teams. Navigate dependencies across teams above and below in the stack. Build the right level of give-and-take with product and business stakeholders. 
 - Design the org and grow the team: Own org design including spans, layers, and the right balance of builders and operators. Hire senior engineers and architects. Drive calibration, promotion decisions, and performance management. Invest in growing senior technical ICs and engineering managers. 
 - Build the platform-managed services model: Develop the shared, multi-tenant WCNP platform model to onboard teams like Camunda, Vespa, and WQS on standardized infrastructure. Define the repeatable onboarding path instead of one-off solutions. 
 - Ensure security, compliance, and platform resilience: Own Prod/Non-Prod segmentation, PCI environment compliance, vulnerability remediation, and quarterly DR testing across WCNP and OneOps. Set SLO and SLA frameworks and enforce them. 

What You'll Bring

- Track record of delivering impact from first principles : 18+ years of engineering experience with a clear record of building products and platforms that delivered measurable business outcomes. Ability to start from the customer problem, define requirements, set metrics, and own end-to-end delivery. 
 - Greenfield system design capability: Demonstrated ability to design large-scale, complex systems from scratch. Deep understanding of tenancy models, scale, decoupling, domain modeling, extensibility, and API design. Can articulate the reasoning behind architectural choices under detailed technical questioning. 
 - Technical depth in orchestration and platform systems : Strong hands-on depth in Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-native platform internals. Knowledge of VM orchestration, device management platforms, or workflow orchestration engines. Comfortable going deep until reaching the boundary of current knowledge. 
 - Engineering and operational excellence: Experience driving measurable improvements in system availability, latency, and throughput for large-scale platforms. Proven ability to optimize public cloud infrastructure costs through utilization analysis, profiling, and workload rationalization. Track record of automation programs that eliminated significant manual operational overhead. 
 - Program execution and stakeholder management : Experience setting up OKRs, metrics, and execution mechanisms for large engineering programs. Able to manage cross-team dependencies, work effectively with teams above and below in the stack, and build trust with product and business stakeholders through a balanced approach. 
 - Org design and talent management : Experience designing engineering organizations with appropriate spans, layers, and builder/operator ratios. Strong hiring instincts. Experience running calibration, managing promotions, and developing senior technical ICs and engineering managers. 
 - Multi-cloud and private cloud experience: Working knowledge of Azure and GCP for production workloads. Experience operating Kubernetes and VM platforms on private data center infrastructure (OpenStack or similar) and store-edge environments. 
 - Clear communication at all levels: Ability to turn complex technical domains into clear roadmaps and priorities. Comfortable presenting strategy and progress to VP-level and above. Able to influence peers and cross-functional partners without direct authority.

data.description:
Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Privileged Access Management (PAM) Engineering Manager - Vice President to join the Global Cybersecurity organization. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who thrives in complex, highly regulated environments and is passionate about privileged access security, CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, PIM, AKV, AWS, automation, platform modernization, and operational resilience. 

The role will drive engineering ownership for strategic PAM capabilities across the enterprise, including CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, privileged account onboarding, secrets management, automation, access modernization, platform reliability, and integration with enterprise IAM, security, and cloud ecosystems. 

- Role Title: PAM Engineering Manager - Vice President
 - Capability: Privileged Access Management / Infrastructure Access Management
 - Function: Global Cybersecurity
 - Primary Focus: CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, PIM, AKV, AWS, PAM engineering, platform modernization, automation, and risk reduction
 - Location: Bangalore or Hyderabad

Key Responsibilities

PAM Engineering Leadership

- Lead the engineering lifecycle for enterprise PAM platforms, including CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, CA-PAM migration support, PIM, AKV, AWS, and related privileged access capabilities. 
 - Drive platform architecture, design, implementation, integration, and continuous improvement for privileged access services. 
 - Own engineering delivery for strategic PAM initiatives such as CyberArk platform uplift, HashiCorp adoption, secrets management expansion, CPM/PSM capability development, access modernization, and migration from legacy PAM platforms. 
 - Partner with product, operations, governance, application, infrastructure, and cloud teams to ensure PAM engineering outcomes align with business priorities, risk requirements, and enterprise security standards. 
 - Lead engineering design and implementation across CyberArk components including Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PSMP, DR, connectors, integrations, monitoring, and platform automation. 
 - Drive HashiCorp Vault engineering for secrets management use cases including cloud workload identities, Azure service principals, AWS workloads, static secrets, database secrets, certificate/PKI use cases, and application credential modernization. 
 - Ensure PAM platforms are engineered for scalability, resilience, auditability, and secure operations. 
 - Support design patterns for privileged account onboarding across Windows, Unix/Linux, databases, network devices, cloud platforms, service accounts, application accounts, and non-human identities. 
 - Identify and deliver automation opportunities to reduce manual effort, ticket volume, operational risk, and configuration errors. 
 - Drive API, scripting, CI/CD, Terraform, PowerShell, REST API, and workflow-based automation for PAM and secrets management use cases. 
 - Establish reusable engineering patterns, onboarding templates, reference architectures, and technical accelerators. 
 - Promote engineering practices such as test automation, code review, tech debt reduction, platform refactoring, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure PAM engineering solutions support least privilege, zero trust, credential vaulting, session monitoring, access control, audit logging, and regulatory expectations. 
 - Partner with governance and audit teams to close control gaps, support evidence generation, remediate findings, and improve control traceability. 
 - Drive remediation of platform-related vulnerabilities, configuration gaps, audit issues, and resiliency risks. 
 - Ensure PAM controls integrate with IAM, SIEM, ServiceNow, SailPoint, monitoring, change management, and incident response processes. 
 - Collaborate with global technology, cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, cloud, risk, audit, and business stakeholders. 
 - Translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable PAM engineering solutions.

 - Work across time zones and global teams to support enterprise delivery. 
 - Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing PAM engineering team. 
 - Provide technical guidance to engineers and support teams across L2/L3/L4 responsibilities. 
 - Build engineering capability across CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, cloud PAM, automation, secrets management, and non-human identity security. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, engineering discipline, innovation, documentation, and operational excellence. 
 - Create and maintain architecture diagrams, engineering standards, SOPs, runbooks, implementation patterns, knowledge articles, and support handover documents. 
 - Ensure documentation is audit-ready, operationally usable, and aligned to enterprise standards. 
 - Establish clear ownership models, RACI alignment, support handoffs, escalation paths, and post-implementation validation practices. 

Your Team

You will be part of the Global Cybersecurity Privileged Access Management / Infrastructure Access Management team, responsible for engineering and modernizing enterprise privileged access, secrets management and non-human identity/account capabilities. The team supports business-critical access platforms that enable secure infrastructure access, privileged credential management, session control, secrets management, and privileged access governance across the enterprise. 

This role will work closely with PAM Operations, PAM Governance, Cloud Security, Infrastructure, Application Technology, Risk, Audit, and Product teams to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient privileged access services. 

Required Experience

- 16+ years of technology experience, with significant experience in cybersecurity, IAM, PAM, infrastructure security, or platform engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with one or more leading PAM platforms such as CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, BeyondTrust, Delinea, or CA-PAM. 
 - Deep understanding of privileged account management, credential vaulting, session monitoring, password rotation, privileged access workflows, and least privilege principles. 
 - Experience leading large-scale PAM engineering or modernization initiatives in complex enterprise environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of CyberArk architecture and components such as Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PSMP, DR, connectors, policies, safes, platforms, and onboarding patterns. 
 - Experience with HashiCorp Vault architecture, secrets engines, authentication methods, policies, namespaces, replication, audit logging, and application integration patterns. 
 - Experience integrating PAM solutions with IAM, SIEM, ServiceNow, SailPoint, Active Directory, cloud platforms, and enterprise monitoring tools. 
 - Strong understanding of Windows, Linux/Unix, databases, network devices, cloud platforms, service accounts, and application credential management. 
 - Experience with platform upgrades, patching, DR validation, certificate management, vulnerability remediation, and operational readiness. 
 - Experience with Agile delivery, Jira, change management, incident management, problem management, and production support governance. 

Technical Skills

- CyberArk: Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PSMP, PTA, EPM, AIM/Conjur or Secrets Manager capabilities. 
 - HashiCorp Vault: KV, database secrets, AppRole, LDAP/OIDC, Kubernetes auth, PKI, transit, dynamic secrets, replication, audit logging.

 - Integrations: ServiceNow, SailPoint, Active Directory, LDAP, SIEM, monitoring platforms, application onboarding workflows.

Leadership Skills

Preferred Qualifications

TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

At TransUnion, we are dedicated to finding ways information can be used to help people make better and smarter decisions. As a trusted provider of global information solutions, our mission is to help people around the world access the opportunities that lead to a higher quality of life, by helping organizations optimize their risk-based decisions and enabling consumers to understand and manage their personal information. Because when people have access to more complete and multidimensional information, they can make more informed decisions and achieve great things. 

Every day TransUnion offers our employees the tools and resources they need to find ways information can be used in diverse ways. Whether it is helping businesses better manage risk, providing better insights so a consumer can qualify for his first mortgage, or working with law enforcement to make neighborhoods safer, we are improving the quality of life for individuals, families, communities, and local economies around the world. 

The role requires a QA professional with 3+ years of experience in both manual and automated testing, with a strong focus on building and maintaining automation using Playwright and TypeScript. The candidate will ensure application quality across web and mobile platforms by validating functionality, performance, usability, and reliability. Responsibilities include API testing, comprehensive test case design, defect tracking in Jira, and regression testing. The role collaborates closely with developers and other stakeholders, integrates testing into CI/CD pipelines, participates actively in Agile ceremonies, uses Git for version control, and continuously seeks ways to improve testing processes and overall product quality. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. 

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

- Actively participate in user story definition and refinement sessions to understand business requirements and identify potential risks early. 
 - Collaborate with product owners and developers to define acceptance criteria and write test scenarios before development begins, ensuring clarity and testability. 
 - Work closely with developers to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Provide feedback during code reviews and sprint demos to help catch issues early and improve feature implementation. 
 - Design and execute manual and automated test cases to validate functionality, performance, and user experience. 
 - Apply a variety of testing techniques including regression, smoke, integration, and exploratory testing to ensure robust coverage. 
 - Treat bugs with urgency and professionalism-log defects with clear reproduction steps, expected vs actual results, and relevant screenshots or logs. 
 - Collaborate with developers to triage and resolve issues, and verify fixes before release. 
 - Apply coding skills to contribute to test automation frameworks, helping expand coverage and reduce manual effort. 
 - Maintain and improve existing test scripts, ensuring they remain reliable and relevant as the product evolves. 
 - Use Git or similar version control systems to manage test scripts and collaborate on code changes. 
 - Understand branching strategies and how to work within a shared codebase. 
 - Maintain up-to-date test cases, test plans, and QA documentation in tools like TestRail, Confluence, or similar. 
 - Ensure documentation is clear, organized, and accessible to the wider team. 
 - Join Agile ceremonies such as daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives to stay aligned with team goals and contribute to continuous improvement. 
 - Stay curious and open to feedback-actively seek opportunities to learn new tools, techniques, and domain knowledge. 
 - Share insights and mentor junior QA engineers when appropriate, contributing to a culture of learning and collaboration. 

Required Knowledge And Experiences

What you will bring: 

- 5+ years of hands-on QA experience, including both manual and automated testing. 
 - Write, maintain, and enhance automated test scripts using tools like Playwright with TypeScript. 
 - Contribute to the stability and scalability of the test automation framework. 
 - Collaborate with developers to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Use tools such as Postman, Playwright's API testing features, or similar to validate RESTful APIs and backend services. 
 - Design and execute test cases for various API scenarios including authentication, error handling, and edge cases. 
 - Perform manual and automated testing across web and mobile platforms. 
 - Validate functionality, performance, usability, and reliability of applications. 
 - Ensure comprehensive test coverage for new features and regression testing. 
 - Log defects clearly and concisely using tools like Jira, including steps to reproduce, expected vs actual results, and screenshots/logs. 
 - Follow up on bug fixes and verify resolutions. 
 - Actively participate in Agile ceremonies such as daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives. 
 - Work closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to align on quality goals and timelines. 
 - Use Git or other version control systems to manage test scripts and collaborate with the development team. 
 - Proactively seek opportunities to improve testing processes and product quality. 

TransUnion Overview

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our Workforce for Good, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver's seat of their professional development- while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that's why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence. 

Be a part of our Workforce for Good - you'll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

DynPro Professional Services is an AI-led systems engineering and technology consulting firm with over 30 years of delivery excellence.
