Role Overview

We are seeking a high-caliber Technical Lead, AI SDLC & Solutions Architect to join our consulting practice in Pune. This is a high-impact, player-coach role: you will blend deep hands-on coding expertise with a consultative, big-picture vision for software design and solution architecture across a diverse portfolio of enterprise clients. 

You will not just advise - you will actively build, prototype, and implement AI-first Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) systems, and guide clients through the cultural and technical shift from traditional development to high-leverage, AI-augmented engineering. 

Key Responsibilities

Hands-On Engineering & Prototyping

- Write production code. Dedicate a significant portion of your time to writing high-quality code, building custom internal AI developer tools, and constructing reusable AI components. 
 - Build proofs of concept. Rapidly prototype end-to-end AI-native workflows, integration patterns, and custom Large Language Model (LLM) gateways that demonstrate immediate value to clients. 
 - Implement tooling. Integrate AI-assisted coding tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor), prompt engineering frameworks, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows into diverse client environments. Solution Architecture & Systems Design

- Design big-picture architecture. Architect scalable, secure, enterprise-grade AI-native SDLC frameworks tailored to each client's ecosystem. 
 - Multi-cloud integration. Design robust architectures spanning AWS, Azure, and modern frontend/serverless platforms such as Vercel. 
 - Agentic workflows. Design and deploy agentic systems in which autonomous AI agents handle complex development lifecycle tasks - multi-agent code reviews, automated unit testing, and legacy system refactoring. 
 - Enterprise guardrails. Embed compliance, IP protection, security, and bias-mitigation protocols within every AI pipeline you design. Application Modernization & Legacy Transformation

- Legacy application assessment. Assess monolithic and legacy applications, identify technical debt, modernization candidates, dependencies, and business-critical constraints, and define pragmatic transformation roadmaps. 
 - Modernization strategy. Lead re-platforming, re-hosting, refactoring, re-architecting, and selective rebuilding initiatives, choosing the right modernization pattern based on business value, risk, cost, and time-to-market. 
 - Cloud-native transformation. Modernize legacy workloads into scalable cloud-native architectures using microservices, APIs, containers, Kubernetes, serverless patterns, and managed services across AWS and Azure. 
 - AI-assisted modernization. Apply GenAI and agentic engineering techniques to accelerate code understanding, documentation, dependency analysis, code conversion, refactoring, test generation, and remediation of legacy systems. 
 - Architecture decomposition. Define domain boundaries and decomposition strategies for monolithic applications, including API enablement, event-driven integration, strangler patterns, and incremental migration approaches. 
 - Modern engineering enablement. Establish CI/CD, automated testing, observability, security controls, infrastructure as code, and DevSecOps practices to support modernized applications from development through production. 
 - Migration governance & risk management. Define phased migration plans, architecture guardrails, quality gates, rollback strategies, and measurable success criteria while minimizing business disruption and maintaining security and compliance. 
 - Value realization. Establish modernization KPIs covering engineering productivity, release velocity, reliability, cloud efficiency, technical-debt reduction, and application maintainability, and communicate outcomes to client leadership. Client Consulting & Strategic Leadership

- Cross-domain adaptability. Rapidly analyze distinct business domains and translate each client's industry constraints into a specific AI SDLC strategy. 
 - Technical advisory. Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders (CTOs, VPs of Engineering), communicating complex AI concepts effectively to technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - AI maturity assessment. Evaluate client engineering organizations, identify SDLC bottlenecks, and define roadmaps for AI engineering automation and Developer Experience (DevEx) optimization. Qualifications & Requirements

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Experience

- 10+ years of professional software engineering and software architecture experience. 
 - 4+ years in technology consulting, professional services, or a client-facing environment. 
 - Proven track record of architecting and shipping complex, production-grade enterprise software systems. 
 - Modernization leadership. Demonstrated experience leading legacy application modernization or cloud transformation programs, including assessment, target-state architecture, phased migration, and production cutover. Technical Skills

- Polyglot developer: Advanced proficiency across modern languages and frameworks, including Python, Java, Node. js, React, Next. js, and Angular. 
 - Cloud ecosystems: Hands-on architecture experience on AWS (e. g. , Bedrock) and Azure (e. g. , Azure OpenAI Service), with deployment experience on Vercel.

 - DevOps & infrastructure: Strong mastery of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code. 
 - Modernization architecture: Strong knowledge of monolith-to-microservices decomposition, API modernization, event-driven architecture, containerization, cloud migration patterns, and incremental transformation approaches such as the strangler pattern. Consulting Mindset

- Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to manage client expectations and confidently handle pushback.

data.title: Staff Engineer - Software Development (Cloud Networking & Network Security)
data.description:
WHO WE ARE: 

Aviatrix® is pioneering the Cloud Native Security Fabric - the architecture the Containment Era requires. The Cloud Native Security Fabric governs every workload communication path across every cloud, every VPC, every Kubernetes cluster, and every serverless function, from a single policy plane. One rule. Universal propagation. Enforced at the workload, not at a chokepoint. Trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. For more information, visit aviatrix. ai

About the Role - Staff Engineer, Cloud Networking & Network Security

We are seeking a Staff Engineer - Cloud Networking & Network Security to design, build, and evolve cloud-native networking and security capabilities across multi-cloud environments. This role is intended for a strong hands-on networking engineer with deep experience in routing, NAT, traffic forwarding, and firewall data planes. You will work on complex, production-grade networking systems and contribute to architecture and design decisions within your domain, while partnering closely with senior engineers and architects. 

You will be responsible for delivering robust networking functionality-from detailed design and implementation through production rollout, scale, and operational maturity. 

Key Responsibilities

Networking Design & Implementation

- Design and implement networking components for cloud networking and security products, spanning both control plane and data plane. 
 - Contribute to architectural designs for routing, NAT, traffic steering, and firewall enforcement within defined product areas. 
 - Own medium-to-large technical problem areas and drive them from design through production. 

Cloud Networking Platforms

- Design and work with cloud networking topologies, including: 
 - VPC/VNet segmentation and routing architectures
 - Hub-and-spoke and transit networking models
 - Hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity patterns
 - Work hands-on with cloud-native networking constructs such as: 
 - Gateways, routing tables, NAT gateways
 - Managed and custom firewall services
 - Ensure implementations align with security best practices and zero-trust principles. 

Routing, NAT & Traffic Engineering

- Design and implement routing-centric features, including: 
 - Dynamic routing using BGP
 - Policy-based routing and traffic steering
 - Route summarization, convergence, and failure handling
 - Implement and scale NAT functionality, including: 
 - SNAT, DNAT, and bidirectional NAT
 - Centralized vs distributed NAT designs
 - Capacity planning, port exhaustion handling, and resiliency
 - Develop a strong understanding of packet-level behavior across gateways, firewalls, and load balancers. 

Firewall & Data-Plane Systems

- Contribute to the design and implementation of firewall data planes, including: 
 - Policy evaluation and enforcement pipelines
 - Stateful vs stateless inspection models
 - Work on performance-sensitive packet processing paths with a focus on correctness and scalability. 
 - Debug complex scenarios involving asymmetric routing, NAT traversal, and multi-path traffic. 

Execution & Collaboration

- Deliver features from design to production with a strong focus on quality, scalability, and operability. 
 - Participate actively in technical design reviews, providing feedback on networking correctness and performance. 
 - Collaborate closely with product management, QA, and operations teams to deliver reliable, shippable solutions. 
 - Mentor junior engineers on networking fundamentals, packet flows, and troubleshooting techniques. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Networking, or a related field. 
 - 6+ years of experience building networking-intensive systems or cloud networking features. 
 - Hands-on experience developing or operating cloud networking or network security products. 
 - Strong understanding of IP networking fundamentals, including: 
 - TCP/IP, ARP, ICMP
 - Subnetting, CIDR planning, and IP address management
 - Solid experience with routing, including: 
 - BGP fundamentals (design, policy control, troubleshooting)
 - Static vs dynamic routing models
 - ECMP and failover concepts
 - Strong hands-on experience with NAT, including: 
 - SNAT and DNAT behavior
 - Common corner cases and failure scenarios
 - Interaction of NAT with routing and firewalls
 - Experience working with firewall and network security technologies, such as: 
 - Policy-based rule engines
 - Stateful and stateless firewalls
 - NGFW or cloud-native firewall services
 - Proficiency in Python and/or Go (Golang) for building control-plane services, tooling, or automation. 
 - Good understanding of distributed systems concepts as applied to networking control planes. 
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI and service networking. 
 - Hands-on experience with one or more public cloud networking stacks (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI). 

Nice to Have

- Experience with virtual routers, SDN controllers, or network operating systems. 
 - Exposure to high-performance packet processing technologies (eBPF, DPDK, XDP). 
 - Experience working on high-scale or latency-sensitive networking systems. 
 - Contributions to open-source networking or cloud infrastructure projects. 
 - Certifications such as AWS Advanced Networking, GCP Professional Cloud Network Engineer, CCNP/CCIE, or equivalent. 

Watch our culture video: glimpse of life at Aviatrix

Benefits

US: We cover 100% of employee premiums and 88% of dependent(s) premiums for medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) match, short and long-term disability, life/AD&D insurance, $1, 000/year education reimbursement, and a flexible vacation policy. 

Outside the US: We offer a comprehensive benefits package which, (subject to regional variations) could include pension, private medical for you and dependents, generous holiday allowance, life assurance, long-term disability, annual wellbeing stipend

Your total compensation package will be based on job-related knowledge, education, certifications and location, per our aligned ranges. 

About Aviatrix

Aviatrix® is the cloud network security company trusted by more than 500 of the world's leading enterprises. As cloud infrastructures become more complex and costly, the Aviatrix Cloud Network Security platform gives companies back the power, control, security, and simplicity they need to modernize their cloud strategies. Aviatrix is the only secure networking solution built specifically for the cloud, that ensures companies are ready for AI and what's next. Combined with the Aviatrix Certified Engineer (ACE) Program, the industry's leading secure multicloud networking certification, Aviatrix unifies cloud, networking, and security teams and unlocks greater potential across any cloud. 

WE WANT TO INCLUDE YOU

We embrace the fact that not everyone's journey took the same route or started at the same place. If your experience doesn't quite meet the requirements but the opportunity excites you and you believe you could be great, don't let that hold you back from applying. Tell us what you CAN bring and what makes you special. 

Aviatrix is a community where everyone's career can grow and we want to help you achieve your goals and be "your best YOU, " however that looks. If you're seeking an opportunity where you can be excited to start work every morning with enthusiastic people, make a real difference and be part of something amazing then let's talk. We want to get to know you and how we could grow together.

data.description:

What You'll Do

We are looking for an exceptional Staff Cloud & AI Platform Engineer to own and independently build a next‐generation enterprise‐scale deployment and orchestration platform. This role goes far beyond traditional CI/CD or infrastructure automation-it sits at the intersection of distributed systems, control‐plane architecture, SRE principles, and applied AI/agentic workflows. 

- Contribute to the design and implementation of a stateful deployment control plane that treats deployments as a continuous convergence problem. 
 - Enable safe, resumable, deterministic, and SLO‐governed rollouts across multi‐cloud, on‐prem, and customer environments. 
 - Implement the practical application of AI agents in DevOps by embedding intelligent decision‐making into deployment workflows. 
 - Apply AI agents for anomaly detection, failure diagnosis, rollout control, and automated mitigation. 
 - Ensure all AI‐assisted workflows preserve correctness, determinism, and full auditability. 

This is a high‐impact individual contributor role requiring deep technical judgment, delivery ownership, and the ability to turn abstract design into production‐grade systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement a stateful deployment control plane with deterministic, resumable execution and rollback support. 
 - Build deployment workflows that reconcile desired vs. actual state using durable control loops. 
 - Support multi‐cloud, on‐prem, and customer environments with a single orchestration framework. 
 - Implement SLO‐governed promotion gates, error‐budget checks, and bounded retry policies. 
 - Enable deployment models including self‐service, wave‐based rollouts, blue‐green, managed updates, and maintenance windows. 
 - Define declarative, extensible workflow schemas with explicit dependencies, retries, and rollback semantics. 
 - Integrate deployment orchestration with CI/CD systems, artifact manifests, entitlement services, and downstream execution systems. 
 - Embed AI‐assisted decision logic into deployment workflows for anomaly detection, failure diagnosis, and rollout control. 
 - Ensure AI‐driven actions remain deterministic, auditable, reversible, and policy‐constrained. 
 - Develop infrastructure and automation frameworks using Terraform, Python, and cloud‐native services. 
 - Embed observability and telemetry into workflows to drive automated validation, retries, and rollback decisions.

 - Deep expertise in CI/CD, release engineering, and deployment strategies including wave‐based, blue‐green, and managed rollouts.

Job Summary

We're looking for an AI Engineer to design and ship GenAI products end to end. You'll own features from data layer through to interface, working directly with LLMs and the surrounding tooling ecosystem. This is a hands-on build role on a small team that moves fast and ships often. 

Responsibilities

- Build and deploy GenAI applications in Python: retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, and the APIs and UIs around them

Qualifications

- 3-5 years of professional software engineering experience

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
Key Responsibilities

A. Forming / Hot-End Quality

Monitor and control the quality parameters of the container forming process, including: 

- Gob weight and gob temperature
 - Section-wise process parameters
 - Blank and blow mould conditions
 - Neck finish dimensions
 - Body dimensions
 - Wall thickness
 - Weight distribution
 - Finish quality
 - Verticality
 - Deflection
 - Thermal shock-related issues
 - Cracks and checks
 - Mould-related defects
 - Forming process stability. Work closely with Production, Maintenance and Hot-End teams to identify and eliminate recurring defects. 

B. Annealing / Lehr Quality

- Monitor annealing process parameters. 
 - Ensure correct lehr temperature profile and process conditions. 
 - Monitor residual stress and annealing quality. 
 - Investigate breakage and thermal-stress-related defects. 
 - Coordinate with Production and Maintenance for corrective actions. 4. Cold-End Quality & Inspection

Lead the cold-end quality function and ensure effective inspection of finished glass containers. 

Critical quality parameters include: 

- Container weight
 - Height
 - Diameter
 - Neck/finish dimensions
 - Capacity
 - Wall thickness
 - Base thickness
 - Verticality
 - Finish quality
 - Heel/base defects
 - Body defects
 - Cracks/checks
 - Stones
 - Seeds/blisters
 - Cord
 - Black spots
 - Bubbles
 - Deformation
 - Coating quality
 - Surface defects. Ensure proper functioning and calibration of inspection equipment such as: 

- Electronic inspection machines
 - Vision inspection systems
 - Dimensional inspection equipment
 - Weight checkers
 - Pressure testers
 - Thermal shock testers
 - Coating inspection equipment
 - Laboratory instruments. 5. Product Inspection & Release

- Establish inspection plans and sampling standards for all products. 
 - Ensure final product inspection before dispatch. 
 - Maintain product quality records and traceability. 
 - Authorize product release/rejection based on approved specifications. 
 - Control non-conforming products through proper identification, segregation and disposition. 
 - Ensure proper control of rejected and downgraded products. 
 - Monitor quality performance line-wise, machine-wise, section-wise and product-wise. 6. Customer Quality & Complaint Management

This is a key responsibility of the position. 

- Act as the primary Quality contact for customers. 
 - Understand customer specifications and quality expectations. 
 - Review customer complaints and coordinate investigation. 
 - Conduct structured root-cause analysis using: 
 - 5 Why
 - Fishbone Analysis
 - 8D
 - CAPA. 
 - Provide timely corrective and preventive action reports to customers. 
 - Monitor effectiveness of corrective actions. 
 - Participate in customer visits, audits, trials and technical discussions. 
 - Support new customer/product development. 
 - Coordinate product approval and qualification with customers. 
 - Maintain customer-specific quality standards and specifications. 
 - Track customer complaints, rejection, returns and quality claims. Preference should be given to candidates having direct experience in dealing with external customers, customer audits and customer complaint resolution. 

7. Quality Management System

- Establish, implement and maintain the plant Quality Management System. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable ISO and customer requirements. 
 - Prepare and maintain: 
 - SOPs
 - Work instructions
 - Quality plans
 - Inspection standards
 - Control plans
 - Check sheets
 - Quality records. 
 - Conduct internal quality audits. 
 - Ensure closure of audit observations. 
 - Monitor CAPA effectiveness. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in the Quality Management System. 8. Quality Data Analysis & Improvement

Develop and monitor quality KPIs such as: 

- Internal rejection %
 - Customer rejection %
 - Customer complaints
 - Defects per million / PPM where applicable
 - Line-wise rejection
 - Machine-wise rejection
 - Section-wise rejection
 - Critical defect percentage
 - Quality losses
 - Downgraded production
 - Glass defects
 - Dimensional defects
 - Packing defects. Use statistical and analytical tools to identify trends and recurring problems. 

Prepare daily, weekly and monthly quality performance reports for management. 

9. Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

- Lead cross-functional quality improvement teams. 
 - Identify chronic and recurring defects. 
 - Drive systematic root-cause analysis. 
 - Implement permanent corrective actions rather than temporary containment. 
 - Reduce internal rejection and customer complaints. 
 - Identify opportunities for: 
 - Process improvement
 - Material optimization
 - Defect reduction
 - Yield improvement
 - Cost reduction. 
 - Participate in improvement projects such as Kaizen, Six Sigma or other structured improvement initiatives. 10. Laboratory Management

Manage the plant quality laboratory and ensure: 

- Proper testing procedures. 
 - Calibration of laboratory equipment. 
 - Testing of raw materials and finished products. 
 - Glass chemical analysis. 
 - Physical and dimensional testing. 
 - Stress/annealing tests. 
 - Thermal shock tests. 
 - Pressure tests where applicable. 
 - Proper maintenance of laboratory records. 
 - Availability of testing facilities and consumables. 11. Calibration & Measurement System

- Establish calibration schedules for all measuring and testing equipment. 
 - Ensure calibration through approved agencies. 
 - Maintain calibration records. 
 - Ensure traceability of measurement standards. 
 - Identify and control equipment found outside calibration limits. 
 - Conduct measurement system verification wherever required. 12. Packing & Dispatch Quality

- Ensure packing quality meets customer requirements. 
 - Monitor: 
 - Pallet quality
 - Carton quality
 - Dividers/separators
 - Shrink wrapping
 - Strapping
 - Labeling
 - Product identification
 - Lot traceability. 
 - Ensure proper segregation and identification of rejected/non-conforming products. 
 - Coordinate with Packing, Stores and Dispatch teams to prevent quality issues reaching customers. 13. Supplier Quality Management

- Evaluate and monitor critical material suppliers. 
 - Review supplier quality performance. 
 - Coordinate supplier corrective actions. 
 - Participate in supplier audits where required. 
 - Establish supplier quality improvement plans. 
 - Monitor incoming rejection and supplier-related quality losses. 14. New Product Development & Trials

- Review customer drawings/specifications. 
 - Establish quality requirements for new products. 
 - Support mould trials and production trials. 
 - Develop inspection standards for new products. 
 - Validate dimensions and functional requirements. 
 - Prepare product quality documentation for customer approval. 
 - Support commercialization of new products. 15. Customer / External Audit Management

Lead preparation and coordination for: 

- Customer audits
 - ISO audits
 - Certification audits
 - Statutory/third-party inspections
 - Supplier/customer technical audits. Ensure timely closure of audit observations and maintain proper evidence of compliance. 

16. Team Management

- Lead and develop the Quality team. 
 - Define responsibilities and accountability for Quality Engineers, Inspectors and Laboratory personnel. 
 - Prepare manpower and shift requirements. 
 - Conduct training and competency development. 
 - Evaluate team performance. 
 - Establish strong ownership for quality at each manufacturing stage. 
 - Develop second-line Quality leadership. 
 - Ensure effective shift-wise quality monitoring. 17. Cross-Functional Responsibilities

The Quality Manager shall work closely with: 

- Production
 - Furnace & Batch House
 - Maintenance
 - Instrumentation
 - Electrical
 - Engineering
 - Packing
 - Stores
 - Purchase
 - Sales
 - Customer Service
 - HR
 - Management. The role requires the ability to influence production and other functional teams without compromising quality standards. 

18. Quality & Cost Improvement

The Quality Manager shall actively contribute to reduction of: 

- Internal rejection
 - Customer rejection
 - Glass wastage
 - Downgraded production
 - Quality-related production losses
 - Customer complaints
 - Rework
 - Packing-related losses. Quality improvement should be driven with a focus on both customer satisfaction and manufacturing cost reduction. 

19. Authority

The Quality Manager shall have authority to: 

- Stop/hold dispatch of products not meeting specifications. 
 - Reject non-conforming materials. 
 - Place non-conforming products under quality hold. 
 - Recommend rejection/rework/downgrade decisions. 
 - Escalate critical quality issues to Plant Management. 
 - Initiate corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Recommend process changes to improve product quality. 
 - Participate in customer technical discussions. 
 - Approve routine quality inspection and testing procedures within the approved QMS. 20. Key Performance Indicators - KPI

Performance shall be evaluated based on: 

- Customer complaint reduction. 
 - Customer rejection reduction. 
 - Internal rejection reduction. 
 - Quality loss reduction. 
 - Critical defect reduction. 
 - Product conformity. 
 - Customer audit performance. 
 - Timely closure of CAPA/8D. 
 - Supplier quality improvement. 
 - Laboratory and calibration compliance. 
 - Quality system compliance. 
 - New product approval and successful trials. 
 - Reduction of recurring quality problems. 
 - Team competency development. 
 - Contribution to overall plant yield and productivity. 21. Qualification

Essential

- Bachelor's degree in: 
 - Glass & Ceramics
 - Chemical Engineering
 - Mechanical Engineering
 - Production Engineering
 - Industrial Engineering
 - Relevant technical discipline. Preferred

- Degree/Diploma in Glass Technology or Ceramics. 
 - ISO/QMS Lead Auditor qualification. 
 - Six Sigma / Quality Management certification. 
 - Training in 8D, FMEA, SPC, MSA and CAPA. 22. Experience

- 12-18 years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, preferably in the glass container manufacturing industry. 
 - Strong preference for candidates with experience in: 
 - Container glass manufacturing
 - IS machine operations
 - Hot-end and cold-end quality
 - Electronic inspection systems
 - Glass laboratory
 - Customer complaint handling
 - Customer audits
 - New product development. Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates from glass container manufacturers or organizations supplying glass containers to major FMCG, pharmaceutical, food & beverage, liquor, cosmetics or other packaging customers would be preferred. 

23. Technical Competencies

The candidate should have strong knowledge of: 

- Glass container manufacturing process
 - Furnace/melting process
 - IS machine process
 - Forming defects
 - Annealing process
 - Hot-end and cold-end inspection
 - Dimensional measurement
 - Electronic inspection
 - Statistical Process Control
 - Root Cause Analysis
 - 8D
 - CAPA
 - FMEA
 - MSA
 - Quality Control Plans
 - ISO 9001/QMS
 - Customer specifications
 - Calibration systems
 - Quality data analysis. 24. Behavioural Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. 
 - Strong leadership and team-management skills. 
 - Customer-oriented approach. 
 - Ability to work under production pressure without compromising quality. 
 - Strong communication and presentation skills. 
 - Ability to work cross-functionally. 
 - Decision-making capability. 
 - Ownership and accountability. 
 - Data-driven approach. 
 - Ability to challenge incorrect processes and drive corrective action. 
 - Strong follow-up and execution capability. 25. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on Quality professional with strong glass container manufacturing experience, capable of independently managing the complete Quality function from raw material → batch → furnace → forming → annealing → cold-end inspection → packing → dispatch → customer complaint. 

The candidate should not be limited to laboratory or inspection activities. He/she should have demonstrated experience in process quality improvement, customer handling, complaint resolution, quality system management and cross-functional problem solving. 

Priority should be given to candidates who have: 

- Direct glass container manufacturing experience. 
 - Experience with external customers. 
 - Experience in customer audits. 
 - Experience handling customer complaints independently. 
 - Strong knowledge of hot-end and cold-end defects. 
 - Experience with electronic inspection systems. 
 - Proven record of reducing rejection and customer complaints. 
 - Experience in new product development and customer approval. 
 - Strong leadership capability to manage the Quality team and influence Production/Engineering teams. Reporting & Working Relationship

Reports to: AGM - Operations / Plant Head

Key Internal Interfaces: 

Production | Furnace | Batch House | Maintenance | Instrumentation | Electrical | Engineering | Packing | Stores | Purchase | Sales | HR

Key External Interfaces: 

Customers | Customer Quality Teams | Suppliers | Auditors | Certification Agencies | Testing Laboratories

Overall Objective

"To ensure that every glass container dispatched from the plant consistently meets customer specifications and statutory/internal quality requirements, while continuously reducing defects, customer complaints, rejection and quality-related manufacturing losses. "

data.title: Lead CMDB & Configuration Management Engineer
data.description:
- Role purpose

The Senior Configuration Management Lead is the senior hands-on technical lead for the operation and assurance of LSEG's enterprise CMDB. The role converts configuration management standards and data-model requirements into reliable operational capability, ensuring that configuration data is complete, correct, current, controlled and usable across on-premises, cloud and hybrid technology estates. 

The role leads CMDB engineering, source onboarding, reconciliation, data-quality automation and control execution. It works across ServiceNow, authoritative technology sources and the enterprise data platform to create trusted, reusable configuration data products, while applying AI and automation with clear human validation, security controls and auditable evidence. 

Core outcome: move SCM from manual detection and remediation toward source-driven, measurable and increasingly automated control operation, without weakening human accountability or production safeguards. 

- Strategic context 
 - LSEG is moving toward trusted, governed and interoperable data foundations that support analytics, AI, automation and reusable data products. 
 - The SCM operating model therefore requires more than traditional CMDB administration. It requires engineering discipline across ingestion, identification, reconciliation, quality controls, exception management, evidence and data consumption. 
 - This role is responsible for the operate-and-assure layer for configuration data. Architecture and standards define how data should be structured; the Senior Configuration Management Lead engineers, runs and improves the mechanisms that make the data dependable in practice. 
 - AI is used as a force multiplier for analysis, documentation, anomaly detection, evidence preparation and remediation prioritisation. Material decisions and production changes remain subject to human review and established approval controls. 
 - Key accountabilities

CMDB engineering and configuration management

Act as the senior SCM technical lead: Provide authoritative operational guidance for CMDB enhancements, integrations, data-source onboarding, identification and reconciliation rules, relationship handling and lifecycle controls. 

Lead capability delivery: Translate SCM requirements into implementable changes and lead delivery from definition through design input, test assurance, deployment readiness, adoption and measurable outcome. 

Operate and assure the CMDB: Ensure that approved configuration management processes, control requirements and data standards are applied consistently across in-scope CI classes and technology domains. 

Define operational scope and exceptions: Maintain clear operational scope, class coverage, source responsibilities and governed exceptions, increasing material risks through the Process Owner and relevant governance forums. 

Data quality, reconciliation and remediation

Engineer data quality at source: Work with infrastructure, cloud, network, database, storage and application teams to prevent poor-quality data entering or updating the CMDB, using quality gates and clearly defined source ownership. 

Automate reconciliation: Design and operate repeatable comparisons between ServiceNow and authoritative inventories, using identification and reconciliation controls to prevent duplicates, conflicting updates and incorrect classification. 

Drive remediation to closure: Prioritise configuration data defects by operational and control risk, establish owners and target outcomes, and ensure exceptions are supervised through to evidence-based closure. 

Improve relationship integrity: Strengthen application-to-service and service-to-infrastructure relationships so configuration data supports impact analysis, incident, change, resilience and audit use cases. 

AI and automation-enabled SCM

Develop automation use cases: Identify and shape high-value automation for data validation, duplicate detection, stale or orphan identification, source-to-CMDB comparison, evidence production and remediation workflow. 

Apply AI responsibly: Use Copilot and approved AI capabilities to accelerate analysis, documentation, rule development and exception triage, while validating outputs and retaining human accountability for decisions and changes. 

Embed controls as code: Help translate SCM policies, control criteria and data-quality rules into version-controlled, testable and repeatable logic that generates traceable evidence. 

Measure automation outcomes: Track reduction in manual effort, improved detection coverage, faster remediation and improved control reliability rather than treating automation delivery as an end in itself. 

Data platform and data product integration

Define trusted SCM data products: Partner with data platform engineering to define curated configuration datasets, quality rules, ownership, lineage, refresh expectations and access patterns for operational and analytical consumption. 

Support strategic ingestion patterns: Enable source-driven integrations through governed APIs, events, CDC or batch patterns, ensuring ServiceNow remains appropriately controlled while configuration data can be reused beyond the platform. 

Provide semantic and metadata input: Supply SCM domain knowledge to shared data definitions, class semantics, mandatory ributes, relationships and reusable contracts that support analytics, AI and agentic use cases. 

Close the feedback loop: Ensure quality findings and execution outcomes from data-platform and automation workflows are routed back into SCM governance, remediation and evidence processes. 

Controls, audit and operational assurance

Operate SCM controls: Support the operational effectiveness of ASLM 1. 2 and related controls through measurable KCI/KDE outputs, exception governance and sustained evidence generation. 

Maintain audit-ready evidence: Ensure that data-quality checks, reconciliations, approvals, exceptions and remediation outcomes are repeatable, traceable and accessible for control owners, Risk, Internal Audit and external assurance. 

Lead test assurance: Define and supervise appropriate testing for CMDB changes, integrations, reconciliation rules and automation, including expected results, defect resolution and production-readiness evidence. 

Resolve systemic failures: Investigate recurring process and data failures, identify root causes and drive corrective action across teams rather than relying on repeated manual cleanup. 

Technical leadership and continual improvement

Lead through influence: Coordinate virtual squads across SCM, ServiceNow, architecture, data engineering and infrastructure domains, without requiring direct line-management authority. 

Establish team capability: Mentor SCM practitioners in CMDB engineering, data quality, automation, testing, evidence and modern engineering practices. 

Maintain operational documentation: Keep process, procedure, work instruction, decision and control documentation current, usable and aligned to implemented capability. 

Drive measurable improvement: Use metrics and structured improvement cycles to increase coverage, accuracy, freshness, relationship integrity, automation and remediation effectiveness. 

- Key relationships 
 - Service Configuration Management Process Owner and SCM practitioners. 
 - ITSM Architecture, CSDM and ServiceNow platform engineering. 
 - Asset Management, Service Operations, Service Transition and Service Performance teams. 
 - Cloud, Network, Server, Database, Storage, application and service-owner communities. 
 - Data platform, data engineering, automation and AI capability teams. 
 - Technology Risk, control owners, Internal Audit, external assurance and regulatory collaborators. 
 - Skills and experience

Crucial

- Significant hands-on experience in Service Configuration Management and enterprise CMDB operation, with evidence of leading sophisticated technical outcomes. 
 - Deep practical ServiceNow CMDB knowledge, including CI classes, relationships, identification and reconciliation, integrations, CMDB Health and data certification. Discovery and CSDM experience is strongly preferred. 
 - Demonstrable experience improving configuration data quality through source reconciliation, de-duplication, lifecycle controls, classification, relationship validation and structured remediation. 
 - Experience translating process, control or data-quality requirements into implementable technical requirements, test scenarios and operational procedures. 
 - Practical automation capability using one or more of Python, scripting, APIs, data pipelines, Git-based workflows, CI/CD or comparable engineering tooling. 
 - Practical experience using AI or Copilot responsibly for analysis, engineering, documentation or quality activities, including validation of generated outputs. 
 - Ability to work with data-platform concepts such as ingestion, curated datasets, lineage, metadata, quality rules, APIs, events and historical data consumption. 
 - Strong controls and evidence rigor, with the ability to explain how a control operates and demonstrate repeatable, auditable outcomes. 
 - Clear customer communication and the ability to lead technical decisions and delivery through influence across multiple teams. 

Desirable

- Experience with Snowflake, CDC, lakehouse or unified data-platform patterns. 
 - Knowledge of configuration-data semantic models, data dictionaries or metadata-management practices. 
 - Experience with controls as code, policy as code, automated evidence or agent-assisted operations. 
 - ITIL certification and knowledge of COBIT, DORA or supervised financial-services control environments. 
 - Experience mentoring practitioners and leading virtual technical squads.

Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted. 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa's Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. Technical Director - Design for Test (DFT)

Summary: 

The Technical Director - DFT is the chief technical authority for our Design-for-Test service line. This strategic leadership role involves defining the cutting-edge DFT methodologies applicable across diverse client projects, leading critical high-stakes execution, and serving as the primary technical interface for business development and client advisory. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Technical & Service Strategy
 - Domain Expertise: 
 - DFT Scan Insertion, DFT RTL Integration Activities, ATPG pattern generation and pattern verification, Post Silicon Debug, ATPG Coverage Improvement, SpyglassDFT, LBIST Verification, MBIST Integration and Verification and low-power DFT. 
 - Tool & Flow Mastery: Define the core technology strategy and create standardized, reusable flows for commercial EDA tools used in DFT insertion and pattern generation, ensuring maximum efficiency and compatibility across client environments. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Continuously simplify and improve design and test methodologies, optimizing test cost and performance based on market trends and manufacturing feedback. 2. Client Leadership & Business Acumen

- Pre-Sales & Solutioning: Provide expert technical solutioning for RFPs (Request for Proposals). Work with the Business Development team to define project scope, accurately estimate effort, create compelling technical proposals, and articulate the unique value of our DFT services. 
 - Strategic Client Advisor: Build and maintain high-trust technical relationships with client executives and engineering leaders, acting as a reliable, strategic advisor on their long-term silicon test strategy. 
 - Architectural Evangelism: Clearly articulate, document, and "sell" architectural targets and recommendations to both client and internal project teams, ensuring the final solution meets both technical rigor and business needs. 3. Team Leadership & Competency Building

- Team Management: Lead, mentor, and strategically scale a team of high-performing DFT engineers and consultants. 
 - Talent Development: Drive the development of internal training programs, Proof of Concepts (POCs), and technical certifications to maintain the team's expertise on the latest test standards, such as ISO 26262 and advanced process nodes. 
 - Thought Leadership & Branding: Be the voice of the organization's DFT Thought Leadership by developing white papers, presenting at industry forums, and contributing to market recognition (e. g. , analyst rankings, client testimonials). 
 - Recruitment & Mentorship: Contribute to the technical architecture practice by conducting selection interviews and mentoring junior architects and developers. Required Qualifications: 

- Experience: 15+ years in VLSI design, with 5+ years in a leadership role in a semiconductor service/consulting or EDA company. 
 - DFT Expertise: Expert-level, tool-agnostic understanding of advanced DFT techniques (ATPG algorithms, scan compression, fault modeling, MBIST/LBIST) and their application in deep submicron technologies. 
 - Business & Consulting Acumen: Demonstrated success in technical pre-sales, project scoping, managing client expectations, and contributing significantly to service contract wins. 
 - ATE & Manufacturing: Strong command of the relationship between DFT features, silicon manufacturing processes, high-volume testing on ATE platforms (Teradyne, Advantest), and yield optimization. 
 - Communication: Exceptional ability to distill complex DFT trade-offs into clear, strategic presentations for both executive management and technical teams. Preferred Qualifications: 

- Familiarity with functional safety standards (e. g. , ISO 26262) and their impact on DFT implementation. 
 - Prior experience managing multiple, concurrent, and technologically diverse client DFT projects.

data.description:
Title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure)

Position Overview: 

The Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure) is a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and operational processes across the organization. This role serves as a subject matter expert for Azure DevOps practices, provides technical leadership to the engineering team, and partners closely with Development, QA, Architecture, and Delivery teams to ensure reliable, secure, and efficient software delivery. 

The Senior Engineer works under the guidance of the Azure DevOps Team Lead and plays a key role in driving automation, cloud modernization, platform reliability, security, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities: 

CI/CD Engineering & Automation

- Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Gitlab, Azure DevOps, and related tooling. 
 - Automate build, test, deployment, and release management processes. 
 - Improve deployment reliability, speed, traceability, and consistency across environments. 
 - Implement pipeline standards, reusable templates, and deployment best practices. 

Cloud Infrastructure , Networking & Platform Engineering

- Build, configure, and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code principles. 
 - Develop and maintain Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates for automated provisioning. 
 - Support Azure services including App Services, AKS, Functions, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, Networking, and Monitoring solutions. 
 - Ensure cloud environments are scalable, resilient, secure, and cost-effective. 
 - Design and configure secure ingress and egress solutions using NAT Gateway, Azure Firewall, Network Security Groups, Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall, and load-balancing services. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex network connectivity, routing, DNS, firewall, TLS, proxy, ingress, and application-access issues. 
 - Drive improvements in cloud scalability, availability, security, observability, governance, and cost optimization. 

Containerization & Kubernetes

- Design and support containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Implement and maintain Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments. 
 - Improve container deployment, scaling, monitoring, and operational reliability. 
 - Develop deployment patterns and operational standards for container-based applications. 

Operational Excellence & Reliability

- Monitor production and non-production environments and proactively address operational issues. 
 - Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and remediation planning. 
 - Implement observability solutions using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and related tools. 
 - Drive platform stability, performance optimization, and system availability initiatives. 

Security & Compliance

- Implement DevSecOps practices within deployment pipelines and cloud environments. 
 - Manage secrets, certificates, service principals, managed identities, and Key Vault integrations. 
 - Support vulnerability remediation, security scanning, and compliance requirements. 
 - Ensure infrastructure and deployment processes align with organizational security standards. 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Provide technical guidance and mentoring to DevOps Engineers and project teams. 
 - Review infrastructure designs, deployment approaches, and automation solutions. 
 - Promote engineering standards, best practices, and operational excellence. 
 - Contribute to architectural discussions and provide DevOps expertise during solution design. 

Collaboration & Delivery Support

- Work closely with Development, QA, Product, and Delivery teams to support successful releases. 
 - Assist with release planning, deployment readiness, and environment strategy. 
 - Troubleshoot complex deployment and infrastructure issues. 
 - Collaborate with architects and platform teams to align solutions with enterprise standards. 

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

- Identify opportunities to improve automation, reliability, scalability, and developer experience. 
 - Develop self-service capabilities and reusable DevOps solutions. 
 - Evaluate emerging Azure services, DevOps tools, and industry best practices. 
 - Contribute to platform modernization and cloud transformation initiatives. 

Skills & Qualifications: 

Required

- 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Azure services and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Expertise with Gitlab Pipelines, Azure DevOps, Git, and CI/CD best practices. 
 - Experience implementing Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates. 
 - Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). 
 - Strong knowledge of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, CIDR addressing, subnetting, DNS, routing, NAT, load balancing, network segmentation, virtual networks (VNets), network security groups (NSGs), private endpoints, and firewall technologies. 
 - Hands-on experience configuring Azure networking services, including Virtual Networks, subnets, Network Security Groups, route tables, VNet peering, NAT Gateway, private endpoints, and Private DNS. 
 - Experience configuring and managing Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall, Azure Load Balancer, and secure ingress and egress traffic flows. 
 - Proficiency in PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability solutions. 
 - Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 

Certifications Preferred

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)
 - Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Preferred

- Experience supporting enterprise-scale Azure environments. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and security automation. 
 - Experience with platform engineering, self-service infrastructure, or internal developer platforms. 
 - Familiarity with Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies. 

We are looking for intellectually curious people, passionate about the bigger picture of how technology industry is evolving, ready to ask difficult questions and deal with complicated scenarios! If you are creative and a problem solver, this is the place to be as will be supporting you to fast-forward your career!

We enhance each employee's potential through personal development through a wide range of learning tools both formal and informal. 

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. 

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions. 

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25, 000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce. You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas and are committed to sustainability across our global business. data.title: Lead Business Process Engineer (Process Automation) - Officer
data.description:
Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking a hands-on process and knowledge engineer to join Alpha Intelligence, State Street's AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations. You will help transform complex processes end to end - understanding how work is done today, designing simpler future-state processes, and enabling automation and AI solutions that improve speed, control and client outcomes. 

The ideal candidate is analytical, structured and delivery-focused, comfortable working directly with subject-matter experts, and able to own a workstream of process discovery and documentation end to end with limited supervision. 

Why this role is important to us

Alpha Intelligence goes beyond documenting processes - we redesign how Alpha implementations are delivered. This role connects process discovery, future-state design, automation and AI, implementation and continuous improvement. 

About The Team - Alpha Intelligence

Alpha Intelligence is State Street's AI & Automation Center of Excellence for Alpha Implementations - the team rewiring how the industry's first front-to-back platform gets delivered. We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last. 

We operate as one global team across the US, UK, Europe, India and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf - what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

- Conduct process discovery through interviews, shadowing, walkthroughs and system observation with implementation and operations subject-matter experts. 
 - Own end-to-end process transformation for assigned workstreams, from discovery and future-state design through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement. 
 - Map and assess current-state processes, including handoffs, systems, data, controls and exceptions, to identify root causes, effort, risk and friction. 
 - Design simpler, standardized future-state processes that improve controls and use the right mix of people, process, data, automation and AI. 
 - Structure and tag content for search, RAG and agent use, ensuring knowledge assets are discoverable, accurate and maintainable. 
 - Validate process and knowledge assets with subject-matter experts, manage signoffs and maintain version control. 
 - Prioritize redesign, automation and AI opportunities, and define the expected benefits and success measures. 
 - Turn approved future-state designs into clear requirements and implementation plans, working with automation, AI, technology, operations and change teams. 
 - Support rollout and adoption, track results, and use feedback to improve the process over time. 
 - Maintain accurate status, progress and delivery reporting for your assigned workstream, escalating risks and blockers early. 
 - Coordinate across regional teams and time zones to enable seamless handoffs and effective dependency management. 

What We Value

- Strong structured thinking and attention to detail - precision matters in process and knowledge engineering. 
 - Curiosity and persistence in getting to the real process, not just the documented one. 
 - Self-driven delivery with the ability to produce quality outcomes with minimal follow-up. 
 - Clear, concise written and verbal communication, especially in documentation. 
 - A collaborative mindset and comfort working with senior subject-matter experts and global stakeholders. 

Experience And Capabilities That Will Help You Succeed

- 10 to 15 years of relevant experience in business process analysis, process documentation, operations, transformation or automation delivery within financial services. 
 - Working knowledge of investment management or capital markets operations across front, middle and back office and the trade lifecycle. 
 - Hands-on experience with process mapping and documentation methods and tools, exposure to BPMN, Visio, UiPath Task Capture, ARIS or comparable platforms is beneficial. 
 - Familiarity with automation platforms such as UiPath and an understanding of what makes a process automatable. 
 - Good understanding of AI and GenAI concepts, including how structured knowledge and content quality drive RAG and agent performance. 
 - Strong analytical and documentation skills, with proficiency in relevant collaboration, data and presentation tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SQL, Excel or PowerPoint; equivalent tools and transferable experience are welcome. 
 - Ability to plan, prioritize and deliver milestones in a fast-moving programme environment. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with regional teams, occasional participation outside local working hours may be required for planned handoffs or critical discussions. 

Education & Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Technology, Engineering, Finance, Management or Information Systems, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 
 - Process excellence or automation certifications (e. g. , Lean Six Sigma, BPM, UiPath) are an advantage. 

Interested but do not meet every qualification? If your experience and transferable skills align with the overall role, we encourage you to apply. We value different paths to building relevant expertise and will consider the full picture of what you can bring to the team. 

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you'll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. 

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law. 

Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet. com/careers

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer Cloud & AI
data.description:
Our Company: 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You'll Do

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Staff Cloud & AI Platform Engineer to own, architect, and independently build a next‐generation enterprise‐scale deployment and orchestration platform. This role goes far beyond traditional CI/CD or infrastructure automation-it sits at the intersection of distributed systems, control‐plane architecture, SRE principles, and applied AI/agentic workflows. 

- Lead the design and implementation of a stateful deployment control plane that treats deployments as a continuous convergence problem. 
 - Enable safe, resumable, deterministic, and SLO‐governed rollouts across multi‐cloud, on‐prem, and customer environments. 
 - Drive the practical application of AI agents in DevOps by embedding intelligent decision‐making into deployment workflows. 
 - Apply AI agents for anomaly detection, failure diagnosis, rollout control, and automated mitigation. 
 - Ensure all AI‐assisted workflows preserve correctness, determinism, and full auditability. 

This is a high‐impact individual contributor role requiring deep technical judgment, architectural ownership, and the ability to turn abstract design into production‐grade systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement a stateful deployment control plane with deterministic, resumable execution and rollback support. 
 - Build deployment workflows that reconcile desired vs. actual state using durable control loops. 
 - Support multi‐cloud, on‐prem, and customer environments with a single orchestration framework. 
 - Implement SLO‐governed promotion gates, error‐budget checks, and bounded retry policies. 
 - Enable deployment models including self‐service, wave‐based rollouts, blue‐green, managed updates, and maintenance windows. 
 - Define declarative, extensible workflow schemas with explicit dependencies, retries, and rollback semantics. 
 - Integrate deployment orchestration with CI/CD systems, artifact manifests, entitlement services, and downstream execution systems. 
 - Embed AI‐assisted decision logic into deployment workflows for anomaly detection, failure diagnosis, and rollout control. 
 - Ensure AI‐driven actions remain deterministic, auditable, reversible, and policy‐constrained. 
 - Develop infrastructure and automation frameworks using Terraform, Python, and cloud‐native services. 
 - Embed observability and telemetry into workflows to drive automated validation, retries, and rollback decisions. 
 - Provide hands‐on technical leadership, mentoring engineers and driving platform architecture across DevOps, SRE, and CloudOps teams. 

Who You'll Work With

This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with project team members and architects, and report to the Senior Engineering Manager. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field
 - 10+ years of hands‐on experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems. 
 - Proven experience designing and building stateful systems such as control planes, workflow engines, or orchestration platforms. 
 - Experience building or operating enterprise‐scale deployment systems across multi‐cloud, hybrid, or on‐prem environments. 
 - Deep expertise in CI/CD, release engineering, and deployment strategies including wave‐based, blue‐green, and managed rollouts. 
 - Practical experience applying SRE principles such as SLOs, error budgets, promotion gates, and automated rollback. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, with the ability to build long‐running services and automation frameworks. 
 - Hands‐on experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform, and cloud‐native services (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP). 
 - Experience integrating observability and telemetry (metrics, logs, traces) into automated systems for decision‐making. 
 - Demonstrated experience building or integrating AI‐assisted or agentic workflows into DevOps or operational systems. 
 - Ability to design safe, auditable, policy‐constrained automation, especially when applying AI or autonomous decision logic. 
 - Strong technical judgment and communication skills, with experience leading architecture across teams as an individual contributor. 

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

data.title: Automation Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Automation Engineer

Job Description

The Automation Engineer independently manages end-to-end automation projects, from requirements gathering and analysis through development, testing, and deployment. This role focuses on building robust Excel VBA solutions, automating workflows across multiple applications, and developing insightful dashboards to support data-driven decision-making. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with effective communication and a collaborative mindset to work seamlessly with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across time zones. 

Responsibilities

- Own and deliver automation projects end to end, including requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and implementation. 
 - Develop, write, debug, and optimize VBA code, including the effective use of objects, methods, and events for robust automation solutions. 
 - Design, build, and maintain Excel-based tools using macros, charts, pivot tables, complex formulas, functions, user forms, and advanced data handling techniques. 
 - Create automated reports and dashboards, ensuring they are accurate, user-friendly, and aligned with business requirements. 
 - Identify issues in existing processes or tools, perform root-cause analysis, and propose and implement effective solutions. 
 - Automate workflows and processes using Excel VBA, Power Automate, GCP, BigQuery, and Python, ensuring scalability and maintainability. 
 - Develop and maintain dashboards in Power BI and Qlik Sense to visualize key metrics and support decision-making. 
 - Integrate and automate interactions between Excel and other applications such as SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Outlook. 
 - Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to understand requirements, provide regular updates, and ensure successful project outcomes. 
 - Adapt to working with diverse cultures and across different time zones, maintaining clear communication and coordination. 
 - Prepare and deliver clear presentations and demonstrations of developed tools, dashboards, and automation solutions. 
 - Leverage experience in the automotive OEM domain, if applicable, to better understand industry-specific processes and requirements. 

Essential Skills

- Proven ability to manage and deliver automation projects independently from requirement gathering through deployment and implementation. 
 - Strong expertise in writing, debugging, error handling, and optimizing VBA code, including working with objects, methods, and events. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Excel, including macros, charts, pivot tables, complex formulas, functions, user forms, and data handling. 
 - Hands-on experience in report creation and dashboard development using Excel and automation tools. 
 - Ability to understand customer requirements and work effectively in a concept-to-design model. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, analyze root causes, and propose practical solutions. 
 - Experience integrating and automating workflows between Excel and other applications such as SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Outlook. 
 - Practical experience in automation using Excel VBA, Power Automate, GCP, BigQuery, and Python. 
 - Experience in dashboard development using Power BI and Qlik Sense. 
 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within cross-functional teams and across different time zones and cultures. 

Additional Skills & Qualifications

- Experience working in an automotive OEM environment is an advantage. 
 - Knowledge of Python and SQL for data processing, automation, and integration with other systems. 
 - Proactive and collaborative approach to working with cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong desire to continuously improve automation solutions and contribute to process optimization. 

Work Environment

The role involves working in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment that spans multiple time zones and cultures. You will use a modern technology stack that includes Excel VBA, Power Automate, GCP, BigQuery, Python, Power BI, Qlik Sense, and integrations with applications such as SharePoint, PowerPoint, and Outlook. The position emphasizes clear communication, regular interaction with stakeholders, and active participation in team discussions and presentations. Work is primarily focused on digital tools and data-driven solutions, with an emphasis on accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement. 

Work Experience: 4-8 years

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Actalent, Diversity And Inclusion Are a Bridge Towards The Equity And Success Of Our People. DE&I Is Embedded Into Our Culture Through

- Hiring diverse talent
 - Maintaining an inclusive environment through persistent self-reflection
 - Building a culture of care, engagement, and recognition with clear outcomes
 - Ensuring growth opportunities for our people

Actalent is an equal opportunity employer. 

About Actalent

Actalent is a global leader in engineering and sciences services. For more than 40 years, weve helped visionary companies advance their goals. A Snapshot of Your Day

As an IT Test Automation Engineer, you will strengthen enterprise testing and quality engineering capabilities across global SAP and business application landscapes. You will be responsible for the design, implementation, operation, governance, and continuous improvement of automated testing solutions, with a key focus on Tricentis Tosca and related Tricentis products to enable scalable, reliable, and maintainable test automation across SAP and integrated non-SAP environments. As SSO for the Test Automation Service, you will ensure secure, compliant, and reliable operations while overseeing governance, risks, documentation, stakeholder collaboration, continuous improvement, and financial planning aligned with the service roadmap. You will also drive ongoing validation and quality assurance to ensure that deployed automation remains effective, efficient, compliant, and aligned with business requirements throughout its lifecycle, including monitoring automation quality, reviewing test assets, validating execution results, and driving continuous improvement of testing processes. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Review and validate automation scripts, test cases, test data, and execution strategies. 
 - Ensure compliance with established automation standards, naming conventions, and development guidelines, and define and continuously improve quality standards for automated testing. 
 - Conduct quality reviews of automation assets and automation frameworks, assess automation coverage, and identify opportunities to expand automation adoption. 
 - Establish controls to ensure consistency and reusability of test assets across projects and verify traceability between requirements, business processes, test cases, and execution results. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of testing methodologies and test automation practices. 
 - Ensure secure, compliant, reliable, and lifecycle-oriented operation of the Test Automation Service (SSO). 
 - Coordinate service governance and manage operational, technical, and compliance risks while maintaining service documentation and controls.

data.title: Quality Assurance Lead
data.description:
Quality Assurance Lead - Health Insurance Platforms & Release Governance

Work Mode: Remote

Time Zone: Montreal Business Hours (9 AM - 5 PM EST)

Experience: 8+ Years

About the Role

We are hiring a Quality Assurance Lead to own QA governance, vendor release validation, regression strategy, and hands-on testing execution across a health insurance organization's enterprise platforms. 

This is a lean, high-impact role. You will be the primary QA owner, working directly with the CTO and a Business Analyst. There is no QA team to manage. The expectation is that you personally drive testing strategy, execute critical test cycles, and progressively build repeatable QA practices across the organization's technology ecosystem. 

The technology landscape includes a policy administration system (CoverGo), Salesforce, an accounting platform (Business Central), broker and member portals, and multiple vendor integrations. Vendor releases arrive frequently, and production stability is a live concern. 

Operating Model

This is a player-coach role in the truest sense. You will: 

- Define QA strategy, governance frameworks, and testing standards
 - Personally execute regression, functional, and release validation testing
 - Review vendor release notes, assess impact, and own go/no-go decisions
 - Create and maintain test cases, defect tickets, and regression suites
 - Coordinate with vendors to improve release quality and deployment discipline
 - Work as part of a small team (CTO, QA Lead, BA) where everyone contributes directlyIf your expectation is to manage a team from day one, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something from the ground up and own it end to end, this role was designed for you. 

Key Responsibilities

Vendor Release Validation & Regression Governance

- Review vendor release notes and perform impact analysis across business workflows, integrations, and platforms
 - Define and execute risk-based regression testing strategies across CoverGo, Salesforce, Business Central, portals, and integrations
 - Prioritize business-critical workflows for reusable regression coverage
 - Coordinate production readiness, release signoff, and go-live validation
 - Maintain traceability between requirements, defects, releases, and regression coverageInsurance Platform & Workflow Quality

Own testing governance across critical health insurance workflows: 

- Policy lifecycle (quote, bind, issue)
 - Member onboarding and movements
 - Endorsements and renewals
 - Billing and invoicing (including Stripe integration flows)
 - Broker and member portal functionality
 - Claims submission and TPA data exchange
 - Cross-platform data flows across CoverGo, Salesforce, and Business CentralQA Governance & Testing Strategy

- Define and implement standardized QA processes, defect management, and test documentation practices
 - Establish testing approaches for functional, integration, performance, and regression testing
 - Define QA metrics, release quality indicators, and testing governance KPIs
 - Improve visibility into release readiness, production stability, and release risksAutomation & Non-Functional Testing

- Progressively introduce practical automation for stable and repetitive regression scenarios
 - Define automation approaches balancing business value, maintenance effort, and release frequency
 - Establish baseline performance testing approaches for critical workflows and integrations

Required Experience

Must-Haves

- 8+ years in QA / Test Management / QA Governance roles
 - Genuine health insurance domain depth across the product lifecycle: 
 - Policy issuance, underwriting, endorsements, renewals
 - Billing, invoicing, premium collection
 - Claims submission and processing workflows
 - Member and broker portal operations
 - This is the single most important requirement. P&C or general insurance experience alone will not suffice. 
 - Experience with vendor/platform release validation, including release note analysis, impact assessment, regression planning, and release signoff
 - Experience defining regression strategies and building reusable regression coverage
 - Hands-on QA execution capability, not just governance or oversight
 - Strong communication, structured thinking, and the ability to work independently in a remote, lean setup
 - Willingness to ramp up on Salesforce QA. The organization uses Salesforce for broker management, commissions, opportunity tracking, and policy workflow integration. You will be expected to learn and own Salesforce QA within the first 60-90 days. 

Strong Preferences

- Experience with health insurance administration platforms (CoverGo, Guidewire, EIS, Majesco, or similar)
 - Familiarity with TPA relationships and outsourced claims administration
 - Experience in SaaS/vendor-driven environments where you are the client, not the software house
 - Moderate-to-strong automation capability (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar)
 - Exposure to performance and non-functional testing
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted QA workflows. The team actively uses AI tools (such as Claude) for test case generation, Jira ticket creation, and accelerating day-to-day QA work. Comfort with AI-augmented workflows is advantageous. 

The Right Profile

You have worked in health insurance long enough that you do not need someone to explain policy lifecycle, member movements, or renewal workflows to you. You understand how these things work operationally, not just theoretically. 

You are someone who sets things up, not someone who waits for a framework to be handed to them. You have done this before in at least one organization where QA practices were either absent or immature, and you built or significantly improved them. 

You are comfortable being the sole QA voice in a small team. You do not need a large team around you to be effective. You are hands-on by preference, not by compromise. 

You understand that in a vendor-driven SaaS ecosystem, protecting production stability requires disciplined regression, structured release validation, and practical prioritization of what to test and when. 

You communicate clearly and proactively in a remote setting. You raise problems early, propose solutions, and do not wait to be asked. 

About Us

Hyper Lychee Labs is an IT services and consulting company committed to delivering innovative and impactful solutions to a diverse client base, including Fortune 500 companies, the Government of India, and forward-thinking startups. With a focus on leveraging technology for transformation, the company provides custom software development, complex systems implementation, and strategic consulting. Our team of talented professionals collaborates to ensure exceptional results tailored to clients' needs. Dedicated to fostering a culture of creativity, diversity, and inclusion, Hyper Lychee Labs strives to empower businesses to thrive in a rapidly evolving world.
