The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team for SabreSonic Inventory (SSI) is responsible for the reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence of one of Sabre's most critical components. 

SSI provides inventory management and availability processing for airlines; a

high-performance, scalable, backend and GUI for rules management. 

The team combines software engineering and operations expertise to manage highly available, fault-tolerant services. Engineers work extensively with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, observability platforms, and AI-driven operational practices to improve reliability while reducing operational toil. The organization partners closely with software engineering, product management, architecture, security, and customer-facing stakeholders across Sabre. 

What You'll Do

As Manager of Site Reliability Engineering, you will lead a team of SRE engineers responsible for the availability, performance, resiliency, and continuous evolution of SabreSonic Inventory. You will drive operational excellence. You will lead incident management, reliability engineering initiatives, cloud modernization efforts, and automation programs while developing a high-performing engineering team. 

- Lead and develop a team of Site Reliability Engineers, providing coaching, performance management, career development, and technical leadership. 
 - Drive service reliability, availability, scalability, and operational excellence across critical production systems and customer-facing platforms. 
 - Partner with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and Infrastructure teams to establish and achieve Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and reliability targets. 
 - Lead major incident response, postmortem reviews, risk mitigation initiatives, and continuous improvement programs. 
 - Promote automation, AI-enabled operations, self-healing capabilities, and platform engineering practices to reduce operational toil and improve efficiency. 

Required Qualifications And Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field required. 
 - 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 2+ years of people leadership experience, including managing engineers, setting priorities, and developing high-performing teams. 
 - Experience in maintaining or operating large-scale distributed systems in cloud environments. 
 - Understanding of observability, monitoring, alerting, incident management, capacity planning, and reliability engineering principles. 
 - Practical experience leveraging automation, analytics, AI-assisted tooling, or generative AI solutions to improve operational effectiveness and engineering productivity. 
 - Fluent English, both written and verbal

Nice-to-have Qualifications

- Knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud-native architecture. 
 - Experience implementing SLOs, error budgets, reliability scorecards, and operational maturity programs. 
 - Background supporting high-availability, customer-facing SaaS or travel technology platforms.

data.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won't just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve - you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We're proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape - but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform. 

If you're looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that's redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We're looking for a Senior Developer - Exposure Management Platform to be part of making this happen. 

Position Overview And Objective

The Arctic Wolf security operations platform ingests and processes upwards of 250 billion events a day from a wide variety of on-premise devices and cloud platforms. The security pipeline is a distributed system of loosely-coupled microservices that constitute our real-time analysis and threat detection systems. These services distill the incoming events into actionable intelligence that our Concierge Security Teams use to protect customers. 

We are growing rapidly, with our data volume increasing ten-fold roughly every two years. We are looking for senior developers to join our pack and help evolve the architecture, reliability, and capabilities of our security platform. This particular role focuses on building and improving components of our Managed Risk Platform while influencing technical direction across the team. 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Developer at Arctic Wolf, you will: 

- Lead the design and delivery of complex backend capabilities for real-time threat analysis and exposure management services. 
 - Translate ambiguous product or technical requirements into well-scoped designs, implementation plans, and production-ready software. 
 - Build, test, and operate scalable microservices with strong attention to reliability, observability, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Own production outcomes for services your team supports, including deployments, operational readiness, incident response, and continuous improvement. 
 - Provide technical guidance through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and raising engineering standards across the team. 
 - Collaborate with product, security operations, and engineering partners to make pragmatic technical trade-offs that support customer impact. 
 - Continuously learn, share knowledge, and help the team improve how it designs, builds, and operates distributed systems. 

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience shipping production-quality backend software, including ownership of complex services in production. 
 - Strong coding skills with a track record of delivering simple, maintainable solutions to complex technical problems. 
 - Experience designing and operating cloud-based distributed systems, preferably on AWS. 
 - Hands-on experience with Golang is preferred; strong Java or other backend development experience is also valuable. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, Kafka, Docker, and Kubernetes/EKS is preferred. 
 - Comfortable leading technical design for microservices, making trade-offs, and guiding implementation across multiple engineers. 
 - Experienced in improving reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence for production systems. 
 - Enjoy mentoring other developers and contributing to team-wide engineering practices. 
 - Excited to work at the intersection of big data, cybersecurity, and real-time systems. 

Our Technology Stack

Golang, Docker, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Kubernetes/EKS, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Java, Linux. 

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations. 

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work - USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work - Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work - UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company - Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10, 000 customers worldwide and more than 2, 000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry. 

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that-by protecting people's and organizations' sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk- we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here. 

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 

All India wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

- Equity for all employees
 - Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days
 - Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance. 
 - Fertility support and paid parental leave
 - Employee Assistance Program

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf. com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.

- Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN's Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies). 
 - Background checks are required for this position. 
 - This position may require access to information protected under U. S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations ("EAR"). data.title: Engineering Leader
data.description:
About Whatfix

Whatfix is an AI platform that makes enterprise software, and now enterprise AI, usable for the people who depend on it. We call this userization: technology should adapt to the user, not the other way round. 

Our proprietary AI engine, ScreenSense, reads what a user is doing inside an application and the intent behind it. It then delivers guidance, knowledge and automation in the flow of work. ScreenSense powers Digital Adoption, Product Analytics and Mirror, with Whatfix AI Agents built into each. Our newer AI-first products include Seek, an AI-native assistant that understands business context and acts across applications, and Mirror 2. 0, which pairs system and role simulation with assessment. 

- 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ of the Fortune 500
 - ~$270M raised, including a $125M Series E led by Warburg Pincus with SoftBank Vision Fund 2
 - Named a Leader in Digital Adoption Platforms by Gartner, Forrester, IDC and Everest Group, and a Gartner Customers' Choice for DAP in 2024 and 2025
 - Seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore and Australia

The role

This is a leadership role for someone who still builds. 

Engineering at Whatfix has changed how it works. Every engineer takes a problem from spec to production, with coding agents doing much of the implementation. People own the judgment: what to build, how it should work, and whether what the agent produced is actually right. 

As an Engineering Leader (EL3), you own engineering for a product or platform area end to end. You lead a team of around 7-12 or more engineers and shape the human + agent system they work in. You stay close enough to the code to make, and challenge, the important technical calls. And you still ship. 

What you'll own

- Your area, end to end. Delivery, architecture, reliability, production health, and infrastructure and AI cost for a product or platform area. 
 - The technical bar. Important design decisions in your area come from you or go through you. You take architecture choices to our Architecture Review Board (ARB) and guide other teams that touch your code. 
 - Production quality. Work goes live with a spec, automated tests, monitoring and runbooks. Production issues get root-cause fixes and systemic improvements, not patches. 
 - Customer impact. You stay on top of customer issues, keep customers unblocked, and make sure Presales, Solutions and Support can confidently represent what your area does. 
 - The roadmap, with Product. You bring a clear technical and customer point of view, plan sprints, run spikes to retire risk early, and balance new work against tech debt and stability. 

How your team builds

You don't just encourage AI adoption. You build the system that makes delegating to agents reliable. 

- Spec-first by default. Every meaningful change starts with a written spec: the problem, expected outcome, constraints and acceptance criteria. 
 - The right context and guardrails. Repository context and instruction files, shared specs and prompts, tooling and review workflows that let engineers hand substantial work to coding agents with confidence. 
 - A Definition of Done that holds up with agents in the loop. Spec in the repo, tests before delegation, human review of agent-generated code, context files kept current. 
 - Engineers who verify, not just generate. You coach the team to write executable specs, delegate well, and critically review what comes back. Nothing ships because it compiles or passes its own generated tests. 
 - Clear accountability. Every engineer owns what they merge, whether a person or an agent wrote it. 
 - Safe use of AI. Approved tools only, with security, privacy, data and licensing requirements intact. 

You still build

We mean this literally. With coding agents, there's no longer a trade-off between leading a team and shipping product. 

- You take real problems from spec to production, using coding agents. 
 - You review specs, designs and agent-generated code closely enough to catch the race condition, the missing index or the weak assumption. 
 - You debug production issues hands-on and can explain, change and fix any system your team owns. 
 - You prototype and run spikes on the hardest technical questions before the team commits to an approach. 

Leading the team

- Manage around 7-12 engineers directly, and over time possibly a further team through another Engineering Leader. 
 - Own performance end to end: expectations, ongoing feedback, reviews, compensation inputs, promotions, and managing underperformance, with support from HR. 
 - Give clear, direct feedback all the time, not just at review time. 
 - Build a team that can run several large initiatives in parallel, without you as the bottleneck and with no single points of failure. 
 - Hire for Engineering, not just your team. Raise the bar in interviews and help close strong senior talent. 
 - Build a culture of trust and ownership, where good work gets recognized publicly and in real time. 

What success looks like

- First 90 days: You know your area's architecture, production health and cost. You've shipped real work yourself through the team's agent workflow. Every engineer knows exactly what you expect from them. 
 - By 6 months: Specs, the Definition of Done and agent guardrails are followed consistently, not just on paper. Customer issues are under control. Product and customer-facing teams come to you first for your area. 
 - By 12 months: Your team owns several large features at once without leaning on you. You can show measurable gains in cycle time, rework or escaped defects that come from better specs and delegation, not longer hours. At least one engineer has grown into a bigger scope. 

What you bring

- Usually 8-15 years in software engineering, including time managing engineers directly. What you've owned matters more to us than the number. 
 - Strong engineering judgment in system design and distributed systems, including performance, scalability, fault tolerance and high availability. 
 - Full-stack fluency. Our services are mostly Java and Spring Boot, our frontends TypeScript and React, running on Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native CI/CD with relational and NoSQL stores. We don't hire by stack boundary. You work across it. 
 - Real experience with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot on meaningful work. You've delegated substantial work, seen where agents go wrong, and changed how you scope and verify as a result. 
 - A track record of leading teams that ship production-quality software, and of growing engineers who now own complex systems. 
 - Customer-first thinking. You tie technical decisions to business outcomes. 
 - Clear, structured communication. You can explain a hard trade-off to an engineer, a product manager or a customer. 
 - Good to have: experience building AI features into products, such as LLM integration, retrieval, agents or evaluation harnesses. 

This may not be the right role if

- Your current role is mostly reviews, planning and people management, and you don't miss building. 
 - You see coding agents as a productivity add-on rather than a change in how engineering gets done. 
 - You'd rather own one layer of the stack than a whole problem. 

How we'll assess you

Our interviews look like the job. You'll use a coding agent of your choice wherever it fits. 

- Discovery conversation with a peer or our Head of Engineering
 - Problem solving with a coding agent: build something that works, adapt it when a new constraint lands, explain what the agent produced, and review AI-generated code critically. 
 - System design and review: work through a larger problem end to end, then critique an existing design or code. 
 - Leadership conversation: how you've built and run teams, including a real example of meaningful work you handed to an agent, the context you gave it, and what you caught in review. 

Working at Whatfix

How we work. We believe being together in the office 4-5 days a week makes communication easier, builds community and speeds up innovation. 

Benefits (India). Best-in-class medical insurance, lunch and dinner buffet, doorstep cab drop, education sponsorship, internal and global mobility programs, and the chance to represent Whatfix at global events. 

Our values. Customer First · Empathy · Transparency · Fail Fast and Scale Fast · No Hierarchies for Communication · Deep Dive and Innovate · Trust, Do It as You Own It. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of, not in spite of, their differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.

data.title: Assamese Team Lead
data.description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as an Assamese Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Assamese AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Assamese content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and help ensure that all contributors follow the expected standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Assamese and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Assamese quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Assamese training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check Assamese items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around Assamese wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, and edge cases. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain Assamese project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Assamese-specific style requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Assamese language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Assamese-language projects. 

Your Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Assamese, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field. 
 - Native or near-native Assamese proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Assamese writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Assamese grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Assamese content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong plus.

data.title: ASIC Digital Design, Staff Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You are an engineer who gets energized when you see a complex Subsystem come together and actually work, not just pass a basic smoke test, actually work under corner cases that would make most people walk away. You have spent enough time in verification to know that the difference between a clean tapeout and a costly respin often lives in a test case no one thought to write or a coverage hole no one noticed until it was too late. That keeps you up at night in the best way. 

You think in test plans, not checklists. When someone hands you a spec for a DDR or PCIe or UCIe interface, you are already mapping out where the edge cases hide and what kind of stimulus will actually stress the design. Debugging a waveform with thousands of signals does not intimidate you, it is where you do your best work. You ask the right questions early, whether that is clarifying an ambiguous requirement with an architect or pushing back on an RTL designer when something does not smell right. 

Leading a team does not mean having all the answers. It means knowing when to dive deep yourself and when to unblock someone else. You have mentored engineers before, or you are ready to, and you understand that the best verification environments are built by people who share what they learn. At Synopsys, you will work on Subsystems that power the chips behind AI, automotive, and cloud infrastructure, and the verification rigor you bring will directly determine whether those chips work. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead verification ownership for critical Subsystem areas, driving strategy and execution alongside a team of verification engineers working on DDR, HBM, PCIe, UCIe, Ethernet, UALink, or UFS IP integration
 - Define, implement, and track detailed verification test plans that map coverage goals to real silicon risk, ensuring nothing slips through
 - Build and maintain Subsystem-level UVM testbenches in SystemVerilog, integrating RTL and behavioral models into a cohesive verification environment
 - Write complex test cases, assertions, and checkers that catch the corner cases other teams miss, and debug simulation failures down to root cause
 - Extract, analyze, and drive closure on functional coverage and code coverage metrics, working with the team to close gaps before signoff
 - Manage regression suites and contribute to continuous improvement of verification flows, methodologies, and automation
 - Collaborate directly with RTL designers and architects across global sites to ensure functional correctness and alignment on design intent

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable successful verification and deployment of high-performance Subsystems that ship in leading-edge SoCs powering AI, automotive, cloud, and mobile applications worldwide
 - Catch critical design issues early in the verification cycle, reducing time-to-market and avoiding costly silicon respins that can delay product launches by months
 - Advance verification methodologies and AI-assisted verification flows that influence how Synopsys and the broader industry approach Subsystem-level verification
 - Build verification environments and test strategies that become reusable assets across multiple product generations and IP families
 - Mentor and grow verification engineers on your team, raising the technical bar and building a culture of rigor and knowledge sharing
 - Strengthen Synopsys' reputation as the premier provider of high-speed connectivity IP Subsystems through engineering excellence that customers depend on
 - Set industry standards for IP verification quality and methodology, contributing to Synopsys' leadership in chip design and EDA

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
 - 8+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC or FPGA verification, with a track record of owning verification deliverables from planning through signoff
 - Proven expertise developing SystemVerilog and UVM-based testbenches for complex ASIC designs, including experience with assertions, checkers, and constrained random stimulus
 - Strong ability to define verification strategies, write rigorous test plans, and drive coverage closure using functional coverage and code coverage analysis
 - Experience technically leading a verification team or mentoring engineers, with demonstrated success collaborating across design, architecture, and verification teams
 - Deep understanding of verification metrics, regression management, and debugging complex simulation failures in large-scale environments
 - Experience with high-speed interface protocols such as DDR, HBM, PCIe, UCIe, Ethernet, UALink, or UFS is highly desirable and will set you apart

Who You Are

- You can look at a failing regression, pull up the waveform, and within an hour tell the team whether it is a testbench bug, an RTL issue, or a timing corner no one considered
 - When a junior engineer brings you a stuck debug, you do not just give them the answer, you walk them through how to isolate the problem so they can solve the next one themselves
 - You push back when a test plan is too shallow or a coverage model misses an important state transition, and you do it in a way that makes the team stronger, not defensive
 - You stay current on verification techniques and tools, whether that is exploring AI-assisted verification flows or adopting new UVM patterns that improve reuse and debug speed
 - You communicate clearly across time zones and disciplines, translating verification status into terms that architects, designers, and project leads can act on
 - You take ownership seriously, if a coverage hole or test gap exists in your area, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you flag it and drive it to closure

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.description:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies-like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion-have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. 

We're a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. 

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful-because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. 

If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here. 

Job Description

Primary Function: 

As Intuitive expands its robotic-assisted surgical ecosystem, we are seeking a Software Quality Engineer

to support the development and sustainment of Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), Embedded

Software, Connected Medical Devices, and AI-enabled software solutions. The individual will provide

quality engineering leadership across the software development lifecycle while ensuring compliance with

global medical device regulations and industry standards. This is not a software testing role. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Act as Software Quality representative for New Product Development and sustaining projects involving SaMD and Embedded Software. 
 - Provide oversight of Design Controls, SDLC compliance, software verification and validation activities. 
 - Review and approve requirements, architecture, software design, risk management, cybersecurity, traceability, test protocols, test reports, and release documentation. 
 - Ensure compliance with IEC 62304, ISO 14971, ISO 13485, FDA QMSR, FDA Software Guidance, and applicable global regulations. 
 - Participate in software risk management, hazard analysis, and risk control verification activities. 
 - Support cybersecurity risk management in accordance with FDA guidance, AAMI TIR57/TIR97, and NIST frameworks. 
 - Provide quality oversight for Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, defect management, CAPA, root cause investigations, and software changes. 
 - Ensure end-to-end traceability from User Needs through Software Verification and Validation. 
 - Support regulatory submissions, audits, inspections, and post-market software quality activities. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) adoption. 

Qualifications

Skills/Job Requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - 4+ years of Software Quality Engineering, Software Development, or Systems Engineering experience within Medical Devices. 
 - Hands-on experience with SaMD, Embedded Software, Connected Devices, or Robotics Software. 
 - Strong knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA Design Controls, FDA QMSR/QSR, and software lifecycle compliance. 
 - Experience with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps. 
 - Understanding of Medical Device Cybersecurity, Secure SDLC, Threat Modeling, and Vulnerability Management. 
 - Experience with traceability, risk-based testing, software reliability, and release management. 
 - Preferred: Experience supporting AI/ML-enabled medical device software and CSA practices. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with strong attention to quality and patient safety. 

Additional Information

Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. 

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws. 

U. S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U. S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR

- 743. 13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U. S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status. 

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U. S. Government on your behalf (note: the government's licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan ("TCP") (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process). 

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee's start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. 

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on

business need and/or on the selected candidate's experience, knowledge and skills.

data.title: Principal Engineer , DFT
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

Renesas is seeking a highly experienced Principal DFT Engineer to drive end-to-end DFT execution for advanced SoCs/MCUs. The candidate should possess deep expertise across the complete DFT lifecycle, from test architecture definition through silicon bring-up and production test deployment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive SoC-level DFT architecture and test strategy, including Scan, ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, JTAG/IJTAG, SSN, and test compression. 

- Own the complete DFT flow from test architecture, RTL design & integration, DFT verification, scan insertion, ATPG, coverage closure, and signoff. 

- Drive silicon bring-up, silicon debug, diagnosis, yield improvement, and production test enablement. 

- Develop and deploy scalable DFT methodologies, automation frameworks, and best practices. 

- Collaborate with Design, Verification, Physical Design, and Test Engineering teams. 

- Provide technical leadership and mentor engineers across projects. 

Qualifications

- B. E. /B. Tech. , M. E. /M. Tech. , or Ph. D. in Electronics or related field. 
 - 15+ years of hands-on DFT experience with successful delivery of multiple SoCs. 

Proven expertise in: 

- DFT Architecture & Test Planning

- DFT RTL Design & Integration

- Scan Insertion & ATPG

- MBIST, LBIST, JTAG/IJTAG

- GLS & Signoff

- Silicon Bring-up, Debug & Diagnosis

- Strong hands-on experience with Tessent, Genus/Fusion Compiler, VCS/Xcelium, and Conformal/Formality. 

- Strong automation and scripting skills using Python, TCL, Perl, or Shell. 

- Leadership & Soft Skills 
 - Strong technical leadership with the ability to influence cross-functional and global teams. 

- Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and execution excellence. 

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 

- Proven mentoring and coaching capabilities to develop engineering talent. 

- Self-motivated, collaborative, and results-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21, 000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‐leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. 

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. 

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. 

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

data.title: Senior Quality Engineer L1
data.description:
Job Description

Senior Associate, Quality Engineering - Level 1

Publicis Sapient is looking for a Senior associate in quality engineering with strong functional and manual testing experience to help deliver high-quality technology solutions for our clients. You will apply your knowledge of capital markets, testing practices, APIs, and databases to validate complex trading applications across the development lifecycle. You will collaborate with developers, business stakeholders, and other quality engineers to identify risks, resolve defects, and improve product quality. Your testing expertise and problem-solving skills will contribute to reliable solutions that create meaningful value for our clients. 

Your Impact: 

- Plan and execute functional, manual, regression, and progression testing to ensure the quality and reliability of complex applications. 
 - Validate capital-markets workflows across the trading lifecycle, including order creation, execution, settlement, and related lifecycle events. 
 - Design comprehensive test scenarios covering Equities and Fixed Income instruments, including Bonds, Bond Forwards, Futures, and Swaps. 
 - Test REST and SOAP APIs by validating contracts, requests, responses, business fields, and error scenarios using tools such as Postman or curl. 
 - Write and execute SQL queries independently to validate application and test data across relevant database tables. 
 - Manage defects through their complete lifecycle, participate in defect triage, analyse application logs, and support root-cause investigation. 
 - Collaborate with developers, traders, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment to complete testing activities and support successful releases. 

Qualifications

Your Skills & Experience: 

- 4+ years of hands-on functional or manual testing experience, preferably involving capital-markets or trading applications. 
 - Practical knowledge of the capital-markets trading lifecycle and experience testing Equities and Fixed Income products. 
 - Strong understanding of test planning, test-case design, estimation, regression testing, defect management, and test metrics. 
 - Working knowledge of REST and SOAP API testing, including request and response validation using Postman, curl, or similar tools. 
 - Ability to independently write SQL queries using SELECT, WHERE, JOIN, and GROUP BY. 
 - Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams and participating in relevant sprint ceremonies. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work independently and drive assigned activities to completion. 

Additional Information

Set Yourself Apart With: 

- Experience working with front-office or middle-office applications within an Asset Management organization. 
 - Exposure to test automation using Selenium with Java or Robot Framework with Python. 
 - Python scripting experience for test utilities, data validation, or simple automation. 
 - Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar solutions for test-case generation or defect analysis. 

Benefits of Working Here: 

- Gender-Neutral Policy
 - 18 paid holidays throughout the year. 
 - Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
 - Flexible work arrangements
 - Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being. 

A Tip from the Hiring Manager: 

"Bring strong testing fundamentals, curiosity about capital markets, and the confidence to independently investigate complex issues. "

Company Description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally-enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20, 000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting and customer obsession to accelerate our clients' businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

data.title: Software Engineer III - BenTech Integrations
data.description:
The next part of your journey is right around the corner - with Standard India

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams across the nation, we've been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture, focused on operational excellence, thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary

A Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET III) in the BenTech Integrations team will contribute to high-quality software delivery for API-first and event-driven integration capabilities that connect The Standard's insurance ecosystem with external benefits technology platforms, HCM systems, and partner solutions. This role will focus on developing, maintaining, and executing automated test solutions for REST APIs, microservices, event-driven flows, data validation, and integration testing across the BenTech platform. 

In this role, you will work closely with API engineers, data engineers, product owners, architects, DevOps/SRE teams, and other delivery partners to ensure that integration capabilities are reliable, secure, scalable, and production ready. You will build automated test coverage into CI/CD/CT pipelines, validate API contracts, test data flow across upstream and downstream systems, contribute to non-functional testing, and use logs, metrics, dashboards, and automated quality checks to investigate failures and strengthen release confidence. 

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on automation engineering experience, API testing expertise, disciplined test design, and the ability to independently deliver quality engineering work within a globally distributed Agile delivery model. This role requires investigative thinking, sound technical judgment, and an understanding of how automated testing, code-level quality practices, observability, and risk-based validation support reliability, operational readiness, and business confidence in a regulated insurance environment. 

- Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, India is a requirement of the role. *

Mode of Working: This role follows a hybrid work model, with a primary base in Bengaluru. While on-site presence is essential for key engagements, flexibility is offered for remote work based on business needs and team alignment. 

Skills And Background You'll Need

Education: B. Tech / B. E. is required. A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. 

Experience: Typically requires 6+ years of related experience in software testing, test automation, API testing, and quality engineering for enterprise applications. 

Automation Engineering And Code-Level Quality

- Hands-on experience developing and maintaining automation frameworks for REST APIs, microservices, backend services, and integration workflows. 
 - Strong programming and automation engineering skills, including object-oriented design, test design patterns, reusable automation components, clean coding practices, maintainable test architecture, and the ability to build automation libraries and troubleshoot code-level failures. 
 - Preferred: Experience with unit testing, white-box testing, or code-level validation practices, including the ability to read application code, understand control flow and failure paths, and collaborate with software engineers to improve testability, coverage, and defect prevention. 

API, Integration, And Distributed Systems Testing

- Strong experience with API testing practices, including OpenAPI/Swagger validation, request/response schema validation, contract testing, authentication and authorization validation, error handling, negative testing, and backward compatibility testing. 
 - Experience with backend, API, and microservices testing, including service virtualization, mocking/stubbing dependent services, test data setup, and automated validation of distributed workflows. 
 - Experience validating integration flows across systems such as HCM platforms, benefits administration platforms, internal insurance systems, data platforms, or partner APIs is preferred. 
 - Experience testing API-first and event-driven integration solutions across benefits technology, HCM, data, or insurance-related platforms is strongly preferred. 

CI/CD, Test Data, Performance, And Operational Readiness

- Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD/CT pipelines, preferably using Azure DevOps, including pipeline-based test execution, analysis of build and test results, and contribution to automated quality reporting and release readiness. 
 - Experience with synthetic data creation, test data management, data masking, and data quality rule automation to support high-fidelity testing in regulated environments. 
 - Working knowledge of performance, load, and resiliency testing for APIs and integration services using tools such as JMeter, Gatling, SOAPUI, Postman, Curl, or similar tools. 
 - Ability to debug distributed test failures by analyzing logs, metrics, traces, API responses, pipeline outputs, and downstream system behavior. 
 - Familiarity with cloud-native engineering practices, Azure-based delivery models, containerized environments, and DevOps ways of working is preferred. 

Quality Execution, Risk Judgment, And Team Contribution

- Applies risk-based testing judgment to identify quality risks, select appropriate test approaches and automation techniques, and prioritize validation around business-critical flows, integration failure points, data integrity, security, resiliency, and production support impact. 
 - Ability to partner with API engineers, data engineers, product owners, architects, and DevOps/SRE teams to define test coverage, automation needs, and release readiness evidence for assigned features and services. 
 - Contributes to automation patterns, quality practices, testability improvements, and team engineering standards; supports team learning through knowledge sharing, pairing, code reviews, and practical guidance. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate test progress, risks, defects, dependencies, and quality insights to technical and non-technical delivery partners. 

Preferred Domain Background

- Preferred: Experience testing software in regulated, mission-critical, or high-consequence domains such as insurance, healthcare, medical devices, financial services, or similar environments where quality, traceability, risk management, and release discipline are essential. 

Key Behaviors Of a Successful Candidate

- Ownership and Accountability - Independently drives assigned automation and quality work, takes responsibility for commitments, manages ambiguity, and owns validation for assigned features from requirement understanding through production readiness.

Job Title

Security Automation Lead

Location

India (Pune)

Role Overview

FNZ is building a global Cyber Platform Engineering function responsible for the operation, reliability, and evolution of the firm's core security platforms. 

We are seeking a Cyber Security Platform Engineer to join the growing engineering capability in India. This is a hands-on technical role focused on operating and improving FNZ's production cyber security platforms. 

The successful candidate will help ensure FNZ's security platforms remain reliable, well-configured, and continuously improving through engineering, automation, and operational excellence. 

This role sits within Cyber Platform Engineering, not the Security Operations Centre (SOC). The focus is on engineering and operating security platforms, rather than monitoring alerts or performing SOC analysis. 

You will work closely with global engineering teams across the UK, US, and APAC. 

Core Responsibilities

Operate, maintain, and continuously improve FNZ's production security platforms to ensure reliability, performance, and operational effectiveness. 

The role combines hands-on platform operation with engineering improvements that enhance platform capability and reduce operational overhead. 

Responsibilities include: 

- Configuring, operating, and optimising enterprise security platforms 
 - Supporting platform upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management 
 - Monitoring platform health, reliability, and performance 
 - Troubleshooting operational issues across security platforms 
 - Ensuring platforms operate in line with FNZ's global security and operational standards 
 - Assisting with automation of platform configuration and operational workflows 
 - Supporting integrations between security platforms and internal systems 
 - Writing scripts or tooling to improve operational efficiency 
 - Supporting infrastructure automation or configuration improvements 
 - Helping improve telemetry pipelines and data flows between security platforms Engineers are expected to approach platform operations with an engineering mindset, identifying opportunities to improve automation, reliability, and operational efficiency over time

Incident Engineering Support

Provide engineering support during security incidents where platform expertise is required. 

This includes: 

- Supporting incident response teams with platform troubleshooting 
 - Assisting with root-cause analysis 
 - Helping implement fixes and improvements following incidents The focus is platform engineering support, not incident monitoring or SOC investigation. 

Platform Reliability & Continuous Improvement

Work with the wider engineering team to improve the maturity and reliability of FNZ's security platform environment. 

This includes: 

- Identifying recurring operational issues 
 - Contributing to automation initiatives 
 - Improving platform observability and operational metrics 
 - Supporting adoption of new security tools and platform capabilities Working Pattern

The team provides global coverage across shifts aligned with international operations. 

Core hours will align with APAC and EMEA collaboration, with occasional out-of-hours work required during major incidents or platform maintenance windows. 

Required Experience

Candidates should demonstrate hands-on experience operating enterprise security platforms. 

Typical background includes: 

- 6+ years in cyber security engineering or platform engineering roles 
 - Hands-on experience working with enterprise security platforms 
 - Experience troubleshooting operational issues across security controls 
 - Experience working within distributed global engineering teams

Technical Experience

Experience across several of the following security platform domains is expected: 

- Endpoint security platforms (EDR / XDR) such as CrowdStrike, Defender, SentinelOne 
 - Secure Web Gateway / Proxy platforms such as Netskope, Zscaler, iBoss, Prisma Access 
 - Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and application-layer protection platforms 
 - Security logging and SIEM platforms 
 - Email security platforms and secure email gateways 
 - Vulnerability management platforms 
 - Network security controls, including next-generation firewalls

Candidates should demonstrate experience operating, configuring, and supporting these platforms in production environments. 

Engineering & Automation Experience

Experience in the following areas is beneficial: 

- scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash or similar) 
 - working with APIs for platform integrations 
 - infrastructure automation or configuration management 
 - operating security tooling in cloud environments

Nice to Have

Experience in the following areas would be beneficial: 

- infrastructure-as-code or DevOps practices 
 - cloud security platform engineering 
 - integrating security tooling within CI/CD pipelines 
 - platform telemetry and observability tooling

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will: 

- support the reliable operation of FNZ's security platforms 
 - contribute to engineering improvements and automation initiatives 
 - help maintain platform performance and stability 
 - collaborate effectively with global engineering teams 
 - grow technical expertise across FNZ's security platform ecosystem

Why This Role Matters

Security platforms form a critical part of FNZ's global technology infrastructure. 

The Cyber Platform Engineering team ensures these platforms remain: 

- reliable 
 - scalable 
 - well-engineered 
 - continuously improving This role contributes directly to maintaining the security and resilience of FNZ's global environment.

Senior Cloud Reliability Engineer

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Reliability Engineer with deep enterprise SaaS operations expertise to own the availability, reliability, security, and efficiency of our Multi-Cloud (AWS, GCP) production SaaS platform. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience running highly available, large-scale Kubernetes-based control and data planes, a strong bias toward automation and AI-augmented operations, and a proven track record in production security, capacity management, and cloud-native data infrastructure.

- Operate a high-scale, multi-cloud (AWS, GCP) SaaS platform - ensuring reliability, performance, and uptime for business-critical production workloads.

 - Define and enforce a culture of automation-first: identify and eliminate toil through self-healing systems, automated remediation pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm, GitOps). 
 - Participate in on-call rotations for critical cloud infrastructure; serve as a senior escalation point and incident commander during high-severity events.

Required skills/qualifications

- B. Tech. degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

 - Strong proficiency in programming, particularly with Go and Python, and experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and Ansible.

data.title: Unity Developer
data.description:
Company: SpatialGrid Computing Pvt. Ltd. 

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Experience: 1-5 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Requirement: Office-based with selective on-site deployment/travel across India

About SpatialGrid

SpatialGrid Computing is an immersive spatial intelligence platform and company developing enterprise solutions across Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Mixed Reality (MR), Simulators, simulation, digital twins, GIS and spatial computing. We work on complex, real-world applications across sectors including Defence, Aerospace, Railways, Mining, Energy, Infrastructure, Industrial Training and Education. We are looking for a Unity Developer with exceptionally strong fundamentals in Unity and C# who is comfortable building applications independently and working on technically challenging simulation and immersive technology projects. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain Unity-based VR, AR, MR, simulation and interactive 3D applications. 
 - Write clean, efficient, maintainable and production-ready C# code. 
 - Develop application architecture, gameplay/simulation logic, interaction systems, UI systems and reusable components. 
 - Integrate VR/MR hardware, controllers, tracking systems and other peripherals with Unity applications. 
 - Work with 3D artists, UI/UX designers, QA engineers and other developers to deliver complete applications. 
 - Optimize applications for performance, memory, rendering and hardware constraints. 
 - Debug and troubleshoot complex Unity and C# issues independently. 
 - Develop applications that may operate in offline, restricted-network or air-gapped environments. 
 - Participate in customer demonstrations, testing, deployment and commissioning at client locations. 
 - Work closely with customers and domain experts to translate real-world procedures and requirements into interactive simulations. 
 - Maintain proper technical documentation and follow internal development standards. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Candidates should have strong fundamentals rather than being dependent on online resources or AI tools for basic development tasks. 

- 1-5 years of professional Unity development experience. 
 - Excellent understanding of C# and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP). 
 - Must be capable of writing, debugging and explaining C# code independently without relying on internet access, AI assistants or online code references for fundamental programming tasks. 
 - Strong understanding of: 
 - Classes, interfaces and inheritance
 - Collections and data structures
 - Delegates and events
 - Coroutines
 - Generics
 - Exception handling
 - SOLID principles and design patterns
 - Unity lifecycle and component architecture
 - Strong knowledge of Unity GameObjects, Prefabs, Scenes, Physics, Animation, UI and Input Systems. 
 - Understanding of 3D mathematics, including vectors, rotations, transforms and coordinate systems. 
 - Experience with performance profiling and optimization. 
 - Strong debugging and logical problem-solving abilities. 
 - Comfortable working with Git/version-control workflows. Experience with VR/AR/MR, OpenXR, Meta Quest, simulation systems, networking/multi-user environments, shaders or hardware integrations will be an advantage. 

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in developers who: 

- Have strong programming fundamentals rather than dependence on tools. 
 - Can understand an unfamiliar codebase and solve problems independently. 
 - Are comfortable taking ownership of modules from development through deployment. 
 - Can work effectively under real-world project and customer constraints. 
 - Are willing to learn new technologies, hardware and domain-specific systems. 
 - Have a disciplined and professional approach suitable for working with enterprise, government and defence customers. 
 - Are comfortable with travel and extended on-site assignments. 

Preferred Qualifications

B. E. /B. Tech/M. Tech/BCA/MCA/B. Sc. Computer Science or equivalent technical qualification. 

Candidates with demonstrable Unity/C# expertise and strong project experience may also be considered irrespective of academic specialization. 

Selection Process

The technical evaluation will place significant emphasis on fundamental programming ability and practical problem-solving. 

Candidates should expect: 

- C# fundamentals and programming assessment
 - Unity technical assessment
 - Practical coding/problem-solving exercise
 - Technical/project discussion
 - Final interviewThe assessment may be conducted without access to the internet or AI coding assistants to evaluate the candidate's core programming and problem-solving capabilities. 

On-Site & Project Travel

SpatialGrid's primary office is based in Hyderabad, and this will be the developer's regular work location. As we work with clients across defence, government, industrial and enterprise sectors, certain projects may provide opportunities to work directly at customer and project locations across India. Depending on the project, this could include short-term or extended on-site assignments, particularly in Hyderabad and Bengaluru. The duration and frequency of such assignments will vary based on project requirements and will be communicated and planned with the team in advance wherever possible. 

Some Defence and government facilities operate within secure or restricted environments, which may include limitations on internet connectivity and personal electronic devices. These assignments offer developers the opportunity to work closely with specialized systems, simulation technologies and real-world operational environments that are not typically accessible in conventional software development roles. 

We are looking for candidates who are open to reasonable travel and on-site assignments when projects require it. Specific travel, duration and deployment expectations can be discussed during the interview process to ensure alignment on both sides. 

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply here or send their updated resume/CV and portfolio to software@spatialgrid. ai.

The focus of this role is to plan, build, execute the verification, validation/emulation and debug of new and existing features for AMD's SOCs, resulting in no bugs in the final SOC design and the firmware/BIOS. data.description:
About Handshake

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1, 600 educational institutions. 

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We've grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month. 

Why Join Handshake Now

- Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
 - Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world's top educational institutions
 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

About Handshake AI

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale. 

We are building our India team to help accelerate the development of frontier models. This team is a critical, strategic investment for us - we have grown the team 3x in the past six months to help fuel our next phase of growth. India-based teammates will work hand-in-hand with US-based teams to scope, execute, and deliver critical human data projects to Frontier Labs and other customers. 

The Role

As the Strategic Projects Lead you'll run multi-week to multi-month coding data initiatives for leading AI and platform teams. You'll coordinate hundreds to thousands of highly skilled SWE Fellows, design and own technical evaluation and annotation workflows, and be accountable for delivery, margins, quality and customer relationships. 

About

You'll write and validate coding assessments, build rubric-driven code review processes, instrument quality signals, and quickly adapt workflows when systems and people need to flex to meet deadlines. This role bridges ML/product/engineering and operations - hands-on with code, fluent with metrics, and ruthless about data quality. What you'll do: 

- Multi-million ARR-equivalent program scope and delivery metrics. 
 - End-to-end delivery of coding-data programs: scoping → assessment design → Fellow selection → annotation → QA → customer feedback. 
 - Design and run technical screens (take-homes, unit-test driven tasks, live coding) that populate the SWE Talent Bench
 - Create rubrics, audit processes and tooling to ensure code annotations/model labels meet production quality. 
 - Create scripts/infrastructure (Python/TypeScript/SQL) to automate QA, analytics and reporting. 

You Have

- 4+ years of experience in technical or analytical roles such as software engineering, data, analytics, or technical product. 
 - A technical degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or similar and/or hands-on experience with coding (Python, SQL, or similar). 
 - Strong coding skills (Python, TypeScript/Node, Java or equivalent) and practical experience with unit tests, CI, version control, and basic infra. 
 - Strong analytical and data driven problem solver, with a first principles approach to scaling and operational challenges. 
 - Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, able to work closely with technical teams and customers while juggling multiple high priority projects. 
 - Entrepreneurial, high ownership mindset, with a high degree of agency, comfort with ambiguity, and pride in end to end outcomes. 
 - Fast learner with deep curiosity about AI, able to quickly pick up complex and technical concepts and stay up to date on LLMs and AI trends. 

You don't need to be a full-time engineer in this role, but you should be technical enough to reason deeply about systems, data quality, and tradeoffs, and to earn credibility with technical stakeholders. 

Desired Capabilities

- Technical background (CS degree or proficiency in SQL/Python for analytics). 
 - Experience in AI, ML, or data operations, particularly in workforce management, data labeling, or model evaluation. 
 - Previous experience in a high-growth startup or an AI-focused company. 

You'll Thrive Here If You

- Are motivated by solving operational problems that have direct, measurable impact. 
 - Want to be part of a company shaping the future of AI through human data. 
 - Can navigate ambiguity, act with urgency, and keep multiple workstreams moving in parallel. 
 - Are ambitious and looking for a stepping stone into leadership roles in operations or client strategy

Perks

- Generous Equity Grant vested over 4 years
 - Housing Bonus: 1. 3 Lakhs spread throughout the first year
 - Well Defined Performance Bonus ranging between 10 - 100% of base
 - Medical Insurance Coverage
 - Food credit for every in person day.

Job Description

QA Engineer would lead quality assurance activities across application releases by ensuring test coverage, quality gates, and release-readiness controls are consistently applied across enterprise digital products. The role would involve validating functional correctness, integration readiness, regression stability, and release quality for applications transitioning from MVP into production-grade platforms. The QA Engineer would help establish repeatable testing practices, support quality governance across release cycles, and improve confidence in deployments through structured validation, defect management, and automation readiness. 

Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Quality Assurance

- Design, execute, and maintain test plans, test cases, and validation scenarios. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, and system testing across releases. 
 - Ensure quality standards are consistently applied across enhancement, defect-fix, and release cycles. 
 - Contribute to test strategy for enterprise-scale and production-sensitive deployments. 

Release Quality Gates & Governance

- Support release readiness by validating quality gates before CAB / production approvals. 
 - Ensure scope, acceptance criteria, and test coverage are complete for planned releases. 
 - Provide quality status, defect summaries, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders. 
 - Support post-release validation, smoke testing, and deployment verification activities. 

Defect Management & Traceability

- Identify, log, triage, and track defects through closure. 
 - Work closely with developers and business teams to reproduce, prioritize, and validate fixes. 
 - Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and release outcomes. 
 - Highlight quality risks, recurring defects, and areas needing preventive improvement. 

Automation & Continuous Improvement

- Contribute to automation strategy for regression, API, or validation workflows where applicable. 
 - Improve test assets, test reusability, coverage visibility, and validation efficiency. 
 - Support continuous improvement of QA practices, release controls, and testing governance. 
 - Assist in developing quality dashboards, metrics, and trend reporting. 
 - Required Technical Skills 
 - Software Testing | Advanced - functional, regression, integration, and system testing

Job Description

Senior Automation Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to lead the design and development of advanced industrial automation solutions using B&R, Siemens, and Rockwell platforms. This role requires deep technical expertise in PLC programming, software architecture, and system integration. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and implement automation software using B&R, Siemens, Rockwell automation platforms.

 - Architect and maintain scalable software solutions for industrial automation systems. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including electrical, mechanical, data and process engineers to deliver integrated solutions. 
 - Support product field testing and training and support commissioning engineers as needed
 - Provide software maintenance support when required
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, including software specifications, architecture diagrams, and user manuals. 
 - Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in automation and control systems. 
 - Conduct code reviews, provide technical mentorship, and support the professional development of junior engineers
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives in automation processes, tools, and methodologies. 
 - Ensure compliance with industry standards, including safety (SIL, ISO 13849), cybersecurity, and quality assurance. 
 - Maintain and develop guidelines
 - There will be occasional travel, to both Decanter main site in Søborg, as well as customer locations. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience in industrial automation, with a strong focus on B&R, Siemens, Rockwell platforms (B&R is advantage). 
 - Expertise in PLC programming for industrial machinery, structured text. 
 - Exposure to IEC 61131-3 standards will be an added advantage
 - Hands on experience on web-based HMI development using web technologies( OPC UA, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript)
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, version control (e. g. , Git & COPIA), and modular design principles. 
 - Experience with industrial communication protocols (e. g. , OPC UA, ProfNet, Ethernet IP, Modbus). 
 - Proven track record of leading automation software development projects from concept to completion. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 - Experience with cloud-based automation platforms and DevOps practices in automation software development. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications in functional safety, project management and industrial cyber security
 - Experience with C/C++, Python, or other high-level programming languages. 
 - Familiarity with IoT platforms, edge computing, and cloud integration. 
 - Knowledge of IIOT, digital twin technologies, simulation tools, and virtual commissioning will be an advantage. 

Why Should You Apply

- We offer you an interesting and challenging position in an open and friendly environment where we help each other to develop and create value for our customers. 
 - Exciting place to build a global network with different nationalities. 
 - Your work will have a true impact on Alfa Laval's future success, you will be learning new things every day.

To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.
