data.description:
Introduction

India Systems Development Lab (ISDL)

IBM Systems division builds Servers, Storage and Systems Software which are the building blocks for next-generation IT infrastructure of enterprise customers and data centers. IBM Servers provide best-in-class reliability, scalability, performance, and end-to-end security to handle mission-critical workloads and provide seamless extension to hybrid multicloud environments. 

India Systems Development Lab (ISDL) is part of word-wide IBM Systems division. Established in 1996, the ISDL Lab is headquartered in Bengaluru, with presence in Pune and Hyderabad as well. ISDL teams work across the IBM Systems stack including Processor development, Firmware, Operating Systems, Systems Software, Storage Software, Cloud Software, Performance Engineering, System Test etc. The ISDL teams also ushered in new development models such as Agile, Design Thinking and DevOps. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Software Engineer at IBM India Systems Development Lab (IBM ISDL), you will get an opportunity to work on all the phases of product development (Design/Development, Test and Support) across core Systems technologies including Operating Systems, Firmware, Systems Software, Storage Software & Cloud Software. 

As a Software Developer At ISDL: 

- You will be focused on development of IBM Systems products interfacing with development & product management teams and end users, cutting across Geos. 
 - You would analyze product requirements, determine the best course of design, implement/code the solution and test across the entire product development life cycle. One could also work on Validation and Support of IBM Systems products. 
 - You get to work with a vibrant, culture driven and technically accomplished teams working to create world-class products and deployment environments, delivering an industry leading user experience for our customers
 - You will be valued for your contributions in a growing organization with broader opportunities. 

At ISDL, work is more than a job - it's a calling: To build. To design. To code. To invent. To collaborate. To think along with clients. To make new products/markets. Not just to do something better, but to attempt things you've never thought was possible. Are you ready to lead in this new era of technology and solve some of the most challenging problems in Systems Software technologies? If so, let's talk. 

Regular Job opportunities across ISDL teams are in the following areas. 

Systems and Cloud Software Engineer: As a Software Engineer with IBM Systems and Cloud Software teams, you will get the opportunity to get involved in all the phases of software development and work with technically accomplished teams. The responsibilities comprise of design new enhancements, coding (including test automation), problem determination and bug fixing, performance analysis, and solving client problems. You could also work on IBM Compute and Storage Systems including Virtualisation, I/O and Reliability Availability & Serviceability thereby, enabling the creation of a seamless software user experience across the stack delivering to IBM's Hybrid Cloud and AI clients. As an engineer you will be responsible for enhancing and maintaining the key components of the Software stack, Platform enablement and an opportunity to work on closed and Open source development communities. 

AI Software Engineer: As a Software Engineer with IBM AI on Z Solutions teams, you will get the opportunity to get involved in delivering best-in class Enterprise AI Solutions on IBM Z and support IBM Customers while adopting AI technologies / Solutions into their businesses by building ethical, secure, trustworthy and sustainable AI solutions on IBM Z. You will be part of end to end solutions working along with technically accomplished teams. You will be working as a Full stack developer starting from understanding client challenges to providing solutions using AI. 

IBM Spectrum Fusion SW Engineer: 

IBM Spectrum Fusion container-native storage solution for OpenShift is designed for enterprise customers who need global hybrid cloud data access. As a Software Engineer with IBM Storage Spectrum Fusion team, you will work with the Dev/Test team to develop and support features for Spectrum Fusion product roadmap. 

Linux Developer: 

As a Linux developer, you would be involved in design and development of advanced features in the Linux OS for the next generation server platforms from IBM by collaboration with the Linux community. You collaborate with teams across the hardware, firmware, and upstream Linux kernel community to deliver these capabilities. 

Hardware Management Console (HMC) / Novalink Software Developer: 

As a Software Developer in HMC / Novalink team, you will work on design, development, and test of the Management Console for IBM Power Servers. You will be involved in user centric Graphical User Interface development and Backend for server and virtualization management solution development in Agile environment. 

AIX Developer: 

AIX is a proprietary Unix operating system which runs on IBM Power Servers. It's a secure, scalable, and robust open standards-based UNIX operating system which is designed to meet the needs of Enterprises class infrastructure. As an AIX developer, you would be involved in development, test or support of AIX OS features development or open source software porting/development for AIX OS

Performance Engineer: 

As a performance Engineer , you will get an opportunity to conduct experiments and analysis to identify performance aspects for operating systems and Enterprise Servers. where you will be responsible for advancing the product roadmap by using your expertise in Linux operating system, building kernel , applying patches, performance characterization, optimization and hardware architecture to analyse performance of software/hardware combinations. You will be involved in conducting experiments and analysis to identify performance challenges and uncover optimization opportunities for IBM Power virtualization and cloud management software built on Open stack. The areas of work will be on characterization, analysis and fine-tune application software to help deliver optimal performance on IBM Power. 

Firmware Engineer: 

As a Firmware developer you will be responsible for designing and developing components and features independently in IBM India Systems Development Lab. ISDL works on end-to-end design, development across Power, Z and Storage portfolio. You would be a part of WW Firmware development organization and would be involved in designing & developing cutting edge features on the open source OpenBMC stack ([1] [1] [1] [1] [1] [1] https: //github. com/openbmc/) and developing the open source embedded firmware code for bringing up the next generation enterprise Power, Z and LinuxONE Servers. You will get an opportunity work alongside with some of the best minds in the industry, forum and communities in the process of contributing to the portfolio.

The Enterprise Systems Design team is keen on hiring passionate Computer science and engineering graduates / Masters students, who can blend their architectural knowledge and programming skills to build the complex infrastructure geared to work for the Hybrid cloud and AI workloads. We have several opportunities in following areas of System & chip development team : 

- Processor verification engineer
 - Needs to develop the test infrastructure to verify the architecture and functionality of the IBM server processors/SOC or ASICs. Will be responsible to creatively think of all the scenarios to test and report the coverage. Work with design as well as other key stakeholders in identifying /debugging & Resolving logic design issues and deliver a quality design
 - Processor Pre / Post silicon validation engineer ; Memory characterization and qualification. 
 - As a validation engineer you would design and develop algorithms for Post Silicon Validation of next generation IBM server processors, SOCs and ASICs. 
 - Electronic design automation - Front & BE tool development. 

EDA tools development team is responsible for developing state of the art Front End verification , simulation , Formal verification tools , Place & Route, synthesis tools and Flows critical for designing & verifying high performance hardware design for IBM's next generation Systems (IBM P and Z Systems) which is used in Cognitive, ML, DL, and Data Center applications.

data.title: Software Engineer IIIng
data.description:
Why UKG

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That's what we do. 

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you'll get flexibility that's real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters-and so do you. 

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our performance engineering team. This role provides an opportunity to lead projects and contribute to high-impact software solutions that are used by enterprises and users worldwide. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing performance strategies, evaluating and optimizing complex software systems, ensuring their reliability and maintainability, and mentoring junior engineers. . You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to the technical foundation behind our flagship products and services. 

Responsibilities: Performance Engineering: Identify performance requirements and risks early in the development lifecycle. Execute load and stress tests, interpret results, analyze performance bottlenecks, and work with the team to improve response times, throughput, and resource utilization. 

Monitoring and Observability: Build and use monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting to understand service behavior. Define and review service health indicators, use telemetry to detect performance regressions, and make systems easier to diagnose in production. 

Project Management: Be able to manage performance execution and delivery of features and projects, negotiating project priorities and deadlines, ensuring successful and timely completion, with quality. 

Code and Runtime Optimization: Analyze application and system behavior to find inefficient code paths or resource usage. Recommend and implement optimizations, then validate their impact through measurement and testing. 

Performance Troubleshooting: Investigate complex performance issues using profiling and diagnostic tools, including heap and thread dump analysis. Identify root causes and drive fixes and preventive measures. 

Architectural Design: Participate in or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders, and contribute to the architectural design of new features and systems. Consider scalability, reliability, maintainability, observability, and performance throughout the design process. 

Mentorship: Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and growth. 

Code Review: Review code developed by other engineers, provide constructive feedback, and maintain a high bar for technical excellence. Promote coding guidelines, elegant and efficient implementations, maintainability, observability, and unit testing. 

Testing: Develop and maintain performance test scripts and automation using tools such as LoadRunner, NeoLoad, JMeter, and JavaScript-based frameworks. 

Debugging and Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues to ensure high-quality service operations. 

Service Health and Quality: Maintain service health and quality, proactively identifying and resolving issues. Use service health indicators and telemetry to recommend improvements to reliability and performance. Lead thorough root cause analyses and implement measures to prevent recurrence. 

Documentation: Document new features, enhancements, fixes, and relevant performance findings. Contribute to technical documentation and training materials. 

Innovation: Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, advocating for their adoption where appropriate to improve innovation and productivity within the team (e. g. , Copilot). 

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

5+ years of experience either in software development or performance engineering, preferably in a product-based or SaaS organization. 

Deep expertise in one or more programming languages such as C, C++, C#, . NET, Python, Java, or JavaScript. 

Hands-On experience with software development practices and in workload modeling, performance test planning, scripting, test execution, monitoring, and results analysis. 

Proficiency with performance testing and APM Tools such as LoadRunner, NeoLoad, JMeter, k6, Grafana, Dynatrace. 

Use APM and diagnostic tools such as Grafana, Datadog, dynatrace, Fiddler, browser developer tools, and platform monitoring solutions to identify bottlenecks and performance risks. 

Proven track record of delivering complex software projects on time and within budget. 

Proficiency with version control systems like GitHub and bug/work tracking systems like JIRA. 

Understanding of cloud technologies and DevOps principles. 

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP. 

Familiarity with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines and automation tools. 

Knowledge of agile development methodologies. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide junior engineers. 

Commitment to continuous learning and professional development. 

Familiarity with developing accessible technologies. 

Dedicated to diversity and inclusion initiatives. 

Work hours: Must be able to overlap with US business hours as required by the team

Company Overview

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry - because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg. com. 

UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process. 

Disability Accommodation in the Application and Interview Process

For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email UKGCareers@ukg. com

data.title: Senior Engineer - NextGen OS V&V Test
data.description:
About Wind River

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. 

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company's software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We've achieved recent 5G milestones including the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone. 

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world. 

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a skilled Validation and Testing Developer to join our team in developing the next generation Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). 

As a Senior Engineer for verification and validation testing, you will contribute to researching and evaluating tools and framework, as well as designing and implementing the test framework used for both certified and non-certified software components. You will also be contributing to designing and implementing system testing and V&V test development. 

In your daily job you will: 

- Work with technical leads to evaluate next-generation validation and verification tools best suited for certification objectives (all Design Assurance Levels) for DO-178C and other standards
 - Assess tool qualification requirements per Software Tool Qualification Considerations
 - Working with architects and tech leads to develop a scalable and maintainable test framework for the next generation embedded OS to support both certified (DO-178C) and non-certified testing workflows, such as requirements-based testing, structural coverage analysis, and traceability
 - Implement automation capabilities for continuous integration and continuous regression testing
 - Participate in developing system-level tests to validate RTOS functionality, performance, and timing behavior
 - Create and execute verification and validation (V&V) test cases traceable to system and software requirements
 - Collaborate with systems and software engineers to ensure complete requirements coverage
 - Take initiative to improve the RTOS product and processes
 - Collaborate and engage effectively with global software engineering teams. 
 - Work in an Agile Scrum Teams and follow Agile processes

How You Will Contribute

Key skills and competencies for succeeding in this role are: 

- BTech / MTech degree (Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or equivalent technical degree). 
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing, verification, or validation
 - Good understanding of RTOS concepts (scheduling, concurrency, determinism, resource management)
 - Experience with DO-178C (or DO-178B) software lifecycle and verification objectives is a plus
 - Familiarity with DO-330 tool qualification processes is a plus
 - Proficiency in test automation and framework development (e. g. , Python, C, C++)
 - Experience with requirements-based testing and traceability is a plus
 - Experience with static analysis, model-based testing, or formal methods is a plus
 - Knowledge of structural coverage tools and techniques (MC/DC, branch, statement) is a plus
 - Experience with commercial or open-source RTOS platforms (e. g. , VxWorks, RTEMS, Zephyr, FreeRTOS) is a plus
 - Familiarity with verification tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, Parasoft, Rapita, or equivalent is a plus
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines
 - Experience with firmware bring up and boot up is a plus

WHY JOIN US?

In a world increasingly driven by software innovation, Wind River is pioneering the technologies that accelerate the digital transformation of our customers with a new generation of mission‐critical AI systems-built for an AI‐first world with the most exacting safety, security, performance, and reliability standards. Our success depends on our ability to innovate with velocity and deliver solutions that help customers solve their toughest challenges. 

Wind River is a global leader in mission‐critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, we have been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that demand the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. We support customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries as they build the next generation of intelligent machines. 

Wind River's technology has supported historic achievements-from NASA's Artemis I and the James Webb Space Telescope to multiple Mars rovers, as well as the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and one of the largest Open RAN networks with Vodafone. 

With industry recognition for innovation, leadership, and workplace excellence-including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten straight years-Wind River offers a culture built on growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging. 

Your Benefits At Wind River

- Named Top Workplace for the 10th year in a row
 - Wind River's strong commitment to DEIB
 - Birthday and Volunteer Time Off
 - Competitive Salary & Benefits Package
 - Extensive Learning Programs
 - Wellness benefits through Unmind

APPLY TODAY, AND TOGETHER LET'S CHANGE TOMORROW!

Wind River is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Test Engineer to drive quality across our web-based products and platform capabilities. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in manual testing, test strategy, defect management, and Agile delivery practices, along with a solid understanding of networking concepts. 

The candidate will work closely with Engineering, Product Management, and DevOps teams to ensure high-quality releases by proactively identifying risks, validating requirements, and executing comprehensive test coverage.

Job Description

QA Engineer would lead quality assurance activities across application releases by ensuring test coverage, quality gates, and release-readiness controls are consistently applied across enterprise digital products. The role would involve validating functional correctness, integration readiness, regression stability, and release quality for applications transitioning from MVP into production-grade platforms. The QA Engineer would help establish repeatable testing practices, support quality governance across release cycles, and improve confidence in deployments through structured validation, defect management, and automation readiness.

 - Contribute to test strategy for enterprise-scale and production-sensitive deployments. 

Release Quality Gates & Governance

- Support release readiness by validating quality gates before CAB / production approvals. 
 - Ensure scope, acceptance criteria, and test coverage are complete for planned releases.

Defect Management & Traceability

Automation & Continuous Improvement

data.title: AI Automation Lead (Our One Person AI Team)
data.description:
iThink Media is a Mumbai OOH (out of home) advertising agency. We sell billboard and LED screen campaigns to brands across real estate, auto, FMCG and BFSI. We're a small team, and we want to become the fastest, sharpest agency in Mumbai, with AI running through everything we do. 

We're hiring one person to make that happen. Not to write a strategy deck about it, but to build it, ship it and get our team using it every day. 

What this role really is

You'll be the only person doing AI at iThink. There's no tech team behind you and no one to hand things off to. Sales, operations, accounts, design, events and management will all come to you. You decide what to build first, build it, document it and make sure people actually use it. If something repetitive is slowing down any part of the company, it's yours to fix. 

Where you'll start (examples, not limits)

- A lead engine that finds brands about to spend, researches the decision maker and drafts personalised emails
 - Follow ups and meeting scheduling that run on their own, with everything logged in our CRM
 - A WhatsApp to CRM flow, so our team updates deals by sending a message
 - Meeting minutes, action items and follow up emails sent to the right people the same day
 - Agents for pitches, proposals, reports and AI mockups

After that, the list keeps growing, and it won't stay in sales. 

What you'll need

- 2 to 5 years building automations that real teams actually use
 - Proof that you've built and owned things on your own, end to end, without a team behind you
 - Hands on experience with n8n, Make or Zapier, plus APIs and webhooks
 - Strong with Claude or ChatGPT, including the API, structured outputs and prompt design
 - At least one CRM integration you've built yourself (Freshsales, HubSpot, Zoho or similar)
 - Clear written English. Your emails will land in front of CMOs
 - The judgement to prioritise, say no, and know what not to automate
 - The habit of documenting everything, so your systems keep running without you

Nice to have

- Experience in advertising, media or B2B sales
 - AI image and video tools such as Higgsfield, Midjourney or Runway
 - Python or Google Apps Script

Please read before applying

- This is not a data science or machine learning role. You won't be training models
 - This is an in office role at our Thane office. We're not hiring remote
 - This is a full time, exclusive role, so no parallel freelance or client work
 - Compensation: ₹6L to ₹10L a year, based on experience and proof of work

What you get

- A blank canvas, real ownership and direct access to the founder
 - A real budget for tools
 - Your work used by the whole company, every day, from week one

How to apply

Send your CV with links to 2 things you've built that are running today, plus a 3 line answer to this question: which one process at an outdoor advertising agency would you automate first, and why?

Applications without links to working builds won't be considered.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
A team of strong engineers is the easy part. Building a team that ships fast, argues well, and holds its own bar without being asked to that's the job. 

Engineering here isn't executing a roadmap someone else wrote. It's deciding what gets built, what gets killed, and where AI actually changes the game for a platform handling sensitive financial data at real scale. 

About Dezerv

Dezerv is a house of investing solutions for India's high-net-worth and affluent families, co-founded by Sandeep Jethwani, Vaibhav Porwal, and Sahil Contractor who between them have run over USD 7 billion in assets across JP Morgan, UBS, and BNP Paribas. We're backed by Premji Invest, Accel, Elevation, and Matrix, and our clients have trusted us with over ₹15, 000 crore of their wealth. 

Investing is stressful. Building wealth is slow and unforgiving. We're building the platform that fixes that - deep investment expertise, paired with technology, minus the cost and anxiety of a traditional advisory relationship. We've grown fast because we're genuinely good at this, transparent on fees, and modern in how we build. 

What are we trying to solve/mission?

We are passionate about helping Indians invest better. We manage investments with active oversight to help both sophisticated and new investors build long-term wealth across various market conditions. 

About the Role

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of backend, frontend, and full-stack engineers and to stay close enough to the code to earn their trust. You'll own delivery for your team, set technical direction alongside Product and Design, and take real responsibility for how your engineers grow. 

Our roadmap ahead is ambitious scaling core platform capabilities, deepening our data infrastructure, and embedding AI into how we build and how our product works. You'll own a meaningful slice of that, and the team that delivers it. 

What You'll Own

Team Leadership & People Growth

- Lead, mentor, and coach a team of backend, frontend, and full-stack engineers
 - Own career growth for your team structured feedback, development plans, and technical guidance that actually changes how people work
 - Grow senior engineers into tech leads and future managers, and give your strongest people problems worth staying for
 - Hire senior engineers independently and hold the bar, even when the pressure is to fill the seat
 - Instill a culture of high ownership, technical rigor, and intellectual honesty about tradeoffs - where the team takes calculated risks without fearing failure. 

Technical Direction

- Set and drive the technical roadmap for your area in partnership with Product and Design
 - Make architectural decisions that balance speed with long-term scalability - and be explicit about what you're trading away when you choose
 - Dive deep into code when it matters debugging, reviewing critical paths, unblocking engineers on hard problems
 - Maintain high standards for system design, performance, observability, and reliability across a fintech-grade platform handling sensitive financial data
 - Bring AI into how the team builds code generation, review, testing - with a clear view of where it adds velocity and where it quietly adds risk. 

Execution Excellence

- Deliver high-quality features on time across multiple parallel workstreams
 - Establish engineering processes that hold under pressure code reviews, incident postmortems, testing culture, release pipelines
 - Partner closely with product managers to shape problem statements, not just execute solutions
 - Build the tracking and accountability mechanisms that make your team's execution predictable
 - Ensure engineering output translates directly into business outcomes and a better client experience. 

What We're Looking For

- 8-10 years of total experience in software engineering. 
 - 2-3+ years managing teams of 8+ engineers, with proven success leading senior talent. 
 - Strong technical depth in one or more of: distributed systems, backend architectures, API design. 
 - Experience shipping products at scale in fast-paced product/tech organisations (fintech a plus)
 - Ability to influence architecture and drive high-quality systems end to end. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows - you've used them and you know their limits. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to align cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - A builder's mindset pragmatic, data-driven, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. 

Why Dezerv

- Shape the technology behind an industry-defining investing platform, at a stage where your decisions compound
 - Real ownership of a team and the systems it builds - with the autonomy to decide how
 - Work alongside an ambitious, high-calibre engineering, product, and design team, close to founders who've built and scaled before
 - A fast-paced, learning-driven culture that rewards initiative, technical excellence, and genuine curiosity about what's next.

FanCode is India's premier digital sports destination, dedicated to delivering a best-in-class

experience for fans across live and non-live sports. Launched in March 2019 by industry

veterans Yannick Colaco and Prasana Krishnan, FanCode has reached over 160 million users. 

The platform features a wide array of global and domestic sporting leagues, in partnership

with leading sports associations. FanCode offers interactive live streaming through

industry-first subscription models, including Match, Bundle, and Tour Passes, as well as

monthly and annual plans at accessible price points. Some of the marquee properties

include La Liga, Formula 1, MotoGP, cricket leagues from around the globe including CPL, Super Smash amongst others. 

FanCode is a brand under Dream Sports, India's leading Sports Technology company, which also includes Dream11 and DreamSetGo in its portfolio. 

Role Overview: 

Technology @ FanCode

The mission is to create a platform for all sports fans, covering Sports Live Video Streaming, Live Scores & Commentary, Video On Demand, Player Analytics, Fantasy Research, News. 

Our tech stack is hosted on GCP and is built on GKE, GCS, Cloud Run, MediaCDN utilizing a microservices-based architecture with Java, Node. js, Python, Redis, MySQL, Cassandra, and Elasticsearch. They are a data-driven team that also uses Python and big data technologies like Kafka, Spark, and Redshift for Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics. As a data-driven team, we also use Python and other big data technologies for Machine Learning and Predictive Analytics. Besides these, we heavily use Kafka, Spark, Redshift and other cutting edge tech to keep improving FanCode's performance. 

You will be a core pillar of the Core Infra Engineering Team, responsible not just for maintaining the environment, but for architecting the next generation of FanCode's platform. You will drive technical decisions that ensure high availability during peak sporting events, minimize latency, and democratize infrastructure for the wider engineering organization. 

You will act as a technical leader, spreading infrastructure knowledge, defining architectural standards, evangelizing best practices and bringing thought leadership in the team. 

What you'll do: 

Architect for Hyper-Scale: 

- Own the reliability and scalability of the platform. Architect systems capable of handling massive traffic spikes during live matches with zero downtime. 
 - Advanced Orchestration & Automation: Go deep into Kubernetes internals. Design custom controllers, operators, or CRDs to automate complex stateful workloads on GKE. 
 - Drive "Platform as a Product": Lead the design and implementation of an Internal Developer Platform (IDP). Move beyond simple CI/CD scripts to building self-service capabilities that allow product teams to provision resources autonomously and securely. 
 - Cost Architecture (FinOps): Take ownership of the cloud budget. Proactively identify cost-optimization opportunities (Spot instances, Autoscaling efficiencies, Reserved capacity) without compromising performance. 
 - Security & Compliance: Implement policy-as-code (OPA/Kyverno) and automated compliance scanning within the delivery lifecycle. 
 - Mentoring: Supporting junior engineers regarding development, concepts, and best practices. 

Must haves: 

- 6+ years of experience as a DevOps or Platform Engineer. 
 - Deep expertise in GCP with a track record of designing multi-region, highly-available and distributed architectures. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure Automation Tools (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible)
 - Strong proficiency in scripting languages such as Python or Bash
 - Deep understanding of Kubernetes Internals, Networking and Service Meshes
 - Experience with DevSecOps and Cloud Security & AppSec tools. 
 - Experience with GenAI, LLMs, Agentic AI Workflows in context of Platform Engineering

Good to have: 

- Video Engineering context: Understanding of CDN, HLS, DASH, and video delivery workflows. 
 - Internal Developer Platform (IDP) tools: Experience with tools like Backstage, Crossplane, or similar tools. 
 - Experience implementing SRE practices (SLOs/SLIs, Post-mortems, Chaos Engineering). 
 - Experience with coding in either Java or Golang. 
 - Experience working on Multi Cloud Setup (AWS/Azure). 
 - Industry Leading Certifications such as CKA, GCP Cloud Architecture, CKAD, etc. 
 - Good understanding of Data Engineering Technologies. 
 - Good understanding on FinOps, AIOps, MLOps.

data.title: Technical Team Leader – Mechanical Commissioning (CxA)- Datacenter
data.description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full-service integrated technology consultancy and professional services to the built environment. 

We partner with clients to improve asset performance, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to lead the commissioning delivery team of hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects. 

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 

This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of 15-20+ leads and commissioning engineers. 

- Own mechanical commissioning strategy, planning, execution and technical governance. 

- Lead L4/L5 commissioning, including FPT, IST, failure-mode and concurrent-maintainability testing. 

- Provide technical oversight across HVAC, chilled-water systems, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, AHUs, DX/In-Row cooling, containment and high-density liquid/immersion cooling systems. 

- Lead commissioning of HSD/fuel systems, including bulk/day tanks, transfer systems, filtration, leak detection and generator auto-fuelling interfaces. 

- Oversee fire protection and life-safety systems, including fire pumps, wet/dry/pre-action systems, clean-agent systems, VESDA, dampers and smoke-control systems. 

- Oversee plumbing and utility systems, including water storage, makeup water, drainage, sump systems, leak detection and associated utilities. 

- Review P&IDs, equipment submittals, control sequences, Sequence of Operations (SOO), cause & effect and commissioning test scripts. 

- Lead TAB/hydronic balancing, equipment performance testing, controls/BMS integration and functional testing. 

- Validate mechanical integration with BMS, EPMS, electrical systems, fire/life-safety and data-center controls. 

- Manage commissioning issues, RCA, risk registers, punch lists and technical close-out. 

- Act as senior technical interface with hyperscale clients, CxA teams, MEP contractors, consultants and OEMs. 

- Drive commissioning quality, safety and readiness for operational handover. 

Requirements

- 15+ years overall mechanical engineering, testing and commissioning experience. 

- 8+ years data-center or mission-critical mechanical commissioning experience. 

- Proven leadership of at least 2 complete L2 to L5 commissioning cycles. 

- Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects. 

- Experience managing 15-20+ Cx engineers. 

- Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chilled-water systems, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, BMS/controls, fuel systems, fire protection and utilities. 

- Experience with high-density/liquid cooling is highly desirable. 

- Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA and applicable local codes/standards. 

- Strong knowledge of Sequence of Operations, controls integration, TAB, hydronic balancing and failure-mode testing. 

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 

- Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills. 

Qualifications

Preferred Certifications

CxA/CBCP | CDCP/CDCS | Uptime Institute ATD | ASHRAE-related credentials

Additional Information

At FPC, we're not just a company-we're a thriving community where innovation flourishes, ideas are celebrated, and careers are shaped. When you join us, you become part of a dynamic team that: 

- Shapes the Future: Work on groundbreaking projects that are redefining industries with sustainability, cutting-edge technology, and bold ambition. 

- Supports Your Growth: From leadership training to cross-functional collaboration, we prioritize your professional development and empower you to explore new ideas, take initiative, and grow in your career. 

- Values Balance and Inclusion: We celebrate diversity, foster collaboration, and ensure every voice is heard-while maintaining a strong commitment to work-life balance. 

- Creates Impact: Contribute to the delivery of iconic, high-performance buildings and innovative solutions that have a lasting, positive impact on the world.

data.title: Quality Engineer - AI Native Platform
data.description:
About the job

Build the future of AI-native Quality Engineering

Quality is not a phase in our development process-it is engineered from day one. 

This is not a traditional testing role. 

We're looking for engineers who can automate everything possible, leverage AI to accelerate quality, and partner closely with developers to ship reliable software at startup speed. 

If you enjoy solving engineering problems, building automation frameworks, and using AI to transform Quality Engineering, we'd love to meet you. 

What You'll Do

- Design and execute comprehensive testing strategies for modern web applications. 
 - Build and maintain scalable UI and API automation frameworks. 
 - Automate Functional, Regression, Integration, System, Smoke, Sanity, and End-to-End testing. 
 - Collaborate with developers during feature design to prevent defects early through Shift-Left Quality Engineering. 
 - Build quality gates into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Validate APIs, databases, workflows, and distributed systems. 
 - Investigate production issues and perform root cause analysis. 
 - Continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, and release confidence. 
 - Work directly with customers when required to understand real-world scenarios. 
 - Use AI extensively to improve productivity, automation, and software quality. 
 - Ship fast without compromising quality. 

What We're Looking For

- 3-5 years of hands-on Quality Engineering experience. 
 - Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Defect Lifecycle, and Agile methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience in Functional, Regression, Integration, System, Smoke, and Sanity Testing. 
 - Strong experience in API Testing and API Automation using REST APIs and Postman. 
 - Hands-on experience with UI Automation using Playwright or Selenium. 
 - Good programming skills in Python, or TypeScript for automation development. 
 - Strong SQL skills with hands-on experience in Database Testing, data validation, and backend verification. 
 - Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc. ). 
 - Experience with Git and modern version control workflows. 
 - Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira or Zoho. 
 - Excellent analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently with high ownership and minimal supervision. 
 - Passion for building automation instead of repetitive manual testing. 

AI-Driven Quality Engineering

We believe AI will fundamentally transform Quality Engineering. 

We're looking for engineers who actively use AI tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality, including: 

- Test case generation
 - Automation script development
 - Test data generation
 - Defect analysis and root cause identification
 - Test optimization and maintenance
 - Exploratory testing
 - Documentation generation
 - Release validationExperience with AI enabled coding platform / tools is highly valued. 

You May Be a Great Fit If

You enjoy: 

- Building automation instead of repetitive manual testing. 
 - Finding problems before customers do. 
 - Working closely with developers to build quality from the start. 
 - Using AI to improve engineering productivity. 
 - Learning new technologies rapidly. 
 - Taking ownership of product quality. 
 - Shipping software continuously. 
 - Solving challenging engineering problems. 

This Role Is Probably Not For You If

- You prefer manual testing over automation. 
 - You don't enjoy writing code. 
 - You need detailed test cases before getting started. 
 - You prefer maintaining existing scripts over building new automation. 
 - You're uncomfortable working in a fast-paced, product-first environment. 

What You'll Get

- Opportunity to redefine Quality Engineering with AI. 
 - Build automation-first testing practices from the ground up. 
 - Work directly with the founding engineering leadership. 
 - High ownership and technical influence. 
 - Exposure to AI, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and modern engineering practices. 
 - Fast learning and career growth. 
 - Competitive compensation and performance rewards. 

Location

- Gurgaon (Work from Office)

data.title: Salesforce Architect
data.description:
Salesforce Architect

Enterprise Architecture  |  Technical Leadership  |  Salesforce Platform  |  Multi-Cloud

Company- Kohler

Role Summary

The Salesforce Architect owns the end-to-end architecture, technical leadership, and governance of the Salesforce ecosystem - spanning Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service, Experience Cloud partner portals, Data cloud, Agentforce, MuleSoft integrations, SAP ERP connectivity, and digital platforms. Acting as platform custodian, this role drives scalability, security, performance, and adherence to enterprise architecture standards while remaining hands-on to guide and elevate development teams. 

  

Key Responsibilities

1. Platform Architecture

•            Define Salesforce architecture and roadmap across Sales, Service, Field Service, Partner Portal, data cloud and Agentforce. 

•            Design scalable, secure solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and Salesforce best practices. 

•            Guide teams on declarative vs. programmatic solution trade-offs. 

  

2. Hands-On Development & Technical Leadership

•            Develop and maintain Apex, LWC, and integrations as needed. 

•            Conduct code reviews; enforce coding standards, design patterns, and governor limit compliance. 

•            Guide teams on efficient Apex, SOQL, and reusable component design. 

  

3. Code Quality & Coverage Governance

•            Define and enforce unit testing standards, code coverage thresholds, and test automation practices. 

•            Review and approve critical code changes and architectural components. 

•            Implement static code analysis and automated quality tools. 

  

4. Platform Health & Optimization

•            Monitor API usage, governor limits, integration failures, batch jobs, and Apex errors. 

•            Establish performance monitoring dashboards and proactively resolve bottlenecks. 

•            Drive platform optimization and long-term sustainability initiatives. 

  

5. Integration Architecture

•            Design and govern API-led integrations with resilient error handling and retry mechanisms. 

•            Establish API standards, versioning strategies, and event-driven architecture patterns. 

  

6. Data Architecture & Governance

•            Design enterprise Salesforce data models with Salesforce-SAP alignment. 

•            Address large data volume (LDV) considerations and define strategies for data sync, quality, and lifecycle. 

  

7. DevOps & Release Governance

•            Architect CI/CD pipelines, release management, environment strategies, and automated testing. 

•            Experience with Copado or equivalent DevOps platforms preferred. 

  

8. Security & Compliance

•            Implement role hierarchy, permission models, field-level security, and data encryption. 

•            Ensure compliance with enterprise cybersecurity policies. 

  

Required Technical Skills

Salesforce Platform

Sales Cloud  |  Service Cloud  |  Field Service  |  Experience Cloud   |  Data Cloud |  Agentforce

  

Development

Apex  |  LWC  |  SOQL / SOSL  |  Platform Events  |  Batch Apex  |  Async Processing  |  Salesforce APIs

  

Integration

MuleSoft Anypoint  |  REST / SOAP APIs  |  Event-Driven Architecture  |  Enterprise Integration Patterns

  

Preferred Certifications

•            Salesforce Application Architect

•            Salesforce System Architect

•            Salesforce Integration Architecture Designer

•            Salesforce Data Architecture Designer

•            Salesforce Technical Architect (CTA) - highly desirable

  

Experience

•            10-15+ years of overall IT experience; 8-10+ years on the Salesforce platform. 

•            Proven delivery of large-scale, enterprise Salesforce implementations. 

•            Hands-on experience leading multi-cloud Salesforce environments and complex integrations. 

  

Key Competencies

✦  Hands-on technical leadership

✦  Enterprise architecture thinking

✦  Code quality governance

✦  Platform performance optimization

✦  Balancing vision with pragmatism

✦  Strong stakeholder communication

data.title: Development Team Lead
data.description:
Role Description

This role has been created to: 

- Serve to support the role requirements of senior developers in the Analyst Developer job family. 
 - Provide a launching pad for transition into more senior roles in the individual contributor and leadership job families. 
 - Support delivery obligations to customers and internal stakeholders. 

Specific Role Responsibilities

Analysis and Design

- Work with the analyst tester in the creation of user story definitions and acceptance criteria. Utilise your knowledge to ensure stories are constructed in a cohesive, logical way that aids smooth implementation and test. 
 - Work within the constraints of the feature/user story to define the underlying design required to deliver these changes
 - Ensure the solution is well defined and fit-for-purpose. It must meet the requirements and work end-to-end. This will require a solid understanding of the underlying business processes involved in and surrounding the change 
 - Provide solutions and recommendations for the resolution of technical issues that arise and ensure solutions meet the technical specs and design requirements
 - Help design and build APIs and external system interfaces for integration into core FNZ products and third-party vendor applications

Development

- Interpret complex financial business requirements and translate into high-transactional, high-availability, secure, working systems
 - Lend your expertise to advise and influence the design and implementation of highly intuitive user interface and interactive financial tools required by financial advisers and investors
 - Non-functional requirements: Consider non-functional requirements. We produce high-volume, real-time transaction processing systems that support millions of trades every day in investment securities in multiple world markets. You will work with other developers to make sure that solutions developed are secure, reusable, maintainable and performant. 
 - Collaborate with other developers to make sure that the solutions developed are robust and in-line with the requirements; 
 - Ensure code is designed and built in a reusable manner. 
 - Able to build high complexity features end-to-end
 - Establish yourself as an expert in multiple system/technical areas of the FNZ platform
 - Contribute to global non-client specific projects to advance key technical strategies across FNZ. 

Quality

- Adhere to the defined procedures for code management, code reviews, coding standards, naming conventions and security standards
 - Write automated unit tests for any newly created code
 - Perform manual testing to ensure any changes made to the system are of a high standard and the system hasn't regressed. 
 - Perform code reviews for developers on their own and different projects, inside the solution centre, to ensure that proposed changes meet quality and best practice standards. 
 - Able to design new core system functionality or completely redesign existing ones whilst maintaining quality. 

Collaboration and Communication

- Promote the development team both internally and externally. Ensure that creative solutions, tight code, tough problems solved are called out appropriately to the developer community, and where they lead to visible outcomes, to the broader FNZ teams and clients; and
 - Collaborate with other developers to share knowledge, best practices, useful technology, and opportunities for cross-project system design / solutions. 
 - Mentor new starters to ensure they understand both platform and SDLC. 
 - Provide solution centre-wide training, as required, on topics of personal expertise. 
 - Support the project lead developer and function as a squad lead if required. 

Technology

- Stay up to date with industry practices, new technologies, tools and methods. Proactive evaluate and provide recommendations to the business on technologies and tools which could be adopted. 
 - Take ownership of and resolve technical (environmental, coding and testing) issues that impede development progress. Assist in the resolution of technical issues when requested. 
 - Create novel solutions to problems by incorporating cutting edge technology or generic concepts. 

Functional Area Responsibilities

Analyst Developers at FNZ are all-rounders who can work across the full stack. This role involves working with complex business requirements in a wide range of functional areas in the financial services and platform domain. You are also responsible for collaborating with internal and client SMEs to deliver complex data mapping solutions for migrations: analyzing, designing and maintaining ETL workflows, resolving issues, testing and providing post-implementation support. 

You are in expert in multiple technical areas and make your mark as a business domain expert as well. This is evidenced in your delivery track record and your ability to execute your individual responsibilities and to provide your expertise and support to colleagues when needed. 

Analyst Developers own non-functional requirements and are responsible for ensuring that their code complies with coding standards, is secure and performs well. At entry-level, you are responsible for learning best-practice in these areas from your senior peers. 

Experience Required

Primary requirements

- First class bachelors degree or higher and/or equivalent experience. 
 - Experience of working on large scale technology delivery projects and successfully delivering technology change as part of these projects. 
 - Confident, and able to take a lead role in a delivery-focused environment. 
 - Experience of working with different levels of stakeholders within a project environment. 
 - Independent, self-directing working style. 
 - Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic fast-paced industry; . 
 - Enjoy working as part of a high-performance team. 
 - Hard-working, innovative and takes pride in their work. 
 - Passionate about creating innovative solutions for customers. 

Secondary Requirements

- Expert in Microsoft . NET development products, including . NET, C# and SQL Server. 
 - Expert in web development, including ASP. NET, JavaScript and ReactJS. 
 - Experience with the following legacy development products would be beneficial: ASP. NET MVC, VB. NET, legacy . NET Framework versions. 
 - Familiarity with financial products and markets. 
 - Understanding of web services. 
 - Familiar with code analysis or automated testing tools. 

About FNZ Culture

Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. Our ambition is to create a culture for growth, one that opens up limitless opportunities for our employees, customers and the wider world. At FNZ we know that great impact is only possible with great teamwork. 

That's why we value the strength and diversity of thought in our global team. 

The FNZ Way is the cornerstone of what we do. It is comprised of four values that set the standard for how everyone at FNZ interacts with each other, with our customers, and with all our diverse stakeholders around the world. 

- Customer obsessed for the long-term 
 - Think big and make an impact
 - Act now and own it all the way
 - Challenge, commit and win together

Read more about The FNZ Way and our values: www. fnz. com/culture

Opportunities

- Right from day one, you will work alongside exceptional, multicultural teams - experts in their respective fields - who will inspire and challenge you to make your greatest impact. 
 - Be part of a highly successful, rapidly growing, global business that is leading the delivery of financial services via cloud computing and partners with some of the world's largest companies; 
 - Working in a flexible and agile way that meets the needs of the business and personal circumstances; 
 - Remuneration, significant financial rewards and career advancement is based on individual contribution and business impact rather than tenure or seniority; 
 - We provide global career opportunities for our best employees at any of our offices in the UK, EU, US, Canada, South Africa and APAC. 

Commitment to Equal Opportunities

At FNZ, we recognise that diversity, equity and inclusion are important factors contributing to our success. We embrace the unique perspective and capabilities of our current and future employees, which will help us continue to drive innovation and achieve our business goals. Recruitment decisions at FNZ are made in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to gender, ethnicity/race, faith, age, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, socio-economic background, disability or military veteran status where all applicants and employees are valued and respected. 

In addition, we want to ensure accessibility needs are well supported, if you require specific support please advise us. 

About FNZ

FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back. 

We created wealth's growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution. 

We partner with the world's leading financial institutions, with over US$2. 5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP). 

Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.

data.title: VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring
data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members across UK and India
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - Over 2, 800 Tideans globally
 - Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide. 

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny. 

This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide. 

As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring You Will

- Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms
 - Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London
 - Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you
 - Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering
 - Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows
 - Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring
 - Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework
 - Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member
 - Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap
 - Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated

This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. Ongoing Monitoring is where we prove that trust scales, across every transaction we process. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment. 

What We Are Looking For

- Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain
 - Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation
 - Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development 
 - Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators
 - Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality
 - Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities
 - Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus

What You'll Get In Return

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

- Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options. 
 - Time Off - Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays. 
 - Parental Leave - Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey. 
 - Sabbatical - Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide. 
 - Health Insurance - Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options. 
 - Life & Accident Cover - Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection. 
 - Mental Wellbeing - Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops. 
 - Volunteering & Development Days - Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth. 
 - Learning & Development - Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more. 
 - WOO (Work Outside the Office) - Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually. 
 - Home Office Setup - Contribution towards setting up your home office. 
 - Laptop Ownership - Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement. 
 - Snacks & Meals - Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent). 

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.

data.title: Engineering Manager- AI & ML (Navi Mumbai)
data.description:
As an Engineering Manager, AI & ML (Data Collection), you will play a critical role in building

and scaling the company's Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform, enabling standardized, reliable, and scalable machine learning capabilities across the organization. 

This role will focus on transforming existing AI/ML and LLM-driven data systems into a cohesive platform that supports data pipelines, model lifecycle management, evaluation frameworks, and production deployment. 

This position requires deep technical expertise in machine learning systems, ML platform architecture, and MLOps, along with a strong ability to lead and mentor engineering teams. 

You will work closely with individual contributors and cross-functional partners to ensure that ML platform capabilities align with broader business objectives and AI/ML strategies. You will be deeply involved in the design, development, and operationalization of platform components, including data ingestion, feature management, model training and evaluation, and scalable inference systems. You will provide strong technical leadership, solve complex system-level challenges, and ensure delivery of high-quality, reliable, and scalable ML solutions. 

Your leadership will ensure that AI/ML systems are production-ready, observable, and maintainable, with a strong emphasis on performance, cost-efficiency, and governance. You will leverage your expertise in areas such as large language models (LLMs), retrieval augmented generation (RAG), ML Operations (MLOps), distributed systems, and cloud native architectures. You will oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of ML systems-from development and experimentation to deployment and monitoring-while ensuring alignment with global engineering standards and business priorities. 

You will be responsible for mentoring engineers, driving technical excellence, and fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation. Your ability to partner across teams, influence technical direction, and build high-performing teams will be critical to success in this role. 

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of ML engineers responsible for building and maintaining the Unified AI/ML Data Collection Platform. The team focuses on developing scalable systems that support data pipelines, model lifecycle management, LLM-based workflows, and evaluation frameworks, enabling downstream teams to build and deploy AI driven data collection solutions. 

Primary Job Responsibilities: 

• AI-Powered Data Collection Systems: Lead the design and development of scalable AI-driven data collection and enrichment workflows across structured and unstructured data sources. 

• LLM & Generative AI Workflows: Drive the implementation of LLM-based capabilities including extraction pipelines, RAG systems, prompt orchestration, summarization, classification, and automated validation workflows. 

• Data Pipeline Engineering: Oversee high-scale ingestion, transformation, and orchestration systems that support real-time and batch data collection processes. 

• Data Quality & Evaluation: Establish frameworks for evaluating extraction quality, model performance, hallucination risks, consistency, and overall data reliability. 

• Technical Leadership: Provide hands-on leadership in architecture, system design, operational scalability, and engineering best practices for AI-enabled data systems. 

• Team Leadership & Mentorship: Build and grow a high-performing engineering team while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with product management, data engineering, research, and business stakeholders to align technical investments with organizational goals. 

• Platform Reliability & Governance: Ensure systems meet standards for scalability, observability, security, compliance, and audit ability. 

• Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies, frameworks, and tooling to improve automation capabilities and developer productivity. 

• Operational Excellence: Drive engineering best practices, Agile delivery processes, and operational maturity across the team. 

• Hiring & Talent Development: Support recruiting, onboarding, and retention efforts while cultivating an inclusive and high-performing team environment. 

• Company Leadership: Model company values and contribute to a culture of innovation, accountability, and collaboration. 

Skills and Qualifications: 

• Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field. 

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on machine learning systems, ML platforms, or distributed systems. 

• 3+ years of experience managing engineering teams and leading technical initiatives. 

• Strong experience building production-grade ML systems, including model deployment and lifecycle management. 

• Hands-on experience with MLOps tools and practices, including CI/CD, model monitoring, and experiment tracking (e. g. , MLflow, W&B). 

• Experience with pipeline orchestration and data platforms (e. g. , Airflow, Dagster, Kafka, Snowflake). 

• Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, or similar

languages. 

• Experience with cloud platforms and containerization (e. g. , AWS/

GCP/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes). 

• Experience with LLM-based systems in production, including RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector databases. 

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and system design tradeoffs. 

• Proven ability to solve complex technical challenges and deliver scalable solutions. 

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across global teams. 

• Experience working in fast-paced, data-driven environments. 

Working

Conditions

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phones on an ongoing basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer II - AI
data.description:
The Opportunity

This is more than a full-stack role - it's your chance to build the AI layer of the platform the world's infrastructure runs on. Sitetracker is building Scout, our AI product line: production LLM systems and agentic workflows embedded in the software companies like Cox, Telefónica, and EVgo use to deploy critical infrastructure. As a Product Engineer, you'll take AI capabilities from idea to production agent orchestration and model integration on the backend, and the web and mobile experiences that put them in customers' hands. 

This is shipping real, customer-facing AI , not prototypes or research demos. You'll own features end-to-end, work with frontier models (Anthropic, OpenAI), and see your work land in the hands of enterprise users deploying telecom networks, EV chargers, and renewable energy around the world. 

What You'll do: 

As a Product Engineer on Scout, you'll hit the ground running and ship customer-facing AI from day one. You'll design, build, test, deploy, and monitor AI product features end-to-end , building agentic LLM systems with multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering over frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI. 

You'll work across the full stack: backend services in Python, Java, Node. js, or Go, and TypeScript/React frontends spanning both web and mobile app experiences. You'll make AI dependable by building automated evaluation pipelines, guardrails, and testing strategies for non-deterministic outputs - and running it on production infrastructure: scalable, fault-tolerant services on AWS and Kubernetes. 

You'll think like a product engineer, not a ticket-taker: dig into user needs, absorb the problem space, make smart calls about what to build, keep stakeholders informed, and find ways to unblock yourself. 

The Skills You'll Have: 

Full-Stack Product Engineering

- Build production backend services in one or more of Python (FastAPI or similar), Java, Node. js, or Go
 - Ship production web interfaces in TypeScript and React; mobile app development (React Native or similar) is a plus
 - Design REST APIs and data models across relational and NoSQL databases
 - Own features end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring

AI / LLM Engineering

- Build with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI): agentic workflows, tool/function calling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering. Production experience preferred; substantial personal or open-source projects considered
 - Write evaluation pipelines and testing strategies for non-deterministic AI outputs
 - Bonus: agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI), Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLMOps tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse), vector databases, or model serving (vLLM, GPU inference)

Production Systems & AI Infrastructure

- Deploy and operate services on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD (Scout runs on AWS)
 - Instrument systems with observability and handle customer data securely in AI systems
 - Design fault-tolerant, scalable services that serve AI workloads reliably
 - Salesforce platform and Apex - Scout integrates with the Sitetracker Salesforce platform

Product Thinking & Communication

- Dig into user needs and use that context to decide what to build and how
 - Explain technical decisions and AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
 - Break challenges into iterative solutions, keep stakeholders informed, and unblock myself

Within 90 Days, You'll: 

- Ramp up on Scout's architecture, codebase, and AI tooling
 - Ship your first AI-driven product features with support from senior engineers
 - Build a working knowledge of our evaluation pipelines and deployment workflow on AWS

Within 180 Days, You'll: 

- Independently deliver AI product features end-to-end, with increasing complexity
 - Contribute to design discussions and team best practices for secure, scalable AI development
 - Own the quality of your features in production: monitoring, evals, and iteration

Within 365 Days, You'll: 

- Consistently deliver well-crafted, end-to-end AI product capabilities that increase velocity and throughput
 - Elevate team quality through strong technical work, thoughtful code reviews, and knowledge sharing
 - Serve as a go-to contributor for agentic systems on Scout

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
