data.description:
Avensys is a reputed global IT professional services company headquartered in Singapore. Our service spectrum includes enterprise solution consulting, business intelligence, business process automation and managed services. Given our decade of success we have evolved to become one of the top trusted providers in Singapore and service a client base across banking and financial services, insurance, information technology, healthcare, retail, and supply chain. 

We are currently looking to hire Backend Test Engineer. This is an exciting opportunity to expand your skill set, achieve job satisfaction and work-life balance. 

Responsibilities

- Design, write, and maintain automated tests in Python for new and existing features of the operating system components of the Robot
 - Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests to ensure stable and reliable releases
 - Work closely with developers to understand the changes being made in the controller operating system layer or the network layer, investigate failures, and improve testability
 - Contribute to and improve test frameworks
 - Help define eKective test strategies and quality practices across the development lifecycle in an agile setup
 - Build tests that have hardware in the loop (not all flakiness comes from software)

Qualification, Experience, Skills and Educational Background

- To succeed in this role, we imagine you have a strong background in software test engineering and a practical mindset when it comes to combining automation with hands on validation. You understand how software is built, how systems fail, and how to create eKective tests that increase quality and confidence. 

Skills Required

- 4 to 6 years of experience in software backend testing, software quality engineering of OS level software components, or a similar role
 - Strong experience writing and maintaining automated tests in Python for backend components using tools like pytest and FastAPI. 
 - Experience with Penetration testing
 - Experience with API Testing
 - Familiarity with GoLang and its frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with Containerization technique (Docker, Podman)
 - Proficient with linux environment and linux commands
 - Linux networking stack + systemd (services, journald, network namespaces)
 - Network analysis tooling: Wireshark/tcpdump and nmap and traffic shaping for resilience tests. 
 - Hands-on experience with manual testing of complex systems, ideally involving hardware, robotics, or integrated software-hardware solutions
 - Experience creating and maintaining unit, integration, and regression tests
 - Good understanding of test frameworks, debugging, and finding root causes
 - Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, build servers, or DevOps practices such as Jenkins or similar tools
 - Ability to understand complex systems, identify risks, and design eKective test coverage

It will be considered an advantage if you have: 

- Familiarity with ROS2, Industrial Communication Protocols
 - Familiarity with Firewall (NF Tables/IP Tables)

 - Hardware-in-the-loop test frameworks such as labgrid, bench hardware, networked power for automated power-cycling, serial console capture, etc. 
 - Automating through the robot's own interfaces (Dashboard Server, RTDE, the primary/secondary/real-time client ports, URScript)
 - Strong knowledge of DevOps practices, pipelines, and build servers

data.title: Technical Lead-Test Automation
data.description:
What We Are Looking For

We are looking for an experienced Test Automation Engineer to lead the planning, design, execution, and delivery of test automation & inspection automation projects implemented across Dover factories worldwide. 

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving project execution and technical integrity of test automation solutions delivered by global test automation suppliers with focus on Indian automation suppliers. This includes defining test strategies and excellence playbook, overseeing execution, and ensuring alignment with global quality, safety, and compliance standards. Your leadership will be key to delivering cost-effective and deployment-ready solutions that support Dover's advanced manufacturing goals worldwide. 

What You Will Be Responsible For In This Role

- Collaborate with global teams to align project objectives and test protocols. 
 - Engage with Dover factories across APAC, NA and EMEA regions to understand expectations and ensure test strategies and execution plans are aligned with global manufacturing and deployment requirements. 
 - Lead the planning, definition, and delivery of functional test automation. 
 - Provide technical leadership and project ownership from concept to production deployment for end-of-line testers, leak testers, hydraulic benches, electrical safety rigs, and inspection systems. 
 - Coordinating, preparing, reviewing Statement of Work (SOW) with Global Dover Automation teams. 
 - Schedule meetings onsite, offsite, conferences with dover factories & supplier. 
 - Manage Project plannings, timeline, status, reports, timelines, prepare proposals, projects trackers, etc. 
 - Lead the planning, definition, and delivery of Inspection automation programs. 
 - Provide technical leadership and project ownership from concept to production deployment Inspection systems (Vision, laser, ultrasonic, etc. ) for quality & improvements. 
 - Plan and supervise PoC evaluations for new functional testing approaches. 
 - Oversee the development and field trials of prototype test benches for validating new processes such as digital leak testing, high-pressure validation, electrical failure simulation, or sensor-based measurements. 
 - Oversee the execution of validation and testing for hydraulic, pneumatic, electric, and mechanical systems. 
 - Ensure robust test planning and execution for systems involving pressure decay, burst testing, flow verification, electrical continuity, insulation resistance, and force/displacement measurements. 
 - Identify, develop, and manage automation solution partners for building functional test equipment. 
 - Evaluate and coordinate with vendors specializing in fluid power, electrical panels, test rig fabrication, control systems, and metrology tools-ensuring reliable, safe, and cost-effective solutions. 
 - Review and approve supplier-developed test concepts, quotes, protocols and validation methods. 
 - Assess the adequacy of testing parameters such as test pressure, flow rates, leak limits, electrical load conditions, calibration tolerances, and functional checkpoints based on part requirements and industry benchmarks. 
 - Review the supplier concepts, quotes, prepare Proposals for Dover factories, coordinate with multiple departments for budget reviews & capex controls. 
 - Validate technical proposals, rig designs, control strategies, and sensor integrations. 
 - Conduct engineering reviews of hydraulic and pneumatic circuit layouts, electrical cabinet schematics, DAQ/PLC logic, sensor placements (pressure, flow, current, displacement), and interface controls (HMI/SCADA). 
 - Conduct Proof of Concepts (PoC), Design of Experiments (DoE). 
 - Perform Risk analysis, report preparing, risk mitigation solutions. 
 - Coordinate FAT/SAT of functional test systems with suppliers and Dover factories. 
 - Lead detailed Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) at supplier facilities to verify functionality, safety, electrical compliance, hydraulic/pneumatic integrity, and adherence to cycle time and accuracy benchmarks prior to shipment. 
 - Define FAT checklist covering PLC/DAQ program logic validation, calibration certification, emergency stop functionality, interlock testing, leak and pressure test accuracy, HMI sequences, and GR&R results. 
 - Plan and execute Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) at Dover facilities, ensuring integration with factory utilities, compliance with ergonomic and floor layout constraints, and final verification of performance repeatability in production conditions. 
 - Document all FAT/SAT observations with pass/fail criteria, deviation logs, and corrective actions; involve cross-functional sign-off with engineering, safety, and plant quality teams before system handover. 
 - Ensure test systems meet operational, safety, and compliance requirements. 
 - Deliver solutions that meet critical-to-quality metrics such as pressure stability, leak thresholds, electrical insulation performance, cycle time targets, and traceability. 
 - Ensure adherence to safety and compliance standards (e. g. , CE, ISO 4413/4414, IEC 61010, UL, etc. ). 
 - Monitor compliance throughout the test system lifecycle, including mechanical, fluid power, and electrical safety regulations applicable to industrial testing environments. 
 - Coordinate automation, controls, and data acquisition for functional test equipment. 
 - Ensure robust integration of PLCs, HMIs, industrial PCs, safety relays, and DAQ systems with measurement instrumentation like pressure sensors, flow meters, load cells, CMMs, and voltage/current transducers. 
 - Drive the strategy for data connectivity, SCADA integration, and test traceability. 
 - Define architecture for test result logging, real-time monitoring, and linkage with MES systems to ensure complete digital traceability and analytics-ready test data. 
 - Promote the use of structured validation tools such as PFMEA, control plans, and RCA. 
 - Ensure proactive risk mitigation and fast issue resolution through systematic analysis tools during design, validation, and production handover stages. 
 - Ensure traceable documentation of test results, deviations, and compliance logs. 
 - Maintain structured reporting for each system including pass/fail data, leak rate charts, pressure curves, electrical test logs, deviation records, and root-cause tracking. 
 - Lead continuous improvement efforts in test strategy and partner capabilities. 
 - Benchmark functional test performance, cycle times, cost of testing, and uptime-driving improvements in supplier offerings and in-house standards. 
 - Support knowledge transfer and capability building across sites
 - Enable cross-functional learning by sharing best practices in functional test rig design, performance tuning, maintenance practices, and fault diagnosis. 
 - Schedule webinars, share case studies, introduce dover factories to new & proven industry solutions. 
What are the basic qualifications?

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, mechanical engineering, mechatronics engineering, manufacturing engineering, industrial technology or equivalent mix of education and experience Test automation coordination or project management experience in manufacturing system testing. 
 - Minimum seven (7) years of production, operation and manufacturing support. 
 - Minimum five (5) experience in testing or validating through robotic systems, vision inspection solutions, or automated machines. 
 - Minimum five (5) years of hands-on experience in testing e. g. Mechanical Testing, functional testing, Hydraulics, Leak, Pneumatic, electric test, inspections, measurements, Pressure, etc. 

What are the preferred qualifications?

- Familiarity with industrial testing like leak, pressure, EOL, endurance, scanning, measurements, etc. etc. and vision-based inspection testing methodologies. 
 - Solid understanding of mechanical devices and automation hardware, including sensors, indexers, pick-and-place mechanisms, PLCs, inverters, and servo systems. 
 - Hands-on technical experience in testing with robotic and Cobot systems, including validation of motion sequences, safety, and repeatability. 
 - Experience conducting and executing FAT/SAT activities and validating automation systems from outsourced vendors. 
 - Exposure to controls validation, test script development, and failure analysis within factory automation environments. 
 - Working knowledge of MES, SCADA, and data acquisition systems used in automated test environments
 - Proficiency in interpreting electrical schematics and mechanical drawings; familiarity with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or EPLAN
 - Experience with test simulation tools (e. g. , FlexSim, RoboDK, Visual Components, Factory Flow, etc. ) is a plus
 - Understanding of industrial safety standards (e. g. , ISO, CE, UL) and commitment to enforcing safety protocols during test & validation
 - Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to work independently on test development, issue resolution, and documentation
 - Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills to interact with other departments. 
 - Effective cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, working with global engineering, quality, and operations teams
 - Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
 - Exposure to Lean principles, Kaizen, or Six Sigma tools for process improvement in testing and validation
 - Proactive, self-driven, and focused on continuous learning, quality enhancement, and technical excellence
 - Ability to multi-task and perform in a dynamic environment. 
 - Strong sense of urgency, accountability and highly objective oriented
 - Highly organized and efficient in approaching tasks, a self-starter with the ability to solve problems proactively. 
 - Impeccable organization and efficiency skills; strong attention to detail
 - Clear, concise, and articulate communication skills - verbal, written and listening. 

To Be a Great Fit For The Role

- Strong project coordination or management background, with a proven track record of delivering automation and testing systems from ideation to production handover. 
 - Demonstrate hands-on experience in testing and validating industrial automation systems, with a strong focus on robotics, precision mechanisms, control systems, and vision-based inspection. 
 - Prove detail-oriented, structured approach to test planning and execution, ensuring reliable performance, compliance with global standards, and smooth handover to production. 
 - Proven ability to develop and execute test strategies across the project lifecycle - from requirements review and design verification to FAT/SAT, root-cause analysis, and quality assurance. 
 - Able to collaborate cross-functionally with team, solution partners, internal stakeholders, and global engineering teams to ensure test objectives are met effectively and consistently. 
 - Show strong analytical and diagnostic skills to investigate system performance, identify failures, and implement corrective actions that are technically sound and scalable. 
 - You are an effective communicator who can articulate test results, risks, and recommendations to engineering leadership, project teams, and vendor partners. 
 - Demonstrate experience in contributing to successful automation deployments, where rigorous testing improved product quality, machine uptime, operational safety, and production efficiency. 
 - You are passionate about building testing excellence - contributing to test documentation, standardization, and knowledge transfer through structured training and mentoring. 
 - Show deep understanding of industrial safety, quality, and compliance standards, and ensure every validation process adheres to them strictly. 
 - Familiarity with APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, and test-oriented process development frameworks, with the ability to contribute meaningfully to integrated product quality initiatives. 
 - Able to manage multiple test workstreams across projects while staying organized, focused, and responsive in dynamic, time-bound environments. 
 - Possess a strong work ethic, continuous improvement mindset, and a proactive, solution-driven approach to ensuring the highest standards in automation testing.

Bench High-Speed Interface Validation Engineer

- Location: Coimbatore, Bengaluru, India
 - Work Mode: Onsite

Role Overview

We are looking for a Bench High-Speed Interface Validation Engineer with hands-on experience in silicon validation, characterization, and high-speed interface testing. The role involves developing validation platforms, performing first silicon bring-up, board-level debugging, protocol compliance testing, and automation for next-generation semiconductor devices. The engineer will work closely with Design, Signal Integrity, PCB, Firmware, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams throughout the product development lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, integrate, and debug bench validation setups for high-speed semiconductor interface devices.

data.title: Avionics System V&V (ARP4754A Aerospace)
data.description:
We are hiring!

Aerospace System Testing Engineer

Location: Bangalore, Karnataka (onsite)

Experience: 6+ Years Are you passionate about aviation safety and mission-critical systems?

Qubist Solutions is expanding our engineering team, and we are looking for a rigorous and detail-oriented Aerospace System Testing Engineer. In this role, you will bridge system design, software, and hardware to ensure our airborne products meet the highest levels of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance. 

What You Will Do: 

- Design, develop, and execute system-level test plans and procedures for complex avionics architectures. 
 - Ensure bi-directional requirements traceability from aircraft-level safety objectives down to implementation artifacts. 
 - Configure and manage Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), System Integration Labs (SIL), and automated test environments. 
 - Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve defects and root-cause anomalies during integration. 
 - Generate objective evidence and traceability matrices to support SOI (Stage of Involvement) audits and FAA/EASA certification. 

The Standards You Will Drive: 

You will directly apply the core ecosystem of aerospace certification guidelines to our testing lifecycle: 

- ARP4754A: Validating system architectures and requirement allocations. 
 - ARP4761: Utilizing FHA, PSSA, and SSA outputs to drive safety-critical failure-mode testing. 
 - DO-178C: Executing high-level/system-level software integration tests. 
 - DO-254: Verifying complex electronic hardware behavior at the system and LRU levels. 
 - DO-330: Defining Tool Operational Requirements and validating automated verification toolchains. 
 - DO-356A: Testing system vulnerabilities and verifying airworthiness cybersecurity architectures. 

What You Bring to the Table: 

- Bachelor's or Master's in Aerospace, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or related fields. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on avionics testing and integration experience in a certified program. 
 - Proficiency in Requirements Management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion). 
 - Experience with test automation scripting (Python, C/C++) and aviation data buses (ARINC 429, AFDX, MIL-STD-1553B). 
 - A proven track record of generating certification artifacts for regulatory audits. 

How to Apply: 

Ready to build the future of flight? Click "Apply" on this post or send your resume directly to communications@qubistsolutions. com with the subject line "Aerospace Testing Engineer - [Your Name]". 

#Hiring #Aerospace #Avionics #SystemsEngineering #DO178C #DO254 #ARP4754A #ARP4761 #DO330 #DO356

Surya at a Glance

Surya was founded in 1999 by Mr. D. N. Prahlad (an early employee of Infosys), to create software products. Headquartered in Bangalore, we also have offices in the USA, and France. 

Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for Financial Control & Risk Management (Balance sheet management, Regulatory & Compliance & Other Risk areas) of banks and financial services industry. We provide web based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. 

We help more than 75 banks, hedge funds and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in USA and France. 

Surya is an equal opportunity employer. 

Why Surya

Suryaʼs business and prime focus is software engineering. At Surya, you will be expected to work hard and smart. We are a meritocracy, implying your career depends only on your merit. We have people amongst us who are experts in the field but adapt quickly to changes. Surya looks for entrepreneurial spirit and indeed makes employees shareholders of Surya. All this makes Surya a fun place to be. 

What We're Looking For

- An unwavering attention to detail and care towards your work. Suryans double-check PRs they submit for review. Each variable name is thought through in detail; attention is paid towards how decisions made today will affect the future. 
 - An absolute commitment towards doing the best work of your life, while helping others to do the same. We deliver with utmost focus on the job at hand. The team works towards crafting the best products for our users, and customers. Working as a team, Suryans go above and beyond when it results in a better end product. 
 - You should be comfortable working in an agile environment. You are also expected to participate in code reviews - both receiving and offering them as needed. You are needed to communicate flexibly with your team pitching in on designs, features and ideas for the product, wherever needed. 
 - You should be open to receiving and providing constructive feedback, with a relentless pursuit of constant improvement. 

What You Will Work On

The specific project you work on is decided based on the list of available projects at the time. While what you work on will change over time, we assure you that youʼll work with people who care deeply about their work and deliver with great attention to detail. 

Your Growth at Surya

Suryaʼs growth is driven by ordinary people who have extraordinary dreams and are bold enough to pursue them. Our leadership team, including our Managing Director, is composed primarily of people who joined Surya as freshers. Through our process of continuous feedback, and regular 1-1 conversations, we believe in upskilling our team, and enabling each of them to grow along paths they find satisfying.

data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Manager, Data Engineering based in India. 

This is a senior technical leadership opportunity focused on building high-performing data engineering and machine learning teams in a fast-moving SaaS environment. 

You will lead teams responsible for scalable data pipelines, production ML systems, analytics infrastructure, and data-driven product capabilities. 

The role combines people leadership with hands-on technical oversight, architecture, engineering standards, and product strategy. 

You will work closely with Finance, Sales, Operations, Product, Platform, Security, and senior engineering stakeholders to turn complex data into measurable business outcomes. 

A major focus will be building reliable, governed, production-ready systems that support executive reporting, machine learning, and evolving product and threat requirements. 

You will also shape engineering culture through hiring, mentoring, continuous improvement, and the adoption of modern AI-assisted development practices. 

This role is ideal for a technically strong leader who enjoys going deep on architecture while developing diverse, high-performing teams across a remote-first environment. 

Accountabilities

- Lead and guide engineering teams across data engineering, enterprise data applications, and machine learning, providing technical direction, delivery oversight, and people leadership. 
 - Build and operationalize end-to-end data pipeline architecture, including ingestion and transformation layers that move CRM and ERP data into centralized platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks. 
 - Partner with Finance, Sales, and Operations to develop unified reporting models covering pipeline health, recurring revenue, billing, churn, and customer lifetime value. 
 - Establish and enforce data governance and analytics engineering standards, including version control, automated testing, modular data modeling, and reliable single-source-of-truth practices. 
 - Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior and executive stakeholders, translating complex financial, operational, and technical metrics into clear business insights supported by reliable data. 
 - Collaborate with Staff and Principal Engineers to influence architecture, define engineering best practices, improve product quality, and deliver scalable features. 
 - Provide technical leadership across ML engineering and data science initiatives, ensuring models move from experimentation into reliable production systems rather than remaining one-off analyses. 
 - Set standards for feature engineering, model training, evaluation, serving, monitoring, rollback, and feedback loops that maintain model performance as product and threat patterns evolve. 
 - Partner with Product, Platform, and Security teams to translate identity, device, and telemetry signals into measurable outcomes such as precision, false-positive rates, and time-to-detect. 
 - Establish appropriate SLAs, monitoring, on-call practices, and operational processes for data and model health. 
 - Hire, onboard, coach, mentor, and manage a growing team, while supporting performance development and career progression across multiple levels of individual contributors. 
 - Lead teams effectively in a geographically distributed, remote-first environment and contribute to building a collaborative, high-performing engineering organization. 
 - Drive continuous improvement through innovation, process development, delivery excellence, reliability, and quality initiatives. 
 - Encourage effective use of AI coding agents and productivity tools to improve engineering workflows and maximize team effectiveness. 

Requirements

- 8+ years of experience in applied machine learning, including several years of people management and experience operating production MLOps environments with versioned training pipelines, evaluation gates, model registries, and automated promotion to serving. 
 - Proven experience managing teams of 8 or more engineers or technical professionals, including performance management, hiring, mentoring, and building high-performing teams. 
 - Strong experience with data and analytics technologies such as Salesforce, NetSuite, dbt, Fivetran, Snowflake, and Databricks. 
 - Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of software engineering principles, architecture, reliability, and production operations. 
 - Hands-on fluency in Python and experience with machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow, alongside large-scale data platforms such as Spark, Snowflake, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience leading ML engineers and data scientists who deploy models into production and manage the complete lifecycle from feature engineering through monitoring and feedback. 
 - Strong understanding of statistical and machine learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, classification, ranking/scoring, model evaluation, and imbalanced datasets. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of SaaS products or platforms, with a strong focus on reliability, operational excellence, and sustainable engineering practices. 
 - Experience working with agile teams and collaborating effectively with engineering managers, technical specialists, and non-technical business stakeholders. 
 - Proven ability to lead geographically distributed teams and operate successfully in a remote-first environment. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, coaching, and organizational skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving and collaborative environment. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or Copilot, as well as productivity tools such as Gemini or NotebookLM, and the ability to apply them effectively to day-to-day work. 
 - Fluency in written and spoken English is required. 
 - Candidates must be located in and authorized to work in India. 

Benefits

- Competitive senior-level compensation aligned with experience and market expectations in India. 
 - Fully remote work within India as part of a remote-first working environment. 
 - Opportunity to lead and grow high-performing, geographically distributed engineering teams. 
 - Significant influence over engineering practices, architecture, product strategy, and execution. 
 - Opportunity to work on complex data, machine learning, identity, device, and telemetry systems at scale. 
 - Strong exposure to senior leadership and cross-functional collaboration across Product, Platform, Security, Finance, Sales, and Operations. 
 - Career growth opportunities through technical leadership, people management, and organizational impact. 
 - Collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, diverse perspectives, and strong human connections. 
 - Opportunity to incorporate modern AI tools into engineering and productivity workflows. 
 - Participation in engineering on-call rotations as part of maintaining reliable production systems.

This role leads quality engineering and AI testing initiatives for reliable, scalable, and secure cloud-based software solutions. 

You will design advanced testing strategies for backend services, APIs, AI-powered features, and microservices architectures. 

A key focus will be validating large language model behavior, agentic AI workflows, security risks, and non-deterministic outputs.

data.title: Research / Senior Research Manager, Weather Data Systems (Weather Initiative)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Research / Senior Research Manager, Weather Data Systems (Weather Initiative) based in India. 

This role offers the opportunity to build and scale evidence-based weather data systems designed to support smallholder farmers. 

You will help transform real-time scientific forecasts into timely, location-specific guidance that can reach farmers through multiple channels. 

Working across research, technology, program, and dissemination teams, you will connect technical systems with practical field needs. 

The role combines research management, data engineering, system design, quality assurance, and stakeholder engagement. 

You will focus on creating reliable, adaptable infrastructure that can be replicated across geographies and use cases. 

This is a high-impact opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building scalable systems, and turning technical insights into actionable outcomes. 

The position may be offered at either Research Manager or Senior Research Manager level, depending on experience, seniority, and scope of previous responsibilities. 

Accountabilities

- Work with forecast science, technology, and dissemination teams to design and oversee pipelines that automatically transform real-time scientific forecast data into location-specific farmer messages. 
 - Develop adaptable systems that can integrate with different dissemination vendors and channels, including voice, SMS, WhatsApp, applications, LLM-powered advisory systems, or combinations of these. 
 - Ensure time-sensitive forecast information reaches farmers quickly and accurately by reducing processing delays, data transformation latency, and other potential points of failure. 
 - Own the technical and operational requirements needed to make weather data pipelines replicable across geographies rather than tailored to a single location or use case. 
 - Bridge technical and non-technical teams by translating forecast science and system constraints into practical requirements for research and program teams, and communicating program needs back to technical stakeholders. 
 - Oversee data management, quality assurance, testing, and technical rigor as the system expands into new applications and geographies. 
 - Document system architecture, decision logic, processes, and design rationale so that the infrastructure remains maintainable, auditable, and extensible. 
 - Coordinate with dissemination teams to ensure automated farmer messages align with standards established through field research. 
 - Provide technical and data-quality guidance to Associate- and Manager-level colleagues supporting the weather data pipeline. 
 - Contribute to funding proposals, technical reports, organizational knowledge management, and broader learning related to weather data systems. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's or advanced degree in a technical, quantitative, or data-focused discipline such as computer science, data science, engineering, statistics, economics, agricultural economics, or a related field. 
 - Experience building, managing, or overseeing data pipelines, ideally involving real-time, automated, or continuously processed data. 
 - Working knowledge of technical tools and programming languages used to build and maintain data systems, such as Python, SQL, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience designing systems intended to be replicated, scaled, or adapted across multiple contexts rather than developed as one-off solutions. 
 - Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical functions, translating between forecast science, engineering considerations, research requirements, and program priorities. 
 - Strong research management, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to take ownership and operate proactively in a fast-growing environment. 
 - Excellent documentation skills and the ability to make technical systems understandable and usable for people who were not involved in building them. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Existing authorization to work in India is required; visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary based on skills, experience, seniority, and the local labor market in India. 
 - Full-time, fully remote position based in India. 
 - Opportunity to work on a high-impact weather initiative supporting smallholder farmers at significant scale. 
 - Exposure to research, technology, program implementation, data systems, and government-facing work. 
 - Opportunity to build scalable infrastructure and contribute to systems designed for replication across geographies. 
 - Flexible working arrangements designed to support employee wellbeing. 
 - Potential to grow into broader research, technical, and leadership responsibilities based on experience and performance.

data.title: Director of Software Architecture
data.description:
Would you like to join a team working across the software technology components used by hundreds of millions of users across multiple platforms and market segments globally? As a Software Architect in the Software Organisation, you will work with our key software ecosystems to define software solutions to enable Arm technology and develop strategies to have those solutions adopted and enabled for users. 

Our Central Engineering Software group delivers support for Arm technologies across a wide variety of software projects and creates example software solutions to demonstrate real world applications. You will join a team of software solution architects addressing the growing demand for software to support Arm systems. 

The position will be based at Arm offices in Cambridge, Budapest, or Bangalore. 

Job Overview

As a member of a large software engineering team you will help evolve our software strategy across all computing segments, including data centre, automotive, mobile, robotics, networking, home, laptops, TVs, embedded and IoT. You will drive adoption of new features and trends in core processing, accelerators, and system hardware, focusing on improved security, reliability, and performance. 

Responsibilities

- Understanding new Arm architecture and IP features, their implementation and what that means for existing software components and tools. Devising how to promote their benefits to software ecosystems and resolve issues that arise in their adoption. 
 - Analysis and deep understanding of software solutions currently deployed in products, in particular the major open-source software projects such as Linux. 
 - Delivering software improvements back to the relevant open-source projects as a reference for Arm customers to create their own systems from. 
 - Working with Arm's OS, OEM and Silicon Partners to drive standards that enable the optimisation, differentiation, and fast evolution benefits of Arm's Partner model 
 - Building new software paradigms onto Arm reference hardware designs 
 - Profiling the performance of the system and innovating ways to improve 
 - Leading validation of the functionality, security and safety 
 - You can expect to be working closely with some of the greatest household names in our industry to help develop, optimize, and deliver the software needed to support Arm's pioneering IP, as well as helping Arm grow its role in new market segments. 

Required Skills And Experience

- Knowledge of Arm based computer Architecture and the range of SoCs and devices that are created using Arm hardware IP. 
 - Experience of software profiling, instrumentation, and optimization for real world applications and workloads such as AI stacks, run-time compilers and multimedia processing. 
 - Strong understanding of complex multi-component computing systems with demonstrable low-level OS/device driver development or integration experience 
 - Authoritative knowledge of C or C++ development with proficiency with optimizing applications, workloads, and compilers 
 - Understanding of how to rigorously test software and design software for test 
 - Experience of the software lifecycle: has taken complex software from concept to production and maintenance

Skills

"Nice To Have" Skills and Experience : 

- Experience with Android, ChromeOS or Windows software and systems 
 - Experience with Linux, Linux distributions, Cloud/Edge applications and networking software 
 - Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence software stacks, algorithms and tooling 
 - Knowledge of multimedia system designs involving GPUs, compositing display processors and image signal processing 
 - Familiarity with System-on-a-Chip architectures

In Return

Our UK offices are outstanding places to collaborate. If you are interested but unsure whether you tick all the boxes, we still would love you to reach out! We are keen to welcome versatile people into Arm!

Please note that no relocation package is available for this role. 

If skilled worker sponsorship is required, Arm will meet costs associated with sponsorship for the employer only. All fees associated with the individual's application e. g. visa application fee and Immigration Health Surcharge, will be the responsibility of the successful candidate. 

Accommodations at Arm

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working at Arm

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities at Arm

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Vantive is a vital organ therapy company dedicated to extending lives and expanding possibilities for patients and care teams around the world. Within Global Shared Services / Finance, the Master Data Management (MDM) organization is responsible for delivering high-quality, governed master data that enables the business to operate effectively across global markets and functions. 

Position Summary

The Senior Business Analyst, Master Data Management Operations is responsible for the day-to-day execution and delivery of MDM operational services across multiple master data domains. This role serves as a front-line operational resource, supporting business users, investigating and resolving data-related incidents, fulfilling work requests, maintaining data quality, and ensuring service commitments are met. 

The successful candidate will partner closely with business stakeholders, data stewards, MDM operations teams, IT support teams, and external partners to ensure timely and accurate execution of master data processes. The role requires strong analytical skills, problem-solving capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently to identify and resolve issues. 

This position is ideal for a hands-on MDM professional who enjoys operational execution, customer support, troubleshooting, process improvement, and managing data within a complex global environment. 

What You'll Be Doing

MDM Operational Service Delivery

- Execute day-to-day master data operations activities across Item, Supplier, Finance, Customer, and other supported master data domains. 
 - Service work orders, requests, and transactions in accordance with established service level agreements (SLAs), operational procedures, and data governance standards. 
 - Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents within defined SLAs while ensuring minimal disruption to business operations. 
 - Analyze and resolve master data issues independently, escalating only when necessary and providing clear documentation of findings and corrective actions. 
 - Perform root cause analysis on recurring issues and partner with stakeholders to implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Monitor work queues, backlog volumes, and service levels to ensure timely completion of requests and adherence to operational targets. 

Data Quality & Governance

- Execute data validation, cleansing, enrichment, and maintenance activities to support master data accuracy, consistency, and completeness. 
 - Ensure compliance with established master data standards, business rules, governance policies, and control requirements. 
 - Identify data quality issues, exceptions, and process breakdowns and partner with data stewards to drive resolution. 
 - Support execution of data quality monitoring and remediation activities across assigned master data domains. 
 - Participate in audits, compliance reviews, and control activities as required. 

Business Support & Stakeholder Engagement

- Serve as a primary point of contact for business users requiring support related to master data processes, requests, incidents, and inquiries. 
 - Partner with stakeholders across Finance, Supply Chain, Commercial, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Shared Services to understand issues and deliver effective solutions. 
 - Communicate issue status, resolution plans, and service updates in a professional and customer-focused manner. 
 - Support business process changes, organizational initiatives, and operational improvements impacting master data management processes. 

Continuous Improvement & Analytics

- Identify opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, improve cycle times, and enhance service delivery performance. 
 - Support development and maintenance of operational KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting. 
 - Utilize data and operational metrics to identify trends, recurring issues, capacity constraints, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Assist with testing, validation, training, and deployment activities associated with MDM enhancements and projects. 
 - Maintain and update standard operating procedures, work instructions, process documentation, and knowledge management materials. 

Project Support

- Participate in MDM projects, system enhancements, process improvement initiatives, and data migration activities. 
 - Execute assigned project tasks including testing, data validation, business process documentation, issue tracking, and deployment support. 
 - Collaborate with business and technical teams to ensure successful implementation of solutions that support operational objectives. 

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Information Systems, Data Management, Engineering, or related field.

 - Proven experience servicing work requests, investigating incidents, troubleshooting issues, and resolving operational problems independently.

 - Experience working with MDM and ERP platforms such as Syndigo/Riversand, SAP, SAP MDG, JD Edwards, Oracle, or comparable enterprise systems. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex data issues and determine root causes. 
 - Experience developing and executing testing scenarios, validation activities, and process documentation. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced operational environment. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting Item Master, Supplier Master, Customer Master, Finance Master Data, or Product Information Management processes. 
 - Experience using SQL, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools for data analysis and reporting. 
 - Experience supporting global organizations and working within matrix environments. 
 - Healthcare, medical device, manufacturing, life sciences, or regulated industry experience.

 - English proficiency required; additional language capabilities are a plus. 

Success in This Role

Success In This Role Will Be Measured Through

data.title: QA & Testing Intern — AI-Assisted Testing
data.description:
Zudu AI builds enterprise AI voice agents that handle real customer calls across India and APAC. Testing directly affects call quality, customer experience and successful task completion. 

We're looking for someone with strong manual testing fundamentals who uses AI extensively to test applications and can independently verify the results. 

What You Will Do

- Perform functional, exploratory, regression and end-to-end testing across voice agents, chat widgets, dashboards and APIs. 
 - Use AI tools to generate test scenarios, identify edge cases, build test scripts, analyze transcripts and logs, and investigate defects. 
 - Execute AI-generated tests, correct inaccurate assumptions and verify actual application behaviour. 
 - Test multilingual conversations, interruptions, silence, fallbacks, call transfers and task completion. 
 - Test APIs for authentication, input validation, response accuracy and changes to application data. 
 - Run load tests under agreed conditions to assess concurrent calls, latency and failures. 
 - Investigate issues through logs, Grafana dashboards and Prometheus metrics. 
 - Write clear bug reports with reproducible steps, expected and actual results, severity and evidence. Must Have

- Hands-on testing experience on at least one deployed application used by real users, through an internship, freelance work or a live project. 
 - Practical experience using AI tools for testing, with an example of work you executed and a verified outcome. 
 - Understanding of LLMs, prompts, context and tokens, hallucinations, variable outputs, retrieval-based grounding, and the speech-to-text → LLM → text-to-speech flow. 
 - Strong manual QA fundamentals: positive and negative scenarios, boundary testing, expected results, regression and exploratory testing. 
 - API testing basics using Postman or similar, including HTTP, REST and status codes. 
 - Working knowledge of JMeter, k6, Locust or similar, and basic ability to interpret logs and Grafana/Prometheus metrics. 
 - Curiosity, debugging discipline and the ability to explain your reasoning. 
 - Availability to work full-time from our Chennai office for six months. Good to Have

- Python or JavaScript scripting. 
 - Playwright, Selenium, pytest or CI pipeline experience. 
 - Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, streaming or real-time voice systems. 
 - Confidence evaluating Tamil, English or Hindi conversations. When Applying, Please Include

- Your latest resume. 
 - One live application you personally tested and your contribution. 
 - AI tools you have actually used for testing, with one successful example. 
 - Current and expected monthly take-home salary/stipend in INR. Enter ₹0 for current take-home if you are not currently earning. 
 - Notice period, earliest joining date and whether you can join within seven days of an offer. 

Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical exercise. AI use is encouraged; you must be able to explain and verify your work.

data.description:
Job Summary

Architect role in a multinational company focusing on structured release management for complex hybrid environments ensuring reliable delivery of solutions across day shift operations with no travel requirement. The architect will design scalable patterns for multi channel platforms optimize deployment workflows and align technical decisions with business outcomes while collaborating across diverse product and operations teams. 

Responsibilities

- Design robust release management architectures that streamline build packaging deployment and rollback processes across hybrid infrastructure while maintaining high reliability and predictable delivery cycles
 - Drive standardization of release pipelines by defining reusable patterns templates and controls that reduce release risk and improve quality for products supported in a day shift environment
 - Coordinate end to end release planning by aligning development testing operations and business stakeholders to agreed schedules scope and success criteria ensuring smooth and well communicated deployments
 - Implement rigorous versioning configuration and environment management practices that protect production stability and support clear traceability of changes across applications and platforms
 - Optimize automation in release workflows using enterprise grade tools and scripts to reduce manual intervention shorten cycle times and minimize human error during deployments
 - Analyze release incidents deployment failures and post release defects to identify root causes and design sustainable improvements that enhance reliability for future releases
 - Create comprehensive release documentation including run books deployment guides and recovery procedures that enable operations teams to execute releases confidently and consistently
 - Collaborate with security and compliance teams to embed required governance checks approvals and audit evidence within the release management lifecycle supporting regulatory and policy adherence
 - Engage with product owners and solution teams to prioritize release content based on business value risk and readiness ensuring that changes delivered through each release contribute meaningfully to company objectives
 - Support multi channel initiatives by designing release strategies that coordinate deployments across web mobile contact center and other interaction channels delivering a consistent experience to end users
 - Mentor junior engineers and release coordinators by sharing best practices troubleshooting approaches and architectural rationale to build a strong organizational capability in release management
 - Monitor release performance using metrics such as deployment frequency failure rate change lead time and mean time to recovery translating insights into actionable improvements for teams and processes
 - Adapt release approaches for hybrid work model conditions by enabling secure remote access clear communication routines and collaboration methods that keep distributed teams aligned during critical deployment windows

Qualifications

- Demonstrate strong hands on experience in enterprise scale release management including planning coordination execution and post release validation across complex application landscapes
 - Exhibit proficiency with common release and deployment tooling and scripting approaches enabling efficient automation of build promotion configuration and deployment activities
 - Apply solid understanding of software development life cycle and continuous integration and continuous delivery practices to design release processes that integrate seamlessly with engineering workflows
 - Display working knowledge of multi channel domain concepts such as unified customer journeys synchronized updates across digital and assisted channels and consistent version rollout across platforms as a desirable capability
 - Show skill in analyzing logs metrics deployment records and defect trends to diagnose release related issues and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence
 - Demonstrate clear communication and stakeholder management abilities to explain release plans articulate technical impacts and negotiate timelines with cross functional teams in a concise and structured manner
 - Leverage experience in hybrid work environments to maintain effective collaboration with onsite and remote colleagues through disciplined planning documentation and use of collaborative tools
 - Utilize strong problem solving and decision making skills to evaluate release risks choose appropriate mitigation strategies and balance speed with stability in production environments

Certifications Required

Preferred certifications include ITIL Foundation or DevOps related credentials such as Certified DevOps Practitioner focusing on release and deployment practices

data.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

Company Overview

Lilly, a leading innovation-driven corporation is developing a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products by applying the latest research from its own worldwide laboratories and from collaborations with eminent scientific organizations. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Lilly makes life better - through medicines and information - for some of the world's most urgent medical needs. Founded over 150 years ago, the company has sustained a culture that values excellence, integrity and respect for people. This has resulted in Lilly frequently being ranked as one of the best companies in the world at which to work. Lilly understands its business has prospered because of its employees - people with a talent for innovation and a passion for making a difference by finding treatments for the most stubborn diseases; people whose talent is matched by their generosity, and people with strong values and a determination to prevail, regardless of the challenges. Join our team - and make a difference in improving health for people all over the world!

About Synthetic Molecule Design and Development (SMDD): SMDD is a critical function within Lilly Product Research & Development (PRD) responsible for the development of synthetic drug substances and drug products from the pre-clinical phase through commercialization. PRD at Lilly Bengaluru, established in 2016, is an integrated business unit with the Global Indianapolis functions supporting synthetic molecules, large molecules and drug delivery developments. Together we advance a dynamic portfolio of small molecules, peptides, oligonucleotides and other emerging therapeutic modalities. 

Job Description

PRD / SMDD @ Bangalore has an exciting opportunity for an Advisor / Sr Advisor - Synthetic Molecule Analytical Chemistry to join our multidisciplinary team of chemists and engineers. The individual will have ttechnical oversight of key process development activities performed at a strategic Indian contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO). The individual will act as the technical bridge between Lilly scientists and the CDMO, review & influence CDMO strategies, ensure alignment with Lilly requirements, escalate risks and develop mitigation plans. 

Empowered by access to world-class capabilities and extensive pharmaceutical development experience, you will help deliver technical solutions that enable deeper understanding of processes and products across the portfolio. Ideal candidates will possess experience across multiple analytical techniques (e. g. , HPLC, mass spectrometry, NMR), demonstrate an aptitude in technical problem-solving, and be motivated to work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic environment. The individual will enable comprehensive characterization of materials and processes necessary to ensure the quality, safety, and efficacy of Lilly's medicines. This responsibility requires direct contribution to the development of analytical methodology and the design of experiments to generate key data.

Scientific & Technical Leadership

- Demonstrate learning agility across modalities (small molecules, peptides, and oligonucleotides). Drive the design, development, and implementation of product control strategies for synthetic / small molecule programs. Demonstrated ability to develop analytical methods, justify specifications, design stability studies, establish starting material rationales for synthetic processes, identify impurities, and test drug product performance characteristics (e. g. , dissolution/disintegration). 
 - Provide technical guidance for analytical activities carried out within the CDMO network. Ensure methods are technically sound, well developed, and fit for purposes. Collaborate closely with process development chemistry and engineering colleagues and manufacturing engineers to translate processes from the bench to pilot plant scale.

 - Work as a team and take responsibility with accountability.

Basic Qualifications

- PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemistry, or related field, with 5+ years of experience

Additional Skills/Preferences

 - Demonstrated self-initiative and appropriate risk-taking
 - Ability to learn and apply technical knowledge to meet changing project needs

We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting regulated environments (GxP, SoX and other regional or local regulations). 

Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world. 

Digital Technology & Architecture organization encompasses following capabilities: Integration, Enterprise Architecture, Operations, Cloud engineering, Platform Engineering (e. g. DevOps & related framework), Enabling Platforms (ServiceNow, Observability, Chatbots, RPA, . . . ), Digital Workplace and more "classical" infrastructures (hosting, network, servers, . . . ).

Productivity & Collaboration suite (Microsoft 365, with Office suite, Teams, Email, . . . )

Videoconferencing (Zoom, Teams) & space booking (Logitech)

Devices & Mobility (Windows, Mac, Workstation as a Service, mobile phones & tablets, device imaging & software deployment, Intune, Industrial devices)

Digital Signage & IP-TV

Telephony (VoIP, Teams or fixed)

Secure Printing & Scanning services

Application store for applications deployed on or accessible from end users' laptops requiring either a license or a local setup (e. g. Adobe, Microsoft Office suite, Visio/Project, . . . ) As a target, all these capabilities will become full managed by Opella but most of them (less and less) are still operated by Sanofi for us. As a lead of Device & Software Experience, you oversee the 360° of Device and end-user software part of the Digital Workplace scope: hardware catalog, evolutions, roadmap, demand management, user education, corrective & preventive maintenance, build & run budget, . . . ) whether they are owned directly by Opella or still managed by Sanofi. 

Main objective is to shape our future state for Opella and take over the devices & manage our end-user software. As a leader of a team, below are the key responsibilities for this role and domain. 

Devices & Software inventory & lifecycle

Secure a clear cartography of Opella end-user devices to be ready for the takeover. This includes Laptops, desktops, mobiles, tablets, virtual desktops, industrial devices and printing. Manage device lifecycle, catalog and relationship with vendors to ensure the best and most cost-effective service In partnership with People organization and other stakeholders, determine a clear device assignment policy and end-to-end provisioning process, including imaging and enrolment, taking into account cybersecurity aspects

Setup a clear process for Opella to operate end-user software (approval, deployment, packaging, . . . ) and maintain it over time through evolutions. Oversee products lifecycle and build strategies (roadmaps, evolutions, Opella target landscape), especially to move from remaining Sanofi-operated capabilities to Opella target

Ensure close relationships with vendors (Microsoft, OEM, . . . ) to always get optimized costs, support & advices

Accurately & fully document solutions architectures, process and support models, especially in application referential (ServiceNow CMDB)

Key Competencies Strategic thinker with hands-on technical depth Strong ownership and accountability mindset Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to balance governance rigor with business agility Strong communication skills across business and technical audiences Comfortable operating in complex, multi-system environments Structured, organized, and delivery-oriented What Success Looks Like High-quality, trusted Customer Master Data adopted across countries Stable and scalable MDM architecture aligned with enterprise data strategy On-time and predictable delivery execution Clear governance, documented architecture, and measurable data quality improvements Strong collaboration between IT, business, governance, and operationsWhy us? At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. data.description:
Job Description

ERP Full Stack Development Lead - MERN & NestJS

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced, technically strong, and ownership-oriented ERP Full Stack Development Lead with deep expertise in MERN, NestJS, React. js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and enterprise ERP application development. 

This is not a conventional ERP developer position. The selected individual will be expected to take end-to-end technical ownership of the organization's current and upcoming ERP development projects, while also leading, mentoring, strengthening, and improving the productivity of the existing development team. 

The ideal candidate should have overall software development experience, with a minimum of 5 years of substantial hands-on experience in ERP / enterprise application development. 

The person should have practical experience working on an ERP product consisting of at least 10 integrated modules and should understand not only software development, but also business processes, workflows, integrations, data flow, implementation challenges, project estimation, delivery management, debugging, team productivity, and the complete ERP software lifecycle. 

We are looking for someone who can operate as a technical owner rather than simply a task executor. 

The Expected Outcome From This Role Is: 

AI-assisted development + Rapid Development + Higher Accuracy + Higher Developer Productivity + Faster Project Delivery + Stronger Development Team

Key Responsibilities

- End-to-End ERP Development Ownership
 - Take technical ownership of the organization's current and future ERP development projects. 
 - Understand the complete ERP product architecture, modules, workflows, integrations, dependencies, and technical ecosystem. 
 - Manage and guide the development lifecycle from requirement analysis → technical design → estimation → development → testing support → deployment → maintenance → enhancement. 
 - Ensure that development decisions are aligned with long-term ERP product scalability and maintainability. 
 - Identify technical risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delivery challenges before they affect projects. 
 - Establish development standards that can be consistently followed across current and future ERP projects. 
 - Ensure that new requirements are developed without unnecessarily compromising existing ERP functionality. 
 - Maintain technical consistency across modules and projects. 
 - ERP Domain Expertise

The candidate must have real-world ERP development experience, preferably involving an ERP product with 10 or more integrated modules. 

Strong Understanding Of Enterprise Workflows Such As: 

- Sales
 - Purchase
 - Inventory
 - Procurement
 - Production / Manufacturing
 - Finance / Accounts
 - CRM
 - Service
 - HR / Payroll
 - Projects
 - Reporting & Dashboards
 - Master Data
 - Approval Workflows
 - User & Role Management
 - Notifications
 - Integrations
 - Document Management

The candidate should be capable of understanding a business requirement and translating it into: 

Business Requirement → ERP Workflow → Technical Design → API → Database → UI → Validation → Testing → Deployment

The individual should be able to distinguish between a quick coding solution and a proper ERP-grade solution that can support future requirements. 

- Full Stack Development

Design, develop, review, optimize, and maintain scalable enterprise applications using: 

Backend

- NestJS
 - Node. js
 - TypeScript
 - Mongoose ODM
 - MongoDB
 - REST API development
 - API architecture and integration
 - Authentication and authorization
 - Error handling and validation
 - Business logic implementation
 - Backend performance optimization

Frontend

- React. js
 - JavaScript / TypeScript
 - Redux
 - Redux-Saga
 - Formik
 - React Hook Form (RHF)
 - Reusable component development
 - Complex enterprise forms
 - API integration
 - State management
 - Frontend performance optimization
 - Error handling and user experience

The candidate should be comfortable working across both frontend and backend, rather than being dependent on separate teams for basic full-stack development requirements. 

- MongoDB & Database Ownership
 - Design scalable MongoDB data models for ERP applications. 
 - Design and optimize Mongoose schemas. 
 - Write efficient MongoDB queries and aggregations. 
 - Identify and resolve database performance issues. 
 - Understand relationships and dependencies between ERP entities. 
 - Ensure data consistency and integrity across complex business workflows. 
 - Review database changes before implementation in critical modules. 
 - Identify potential scalability problems in database design. 
 - Project Estimation & Delivery Planning

The candidate must be highly capable of converting requirements into realistic, technically defensible ETAs. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Analyze incoming requirements quickly. 
 - Break requirements into development tasks. 
 - Identify dependencies and technical complexity. 
 - Provide accurate development estimates and ETAs. 
 - Identify parallelizable development activities. 
 - Allocate work effectively across developers. 
 - Track estimated vs. actual development effort. 
 - Continuously improve estimation accuracy. 

The role should be capable of assessing and planning ETAs for a high-volume development pipeline, including 100+ new project/change requests or requirements in a month, without compromising technical quality. 

The expectation is not simply to provide an ETA, but to build a development system capable of predictable and measurable delivery. 

- Rapid Development & Faster Delivery

We are specifically looking for a developer who believes in rapid, disciplined, and intelligent development. 

The Candidate Should: 

- Develop rapidly without compromising maintainability. 
 - Minimize unnecessary development cycles. 
 - Reuse existing components, services, utilities, and patterns wherever appropriate. 
 - Identify repetitive development activities and automate them. 
 - Establish reusable development frameworks and standards. 
 - Reduce rework caused by incomplete analysis or poor implementation. 
 - Improve developer productivity continuously. 
 - Identify bottlenecks in the current development process and eliminate them. 
 - Convert requirements into production-ready functionality quickly and accurately. 

The Objective Is: 

More quality output in less time - not simply more lines of code. 

- AI-Driven Development

Strong practical adoption of AI-assisted software development is a core expectation of this position. 

The Candidate Should Actively Use AI Tools To Improve: 

- Development speed
 - Code generation
 - Code refactoring
 - Debugging
 - Error analysis
 - API development
 - Test case generation
 - Documentation
 - SQL / MongoDB query assistance
 - Technical research
 - Requirement analysis
 - Code reviews
 - Performance optimization
 - Repetitive development activities
 - Developer productivity

The candidate should not merely know how to use AI tools personally, but should be capable of introducing, standardizing, and improving AI-assisted development practices across the entire development team. 

The Candidate Is Expected To Continuously Identify: 

What can be developed faster with AI?

What can be tested more accurately with AI?

What can be automated with AI?

What repetitive developer activity can be eliminated with AI?

AI should be treated as a development productivity tool, while maintaining proper engineering judgment, security, correctness, maintainability, and code quality. 

- Team Leadership & Productivity

This position carries significant responsibility for the productivity and technical growth of the development team. 

The Candidate Should: 

- Understand the strengths and weaknesses of the existing developers. 
 - Assess the technical capability of individual team members. 
 - Allocate work according to capability and project priority. 
 - Mentor developers technically. 
 - Conduct meaningful code reviews. 
 - Improve development practices across the team. 
 - Identify productivity issues early. 
 - Help developers overcome technical blocks. 
 - Encourage AI-assisted development practices. 
 - Establish accountability for assigned work. 
 - Track commitments and delivery. 
 - Create a culture of ownership rather than dependency. 
 - Motivate developers toward continuous technical improvement. 
 - Uplift the overall technical capability of the team. 

The expectation is to make the team stronger, faster, and more independent over time. 

- Ownership & Accountability

The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong ownership mindset. 

This Role Requires Someone Who: 

- Takes responsibility for outcomes, not merely assigned tasks. 
 - Follows a requirement until it reaches completion. 
 - Does not wait for problems to become escalations. 
 - Identifies problems proactively. 
 - Communicates delays and risks early. 
 - Takes responsibility for technical decisions. 
 - Follows through on commitments. 
 - Maintains accountability for project delivery. 
 - Supports the team when critical issues arise. 
 - Takes ownership of both successful outcomes and failures. 

We Are Looking For Someone Who Asks: 

"How do we get this delivered?"

Rather Than: 

"Who is responsible for this?"

- Code Quality & Technical Standards
 - Establish and enforce clean coding standards. 
 - Conduct effective code reviews. 
 - Ensure reusable and maintainable architecture. 
 - Identify technical debt. 
 - Reduce duplicate and unnecessary code. 
 - Improve existing implementations where required.

 - Ensure proper error handling and validation.

 - Git, CI/CD & Deployment

- Git
