data.title: is hiring for Digital Delivery Manager - Associate Director
data.description:
Job Summary: 

This role is part of a peer leadership group with the Context Engineering Manager, who owns the context layer, and the AI Engineering Manager, who owns AI application and agent runtime. Together, the three leaders share ownership of the delivery platform, engineering standards, agentic pipeline, and shared skill and agent library. Each leader is also accountable for delivery in the product lanes assigned to their team. The role operates within the Advantage SDLC, ARB, firm policies, and security standards, and helps keep the practice aligned to one shared platform rather than allowing parallel stacks to form. 

Duties & Responsibilities

- Agentic Delivery Operations - Co-own and improve the shared agentic delivery pipeline with DT&I peers. Break work into units that agents can execute, with clear entry criteria, exit criteria, and verification steps. Contribute reusable agents, skills, and tooling back to the shared library, and track throughput per agent-hour, human review load, rework rate, and cost per delivered increment. 

- Context Engineering Practice - Lead the RISE context engineering team and co-develop practice standards with the Context Engineering Manager. These standards include context and prompt versioning, session and handoff artifact design, agent instruction inheritance such as CLAUDE. md and equivalents, context window management, and prevention of context drift across long-running work. Maintain change control over agents, prompts, context packages, and tool definitions as governed configuration items. 

- Validation, Evaluation & Quality Assurance - Own verification of agent-produced work products, including the evidence required, the accountable attester, the audit trail, and the steps a reviewer must follow to reconstruct how an output was produced. Build and maintain golden data sets, regression suites, adversarial coverage, drift detection, and evaluation-based release gates. Keep the deterministic and probabilistic boundary explicit in every design. 
 - Product & Platform Engineering Delivery - Deliver assigned features across the Advantage product portfolio on the . NET 10 / React stack, integrating Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Container Apps, Dapr, and Microsoft Fabric. Take designs through the pre-build design review panel before pipeline entry and supply reviewers to it, and own CI/CD, testing, observability, and production support for what the team ships. 
 - Team Leadership & Capability Building - Build and mentor a RISE team of context engineers, evaluation engineers, and AI and full-stack engineers. Establish role clarity, performance expectations, and career paths for disciplines new to the firm, and staff for depth over headcount so capability growth shows up as throughput rather than team size. 
 - Risk Management - Ensure solutions and the agents that produce them meet firm security, privacy, and compliance baselines (SOC 2, PCAOB AS 2201, QC 1000, ISO 27001); define human-in-the-loop review as a documented control covering review depth, reviewer qualification, sign-off evidence, and exception escalation; and lead root cause analysis and corrective action for defects, agent failures, and control gaps. Supervisory Responsibilities

This role manages context engineers, evaluation engineers, and AI and full-stack engineers within RISE, and may direct contract resources. The role helps set DT&I engineering practice as a peer of the Context Engineering Manager and AI Engineering Manager, reviews code and evaluation results, and is accountable for the quality and reliability of what the RISE team ships to production. Portfolio priorities are set jointly with those peers and the AI & Digital Innovation Delivery Lead. 

Success in this role is measured by reliable delivery of assigned product increments, improved throughput through agentic delivery, reduced rework, strong evaluation coverage, compliant production releases, and sustained use of the shared Advantage platform and engineering standards. 

Qualifications

Key stakeholders include DT&I engineering peers, Assurance leadership, AI and digital innovation delivery leadership, infrastructure, data, security, compliance, and product stakeholders across RISE and BDO USA. 

- Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field required; Master's degree is preferred. 
 - Experience: Twelve (12-15) or more years in software, Data, or AI engineering, including five (5) or more years in Engineering Leadership, three (3) or more years in building Production AI, LLM, RAG, and/or Multi-Agent Systems beyond single-prompt applications, five (5) or more years of experience in leading large Program/Portfolio delivery and three (3) or more years of experience in Budget, Vendor & stakeholder Management. Demonstrated experience designing evaluation and validation approaches for non-deterministic systems, including regression testing and quality gating, required. Regulated or Professional Services experience is preferred. 
 - License / Certification: Relevant Azure or AI certification preferred (e. g. , Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate). 
 - Software: Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI / model APIs, Azure AI Search / vector stores, Azure Container Apps and Dapr, Microsoft Fabric, . NET / C#, React and TypeScript, Azure DevOps / CI-CD, evaluation and observability tooling, and Claude Code or equivalent agentic development tooling. Other Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Deep working knowledge of LLM context windows, prompting, retrieval, grounding, and multi-agent coordination, and how each affects accuracy, cost, and reliability. 
 - Evaluation and measurement mindset; able to define and defend accuracy, cost, and latency targets, and to evidence them under audit-grade scrutiny. 
 - Production-grade software discipline: testing, CI/CD, observability, and reliability in a governed environment. 
 - Builds shared standards with peers and extends a common platform rather than forking it locally, including comfort with adversarial design review in both directions. 
 - Clear communication and pragmatic delivery focus; partners across context, AI, infrastructure, data, and assurance stakeholders with meaningful daily overlap with U. S. hours.

 - 6. Verification & TestOwn requirements-based test development and execution. 
 - Conduct MC/DC and structural coverage analysis.

 - 7. Configuration & Process ComplianceWork within the project's SCMP and SQAP. 
 - Maintain firmware baselines, problem reports and lifecycle data under control and audit-ready throughout the program. 
 - 8. Defect & Risk ManagementTriage and resolve firmware defects and anomalies.

 - 9. Continuous ImprovementIdentify opportunities to improve firmware development tooling, review efficiency and team capability.

Cloud & Data: Comfortable in cloud and high-performance environments (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake) and building data pipelines. Business Understanding: Familiarity with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality processes and KPIs, and the ability to translate business problems into deployable agents. Experience: [Add required years] of hands-on experience building and deploying production AI / software solutions; life-sciences or regulated (GxP) manufacturing experience is a strong plus. Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline. Soft & Behavioral Skills Challenger Mindset: Demonstrates a proactive and questioning mindset, constantly challenging the status quo and driving innovation in AI use cases. All In, Together: Strong collaboration across global, cross-functional teams, acting as a bridge between business and technical stakeholders in an FDE setup. Outcome-Obsessed: Focuses relentlessly on delivering measurable business impact, prioritizing high-value outcomes in Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality. Courageous: Takes ownership, makes decisions in complex environments, and drives initiatives forward end-to-end, even under uncertainty. Radically Simple: Ability to simplify complex systems, processes, and AI solutions into clear, actionable, and scalable products. Ownership & Accountability: Takes full ownership of delivery - not only design, but hands-on implementation and successful deployment into operations. Communication: Clear and structured communication adapted to both business and technical audiences. Why us? At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day. We Are Challengers. We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things: All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs. Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity. Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity. data.title: Mgr, Software Development
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies. 
 - Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation. 
 - Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Redis, Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, infrastructure-as-code, service virtualization, and container security. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post-market investigations, and enterprise-scale healthcare product releases. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - C#, Azure, Kubernetes, performance testing, healthcare interoperability, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is advantageous. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. 

Reasonable Accommodations

Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. 

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Baxter has discovered incidents of employment scams, where fraudulent parties pose as Baxter employees, recruiters, or other agents, and engage with online job seekers in an attempt to steal personal and/or financial information. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

data.description:
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally. 

Our mission is to bring health in people's hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide - and counting. At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11, 000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world's most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www. opella. com. About You You will lead a team of 5 to 10 experts and platform owners covering three connected areas: Digital Quality, meaning GxP processes, computer system validation, and the Digital Control Framework. Testing and quality engineering, including test strategy, test management and automation on Xray and Tricentis Tosca. The Atlassian platform, where Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud carry project delivery, documentation and compliance evidence for Opella Digital. The role is both platform owner and people manager. There is no intermediate management layer, so you lead senior specialists directly and stay close enough to the work to challenge a validation rationale, review a test automation approach, or settle a Jira workflow design. We are looking for someone with 12 to 15 years of experience who owns the outcome rather than the task, simplifies processes that have grown complicated, and works comfortably across Digital, Quality and the business functions. What you will do Lead the team Line manage 5 to 10 experts and platform owners, including internal staff and partner resources. Set direction and priorities across three areas at once. Give each platform owner clear accountability, decision rights and a roadmap they own, then hold them to it. Run objective setting, performance and development conversations, coaching, and skills, backup and succession planning. Shape resourcing, capacity and the balance between insourced and partner-delivered work. Own the budget and vendor relationships for the platforms in scope. Build one team culture across quality, testing and platform engineering rather than three separate groups. Digital Quality, policy and validation governance You are the global owner for GxP-relevant Digital Quality policies, standards, SOPs and work instructions, and for making them usable in practice. You own the Digital Control Framework: control design, control ownership, testing of control effectiveness, evidence retention and remediation tracking. The role covers controlled document management for CSV and CSA, data integrity under ALCOA+, cloud and SaaS governance, and electronic records and electronic signatures under 21 CFR Part 11. Digital solutions must meet GxP, ICH, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, including how protected health and personal data is handled across regulated and commercial systems. You provide quality oversight for computer system validation using GAMP 5 and CSA principles, take risk-based decisions and document the reasoning. You govern validation plans, risk assessments and test strategies, and you review and approve URS, functional specifications, UAT reports, validation summaries and Authorization for Use. You manage validation deviations and CAPAs, oversee change controls for validation impact, and run GxP periodic reviews. You also govern digital supplier management: vendor inventories, assessments, quality agreements and performance monitoring. Testing, strategy, tooling and delivery assurance Own the global test strategy and testing standards for Opella Digital across functional, integration, regression, performance and user acceptance testing, in both GxP and non-GxP systems. You are accountable for Xray as the test management layer in Jira and for Tricentis Tosca as the automation platform, covering roadmap, licensing, environments, upgrades, integrations and adoption, working through the platform owners in your team. Grow automation coverage on the systems that matter most, such as ERP, supply chain, commercial and web, and make automated evidence usable for validation where the regulations allow it. Keep traceability intact from requirement to test case to execution to defect, which serves delivery quality and inspection readiness at the same time. Set testing metrics such as coverage, defect leakage, automation rate and cycle time, and use them to change how the teams work. Get involved early enough with project and product teams that testing is planned in from the start rather than added at the end. Atlassian platform Own Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud, along with Jira Service Management, the Marketplace app portfolio and the integrations with the rest of the digital toolchain. Define and govern project templates, workflows, schemes, permissions and space structures so that they support agile delivery and the traceability a regulated environment needs. Cloud releases arrive continuously, so the platform roadmap has to cover release and change management, app rationalization, performance, cost and license optimization. Work with Cybersecurity, Identity and Internal Audit on security, privacy, access management, data residency and audit requirements, including the controls needed for Jira and Confluence to hold GxP-relevant records. Drive adoption and standardization across Digital and the business so the standard way is also the easy way, and run platform operations to agreed service levels with a clear support model and incident and problem management. Collaboration, audit and inspection readiness Partner with Digital, Manufacturing, R&D, Quality and Supply Chain teams to give GxP and testing guidance during system modernization. Work with Cybersecurity, Data Privacy and Internal Audit specialists so requirements are managed in one central framework rather than several. Build and deliver global training on digital and GxP policies, data integrity, validation, testing and Atlassian practices. Keep evidence packages and stakeholder coordination ready for audit at any time, not only when one is announced. Act as the subject matter expert during Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA and others) and internal or external audits covering digital systems, validation and data integrity, and lead CAPA development and effectiveness checks for findings related to digital quality governance. About you We look at potential, character and culture fit alongside experience. You have 12 to 15 years of experience across digital quality and compliance, software testing and platform ownership in a regulated industry such as pharma, healthcare or life sciences. You have managed people for at least 3 to 5 years, ideally senior specialists and platform owners in a flat structure, including hiring, coaching, performance management and leading work delivered through partners. You have owned an enterprise SaaS platform yourself, including its roadmap, budget, vendors, lifecycle, adoption and service levels. You know test strategy, test management, automation and the validation lifecycle for GxP digital systems. On tooling, you have worked hands on with Jira and Xray for test plans, executions, traceability matrices and dashboards. You understand how Tricentis Tosca automation is designed, maintained and scaled in a large system landscape. You can configure and govern Jira and Confluence Cloud, including workflows, permissions, apps and admin and security controls. You are familiar with ServiceNow, Veeva Vault or equivalent document management systems. On regulation, you know GxP, ICH guidelines, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures, together with GAMP 5, CSA, IT general controls and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. You have run GxP supplier qualification activities. You are fluent in English and comfortable working with stakeholders across a global matrix organization. The Opella leadership behaviors we are looking for We assess every candidate against our four behaviors. Behavior What it looks like in this role All in. Together. You lead one team across quality, testing and platforms, and you partner across Digital, R&D, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, asking for help and giving it freely. Courageous You challenge how validation and testing are done today, take considered risks on automation and platform change, and speak up during inspections. Outcome-Obsessed You own the compliance and delivery result, not only the task, and follow through with integrity and speed. Radically Simple You make GxP frameworks and platform configurations simple enough for teams to understand and apply. Opella is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every candidate feels respected.

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

DevOps Engineer

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on, responsible and growth-oriented DevOps Engineer with approximately 1-2 years of experience who is interested in building strong practical expertise in Linux, Docker, CI/CD, server management, deployment automation, security, monitoring and infrastructure management. 

GwayERP and ThiranERP are growing rapidly, and we are preparing our infrastructure and deployment processes to support an increasing number of ERP implementations and frequent application releases. 

The selected candidate will work closely with the development, QA and technical teams to maintain the existing environments, improve the current infrastructure, automate repetitive activities, strengthen security, improve documentation and progressively build a reliable deployment ecosystem. 

This role is ideal for someone who has a good foundation in DevOps and is willing to learn deeply, take responsibility, research solutions independently and grow into larger infrastructure and DevOps responsibilities. 

The candidate does not need to know everything from day one. 

However, The Candidate Must Have The Mindset: 

"If I don't know it, I will learn it, understand it properly, implement it safely and document it. "

Key Responsibilities

- Environment Management

Support and maintain the different application environments used by GwayERP and ThiranERP, including: 

- Development
 - Testing / QA
 - Staging
 - Trial / Demo
 - Production / Client environments

Responsibilities Include: 

- Maintaining environment availability. 
 - Checking server health. 
 - Managing application services. 
 - Managing Docker containers. 
 - Managing environment configurations. 
 - Supporting developers with environment-related issues. 
 - Identifying configuration inconsistencies. 
 - Keeping environments properly documented. 

The candidate will progressively improve the structure and reliability of these environments. 

- Local Server & Linux Administration

Work hands-on with our local/on-premises infrastructure. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Ubuntu/Linux server administration. 
 - User and permission management. 
 - SSH configuration. 
 - Server resource monitoring. 
 - Disk and storage monitoring. 
 - Network configuration. 
 - Firewall configuration. 
 - Service management. 
 - Log analysis. 
 - System updates and patching. 
 - Troubleshooting server-related issues. 

The candidate should gradually develop the ability to independently troubleshoot common Linux infrastructure problems. 

- Docker & Container Management

Work with Docker-based application environments. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Creating and maintaining Docker containers. 
 - Managing Docker Compose configurations. 
 - Managing container networks. 
 - Managing Docker volumes. 
 - Managing application configuration. 
 - Monitoring container health. 
 - Troubleshooting container failures. 
 - Managing application logs. 
 - Maintaining Docker images. 
 - Cleaning unused resources safely. 
 - Following standard containerization practices. 

The candidate should progressively learn how to design consistent and reusable Docker environments rather than maintaining containers manually. 

- CI/CD & Jenkins

Support and improve the organization's CI/CD processes using Jenkins, Git and GitHub. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding existing Jenkins pipelines. 
 - Maintaining Jenkins jobs. 
 - Supporting automated builds. 
 - Managing deployment pipelines. 
 - Troubleshooting failed builds. 
 - Troubleshooting deployment failures. 
 - Managing build artifacts. 
 - Supporting automated application deployments. 
 - Maintaining Jenkins credentials securely. 
 - Gradually improving deployment automation. 

The long-term objective is to reduce manual deployment activities and make deployments: 

Repeatable → Reliable → Automated → Traceable

- Deployment Automation

Work with developers to improve the way GwayERP and ThiranERP applications are deployed. 

The candidate will help establish a standardized deployment process such as: 

Code → Build → Release → Deploy → Verify

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding application deployment requirements. 
 - Preparing deployment scripts. 
 - Automating repetitive deployment tasks. 
 - Supporting application updates. 
 - Maintaining deployment configurations. 
 - Performing deployment verification. 
 - Supporting rollback procedures. 
 - Maintaining deployment documentation. 

The candidate should continuously identify opportunities to eliminate unnecessary manual steps. 

- Preparing for High-Volume Deployments

GwayERP and ThiranERP are expected to be deployed to an increasing number of customers. 

The infrastructure is being prepared for a future requirement of approximately: 

20-30+ deployments per day

The candidate will work with technical team members and developers to understand this requirement and progressively improve the deployment architecture. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Identifying deployment bottlenecks. 
 - Automating repetitive deployment tasks. 
 - Improving deployment speed. 
 - Improving deployment reliability. 
 - Standardizing client deployment procedures. 
 - Supporting parallel deployment where appropriate. 
 - Maintaining deployment records. 
 - Learning and implementing suitable DevOps practices for higher deployment volumes. 

The candidate is expected to grow with the requirement and continuously improve the deployment system as the number of clients increases. 

- Secure Client Deployment

GwayERP And ThiranERP Applications May Be Deployed In: 

- Customer on-premises servers
 - Customer-preferred cloud servers
 - Other approved customer environments

The candidate will assist in developing a deployment architecture where the application can run securely in the customer's environment without unnecessarily exposing the organization's source code. 

The candidate should learn and work with concepts such as: 

- Docker images
 - Private container registries
 - Build artifacts
 - Runtime configuration
 - Secrets management
 - Access control
 - Secure deployment packages
 - Application versioning
 - Container security

The Objective Is: 

Customers should be able to run and use the ERP application without receiving unrestricted access to the development source code. 

The candidate should continuously research and recommend better approaches as the deployment model evolves. 

- Application Updates & Release Management

ERP Applications Will Continuously Receive: 

- Bug fixes
 - Security fixes
 - New features
 - Performance improvements
 - Workflow enhancements

The DevOps process must support updating existing client installations safely. 

The Candidate Will Assist In Building Processes For: 

New Release → Backup → Deployment → Database Migration → Verification

Responsibilities Include: 

- Preparing release packages/images. 
 - Supporting application updates. 
 - Checking deployment prerequisites. 
 - Supporting database migrations. 
 - Verifying application health after deployment. 
 - Maintaining release versions. 
 - Supporting rollback when required. 

The candidate must understand that ERP deployments involve customer business data and therefore require much greater care than a simple application redeployment. 

- MongoDB Backup & Recovery

Work with the technical team to maintain reliable MongoDB backup and recovery processes. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding MongoDB backup methods. 
 - Configuring automated backups. 
 - Monitoring backup jobs. 
 - Maintaining backup retention. 
 - Checking backup integrity. 
 - Performing test restores. 
 - Supporting database recovery. 
 - Maintaining backup documentation. 

The Candidate Should Develop a Strong Understanding Of: 

Backup ≠ Recovery

A backup should be periodically tested to ensure that it can actually be restored. 

- Data Safety During Deployment

The candidate must follow deployment practices that protect customer data. 

Before significant application updates, the candidate should ensure appropriate procedures are followed for: 

- Database backup
 - Application compatibility
 - Database migration
 - Configuration backup
 - Deployment verification
 - Rollback

The Objective Is To Minimize The Possibility Of: 

- Data loss
 - Database corruption
 - Incompatible application/database versions
 - Configuration loss
 - Failed updates
 - Infrastructure Security

Security will be an important responsibility of this role. 

The Candidate Will Work On: 

- Linux server hardening. 
 - SSH security. 
 - Firewall configuration. 
 - Port management. 
 - User access control. 
 - File permissions. 
 - Docker security. 
 - Database access restrictions. 
 - Jenkins security. 
 - Git/GitHub security. 
 - Secret management. 
 - SSL/TLS. 
 - Security updates. 

The candidate should continuously learn about current infrastructure and application security practices. 

- Monitoring & Logging

Help Implement And Maintain Monitoring For: 

- Server CPU
 - RAM
 - Disk space
 - Disk health
 - Network
 - Docker containers
 - Application services
 - MongoDB
 - Redis
 - Jenkins
 - Backup jobs

The candidate should help establish alerts for important conditions such as: 

- Server unavailable
 - Disk nearly full
 - Container repeatedly restarting
 - Database unavailable
 - Backup failure
 - Application health failure
 - Deployment failure

The goal is to identify problems before they become customer-impacting issues. 

- Documentation

One of the important responsibilities of this role is to improve the current level of infrastructure documentation. 

The Candidate Should Maintain Documentation For: 

Environment

- Server details
 - Application environments
 - Docker services
 - Ports
 - Network configuration
 - Application dependencies

Deployment

- Deployment procedures
 - Update procedures
 - Rollback procedures
 - Client deployment steps

Backup

- Backup procedures
 - Backup locations
 - Retention
 - Restore procedures

Infrastructure

- Server configuration
 - Docker architecture
 - Jenkins pipelines
 - Application deployment architecture

Troubleshooting

- Common problems
 - Solutions
 - Recovery procedures

The objective is to ensure that important operational knowledge is documented and repeatable rather than dependent on individual memory. 

- Git & Release Management

Work with Git/GitHub-based development workflows. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding branches. 
 - Understanding pull requests. 
 - Managing deployment branches where required. 
 - Understanding release tags. 
 - Tracking application versions. 
 - Supporting release management. 
 - Maintaining deployment history. 

The Candidate Should Understand The Relationship Between: 

Git → Build → Release → Deployment → Production

- Infrastructure Automation

The candidate should actively look for opportunities to automate repetitive work. 

This May Include: 

- Shell scripts
 - Bash
 - Docker automation
 - Jenkins pipelines
 - Deployment scripts
 - Backup scripts
 - Monitoring scripts
 - Server setup scripts
 - Configuration automation

Knowledge of tools such as Ansible or Terraform will be an advantage. 

The expectation is not that the candidate knows every automation tool immediately, but that they have the willingness and ability to learn them when required. 

- Working With Developers

The DevOps Engineer will work closely with developers and QA engineers. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Understanding application requirements. 
 - Understanding environment requirements. 
 - Supporting development environments. 
 - Supporting testing environments. 
 - Supporting staging. 
 - Preparing deployment environments. 
 - Understanding application configuration. 
 - Supporting database migrations. 
 - Identifying deployment risks. 
 - Helping developers troubleshoot environment issues. 

The candidate should be comfortable discussing technical issues directly with developers. 

- Learning & Continuous Improvement

This position requires a strong self-learning mindset. 

The candidate will encounter technologies and infrastructure requirements that may not be known at the time of joining. 

The Candidate Is Expected To: 

- Research unfamiliar technologies. 
 - Read official documentation. 
 - Test solutions safely. 
 - Build proof-of-concepts where necessary. 
 - Learn from incidents. 
 - Improve existing processes. 
 - Keep up with DevOps practices. 
 - Learn security best practices. 
 - Learn infrastructure automation. 
 - Learn container orchestration and deployment approaches as the organization's needs evolve. 

We value the ability to learn and implement more than simply listing a large number of technologies on a resume. 

- Problem Solving & Troubleshooting

The candidate should develop strong troubleshooting skills. 

Problems May Include: 

- Application not starting
 - Container failure
 - Database connection failure
 - Network issue
 - Jenkins build failure
 - Deployment failure
 - Disk space issue
 - Permission issue
 - SSL certificate issue
 - Backup failure
 - Server performance issue

The Expected Approach Is: 

Understand → Investigate → Identify Root Cause → Fix → Verify → Document → Prevent Recurrence

Technical Skills

Required / Expected

- Linux / Ubuntu
 - Docker
 - Docker Compose
 - Git
 - GitHub
 - Jenkins
 - CI/CD fundamentals
 - Basic networking
 - SSH
 - Firewall fundamentals
 - MongoDB basics
 - MongoDB backup and restore
 - Shell / Bash scripting
 - Basic server monitoring
 - Basic security practices

Good to Have

- Ansible
 - Terraform
 - Nginx
 - Private Docker Registry
 - Prometheus
 - Grafana
 - Redis
 - SSL/TLS
 - VPN
 - AWS
 - Azure
 - OVH
 - Proxmox
 - Cloud infrastructure
 - Infrastructure as Code
 - Container security

Experience

Required

- 1-2 years of practical DevOps / Infrastructure / System Administration experience
 - Hands-on Linux experience. 
 - Hands-on Docker experience. 
 - Basic Jenkins/CI/CD experience. 
 - Git/GitHub knowledge. 
 - Basic understanding of networking and server security. 
 - Basic understanding of databases and backup. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot technical problems independently. 
 - Strong willingness to learn. 

Advantage

Experience Working With: 

- SaaS applications
 - ERP applications
 - Enterprise applications
 - MongoDB
 - Node. js applications
 - React applications
 - Dockerized applications
 - On-premises deployments
 - Cloud deployments
 - Customer application deployments

What We Expect From You

You are not expected to know everything when you join. 

However, We Expect You To Be Someone Who: 

- Takes responsibility. 
 - Learns quickly. 
 - Does not give up when facing an unfamiliar problem. 
 - Researches before asking for solutions. 
 - Documents what you learn. 
 - Communicates problems early. 
 - Works carefully with production systems. 
 - Understands the importance of data security. 
 - Understands the importance of backups. 
 - Thinks about automation. 
 - Thinks about scalability. 
 - Thinks about security. 
 - Works well with developers. 
 - Continuously improves existing processes. 

Growth Opportunity

This role is designed for a person who wants to grow from: 

DevOps Engineer

Into: 

Senior DevOps Engineer → DevOps Lead / Infrastructure Lead

As the organization grows, the candidate will have the opportunity to gain practical experience in: 

- Production infrastructure
 - Enterprise ERP deployments
 - CI/CD architecture
 - Deployment automation
 - Infrastructure security
 - Database reliability
 - Disaster recovery
 - Cloud infrastructure
 - On-premises infrastructure
 - Container architecture
 - Infrastructure automation
 - High-volume application deployments

The candidate will be encouraged to take on increasingly complex responsibilities as their capability develops. 

Performance Expectations

The success of this role will be evaluated based on measurable improvements such as: 

- More stable development and testing environments. 
 - Faster and more reliable deployments. 
 - Reduced manual deployment activities. 
 - Better infrastructure documentation. 
 - Reliable backup and recovery processes. 
 - Improved server security. 
 - Reduced deployment failures. 
 - Better monitoring and alerting. 
 - Improved deployment consistency. 
 - Better collaboration with developers. 
 - Ability to support increasing deployment volumes. 
 - Continuous improvement of DevOps processes. 

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a young DevOps professional with strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership and a desire to become technically strong. 

You may have only 1-2 years of experience, but you should be willing to work on real infrastructure, understand how systems actually operate, investigate problems deeply and learn technologies that are required to solve them. 

We Are Looking For Someone Who Thinks: 

"I may not know the solution today, but I can learn, research, test and implement the right solution. "

You should enjoy improving systems rather than simply maintaining them. 

You should be interested in building a DevOps environment that is: 

Secure → Automated → Documented → Reliable → Scalable

and capable of supporting the rapid growth of GwayERP and ThiranERP. 

For quicker communication regarding your application, you may send a WhatsApp message to our official HR number after submitting your application through the website. 

Kindly do not make phone calls, as our recruitment team may not be able to answer individual application enquiries due to the high volume of applicants. 

We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with candidates who are passionate about learning, growing, and building a successful career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited. 

HR Contact Details: 

Whatsapp: +91 7200082250

Email: hr@gwayit. com

data.title: Technical Support Engineer
data.description:
Technical Support Engineer - US Shift

In-Office, Bengaluru | Full-Time | US Shift (Evening/Night IST)

About Triomics

Triomics is building the agentic AI layer for oncology EHRs. Cancer hospitals spend billions on highly trained staff manually reading unstructured patient records - pathology reports, clinical notes, genomic panels - to power workflows like trial matching, registry curation, visit prep, and quality reporting. We replace that manual work with task-driven AI agents that sit inside the EMR and process records at scale, in real time. 

Our platform is trusted by leading cancer centers including Memorial Sloan Kettering, Mount Sinai, and Yale Cancer Center. We have grown 10x in the last year and process millions of oncology medical documents monthly. 

Our investors include Battery Ventures, Lightspeed, General Catalyst, Nexus Venture Partners, and Y Combinator. 

Role Overview

We're looking for a Technical Support Engineer to be our first dedicated support hire, working US shift hours from our Bengaluru office. You'll be the eyes and hands of the engineering team when they're offline - monitoring production systems, triaging issues raised by our customer team, resolving what you can independently, and escalating intelligently when you can't. 

This isn't a ticket-closing role. You'll dig into data, investigate root causes, query databases, check API responses, and package your findings so clearly that when you do need to page an engineer at 2 AM, they can hit the ground running. Between incidents, you'll proactively monitor systems, spot patterns in recurring issues, and build documentation and runbooks that make the whole team more efficient. 

What You'll Work On

Here's what a typical shift looks like: 

- Triage & Investigation: Review tickets raised by the customer team during US hours. Investigate application, API, and data issues by querying databases, reading logs, and checking monitoring dashboards. Resolve straightforward issues independently. 
 - Escalation & Coordination: For complex issues, package the investigation clearly - what's broken, what you've checked, what you suspect - and escalate to the right on-call engineer via Slack or calls. Coordinate with the customer team to keep them updated. 
 - Proactive Monitoring: Monitor production systems, track data quality metrics, and flag anomalies before they become customer-facing issues. You're the early warning system. 
 - Documentation & Automation: Maintain runbooks, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides. Identify repetitive issues and build lightweight automations (scripts, bots, alerts) to reduce manual toil over time. 
 - Pattern Recognition: Track recurring issues, analyze trends, and surface insights to the engineering and product teams that help improve product reliability. 

Tools & Systems You'll Work With

Databases: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch (for querying and investigating data issues)

APIs: REST APIs, Postman (for reproducing and debugging integration issues)

Monitoring: AWS / Azure dashboards, log monitoring tools

Ticketing: Jira, Slack (primary communication with customer team and engineering)

data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Senior Test Engineer - Product Development

About The Role

As a Senior Test Engineer in our Product Development team, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing cost-effective methods for testing and troubleshooting systems and equipment throughout all phases of product development and manufacturing. 

With minimal guidance, you will lead the preparation of test and diagnostic programs, design advanced test fixtures and equipment, and develop comprehensive specifications and procedures for new products. You will independently plan labor, schedules, and equipment requirements for testing and evaluating both standard and specialized devices, while mentoring junior engineers and driving continuous improvement in test methodologies. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Case Development: Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive test strategies and methodologies across multiple product lines, ensuring optimal test coverage and efficiency. 
 - Diagnostic Testing: Develop sophisticated diagnostic testing programs that effectively identify complex performance issues throughout various product development phases. 
 - Test Fixtures Design: Design and oversee the development of advanced test fixtures and equipment that accurately measure and validate product specifications under demanding conditions. 
 - Procedure Development: Create and standardize test setups and procedures that ensure devices comply with industry and company standards, while optimizing for cost and efficiency. 
 - Resource Planning: Independently plan and coordinate resources including labor, schedules, and equipment allocation across multiple projects to optimize testing activities and timelines. 
 - Troubleshooting: Resolve complex technical issues in systems and equipment throughout the development process, applying advanced analytical problem-solving techniques and leading troubleshooting efforts. 
 - Quality Assurance: Develop and optimize testing processes that exceed established quality standards and requirements, driving continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Qualification Testing: Spearhead qualification efforts for multiple product lines to meet market standards and customer requirements, providing technical guidance to cross-functional teams. 
 - PCB Design: Lead the design and oversee the manufacture of complex PCBs for test setups and evaluation boards that enable effective product testing across various applications. 

Must Have Skills

- Test Case Development: Advanced ability to architect comprehensive test strategies that thoroughly validate product functionality against specifications, with expertise in applying and developing novel test principles. 
 - Diagnostic Testing: Deep expertise in creating and executing sophisticated diagnostic programs to identify complex product defects and performance issues, with ability to adapt approaches for challenging scenarios. 
 - Test Fixtures Design: Significant experience designing and developing complex test fixtures and equipment that accurately measure product parameters under varied conditions, with attention to cost optimization. 
 - Procedure Development: Mastery in defining robust test setups and writing comprehensive procedures that ensure consistent testing approaches and results across multiple product lines. 
 - Resource Planning: Strong capability in developing resource strategies for testing activities across multiple projects, including optimizing schedules and equipment allocation for maximum efficiency. 
 - Troubleshooting: Demonstrated expertise in resolving complex technical problems in systems and equipment, including ability to lead troubleshooting efforts and mentor junior engineers. 
 - Quality Assurance: Comprehensive knowledge of quality standards and ability to implement and improve testing processes to exceed quality requirements and industry benchmarks. 
 - Qualification Testing: Thorough understanding of qualification testing methodologies and proven ability to lead qualification efforts for multiple product lines while anticipating market needs. 
 - PCB Design: Advanced technical knowledge of PCB design principles and demonstrated ability to design complex boards for test setups and evaluation purposes across diverse applications. 

Preferred Education And Experience

 - Typically requires 5+ years of relevant experience in test engineering or a related discipline.

We offer a supportive environment focused on professional growth, competitive compensation and benefits, work-life balance, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that make a real impact on the world. 

You'll have access to continuous learning opportunities and mentorship from industry experts. Join us and help create the technologies that bridge the physical and digital worlds, making a tangible difference in how people live, work, and connect.

data.description:
Role: DevSecOps Engineer

Location: Bangalore (4 days WFO)

Team: Product & Engineering

Reports to: Director of Compliance

About Triomics: 

Triomics helps oncology organizations scale clinical research and high-quality data creation without scaling headcount. Our AI platform - powered by OncoLLMTM- automates the operational work behind trial screening, eligibility interpretation, and oncology data abstraction across Prism (clinical trial matching), Harmony (oncology registry + RWE curation), and Symphony (clinician copilot). Built for real-world hospital workflows, Triomics integrates with EHRs and CTMS systems and is deployed with leading academic cancer centers to improve speed, consistency, and audit-ready clinical accuracy. 

Role Overview: 

We are looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to help secure, harden, and maintain scalable, reliable infrastructure in a HIPAA-regulated, SOC 2-audited environment. In this role, you will work closely with engineering teams to build security into our cloud environments and deployment pipelines, and you will remediate security findings directly including in code. 

This role works under the direction of the Compliance and Security function, which sets priorities, requirements, and remediation targets. You will sit with engineers, work in their repositories and pipelines, and ship changes through the same development process they use. You will be responsible for cloud security across Azure and AWS, securing CI/CD pipelines, managing the vulnerability lifecycle from detection through verified closure, and supporting incident response and compliance operations. 

What You'll Do: 

- Secure and harden cloud environments Microsoft Azure and AWS: including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, and configuration baselines. 
 - Build security into CI/CD pipelines: secrets management, dependency and container scanning, SAST/SCA integration, and infrastructure-as-code review. 
 - Remediate findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, and code analysis writing fixes in application code where practical and driving engineering teams to closure where not. 
 - Manage the vulnerability lifecycle: triage, prioritize, track remediation in Jira, and verify closure. 
 - Support incident response and root cause analysis: investigation, containment, and post-incident hardening. 
 - Automate security operations and compliance evidence collection supporting SOC 2 and HIPAA obligations. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to improve security posture without slowing delivery. 
 - Maintain clear documentation for security controls, processes, and operational procedures. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 3-5 years of experience in DevOps, security engineering, or a related role. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Azure and AWS (security services, Entra ID, networking); 
 - Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting able to read application code and write fixes, not just configure tools. 
 - Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD tooling, VS Code. 
 - Solid understanding of Linux system administration, networking concepts, and security hardening practices. 
 - Familiarity with common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10) and remediation patterns. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, and incident response systems. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to document technical processes effectively. 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field. 
 - Equivalent practical experience in technical program management, product delivery, healthcare technology, or software engineering environments may be considered. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience in healthcare, health-tech, or AI/ML-driven products
 - Prior experience in a startup or high-growth company
 - Cloud security certification (AZ-500 or equivalent). 
 - Experience in a HIPAA, SOC 2, or otherwise regulated environment. 

What Success Looks Like: 

- New vulnerabilities stop reaching production: findings are caught in the pipeline or in QA
 - Pen test and vulnerability findings remediated within SLA, with closure verified. Tests come back cleaner each cycle. 
 - Security controls built into pipelines that speed up releases instead of blocking them. 
 - Security discipline is built into how the team works: secure defaults, automated checks, and paved-road patterns mean the remediation backlog shrinks quarter over quarter
 - Clear visibility for Compliance and Engineering on security posture, open risks, and remediation progress

Why Join Us?

- Impact at scale - The AI you build directly accelerates cancer research and improves patient outcomes worldwide
 - Cutting-edge problems - You'll work on some of the hardest and most interesting LLM engineering challenges in a highly regulated industry. 
 - World-class team - Collaborate with experts across AI, engineering, product, and oncology with best-in-industry compensation. 
 - Culture that ships - We're a team that works hard and plays hard (company-sponsored retreats in Bali, Sri Lanka, Goa, and more)

Employment eligibility: 

- Employment is subject to successful completion of applicable pre-employment verification, including identity, education, prior employment, references, and other role-relevant checks, conducted in accordance with applicable law. 

Perks & Benefits: 

- Lunch Provided at the Office - one less daily decision, one happier employee. 
 - Flexible Working Hours - we care about output, not clock-ins. 
 - Health Insurance - comprehensive coverage for you and your family. 
 - Zomato Meal Benefit - breakfast and dinner can be ordered when you come in early or leave late, because effort deserves fuel.

We're Looking:

• Caching strategies with Redis, and knowing when not to cache. 

• Infrastructure as code (Terraform or AWS CDK).

Model Quality · Release Validation · Production Impact Analysis

Location: On-site, HSR Layout, Bengaluru

Level: Mid/Senior Individual Contributor / Lead-track IC

About Triomics

Triomics is building the agentic AI layer for oncology EHRs. Cancer hospitals spend billions on highly trained staff manually reading unstructured patient records - pathology reports, clinical notes, genomic panels - to power workflows like trial matching, registry curation, visit prep, and quality reporting. We replace that manual work with task-driven AI agents that sit inside the EMR and process records at scale, in real time. 

Our platform is trusted by leading cancer centers including Memorial Sloan Kettering, Mount Sinai, and Yale Cancer Center. We have grown 10x in the last year and process millions of oncology medical documents monthly. 

Our investors include Battery Ventures, Lightspeed, General Catalyst, Nexus Venture Partners, and Y Combinator. 

GROWTH PATH

This is an individual contributor role with strong ownership expectations. High performers may be considered for workstream lead or functional lead responsibilities after approximately 12 months, based on demonstrated ownership, delivery, technical judgment, mentoring, cross-functional influence, and ability to reduce dependency on the Director of ML. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an ML Evaluation Engineer to own model quality, regression testing, release validation, and production impact analysis for clinical AI systems. This role sits between applied ML, clinical data, MLOps, and production operations. 

Your job is to ensure that every model or workflow release is measurable, stable, and not degrading important clinical behavior. You will maintain evaluation datasets, create hidden test sets, run regression checks, analyze production issues, and produce release-readiness reports. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build and maintain evaluation frameworks for clinical NLP, LLM, RAG, information extraction, and structured abstraction systems. 
 - Create and manage hidden test datasets that are not directly visible to model developers, reducing overfitting risk. 
 - Define release metrics, regression thresholds, slice-based evaluation, failure-mode tracking, and release/blocker criteria. 
 - Compare model versions and identify performance degradation across clinical segments, document types, clients, data sources, labels, and edge cases. 
 - Work with Clinical AI Data Specialists to design gold sets, hidden test sets, adjudication workflows, and label quality checks. 
 - Work with Research Engineers to understand model changes, expected behavior, and evaluation risks without compromising test-set independence. 
 - Work with MLOps/Data Engineering to monitor production behavior, triage bugs, analyze incident impact, and prioritize fixes. 
 - Create release-readiness reports before production deployment. 
 - Build dashboards, scripts, and automated checks for evaluation, monitoring, regression testing, and model comparison. 
 - Prioritize model bugs based on clinical severity, user impact, frequency, regression risk, and operational urgency. 

WHAT WE EXPECT

- 3-6+ years of experience in ML engineering, data science, model evaluation, ML QA, applied NLP evaluation, or data-heavy quality engineering. 
 - Strong Python and data analysis skills. 
 - Strong understanding of precision/recall/F1, calibration, confidence thresholds, dataset splits, leakage, overfitting, statistical testing, and error analysis. 
 - Experience building evaluation pipelines, benchmark suites, test harnesses, dashboards, or regression frameworks. 
 - Ability to work with imperfect labels, annotation disagreement, clinical ambiguity, and hidden evaluation sets. 
 - Strong independence and judgment; ability to challenge releases when evidence is weak. 
 - Clear written communication for release reports, incident analysis, and quality decisions. 

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with LLM evaluation, RAG evaluation, extraction evaluation, clinical NLP, or healthcare ML. 
 - Experience with model monitoring, production incident analysis, data drift, or observability. 
 - Experience with MLflow, Weights & Biases, Evidently, Great Expectations, DeepEval, Ragas, pytest, Airflow, Prefect, or similar tools. 
 - Clinical or biomedical NLP exposure. 

SUCCESS IN 6 MONTHS

- Establishes a repeatable release validation process. 
 - Maintains hidden evaluation datasets and prevents overfitting to test data. 
 - Produces release reports that leadership, ML, and engineering can trust. 
 - Catches meaningful regressions before release. 
 - Provides reliable impact analysis for production issues and helps prioritize fixes. 

Why Join Triomics

- Impact at scale. The systems your teams build directly power AI workflows that accelerate cancer research and improve patient outcomes. 
 - Cutting-edge problems. Hard, data-intensive systems at the intersection of AI, healthcare, and scale - in a highly regulated industry where reliability is non-negotiable. 
 - World-class team. Work alongside top talent across AI, engineering, and product, with best-in-industry compensation. 
 - Culture that ships. Fast-paced, ownership-driven, with company-sponsored workations. 

Perks & Benefits

- Lunch provided at the office - one less daily decision. 
 - Flexible working hours - we care about output, not clock-ins. 
 - Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family. 
 - Zomato meal benefits for early starts and late nights.

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Staff Digital Design Engineer

About The Role

As a Staff Digital Design Engineer, you will lead complex digital design projects and provide technical leadership for system-level architecture. You'll influence product direction, guide methodology improvements, and lead small technical teams. This position requires deep expertise across multiple technical domains and strong cross-functional collaboration skills to drive innovation and excellence in digital design. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and develop system-level architectures for complex digital designs
 - Lead technical teams on complex digital design projects
 - Guide methodology improvements and best practices across the organization
 - Influence product direction and technical roadmaps
 - Collaborate across functions to drive innovative solutions
 - Engage directly with customers on technical requirements and solutions
 - Mentor engineers and help develop technical talent

Must Have Skills

- System Architecture: Expert ability to define and implement complex digital system architectures
 - Technical Leadership: Demonstrated capability to provide technical direction to engineering teams
 - Multi-Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge across multiple technical domains relevant to digital design
 - Methodology Expertise: Authority in digital design methodologies with ability to drive improvements
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong capability to work across organizational boundaries
 - Customer Engagement: Experience translating customer needs into technical requirements and solutions

Preferred Education And Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
 - 8-12 years of relevant experience in digital design engineering

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Analog Devices, you'll be part of a collaborative and innovative team that's shaping the future of technology. We offer a supportive environment focused on professional growth, competitive compensation and benefits, work-life balance, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that make a real impact on the world. 

Your expertise will shape the future of technology, and you'll be supported by a culture that values continuous advancement and professional growth. Join us and help create the technologies that bridge the physical and digital worlds, making a tangible difference in how people live, work, and connect.

data.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2, 500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories. 

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows-including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence-we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence. 

Role summary

We are looking for an experienced IT Support Team Lead to join our Corporate IT team in India. 

You'll be the bridge between hands-on technical support and IT strategy, providing end-user and site IT support across APAC offices and outsourced contact center locations, supporting around 1, 900 internal and outsourced users. This role partners closely with Global IT teams on systems, network, and office expansion projects, while ensuring SLAs are met, processes are effective, and the team is empowered to deliver secure, reliable IT operations and high-quality user support every day. The role reports directly to the Regional IT Manager. 

Location: Gurgaon-India

Hybrid - Full-time

What You'll Do

- Lead and mentor the India IT support team, setting clear priorities, expectations, and support standards. 
 - Own day-to-day IT operations for the India offices, ensuring reliable support, site readiness, and business continuity. 
 - Keep India's office IT environment stable and scalable through support planning, maintenance coordination, and operational improvements. 
 - Support India business growth by planning IT readiness for onboarding waves, office changes, new teams, and operational scaling. 
 - Manage local escalations and act as the primary IT point of contact for India site management, users, and vendors. 
 - Build strong relationships with local management and understand business needs, acting as a trusted IT partner for the India sites. 
 - Execute Global IT policies and standards within India while ensuring practical adoption in the local environment. 
 - Participate in APAC IT processes, support activities, and project execution when regional alignment or coordination is required. 
 - Ensure the India IT team maintains strong execution discipline, including timely follow-up, clear ownership, and consistent communication on risks and progress. 
 - Maintain India IT processes, runbooks, KPIs, service reviews, and improvement actions. 

Technical Responsibilities

- Provide hands-on support for complex endpoint, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, network, meeting room, and site connectivity issues. 
 - Oversee endpoint and office technology lifecycle, including deployment, configuration, patching, recovery, secure disposal, and stock readiness. 
 - Coordinate local execution of IT projects, maintenance, upgrades, office expansions, and infrastructure changes with Global IT and local stakeholders. 
 - Manage India IT vendors, procurement, contracts, licenses, maintenance renewals, ISP lines, inventory, and service follow-up. 
 - Support audit and compliance readiness by maintaining accurate documentation, asset records, access controls, and evidence of local IT activities. 
 - Track recurring issues, user feedback, site risks, and operational gaps, then drive practical improvements. 
 - Identify and implement automation, AI-enabled tools, dashboards, and process improvements to improve support efficiency and service quality. 

Who You Are

- 5+ years in corporate IT support, systems administration, or site IT operations, including 2+ years in a senior/team lead role, ideally in an MNC or multi-site environment. 
 - Strong hands-on knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Entra ID/Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, Jamf, endpoint lifecycle, and ITSM tools. 
 - Solid understanding of office IT infrastructure, including LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, meeting rooms, video conferencing, and site connectivity. 
 - Experience managing vendors, procurement, inventory, licenses, maintenance, and local service follow-up. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; self-driven, organized, calm under pressure, and able to work independently. 
 - Firewall/switching experience (Palo Alto, HPE, Cisco, Aruba) and automation/scripting capability are strong advantages. 

Personal Attributes

- Professional, trustworthy, accountable, and ownership driven. 
 - Strong communicator and relationship builder across users, local management, vendors, and Global IT teams. 
 - Customer-first, calm under pressure, proactive, organized, and detail-oriented. 
 - Practical problem solver with a continuous improvement mindset and openness to automation/new ways of working. 

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer's partner on the inside

Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 

Do it. Own it. 

Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 

Continuously improve

Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 

Build Each Other Up

Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. 

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today. 

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.
