Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) - Capital, Stress Testing & Credit risk management (FSRM) - Manager

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking experienced Credit Risk and Quality Assurance professionals to join the QA Managed Services team supporting Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance (WCQA) activities, where the role involves: 

- Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations
 - Executing end-to-end QA processes within a managed services operating model while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance frameworks
 - Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities
 - Providing credible challenge to underwriters and portfolio teams on credit decisions, documentation quality, and process adherence 
 - Generating thematic, portfolio-level insights beyond case-specific observations to identify operational and control weaknesses, training gaps, and process deficiencies, thereby supporting continuous improvement and strengthening overall credit risk management practices. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Perform periodic Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) across wholesale lending credit risk activities, including underwriting & credit analysis, credit documentation quality, and overall process adherence. 
 - Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of risk ratings, financial analysis, and credit decisions
 - Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols. 
 - Review credit memos, financial models, covenant structures, and approval workflows
 - Identify and document process gaps, control weaknesses, and quality deficiencies, with a strong focus on thematic trends and systemic issues to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Provide credible challenge to Business/Portfolio Leads and Underwriters on underwriting quality, analytical rigor, and adherence to policies and standards, with appropriate escalation of material issues. 
 - Support the effective identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of wholesale credit risks, ensuring alignment with risk appetite and established risk governance frameworks. 
 - Translate policy and standard requirements into testing strategies and standardized test scripts and support planning efforts to enable efficient and scalable QAR execution. 
 - Prepare high-quality QA deliverables, including QAR workpapers, review summaries, scorecards, and management reports, highlighting key findings, emerging risks, and actionable recommendations. 
 - Generate portfolio-level insights and management information (MI), contributing to governance reporting and enabling informed decision-making by QA leadership. 
 - Track and manage corrective actions and remediation efforts, including follow-ups and validation of issue closure, supported by root cause analysis to minimize recurrence of findings. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining strong working relationships to ensure alignment on QA scope, findings, and continuous enhancement of QA frameworks and protocols. 

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- CA or Bachelor's/master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
 - 7-10 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: wholesale credit underwriting, credit risk management, loan review, credit quality assurance, or internal audit/assurance covering credit processes
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale credit risk lifecycle, including underwriting, monitoring, and credit risk governance (policies, standards, and process adherence)
 - Solid knowledge of risk management and control frameworks relating to corporate or counterparty credit risk; exposure to problem credit assessment and risk mitigation is an added advantage
 - Ability to evaluate credit processes and control design, identify quality gaps, and assess effectiveness of controls within a QA or review function
 - Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions
 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured QA reports and articulate thematic insights for senior stakeholders
 - Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with 1LoD/2LoD teams and stakeholders to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement
 - Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in credit risk management, QA review, and workflow automation. 
 - Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem‐solving skills

Nice to Have Skills: 

- Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, or equivalent
 - Experience building/testing QA test scripts, review checklists, or testing strategies mapped to policy requirements
 - Exposure to portfolio analytics / sampling / scoping methodology for QA coverage
 - Exposure to data analytics tools, reporting dashboards, or workflow tools
 - Experience in managed services or offshore delivery models
 - Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Robotics Engineer (Motion Control)
data.description:
🚀 We're Hiring: Robotics Engineer (Motion Control)
📍Location: Hubli, Karnataka
Experience: 2+ years
Domain: Motion Control | Embedded Firmware | Actuators and Sensors
❗Freshers are not eligible. 
❗Candidates must be willing to relocate. 
About this role
You will own the motion system of a two-axis, remotely operated, stabilised platform for defence use. That covers the software (control loops and real-time firmware) and the hardware (motors, drives, sensors, harnessing) that keep a payload pointed precisely at a target. 
You need working depth in both software and hardware. Core mechanical design is handled by a separate Mechanical Design Engineer. 
This is not a ROS demo or simulation-only role. Your code will drive real motors on hardware that goes to field trials. 

What you'll be doing
Software
Design position, velocity and current control loops and IMU-based stabilisation
Write real-time control firmware in C/C++ on microcontrollers (STM32 or similar)
Implement operator control modes, travel limits and safety interlocks
Take low-latency tracking commands from the vision software and close the loop on them

Hardware
Size and select motors, gearboxes, encoders and brakes against torque, speed, accuracy and weight budgets
Integrate and commission BLDC/PMSM motor drives, IMU and feedback sensors on a two-axis platform
Define wiring harnesses, connectors and power distribution for a battery-powered system
Build test rigs and measure backlash, friction, pointing accuracy and repeatability. 

System
Tune the complete system on real hardware for pointing accuracy and smooth tracking
Support environmental, EMI/EMC and field trials, analyse the logs and fix what they find

Mandatory skills and experience
2+ years of hands-on work on robotic or electromechanical products (robotics, gimbals, drones, automation, EV or defence), covering both firmware and hardware
Software
Embedded C/C++ on microcontrollers, with an RTOS or bare metal
Control fundamentals: PID, cascaded loops, feedforward, and BLDC/PMSM control including FOC
IMUs, encoders and sensor fusion (complementary or Kalman filters)
MATLAB/Simulink or Python for modelling, tuning and test scripts
Hardware
Actuator sizing and selection: BLDC or servo motors, gearboxes, encoders or resolvers
Motor drivers and interfaces: CAN, RS-422/485, SPI, UART
Able to read electrical schematics and mechanical drawings
Comfortable with oscilloscopes, power supplies and data loggers

Good to have
Experience with gimbals, pan-tilt units, antenna positioners, drone flight controllers or robotic arms
Working knowledge of CAD (SolidWorks or similar)
Exposure to ROS 2, MIL-grade harnessing, JSS 55555 or MIL-STD-810

Why join us
Work on real defence hardware that goes to field trials, not demos or PoCs
Own a complete subsystem from design to deployment
Work in a small team directly with mechanical, electronics and software engineers

About Astr Defence
Astr Defence is an award-winning Indian defence manufacturer building next-generation armaments and counter-UAV systems for modern battlefield requirements. 

📩Apply: send your profile to career@astrdefence. com with the subject "Robotics Engineer".

This is a senior leadership opportunity to drive manufacturing test operations for next-generation semiconductor products across high-performance segments including Cloud, Infrastructure, and Automotive.

 - Test method development (Scan/ATPG, MBIST, HSIO, Functional)

data.title: Sr. ML Engineer - Consultant
data.description:
About Ushak Kaal

Ushak Kaal Communications Limited is a technology company that builds and runs applied AI systems for businesses. We work with clients to put AI agents into real customer conversations and make them measurably better over time. 

The Role

We are hiring one hands-on senior engineer to build a shared brain for our AI agents across texting, calling and email. It should remember past lessons, use our team's feedback, and steadily improve how conversations turn into bookings. 

The Problem Today

When an agent makes a mistake, we capture the conversation and edit its instructions by hand. Those fixes don't last or carry across channels. We need every correction to become a lasting lesson that guides future texts, calls and emails. 

Customer accounts stay in the existing CRM. This project reads from it and adds a memory of lessons learned on top. 

What You Will Build

The system should work like coaching a new employee: show it what went wrong, explain what to do instead, save the lesson, and check that it handles similar situations better next time. 

- Capture every conversation. This covers text messages, email threads, call transcripts and relevant call audio, plus confirmed bookings and every point where a person had to step in. 
 - Set goals and rules per channel. Define what good looks like for text, calls and email, including correct pricing, valid bookings and appropriate call handling. 
 - Review conversations automatically. Check them against those rules, flag likely problems, and give our team a simple way to mark what was right or wrong. 
 - Store approved corrections as lessons. Each lesson holds the situation, the better response or action, the reason, and which channels it applies to. 
 - Apply lessons in live conversations. Use relevant lessons in future texts, calls and emails, share them across channels where they fit, keep channel-specific guidance separate, and always use current business and pricing information. 
 - Test before release. Run changes against past mistakes and new situations in all three channels, compare results with the current agent, and keep a one-step way to roll back. 

How Success Is Measured

Success means more confirmed bookings and fewer repeated mistakes across all three channels, measured against today's starting results. 

- Booking rate: the share of conversations that end in a confirmed booking. 
 - Repeated mistakes: how often an error that already has a lesson happens again. 
 - Human intervention: routine conversations run with zero hand-holding, and exceptions hand off cleanly to a person. 
 - Accuracy: correct pricing, valid bookings and appropriate call handling. 

Who We Are Looking For

We want a senior AI or machine learning engineer who has shipped AI agents used by real customers and can write the software behind them. You will own this system and work with the existing engineering team to connect it to our live agents. 

Must Have

- Hands-on experience connecting AI models to texting, calling and email systems, including OpenAI APIs and live voice agents. 
 - Experience storing lessons or feedback and testing improvements against human judgement. 
 - Strong Python or TypeScript, plus solid database skills. 
 - Ability to build a simple internal screen where the team reviews mistakes and enters corrections. 
 - Clear communication, with real examples of improving a live AI agent using feedback and measurable results. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with booking, scheduling or sales-conversion flows. 
 - Familiarity with CRM integrations and consumer-facing service businesses.

🌟 About the role

Build the function that turns specialist human expertise into AI data and evaluations customers can rely on. 

You will work with Joveo leadership to shape the offering, hire the managers who deliver it and establish the standards we commit to. Your remit includes customer delivery and portfolio economics, with influence over the tools and capabilities we develop. 

For someone who has already led complex AI programs, this is an opportunity to put that experience to work across an entire function. You will help decide which opportunities we pursue, what a successful pilot must demonstrate and how we grow without losing control of quality or cost.

- Shape the offering with leadership. Identify the customer problems we can solve well, define the deliverables and acceptance standards, and establish what we need to prove before expanding a service. 
 - Build the delivery leadership team. Hire and develop program managers and specialist leads. Give them clear accountability and decision rights, and plan expert capacity around qualified demand. 
 - Establish quality standards across programs. Set expectations for expert qualification, calibration, adjudication and measurement. Work with technical specialists to challenge weak metrics and keep evaluation conclusions defensible. 
 - Lead senior customer conversations. Translate technical needs into realistic commitments, resolve difficult escalations and use customer feedback to improve the offering. Help turn successful pilots into repeat programs. 
 - Own delivery economics across the portfolio. Understand the full cost of expert supply, technical integration and rework. Partner with commercial teams on pricing, scope changes and capacity decisions. 
 - Shape tooling priorities with engineering. Turn recurring delivery problems into reusable capabilities, make deliberate choices about automation and maintain strong practices for customer data protection and traceability. 

🎯 What we're looking for

- You have built or led a delivery, operations or technical program function in AI data, evaluation, applied AI or a closely related field. 
 - You have hired or developed managers and held responsibility for complex customer outcomes. You can build a team that makes good decisions without every issue reaching you. 
 - You are credible in both a technical review and a commercial discussion. You can challenge an evaluation design, identify weak acceptance criteria and work through the implications for delivery and cost. 
 - You have made consequential operating decisions: narrowing an offering, resetting a customer commitment, changing a quality system or rebuilding a team. You can explain your reasoning and the results.

data.description:
Company Description

ComplianceMedQRA provides regulatory and quality consulting services to medical device, software, pharmaceutical, and life sciences organizations across the full product lifecycle, from early regulatory strategy to market authorization and post-market compliance. The team's expertise covers EU MDR, IVDR, FDA pathways, SaMD, AI-enabled medical devices, and GCC/UAE frameworks, including MOHAP/EDE, UAE PDPL, and healthcare data security requirements. The company also offers QraOne, an AI-enabled eQMS platform designed for MedTech, SaMD, IVD, and life sciences organizations, translating regulatory and quality experience into automated workflows that streamline compliance and improve audit readiness across EU, U. S. , and GCC regulations. 

Role Description

We are looking for a hands-on Software Development Team Lead to lead and contribute directly to the development of a SaaS-based software platform. It is not a purely managerial role. The successful candidate must be a strong full-stack developer who is comfortable actively coding, designing solutions, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and building key parts of the platform while also coordinating and supporting the development team. You will take ownership of day-to-day software development activities, help translate product requirements into technical solutions, coordinate development priorities, review code, support releases, and ensure that the platform remains secure, scalable, reliable, and maintainable. You will also work closely with product, QA/RA, Sales, and Customer-facing teams to understand business and customer requirements, evaluate feedback, and prioritize product improvements. Experience developing SaaS platforms, document management systems, workflow applications, eQMS platforms, compliance software, enterprise management systems, or similar business applications would be a strong advantage. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate the software development team while remaining hands-on with coding and technical implementation. 
 - Develop, maintain, and improve both frontend and backend functionality. 
 - Contribute to system architecture, technical planning, and key development decisions. 
 - Translate product and business requirements into clear technical tasks, priorities, and development plans. 
 - Review code, troubleshoot technical issues, and provide guidance and support to other developers. 
 - Develop and maintain APIs, databases, integrations, authentication, user roles and permissions, workflows, and document management functionality. 
 - Support the development of AI-enabled features, including LLM and RAG-based integrations. 
 - Work closely with Sales and Customer teams to understand customer needs, gather feedback, and prioritize product improvements and development requests. 
 - Coordinate testing, bug fixing, deployments, releases, and continuous platform improvements. 
 - Support and improve DevOps and CI/CD processes. 
 - Ensure the platform remains secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable. 
 - Take ownership of technical delivery, track development progress, and communicate key risks, blockers, or delays. 

Qualifications and Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of professional software development experience, including at least 1-2 years in a technical lead or software development team leadership role. 
 - Strong hands-on full-stack development experience. 
 - Experience managing and coordinating software development projects, priorities, and releases. 
 - Experience with modern web applications, APIs, databases, Git, and cloud-based deployment. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues. 
 - Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams. 

Preferred Technical Skills

- Experience with some of the following technologies and areas would be an advantage: AI/LLM/RAG: LLM integrations, RAG-based applications, AI APIs
 - Frontend: React. js, Next. js, JavaScript, TypeScript
 - Backend: Python, Django, FastAPI, Node. js
 - Database: PostgreSQL
 - Cloud: AWS or similar cloud platforms
 - DevOps: Git, CI/CD, Docker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes
 - Testing: Pytest, Jest, Cypress, Playwright, or similar testing frameworks
 - Experience in healthcare, MedTech, life sciences, or other regulated industries would be an advantage, but is not required. 

Language

Excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of additional languages is an advantage. 

Location

Remote - preference for candidates based in India, Nepal, or elsewhere in South Asia. Candidates from other locations are also encouraged to apply. 

Please note: This role requires full professional commitment and availability. It is not suitable for freelancers or consultants. 

Interested?

Apply via LinkedIn or send your CV to info@compliancemedqra. net

data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

Staff Design Verification Engineer

About The Role

As a Staff Design Verification Engineer at Analog Devices, you will provide technical leadership in developing verification strategies for our most complex analog and mixed-signal designs. You'll architect sophisticated verification environments, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate across organizational boundaries to ensure product quality and reliability. 

Working with limited direction, you'll apply your deep technical expertise to solve critical verification challenges while representing ADI in interactions with key customers and industry partners. This senior position involves significant influence on verification methodology adoption and technical decisions that impact crucial organizational objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

- Strategic Leadership: Architect and lead verification strategy for complex digital and mixed-signal designs, acting as a key contributor in critical verification environments
 - Verification Architecture: Design and implement sophisticated UVM-based verification environments that ensure comprehensive test coverage and design quality
 - Technical Mentorship: Guide and develop junior engineers, serving as a resource for colleagues with less experience while modeling professional behaviors
 - Cross-Functional Direction: Coordinate work across organizational lines, collaborating with design teams on verification requirements and sign-off criteria
 - Problem Resolution: Lead complex debugging efforts across RTL and gate-level simulations with minimal direction, developing resolutions that require in-depth analysis
 - Coverage Closure: Drive functional and code coverage closure using advanced verification methodologies to ensure design accuracy
 - Post-Silicon Support: Lead post-silicon validation activities, contributing expertise to address critical issues
 - Customer Representation: Serve as principal customer contact on projects, representing ADI's technical excellence and customer commitment

Must Have Skills

- SystemVerilog and UVM Expertise: Expert-level knowledge of SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology for architecting advanced verification environments for complex designs
 - Test Planning and Strategy: Demonstrated ability to develop comprehensive verification plans that drive coverage-driven methodologies and verification closure
 - Mixed-Signal Verification: Deep understanding of mixed-signal design principles and verification methodologies, with experience implementing sophisticated verification approaches
 - Debugging Mastery: Advanced debugging skills across multiple design abstractions, with proven ability to resolve complex verification issues with minimal direction
 - EDA Tool Proficiency: Extensive experience with electronic design automation tools (Cadence/Synopsys) and formal verification techniques
 - Scripting and Automation: Advanced proficiency in Python, Perl, TCL, or Shell scripting for creating sophisticated verification automation frameworks
 - Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence verification direction, mentor junior engineers, and drive methodology adoption across teams

Preferred Education And Experience

- MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 7-10+ years of relevant digital design verification experience, with particular emphasis on mixed-signal verification

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Analog Devices, you'll be part of a collaborative and innovative team that's shaping the future of technology. We offer a supportive environment focused on professional growth, competitive compensation and benefits, work-life balance, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that make a real impact on the world. 

Your expertise will shape the future of technology, and you'll be supported by a culture that values continuous advancement and professional growth. Join us and help create the technologies that bridge the physical and digital worlds, making a tangible difference in how people live, work, and connect. 

For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U. S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position - except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3) - may have to go through an export licensing review process. 

Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group. 

Job Req Type: Experienced

Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time

Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days

Location: Bommasandra Industrial Area, Bengaluru

Job Summary

We are looking for a Quality Engineer with hands-on experience in CNC Turning, VMC machining, and automotive/precision component manufacturing. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining dimensional and process quality of machined automobile components through shop-floor inspection and process control. 

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct first-piece, in-process, and final inspection of CNC/VMC machined components.

 - Support PPAP, APQP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and IATF 16949 requirements. 

Required Skills

- Strong practical knowledge of CNC Turning & VMC machining quality. 
 - Good knowledge of GD&T, engineering drawings, machining tolerances, and precision measurement. 
 - Experience in automotive components / auto ancillary / precision machined parts is preferred. 
 - Hands-on shop-floor quality inspection experience is essential.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering - owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions. 

This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.

Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets

data.title: Manager Instrumentation & Commissioning HVAC
data.description:
CLIENT: Global player in energy efficient HVAC/Air cooling technology with product range comprising AHU, Precision CRAC/CRAH, VRF, HVAC System and Clean Room Cooling Technology. 

Position Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Electrical and Instrument Commissioning Engineer to lead the commissioning activities for Air Handling Units (AHUs). The candidate will be responsible for verifying electrical installations, integrating control systems, calibrating instrumentation, testing field devices, and optimizing energy efficiency. This role requires close collaboration with project teams, vendors, and subcontractors to ensure the successful commissioning and handover of AHU systems. 

KEY DRIVERS: 

- Electrical System Verification: 
 - Verify the installation and wiring of power distribution systems and Electronically Commutated (EC) fans, ensuring proper earthing and bonding for system safety and reliability. 
 - Control System Integration: 
 - Commission and integrate the Building Management System (BMS) interface, validate control loops, and ensure seamless integration with other HVAC components to optimize overall performance. 
 - Instrumentation Calibration: 
 - Calibrate and configure sensors, transmitters, and actuators. Perform loop checks to ensure accurate signal transmission and optimal system functionality. 
 - Field Devices Testing: 
 - Inspect and rigorously test instrumentation wiring, actuators, dampers and Pressure Independent Control Valves (PICVs) to confirm proper operation and response to control signals. 
 - Safety Systems: 
 - Test and validate the operation of emergency stop circuits, interlocks, overload protection devices, and safety systems, including smoke detectors and fire dampers, to ensure operational safety. 
 - Troubleshooting: 
 - Identify and resolve issues related to electrical wiring, control logic, sensor accuracy, and actuator functionality through methodical testing and analysis. 
 - Documentation: 
 - Develop and execute detailed commissioning plans, systematically document all test results, and prepare comprehensive as-built documentation for future reference. 
 - Team Coordination: 
 - Collaborate closely with project teams, vendors, and subcontractors to ensure seamless commissioning, successful system integration, and effective handover of AHU systems. 
 -

INCUMBENT PROFILE

- Engineer with 12+ years experience in electrical and instrument commissioning for HVAC / AHUs. Strong understanding of EC fan technology, BMS integration. 
 - 10-12 years experience in electrical and instrument commissioning for HVAC systems, particularly AHUs. 
 - Ability to read and understand electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs).

data.title: Programme Manager
data.description:
About the Company: 

The National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP) is the central platform of the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY). Farmer enrolment, premium calculation, loss intimation, claim settlement and payment through PFMS all run on it. It is used by farmers, banks, CSCs, insurance companies, State Governments and DA&FW, and is supported by a set of ancillary applications - the Farmer App, AIDE, CCE-Agri, CLAP, WINDS, YES-TECH, CROPIC, KRPH and the WhatsApp bot. NeGD is taking over the technical and managerial ownership of NCIP and these applications from the incumbent vendors. The first year covers the takeover, the thirty-five Schedule-II modules, and the consolidation of fourteen surfaces into a farmer app, an intermediary app, a field evidence app and the NCIP portal. Three years of operations and maintenance follow, across three full Kharif and Rabi cycles. The platform runs on Node. js services with a React front end, on MS-SQL and Elasticsearch, with Android applications in the field. The Node. js and React versions in use are past active support and are to be upgraded as part of the work. 

About the Role: 

Own the programme plan across the takeover, the thirty-five Schedule-II modules and the three years of operations and maintenance. Run the governance cadence with DA&FW - weekly progress, monthly steering, and the decisions log. Lead the handover from the incumbent vendors until source code, credentials, environments and runbooks are in NeGD custody and a release can be deployed and reversed without them. Hold the agency to the agreed staffing, timelines and service levels, and certify its deliverables for payment. Maintain the risk, issue and dependency registers, including dependencies on insurance companies, banks, PFMS, States and the KRP agency. Plan capacity and releases around the Kharif and Rabi enrolment and claim windows. Prepare the material for Parliamentary questions, audit observations and reviews by senior officers. Manage the change requests that follow scheme policy decisions, with an impact note on scope, cost and timeline for each.

- Own the programme plan across the takeover, the thirty-five Schedule-II modules and the three years of operations and maintenance. 
 - Run the governance cadence with DA&FW - weekly progress, monthly steering, and the decisions log.

 - Hold the agency to the agreed staffing, timelines and service levels, and certify its deliverables for payment. 
 - Maintain the risk, issue and dependency registers, including dependencies on insurance companies, banks, PFMS, States and the KRP agency. 
 - Plan capacity and releases around the Kharif and Rabi enrolment and claim windows. 
 - Prepare the material for Parliamentary questions, audit observations and reviews by senior officers. 
 - Manage the change requests that follow scheme policy decisions, with an impact note on scope, cost and timeline for each. 

Qualifications: 

- Essential. B. E. or B. Tech in any discipline, or MCA, from a recognised University or Institution. 
 - Desirable. MBA or PGDM. PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent programme management certification. 

Required Skills: 

Experience

- Minimum 15 years of experience after qualification, including at least 7 years managing large IT programmes with multiple vendors. 
 - Running a programme of 25 or more people across development, operations and helpdesk. 
 - Taking over a live system from an incumbent vendor, or handing one over, without service disruption. 
 - Managing an application that carries financial transactions or benefit payments at national scale.

 - Delivery methods: Agile and hybrid delivery for government projects (Essential)
 - Reporting: MS Excel, Power BI, briefing notes and presentations (Essential)

Preferred Skills: 

Experience

- Desirable. Programme management on a Government of India platform, and familiarity with GFR 2017, GeM and government procurement. 
 - Work in agriculture, insurance, or a Direct Benefit Transfer scheme. 

Skills

- Procurement: GFR 2017, GeM, RFP and RFQ processes (Desirable)

data.title: Shopfloor Apps Software Engineer - Cloud & Integration
data.description:
About Us

PHINIA: Advancing sustainability today, powering a cleaner tomorrow. 

PHINIA is an independent, market-leading, premium solutions and components provider with over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, with a strong brand portfolio that includes DELPHI®, DELCO REMY® and HARTRIDGETM. With over 12, 500 employees across 43 locations in 20 countries, PHINIA is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA. 

At PHINIA, we provide fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket products and solutions of the highest quality - developed and manufactured responsibly - that are designed to enhance efficiency and reduce the environmental impact of vehicles, industrial machinery, and other applications. In doing so, we contribute to a cleaner tomorrow, treat our people and surrounding communities with respect, and hold ourselves accountable to robust ethical standards. 

Our Culture

PHINIA promotes and cultivates an inclusive culture and diverse perspectives, strives to maintain its reputation for excellence, thrives on the power of collaboration, and fosters the development of our talented employees. We believe in making a positive impact through our business and actions, and we take our collective responsibility seriously. 

Career Opportunities

We believe in building a brighter tomorrow for our employees as well as our customers and encourage you to learn about our long history, strong culture, new technologies, and future vision. We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Join us on this shared journey toward a brighter tomorrow. 

Job Purpose

PHINIA is seeking a Shopfloor Apps Software Engineer with a cloud and integration focus to build and maintain the data pipelines and applications that ingest IoT/manufacturing data, process it, and surface it in dashboards and apps for plant stakeholders. This role owns the portfolio of cloud side applications and integrations that turn raw machine data into usable information - from streaming ingestion through to the dashboards that plant managers use daily. The engineer works under the technical direction of a Bucharest based architecture lead and coordinates with a local delivery coordinator in Bangalore. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain end‐to‐end IoT and manufacturing data pipelines - from plant‐floor data sources (sensors, PLCs, OPC‐UA gateways) through cloud ingestion (Azure IoT Hub, Event Hub, Kafka, MQTT) to storage and visualization. 
 - Develop and maintain production‐facing applications: OEE dashboards, downtime trackers, quality reporting tools, and operator‐facing UIs using React/Angular frontends and . NET/Node. js/Python backends. 
 - Build secure, event‐driven integrations between shopfloor solutions and MES, ERP (SAP), PLM, SCADA/PLC, historians, and IoT platforms using REST/GraphQL APIs, MQTT/AMQP, OPC‐UA, and middleware. 
 - Own CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), infrastructure‐as‐code, and environment promotion across dev/test/production for shopfloor applications. 
 - Implement and maintain real‐time streaming architectures handling high‐throughput manufacturing data with proper handling of backpressure, out‐of‐order events, schema evolution, and failure recovery. 
 - Write and optimize non‐trivial SQL queries against production databases for data mining, reporting, and integration validation; design data models for time‐series and manufacturing datasets. 
 - Implement observability (logs/metrics/traces), SLOs/SLIs, and proactive alerting using Grafana, Prometheus, or Azure Monitor; ensure high availability during production shifts. 
 - Troubleshoot integration failures end‐to‐end: capture raw payloads, compare against schema, identify encoding issues, trace through network layers, and resolve root cause across JSON, XML, and SOAP integrations. 
 - Develop and maintain real‐time dashboards, machine connectors, and monitoring tools; integrate time‐series data from sensors/PLCs/historians for actionable insights (OEE, scrap, downtime, anomaly trends). 
 - Ensure all solutions meet PHINIA's standards for reliability, cybersecurity, ISA/IEC 62443 alignment, Zero Trust, data integrity, and operational performance. 
 - Apply automation‐first engineering: test automation, containerization, repeatable builds, and standardized templates/components for reuse across global sites. 
 - Explore and implement edge AI/computer‐vision capabilities (e. g. , defect detection) and cloud/edge patterns (Azure IoT, Functions, Event Hub, Kafka) where value is demonstrated. 
 - Produce and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, data‐flow diagrams, configuration guides, and runbooks. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field
 - 4-7 years of experience in cloud engineering, integration engineering, or software engineering for manufacturing/industrial environments
 - Hands‐on experience with Azure cloud services (IoT Hub, Functions, Event Hub, App Service) or equivalent cloud platform
 - Experience with real‐time streaming technologies (Kafka, MQTT, NiFi, Azure Event Hub) including handling of backpressure, deduplication, and late‐arriving data
 - Strong programming skills in Python, Node. js, C#/. NET, or Java; modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular) for dashboard development
 - SQL fluency (joins, window functions, query optimization) for data mining against production and analytics databases; comfort with time‐series data modeling
 - Big data awareness: familiarity with data lake architectures, batch and streaming ingestion patterns, and time‐series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, ADX)
 - Fluency reading and debugging JSON, XML, and SOAP payloads across integration boundaries
 - Basic algorithm understanding (sorting, searching, graph traversal, complexity analysis)
 - CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions or equivalent); containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
 - Experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor)
 - Understanding of IT/OT security principles (ISA/IEC 62443, Zero Trust) and manufacturing network basics
 - Integration experience with MES/SCADA/PLC/ERP/PLM using REST APIs, OPC‐UA, MQTT/AMQP
 - Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ‐900, AZ‐204) - preferred
 - Docker/Kubernetes certifications - preferred

What We Offer

We provide compensation and benefits programs intended to attract, motivate, reward, and retain an incredibly talented, globally diverse workforce at all levels within our organization. Our compensation programs are informed by market data and business needs, and we are committed to providing equitable and competitive compensation. We are committed to providing our team with quality and competitive benefit programs, including health and well-being resources, family-centric policies, and an agile workplace program, where not precluded by collective bargaining agreements or national statutory plans. Plans are benchmarked for competitiveness and value. 

We provide formal development opportunities at all levels and stages of employee careers. These opportunities are delivered in a variety of formats to make our portfolio of solutions agile, sustainable, and scalable to support our employees in developing the skills needed to succeed. 

What We Believe

- Product Leadership - Innovation that brings value to our customers 
 - Humility - Seeking out diverse perspectives and working collaboratively 
 - Inclusivity - Recognizing our differences makes us stronger; we are bold and intentional 
 - Net-Zero - Committed to energy efficiency, waste reduction and beneficial reuse 
 - Integrity - Taking responsibility for our decisions and doing what is right 
 - Accountability - Taking ownership of our actions and driving results

SAFETY

You will consistently hear us say Safety First! We are committed to continually improving our strong safety performance supporting the health and wellness of our employees!

We also believe employee health and safety is everyone's responsibility. We encourage safety learning and collaboration to help employees understand and follow applicable safety policies, standards, and procedures and identify opportunities to minimize or eliminate risk. Work is expected to be conducted in a manner that stresses the importance of preventing incidents and illnesses, including attending all required safety meetings and trainings. It is expected that all incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions are immediately reported to the direct manager, Human Resources, or Safety Representative. 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

PHINIA is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. 

VISA SPONSORSHIP

PHINIA does provide sponsorship for employment visa status based on business need. However, for this role, applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full-time basis, in the country where the position is currently based. 

NO UNAUTHORIZED REFERRALS FROM RECRUITERS & VENDORS

Please note that PHINIA does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or offers from third party recruiters or staffing agencies associated with any published or unpublished employment opportunities. Any unsolicited information sent to PHINIA will be considered as unencumbered and free from any fee or charge whatsoever. Only members of our Human Resources Team have the authority to engage or authorize recruiting services, which must be agreed upon before the unsolicited resume or offer is received. 

GLOBAL TERMS OF USE AND PRIVACY STATEMENT

Carefully read the PHINIA Privacy Policy before using this website. Your ability to access and use this website and apply for a job at PHINIA are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms. 

Please access the linked document by clicking here, select the geographical area where you are applying for employment, and review. 

Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms. 

Career Scam Disclaimer: 

PHINIA makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third-party website. To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by PHINIA. Applicants should never provide their national ID numbers, birth dates, credit card numbers, bank account information or other private information when communicating with prospective employers or responding to employment opportunities online. About the Company: 

The National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP) is the central platform of the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY). Farmer enrolment, premium calculation, loss intimation, claim settlement and payment through PFMS all run on it. It is used by farmers, banks, CSCs, insurance companies, State Governments and DA&FW, and is supported by a set of ancillary applications - the Farmer App, AIDE, CCE-Agri, CLAP, WINDS, YES-TECH, CROPIC, KRPH and the WhatsApp bot. NeGD is taking over the technical and managerial ownership of NCIP and these applications from the incumbent vendors. The first year covers the takeover, the thirty-five Schedule-II modules, and the consolidation of fourteen surfaces into a farmer app, an intermediary app, a field evidence app and the NCIP portal. Three years of operations and maintenance follow, across three full Kharif and Rabi cycles. The platform runs on Node. js services with a React front end, on MS-SQL and Elasticsearch, with Android applications in the field. The Node. js and React versions in use are past active support and are to be upgraded as part of the work. 

About the Role: 

This role is a Business Analyst position on NeGD's rolls, responsible for supporting the takeover, enhancement, and ongoing operations and maintenance of the National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP) and its ancillary applications, working closely with DA&FW and other stakeholders across the full lifecycle from requirements to release. 

Responsibilities: 

- Document the As-Is processes of NCIP and the ancillary applications, from scheme notification through to grievance closure.

 - Turn policy decisions and circulars from DA&FW into change requests the development team can size and build. 
 - Specify the data exchanged with insurance companies, banks, PFMS, States, AgriStack and the KCC ecosystem.

Desirable: 

- Graduate or postgraduate degree in Agriculture, Agricultural Economics or Insurance.

Job Title - QA/QC Engineer - Electrical & Instrumentation

Location: Dholera, Gujarat (On-site)

Flexibility with Travel: 10-20% as per requirement

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer - Electrical & Instrumentation to oversee quality assurance and quality control activities for electrical and instrumentation installation, testing, pre-commissioning, and commissioning works on large industrial and semiconductor projects. The role requires strong expertise in quality management systems, inspection planning, FAT/SAT participation, NCR management, and coordination with multidisciplinary project teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare, review, implement, and maintain Project Quality Plans (PQP), Quality Assurance Plans (QAP), Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), and Inspection Test Reports (ITR). 
 - Inspect and verify installation of HT/LT switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, MCC/PCC panels, bus ducts, cable trays, earthing systems, and power distribution equipment. 
 - Witness and support FAT/SAT activities, vendor inspections, factory testing, and site acceptance activities. 
 - Perform and witness electrical testing activities including insulation resistance (IR), continuity, grounding/earthing, relay testing, transformer testing, and functional testing. 
 - Verify instrumentation installation, loop checking, calibration activities, hook-up compliance, and P&ID requirements. 
 - Review and close NCRs, punch points, and non-conformities through structured RCA and CAPA methodologies. 
 - Coordinate with engineering, construction, commissioning, vendor, consultant, and client teams to resolve quality-related issues. 
 - Maintain quality dossiers, turnover packages, inspection records, test reports, and project QA/QC documentation.

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

Help shape the future of mining and metals projects across Australia and India. As a Senior Control & Instrumentation (C&I) Designer, you'll play a key role in delivering complex mining, metals, and material handling projects that support the energy transition, operational decarbonization, and sustainable resource development. Working as part of Jacobs' growing India-based mining and metals team, you'll collaborate closely with our Australian Resources Hub and global engineering specialists to deliver high-quality solutions for major clients. 

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to lead C&I design activities across the full project lifecycle, from concept studies and FEED through to detailed engineering and EPC delivery. Your work will directly influence project outcomes by ensuring safe, efficient, and integrated instrumentation and control system designs. You'll work within multidisciplinary teams, contribute to global project delivery, and support the development of junior designers through technical guidance and mentoring. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and execute Control & Instrumentation design and drafting activities across concept, FEED, detailed engineering, and EPC project phases. 
 - Prepare, review, and check C&I design deliverables, including instrument location layouts, cable routing layouts, cable schedules, hook-up drawings, junction box layouts, control room layouts, and installation details. 
 - Develop and maintain engineering documentation, including P&IDs, instrument indexes, I/O lists, loop diagrams, termination diagrams, wiring schematics, and interconnection drawings. 
 - Collaborate with process, electrical, mechanical, piping, and civil disciplines to deliver coordinated and clash-free designs. 
 - Participate in model reviews, design reviews, and interdisciplinary checks to ensure compliance with project requirements and applicable standards. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to designers and drafters, promoting quality, consistency, and effective delivery. 
 - Ensure compliance with client specifications, engineering standards, project procedures, and relevant industry codes. 
 - Partner with clients, vendors, and Australia/New Zealand (ANZ) project teams to resolve technical and design challenges. 

Here's what you'll need

We're looking for someone who can demonstrate the following capabilities

- 11+ years of experience in delivering high-quality C&I design and drafting outputs across multiple project phases within mining, metals, and material handling industrial environments. 
 - Produce and review a broad range of C&I engineering deliverables, including drawings, schematics, layouts, and instrumentation documentation. 
 - Apply practical knowledge of PLC, DCS, SCADA, field instrumentation, control systems, and industrial communication networks to project delivery. 
 - Expert proficiency in AutoCAD, MicroStation and related engineering design software Experience with OpenPlant Bentley or similar 3D software is a plus. 
 - Coordinate successfully with multidisciplinary engineering teams to achieve integrated design outcomes. 
 - Build productive working relationships with clients, vendors, and geographically distributed project teams. 
 - Prioritise and manage multiple project deliverables while working independently and collaboratively within global project environments. 
 - Provide technical direction, quality oversight, and mentoring to designers and drafters. 
 - Contribute experience gained in mining, metals, and material handling projects. Experience in power, process, or other heavy industrial facilities would also be beneficial. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. As the Team Lead for Initiator & Protocol Engineering, you will spearhead the critical bridge between our industry-leading FlashArray and the Linux/VMWare ecosystems. You will drive the performance and reliability of our storage protocol stacks-spanning NVMe over Fabrics and Fibre Channel-ensuring Pure Storage remains the gold standard for enterprise connectivity. Collaborating closely with cross-functional hardware and software teams, you'll mentor a high-caliber engineering squad to solve complex kernel-level challenges and influence the global Linux upstream community. 

What You'll Do

- Own the Protocol Lifecycle: Lead the development, maintenance, and optimization of Linux and VMWare initiator stacks (NVMeoF, FC-SCSI, iSCSI) and target drivers to ensure seamless, high-performance integration with Pure FlashArray.

data.title: Manager - Senior AI/ML Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with 5-9 years of experience designing, building, and operating production-grade AI and Generative AI solutions. You will provide hands-on technical leadership across solution architecture, data and model pipelines, agentic systems, evaluation, cloud deployment, and observability. The ideal candidate pairs deep AI/ML expertise with strong software-engineering discipline and sound architectural judgment and can lead delivery for complex enterprise use cases. 

What You Will Do

- Own AI/ML and GenAI solutions end to end - data pipelines, model and prompt workflows, APIs, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous optimization. 
 - Design enterprise RAG platforms: secure ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid/vector search, reranking, citations, and access-aware retrieval. 
 - Build production agentic systems using tool/function calling, structured outputs, planning and memory, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop approvals, failure recovery, and auditable traces. 
 - Architect and operate MCP clients and servers that expose enterprise tools, resources, and prompts - with secure transports (stdio, Streamable HTTP), authentication, least-privilege access, tenant isolation, and protection against prompt injection and unsafe tool execution. 
 - Integrate agents with enterprise systems (document repositories, source control, ticketing, databases, ERP/CRM, cloud services) through reusable connectors and governance patterns. 
 - Define evaluation strategies and quality gates for accuracy, groundedness, safety, latency, and cost, and establish end-to-end observability for agent and MCP activity. 
 - Build production services in Python with strong engineering practices, GitHub-based CI/CD, and cloud-native deployment on AWS or Azure using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Partner with product, architecture, data science, security, and business stakeholders; lead design and architecture reviews and mentor engineers. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5-9 years developing production software, data, ML, or AI solutions, including hands-on delivery of GenAI/LLM applications. 
 - Advanced Python and practical experience with data/ML libraries (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent). 
 - Strong grasp of LLM and agentic architecture: prompting, context engineering, embeddings, RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, orchestration, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Proven experience designing APIs, distributed services, and event-driven or asynchronous workflows with secure tool execution for AI agents. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub and CI/CD, including automated build, test, security-scan, and deployment workflows. 
 - Strong experience with AWS or Azure and containerized deployment using Docker; Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code experience expected.

Preferred Experience

This role combines technical leadership, production support, operational readiness, incident recovery, automation and continual service improvement within a complex telecom OSS environment.

data.title: Principal Engineer - AI Engineering
data.description:
Job Description Summary

Entwirft, programmiert, dokumentiert, testet und behebt Fehler, die beim Erstellen und Warten von Anwendungen und Frameworks auftreten, die in einem Software-Release-Lebenszyklus zu einem digitalen Produkt führen. Beeinträchtigt die Fähigkeit des Teams, Service, Qualität und Aktualität der Ziele zu erreichen. Die Rolle unterliegt operativen Richtlinienzielen. Innerhalb der Rolle besteht eine moderate Autonomie. Um die gewünschten Ergebnisse zu erzielen, ist ein hohes Maß an operativem Urteilsvermögen erforderlich. 

Job Description

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

- Entwerfen, erstellen, stellen bereit und warten Softwareanwendungen und -dienste. Arbeiten in den Bereichen Maschine, Cloud, Plattformen und/oder Anwendungen. Verantwortlich für den gesamten Software-Lebenszyklus einschließlich Aktivitäten wie Anforderungsanalyse, Dokumentation/Verfahren und Implementierung. 
 - Erfordert Fachwissen innerhalb der Funktion. Beeinflusst die Strategieentwicklung für den Verantwortungsbereich, einschließlich Kontrolle der Ressourcen, und beeinflusst die Richtlinienformulierung. 
 - Wertet einfache interne und externe geschäftliche Herausforderungen aus und empfiehlt Best Practices zur Verbesserung von Produkten, Prozessen oder Dienstleistungen. Bleibt über Branchentrends informiert, die die Arbeit informieren können. 
 - Verwendet ein hohes Maß an Urteilsvermögen, um Entscheidungen zu treffen und komplexe Aufgaben oder Probleme in den Bereichen Betrieb, Produktmanagement, Fertigung, Technologie oder Konstruktion zu lösen. Hat die Fähigkeit, die Qualität der bereitgestellten Informationen zu beurteilen und Stakeholdern relevante Fragen zu stellen. Kann neue Lösungen für Probleme anbieten, die außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter liegen, und ist in der Lage, Empfehlungen zu erstellen und abzugeben. Verwendet mehrere interne und einige externe Quellen außerhalb der eigenen Funktion, um eine Entscheidung zu treffen. 
 - Kann Funktionsteams oder Projekte mit minimalem Ressourcenbedarf, Risiko und/oder moderater Komplexität leiten. Kommuniziert schwierige Konzepte und kann die Optionen anderer zu bestimmten Themen beeinflussen. Kann andere anleiten, einen anderen Standpunkt einzunehmen. 

Grundqualifikationen

- Diese Rolle erfordert umfangreiche Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule. 

Gewünschte Eigenschaften

- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Probleme zu analysieren und zu lösen. Nachweislich eFähigkeit, Programme/Projekte zu leiten. Fähigkeit, Programme zu dokumentieren, zu planen, zu vermarkten und auszuführen. Dokumentierte Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. Hinweis: Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind. Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden. Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern. Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern. 

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

data.title: Integration Architect
data.description:
About Refold AI

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants. 

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM. 

Refold AI has raised $6. 5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital. 

About this role

The Integration Architect is Refold's resident integration expert who owns the architecture for our hardest enterprise problems. You've spent years in the integration space, know iPaaS platforms inside out, and have a deep, hands-on command of APIs and how enterprise systems talk to each other. You set the technical approach where there's no playbook and serve as the primary technical point of contact for enterprise accounts. 

- Team: Senior technical IC role within the delivery org, owning enterprise architecture and implementations
 - Building: Mission-critical agentic AI integrations at enterprise scale - the problems for which no playbook exists yet. 
 - You'll work with CTOs, VPs of engineering, and integration leaders at Fortune 500 enterprises and $50M+ ARR software companies. 

What you'll do: 

- Own the architecture for the hardest problems. Design complex, mission-critical agentic AI integrations spanning Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, Workday, ServiceNow, and modern data ecosystems, especially where no playbook exists yet. 
 - Be the technical POC for enterprise accounts. Serve as the senior technical voice enterprise customers trust and the technical owner of their most important integrations. 
 - Make the decisive technical calls. Own the hard decisions on data modelling, agentic orchestration, authentication, idempotency, error handling, and performance under real enterprise load. 
 - Speak credibly to enterprise security. Be the trusted technical voice with customers' security and compliance teams on VPC, mTLS, SSO, and our SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 / HIPAA posture. 
 - Shape product direction. Be the most credible field voice in the room. Translate patterns observed across accounts and deals into identified gaps, reference architectures, and durable product bets, partnering directly with Product and Engineering on the roadmap. 
 - Codify what works. Turn hard-won learnings into reference architectures, integration patterns, and runbooks that scale across the delivery team and feed the support knowledge base. 
 - Bring architecture expertise to high-stakes deals. Partner with pre-sales on the prospects where getting the technical approach right is what wins, leading architecture reviews and technical deep dives. 

What we're looking for: 

- 6-10 years in integration engineering and solutions architecture, with a substantial, demonstrable background in the integration space. 
 - Mandatory hands-on experience with iPaaS/integration platforms (e. g. , Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Informatica, SnapLogic, Fivetran, TIBCO, and SAP CPI); you've architected and delivered enterprise integrations using an integration platform. 
 - Excellent, deep understanding of APIs and the integration landscape, REST, GraphQL, SOAP, webhooks, and auth models. 
 - A deep technical problem-solver, you design solutions from first principles for problems that have no established answer. 
 - Deep expertise in enterprise integration architecture, data pipelines, and modern cloud infrastructure. 
 - Strong technical communication; credible as the senior technical voice with CTOs, VPs of engineering, and integration leaders. 
 - Startup-grade agency, high ownership, low ego, comfortable building the playbook as you go. 

Nice to have: 

- Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, agent orchestration). 
 - Prior principal/staff solutions architect, lead integration engineer, or founding solutions engineer role at a high-growth enterprise startup. 
 - Direct experience integrating with Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or ServiceNow. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and Azure), containerised environments (Docker and Kubernetes), and modern data infrastructure.

data.title: Lead Data Engineer
data.description:
Job Title Lead Data Engineer (Cloud)

Job Type Permanent

Relevant Experience 10+ years' experience in in the field of Datawarehouse, Data Engineering, Big Data, Cloud & Analytics. Familiarity with AWS is required; experience with Tableau or other BI tools is an advantage. 

Reports into Data & Analytics Manager

Job Description

We, at Jet2 (UK s third largest airlines and the largest tour operator), have set up a state-of-the-art Technology and Innovation Centre in Pune, India. We are recruiting for an experienced and passionate Lead Data Engineer to join our growing Data Engineering program which is focused on making data assets from across our business available in cloud for advanced analytics, data science and automated decision making. These data assets drive mission critical processes across our commercial and operational teams contributing towards profitable growth, competitive advantage, and exceptional customer satisfaction. This is an exciting opportunity to help us become a leading data-driven organization through the effective use of data. 

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in the success of our Data Analytics and Engineering program, working closely with colleagues across our business and technical teams. You will be designing and building complex data ingestion pipelines from different Jet2 and third-partysource systems will ensure data is cleansed, well structured, and appropriately transformed into our data lake to support a wide variety of use cases ranging from self-service analytics through to data warehousing and data science. 

Key Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be in a lead role with responsibility for both solution delivery and direct management of a team of up to 6-7 Data and QA Engineers (across Senior, Mid, Junior and Graduate levels). They will own delivery commitments for the team, run sprint planning and execute prioritization order set by Product team, conduct performance reviews and 1: 1s, and collaborate closely with stakeholders in Pune and Leeds UK. 

- Design and deliver scalable and reliable data ingestion pipelines to support data consumers across Jet2. com and Jet2Holidays
 - Ingest, cleanse and transform data from a wide variety of sources systems into our cloud data lake to support advanced analytics, data warehousing and data science
 - The primary focus is: ingest data cleanse data apply light transformations make data ready for downstream analytics teams. 

Below are the main areas of responsibility for this role -

- Data Ingestion
 - Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines from multiple source systems into the cloud data platform. Ingest data from databases, APIs, files, event streams, and third-party systems. 

Support batch, near-real-time, and real-time ingestion patterns where required. 

- Ensure ingestion jobs are reliable, monitored, and recoverable in case of failure. 
 - Work with source systems owners / Architect s teams to understand data availability, structure, refresh frequency, and extraction constraints. 

Data Cleansing and Standardisation

- Apply basic data cleansing rules and standardization as part of ingestion. 
 - Implement basic validation checks to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and consistency. 
 - Identify and raise data quality issues with source system owners or relevant stakeholders. 
 - Maintain reusable cleansing patterns and standards across ingestion pipelines. 

Light Data Transformation

- Perform simple transformations to achieve standard data platform formats. Conversion from semi-structured to structured data. 
 - Create clean, structured, and well-organised staging or curated datasets. 
 - Avoid complex business logic, KPI definitions, semantic modelling, or advanced analytics transformations unless clearly assigned. 

Ingestion Pipeline Development and Maintenance

- Develop, test, deploy, and maintain optimized data ingestion pipelines using approved cloud data engineering tools. 
 - Ensure pipelines follow engineering standards for code quality, configuration, logging, and error handling. 
 - Monitor pipeline performance and resolve failures or data load issues. 
 - Support pipeline scheduling, orchestration, and dependency management. 
 - Data quality reconciliation checks, monitoring, and incidence management
 - Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment planning, and production support. 
 - Work with cloud storage, data warehouse, and data lake technologies. (AWS S3, Snowflake , GCS)
 - Follow Jet2 s data platform standards for data storage, partitioning, naming conventions, access control, and security. 
 - Ensure data is stored in appropriate zones such as raw, cleansed, staging, or curated layers. 
 - Support metadata capture and basic data cataloguing requirements. 
 - Follow governance, privacy, and security guidelines while handling enterprise data. 
 - Understand in detail Jet2 s current data warehouse architecture and standards (architecture, coding, data modelling etc ) and do detail designing in compliance those and stated business requirement
 - Support the continual training and development of your team and the wider data engineering function at Jet2 to keep up to date with developments in data engineering and drive continual improvement across the team
 - Help to recruit, train and mentor a team of highly skilled Data and QA Engineers with a wide range of technical knowledge and experience
 - Plan, prioritise and oversee end-to-end delivery for the team managing capacity, sequencing work against business commitments, removing blockers and ensuring quality through robust QA practices

Technical Skills & Knowledge

- Expert-level SQL advanced query optimisation, window functions, complex joins and performance tuning across large datasets; experience with a variety of source systems including Microsoft SQL Server
 - Cloud Platforms (mandatory): You should have experience working with key services on AWS (preferred) or GCP / Azure. Key services include following: 
 - AWS Data Firehose 
 - AWS S3 / Data Lake 
 - AWS Lamda 
 - AWS SQS SNS 
 - AWS Event bridge 
 - AWS Step Function 
 - AWS Athena 
 - AWS DynamoDB 
 - AWS CloudWatch 
 - AWS MWAA (Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow)
 - Apache Kafka 
 - AWS API Gateway 
 - Terraform 
 - Deep expertise in Snowflake warehouse sizing and cost optimisation, RBAC, micro-partitioning, clustering keys, Time Travel, Streams & Tasks, Snowpipe, and zero-copy cloning
 - Experience working with DBT to develop, test, deploy and monitor data transformation code
 - Ability to use the AI Tooling @Jet2 (Snowflake Cortex Code, GitHub copilot, AWS Kiro etc. ) to effectively to deliver faster value to business by rolling out data products to business
 - Experience working with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), specifically with Terraform (equivalent experience with similar technology also accepted) Develop and maintain Terraform scripts/modules to provision and manage cloud data engineering infrastructure. 
 - Experience of working in an Agile delivery team using automated build, deployment and testing (CI\CD, DevOps, DataOps)
 - Experience with one or more programming language compatible with developing functionality on the above platform (Python or Java preferred)
 - Data Visualisation tool (Tableau) knowledge is a plus
Soft Skills

- Excellent communication skills verbal and written
 - Strong team and stakeholder management skills you should have the ability to build strong relationships with people across a wide variety of teams and backgrounds
 - Experience working with people across different geographical regions, particularly UK (Leeds and Sheffield) and India (Pune)
