data.title: Forward deployed Engineer
data.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer

Company: Trida Labs

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 3-5 Years

About Trida Labs

Trida Labs builds AI-native products that help organizations work with enterprise data, analytics, and intelligent applications. 

Our products include TridaPad, an AI-native data collaboration platform for querying, analyzing, visualizing, and working with data across enterprise data sources; AgentSQL, an agentic AI analytics solution for natural-language interaction with enterprise data; and TridaPad MCP Server, which enables AI assistants and MCP-compatible clients to interact with TridaPad capabilities. 

About the Role

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers, translating business and technical requirements into practical solutions using Trida Labs products. You will support customer discovery, integrations, deployments, troubleshooting, pilots, and pre-sales while working with engineering teams to address product-level requirements. 

What You'll Do1. Customer Discovery & Solution Design

- Understand customer business workflows, technical requirements, data environments, and operational constraints. 
 - Translate customer requirements into practical Trida Labs solutions. 
 - Identify required data sources, integrations, configurations, permissions, and deployment requirements. 
 - Assess technical feasibility and communicate implementation trade-offs clearly. 
 - Define implementation approaches that can be reused across customers where possible. 2. Pre-Sales, Pilots & Proofs of Concept

- Support technical customer discussions, product demonstrations, pilots, and proofs of concept. 
 - Understand customer use cases and demonstrate how TridaPad and AgentSQL can address them. 
 - Configure representative customer environments for evaluation. 
 - Validate technical requirements and identify integration or security constraints before deployment. 
 - Communicate technical feasibility, limitations, and implementation requirements to product and sales stakeholders. 3. Product Implementation & Data Integration

- Deploy and configure TridaPad and AgentSQL for customer use cases. 
 - Configure data sources, database connections, permissions, schemas, settings, and analytics workflows. 
 - Work with customer databases and data platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks. 
 - Understand customer data models, business metrics, relationships, and query requirements. 
 - Validate that connected data is accessible and correctly represented in the application. 
 - Troubleshoot connection, permission, schema, query, and integration issues. 4. AI & Analytics Implementation

- Configure existing AI and analytics capabilities for customer requirements. 
 - Adapt prompts, context, tools, and application workflows where configuration is appropriate. 
 - Validate natural-language analytics, SQL generation, analytical results, visualizations, dashboards, and generated summaries. 
 - Diagnose AI-output issues and determine whether they are related to data, configuration, context, model behavior, or product functionality. 
 - Work with the relevant engineering teams when issues require changes to core AI capabilities. 5. Security, Access & MCP Integrations

- Support customer security reviews, access requirements, VPNs, IP allowlisting, private connectivity, and restricted networks. 
 - Support self-hosted deployments in customer cloud or on-premises environments and apply least-privilege database access. 
 - Follow customer and company requirements for handling production data, PII, credentials, logs, screenshots, and debugging information. 
 - Configure and validate MCP integrations between TridaPad, AI assistants, internal applications, and customer workflows, including authentication, permissions, and tool access. 6. Customer Evaluation & Validation

- Build customer-specific golden question sets containing representative business questions, expected SQL, and verified analytical results. 
 - Use these test cases to validate customer configurations and AI workflows. 
 - Rerun relevant test cases after product upgrades, model changes, prompt changes, or configuration changes. 
 - Validate SQL, analytical results, visualizations, dashboards, and generated summaries against expected outcomes. 
 - Track regressions and communicate failures with sufficient technical context for engineering teams. 
 - Maintain customer-specific prompts, context, and configuration as versioned implementation artifacts. 7. Deployment & Production Troubleshooting

- Create implementation plans and technical validation checklists for customer deployments. 
 - Support deployments across development, staging, and production environments. 
 - Troubleshoot application, API, database, AI, integration, and deployment issues. 
 - Use logs, errors, traces, configuration details, and reproduction steps to isolate problems. 
 - Validate engineering fixes in customer-relevant scenarios before production deployment where appropriate. 
 - Support production releases, rollouts, upgrades, and post-deployment validation. 8. Customer Feedback & Engineering Collaboration

- Identify recurring customer problems and implementation challenges. 
 - Distinguish customer-specific requirements from broader product capabilities. 
 - Provide structured product feedback with technical context and customer impact. 
 - Identify opportunities to turn repeated implementation work into reusable product capabilities, tooling, or documentation. 
 - Work closely with AI, AI Agent, Data & AI, Backend, Platform, NLP/ML, and Product teams. 
 - Provide clear requirements, reproduction steps, logs, expected behavior, and customer context when escalating issues. 
 - Help reduce customer-specific workarounds and avoid unnecessary product forks. Role Ownership

- Forward Deployed Engineer: Owns customer discovery, solution design, implementation, integration, configuration, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer-facing delivery. 
 - AI Engineer / AI Agent Engineer: Owns reusable AI features, agent orchestration, agent behavior, tool workflows, and core agent capabilities. 
 - Data & AI Engineer: Owns data connectivity, schemas, metadata, semantic representations, and cross-database data correctness. 
 - NLP/ML Engineer: Owns model-level NLP and generation quality, including SQL-generation capabilities. 
 - Platform / Backend Engineer: Owns infrastructure, deployment systems, observability, security, APIs, business logic, and shared application services. The Forward Deployed Engineer configures and extends existing capabilities, provides customer context to specialist teams, and escalates core product changes rather than maintaining customer-specific forks. 

Customer Engagement Expectations

- Work directly with customers across different technical and business environments. 
 - Support customer deployments and meetings across relevant customer time zones when required. 
 - Be willing to travel for customer meetings, deployments, workshops, or go-live activities when required. 
 - Manage multiple customer implementation activities while maintaining clear priorities and communication. What We're Looking For

- 3-5 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technical consulting, or a similar technical role. 
 - Strong Python and SQL skills. 
 - Experience working with APIs, databases, backend services, and enterprise applications. 
 - Experience integrating software with customer systems, databases, and data environments. 
 - Strong understanding of SQL, databases, data workflows, and technical troubleshooting. 
 - Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams. 
 - Familiarity with LLMs, Generative AI, and AI-powered applications. 
 - Ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across application, data, integration, and AI layers. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot issues using logs, errors, configuration details, and reproduction steps. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineering teams. 
 - Comfortable working with customer environments and supporting production deployments. 
 - Ability to manage multiple customer requirements while maintaining clear priorities and communication. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Technical Implementation. 
 - Experience supporting product demonstrations, pilots, or proofs of concept. 
 - Experience with AI analytics, natural-language-to-SQL, or enterprise data applications. 
 - Experience with AI agents, tool calling, or agent workflows. 
 - Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex. 
 - Experience with MCP and AI assistant integrations. 
 - Experience with enterprise databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks. 
 - Experience with Docker and cloud or deployment platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Render, or Vercel. 
 - Experience supporting production deployments and customer environments. 
 - Familiarity with AI evaluation, regression testing, observability, or production AI troubleshooting. Key Skills

Python | SQL | APIs | Databases | Enterprise Data | System Integration | Generative AI | LLMs | AI Applications | Natural-Language-to-SQL | Data Analytics | AI Agents | MCP | Docker | Cloud | Customer Deployment | Production Troubleshooting | Technical Implementation | Technical Communication

Why Join Trida Labs?

Work directly on real AI systems solving enterprise data and analytics problems, collaborating with customers and engineering teams to turn real-world requirements into reliable, reusable product capabilities. 

Equal Opportunity

Trida Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

data.title: Central Monitor Senior Associate
data.description:
Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission-to serve patients living with serious illnesses-drives all that we do. 

Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas -Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. 

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. 

Central Monitor Senior Associate

What You Will Do

Let's do this. Let's change the world. Scrap reduction

Process Stability & trouble shooting

data.description:
About Food Stories

Foodstories is redefining the gourmet food landscape in India, catering to the nation's most discerning and affluent consumers with an unwavering passion for exceptional culinary experiences. With an ambitious vision to become the leader in India's gourmet food space, Foodstories is committed to shaping the narrative around food, while offering products and experiences that delight the senses and elevate everyday dining. 

Currently, Foodstories operates flagship stores in Ambience Mall, Vasant Kunj (Delhi), Banjara Hills (Hyderabad), Hill Road (Mumbai), Lokhandwala, Andheri (Mumbai) and Prestige Sterling Square (Bengaluru) with customers also enjoying seamless access through FoodStories. Shop. These thoughtfully designed spaces offer a curated selection of premium, farm-sourced produce, artisanal bakery items, bespoke cheeses, single-origin chocolates, exotic spices, and more. The range is further complemented by a unique all-day dining café, where patrons can indulge in a culinary journey that includes a specialized estate-tocup organic coffee program and a cutting-edge bio-hacking zone, designed to address the evolving wellness needs of today's health-conscious consumer. Nearly half of the offerings at Foodstories are freshly prepared on-site, ensuring the highest standards of quality and flavor. The brand also provides an exclusive assortment of domestic and international pantry essentials, dry fruits, and other premium food products, all handpicked to cater to the most refined tastes. Looking ahead, Foodstories plans to expand its footprint with multiple stores across Gurgaon supported by state-of-the-art commissaries, back-end kitchens, and dark stores. Founded by Ashni and Avni Biyani, 

Foodstories is the result of their shared passion for food and their commitment to offering unparalleled quality and innovation. Owned and operated by Foodstories Private Limited, 

Foodstories is setting a new standard in gourmet food retail in India, combining luxury, sustainability, and culinary excellence in every product and experience. 

Visit us : 

https: //www. foodstories. shop/

https: //www. linkedin. com/company/foodstoriesshop/posts/?feedView=all&viewAsMember=true

About the Role

We are looking for a National Head - Commissary & Central Food Operations to own the end-to-end performance of FoodStories' commissary network. 

The role will be responsible for establishing standardized processes across cities, improving product quality and consistency, optimizing raw material and production costs, and ensuring that the commissary network is capable of supporting rapid store expansion. 

The ideal candidate will combine strong food operations expertise with commercial and procurement understanding and will be comfortable working across multiple cities, teams and stakeholders. 

A key part of the role will be to build systems that allow FoodStories to scale nationally without compromising product quality, consistency or customer experience. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Commissary Operations & SOPs

- Review, streamline and standardize all commissary SOPs across the network. 
 - Own the end-to-end commissary process covering procurement, ordering, receiving, storage, production, portioning, packaging, inventory and dispatch. 
 - Establish standardized operating processes that can be replicated across cities and new commissaries. 
 - Identify operational gaps and eliminate unnecessary complexity, duplication and process variation. 
 - Build clear operating manuals, checklists and process controls for commissary teams. 
 - Establish systems to ensure SOP adherence across all locations. 2. Product Quality & Consistency

- Own product quality and consistency across all commissaries and markets. 
 - Establish clear product specifications, recipes, yields, portion sizes and quality benchmarks. 
 - Ensure that products manufactured across different cities deliver the same taste, texture, appearance and quality. 
 - Develop robust quality-control mechanisms and regular commissary audits. 
 - Identify root causes of quality deviations and drive corrective actions. 
 - Work closely with Store Operations to understand customer and store-level feedback and translate it into improvements at the commissary level. 3. Procurement & Cost Optimization

- Review raw material procurement across commissaries and stores to identify cost optimization opportunities. 
 - Establish standardized pricing and acceptable cost bands for key raw materials across cities. 
 - Benchmark procurement costs across locations and identify significant variances. 
 - Work closely with Procurement to improve vendor selection, negotiation, sourcing and supply reliability. 
 - Identify opportunities for local sourcing without compromising quality or consistency. 
 - Specifically evaluate and develop suitable alternatives to TWF for flour procurement, while maintaining product specifications and quality. 
 - Drive greater purchasing efficiency through standardization, vendor consolidation and volume leverage. 4. Production Efficiency & Yield

- Monitor production costs, yields, wastage and productivity across commissaries. 
 - Establish benchmarks for yield, wastage, labour productivity and production efficiency. 
 - Identify and address production losses and inefficiencies. 
 - Improve forecasting and production planning in partnership with Operations and Supply Chain. 
 - Ensure the right balance between centralized production and local production based on product, geography and economics. 
 - Build scalable capacity-planning models to support FoodStories' national expansion. 5. New Product Development & Innovation

- Work closely with Avni (Founder) and the Innovation team to operationalize new product launches. 
 - Translate product concepts and recipes into scalable production processes. 
 - Ensure new products are commercially viable and can be consistently produced across multiple commissaries. 
 - Establish standardized recipes, production methods, specifications, packaging and quality benchmarks before launch. 
 - Partner with Store Operations to ensure successful execution of new products at store level. 
 - Identify operational challenges early in the innovation process and provide practical solutions. 6. National Standardization

- Build a national operating framework for commissaries while accounting for relevant local requirements and supply realities. 
 - Ensure consistency in processes, recipes, raw materials and quality standards across cities. 
 - Create mechanisms for sharing best practices between commissaries. 
 - Lead cross-city operational reviews and benchmarking. 
 - Ensure that every new commissary is set up using standardized FoodStories processes and operating principles. 7. Food Safety & Compliance

- Strengthen food safety, hygiene, storage and handling practices across all commissaries. 
 - Establish and monitor food safety and quality-control standards. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable food safety and statutory requirements. 
 - Conduct regular audits and ensure timely closure of identified gaps. 
 - Build a strong culture of food safety and operational discipline across commissary teams. 8. Team & Capability Building

- Build and lead a strong commissary leadership team across locations. 
 - Define organizational structures, roles, responsibilities and performance metrics. 
 - Develop the capability of Commissary Heads, Production Managers and frontline teams. 
 - Establish clear performance expectations and review mechanisms. 
 - Build a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. 9. Business & Cross-functional Partnership

- Partner closely with Founder, Innovation, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance and Store Operations. 
 - Provide regular visibility on commissary performance, quality, cost and capacity. 
 - Work with Finance to identify and deliver cost-saving opportunities. 
 - Partner with Operations to ensure commissaries consistently meet store requirements. 
 - Act as the central owner for resolving cross-functional issues affecting product quality, availability or cost. Key Metrics / Success Measures

The role will be measured on: 

- Product quality and consistency across cities
 - Commissary-level food cost and production cost
 - Raw material cost optimization
 - Yield and wastage
 - Production efficiency and capacity utilization
 - SOP adherence
 - Food safety and audit scores
 - Store-level product complaints and quality deviations
 - New product launch execution
 - Commissary service levels and dispatch accuracy
 - Readiness of the commissary network to support national store expansion

We are specifically looking for someone with national / multi-city experience. 

The ideal candidate would have: 

- 10-15+ years of experience in food operations, preferably across QSR, restaurant chains, food retail, FMCG, central kitchens or food manufacturing. 
 - Proven experience managing multi-city / national commissary or central kitchen operations. 
 - Experience managing multiple commissaries or production facilities across different geographies. 
 - Strong understanding of food production, recipes, yields, quality control, procurement and food costs. 
 - Experience in building and implementing SOPs across a distributed network. 
 - Strong understanding of raw material sourcing, vendor management and cost optimization. 
 - Experience scaling central kitchens/commissaries alongside rapid store expansion. 
 - Strong exposure to new product commercialization and product launches.

data.title: Research Development Lead
data.description:
College Circle AI is an early-stage AI-powered EdTech company building the Academic Intelligence Layer for colleges. 

Our belief is simple: 

Curiosity should never die in a classroom. 

We are building technology that understands how students learn and helps create a more personalised, intelligent, interactive, and accessible academic experience. 

As we move into our next stage of product development, research will become a core part of how we build our technology. We are looking for a Head of Research Co-Builder who can lead this function with both research depth and technical understanding. 

The Role

As the Head of Research, you will lead a 5-7 person research team working on the research foundations behind College Circle AI. 

The role sits at the intersection of: 

Research × AI × Student Behaviour × Personalisation × Product

You will work closely with the CEO, CTO, and product/engineering teams to turn research into systems that can actually be implemented in the product. 

This is not purely an academic research role. 

We are looking for someone who can understand the research, understand the technology, lead researchers, and help turn findings into working models and product capabilities. 

What You Will Lead

1. Personalisation Model

A major area of research will be understanding how individual students learn and how we can use that information to create a more personalised learning experience. 

You will help lead research around: 

- Student learning patterns
 - Academic behaviour
 - Learning preferences
 - Engagement patterns
 - Student interaction with academic content
 - Personalisation signals
 - Data required for adaptive learning
 - Evaluation of personalisation modelsThe objective is to help build a foundation for a Personalisation Engine that can continuously understand and adapt to students. 

2. New-Student Prediction Model

You will also lead research into building a foundation prediction model for new students. 

The goal is to explore how we can make useful predictions about a student even when we have limited historical data. 

This may involve researching: 

- What signals can be collected during onboarding
 - Academic and behavioural indicators
 - Course and syllabus information
 - Student interaction patterns
 - Early learning signals
 - Feature engineering
 - Prediction approaches
 - Model evaluation and validationThe research should ultimately help answer: 

"How can College Circle AI begin understanding a student before it has years of data about them?"

3. Research Team Leadership

You will lead a 5-7 person research team. 

Your responsibility will include: 

- Defining research priorities
 - Dividing research areas among team members
 - Setting research milestones
 - Reviewing research output
 - Maintaining research documentation
 - Coordinating experiments
 - Ensuring research quality
 - Connecting research findings with product and engineering
 - Presenting findings to leadershipYou will be responsible for making sure the research team is not simply producing papers or documents, but creating research that can move the company forward. 

Technical Understanding

You do not need to be the primary engineer for every model. 

However, you should have enough technical understanding to work effectively with our technical team. 

Relevant areas may include: 

- Machine Learning
 - Artificial Intelligence
 - Statistics
 - Data analysis
 - Predictive modelling
 - Recommendation systems
 - Personalisation systems
 - Model evaluation
 - Python
 - Data processing
 - Basic ML/AI architecture
 - Research methodology
 - Experiment designExperience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, recommendation systems, student modelling, behavioural modelling, or adaptive learning would be valuable. 

Research → Product

One of the most important responsibilities of this role is connecting research with execution. 

We don't want: 

Research → Paper → Folder

We want: 

Research → Experiment → Model → Product → Student Impact

You will work with the CTO and engineering team to determine which research ideas can actually become part of College Circle AI's products. 

Research Grants & Opportunities

College Circle AI intends to explore research grants, academic collaborations, institutional partnerships, and other research funding opportunities. 

If research grants or dedicated research funding are secured, an appropriate portion of the allocated research funding may be assigned to support the Head of Research and/or research team, based on the grant terms, role, contribution, and available budget. 

This is not a fixed salary position. 

The role is primarily structured as an equity-based Co-Builder opportunity, with research-related monetary opportunities potentially arising through successfully secured grants or specifically funded research projects. 

Co-Builder Structure

The Head of Research position is intended for someone who wants to build with College Circle AI for the long term. 

Minimum expected commitment: 8 months

Potential continuation: Up to 3 years based on mutual alignment and performance. 

In recognition of long-term contribution, Co-Builders may become eligible to unlock equity after completing 8 months, with equity opportunities of up to 5%, subject to: 

- Individual contribution
 - Performance
 - Role and responsibility
 - Tenure
 - Vesting conditions
 - Mutual agreement
 - Separate formal equity agreementEquity is not automatic and will be determined through the formal Co-Builder process. 

What We Offer

Equity OpportunityLong-term Co-Builders may be eligible for equity opportunities of up to 5%, subject to formal terms. 

Real ResearchWork on research that can directly influence an AI-powered learning product used by students. 

Research LeadershipBuild and lead a 5-7 person research team rather than working only as an individual researcher. 

Founder & Technical CollaborationWork closely with the CEO, CTO, and product/engineering teams. 

Learning & MentorshipAccess to learning resources, courses, workshops, mentorship, and practical startup exposure. 

Research Funding OpportunitiesOpportunity to participate in research projects supported by grants, academic collaborations, and funded research initiatives, where available. 

Builder CultureA collaborative environment where research, experimentation, questioning, and independent thinking are encouraged. 

Student & Academic NetworkAccess to College Circle AI's growing student, campus, and academic ecosystem. 

College Circle AI Merchandise & Team ExperiencesTeam merchandise, meetups, hangouts, and collaborative activities as part of the Co-Builder culture. 

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who: 

- Can lead a research team
 - Understands AI/ML and research methodology
 - Can think scientifically and practically
 - Is comfortable working with technical teams
 - Can translate research into product direction
 - Is capable of designing experiments
 - Can evaluate models critically
 - Has strong analytical thinking
 - Can communicate complex research clearly
 - Takes ownership
 - Wants to build for the long termMost importantly: 

We are looking for a researcher who wants to build something, not just study something. 

Why This Role Matters

The long-term intelligence of College Circle AI will depend on how well we understand students. 

The research team will help answer some of the most important questions behind the product: 

How does a student learn?

How can we personalise that learning?

How can we understand a new student with limited data?

How can an AI system continuously become better at supporting each student?

As Head of Research, you will lead the team working towards those answers. 

College Circle AI

Building the Future of Academic Intelligence

We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.

Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who we hire - the DNA: 

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.

 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Build Desktop Intercept - the native Windows driver and app that acts as a virtual mic/speaker, replaces audio in real time, and (Phase 1 Phase C) reads the DOM and drives Computer Use
 - This is the hardest engineering on the platform and the deepest moat. Everything you build feeds a high-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency distributed platform - voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI combined - so you think in latency budgets, throughput, and efficiency, not just features
 - Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- Windows native driver (WASAPI, virtual audio devices, kernel-adjacent hooks)
 - real-time bidirectional audio routing
 - The user-space app (audio router, DOM scraper, MCP server)
 - The desktop-to-cloud path onto the event bus (NATS-class, WebSocket) under a sub-300ms budget
 - AV co-existence and mass-deployment
 - Your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- Self-starter, hacker, grit
 - You consider yourself exceptional at the systems level and can show it
 - You love new technology, adapt fast when it changes, demonstrate ideas with working code, and use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity
 - Team player who makes and hits committed timelines
 - Loves solving the problems nobody else can - and winning. 

What You Will Bring: 

- 8+ years systems / native development; shipped a Windows desktop agent at real scale (>10k seats) with audio. 
 - Strong C/C++ - mandatory. Strong Go for the service side - mandatory. 
 - Comfortable building and interacting with drivers - virtual audio devices, virtual microphones/speakers, WASAPI / Core Audio, kernel-adjacent hooks. 
 - Real-time audio pipelines under a sub-300ms budget - buffering, resampling, drift, glitch-free capture/playback. 
 - Understands high-efficiency systems end-to-end - event-driven architecture, pub/sub, WebSocket streaming, and what state, race conditions, and locking mean at the native layer (lock-free audio buffers, real-time threads, priority inversion). 
 - macOS / Linux native experience is a huge +++++ - cross-platform desktop is where this goes next. 
 - Browser / DOM internals and process injection a strong plus (Phase C). 
 - Enterprise mass-deployment craft - MSI/installer engineering, silent deploys, fleet upgrades across 10k+ locked-down seats. 
 - Driver/code signing and AV/EDR co-existence - WHQL, EV certs, and staying invisible to CrowdStrike-class agents without tripping them. 
 - Crash-dump and telemetry discipline - WinDbg/minidumps, symbolized crash reporting from the field; you debug machines you'll never touch. 
 - Security posture - least-privilege service design; this app hears customer audio and reads screens, so it must be provably tight. 
 - A master debugger at the systems level - kernel logs, crash dumps, audio glitches, AV interference; you see it. 
 - SIP / RTP a strong plus. Mid-tier or better hands-on AI-in-product experience a plus (the desktop app hosts an MCP server and drives Computer Use).

data.title: Director – Technology Delivery, AI & Digital Platforms
data.description:
Spydra is looking for an experienced technology leader to drive the successful execution of complex AI, data, blockchain, automation, and enterprise-platform initiatives. 

This position sits at the intersection of business, product, engineering, architecture, and customer delivery. The person will convert business priorities into executable technology programs, establish clear delivery plans, address risks before they affect commitments, and ensure that solutions move reliably from design to production. 

The role requires more than project tracking. The successful candidate will be expected to understand the technology being delivered, question assumptions, challenge designs where necessary, resolve cross-functional bottlenecks, and make practical decisions that protect customer outcomes. 

The opportunityYou will lead a portfolio of strategic technology initiatives and ensure that each program has: 

- Clearly defined business outcomes
 - Realistic scope and delivery plans
 - Strong technical foundations
 - Accountable owners and delivery teams
 - Transparent risk and dependency management
 - Production-ready environments
 - Measurable customer and business impactYou will work closely with senior leadership, customers, product managers, architects, engineering teams, cloud and infrastructure teams, and external partners. 

Key areas of responsibilityTechnology program leadership
 - Lead technology initiatives from discovery and planning through implementation, rollout, and production stabilization. 
 - Build integrated delivery plans covering product, engineering, data, infrastructure, security, testing, and deployment activities. 
 - Set milestones, delivery checkpoints, acceptance criteria, and readiness conditions for each initiative. 
 - Ensure teams remain focused on business-critical outcomes rather than activity-based progress. 
 - Review delivery status using tangible evidence such as working demonstrations, test results, deployment outputs, and production metrics. 
 - Identify delays early and implement recovery plans before commitments are affected. 
 - Adjust sequencing, resources, scope, or implementation approaches when required. Technical oversight
 - Review proposed architectures and engineering approaches for feasibility, scalability, security, maintainability, and operational readiness. 
 - Engage deeply with engineering teams to understand technical constraints and implementation risks. 
 - Challenge designs that create unnecessary complexity, delivery uncertainty, or long-term operational issues. 
 - Facilitate decisions where multiple technical approaches are available. 
 - Ensure that architecture choices are appropriate for the business requirement and delivery timeline. 
 - Confirm that solutions meet functional and non-functional expectations before progressing through major delivery gates. 
 - Promote practical engineering choices while maintaining essential quality and security standards. AI, data, and platform delivery
 - Oversee initiatives involving generative AI, machine learning, data platforms, enterprise integrations, workflow automation, and blockchain-based applications. 
 - Ensure AI systems are appropriately evaluated for output quality, reliability, security, privacy, bias, and operational performance. 
 - Review approaches involving model integration, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, vector databases, data pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure. 
 - Ensure that appropriate testing, observability, monitoring, human-review, and fallback mechanisms are incorporated into AI-enabled products. 
 - Work with platform teams to establish production-readiness and governance requirements. 
 - Support teams in moving AI and data solutions from proof of concept to scalable enterprise deployment. Delivery governance and intervention
 - Establish a delivery cadence that encourages timely decisions, clear ownership, and rapid issue resolution. 
 - Maintain visibility over risks, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, and unresolved actions. 
 - Assign clear owners and deadlines for critical issues. 
 - Investigate the underlying causes of delivery problems rather than relying only on status reporting. 
 - Step in directly when teams are blocked or commitments are at risk. 
 - Bring together the right stakeholders to resolve technical, business, commercial, or operational dependencies. 
 - Recommend corrective action where progress, quality, or accountability is insufficient. 
 - Escalate matters with clear options, implications, and recommended decisions. Business and engineering alignment
 - Translate business requirements into structured technology plans that engineering teams can execute. 
 - Clarify expected user behaviour, business rules, operational processes, and measurable success criteria. 
 - Resolve ambiguity before it results in development rework. 
 - Help business stakeholders understand technical constraints, dependencies, and implementation consequences. 
 - Present clear choices when trade-offs are required across scope, timeline, cost, quality, and risk. 
 - Ensure that delivered solutions address the intended customer or business problem. 
 - Maintain alignment between customer expectations, product priorities, and engineering capacity. Partner and vendor management
 - Coordinate onboarding of implementation partners, technology providers, consultants, and specialist vendors. 
 - Define technical access requirements, integration dependencies, delivery milestones, and productivity expectations. 
 - Track whether partners are contributing effectively within agreed timelines. 
 - Resolve delays involving access, infrastructure, environments, documentation, integration, or technical dependencies. 
 - Require improvement plans where partner performance is below expectations. 
 - Work with commercial and leadership teams where contractual or delivery interventions are required. 
 - Confirm partner and environment readiness before critical implementation stages. Environment and release readiness
 - Ensure development, testing, staging, and production environments are available in line with delivery plans. 
 - Establish readiness checklists for deployment, integration, security, performance, monitoring, and support. 
 - Coordinate resolution of infrastructure and environment-related dependencies. 
 - Ensure release decisions are supported by appropriate testing and operational evidence. 
 - Work with DevOps, cloud, security, and support teams to improve deployment predictability. 
 - Reduce avoidable delays caused by incomplete environments or unresolved production dependencies. Decision-making expectationsThe person in this role will be expected to: 

- Take timely decisions within agreed commercial, technical, and governance boundaries. 
 - Recommend changes to delivery plans, scope, staffing, sequencing, or implementation approaches. 
 - Approve carefully controlled interim solutions where they are necessary to protect delivery. 
 - Require corrective action from internal teams and external partners. 
 - Prevent initiatives from progressing when critical security, reliability, or deployment conditions have not been met. 
 - Document important decisions and communicate their impact to relevant stakeholders. 
 - Involve senior leadership when decisions exceed agreed authority or materially affect customer and business commitments. Candidate profileYou are likely to succeed in this role if you combine technical understanding with strong execution discipline. 

You should be comfortable discussing architecture and engineering decisions with technical teams while also communicating delivery implications to business leaders and customers. 

The role requires someone who is willing to take ownership, ask difficult questions, resolve conflict constructively, and remain focused on measurable outcomes. 

Required experience
 - Approximately 12-16 years or more of experience in technology delivery, engineering leadership, architecture, enterprise platforms, or digital transformation. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading complex programs involving multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders. 
 - Strong record of delivering enterprise technology solutions into production. 
 - Experience working directly with engineering, architecture, product, infrastructure, security, and business teams. 
 - Experience managing distributed teams, implementation partners, or technology vendors. 
 - Experience with AI, machine learning, data platforms, automation, cloud-native systems, or enterprise SaaS products. 
 - Understanding of the complete delivery lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Relevant certifications in architecture, cloud platforms, program management, data engineering, cybersecurity, or artificial intelligence would be useful but are not essential. 

Technical capabilitiesThe ideal candidate should have a sound understanding of several of the following areas: 

- Generative AI and large language models
 - Machine-learning systems and model deployment
 - Retrieval-augmented generation and vector databases
 - AI agents and workflow automation
 - Data ingestion, ETL, streaming, and warehousing
 - APIs and enterprise-system integrations
 - Cloud architecture and containerized environments
 - MLOps, DevOps, and release automation
 - Application and infrastructure observability
 - Security, privacy, access control, and data protection
 - Distributed systems and blockchain platforms
 - Scalability, performance, resilience, and availability
 - Production monitoring and incident managementHands-on development experience is valuable, but the primary requirement is the ability to assess technical approaches, identify delivery implications, and guide teams toward practical solutions.

data.title: Automation Engineer
data.description:
Several hundred hours a month currently go into work that should not need a person. 

A leading European manufacturer is establishing its India shared-services centre and has partnered with Flexiple to hire the engineers who will automate the processes moving into it. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India. 

What you would actually be doing

Building automations across finance, procurement and supply-chain operations - real code against APIs where they exist, not recorded click-paths that break the next time a screen moves. Writing exception handling that routes to a person with enough context to act on it. And measuring hours genuinely saved, then retiring automations that have stopped earning their maintenance. 

The judgement the role needs

Knowing when a process should be fixed rather than automated as it stands. A bad process automated is a bad process that now runs faster and is harder to change. You would be trusted to say so, to process owners who have lived with the workaround for years and know every exception the documentation omits. 

Background

 - Document extraction or OCR experience helps for the invoice-heavy processes
Where

Pune, Chennai, Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Mumbai or Delhi NCR, or remote within India. An HR screen, a technical round, then a process walkthrough with an operations lead.

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities.

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies.

data.description:
About The Company

Vistance Networks is a leading innovator in the communications technology industry, dedicated to developing advanced solutions that enhance connectivity and digital experiences worldwide. Our commitment to excellence and innovation drives us to create reliable, high-performance products that meet the evolving needs of our global clients. With a focus on cutting-edge RF and embedded systems, Vistance Networks strives to push the boundaries of what is possible in wireless communications, IoT, and network infrastructure. Our diverse team of experts collaborates to deliver impactful solutions that empower industries and communities, fostering a connected world where information flows seamlessly and securely. 

About The Role

We are seeking a high-caliber Staff Engineer specializing in Embedded Software to join our dynamic team based in Bangalore. This senior technical role involves leading the design, development, and architecture of firmware for next-generation Smart RF Amplifiers, Nodes, and Remote Telemetry Modules, including FDX/DOCSIS 4. 0 cable access and IoT edge nodes. As a key member of our engineering team, you will take ownership of ARM-based MCU/MPU firmware development, working at both bare-metal and RTOS levels. Your expertise will be instrumental in bridging software engineering with RF hardware design, implementing low-level drivers, and leading complex hardware bring-up processes. You will collaborate closely with our US-based hardware, RF, and firmware teams to bring innovative hardware platforms to life, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability in our products. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of wireless communication technology and IoT connectivity through hands-on technical leadership and innovative problem-solving. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrated competencies in embedded software engineering, with strong physical, mental, and interpersonal skills. 
 - Educational background with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - Preferably 8+ years of embedded software development experience, with a proven track record as a technical lead or Staff Engineer. 
 - Deep expertise in ARM Cortex architecture, including assembly language, registers, linker scripts, and memory management. 
 - Proficiency in C and C++ programming languages, with extensive experience working on RTOS (such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX) and bare-metal firmware architectures. 
 - Practical knowledge of RF hardware components, including attenuators, equalizers, power amplifiers, and implementation of AGC algorithms. 
 - Hands-on experience with LoRaWAN protocol stacks, managing sub-GHz wireless transceivers, and integrating wireless connectivity solutions. 
 - Ability to read schematics, interpret component datasheets, and utilize hardware debugging tools such as Keil, GDB, JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, and spectrum analyzers. 
 - Strong collaboration skills, with experience working effectively with cross-functional teams across different geographies, especially US-based hardware, RF, and firmware engineers. 

Responsibilities

- Design, architect, and optimize low-level firmware for ARM Cortex-M and Cortex-A microcontrollers and microprocessors operating on RTOS or bare-metal environments. 
 - Develop and fine-tune RF control and signal processing algorithms, including AGC, ALC, tilt compensation, and digital equalizers, to enhance RF performance. 
 - Collaborate closely with hardware and RF design teams, interpreting schematics and guiding pinouts, power management, and peripheral routing. 
 - Develop robust, efficient drivers over I2C, SPI, UART, and GPIO interfaces to control RF chips, sensors, and power management components. 
 - Design, integrate, and maintain LoRaWAN stacks and application layers for remote monitoring and field telemetry applications. 
 - Lead initial board bring-up on custom prototype PCBs, conducting hardware/software co-debugging using industry-standard tools and methodologies. 
 - Architect system memory maps, optimize code for performance and memory usage, and ensure deterministic real-time operation. 
 - Implement and maintain development workflows using version control systems like Git and project management tools such as Jira, ensuring high software quality and team collaboration. 

Benefits

At Vistance Networks, we invest in our employees' growth and well-being by offering a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive salary packages, health insurance, and wellness programs. Our work environment fosters innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, providing opportunities for professional development through training, certifications, and participation in industry conferences. We support work-life balance with flexible working hours and a supportive organizational culture that values diversity and inclusion. Joining our team means becoming part of a forward-thinking company that values your contributions and encourages you to create impactful solutions in the rapidly evolving field of wireless communication and IoT technology. 

Equal Opportunity

Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our innovation and success, and we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

data.title: Health - Team Lead - React Native
data.description:
App Team Lead

Requirement : Work From Office Role

About Us

Traya is an Indian direct-to-consumer hair care brand platform provides a holistic treatment for consumers dealing with hairloss. The Company provides personalized consultations that help determine the root cause of hair fall among individuals, along with a range of hair care products that are curated from a combination of Ayurveda, Allopathy, and Nutrition. Traya's secret lies in the power of diagnosis. Our unique platform diagnoses the patient's hair & health history, to identify the root cause behind hair fall and delivers customized hair kits to them right at their doorstep. We have a strong adherence system in place via medically-trained hair coaches and proprietary tech, where we guide the customer across their hair growth journey, and help them stay on track. Traya is founded by Saloni Anand, a techie-turned-marketeer and Altaf Saiyed, a Stanford Business School alumnus. 

Our Vision

Traya was created with a global vision to create awareness around hair loss, de-stigmatise it while empathizing with the customers that it has an emotional and psychological impact. Most importantly, to combine 3 different sciences (Ayurveda, Allopathy and Nutrition) to create the perfect holistic solution for hair loss patients. 

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Team Lead to guide and empower our mobile app development team specializing in React Native. In this crucial leadership role, you will be responsible for the team's technical direction, project delivery, and professional growth in the mobile space. You will play a key role in shaping our mobile architecture, ensuring the successful execution of our mobile product roadmap, and fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture focused on React Native. 

Responsibilities

- Lead and manage a team of mobile app developers specializing in React Native, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and performance feedback. 
 - Own the technical vision and architecture for the team's mobile projects, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability across iOS and Android using React Native. 
 - Drive the planning, execution, and delivery of mobile app development projects, ensuring they are on time and within scope. 
 - Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, backend engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to define mobile project requirements, priorities, and timelines. 
 - Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting knowledge sharing, open communication, and continuous improvement in mobile development practices. 
 - Lead technical design discussions and ensure adherence to best practices, coding standards, and architectural guidelines specific to React Native mobile development. 
 - Oversee code reviews, ensuring code quality and providing constructive feedback to team members with a mobile-first perspective. 
 - Proactively identify and address technical challenges and roadblocks specific to mobile development, ensuring the team's productivity and success. 
 - Contribute to the professional development of team members through coaching, mentoring, and identifying growth opportunities in mobile technologies, particularly React Native. 
 - Participate in recruitment and onboarding of new mobile team members. 
 - Advocate for the adoption of new mobile technologies and best practices to enhance the team's capabilities and efficiency in React Native development. 
 - Monitor team performance metrics and implement strategies for improvement in mobile app delivery. 
 - Represent the mobile team in cross-functional meetings and contribute to broader engineering initiatives. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent extensive practical experience). 
 - Significant experience (typically 6+ years) in mobile app development with a strong focus on React Native for both iOS and Android. 
 - Proven experience (typically 2+ years) in a technical leadership role, managing and mentoring mobile app developers. 
 - Deep understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6+) and mobile development best practices for cross-platform development. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience building and leading mobile projects with React Native, including native module integration, performance optimization, and deployment. 
 - Solid understanding of mobile architecture patterns and experience guiding teams in using appropriate state management solutions within React Native. 
 - Strong experience with mobile testing frameworks and guiding teams in writing effective unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for mobile apps. 
 - Excellent understanding of mobile UI/UX principles, platform-specific guidelines (iOS & Android), and performance optimization techniques for mobile applications built with React Native. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical discussions, make sound architectural decisions for mobile systems, and drive technical consensus within a team. 
 - Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills, particularly in a mobile development context. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach mobile engineers, fostering their technical growth and career development in React Native and mobile technologies. 
 - Strong organizational and project management skills, with a track record of delivering mobile app projects successfully. 

Bonus Points

- Experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines and app store deployment automation. 
 - Familiarity with mobile analytics, crash reporting, and performance monitoring tools. 
 - Experience with integrating various native mobile SDKs and services. 
 - Contributions to the React Native open-source community. 
 - Experience with different mobile build systems and dependency management. 
 - Understanding of mobile security best practices and guiding teams in their implementation. 

Hiring Process

- Round 1 : Leadership & Mobile Technical Strategy : Discussion about your leadership philosophy in the context of mobile app development, your experience managing mobile teams, and your strategic vision for building scalable and high-performance mobile applications with React Native. 
 - Round 2 : Mobile Architecture & Deep Dive (React Native Focus) : In-depth technical discussion focusing on your architectural decisions for complex mobile systems using React Native, including state management, navigation, native integrations, and performance optimization for both iOS and Android. 
 - Round 3 : Team Leadership & Mobile Mentoring : Behavioral interview focused on your experience in building, mentoring, and growing mobile engineering teams specializing in React Native, including conflict resolution and performance management within the mobile domain. 
 - Round 4 : Hiring Manager & Cross-Functional Collaboration (Mobile) : Meeting with the Hiring Manager to assess your strategic alignment with the company's mobile vision and your ability to collaborate effectively with product, design, and backend teams in the context of mobile app development. 

Traya provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, nation origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by central, state, or local laws.

data.title: Technical Service Delivery Manager
data.description:
Job Description

About the Role: 

We are seeking an Technical Service Delivery Manager with 15 years of experience to act as a Technical SDM with strong NOC & Production Support expertise, ensuring overall infrastructure stability in a 24×7 environment. Lead and anchor Major Incidents (P1/P2) with effective coordination and strong technical understanding. 

Provide technical guidance (non-hands-on) to L2/L3 teams to drive faster troubleshooting and resolution. 

Own NOC operations, monitoring effectiveness, and service delivery governance, while ensuring strong team performance and stakeholder communication. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Oversight

- Provide technical direction across infrastructure towers: 
 - Windows / Linux Servers
 - Network
 - Load Balancers (F5 or similar)
 - Middleware (WebSphere, Tomcat, IIS, etc. )
 - Monitoring & Observability tools
 - Guide L2/L3 teams in troubleshooting and resolution approach. 
 - Validate technical diagnosis and ensure correct direction during incidents. 
 - Drive structured troubleshooting across multiple towers. 
Major Incident Management

- Anchor and lead Major Incidents (P1/P2) with strong technical coordination. 
 - Ensure the right teams are engaged and escalation happens on time. 
 - Drive faster resolution through structured incident handling. 
 - Provide clear and timely communication to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure proper incident closure, documentation, and RCA follow-up. 

NOC Operations & Monitoring Governance

- Own NOC operations during the assigned shift. 
 - Oversee monitoring effectiveness across tools and platforms. 
 - Drive alert quality improvement, correlation, and noise reduction. 
 - Ensure proactive detection of incidents and avoid missed alerts. 
 - Ensure adherence to SOPs, runbooks, and operational standards. 

Production Stability & RCA Governance

- Ensure quality Root Cause Analysis (RCA) with clear technical insights. 
 - Identify recurring issues and drive permanent fixes. 
 - Improve system reliability and reduce repeat incidents. 

Service Delivery & Operations

- Ensure SLA adherence (incident response, resolution, escalation). 
 - Coordinate across infrastructure towers for seamless delivery. 
 - Track and report service metrics such as: 
 - SLA compliance
 - Incident trends
 - MTTR / MTTx
 - Participate in operational governance meetings (Daily / Weekly / Monthly). 
People & Team Management

- Lead and manage NOC team during the shift. 
 - Ensure proper shift coverage, handover quality, and accountability. 
 - Mentor team on incident handling and monitoring practices. 
 - Drive team discipline, ownership, and responsiveness. 
 - Identify skill gaps and support team development. 

Experience

Required Skills & Experience

- Minimum 6 years to 10 years in Infrastructure Operations / Managed Services. 
 - Strong experience in NOC Operations, Production Support, and Major Incident Management. 
 - Must have prior hands-on technical experience (now in leadership role). 

Technical Skills (Experience-Based)

- Good understanding of: 
 - Windows / Linux Servers
 - Networking fundamentals
 - Load Balancers (F5 preferred)
 - Middleware platforms
 - Monitoring / Observability tools
 - ITSM tools (ServiceNow preferred)
Core Competencies

- Strong technical decision-making capability
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management
 - Strong escalation and coordination skills
 - Ability to manage high-pressure situations
 - High ownership and accountability mindset

Work Requirements

- Work from Office (Mandatory)
 - 24×7 rotational shift model
 - Availability during major incidents and critical situations

Technical / Delivery Requirements

- Strong control over major incidents with faster resolution
 - Improved monitoring effectiveness and reduced alert noise
 - Stable NOC operations with strong governance
 - High team performance and responsiveness
 - Strong customer confidence and communication

data.title: LLMOps/MLOps Lead
data.description:
Company Description Klimber Technologies is an AI-first company built by a team with decades of experience in enterprise data, analytics, and cloud platforms across AWS, GCP, and Azure. The organization focuses on building AI products that remove friction for enterprises, solving real problems and delivering production-grade solutions for Fortune 100 clients and beyond. Klimber's vision is to enable businesses to move fast with AI while maintaining reliability and trust in the outputs, ensuring pilots have a clear path to production. Its offerings include Turn3, an agent monitoring solution that evaluates whether AI agents truly achieve user goals, and hypernear, a vector database and similarity search engine for large-scale RAG, semantic search, and agent memory. In addition to products, Klimber partners with enterprises and ISVs to deliver end-to-end LLMOps, domain-tuned language models, knowledge-graph-driven analytics, and human-in-the-loop moderation for regulated and high-stakes use cases. 
Role Description The LLMOps/MLOps Lead will oversee the design, implementation, and operation of production-scale AI and LLM pipelines across Klimber products and client environments. This contract, remote role involves architecting and maintaining CI/CD workflows for machine learning models, deploying and monitoring LLM-based systems, and ensuring observability, reliability, and security of AI infrastructure. The lead will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data science teams to define deployment standards, manage model lifecycle (training, evaluation, rollout, rollback), and optimize performance in multi-cloud and on-premise settings. Day-to-day work includes building tooling for agent monitoring, integrating vector databases and RAG pipelines, implementing guardrails and human-in-the-loop workflows, and translating operational insights into product and platform improvements. The person in this role will also mentor engineers on MLOps/LLMOps best practices and contribute to internal frameworks that help clients move AI solutions from pilot to production. 
Qualifications

- Strong experience with MLOps/LLMOps practices, including model lifecycle management, CI/CD for ML, and production monitoring of AI systems. 
 - Hands-on proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization/orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Solid background in Python-based ML/LLM development, including integration with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or popular LLM orchestration libraries. 
 - Experience designing and operating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, vector databases, and semantic search or similarity search infrastructure. 
 - Knowledge of observability and reliability tooling (e. g. , logging, metrics, tracing, alerting) for AI and microservices, with a focus on safety, guardrails, and agent monitoring.

As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the world's top professional services firms, and in support of our global workforce strategy, we're growing our operations in India! We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!

Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients' unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices worldwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia. We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Senior Specialist - Azure Developer to join the GDC team. CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings

This position will support our GDC team and as a Senior Azure Developer, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of complex cloud-based applications on the Microsoft Azure platform

WHY COHNREZNICK?

At CohnReznick, we're united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it's working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your "why" at the firm. 

We believe it's important to balance work with everyday life - and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning & development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.

Lead the design and development of cloud-based applications.

Write high-quality, scalable, and maintainable code. 

Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance.

Under BVC, Vorro is being repositioned from a commodity iPaaS tool into an AI-native Healthcare Data OS, adding AI reporting, visualization and workflow-automation modules on top of its integration core.

We're looking to hire a AI VP - Technology for Vorro.
