data.title: Sr. Engineer Reliability Engineering XI
data.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Sr. Engineer - Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab. The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement. 

The role will work closely with Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab. 
 - Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements. 
 - Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data-acquisition systems. 
 - Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions. 
 - Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures. 
 - Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions. 
 - Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability. 
 - Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions. 
 - Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams. 
 - Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities. 
 - Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers. 
 - Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure. 
 - Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation. 
 - Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required. 
 - Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities. 
 - Mentor junior engineers/technicians on reliability testing, instrumentation, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 

Key Technical Skills

- Strong knowledge of Reliability Engineering and Reliability Testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with reliability and environmental testing. 
 - Knowledge of FMEA, FTA, RCA, 8D, Weibull analysis, life testing, and accelerated life testing. 
 - Understanding of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and environmental stress testing. 
 - Experience with data acquisition systems, sensors, instrumentation, and test equipment. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot test setups and identify test-system vs. product failures. 
 - Strong data analysis and interpretation skills. 
 - Knowledge of relevant industry/testing standards and engineering practices. 
 - Good understanding of product design and manufacturing processes. 
 - Strong technical documentation and reporting skills. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline. 
 - Typically 5-8 years of relevant experience in Reliability Engineering, Product Validation, Testing, or Engineering Laboratory functions. 
 - Hands-on experience working in a Reliability/Test/Validation Lab is preferred. 
 - Experience in HVAC, thermal management, cooling systems, data-center equipment, power electronics, or similar engineered products will be an advantage. 

Key Competencies

- Reliability & Failure Analysis
 - Laboratory & Test Management
 - Technical Problem Solving
 - Data Analysis
 - Root Cause Analysis
 - Product Testing & Validation
 - Project Ownership
 - Cross-functional Collaboration
 - Attention to Detail
 - Technical Documentation
 - Decision Making

Key KPIs

- On-time completion of reliability and qualification testing
 - Reliability test execution quality and accuracy
 - Reduction in repeat/recurring test failures
 - Timely identification and closure of reliability issues
 - Effectiveness of RCA and corrective actions
 - Laboratory equipment availability and utilization
 - Compliance with testing, calibration, safety, and documentation requirements
 - Contribution to product reliability and design improvements

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv's Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities. 

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion. 

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

- High-Performance Culture
 - Customer Focus
 - Operational Excellence
 - Innovation

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

 - Foster a customer-first mindset
 - Think big and execute

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers' vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today's data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. data.title: Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)
data.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

11

Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)

Role Summary

As the Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems), you will help architect and build the organization's next generation of autonomous AI workflows. This is a multidisciplinary technical role operating at the intersection of Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineering. You will move beyond simple "chatbots" to design production-grade Agentic Systems: intelligent applications capable of reasoning, planning, and executing complex tasks autonomously. 

Responsibilities

Agentic Systems Architecture & Core Engineering

- Architect & Build Multi-Agent Workflows: Lead the hands-on design and coding of stateful, production-grade agentic systems using Python and orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen. 
 - Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Communication: Design and implement robust A2A protocols enabling autonomous agents to collaborate, hand off sub-tasks, and negotiate execution paths dynamically within multi-agent environments. 
 - State Management & Orchestration: Engineer robust control flows for non-deterministic agents; implement complex message passing, memory persistence, and interruptible state handling to support long-running autonomous tasks. 
 - Tool Interface Design (MCP): Implement and standardize the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create universal interfaces between agents, data sources, and operational tools, ensuring modularity and scalability. 
 - Model Integration & Optimization: Utilize proxy services (i. e. LiteLLM) to manage model routing and fallback strategies; optimize context windows and inference costs across proprietary and open-source models. 
 - Production Deployment: Containerize agentic workloads using Docker and orchestrate deployments on Kubernetes; leverage AWS AgentCore or similar cloud-native services for scalable infrastructure. 

Data Engineering & Operational Real-Time Integration

- Build Agent Data Pipelines: Write and maintain high-throughput ingestion pipelines (using Databricks or Python-based ETL) that transform raw operational signals into structured context for agents. 
 - Real-Time Context Injection: Ensure agents have access to "operational real-time" data (seconds/minutes latency) by optimizing retrieval architectures and vector store performance. 
 - Cross-Functional Engineering: Act as the technical bridge between Data Engineering and AI teams; translate complex agent requirements into concrete data schemas and pipeline specifications, while stepping in to resolve hands-on bottlenecks in data availability. 

Observability, Governance & Human-in-the-Loop

- LLMOps & Tracing: Implement comprehensive observability using tools like Langfuse to trace agent reasoning steps, monitor token usage, and debug latency issues in production. 
 - Safety & Control Frameworks: Design hybrid execution modes ranging from Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) for sensitive operations to fully autonomous execution; build "break-glass" mechanisms and guardrails for automated decision-making. 
 - Evaluation & Reliability: Establish technical standards for testing non-deterministic outputs; automate evaluation pipelines to measure agent accuracy, hallucination rates, and drift before deployment. 

Technical Leadership & Strategy

- Technical Roadmap Definition: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to scope feasibility for autonomous projects; define the "Agentic Architecture" roadmap. 
 - Mentorship & Standards: Define code quality standards, architectural patterns, and PR review processes for the AI engineering team; upskill team members on the latest agentic frameworks and methodologies. 
 - Innovation: Proactively prototype with emerging tools (e. g. , new reasoning models, graph-based RAG) to solve high-value business problems, moving successful experiments into the production roadmap. 

Qualifications

Required

- Experience: 7+ years of total technical experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or Machine Learning. 
 - GenAI Specialization: 2+ years of specific experience building and deploying LLM-based applications or Agentic Systems in production. 
 - Database & Lakehouse Mastery: Experience architecting storage layers for AI, including Vector Databases (e. g. , Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant), NoSQL/Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB), and modern Data Lakehouses (specifically Databricks or Snowflake). 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Expertise in cloud architecture and container orchestration (AWS, GCP, or Azure) using Kubernetes and Docker. You must be comfortable deploying and scaling your own applications. 
 - LLM Ecosystem: Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and orchestration libraries (e. g. , LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen). You understand the mechanics of RAG, embeddings, and context window management. 
 - Hybrid Engineering Skillset: A unique blend of Data Science (understanding model behavior, probability, and prompting) and Software Engineering (CI/CD, API design, asynchronous programming, and system reliability). 
 - Language Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python for systems engineering, capable of writing modular, testable, and maintainable production code. 
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field. 

Preferred

- Advanced Education: Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field. 
 - NLP Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), ranging from foundational techniques (e. g. , text processing, embeddings, classification) to modern architectures. 
 - Graph Technologies: Experience with Knowledge Graphs (e. g. , Neo4j, AWS Neptune), Graph Databases, and GraphML (Graph Machine Learning) to support complex reasoning and relationship modeling. 
 - Agentic Tooling: Specific experience with LangGraph, LiteLLM, Langfuse, AWS AgentCore, or implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 - Advanced Architectures: Proven track record of implementing Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, swarm intelligence, or multi-modal agent workflows. 
 - Real-Time Operations: Experience working in environments requiring operational real-time processing (e. g. , FinTech, Energy, Logistics). 

Why This Role Matters

You won't just be building chatbots here; you will be architecting the organization's "central nervous system. " As the Lead AI Engineer for Agentic Systems, you are bridging the gap between static data models and active decision-making. The autonomous workflows you design-capable of planning, collaborating (A2A), and executing tasks-will fundamentally change how we operate, moving us from human-dependent processes to self-healing, intelligent systems. This is a rare opportunity to define the standards for Agentic AI in a production environment, working with a stack that represents the absolute cutting edge of the industry. 

About S&P Global Energy

At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration. 

S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. data.title: Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems
data.description:
Description

At Envalior, we combine over a century of materials expertise with innovation and digital technology to help create sustainable, high-performance solutions for our customers around the world. As our laboratories, manufacturing sites, and quality organizations become increasingly digital, we are looking for a Solution Engineer who can help bridge business processes and technology across Quality, Research & Technology (R&T), and Operational Technology (OT) domains. 

This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions. 

The Role

As a Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems, you will act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for a portfolio of laboratory, quality, and manufacturing applications, with a primary focus on Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). 

LIMS applications sit at the heart of Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement. 

You will work closely with Quality, R&T, Operations, Manufacturing, Digital Solutions Delivery, and Technology Services teams worldwide to support existing solutions while identifying opportunities for innovation, automation, and simplification. 

What You Will Do

Own and Support Critical Laboratory & Quality Systems

- Serve as the IT System Owner for Envalior's LIMS QA solutions. 
 - Manage the lifecycle of laboratory and quality applications, including enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and support activities. 
 - Ensure platforms remain secure, stable, and aligned with evolving business requirements. 
 - Act as the primary escalation point for complex application and process issues. 
 - Support business continuity across laboratory and quality operations globally. 

Partner with the Business

- Develop a deep understanding of Quality, R&T, and Operational Technology processes. 
 - Collaborate with laboratory managers, quality teams, manufacturing stakeholders, and digital colleagues to identify opportunities for improvement. 
 - Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions. 
 - Build strong relationships with stakeholders and effectively communicate the value of technology-enabled change. 

Drive Innovation and Digital Transformation

- Propose innovative information solutions by combining existing systems with emerging digital technologies.

Job Overview-

Location: Noida (Sector 132)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Required- 5-8 Years

About the Company-

Zoid is a high-tech R&D startup devoted to developing cutting-edge technologies in the Defence and Aerospace sector. We primarily deliver customized solutions to the Indian Armed Forces, leveraging our expertise in AI, Electronics, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, and Robotics. 

Currently Funded By The IDEX Initiative Under The Ministry Of Defence, India, We Are Working On Projects Of Strategic National Importance, Including

- AI-based FOD detection software for Naval Air Stations
 - Reusable Off-board Missile Decoys for Anti-Ship Missile Defense

Role Overview -

We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to lead the development and deployment systems for defense and aerospace applications. You will oversee system integration, drive technical requirements definition, and lead a team of system engineer and jr. engineer in a mission-critical product environment. You will be the bridge between hardware, software, and product teams, ensuring that all components work seamlessly together, meet performance specifications, and comply with defense/aerospace standards. 

Key Responsibilities

Design & Architect Core Software Systems

- Design end-to-end software architectures for defense systems: drone swarms, AI inference servers (marine/ground), third-party platform integrations, GCS/HMI, and vehicle-mounted sensor platforms 
 - Define the full stack for each system: application logic, IPC, networking, OS configuration, security hardening, deployment 
 - Produce documentation to IEEE/ISO/IEC 12207 and IEEE 29148 (prior experience not mandatory; learn within the first few months) 
 - Familiarity with DO-178C, MIL-STD-498, STANAG 4586 is a plus 
 - Set and enforce coding standards, code reviews, version control workflows, and CI/build practices

Autonomous UAV Software

- Modify ArduPilot/PX4 (or similar) core code: custom flight modes, EKF tuning, failsafe logic, new sensors and payloads 
 - Develop companion computer software for perception, mission decisions, payload control, and comms relay 
 - Build multi-drone swarming: coordination, formation control, task allocation, deconfliction 
 - Implement GNSS-denied navigation (VIO, optical flow, terrain-relative navigation) 
 - Work extensively with MAVLink, including custom messages 
 - Maintain SITL/HITL simulation and analyze flight logs 
 - Integrate payloads: gimbal cameras, EO/IR, GNSS, rangefinders, LIDAR, comms modules

Edge AI Deployment (COMPUTER)

- Run AI team models on systems, low-SWaP edge compute (Jetson Orin/Xavier, Intel NUC) and high-throughput rack/rugged servers 
 - Build edge infrastructure: video ingestion, pre-processing, result aggregation, alerting, structured logging 
 - Find bottlenecks and work with the CV engineer on model size, quantization, resolution, and architecture to hit latency/throughput targets

Hardware and Sensor Integration

- Interface with GNSS, IMUs, industrial/thermal cameras, LIDAR, rangefinders, radios, flight controllers, and gimbals 
 - Generic hardware: use and contribute to open-source drivers, configure kernel modules, write integration layers 
 - Specialized hardware (Basler/FLIR, Veronte, military radios): use vendor SDKs and build wrappers that isolate vendor dependencies 
 - Communicate over UART, SPI, I2C, RS-232, RS-422 
 - Read datasheets, coordinate with hardware engineers, debug hardware-software boundary issues

Linux Systems, Networking, and Infrastructure

- Build and harden Ubuntu OS images for field systems: secure boot, minimal attack surface, automated provisioning, systemd, permission lockdown 
 - Implement process management: watchdogs, heartbeats, auto-restart, graceful shutdown 
 - Write bash scripts for configuration, networking, orchestration, and deployment 
 - Build TCP/UDP, RTSP streaming, and mesh networking 
 - Implement IEEE 1588 PTP and NTP time synchronization

Required Qualifications

- 5 to 8 years of software engineering experience, mostly in robotics, autonomous systems, embedded, or defense software, with real hardware in the loop (drones, ground vehicles, robotic arms) 
 - Expert-level C++ (memory management, concurrency, multi-threading, performance optimization); production-level Python for automation and scripting 
 - Proven experience designing architectures for real-time or mission-critical systems: module decomposition, IPC, state machines, data flow, deployment topology 
 - Deep Linux proficiency: process management, networking stack, shell scripting, OS-level debugging 
 - Hands-on ArduPilot or PX4 source experience (or a comparable large robotics stack); understanding of MAVLink, SITL/HITL, companion computers, flight log analysis, custom flight modes 
 - Socket-level TCP/UDP programming; experience with at least one pub/sub middleware

Preferred Qualifications

- Ability (or demonstrated aptitude) to produce defense-grade documentation to IEEE 12207 
 - ML inference on edge hardware (Jetson Orin/Xavier, NUC-class; TensorRT, ONNX Runtime) 
 - DDS implementation, including QoS configuration and domain architecture 
 - Hardware bring-up experience: UART, SPI, I2C, RS-422, industrial camera SDKs (Basler, FLIR, Allied Vision) 
 - ROS/ROS 2 with real robot or drone deployments 
 - GStreamer/RTSP video pipeline development 
 - GNSS receiver integration and protocols (NMEA, UBX) 
 - IEEE 1588 PTP / NTP time synchronization 
 - Familiarity with DO-178C, MIL-STD-498, STANAG 4586 
 - Multi-drone swarming, formation control, or multi-agent coordination 
 - Open-source contributions (ArduPilot, PX4, ROS, or equivalent) 
 - GCS and C2/HMI software (QGroundControl, Mission Planner, or custom), STANAG 4586, or naval combat management system integration 
 - Tactical radios and data links: mesh radios, basic link budgets, encrypted links

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day. 

Smartsheet is hiring a Manager, Revenue Operations Analytics to lead and grow our India-based analytics team in Bangalore. This is a senior people management role at the intersection of analytical strategy and operational execution - you will own the day-to-day leadership of five Senior Revenue Operations Analysts and one Data Engineer, while serving as a key strategic partner to Go-To Market (GTM) leadership globally. 

You will drive the analytical agenda that informs Smartsheet's growth strategy, aligning data and analysis around pipeline health, sales productivity, retention, territory effectiveness, services utilization, and commission planning. Your team will be at the center of how the GTM organization understands its business and makes decisions. 

This role is designed to bring senior analytical leadership into the IST time zone, providing direct, timezone-aligned support to the India-based team while maintaining meaningful overlap with North America Pacific Time leadership. You will also be a bridge to Smartsheet's Bangalore BI and Data Engineering teams, deepening the partnership between Revenue Operations and the broader data platform organization. 

You will report to our Sr Manager, Revenue Operation Analytics. 

You Will

- People Leadership & Team Development
 - Directly manage 5 Senior Revenue Operations Analysts and 1 Data Engineer in Bangalore, providing day-to-day guidance, coaching, and operational support. 
 - Set clear priorities, hold the team accountable for high-quality and timely outputs, and own performance management including merit reviews and calibrations. 
 - Support career growth through regular 1: 1s, identifying skill gaps, and coordinating mentorship and development opportunities. 
 - Partner with HR on recruiting, onboarding, and workforce planning for the Bangalore team. 
 - Analytics Execution & Business Partnership
 - Act as the primary analytics business partner out of our Bangalore office for Global Sales and GTM leaders, translating business questions into structured analysis, reports, and recommendations. 
 - Lead team execution across Revenue Operations priorities: pipeline health, retention, sales productivity, territory performance, services utilization, and commission planning. 
 - Help create, evolve, and maintain the Sales reporting infrastructure; mine large datasets to surface insights and monitor for anomalies and data quality issues. 
 - Partner with Bangalore BI and Data Engineering teams to build scalable analytics solutions and ensure data pipelines meet the team's needs. 
 - Present findings clearly to stakeholders across the organization - from peer teams to senior GTM leadership - for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Operations & Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Translate functional plans into operational processes; manage team work intake, project tracking, stakeholder updates, and milestone reviews. 
 - Recommend and implement process improvements that increase team throughput and analytical quality. 
 - Maintain flexible overlap with North America Pacific Time leadership to stay aligned on priorities, decisions, and escalations. 
 - Build strong relationships with the Bangalore BI and Data Engineering organizations, connecting Revenue Operations Analytics to the broader data platform. 
You Have

- 8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, revenue operations, or a related quantitative discipline. 
 - 2+ years of direct people management experience, with demonstrated ability to develop and support a team of analysts. 
 - Deep expertise in SQL and data preparation for analysis, modeling, and visualization. 
 - Experience with business intelligence tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or equivalent). 
 - Proven ability to translate business questions into analysis, reports, and recommendations for Sales or GTM stakeholders. 
 - Experience in Cloud or SaaS go-to-market analytics (pipeline, ARR, retention, sales productivity, or similar). 
 - Strong communication skills - able to present data and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Comfortable with flexible working hours to maintain overlap with North American Pacific Time leadership. 
 - Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (engineering, mathematics, statistics, economics, business, or computer science). 

Nice To Have

- Experience with statistical techniques: time series analysis, cluster analysis, multivariate modeling. 
 - Familiarity with data engineering concepts and ability to collaborate effectively with a data engineer on pipeline and infrastructure work. 
 - Channel / Partner GTM experience. 
 - Experience working in a global, matrixed organization with cross-functional teams across time zones. 
 - Prior experience partnering with BI or Data Engineering teams in a shared-service model. 

Get To Know Us

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths-because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. 

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

data.title: Team Lead - CRE
data.description:
Job Description

As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the world's top professional services firms, and in support of our global workforce strategy, we're growing our operations in India! We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!

CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients' unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices worldwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia. 

We currently have an exciting career opportunity for Senior to join the Assurance CRE Team in our National Assurance practice. 

CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered hybrid which means team members are expected to be thoughtful and intentional in how they create opportunities for in-person collaboration. While the cadence of in-office presence is determined at the team level, our professionals are encouraged to be in the office/together in person on average 3 days a week. 

YOUR TEAM. 

This position will support our Assurance - Senior CRE and as an Audit Industry Senior CRE, you will be part of a dynamic team delivering high-quality audit and assurance services to clients in the Finance sectors. You will work closely with clients and internal teams to understand industry-specific challenges and provide actionable insights that drive business performance. 

WHY COHNREZNICK?

At CohnReznick, we're united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it's working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your "why" at the firm. 

We believe it's important to balance work with everyday life - and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning & development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer. 

YOUR ROLE. 

Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To

- Responsibilities include but not limited to: 
 - Drive client engagements
 - Review and prepare financial statements, footnotes & workpapers
 - Demonstrate professional creativity in dealing with client matters and make constructive suggestions to improve client operations
 - Effectively analyze client transactions, recognizing potential or existing problems, conducts appropriate research, and works closely with managers on resolving the issue
 - Understand the purpose of accounting and general ledger recording procedures
 - Perform auditing procedures in accordance with firm standards and in an accurate, thorough and timely manner, including proposing journal entries to client general ledgers
 - Serve as the Engagement Lead on specific client accounts, taking responsibility for pre-engagement planning, execution, and final deliverable
 - Develop a detailed engagement work plan, illustrating budgets and schedules
 - Monitor project status against the work plan and communicate schedule adjustments to managers and/or partners
 - Oversee, mentor, and develop staff
 - Develop a professional relationship with the client and serve as the primary point-of-contact

Your Experience. 

- The successful candidate will have: 
 - The successful candidate will have: 
 - 5+ years of work experience in another public accounting firm
 - Exceptional analytical, technical, and auditing skills including knowledge in US GAAP and GAAS
 - Exceptional client service and communication skills and strong leadership and mentoring skills, coupled with excellent written interpersonal, and presentation skills
 - Demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit
 - Computer expertise including knowledge of audit-preparation software and an understanding of the impact of technology
 - Proven technical skills with MS Office applications such as Excel, Word, and Outlook; audit software - CCH Engagement experience
 - Exceptional organizational and communication (verbal and written) skills

In addition, please take a moment to review our Universal Job Standards. 

Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles. 

"CohnReznick" is the brand name under which CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC and their respective subsidiaries provide professional services. CohnReznick LLP and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiaries) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. CohnReznick LLP is a licensed CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. CohnReznick Advisory LLC and its subsidiaries are not licensed CPA firms. 

CohnReznick is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive team to drive business results and create a better future every day for our team members, clients, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

data.title: Sr. Software Engineer | Defence
data.description:
Location: Noida (Sector 132)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience : 5-8 years

About The Company-

Zoid is a high-tech R&D startup devoted to developing cutting-edge technologies in the Defence and Aerospace sector. We primarily deliver customized solutions to the Indian Armed Forces, leveraging our expertise in AI, Electronics, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, and Robotics. 

Currently Funded By The IDEX Initiative Under The Ministry Of Defence, India, We Are Working On Projects Of Strategic National Importance, Including

- AI-based FOD detection software for Naval Air Stations
 - Reusable Off-board Missile Decoys for Anti-Ship Missile Defense

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to design and lead our software architecture, AI/Computer Vision systems integration, and embedded systems infrastructure. You will be a technical leader who codes, architects, and mentors-driving both strategic system design and hands-on execution. You will take ownership of end-to-end software systems, from hardware abstraction layers through AI pipelines, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability for defence and aerospace applications. 

Key Responsibilities -

Design & Architect Core Software Systems

- Define system architecture for project requirements. 
 - Create modular, scalable design patterns that handle real-time sensor inputs and AI inference pipelines 
 - Design hardware abstraction layers for seamless integration with various sensors (cameras, LiDAR, thermal) and edge processors 
 - Establish data flow architecture, APIs, and communication protocols between components 
 - Document architectural decisions, design patterns, and system specifications

Production Code Development in C++

- Write high-performance, production-grade C++ code for critical system components 
 - Develop code for GPU-accelerated AI inference and image processing 
 - Implement multi-threaded, real-time systems with stringent latency requirements 
 - Conduct performance profiling and optimization (memory, CPU, GPU utilization) 
 - Maintain code quality through testing, code reviews, and documentation

Lead AI & Computer Vision Implementation

- Own the integration of AI/CV models (detection, tracking, anomaly detection) into production systems 
 - Optimize model inference pipelines for edge deployment on resource-constrained devices 
 - Implement real-time processing frameworks handling multi-camera feeds and sensor fusion 
 - Benchmark and optimize performance (latency, throughput, memory footprint) 
 - Work on model quantization, pruning, and optimization for efficient edge execution

Hardware & Sensor Integration

- Lead integration efforts with hardware teams: cameras, compute modules, networking equipment, sensors 
 - Define hardware requirements and validate hardware selections 
 - Implement device drivers, firmware interfaces, and hardware communication protocols 
 - Ensure systems remain reliable in long-term industrial/defence deployments. 
 - Interface with GNSS receivers, inertial measurement units (IMUs), industrial cameras, thermal/IR cameras, LIDAR, rangefinders, communication radios, gimbal systems, and other peripherals. 
 - Contribute to open-source drivers, configure kernel modules, and write integration layers. 
 - For specialized hardware (e. g. , Basler/FLIR industrial cameras, Veronte autopilots, military-grade radios): work with manufacturer SDKs, understand vendor-specific APIs and protocols. 
 - Communicate over serial protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, RS-232, RS-422) . 

Linux Systems Software

- Set up and optimize Linux kernel configurations for real-time performance 
 - Provision, configure, and harden Linux (Ubuntu) OS images for field-deployed systems: minimal attack surface, systemd service management, user/permission lockdown. 
 - Implement process management: watchdog timers, heartbeat monitoring, automatic service restart, graceful shutdown sequencing, zombie process management. 
 - Write robust Bash scripts for Ubuntu command-line automation 
 - Manage system-level drivers, device tree configurations, and boot processes 
 - Implement system monitoring, logging, and telemetry frameworks 
 - Handle cross-compilation, build systems (CMake, Yocto), and deployment pipelines

Networking & Infrastructure Development

- Design and implement network communication layers (Ethernet, CAN, MQTT, gRPC) 
 - Set up edge computing infrastructure and distributed system communication 
 - Implement secure communication protocols and data transmission standards 
 - Manage system interconnectivity 
 - Build TCP/UDP socket communication, RTSP video streaming pipelines, and mesh networking for multi-node systems. 

Technical Planning & Execution

- Create technical roadmaps aligned with product goals (6-12 month outlook) 
 - Break down complex architectural work into executable sprints and milestones 
 - Identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and scalability challenges early 
 - Drive solutions and proof-of-concepts for new technical requirements 
 - Coordinate with systems engineers on end-to-end testing and validation 
 - Support field testing and customer deployment efforts with technical expertise

Required Qualifications

- 5-8 years of software development experience in complex, real-time systems 
 - Expert-level proficiency in C++ ; deep understanding of memory management, concurrency, multi-threading, and performance optimization 
 - Strong hands-on experience optimizing AI inference on GPUs 
 - Proven background in AI/Computer Vision (model deployment, PyTorch/TensorFlow, OpenCV) 
 - Deep experience with Linux kernel and linux based OS, system programming, device drivers, and embedded systems 
 - Solid knowledge of networking protocols, hardware integration, and sensor interfaces 
 - Experience with technical documentation and architectural design patterns 
 - Proven experience designing architectures for real-time or mission-critical systems: module decomposition, IPC, state machines, data flow, deployment topology 
 - Experience building multi-threaded and multi-process systems on multi-core and/or multi-GPU hardware. 
 - Produce documentation to IEEE/ISO/IEC 12207 and IEEE 29148 (prior experience not mandatory; learn within the first few months) 
 - Demonstrated problem-solving and systems-level thinking 
 - Leadership experience (formal team lead) 
 - Strong communication skills; ability to explain complex technical concepts

Desirable Qualifications

- Experience with defence or aerospace software systems and constraints 
 - Knowledge of distributed systems, edge computing, and system scalability patterns 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices 
 - Ability to produce defence-grade engineering documentation to IEEE 12207 or demonstrated aptitude to learn. 
 - Implement pub/sub middleware (DDS) for real-time communication in distributed defence systems, including domain partitioning, QoS policy configuration, and topic architecture. 
 - Experience deploying ML inference pipelines on edge hardware (Jetson, NUC) or server hardware (multi-GPU, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, CUDA). 
 - DDS middleware implementation including QoS configuration and domain architecture. 
 - Hardware integration experience: sensor bring-up, serial protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, RS-422), industrial camera SDKs (Basler, FLIR, Allied Vision). 
 - Familiarity with defence software standards (DO-178C, MIL-STD-498, STANAG 4586). CODE- SOFTTECH

Skills: c++, linux, architecture, software

data.title: Senior Manager Design-Solidworks
data.description:
Job Title: Senior Design Manager

Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India

Experience: Minimum 15 years overall; 7+ years in leadership

Working Days- Monday-Saturday

Employment Type: Full-time

  

Role summary

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Design Manager with deep expertise in SolidWorks and Production line experience in Sheet Metal. You will lead design projects from concept through validation, mentor engineers, enforce design-for-manufacturability and cost‐efficiency, and drive continuous improvement in processes and tools. The role requires strong technical judgment, excellent stakeholder management, and hands-on involvement in complex sheet‐metal product development. 

  

Key accountabilities-

- Team leadership and people management

  - Recruit, develop, retain, and scale a high-performing design team (mechanical engineers, CAD leads, drafters). 

  - Establish clear role descriptions, career ladders, KPIs, and individual development plans. 

  - Conduct regular 1: 1s, performance reviews, succession planning, and calibration with HR and senior leadership. 

  - Promote a culture of ownership, continuous learning, safety, and cross-functional collaboration. 

  

- Technical ownership and hands-on design

  - Provide hands-on SolidWorks leadership for complex sheet‐metal parts and assemblies; create and review 3D models, flat patterns, BOMs, and manufacturing drawings. 

  - Set and enforce CAD modeling standards, naming conventions, feature suppression strategies, and template libraries. 

  - Approve final CAD deliverables for prototype release and production release; maintain as‐built documentation. 

  

- Product development lifecycle & project leadership

  - Drive design phases: conceptualization, feasibility, prototyping, verification, pilot production, and full-scale production. 

  - Define design milestones, gate criteria, quality checkpoints, and deliverables (DFMEA, test plans, validation matrices). 

  - Lead cross-functional Design Reviews (DRs) and Gate Reviews; present technical trade-offs and risk mitigation plans to stakeholders. 

  

- Manufacturability, cost optimization & supplier engineering

  - Own DFMA for sheet‐metal: material selection, blank size optimization, bend allowances, nesting strategies, common parts, and fastener selection. 

  - Collaborate with toolrooms and suppliers on tooling design (dies, progressive tooling, fixtures), vendor capabilities, and lead-time management. 

  - Drive cost-down initiatives through design simplification, standardization, and volume-based sourcing strategies. 

  

- Quality, compliance & reliability

  - Ensure designs meet applicable standards (safety, EMC, environmental) and internal quality requirements. 

  - Lead root cause analysis (8D) for field failures involving mechanical design; drive corrective & preventive actions. 

  - Oversee validation plans: structural testing, fatigue, vibration, thermal, and ingress protection as required. 

  

- Process improvement & systems

  - Implement and mature CAD/PDM/PLM workflows (SolidWorks PDM/Manage, Teamcenter, Windchill), change control (ECO), and revision management. 

  - Champion automation: design tables, macros, templates, configurators, and model-based definition (MBD) where applicable. 

  - Institutionalize best practices: design reuse libraries, standard parts catalogs, and knowledge-sharing sessions. 

  

- Stakeholder management & reporting

- Work closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, QA, and Program Management to align schedules, costs, and requirements. 

  - Produce regular reports on design progress, risks, resource utilization, and cost metrics to senior leadership. 

  - Represent the design function in supplier selection, audits, and escalation meetings. 

  

Deliverables & success metrics

- Deliverables

  - Complete CAD packages (models, flat patterns, drawings, BOMs) for prototypes and production. 

  - DFMEA, tolerance stack-ups, verification & validation plans, prototype test reports. 

  - Design standard documentation, CAD libraries, and training materials. 

  

Required qualifications & experience (expanded)

- Education: B. Tech/B. E. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent; M. Tech/M. S. preferred. 

- Experience: Minimum 15 years in mechanical/product design with heavy emphasis on sheet‐metal; at least 7 years in a managerial or lead capacity. 

- CAD skills: Expert-level SolidWorks (modeling, sheet‐metal module, assemblies, weldments, routing optional), experience with SolidWorks PDM/Manage or equivalent. 

- Manufacturing knowledge: Thorough understanding of sheet‐metal fabrication processes (laser, plasma, punching, bending, progressive forming), welding, adhesive joining, rivets, fastening, surface treatments, and finish processes. 

- Systems: Hands-on experience with PLM/PDM systems, ECO workflows, BOM management, and basic ERP interactions. 

- Process skills: DFMA, GD&T, tolerance analysis, DFMEA, root cause analysis tools (8D, RCA), and test plan development. 

- Leadership: Demonstrated people management, hiring, mentoring, and stakeholder negotiation experience. 

- Communication: Strong written and verbal English; ability to present technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 

- Mobility: Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to suppliers and production sites (as required). 

  

Preferred / differentiating skills

- Certifications: CSWP/CSWE, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP or equivalent. 

- Domain experience: Automotive, industrial machinery, telecom enclosures, medical devices, appliances, or defense. 

- Simulation: Experience with sheet‐metal forming simulation (e. g. , AutoForm), FEA for stamped parts, topology optimization. 

- Tooling & fixtures: Prior experience designing jigs, fixtures, and progressive dies. 

- Software: Exposure to CAM, nesting software, NestMaster, Lantek, RADAN or similar. 

- Manufacturing exposure: Experience working with contract manufacturers and international supply chains.

data.title: Head of Software Platforms-Electronics Automation
data.description:
TEAL designs and builds precision automation equipment for for Fortune 500 customers who demand world class throughput, repeatability, and reliability. We are a subsidiary of Titan Company Limited and a Tata Enterprise. 

Our equipment is getting smarter. The next generation of our platforms integrates vision AI, real-time sensing, and adaptive control into the machines we build. The software layer is no longer a supporting function - it is how our products differentiate. 

We are looking for a Head of Software Platforms to build and own that layer for electronics manufacturing. You will own the software architecture across our control, vision, and applied AI platforms, hire and lead a team of software and controls engineers, and ensure delivery keeps pace with hardware and process development. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will make architectural decisions, review code, and stay close to the engineering - while building the practices and team that allow TEAL's software capability to scale. You will be working with leading tech companies who are our manufacturing customers. 

What You Will Own

- Software architecture across machine control, vision AI, and applied AI platforms - modular, testable, built to evolve- you will be creating and shaping product platforms. 
 - Real-time machine control software: motion control, HMI, data acquisition, process control, diagnostics · Integration with industrial protocols: EtherCAT, OPC-UA, Profinet, and sensor/actuator interfaces · Vision AI inference pipeline and camera integration layer (working alongside AI/ML Research Lead who owns model architecture)
 - Robotics and vision integration in high tech manufacturing applications
 - AI deployment infrastructure: TensorRT, ONNX, model versioning, edge inference for <50ms production targets - we are early stage, so you get to shape use cases around physical AI implementation. 
 - Software engineering culture: Git, CI/CD, code review, structured testing for control software and AI pipelines · Delivery commitments across concurrent programmes - schedule, quality, and customer commissioning readiness
 - Hiring and developing a team to a scalable organisation

What We Are Looking For

- 10+ years in software development; 5+ years in a leadership or technical lead role
 - Hands-on experience building software with hardware integration - motion control, machine vision, PC-based controls OR hands on experience of building platforms for hardware applications in relevant industry segements. 
 - Track record of building software teams and engineering practices from early stages, not just inheriting them. Startup experiences are greatly valued. 
 - Proficiency in C#, Python, C++. Familiarity with PC-based automation frameworks or PLC mechanisms such as with TwinCAT, Beckhoff, or equivalent. 
 - Familiarity with AI/ML deployment: TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, edge inference optimisation. You don't train models - you own the pipeline that deploys them · Understanding of software safety standards (IEC 62061, ISO 13849) in a machine context
 - Exposure to electronics, semiconductor, battery, or manufacturing is a plus. Adjacent high-precision industries welcome· Those with Startup or high-growth product platform experiences are strongly encouraged to apply

Why This Role

· The software platform is being built now - you make the foundational decisions · Your software runs in high tech manufacturing environments in Fortune 500 factories; you get to build use cases for physical AI applications. 

Real engineering problems: the software has to work on a machine, under manufacturing constraints, in front of a customer · Hosur, Tamil Nadu - near Bangalore, close to India's electronics manufacturing growth corridor

Combining deep expertise and the development of the world's most cutting-edge, high-performance supercomputers, is defining the next era of computing delivering valuable insight & innovation. Join us and redefine what's next for you. 

What You'll Do

Key Responsibilities

Architect & Deliver Scale-Up Networking

- Design and implement GPU-aware networking paths for high-bandwidth, low-latency intra-node communication. 
 - Develop and optimize GPU → NIC → GPU data movement, shared memory models, and DMA pathways. 

GPU Ecosystem Integration

- Work with NVIDIA CUDA, NVLink, NCCL, and AMD ROCm, InfinityFabric, RCCL teams to integrate and optimize scale-up communication semantics. 
 - Drive improvements to DMA engines, BAR mappings, ATS/IOMMU, and GPU memory registration workflows. 

Runtime & Communication Stack Development

- Enhance and extend Libfabric, UCX, CXI, SHMEMX, OpenMPI for GPU-accelerated scale-up workflows. 
 - Optimize communication collectives, transport layers, and GPU-direct capabilities. 

Multi-NIC / NUMA Performance Optimization

- Characterize and tune multi-NIC per socket, NUMA-zone mapping, GPU locality, CQ/queue design, and CPU/GPU topology optimization. 

Upstreaming & Architecture Influence

- Lead upstream contributions to open-source projects (OFI, UCX, OpenMPI, RCCL/NCCL enablement). 
 - Partner with HPC/AI ecosystem teams to shape future architectures. 

Debugging, Performance, and Quality

- Own complex debugging across driver, runtime, GPU, kernel, and user-space boundaries. 
 - Develop profiling workflows using Nsight, ROCm tools, eBPF, perf, etc. 

What You Need To Bring

Required Skills & Experience

- 10-15+ years building high-performance networking, GPU, or kernel-level software. 
 - Deep expertise in C/C++, Linux internals, memory management, RDMA, PCIe, IOMMU, ATS, DMA engines. 
 - Strong understanding of CUDA, ROCm, GPU memory models, P2P, GDS (GPUDirect Storage), GDR (GPUDirect RDMA). 
 - Hands-on experience with MPI, SHMEM, Libfabric, UCX, or similar communication stacks. 
 - Proven experience driving architecture, cross-org technical decisions, and upstream contributions.

data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary

Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5Gs potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age - and this is where you come in. 

Qualcomm has been at the forefront of driving the revolution in the mobile gaming space by providing state of the art powerful GPUs as part of the Snapdragon program. Snapdragon Elite Gaming delivers the full suite of desktop-level features, including volumetric rendering for hyper-realistic visuals. Qualcomm® AdrenoTM GPU is the powerhouse engine behind high-performance graphics and rich user experiences with low power consumption. Our AdrenoTM GPU is designed to quickly render complex geometries for next-level visuals in games and apps-with super-fast responsiveness and superior mobile connectivity for truly immersive experiences. As part of GPU performance and architecture team, the candidate will be working on the latest and greatest in GPU architecture and Computer Graphics. The role revolves around working on analyzing the most popular games and benchmarks which use highly advanced rendering techniques, evaluating their performance on Qualcomm GPUs, define new optimizations/algorithms/configurations for the Adreno GPUs and modeling them to define next generation of AdrenoTM GPU

Responsibilities

- Conduct system level performance analysis and bottleneck analysis for intricate, high-performance GPUs and System-on-Chips (SoCs). 
 - Utilize hardware models at various levels of abstraction, including performance models, RTL test benches, emulators, and silicon, to scrutinize and identify performance bottlenecks in the system. 
 - Comprehend key performance use-cases of the product and formulate workloads and test suits focusing on graphics, machine learning, automotive, video, and computer vision applications. 
 - Collaborate closely with architecture and design teams to explore architecture trade-offs related to system performance, area, and power consumption. 
 - Develop necessary infrastructure, including performance models, testbench components, and performance analysis and visualization tools.

Job Description

We are looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to own the end-to-end architecture of our platform and drive its evolution as we scale. You will design, build, and maintain a multi-service application spanning backend, frontend, AI/ML services, and cloud infrastructure, while ensuring the platform is secure, scalable, and maintainable. As we move deeper into client conversations, this role also requires you to represent engineering in client discussions and lead the design of integrations between our platform and external HRMS (Human Resource Management System) or ATS (Applicant Tracking System) products. 

Role Details

- Own the technical architecture of the platform end-to-end, including backend services, frontend applications, data stores, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Design and evolve a scalable, secure, and maintainable microservices architecture using Java and Spring Boot, deployed on AWS (with a growing footprint on GCP and Azure). 
 - Guide and review the development of Python FastAPI-based AI services, including integration with OpenAI and Vapi for conversational/voice AI use cases. 
 - Define data architecture and access patterns across MongoDB and Redis, ensuring performance, consistency, and cost efficiency at scale. 
 - Architect and oversee real-time communication features using WebSockets, and asynchronous messaging workflows via MSG91 (email/SMS) and WhatsApp. 
 - Set technical direction for the Angular, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS frontend, and the Electron-based desktop application, ensuring consistency, performance, and code quality. 
 - Establish and enforce standards for observability and monitoring using Grafana (backend/infra) and Sentry (frontend), including alerting and incident response practices. 
 - Own authentication and identity architecture across Microsoft SSO and related identity providers, ensuring secure access management for enterprise clients. 
 - Guide secure use of Microsoft Graph API for email-based workflows in staffing scenarios, and Judge0 for code-execution/assessment use cases. 
 - Drive build vs. buy and tooling decisions, manage technical debt, and maintain architecture documentation (system diagrams, ADRs, data flow diagrams). 
 - Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines and build processes (Maven and related tooling) to support reliable, frequent releases. 
 - Participate in client discussions and solutioning calls, translating client requirements into technical designs and realistic delivery estimates. 
 - Lead the design and delivery of integrations between our platform and third-party HRMS/ATS systems (e. g. , data sync, SSO, webhooks, candidate/employee data exchange, API-based or file-based integrations). 
 - Act as the primary technical point of contact for prospective and existing clients on integration feasibility, data security, and architecture questions during pre-sales and onboarding. 
 - Mentor engineers across backend, frontend, and AI teams, and conduct architecture/design reviews for major features. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Backend & Cloud

- Java and Spring Boot for building production-grade microservices
 - AWS: strong hands-on experience across compute, storage, networking, and managed services; working knowledge of GCP and Azure is a plus (platform is moving toward a broader multi/all-AWS setup)
 - MongoDB and Redis: schema/data modeling, indexing, caching strategies, and performance tuning
 - Python and FastAPI for AI-service development
 - WebSocket-based real-time systems
 - Maven-based build and dependency management
 - Grafana for metrics, dashboards, and alerting

Frontend

- Angular and TypeScript for enterprise web applications
 - Tailwind CSS for scalable, consistent UI styling
 - Electron for cross-platform desktop application development
 - Sentry for frontend error monitoring and performance tracking

Integrations, Messaging & AI

- MSG91 (email and SMS) and WhatsApp Business API for transactional/notification workflows
 - Vapi for voice bot/conversational AI integrations
 - OpenAI APIs for AI-assisted product features
 - Judge0 for code execution/assessment workflows
 - Microsoft Graph API for email-specific staffing workflows
 - Microsoft SSO and enterprise identity/authentication protocols (OAuth2, SAML, OIDC)
 - Jupyter for prototyping and validating AI/data workflows

Mandatory Non-Technical Skills

- Experience with additional cloud platforms (GCP, Azure) beyond AWS. 
 - Familiarity with conversational AI/voice bot platforms and prompt engineering for LLM-based features. 
 - Exposure to DevOps practices: containerization, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipeline design. 
 - Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure/GCP equivalents) are a plus. 

Education Qualification and Certifications required, If any

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 8-14 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years designing and owning system architecture for production applications at scale. 
 - Demonstrated experience architecting systems that combine backend services, frontend applications, cloud infrastructure, and third-party integrations. 
 - Prior experience in HR-tech, staffing, recruitment, or workforce-management platforms is strongly preferred. 
 - Experience presenting technical solutions directly to clients or in pre-sales/solutioning contexts.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

TITLE

Senior Software Engineer

Who We Are

Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences. 

Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you'll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration. 

About Vista

Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you'll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers. 

Position Overview

The Senior Software Engineer, Senior Manager at Duck Creek Technologies is a high-impact technical leadership role responsible for providing deep expertise and strategic direction in the development of advanced software solutions for the insurance technology sector. This position focuses on technical innovation, architectural excellence, and the delivery of complex software systems. As a Senior Software Engineer, this role requires significant experience in leading large-scale technical projects but does not involve direct people management. The Senior Software Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to define and execute the technology vision while driving engineering best practices across the organization. 

What You'll d

- Serves as the technical lead for large-scale, complex software projects, ensuring architectural integrity, scalability, and performance across cloud-native systems. 
 - Provides expert guidance on software design, architecture, and implementation strategies - including cloud infrastructure architecture (Azure), containerized/orchestrated deployments (Kubernetes), and Infrastructure-as-Code practices (Terraform) - to ensure alignment with business and technical objectives. 
 - Drives technical innovation and evaluates emerging technologies, including AI-assisted and agentic development tooling, for integration into the engineering ecosystem, defining team standards for their safe and effective use. 
 - Leads the design and development of key system components, frameworks, and services that form the foundation of Duck Creek's product offerings. 
 - Collaborates with Product Management, Quality Assurance, and other Engineering teams to deliver high-quality, on-time software solutions. 
 - Influences technical roadmaps and makes architectural decisions that support long-term scalability, maintainability, and cloud cost efficiency. 
 - Ensures adherence to software development best practices, including coding standards, automated testing, security, performance optimization, and responsible use of AI-generated code. 
 - Partners with engineering teams across the organization to solve complex technical challenges - including production infrastructure issues (cloud networking, autoscaling, deployment pipelines) - and drives engineering excellence. 
 - Conducts design reviews, code reviews, and provides constructive feedback to engineering teams, applying the same scrutiny to AI-assisted contributions as to hand-written code. 
 - Develops and maintains detailed technical documentation that supports engineering teams in delivering solutions efficiently. 
 - Works closely with DevOps to ensure CI/CD pipelines are optimized for fast, reliable, and secure software delivery. 
 - Acts as a thought leader within the engineering organization, contributing to technical discussions, knowledge sharing, and fostering a culture of technical excellence - including how AI tooling is adopted responsibly across teams. 
 - Performs all other duties and activities as required. 
 - Acts in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies' mission, vision, and core values. 

What You've Done

Education and Work Experience: 

- Bachelor's degree, or higher education level, or its foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Computer Information Sciences, and/or related field 
 - Total Work Experience: 12+ years (software development) 
 - Leadership Experience: 3 years minimum, 5 years preferred

Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors

- Extensive experience with software architecture, design patterns, and microservices. 
 - Strong technical leadership experience on large-scale projects in a global organization. 
 - Experience with cloud-native architectures, containerization, and orchestration technologies (e. g. , Kubernetes, Docker) and their autoscaling/production operational characteristics. 
 - Hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or equivalent) and cloud platform engineering, including diagnosing infrastructure-level issues (networking, load balancing, quotas). 
 - Demonstrated experience leading teams in the adoption of AI-assisted and agentic software development practices, with a clear point of view on governance, code-review rigor, and risk management for AI-generated code. 
 - Prior experience working in a senior technical role in a global software company. 
 - In-depth understanding of modern software development methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, and DevOps practices. 
 - Proficiency in managing complex software development projects with competing priorities and deadlines. 
 - Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions. 
 - Expertise in cloud computing platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. 
 - Knowledge of software architecture principles, including microservices, APIs, and containerization. 
 - Ability to foster a collaborative, high-performing engineering culture that embraces new tooling (including AI) without compromising quality or accountability. 
 - Proven ability to manage budgets, forecasts, and resource planning in an engineering organization. 
 - Proficiency in software development tools, such as Jira, Git, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or equivalent). 
 - Commitment to continuous improvement, innovation, and process optimization. 
 - Ability to manage conflict and resolve complex team dynamics. 
 - Strategic thinking with a focus on long-term planning and aligning engineering efforts with business goals. 
 - High emotional intelligence and ability to manage diverse teams effectively. 
 - Ability to operate in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with changing priorities. 

CORE COMPETENCIES

Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing-treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds. 

LEARN MORE

- Company Website - Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
 - Life at Duck Creek - Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
 - Benefits & Rewards - Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING

Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. 

This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities. 

At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs. 

The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations. 

What We Stand For

Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems. 

Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements-without regard to any protected status. 

We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead. 

To learn more: https: //www. duckcreek. com/life-at-duck-creek/

AI STATEMENT

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our SaaS Onboarding & Reliability team at SimCorp. This role is pivotal in ensuring the seamless delivery, integration, and reliability of our cloud-based solutions. As part of a cross-functional agile team, you will combine your expertise in software development and IT operations to enhance deployment pipelines, automate infrastructure, and maintain high service availability. 

You will play both DevOps and SRE roles - building and automating our Azure platform while keeping mission-critical client environments reliable and secure. You will contribute to the onboarding of new clients onto our GAIN SaaS offering and play a key part in our strategic migration of live clients from AWS to Azure. You will promote continuous improvement through feedback, monitoring, and collaboration with peers and stakeholders. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

DevOps & Engineering

- Administer and support SimCorp Data Management and Cloud SaaS (GAIN) environments for internal and external clients. 
 - Build and manage cloud environments using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, ARM). 
 - Develop and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines to automate builds, deployments, and integrations. 
 - Create and enhance automation scripts (PowerShell, Python, etc. ) to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort. 
 - Streamline release and deployment processes for faster, more reliable delivery. 
 - Apply OS, database, and infrastructure patches in line with current standards. 
 - Conduct Proof of Concepts (PoCs) with Cloud Services Architects to evaluate new solutions. 
 - Contribute to the migration of live clients - building and adapting the infrastructure and pipelines required to stand up client environments on Azure. 

Monitoring, Reliability & Incident Management (SRE)

- Implement monitoring and alerting solutions for Azure services and infrastructure. 
 - Manage incidents, problems, and changes in alignment with SRE and ITIL best practices. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex technical issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing sustainable fixes. 
 - Schedule, optimise, and transition batch jobs to event-driven patterns using enterprise schedulers (e. g. ActiveBatch). 
 - Participate in disaster recovery and business continuity exercises, including annual VAPT. 
 - Provide weekend or on-call support on a rotational basis.
