data.title: Plant Operations Specialist
data.description:
Position-GM Plant

Location Ambaji (Gujrat)

Assignments: 

A. Plant Commissioning & Strategic Leadership

- Lead the beneficiation plant from construction/pre-commissioning through commissioning and ramp-up to peak capacity, coordinating closely with EPC contractors, equipment OEMs and the Project Director. 
 - Oversee day-to-day plant operations to ensure production targets are met; develop production plans and schedules aligned to mine ore supply and project/customer requirements. 
 - Implement and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all plant activities; analyse production data and drive continuous improvement in productivity and cost-effectiveness. 
 - Address quality or throughput issues and implement corrective actions as needed; coordinate across mining, maintenance, QC and logistics for smooth material flow. 
 - Lead preparation of the Techno-Economic Feasibility Report (TEFR) and Detailed Project Report (DPR) for the beneficiation plant, and prepare tender documentation and finalise contracts with EPC contractors, technology licensors and equipment suppliers for plant construction and major capital projects. B. Process Technology, Engineering & Metallurgical Performance

- Lead process technology and major equipment selection in coordination with technology licensors and OEMs, and own development of Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), expediting detailed engineering with EPC/engineering consultants. 
 - Drive process control and metallurgical optimisation of grinding and selective/differential flotation circuits to maximise recovery of copper along with lead and zinc, against design/target recovery rates, across varying ore sources and grades. 
 - Own metal and mass balance reconciliation for the plant, and track cost of production (including manufacturing input cost) against budget. 
 - Drive plant upgradation through introduction of instrumentation and PLC-based process control to improve consistency and reduce manual intervention. C. Mechanical Operations & Maintenance

- Lead and supervise the mechanical team in executing daily plant operations, ensuring compliance with safety protocols and operating procedures. 
 - Oversee maintenance and reliability of crushers, mills, conveyors, pumps, flotation cells and other mechanical equipment; develop and implement a comprehensive preventive and predictive maintenance programme. 
 - Lead mechanical projects - equipment overhauls, plant expansions and process improvements - and ensure availability of critical spare parts through effective inventory management. 
 - Analyse equipment performance data to identify trends, recommend improvements, and implement reliability-centred maintenance strategies; ensure compliance with relevant safety, environmental and industry codes. D. Quality Control & Laboratory

- Develop, implement and maintain a comprehensive quality management system so extracted and processed copper, lead and zinc concentrates meet industry standards, customer specifications and regulatory requirements. 
 - Establish and enforce quality control procedures and design testing protocols/methodologies for accurate, consistent product quality assessment. 
 - Oversee inspection and testing of raw materials, intermediate products and final products; analyse data/trends to proactively address quality issues. 
 - Responsible for safe and sustainable functioning of the plant laboratory. E. Electrical & Instrumentation

- Oversee electrical systems management, instrumentation & automation, and control-room operations for the plant. 
 - Ensure all activities comply with the Central Electricity Authority Regulations, 2010 (CEAR, 2010) and other applicable regulatory requirements; drive cost control and energy efficiency. 
 - Oversee quality maintenance and repair of plant equipment to maximise availability and reliability for production; recommend changes to maintenance/operating routines and equipment to reduce downtime and maintenance cost. F. Production Planning

- Direct production planning and scheduling in line with the Project Director's overall direction to ensure production targets are met and customer/project goals satisfied. 
 - Monitor and optimise plant processes for efficient resource utilisation and maximum output; support planning activities and ongoing monitoring of plan-versus-actual performance. G. Civil Infrastructure & Tailings Management

- Oversee civil infrastructure management, including structural integrity assessments and recommending necessary improvements. 
 - Direct tailings storage facility (TSF) management - monitoring for stability, seepage and environmental impact, and implementing best practice for tailings deposition and water recovery. 
 - Evaluate and implement paste plant / paste tailings (backfill) technology as part of the tailings management strategy, alongside conventional TSF deposition, to reduce water usage and improve tailings stability. 
 - Ensure safety and regulatory compliance for all civil and tailings infrastructure; plan and execute civil/tailings projects within budget and timeline, collaborating with geotechnical, environmental and process engineering functions. H. Organisation & Cross-Functional Coordination

- Build, lead and develop the plant embedding a strong safety and quality culture. 
 - Coordinate with the GM (Mining) counterpart on ore blend quality specification and transportation to ensure consistent, specification-grade feed to the plant. 

Qualification and Eligibility Criteria: 

• B. E. /B. Tech in Mineral Processing/Metallurgical/Mechanical/Chemical Engineering, with a mineral beneficiation specialisation preferred

• Minimum 15 years of total experience in mineral processing/beneficiation plant operations, of which: 

- at least 7 years in plant operations leadership for a polymetallic or comparable base-metal ore, including crushing, grinding and selective/differential flotation to produce multiple concentrates; and 
 - at least 5 years in senior leadership role

• Prior experience commissioning a greenfield concentrator/beneficiation plant - from construction through ramp-up to steady-state production is highly desirable

• Hands-on experience preparing or reviewing a TEFR/DPR and leading process technology and equipment selection for a beneficiation plant is strongly preferred

• Strong background in plant maintenance and reliability, quality management systems, and tailings storage facility management; exposure to paste plant/paste tailings (backfill) technology is an advantage

• Familiarity with CEA Regulations, 2010 and applicable environmental/safety compliance requirements for mineral processing plants; exposure to EPC/technology-licensor contract finalisation and commissioning management

• Strong leadership, cross-functional coordination and stakeholder management skills

Location: Copper Project , Ambaji, Gujarat

Remuneration: The monthly consolidated remuneration will be based on the previous/current remuneration. (Negotiable)

Terms of Contract: 

The engagement will be strictly contractual for initial period of two (2) Years, extendable for one year based on performance and business requirement. The candidate will not confer any right for regular appointment in the organization at any point of time. The contract can be terminated by either side at any time by giving one month's prior notice or pay in lieu of notice period.

data.title: Technical Team Leader – Mechanical Commissioning (CxA)- Datacenter
data.description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full-service integrated technology consultancy and professional services to the built environment. 

We partner with clients to improve asset performance, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to lead the commissioning delivery team of hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects. 

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 

This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards. 

Key Responsibilities

Mechanical Commissioning Leadership

- Spearhead end-to-end commissioning of mission-critical electrical systems including MV/LV utility and distribution systems, transformers, protection systems, switchgear, busway systems, UPS (static and rotary), battery systems, standby generators, paralleling gear, load bank systems, STS, PDUs, RPPs, and critical power distribution. 

Integrated Systems Testing & Validation

- Architect and execute IST strategies and scripts aligned with Uptime Institute methodology. 
 - Lead failure mode testing, redundancy validation, and fault tolerance demonstrations across black-building, partial load, and full load testing scenarios. 
 - Oversee Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) for major electrical equipment. 
 - Direct Functional Performance Testing (FPT) to verify system operation under normal, abnormal and failure conditions. 

Design Assurance & Technical Review

- Conduct design and peer reviews at all project stages from a commissionability and operational resilience perspective. 
 - Evaluate electrical schematics, single line diagrams, protection philosophies and vendor technical submittals to identify and mitigate commissionability risks. 

Systems Integration & Controls Validation

- Validate integration of electrical systems with EPMS and BMS platforms, verifying alarms, trending, sequencing, interlocks, and operational visibility during IST. 
 - Coordinate with mechanical and IT commissioning teams to ensure holistic system integration and performance. 

Project Coordination & Stakeholder Management

- Collaborate with project managers, construction teams, MEP contractors, OEMs, and client representatives to ensure seamless commissioning delivery. 
 - Facilitate resolution of technical issues and coordinate across disciplines to maintain programme momentum. 

Documentation, Compliance & Handover

- Develop and manage commissioning plans, execution strategies, test scripts, procedures, checklists, issue logs, punch lists, risk registers, and final commissioning reports. 
 - Ensure strict compliance with Uptime Institute Tier Standards, IEC, IEEE, NFPA, NEC and applicable local codes. 
 - Support client handover and transition to operations with comprehensive systems documentation. 

Risk Management & Issue Resolution

- Identify, analyse and resolve electrical system deficiencies during commissioning to mitigate risk to programme, safety and availability objectives. 

Health, Safety & Team Leadership

- Enforce site HSE compliance including RAMS reviews, toolbox talks and risk assessments. 
 - Lead, mentor and develop commissioning engineers, subcontractors and vendors to deliver excellence. Requirements

- 15+ years overall mechanical engineering, testing and commissioning experience. 

- 8+ years data-center or mission-critical mechanical commissioning experience. 

- Proven leadership of at least 2 complete L2 to L5 commissioning cycles. 

- Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects. 

- Experience managing 15-20+ Cx engineers. 

- Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chilled-water systems, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, BMS/controls, fuel systems, fire protection and utilities. 

- Experience with high-density/liquid cooling is highly desirable. 

- Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA and applicable local codes/standards. 

- Strong knowledge of Sequence of Operations, controls integration, TAB, hydronic balancing and failure-mode testing. 

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 

- Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills. 

Qualifications

Preferred Certifications

CxA/CBCP | CDCP/CDCS | Uptime Institute ATD | ASHRAE-related credentials

Ideal Background

Hyperscale/colocation data centers, mission-critical facilities, semiconductor, pharmaceutical/biopharma, advanced manufacturing or other high-availability facilities. 

Additional Information

At FPC, we're not just a company-we're a thriving community where innovation flourishes, ideas are celebrated, and careers are shaped. When you join us, you become part of a dynamic team that: 

- Shapes the Future: Work on groundbreaking projects that are redefining industries with sustainability, cutting-edge technology, and bold ambition. 

- Supports Your Growth: From leadership training to cross-functional collaboration, we prioritize your professional development and empower you to explore new ideas, take initiative, and grow in your career. 

- Values Balance and Inclusion: We celebrate diversity, foster collaboration, and ensure every voice is heard-while maintaining a strong commitment to work-life balance. 

- Creates Impact: Contribute to the delivery of iconic, high-performance buildings and innovative solutions that have a lasting, positive impact on the world.

data.title: Technical Lead
data.description:
About AiSensy

AiSensy is a WhatsApp-based Marketing & Engagement platform helping businesses generate leads, automate conversations, engage customers, and grow revenue through WhatsApp. 

Our platform brings together WhatsApp marketing, AI agents, chatbots, live chat, and Click-to-WhatsApp advertising to help businesses build meaningful customer conversations at scale. 

AiSensy is used by 250, 000+ businesses, with 800+ Crore WhatsApp messages exchanged between businesses and users every year. We work with leading brands including Skullcandy, Vivo, Rentomojo, Physicswallah, Cosco, Delhi Transport Corporation, and more. 

We are a mission-driven, growth-stage startup backed by Marsshot. vc, Bluelotus. vc, and 50+ angel investors. 

About the Role

We're looking for a Tech Lead to provide technical leadership while remaining deeply involved in building and shipping products. 

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and leadership to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

You will own important technical decisions, contribute to architecture and system design, review code, improve engineering practices, mentor engineers, and ensure that products are built with the right balance of speed, reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability. 

The ideal candidate is someone who can move comfortably between architecture-level thinking and hands-on implementation. You should be able to simplify complex technical problems, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help the team deliver high-quality software in a fast-moving environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own Technical Design & Architecture: Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable systems for new products and major features. Evaluate architectural trade-offs and make decisions that support both current requirements and future scale. 
 - Lead Technical Execution: Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to break complex requirements into clear technical solutions, milestones, and deliverables. Take ownership of critical projects from design through production. 
 - Stay Hands-On with Development: Contribute directly to the codebase, particularly on complex, high-impact, or technically challenging problems. The role is not limited to reviews or delegation. 
 - Drive Engineering Quality: Establish and maintain high standards for code quality, testing, documentation, observability, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Conduct Code Reviews: Review important changes, identify technical risks, promote clean coding practices, and ensure consistency across the codebase. 
 - Solve Complex Technical Problems: Investigate and resolve challenging issues related to performance, scalability, reliability, integrations, distributed systems, data, and production environments. 
 - Build for Scale & Reliability: Identify potential bottlenecks and design systems capable of handling growing traffic, data, users, integrations, and messaging workloads. 
 - Improve Engineering Processes: Identify opportunities to improve development workflows, CI/CD, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and overall engineering productivity. 
 - Mentor & Develop Engineers: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, help them solve complex problems, conduct technical discussions, and support their growth. 
 - Set Technical Standards: Establish best practices around architecture, coding standards, testing, documentation, security, performance, and system reliability. 
 - Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Product, Design, QA, DevOps, and other teams to ensure technical decisions align with customer and business requirements. 
 - Translate Business Requirements into Technical Solutions: Understand the underlying business problem rather than simply implementing feature requests. Help Product teams evaluate technical feasibility, effort, dependencies, and trade-offs. 
 - Manage Technical Debt: Identify and prioritize technical debt, refactoring, infrastructure improvements, and architectural risks while balancing them against product delivery priorities. 
 - Own Production Reliability: Participate in incident investigation and root-cause analysis. Drive permanent fixes and improvements to prevent recurring production issues. 
 - Evaluate New Technologies: Assess tools, frameworks, services, and emerging technologies where they can meaningfully improve product capabilities, engineering efficiency, or scalability. 

What We're Looking For

Experience

- 5-8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with experience taking technical ownership of significant systems or products. 
 - Proven experience designing, building, and operating scalable production systems. 
 - Experience leading technical projects or mentoring engineers in a collaborative engineering environment. 
 - Strong experience working across the complete software development lifecycle-from technical design and development to testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 
 - Experience working in a fast-paced product or startup environment is preferred. 

Technical Skills

- Strong programming fundamentals: Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented/design principles, and software engineering best practices. 
 - System Design: Strong ability to design scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and maintainable systems. 
 - Backend Engineering: Strong experience building APIs, services, integrations, and backend systems. 
 - Database Expertise: Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modelling, indexing, transactions, and performance optimization. 
 - Distributed Systems: Understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, caching, concurrency, event-driven architectures, and distributed system trade-offs. 
 - API & Integrations: Experience designing and integrating REST APIs, webhooks, third-party services, and external platforms. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, deployment, networking, containers, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Testing & Quality: Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, debugging, observability, and production readiness. 
 - Security: Understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure engineering practices. 

Leadership & Ownership

- Strong ability to make technical decisions and communicate the reasoning behind them. 
 - Ability to balance speed of execution with long-term technical quality. 
 - Strong mentoring and coaching skills with the ability to raise the technical bar across the team. 
 - Ability to break ambiguous problems into clear technical approaches. 
 - Strong communication skills across both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - High ownership, accountability, and bias toward solving problems rather than simply identifying them. 

Good to Have

- Experience building high-scale SaaS or B2B products. 
 - Experience with messaging platforms, communication APIs, automation, AI, chatbots, or customer engagement products. 
 - Experience handling high-volume event processing, messaging, or real-time systems. 
 - Experience with WhatsApp Business API or similar communication platforms. 
 - Experience with AI/LLM-based applications, agents, or AI-assisted product experiences. 
 - Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, Kafka/RabbitMQ, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, or modern cloud infrastructure. 
 - Experience owning production systems and participating in on-call, incident management, and post-incident reviews. 
 - Experience hiring, interviewing, and developing software engineers. 

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means: 

- Engineering teams can move quickly without compromising fundamental technical quality. 
 - Systems remain reliable and scalable as AiSensy grows. 
 - Technical decisions are clearly reasoned and aligned with product and business priorities. 
 - Engineers receive strong technical guidance and become increasingly independent. 
 - Critical technical problems are solved proactively rather than repeatedly becoming production issues. 
 - Architecture and engineering practices evolve as the product and scale evolve. 
 - Product, engineering, and business teams have strong alignment on technical trade-offs and delivery expectations. 

Why Join AiSensy?

- Build technology powering WhatsApp engagement for 250, 000+ businesses. 
 - Solve interesting engineering challenges around scale, messaging, automation, integrations, and AI. 
 - Take meaningful ownership of architecture and technical direction. 
 - Work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and leadership. 
 - Build systems used by leading businesses across industries. 
 - Work in a high-ownership, fast-paced product environment. 
 - Help shape the engineering practices and technology foundation as AiSensy scales. 

Apply Now and be part of the AiSensy growth story.

data.title: AI QA Engineer
data.description:
Channel Fusion is moving from a services-heavy channel marketing operation to a product-led, AI-enabled platform business. Our engineers now ship with AI-assisted development, so quality can't rely on manual testing that lags behind. We're hiring one to two AI-native QA engineers to build the automated suites and agent-based checks that let us move fast without breaking what our enterprise clients depend on. 

You own the gate into UAT. Builds that don't meet the standard don't reach clients. Our quality model has two layers. First, agents catch regressions at scale. Second, screenshot regression plus a human review catches visual and workflow drift on anything client-facing. You build both layers, run them, and answer for what gets through. 

What You Own

- The UAT gate. You define, document, and enforce entry criteria for UAT on every release. You can block any build that doesn't meet the criteria. Overriding a block requires sign-off. 
 - Automated regression coverage. You build and maintain automated suites in CI so that regressions are caught before UAT, not by clients during it. 
 - Agent-based checks. You design and maintain AI agents that exercise workflows, generate test cases, and triage failures at scale. You also measure agent reliability by tracking false passes and false failures so the team can trust the results. 
 - Visual and workflow drift detection. You run screenshot regression across client-facing surfaces. Nothing client-facing goes to UAT without a human review pass. 
 - Quality reporting. You report on defect escape rate, gate pass rate, and flaky-test rate so engineering leadership can see release risk before it becomes client impact. 

Who Relies On This Role

- AI engineers need fast, trustworthy feedback on their changes. 
 - Engineering Leadership
 - Client Delivery and Customer Success needs clean UAT cycles that don't damage client trust. 
 - Enterprise clients need a platform that behaves consistently from one release to the next. 

What Great Looks Like

- 6 Months. Gate criteria are documented and enforced on every release. Automated regression covers the top critical workflows in CI. Screenshot regression is live on all client-facing surfaces. 
 - 12 Months. Client-found defects in UAT are down from the current baseline. Agent checks run on every pull request. Engineers treat the gate as a help rather than a bottleneck. 

What You Do Not Own

- Fixing the defects you find. Engineers own fixes. You own detection, triage, and the gate. 
 - Client UAT execution and sign-off. Client Delivery and Customer Success owns this. 
 - The CI/CD platform itself. You build on it. DevSecOps and Infrastructure own it. 
 - Security and penetration testing. DevSecOps own this. 
 - Product requirements and acceptance criteria. Product owns these. You are expected to push back when something isn't testable. 
 - Production release go/no-go. 

Required Qualifications

- 4+ Years in QA automation or software engineering in test, including owning automated suites. 
 - An AI-native working style: you use AI coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, Cursor) daily to build and maintain tests, and you can show it. 
 - Hands-on experience with modern end-to-end frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, or similar) and strong coding skills in Python and/or C#. 
 - Experience building or running LLM-based agents for testing, including a practical understanding of their failure modes, such as nondeterminism and false passes. 
 - Experience with visual regression tooling (e. g. , Playwright snapshots, Percy, Applitools). 
 - The judgment and backbone to hold a quality gate under deadline pressure, and to explain why. 

Required Qualifications

- Experience testing LLM-powered features, including building evals. 
 - Background in enterprise B2B or multi-tenant platforms with client-configurable workflows. 
 - Experience at a company moving from services to product.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
data.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform

Position Summary

We are seeking a senior software engineer who combines strong, broad-based software engineering experience with practical knowledge of data platforms, analytics, and data science. 

This is a software engineering role first. 

The successful candidate must be able to design, build, deploy, operate, and support complete production applications-not only data pipelines, notebooks, database solutions, or isolated cloud services. They should be equally comfortable building an API, integrating enterprise systems, implementing an event-driven workflow, creating a web application, establishing a CI/CD pipeline, and helping operationalize a data or machine-learning capability. 

Experience with technologies such as AWS Glue, Apache Flink, Spark, data warehouses, and relational databases is valuable, but it is not sufficient on its own. We need an engineer who understands the full software development lifecycle and can turn data capabilities into reliable, secure, usable products. 

Responsibilities

· Design, build, test, deploy, and operate production-grade software applications and data products. 

· Develop backend services, REST and GraphQL APIs, asynchronous workflows, web applications, and system integrations. 

· Build event-driven solutions using messaging, streaming, queues, and event-bus technologies. 

· Create reusable platform capabilities that allow product teams and data-domain owners to publish, discover, access, and manage trusted data products. 

· Develop and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines, test automation, infrastructure configuration, and repeatable deployment processes. 

· Apply sound software engineering practices, including modular design, clean code, version control, code reviews, automated testing, dependency management, and secure development. 

· Design applications and services for reliability, scalability, performance, observability, and operational support. 

· Implement logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, error handling, and production troubleshooting capabilities. 

· Integrate applications with cloud services, enterprise platforms, third-party systems, identity providers, and internal APIs. 

· Work with relational, NoSQL, analytical, streaming, and object-storage technologies as appropriate. 

· Help productionize data-science and machine-learning solutions by turning experimental code and models into secure, maintainable, observable services and workflows. 

· Partner with data scientists, data engineers, architects, product managers, security teams, platform engineers, and application-development teams. 

· Contribute to architecture decisions, technical standards, reusable patterns, and platform roadmaps. 

· Mentor engineers whose experience has primarily focused on data tools, helping them adopt broader software engineering practices. 

· Participate in on-call support and take ownership of the software and services the team delivers. 

Required Qualifications

· Five or more years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production applications. 

· Strong programming ability in at least one general-purpose language such as Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Go, or Kotlin. 

· Demonstrated experience building backend application services and well-designed APIs. 

· Experience developing or contributing to web applications using modern frontend and backend frameworks. 

· Experience with system integration patterns, authentication and authorization, API security, and service-to-service communication. 

· Practical experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, streaming platforms, or event buses. 

· Strong understanding of automated testing, including unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing. 

· Hands-on experience creating or maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes. 

· Experience deploying and operating applications in a public cloud environment, preferably AWS. 

· Experience with containers, serverless technologies, or managed application-runtime platforms. 

· Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, distributed systems, and production-operability concerns. 

· Experience with relational databases, data modeling, SQL, and at least one non-relational or analytical data technology. 

· Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot applications across code, infrastructure, networking, integration, and data boundaries. 

· Ability to work across disciplines and take ownership of a capability from initial design through production support. 

Data and Analytics Qualifications

Candidates should also have meaningful experience in one or more of the following areas: 

· Data engineering, analytics engineering, or data-platform development

· Machine learning or applied data science

· Statistical analysis and experimentation

· Data pipelines, transformation frameworks, and orchestration

· Streaming data processing

· Data quality, lineage, governance, metadata, and discoverability

· Data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, and modern analytical architectures

· Turning notebooks, models, or analytical prototypes into production software

Familiarity with technologies such as Apache Flink, Spark, Kafka, AWS Glue, dbt, Iceberg, Snowflake, Databricks, Dremio, Athena, or similar platforms is beneficial. 

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience building internal developer platforms, self-service data platforms, or reusable enterprise capabilities. 

· Experience applying data-mesh principles, including domain-owned data products, federated governance, and self-service platform enablement. 

· Experience developing user-facing tools that make complex platform capabilities accessible to non-specialists. 

· Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or an equivalent technology. 

· Experience with Kubernetes, ECS, Lambda, or other container and serverless deployment models. 

· Experience implementing observability using tools such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, or similar platforms. 

· Experience integrating machine-learning models or generative-AI capabilities into production applications. 

· Familiarity with MLOps, model deployment, model monitoring, feature management, and responsible AI practices. 

· Experience working in a product-oriented engineering organization. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role can: 

· Take a business or platform problem from concept through production without depending on another engineering team to provide basic application-development expertise. 

· Choose appropriate technologies rather than treating every problem as a database, ETL, notebook, or streaming problem. 

· Build secure and maintainable APIs, applications, integrations, and event-driven services around data capabilities. 

· Establish automated testing, deployment, observability, and operational support as part of the solution-not as afterthoughts. 

· Translate data-science prototypes into reliable production products. 

· Collaborate effectively with both traditional software-engineering teams and specialized data professionals. 

· Help the data platform operate as a product-oriented, cross-functional engineering organization.

data.description:
This is a remote position. 

About the role

A well-funded, seed-stage industrial-AI company is looking for an experienced, hands-on DevOps engineer who
 has already built and managed infrastructure in an early-stage startup or taken a system from zero. You will own
 the cloud infrastructure and set the standards for security, monitoring and incident response. You will also work as
 a core partner on the infrastructure that serves the company's main ML/AI models. We need a versatile generalist
 who can work independently with little oversight and take on a wide range of responsibilities. 

What you will own

• Infrastructure: Design, deploy and run scalable, highly available infrastructure across multiple cloud
 environments using Infrastructure as Code (for example Terraform or CloudFormation). 
 • CI/CD: Build, run and improve the CI/CD pipelines used across the whole company. 
 • Observability: Set up and operate monitoring, logging and alerting (for example Prometheus, Grafana or the
 ELK stack) so services stay healthy and perform well. 
 • Security: Define and enforce security practice across infrastructure and applications, covering secrets
 management, network segmentation and vulnerability patching. 
 • Cloud cost: Look for savings in cloud spend on your own initiative and put them in place without hurting
 performance or reliability. 
 • Engineering support: Work alongside engineers to make development workflows smoother, resolve
 production issues and support their infrastructure needs. 

What we are looking for

• At least 5 years as a DevOps engineer, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) or in a comparable role. 
 • Proven experience in a seed-stage startup or a ground-up build, and an understanding of what that means: 
 limited resources, quick changes of direction and a hands-on, do-everything approach. 
 • Solid working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (EKS, GKE or AKS). 
 • Expert-level skill with Terraform or a comparable Infrastructure as Code tool. 
 • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (for example GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Jenkins). 
 • Hands-on database administration experience (for example PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Redis). 

Nice to have

• MLOps experience, including production serving infrastructure for machine learning models. 
 • Security certifications, or deep experience with cloud security frameworks. 
 • Experience with on-prem deployments and observability. 
 • Experience building and deploying ML models on real-time time-series data, such as sensor or IoT streams. 

To apply: send your resume and a short example of infrastructure you built or ran yourself, with your role and the
 outcome. Sanitized descriptions are fine.

At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive. 

TTEC Digital seeks a Design System/UX Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: 
We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools - automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation - for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. 

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who we hire - the DNA: 

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Own the design system in code and the UX of the wedge - the Agent UI shell, slide-out / pill, Control UI, and the per-module panels
 - UX here ships as code, not Figma hand-offs. This is not a look-pretty job: the UI renders live voice, desktop, and AI event streams in real time, and you have to understand the technology underneath - events, WebSocket state, latency, plugin loading - so what you design flows and works, not just looks good
 - Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast, move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- The design system as a real component library - templates and patterns developers implement without friction
 - Agent UI / Control UI interaction patterns
 - Active Listening and Agent Handover UX
 - The graphics language of the product (iconography, motion, data visualization)
 - Accessibility (Lighthouse a11y > 90) and keyboard-first agent flows
 - Your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- A self-starter with taste and grit - a designer who ships
 - Show-me mentality: you demo working UI on Fridays like every other engineer
 - You think from the developer's seat: every component you design, you've already thought through how the squads will implement, extend, and theme it - your design system makes them faster, never slower
 - You love new technology, adapt fast when the product shifts weekly, use AI tools daily to multiply velocity, consider yourself exceptional, and like winning. 

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years of product design with real front-end engineering - you ship React + TypeScript, not just specs. 
 - Strong graphics experience - ++++ on visual craft: iconography, motion design, canvas/SVG data visualization, rendering dense live data beautifully and legibly. 
 - Has owned a design system as a living component library in a fast-shipping product - versioned, documented, themed, adopted. 
 - Strong templating discipline - reusable patterns and layout systems built for developer implementation; you understand component APIs, composition, and what makes a pattern cheap or expensive to build. 
 - Understands the tech underneath - WebSocket-driven state, event ordering, render performance, module federation/plugin loading - well enough that your designs never fight the architecture. 
 - Strong on dense, real-time, professional-tool UX (think trading terminals, not marketing sites) - an agent lives in this UI 8 hours a day. 
 - Accessibility and keyboard-first design as defaults, not afterthoughts. 
 - Perceived-performance craft - skeletons, optimistic updates, motion that masks latency; the UI must feel instant even when the network isn't. 
 - Design tokens as the theming backbone - enterprise customers will want branding; tokens make that config, not a rewrite. 
 - Overlay/extension constraints fluency - designing UI injected over a host page (pill, slide-out) with its size, z-index, and isolation realities. 
 - Usability evidence at startup speed - lightweight session recordings and agent feedback loops instead of month-long studies. 
 - A debugger in the browser - you profile the render, find the jank, and fix your own component.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Full-Stack Mobile/Web App Developer
data.description:
Company Description

ANX Labs (formerly Antariksha Labs) is reshaping education and innovation through practical, hands-on learning. We build advanced hardware modules and a developer platform for learners, educators and professionals. Our work covers satellite-inspired and modular hardware, aerial platforms and scalable research projects. We also work closely with academic institutions, industry partners and creators to build data-driven solutions across industries. 

Through ANX Labs, you will work on an energy-technology venture in our ecosystem. It builds IoT metering hardware, a consumer energy app and a multi-tenant facility-management console. The product helps buildings and households see where their electricity goes, what it costs, and what is unsafe. It does this with live telemetry, tariff intelligence and AI-assisted analytics. 

Role Description

This is a part-time, remote role for a hands-on engineer who can build, ship and lead. You will own delivery across a Flutter mobile app and a React-based web console. You will guide a small team of developers who work across both frameworks. You will also write production code yourself. 

You will wear several hats: 

- Developer: build screens, APIs and data flows across mobile, web and backend. 
 - Team lead: plan sprints, review pull requests, unblock teammates and keep quality high. 
 - DevOps owner: run CI/CD, containerised deployments, environments, secrets and monitoring. 
 - Business-facing engineer: turn requirements from non-technical stakeholders and executives into scoped tasks, estimates and clear status updates. 

Responsibilities: 

- Build and maintain a cross-platform mobile app in Flutter/Dart (state management, navigation, offline caching, push notifications via FCM/APNs, deep links, app-store releases). 
 - Build and maintain a React/TypeScript web console, using Next. js or Vite, a component library, design tokens, dark/light theming, and canvas/SVG/WebGL data visualisation. It will include line, bar, heatmap, gauge and topology charts. 
 - Keep UI behaviour and shared logic consistent across Flutter and React. This covers an API client, auth and role resolution, entitlements, and formatting helpers. 
 - Design and build REST APIs with FastAPI (Python) and, where needed, Node. js/TypeScript. Use OpenAPI 3. 1 contracts, Pydantic validation, versioned routes, cursor pagination, idempotency keys and problem-details error handling. 
 - Model data in PostgreSQL (Supabase). This includes schema design, migrations, indexing, time-partitioned tables, JSONB columns, views, and Row-Level Security (RLS) policies for multi-tenant data isolation. 
 - Implement authentication and authorisation: JWT/OAuth2, role-based access control (RBAC), MFA, and audit logging. 
 - Build real-time features with WebSockets, Server-Sent Events or database change subscriptions, with throttled live updates and graceful handling of stale or missing data. 
 - Work with IoT data pipelines. This means MQTT topics and QoS, message queues (RabbitMQ), idempotent ingestion, de-duplication, and late or out-of-order data. It also means a hot-state cache (Redis/Valkey) and serialisation formats such as JSON and Protobuf. 
 - Support analytics and AI features: DuckDB/Parquet queries, scheduled jobs, LLM and RAG integration (embeddings, pgvector, Ollama), and grounded, citation-backed answers. 
 - Run DevOps: Docker, Railway deployments, GitHub Actions CI/CD, environment and secret management, TLS, logging, metrics and alerting (Prometheus/Grafana, Sentry), and release management. 
 - Write unit, widget, integration and API tests (pytest, Jest/Vitest, Flutter test), enforce code-review standards, and keep technical documentation current. 
 - Present progress, risks and trade-offs to business and leadership teams in plain language. 

Qualifications

- 2-5 years of professional experience in software development, with shipped production work. 
 - Working knowledge of both Flutter/Dart and React/TypeScript. You do not need to be an expert in both, but you must be able to build and review in either. 
 - Solid grounding in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3, including responsive design, Tailwind or CSS-in-JS, and accessibility basics. 
 - Backend experience with Python (FastAPI) or Node. js. You should understand async programming, REST design and API versioning. 
 - Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills: normalisation, query optimisation, indexing, transactions and migrations. 
 - Experience with Git/GitHub workflows: branching, pull requests, code review and semantic versioning. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines, and with deploying to a cloud or PaaS platform. 
 - Knowledge of Protobuf, GraphQL, Next. js SSR/SSG, PWA, Capacitor, or React Native. 
 - Familiarity with authentication and security basics: JWT, OAuth2, CORS, CSRF/XSS and secrets handling. 
 - Experience integrating third-party and external APIs: webhook handling, retries with exponential backoff and jitter, rate limiting, and idempotent writes (for example, payment gateways, weather APIs, push services). 
 - Familiarity with the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture on S3-compatible object storage. This includes Parquet/Apache Iceberg tables, dbt transformations, Airflow scheduling, and querying with DuckDB or Polars. 
 - Clear written and spoken communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and executives. 
 - Reliability and ownership. This is part-time, so we need people who commit to their hours and deliver. 

Bonus Qualifications: 

- Supabase (Auth, Realtime, Storage, RLS), Firebase/FCM, or similar backend-as-a-service tools. 
 - MQTT, WebSockets or other real-time and IoT messaging experience. 
 - Redis, RabbitMQ, Celery/Arq, or background-job patterns. 
 - Data visualisation (Chart. js, ECharts, D3, Recharts, canvas/WebGL) and dashboard UX. 
 - State management: Riverpod/Bloc/Provider (Flutter) and Redux/Zustand/React Query (React). 
 - Monorepo tooling, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI, and observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana). 
 - LLM/RAG exposure: embeddings, vector search, prompt grounding and evaluation. 
 - Interest in energy, utilities, IoT, smart meters or hardware-connected software. 
 - Prior experience mentoring juniors or leading a small project. 

Working Arrangement: 

- Part-time and remote. You set your own hours inside an agreed weekly schedule, with a few overlap hours for stand-ups and reviews. 
 - Who this suits: professionals with a full-time job who want meaningful side work, and people changing careers or between roles who want a real engineering team to join. We expect commitment and consistency in either case. 
 - Compensation: ₹12, 000-₹15, 000 per month. 
 - Growth path: strong performers will be considered for a full-time position after 3-6 months of consistent, positive work.

data.title: Manager - MELS
data.description:
Description

BACKGROUND: 

Passing Gifts Private Limited (PGPL) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Heifer International USA and it provides services in educating, consulting, training, advising, and providing professional and technical services to individuals, associations, and entities in India and abroad, particularly those who support or are working in the areas of social advancement and sustainable development. This position may also require service agreements, secondment agreements and agreements between entities, etc. 

PGPL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability

Function

The Manager - MELS will lead the operationalization and strengthening of MELS systems across PGPL's projects and portfolios. Sitting between the Associate Director - MELS & Program Quality and the MELS Officer/Sr. MELS Officer, the position plays a pivotal role in: 

- Ensuring high-quality MEL planning and execution, 
 - Leading project-level evaluations and outcome monitoring, 
 - Driving data quality, analytics, and reporting, and 
 - Ensuring learning integration across projects and partners. 

The Manager - MELS will work with the MELS Officer/Sr. MELS Officer and ensure alignment of their work with project and organizational MEL frameworks. The role bridges strategic direction from the Associate Director with operational execution at the field and project levels. 

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES: (including approximate percentage effort)

Strengthen Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning, and System (MELS) at Organization Level (30%)

- Lead the development and periodic revision of MEL Plans for all projects, ensuring alignment with the organization's program model. 
 - Guide and support the MELS Officer/Sr. MELS Officer in executing project-level MEL tasks, ensuring alignment with organizational standards. 
 - Ensure effective rollout and management of Project Management Information System (PMIS). 
 - Standardize MEL tools, SOPs, quality assurance protocols, and reporting templates across all projects. 
 - Coordinate quarterly and annual data reviews, ensuring data integrity and consistency across all programs. 
 - Support digital transformation initiatives in MEL-including automation, dashboards, Power BI, and AI-enabled quality checks. 
 - Ensure integration of standard indicators, harmonized PIRS definitions, and alignment with Heifer's MELS standards. 

Project Level MEL Execution and Quality Assurance (30%)

- Lead implementation of baselines, midline, endline surveys, outcome monitoring, and special studies across projects. 
 - Prepare and review ToRs for external evaluators; supervise consultants and research partners. 
 - Review data sets, conduct data cleaning, and ensure analysis is accurate and ready for reporting. 
 - Oversee routine Data Quality Assessments (DQAs) at partner and field levels. 
 - Ensure real-time tracking of log-frame and IPTT indicator progress for all projects. 
 - Support adaptive management through technical advisories and evidence-based recommendations. 

Data Analytics, Reporting, and Knowledge Management (15%)

- Lead consolidation and analysis of program data for monthly, quarterly, and donor reporting. 
 - Lead data validation, triangulation, and synthesis before reports are shared with external stakeholders. 
 - Develop dashboards, analytical briefs, and presentations for leadership and stakeholders. 
 - Develop periodic program performance briefs for decision-making. 
 - Support the Associate Director in generating evidence for proposal development, resource mobilization, and program design. 
 - Document and disseminate learning products, case studies, and program insights. 
 - Organize learning events and cross-project knowledge exchange sessions. 
 - Capacity Building (15%) 
 - Provide direct supervision, mentoring, and performance oversight to the MELS Officer/Sr. MELS Officer to ensure consistent quality of MEL implementation across projects. 
 - Build capacities of program teams, partner NGOs, enumerators, and field staff on MEL tools, data systems, and analytical methods. 
 - Support onboarding of new project staff on MELS guidelines, systems, and digital tools. 
 - Lead training on SurveyCTO, data quality protocols, ODK, dashboards, and evaluation methodologies. 
 - Support the Associate Director in building a culture of evidence-driven decision-making within the program team. 

Sub Award Design, Program Quality, and Donor Compliance (5%)

- Support development of MEL budgets, theory of change, logical framework, PIRS, and evaluation frameworks for new proposals. 
 - Contribute to donor reporting, especially sections related to outputs, outcomes, and impact. 
 - Track sub-award performance (physical and financial) and provide MEL-related guidance to sub-awardees. 

May perform other job-related duties as requested (5%)

Qualifications And Experience

- Master's degree in development studies, Economics, Statistics, Agriculture, Public Policy, Management, or other relevant fields. 
 - Advanced training in MEL, research methods, or data analytics is preferred. 
 - A minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning, and Systems (MELS) within INGOs/development sector. 
 - At least 3-4 years leading MEL functions at project or portfolio level, including evaluation design, sampling, data management, and analysis. 
 - Minimum of 2 years of experience managing and supervising a team, preferably MELS staff. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing or quality assuring baselines, midlines, endlines, and outcome monitoring. 
 - Strong experience in digital MEL systems, including ODK/SurveyCTO, PMIS, and data visualisation platforms. 
 - Proven ability to validate, analyze, and synthesize complex data for decision-making. 
 - Experience developing MEL components for proposals (log frames, ToC, indicators, PIRS, MEL budgets, evaluation costing). 
 - Experience coordinating with external evaluators, research agencies, and managing evaluation contracts. 
 - Familiarity with agriculture/livestock development programs is an advantage. 

Technical Skills

- Strong analytical skills with experience in quantitative and qualitative methods. 
 - Proficiency in at least one statistical or analytical software (SPSS, STATA, R, or equivalent). 
 - Advanced Excel and Power BI skills for dashboards and performance tracking. 
 - Strong understanding of MEL planning, logframe/results framework, IPTT, and data quality standards. 
 - Ability to interpret data and generate actionable insights aligned with program strategies. 
 - Ability to lead technical teams and coordinate MEL execution across multiple projects. 

Behavioral & Managerial Competencies

- Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills. 
 - Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver within deadlines. 
 - Demonstrated ability to supervise, coach, and build capacity of team members, ensuring high-quality MEL execution. 
 - High level of integrity, professionalism, and meticulous attention to data quality. 
 - Ability to work effectively with diverse cultures and stakeholders. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate evidence into program improvements. 
 - Commitment to continuous learning and innovation in MEL.

data.description:
About The Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited is a global leader in the semiconductor and telecommunications equipment industry. Renowned for its innovation and technological advancements, Qualcomm is dedicated to shaping the future of connectivity through cutting-edge solutions in mobile, IoT, automotive, and networking sectors. The company fosters a collaborative and dynamic work environment that encourages creativity, diversity, and professional growth. With a strong emphasis on research and development, Qualcomm continuously pushes the boundaries of technology to deliver high-performance, energy-efficient products that meet the evolving needs of consumers and enterprises worldwide. 

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative CPU Software Architect to join our engineering team at Qualcomm. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing software that enhances CPU performance, power efficiency, and scalability across various product segments. You will leverage your expertise in computer architecture, software development, and performance analysis to drive improvements in software stacks, including Linux internals, device drivers, and application workloads. Your work will directly impact the performance benchmarks and silicon verification processes, ensuring that Qualcomm's next-generation products meet stringent performance and energy efficiency standards. 

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, with a minimum of 2 years of relevant software engineering experience. Candidates holding a Master's degree with at least 1 year of experience or a PhD in the relevant fields are also encouraged to apply. Proficiency in programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Python, or similar is essential. A strong understanding of computer architecture, operating system concepts, and Linux internals is required. Experience with performance benchmarking, software optimization, and collaboration with cross-functional teams will be highly valued. 

Responsibilities

As a CPU Software Architect at Qualcomm, your primary responsibilities will include leveraging your knowledge of CPU architecture to develop and optimize software for high performance and low power consumption. You will run and analyze benchmarks for various applications, performing critical pre- and post-silicon verification to ensure that performance and power goals are achieved. Developing new benchmarks tailored for upcoming workloads and product segments will be part of your role, alongside understanding software workloads at a deeper level, including libraries, compilers, assembly, runtime environments, and algorithms. 

You will collaborate closely with internal teams such as CPU, compiler, and kernel developers, as well as external partners including benchmark vendors and open-source communities. Your role will involve evaluating optimization opportunities and implementing solutions that meet stringent performance requirements. Additionally, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of software stacks, ensuring that Qualcomm's products remain at the forefront of technological innovation and efficiency. 

Benefits

Qualcomm offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional development of its employees. Employees enjoy competitive salaries, health insurance, and wellness programs. The company promotes a flexible work environment, opportunities for career advancement, and access to cutting-edge technology and resources. Qualcomm also emphasizes continuous learning through training programs, workshops, and participation in industry conferences. Additionally, employees benefit from a collaborative corporate culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation, fostering an engaging and rewarding work experience. 

Equal Opportunity

Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are dedicated to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process to ensure all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed. Qualcomm values diversity as a key driver of innovation and excellence, and we strive to create a work environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to our shared success.

data.title: Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
Why This Role Is Different

Most engineers spend their careers on a single product, working through someone else's backlog. At Techdome, you'll build across four live, revenue-generating products: an AI-driven hiring platform, a healthcare management portal, a stock trading and investment app, and fintech payments infrastructure. We're a lean team, so there's no layer of process between you and the people using what you build. 

You'll work side by side with Product and Design, take ownership of your features from first idea to production, and gain experience in domains that many engineers spend years trying to get into. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Taking features from concept to launch: scoping, system design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration. 
 - Building fast, responsive user interfaces with React. js, and secure, scalable services with Node. js and Express. js. 
 - Designing REST APIs, backend services, and third-party integrations, with authentication and authorization done right (JWT, OAuth 2. 0, RBAC). 
 - Working with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL for data modeling and querying, and using Next. js and TypeScript on the frontend. 
 - Moving across all four product lines, covering payment flows, healthcare workflows, trading features, and AI-powered recruitment tools, rather than being confined to one area. 
 - Contributing to architecture discussions, sprint planning, code reviews, and releases. 
 - Diagnosing production issues, tuning performance, and supporting your features after they ship. 
 - Making AI-assisted development (Claude, Copilot, Cursor) part of your everyday workflow, not an occasional experiment. 

What You Should Have

- 1. 5+ years of professional experience as a Full Stack Developer, Software Engineer, or Product Engineer. 
 - Strong skills in React. js, Node. js, Express. js, and modern JavaScript (ES6+). 
 - Working knowledge of Next. js and TypeScript. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one of MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. 
 - A solid understanding of REST API design, Git workflows, Agile/SDLC practices, and secure coding. 
 - Practical experience in debugging, deployments, and production support. 

Nice to Have

- Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - CI/CD pipelines and microservices architecture. 
 - Redis, Kafka, or RabbitMQ for caching, queuing, or real-time data. 
 - Strong system design skills and a history of performance optimization. 
 - Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and application security awareness. 
 - Familiarity with LLMs, RAG, LangChain, AI agents, prompt engineering, MCP servers, or vector databases. 

Life at Techdome

We're a product company, not a services shop or a headcount factory, building across Healthcare, FinTech, HRTech, and Enterprise Automation. We look for engineers who want real ownership, and we give them the autonomy and trust to build things that matter.

data.description:
Job Title- Senior Software Engineer

Position type- Full Time

Work Location- Bangalore/Gurgaon

Working style- Hybrid

Shift Time- 10PM to 7PM

People Manager role: No

Required education and certifications critical for the role- bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or related field.

4-8 years of work experience in relevant field

AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. 

As an organization, we are committed to our purpose as one firm, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. 

General Description Of Role

As a Senior Software Engineer within the Assessment Solutions business, you will design, build, and deliver core features of the Aon Assessment Platform - the enterprise solution for accurate and fair workforce assessments at scale, used by millions of participants worldwide. 

You are a senior individual contributor within one of our international engineering squads (Germany and India), trusted to own the design and delivery of significant features and modules with minimal supervision. You work from Product Requirement Definition (PRD) documents and, in partnership with your Software Engineering Team Lead, turn them into sound technical designs - then build, test, and ship them. You also raise the bar for the engineers around you through code review, pairing, and example. 

Our platform is large and deeply interconnected, so strong analytical thinking matters as much as coding skill. You need to understand how your changes ripple across other components and design accordingly, rather than optimising only for the feature directly in front of you. 

Key Responsibilities

Feature Design & Delivery

- Own the design and delivery of significant features and modules end-to-end - from technical design through implementation, testing, and release - with minimal supervision. 
 - Translate PRDs into clear implementation plans, contributing directly to Technical Specification Documents (TSDs) alongside your Team Lead. 
 - Write clean, well-structured, well-tested code across the stack: C#/. NET services, SQL Server data access, and react front-ends. 
 - Identify edge cases, failure modes, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, accessibility) early in design - not after code review. 

Code Quality & Technical Practice

- Conduct thorough code reviews that raise the quality bar for the whole squad - checking not just correctness but architectural fit, testability, and maintainability. 
 - Champion and apply engineering standards: layered architecture, OpenAPI-first API design, and our React corporate design system. 
 - Write and maintain automated tests (unit, integration) as a core part of delivery, not an afterthought. 
 - Investigate and resolve complex bugs and production issues that require deep platform knowledge to diagnose. 

Cross-Platform Collaboration

- Map how your changes interact with other components of the platform, flagging cross-team dependencies and risks early. 
 - Work closely with your Team Lead, Solution Architects, QA, and Business Analysts to clarify requirements, resolve ambiguity, and validate designs before implementation. 
 - Participate actively in technical design reviews - both presenting your own designs and providing rigorous, constructive feedback on others'. 
 - Support integration efforts with other squads and systems (ATS integrations, shared services) where your modules are involved. 

Mentorship & Team Contribution

- Mentor and unblock less experienced engineers - through pairing, code review, and informal technical guidance - without formal management responsibility. 
 - Help new engineers onboard to the platform's architecture, standards, and ways of working. 
 - Contribute to evolving team practices, tooling, and technical standards based on what you learn from hands-on delivery. 

AI-Augmented Engineering

- Use AI tools in your day-to-day work - for design exploration, coding, testing, code review, and documentation - and apply them effectively and responsibly. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have. 
 - Identify opportunities where AI-assisted development can improve code quality and delivery speed for your squad. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 4-8 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally on a large-scale SaaS or enterprise platform. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with C#, ASP. NET / . NET Core / MVC, SQL, JavaScript, and React. 
 - Proven ability to own the design and delivery of non-trivial features end-to-end with minimal supervision. 
 - Solid understanding of database design, querying, schema design, and query optimization. 
 - Experience integrating systems via APIs, with comfort working against OpenAPI specifications. 
 - Strong analytical thinking - able to reason about the downstream impact of design and implementation decisions on an interconnected platform. 
 - Demonstrated experience conducting thorough, constructive code reviews. 
 - Good communication skills, and comfortable working in an international team across time zones. 
 - Day-to-day use of AI tools in engineering work. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with our cloud and delivery stack: Azure, AKS (Kubernetes), and Azure DevOps CI/CD. 
 - Exposure to the OpenAPI governance approach we follow. 
 - Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading small technical initiatives. 
 - Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and CI/CD-integrated quality gates. 
 - Exposure to HR technology, talent assessment, or recruitment platform domains.

data.title: Medical Coding Audit Manager
data.description:
Manages the day-to-day operations of the Medical Coding Evaluation team supporting Veradigm's enterprise coding capability. The team reviews the outputs of AI agents against clinical documentation to confirm that codes are supported, billable, and accurate, and its judgments establish the clinical ground truth used to measure how our AI agents perform. 

Owns the scoring guide that defines how agent output is judged, incorporating input from the reviewers who apply it. Adjudicates disagreements between reviewers, measures and reports inter-reviewer agreement, and defines the clinical metrics reported to customers, so that accuracy claims made commercially and under federal transparency requirements are defensible. Builds and develops a distributed team of certified coders, plans capacity across specialties, and extends the team's scope across coding, chart preparation, and clinical note quality as the AI roadmap expands. 

Essential Functions / Major Job Responsibilities

- Develops and maintains the scoring guide with clinical experts, updating it as specialties and agent behaviors expand. 
 - Manages daily operations for the review team, including assignments, priorities, capacity, and throughput. 
 - Adjudicates dual-review disputes, documenting rationale and identifying reviewer error versus guide ambiguity. 
 - Tracks inter-reviewer agreement, using low agreement to refine guidance rather than penalize staff. 
 - Runs calibration rounds across reviewers to set throughput benchmarks and validate scaling readiness. 
 - Reports clinical metrics, accuracy, claims inclusion, and risk impact, to leadership, product teams, and clients. 
 - Plans specialty coverage, starting with internal medicine and expanding as scope broadens. 
 - Expands scope into chart prep and note quality, establishing evaluation criteria for subjective tasks. 
 - Validates automated scoring through sampling and reports divergences between automated and expert review. 
 - Coordinates design-partner evaluations to maintain consistent review standards across teams. 
 - Enforces approved data access boundaries, authorized data tiers, and compliant review tools. 

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent technical or business experience
 - 8+ years relevant work experience; 2-3 years at the Expert level or equivalent experience - Preferred
 - 4 Years ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding across multiple specialties, with strong attention to detail and a high accuracy rate
 - 2 Years coding auditing or coding quality review
 - 2 Years outpatient or ambulatory coding in a multi-specialty or large group practice setting
 - 1 Year developing coding guidelines, audit criteria, or annotation standards that others apply
 - 1 Year reviewing output from automated or computer-assisted coding tools, or other structured annotation work
 - Medicare Risk Adjustment or HCC coding experience - preferred
 - 2-4 years relevant leadership experience, including leading distributed or remote teams - preferred

Certifications

- CPC, CCS, or CCS-P - AAPC or AHIMA coding certification, active -Required
 - CPMA - Certified Professional Medical Auditor - Preferred
 - CRC - Certified Risk Adjustment Coder - Preferred

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

- Expert-level knowledge of medical coding, including ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, modifier application, E/M documentation guidelines, and CMS claims processing rules. 
 - Ability to write clear, unambiguous evaluation criteria that multiple reviewers can apply to reach the same conclusion on the same record. 
 - Working understanding of measurement concepts relevant to human review, including inter-rater agreement, sampling, and the difference between reviewer error and ambiguous guidance. 
 - Ability to explain coding reasoning to engineers and product managers who have no coding background, and to translate their technical questions into coding terms. 
 - Sound judgment in cases where documentation is incomplete or coding guidance does not clearly apply, and the discipline to distinguish confident conclusions from uncertain ones. 
 - Proven ability to lead others, including where the next-level leader is not in the same location or time zone. 
 - Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in an environment where standards and processes are still being established. 
 - Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as they apply to handling clinical information and de-identified data. 

Working Arrangements

- Standard work week or as defined by assignment requirements. 
 - Primarily works in a standard office environment or remotely. 
 - Requires periodic overlap with United States time zones to collaborate with Applied Intelligence, product, and engineering teams. 

Travel

- Up to 10% travel may be required. 

Benefits

Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish. 

- Quarterly Company-Wide Recharge Days
