data.title: Revenue Operations Manager
data.description:
GTM Engineer Pepper · Full-time · Mumbai (US Hours)

About the Role

We're hiring a GTM Engineer to be the technical operator behind Pepper's US revenue engine. You'll sit at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and AI - building the automations, agents, data pipelines, and signal-based plays that let a small team punch like a much larger one. 

This is not a traditional RevOps or marketing ops role. You're a builder. You ship workflows in Clay, n8n, and custom code; you wire LLMs into outbound and lifecycle; you stand up an AI-SDR layer; you build internal tools that make every rep and marketer 3-5x more productive. If "what could I automate this week with an LLM and an API key?" is the first question you ask on Monday, this is your role. 

You report into the Revenue Operations Lead and work closely with the founders. 

Location & Hours

Base location: Mumbai (in-office). 

Working hours: 5: 00 PM - 2: 30 AM IST, aligned to US business hours, Monday-Friday. 

This role partners daily with US Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. The shift is non-negotiable - please apply only if you're committed to the US schedule. 

What You'll Own

Signal-Based Outbound & AI-Led GTM

Build and run the signal-based outbound engine in Clay (or equivalent): scrape, enrich, score, and route inbound + outbound leads using firmographic, technographic, intent, hiring, funding, and product-usage signals. 

Stand up the AI-SDR layer: LLM-powered lead research, hyper-personalized first-touch generation, multi-step sequence orchestration, reply classification, and meeting routing. Replace 60-80% of manual SDR work with agents. 

Wire intent data (6sense, G2, Bombora, Clearbit Reveal, LinkedIn signals, web visitor intel) into actionable plays - alerting reps in real time, triggering sequences, prioritizing accounts. 

Continuously test and ship new outbound plays - measure response rate, meeting booked rate, and pipeline contribution per play. Kill what doesn't work in 2 weeks; scale what does. 

GTM Stack Architecture & Automation

Own the GTM tech stack: CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), sequencer (Outreach/Salesloft/Smartlead/Instantly), enrichment (Apollo/ZoomInfo/Cognism/Clay), intent (6sense/G2), CDP, and lifecycle tooling. 

Build automations across the stack using n8n, Zapier, Make, and custom code (Python/JavaScript). Wire systems together so data flows end-to-end without manual touch. 

Design and ship lead scoring, routing, deduping, and lifecycle workflows in HubSpot/Salesforce. Own SLA enforcement and routing logic. 

Build and maintain GTM data pipelines - sync product usage, billing, and engagement data into the CRM. Make every rep's view of the customer 10x richer. 

Internal AI Tools & Custom Builds

Ship internal AI tools for the GTM team: AI-powered call review and coaching, deal health scoring, account research agents, ICP scoring models, churn prediction, win-loss analysis automation. 

Build lightweight internal apps (Streamlit, Retool, custom React, or no-code) that solve specific GTM bottlenecks the team flags week to week. 

Operate as the AI translator - when sales/marketing leadership has a workflow problem, you scope it, build a v1 in 3-5 days, and iterate. 

Measurement & Experimentation

Instrument every play, every automation, every agent. Track precision/recall, cost per output, and downstream pipeline impact. 

Build dashboards (Looker, GA4, custom SQL) that show GTM leadership the health of the engine in real time. 

Run a continuous experimentation backlog - outbound plays, scoring models, prompts, sequence variants. Ship 2-3 experiments a week. 

What We're Looking For

3-7 years in a builder-heavy GTM, RevOps, growth engineering, marketing ops, or sales engineering role at a high-growth B2B SaaS or marketplace company. 

Hands-on Clay expertise (or equivalent - Apollo + Smartlead + custom enrichment stacks). You've built non-trivial waterfalls, written Clay formulas, used the HTTP API node, and shipped real plays into production. 

Strong working knowledge of HubSpot or Salesforce - workflows, custom objects, properties, integrations, and reporting. You can build complex automations without breaking things. 

Comfortable writing Python or JavaScript for glue code, scripts, and lightweight tools. You don't need to be a senior engineer - but you can read API docs, call endpoints, parse JSON, and ship. 

Hands-on with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and orchestration tools (n8n, LangChain, Vellum, custom). You've built at least one production agent or LLM workflow that delivered measurable business value. 

Fluent with outbound sequencers (Outreach, Salesloft, Smartlead, Instantly, Lemlist) and the modern outbound stack. 

Strong analytical chops - SQL is a big plus. You make decisions from data and can build the dashboard yourself if needed. 

High ownership, strong bias for action, builder mentality. You'd rather ship a v1 in 3 days than a v3 in 3 weeks. 

Excellent written communication - you can document a workflow, write a clean Loom, or scope a project in a one-pager. 

Comfortable working US hours from Mumbai on a sustained basis. Prior US team/stakeholder experience required. 

Bonus Points

Built and scaled an AI-SDR motion that produced measurable pipeline. 

Built signal-based outbound that beat traditional cold outbound on response rate by 3-5x. 

Worked at a company where GTM Engineering was a recognized function (Clay, Rippling, Ramp, OpenAI, Vercel, etc. ). 

Shipped internal AI tools that the sales/marketing team uses daily. 

Familiarity with vector DBs, RAG, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks. 

Background in CS, engineering, or a quantitative field. 

Why This Role

Own a brand-new function at Pepper - define what GTM Engineering looks like here. 

Build at the frontier: LLM-powered outbound, AI-SDR agents, signal-based plays, and the next-gen GTM stack. 

- Work at a company where AI is core to product and core to GTM - your work compounds with the company's direction.

Job Purpose: Lead - Integrated Management System (IMS) is responsible for the strategic development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of the Integrated Management System. This role ensures that IMS effectively integrates various management standards and frameworks, such as quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety systems. The Lead will focus on ensuring comprehensive compliance with industry standards, optimizing system performance, and driving operational efficiency through regular audits, process improvements, and stakeholder engagement. 

Responsibilities

Design and integrate a comprehensive Integrated Management System (IMS) that aligns with ISO standards (e. g. , ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and organizational objectives.

data.title: Systems Engineer (Cloud) - Swing Shift
data.description:
JOB COMPETENCIES

- AWS depth: Advanced, practical command of AWS infrastructure services across compute, storage, networking and databases, sufficient to design a resilient deployment and to troubleshoot one that is failing. 
 - Multi-cloud consistency: Working command of Microsoft Azure alongside AWS, and the judgement to operate both to one standard rather than two divergent practices. 
 - Cloud identity command: Practical administration of AWS IAM and Microsoft Entra ID for infrastructure access, including federation, least-privilege role design, managed identities and elimination of long-lived credentials. 
 - Infrastructure as code: Treats infrastructure as code held in version control with peer review, state management and a promotion path, rather than as a set of console changes later documented. 
 - Automation mindset: Strong Terraform, Ansible, Python and Bash capability applied to provisioning, configuration, patching, remediation and reporting, treating repeated manual work as a defect. 
 - Container platform capability: Practical operation of Kubernetes and managed container services, including cluster lifecycle, RBAC, ingress, storage and autoscaling, and the boundary between platform and application. 
 - Observability judgement: Builds monitoring that detects failure early and tunes alerting so that what reaches an engineer is actionable rather than noise. 
 - Security orientation: Applies hardening baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation to cloud instances and cloud service configuration with the same discipline expected on premises. 
 - Resilience focus: Designs for availability zone and region failure where required and proves recovery by test rather than assuming it from a snapshot policy. 
 - Operational discipline: Runbook-driven execution, adherence to change control, and structured validation before and after every change, with a tested rollback path. 
 - Problem solving: Strong analytical skills with proven ability to identify root cause across compute, network, identity, storage, container and application layers rather than replacing an instance and moving on. 
 - Support capability: Supports cloud workloads serving users and business functions, works the agreed shift pattern, and hands over open work explicitly at shift boundaries. 
 - Collaboration: Works effectively with application teams, information security, the Wintel and Linux engineers and the M365 Platform Engineer and can hold a platform boundary without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Documentation and knowledge transfer: Clear, maintainable runbooks, architecture documentation and code comments that reduce single-person dependency across shifts. 
 - Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to explain a cloud outage, a cost variance or an access restriction to technical and business stakeholders in other regions. 

Accountability and autonomy: Owns the cloud estate end to end, prioritizes across a broad surface, and makes sound technical decisions with limited information and under incident pressure. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or a closely related field, or equivalent professional experience. (Required)
 - 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering or administration, including 5+ years with substantial hands-on responsibility for production cloud infrastructure. (Required)
 - Demonstrated hands-on administration of AWS at production scale, including EC2 and auto scaling, EBS and S3, VPC design, subnets, routing, security groups and peering or Transit Gateway, Route 53, ELB and ALB, and RDS. (Required)
 - Demonstrated hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure services. (Required)
 - Demonstrated hands-on administration of AWS IAM, including roles, policies, instance profiles, permission boundaries and least privilege design. (Required)
 - Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Entra ID as it applies to cloud access, including groups, service principals, app registrations, managed identities and federation or single sign-on with AWS. (Required)
 - Demonstrated experience building and maintaining Terraform configurations and modules in production, including remote state, environment separation and a promotion path. (Required)
 - Demonstrated experience with Ansible for configuration management, hardening and patching of cloud instances. (Required)
 - Strong Python and Bash scripting ability, including use of cloud SDKs and APIs such as boto3 for automation and reporting. (Required)
 - Demonstrated experience operating Kubernetes in production, including a managed service such as EKS, ECS or AKS, covering cluster lifecycle, RBAC, ingress, storage and autoscaling. (Required)
 - Demonstrated ownership of patching and operating system currency for cloud instances, including compliance reporting and exception governance against defined standards. (Required)
 - Experience with cloud hardening baselines such as CIS, drift detection and remediation, and remediation of findings from a vulnerability management programme. (Required)
 - Experience with encryption and secrets management in cloud, including KMS key policy and rotation, and a secrets or parameter store. (Required)
 - Demonstrated experience with cloud monitoring and observability tooling, such as CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk or ELK, including alert tuning. (Required)
 - Demonstrated experience managing cloud cost and consumption, including right-sizing, commitment planning, tagging governance and variance reporting. (Required)
 - Experience with backup, replication and disaster recovery for cloud workloads, including cross-region or cross-account copies and validation by restore test. (Required)
 - Experience with hybrid connectivity between cloud and on-premises, including VPN or Direct Connect and DNS resolution across environments. (Required)
 - Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins or Azure DevOps for delivery of infrastructure change. (Preferred)
 - Experience operating within a formal change-management process, including Change Advisory Board submission, rollback planning and post-implementation review. (Required)
 - Experience working within a shift-based infrastructure team supporting a globally distributed estate, including structured handovers. (Required)
 - Linux administration capability sufficient to build, harden and troubleshoot the instances hosting cloud workloads. (Required)
 - Professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to coordinate with global infrastructure and application teams and to communicate with senior stakeholders. (Required)
 - Certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate or Professional, or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator. (Preferred)
 - Certification such as Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, or a Kubernetes credential such as CKA. (Preferred)

ITIL 4 Foundation, or equivalent demonstrated knowledge of incident, change and problem practice. (Preferred)

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. 

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will work closely with our design and product management as well as architecture teams to influence the direction of the product and plan the steps to get there. You'll be responsible for building effective teams, empowering them to achieve their goals, and putting those goals into broader context. Your greatest responsibility will be looking after the individuals reporting to you - coaching and supporting them in their professional development, unlocking their potential, and challenging them to step outside their comfort zone to grow and excel. As a hands on engineering leader, you will also contribute to the engineering and operational practices and bring in a continuous improvement mindset. 

Your future team

To become a 100-year company, we need a world-class engineering organisation made up of empowered teams who have the tools and infrastructure to do the best work of their careers. 

As part of a unified R&D team, Engineering is prioritising key initiatives which support our customers in moving to cloud while simultaneously continuing to bring the most value to our customers through investments across our core product suite - including Jira, Confluence, Trello, and Bitbucket. 

We're looking for people who want to write the future and who believe that we can accomplish so much more together. 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

You will bring in your rich technical and leadership experience in driving a team of 2-3 scrum teams. The overall span of the team would be 12-20 and would be the front-line manager role, to start with. As a senior leader, you will work closely with multiple principal engineers, mentor and coach engineers. You will not only drive impactful business outcomes, but also take part actively in driving the technical architecture. As a seasoned leader, you will bring in world class engineering excellence and operational excellence. You'll also thrive in a challenging and growing business environment that has ambiguity, multiple global dependency footprint and diverse stakeholders. 

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range. 

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity. 

Qualifications

Your background: 

- Significant experience with building large-scale web software
 - Experience in leading large development teams directly
 - Experience in developing platforms and products in a SaaS world, preferably on AWS
 - Strong technical experience and a passion for getting involved in the details
 - Familiarity with agile software development methodologies
 - Ability to drive technical excellence, pushing innovation, quality and operational excellence
 - Strong organisation and communication skills
 - Driving clarity from single line requirements and providing direction in an ambiguous environments
 - A track record of strong execution and delivering results

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go. atlassian. com/perksandbenefits . 

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. 

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them. 

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go. atlassian. com/crh . 

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

data.title: Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
data.description:
Location: Pune - Hybrid

Position Summary

SRE Managers operate with significant autonomy and are accountable for the operational success of an entire service area, product platform, or collection of services. They balance people leadership, technical leadership, and operational ownership, regularly influencing priorities beyond their immediate team and partnering with engineering and product leaders to improve reliability, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes. 

They are trusted to make decisions that affect multiple teams and are expected to build systems, processes, and organizations that scale. 

Responsibilities

The Manager, SRE leads one or more teams of Site Reliability Engineers and is accountable for reliability, availability, operational excellence, automation strategy, and engineering effectiveness within their assigned service area. Responsibilities span four primary domains: 

Reliability Leadership

- Own availability, performance, scalability, and operational health of assigned services. 
 - Drive adoption and enforcement of SRE practices including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, incident management, and operational reviews. 
 - Own reliability roadmaps and ensure investment is balanced between feature delivery, technical debt reduction, and operational sustainability. 
 - Establish measurable operational targets and continuously improve system resilience. 
 - Strategize and communicate with management of Support teams on releases, automation changes, SOPs, and ticket management. 

Engineering & People Leadership

- Build a high-performing team through hiring, coaching, mentoring, and career development. 
 - Set clear expectations and performance standards aligned to organizational objectives. 
 - Develop future technical and people leaders within the team. 
 - Ensure engineering excellence through design reviews, operational reviews, and technical governance. 
 - Collaborate with management of Development, QA, Product, and Release teams to ensure SRE principles, defensive coding practices, and release readiness posture are shifted left into planning, design, development, and delivery processes. 

Operational Excellence

- Lead response and recovery efforts for critical incidents. 
 - Drive systemic problem resolution through blameless postmortems and automation. 
 - Eliminate toil through software engineering and platform capabilities. 
 - Ensure operational readiness for new products, services, and major releases. 

Strategic Execution & Organizational Leadership

- Translate organizational strategy into actionable roadmaps and quarterly objectives. 
 - Work across development, product management, cloud operations, security, and support teams to align priorities. 
 - Guide architectural decisions that improve reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency. 
 - Lead multiple concurrent initiatives spanning products, platforms, or service areas. 
 - Establish operating mechanisms, standards, and best practices across teams. 
 - Represent SRE during executive reviews, customer escalations, and strategic planning discussions. 
 - Participate in budget planning, workforce planning, and organizational design discussions. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Typically 8+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, systems administration, or reliability engineering. 
 - Minimum 4 years of experience with: 
 - Public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) 
 - Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or Ansible) 
 - Kubernetes and containerized workloads 
 - Observability tooling and telemetry systems 
 - CI/CD and software delivery practices 
 - Minimum 3 years of experience leading engineers through formal people-leadership, technical leadership, or team management responsibilities. 
 - Experience operating and supporting business-critical production services. 
 - Experience leading major incidents, postmortems, and reliability improvement programs

This is a Hybrid role. 

What We Offer

- Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success. 
 - An attractive salary and benefits package. 
 - Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice. 
 - Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform. 
 - A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups. 
 - Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world's infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact. 

Who We Are

Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world's infrastructure - sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent's software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems' 5, 200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.

data.title: Associate Architect - Site Reliability
data.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and adaptable Associate Architect (9 - 12 Years) to become a key member of our Cloud Engineering team. In this crucial role, you will be instrumental in designing and refining our cloud infrastructure with a strong focus on reliability, security, and scalability. As an Architect, you'll apply software engineering principles to solve operational challenges, ensuring the overall operational resilience and continuous stability of our systems. This position requires a blend of managing live production environments and contributing to engineering efforts such as automation and system improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Cloud Infrastructure Architecture and Management: Design, build, and maintain resilient cloud infrastructure solutions to support the development and deployment of scalable and reliable applications. This includes managing and optimizing cloud platforms for high availability, performance, and cost efficiency. 
 - Enhancing Service Reliability: Lead reliability best practices by establishing and managing monitoring and alerting systems to proactively detect and respond to anomalies and performance issues. Utilize SLI, SLO, and SLA concepts to measure and improve reliability. Identify and resolve potential bottlenecks and areas for enhancement
 - Driving Automation and Efficiency: Contribute to the automation, provisioning, and standardization of infrastructure resources and system configurations. Identify and implement automation for repetitive tasks to significantly reduce operational overhead. Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and automate workflows using tools like Rundeck or Jenkins. 
 - Incident Response and Resolution: Participate in and help resolve major incidents, conduct thorough root cause analyses, and implement permanent solutions. Effectively manage incidents within the production environment using a systematic problem-solving approach. 
 - Collaboration and Innovation: Work closely with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams, including software engineers, to integrate cloud solutions, gather requirements, and execute Proof of Concepts (POCs). Foster strong collaboration and communication. Guide designs and processes with a focus on resilience and minimizing manual effort. Promote the adoption of common tooling and components, and implement software and tools to enhance resilience and automate operations. Be open to adopting new tools and approaches as needed. 

Required Skills And Experience

- Cloud Platforms: Demonstrated expertise in at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP). 
 - Extensive experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) technologies. 
 - Automation & IaC: Proficiency in scripting languages (shell and Python). Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible or Puppet). Must have exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (Terraform or CloudFormation). 
 - Monitoring & Observability: Experience setting up and configuring monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, or the ELK stack). Hands-on experience implementing OpenTelemetry for observability. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools for cloud-based applications. 
 - Service Reliability Concepts: A strong understanding of SLI, SLO, SLA, and error budgeting. 
 - Infrastructure Management: Proven proficiency in on-premises hosting and virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, or KVM). Solid understanding of storage internals (NAS, SAN, EFS, NFS) and protocols (FTP, SFTP, SMTP, NTP, DNS, DHCP). Experience with networking and firewall technologies. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Linux internals and operating systems (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky Linux). 
 - Experience with Windows operating systems to support varied environments. 
 - Soft Skills & Mindset: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective teamwork. We value proactive individuals who are eager to learn and adapt in a dynamic environment. Must possess a pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with a willingness to step outside comfort zones and acquire new skills. Ability to consider the broader system impact of your work. Must be a change advocate for reliability initiatives. 

Desired/Bonus Skills

- Experience with DevOps toolchain elements like Git, Jenkins, Rundeck, ArgoCD, or Crossplane. 
 - Experience with database management, particularly MySQL and Hadoop. 
 - Knowledge of cloud cost management and optimization strategies. 
 - Exposure to Gen AI. 
 - Understanding of cloud security best practices, including data encryption, access controls, and identity management. 
 - Experience implementing disaster recovery and business continuity plans. 
 - Familiarity with ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) processes

data.title: Mgr, Software Development
data.description:
This is where your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Development and Test Manager with 12+ years of experience leading software development, verification, and quality engineering for connected healthcare and regulated medical software. The manager will provide technical and people leadership across the complete product lifecycle-from requirements, architecture, design, and implementation through functional, automation, performance, reliability, and release-readiness testing. This role owns delivery of cloud-native applications, REST and GraphQL APIs, user interfaces, microservices, medical-device integrations, and EMR/EHR workflows within agreed quality, schedule, and budget commitments. The role combines engineering leadership, development and test governance, technical direction, stakeholder management, design-control compliance, and audit-ready delivery. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and continuously improve the integrated software development and test strategy in alignment with product roadmaps, business priorities, regulatory commitments, architecture direction, and release plans. 
 - Lead software developers, automation engineers, performance engineers, and functional verification engineers; manage capacity, hiring, onboarding, objectives, coaching, technical development, succession planning, and delivery accountability. 
 - Plan and lead engineering assignments involving the evaluation, selection, and adaptation of software designs, technologies, development methods, test approaches, tools, and engineering practices. 
 - Provide technical direction from product conception through requirements, architecture, detailed design, implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining activities. 
 - Establish software engineering governance covering estimation, design and code reviews, coding standards, branching and configuration management, unit and component testing, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt, defect management, and quality metrics. 
 - Ensure software architecture and implementation meet requirements for maintainability, security, scalability, performance, reliability, interoperability, observability, and supportability. 
 - Own delivery of cloud-native applications, microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, web user interfaces, integration services, and data processing capabilities using appropriate C#/. NET and related technologies. 
 - Establish test governance, risk-based planning, entry and exit criteria, requirements traceability, defect management, quality dashboards, and release-readiness assessments. 
 - Own the roadmap and governance for reusable C#-based REST API and UI automation frameworks, including coding standards, test-data management, parallel execution, logging, reporting, and environment configuration. 
 - Ensure unit, component, integration, smoke, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and release-level testing is incorporated into CI/CD pipelines with appropriate automated quality gates. 
 - Guide design, development, integration, and verification of HL7 ADT, FHIR resources, clinical workflows, EMR/EHR interfaces, connected medical devices, real-time communications, notifications, and downstream clinical systems. 
 - Implement configuration and change management throughout the complete product lifecycle, including design, development, verification, release, and sustaining phases. 
 - Partner with product, clinical, systems, architecture, DevOps, cybersecurity, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, and external integration teams to resolve dependencies, technical issues, and product risks. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis by correlating application behavior, source code, automated and performance results, logs, API traces, network data, database records, queues, container metrics, and infrastructure telemetry. 
 - Incorporate field issues, customer feedback, post-market learnings, and production trends into product design improvements, corrective actions, regression coverage, reliability testing, and performance validation. 
 - Ensure compliance with the product development process, design controls, Quality System requirements, software lifecycle procedures, cybersecurity expectations, and applicable regulatory standards. 
 - Maintain audit-ready requirements, architecture and design records, code and review evidence, plans, test cases, objective evidence, reports, approvals, and traceability in approved tools such as Jira, Jama, source-control platforms, and validated test-management systems. 
 - Develop project plans, engineering milestones, resource strategies, budgets, and delivery forecasts; identify and mitigate issues that could affect quality, cost, scope, or schedule. 
 - Manage external development partners, contractors, vendors, and third-party service providers, including technical direction, deliverable acceptance, and performance monitoring. 
 - Communicate development progress, quality status, technical risks, mitigation plans, resource needs, architecture decisions, test findings, and go/no-go recommendations to program and leadership forums. 

What You'll Bring

- 12-18 years of software engineering, software development, testing, verification, quality engineering, or performance engineering experience, including at least 5 years leading multidisciplinary technical teams in a regulated or safety-critical environment. 
 - B. E/B. Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Electrical or related field 
 - Demonstrated experience managing the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, implementation, code review, unit testing, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on or technical leadership experience with C#/. NET, object-oriented design, design patterns, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, web applications, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of functional and automation test strategy for REST APIs, web user interfaces, integration workflows, and end-to-end regression using Playwright, Selenium, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with software architecture and engineering practices such as clean architecture, secure coding, static analysis, code quality, code coverage, configuration management, branching strategies, dependency management, and technical-debt reduction. 
 - Experience validating distributed microservices, event-driven systems, JSON/XML, SQL/PostgreSQL, authentication, authorization, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, MQTT, or comparable technologies. 
 - Working knowledge of Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, autoscaling, service discovery, role-based access control, secrets management, service mesh, resilience, and cloud observability. 
 - Experience with CI/CD architecture, Git, build automation, automated quality gates, pipeline troubleshooting, artifact management, deployment practices, test reporting, and engineering dashboards. 
 - Healthcare domain expertise covering HL7 v2, ADT messages and acknowledgements, FHIR REST resources, EMR/EHR workflows, connected medical devices, data integrity, patient safety, privacy, and clinical risk. 
 - Knowledge of regulated healthcare software practices and standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, design controls, cybersecurity expectations, and formal verification evidence. 
 - Ability to manage complex projects and engineering programs within boundaries of quality, time, scope, and budget while balancing development and verification priorities. 
 - Strong people leadership, stakeholder influencing, conflict resolution, planning, prioritization, vendor coordination, risk management, and executive communication skills. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with SIP, RTP, WebSocket, WebRTC, audio/video communication, Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, RTPEngine, or comparable real-time communication technologies. 
 - Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Application Insights, APM platforms, centralized logging, packet analysis, database diagnostics, and automated performance-threshold evaluation. 
 - Knowledge of Azure Key Vault, Azure App Configuration, Redis, Web PubSub, Terraform, KEDA, infrastructure-as-code, service virtualization, and container security. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory audits, formal submissions, post-market investigations, and enterprise-scale healthcare product releases. 
 - Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, cybersecurity expectations, and quality systems for regulated healthcare software. 
 - Experience with Jira, Jama, validated toolchains, Agile/Scrum delivery, and formal release-readiness reviews. 
 - C#, Azure, Kubernetes, performance testing, healthcare interoperability, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is advantageous. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Working at Mastercard means being part of a unique culture. Inclusive and diverse, a rich collaboration of ideas and perspectives. A place that celebrates your strengths, values your experiences, and offers you the flexibility to shape a career across disciplines and continents. And the opportunity to work alongside experts and leaders at every level of the business, improving what exists, and inventing what's next. 

About The Role

Software Engineers at Mastercard design and code a variety of applications covering transaction processing, analytics, user interfaces, and APIs using a blend of cutting-edge technologies across big data, distributed systems, machine learning, and more. - Own complex problems with dependency across services and facilitate cross-functional team interactions to drive resolution 
 - Drive prioritization decisions and trade-offs in working with product partners 
 - Automate and simplify all aspects of software delivery and development 
 - Introduce new technologies and architecture by following enterprise guidelines

- Own complex problems having dependency across services and facilitate cross-functional team interactions to drive resolution
 - Write code to build and enhance applications/services and promote code-reviews, code scanning, and other standard development practices to deliver high-quality artifacts to production.

 - Identify opportunities and build backlogs to enhance primary service/function
 - Automate and simplify all aspects of software delivery and development actively evangelizing the need to automate and simplify where needed. 
 - Lead by example with hands-on approaches to demonstrate engineering excellence. Able to troubleshoot and refactor existing code for exceptional code quality. 
 - Drive seamless integration across all connected services to meet end-user expectations
 - Drive blameless postmortems culture to identify root causes of incidents and implement learnings
 - Introduce new technologies and architecture by following enterprise guidelines
 - Advocate for engineering principles outside of current organization/platform
 - Provide development and architecture guidance to team members
 - Build relationships and effective partnerships across organizations
 - Conduct technical interviews for hiring engineering staff and raising the performance bar
 - Experience working in cross-functional and large projects with globally dispersed development resources

All About You And What You Need To Bring: 

- Able to write secure code and hands-on experience on Java, spring. 
 - Must have hands-on experience on AI based development, GitHub copilot, Claude code. 
 - Must have hands-on experience on messaging systems like kafka, event driven architecture. 
 - Familiar with secure coding standards (e. g. , OWASP, CWE, SEI CERT) and vulnerability management
 - Understands and implements Application Programming Interface (API) standards and cataloguing to drive API/service adoption and commercialization and effort estimation
 - Has skills to elaborate and estimate non-functional requirements, including security (e. g. , data protection, authentication, authorization), regulatory, and performance (SLAs, throughput, transactions per second)

 - Has skills to conduct product demos and co-ordinate with product owners to drive product acceptance signoffs
 - Drives operational excellence by suggesting improvements to product modules/features using test data, performance data, and production metrics. Leverage testing to verify both functional and non-functional application requirements. Drives efforts to build and maintain lower environments that accurately reflect production. 
 - Demonstrable expertise with root cause analysis of issues in multi-tier distributed systems, with the ability to prescribe risk-reward balanced short-, mid- and long-term changes, over multiple release cycles. 
 - Highly regarded mentor. Instills best practices and proactively coaches others to high technical and quality standards. Identifies and sponsors junior teammates for key growth opportunities. 
 - Approaches discussions and problem solving, across organization and team boundaries with differing motivations/priorities, with empathy and a goal of building consensus. Finds way pitches in and lends support where needed. Valuable partner with organization and business partners in all roles and geographies.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

data.title: Member of Technical Staff - Microarchitectural Validation
data.description:
About Architect Labs

Architect is a frontier AI lab for custom silicon. We partner with frontier labs, clouds / neoclouds, physical AI companies, and advanced fabs to tape-out custom chips co-designed for next-generation AI workloads. Our goal is to compress end-to-end software to silicon timelines, and maximize intelligence per watt and per dollar for the world. We are a small exceptional team across silicon, systems, software and frontier AI. Our team have led research teams at nearly every frontier AI lab, and at some of the most complex SoCs in the world. 

What You'll Do

As a Member of the Technical Staff on the Design Verification & Validation team at Architect, you'll own the verification strategy behind AI-generated designs taping out on leading foundries. You'll work at the intersection of rigorous hardware verification and AI-driven design automation. 

- Review AI-driven test plan, and validation strategy for internal and external SoC projects. 
 - Provide domain-specific expertise to our AI/ML teams, including architectural and microarchitectural checks, validation modularity, checkers, coverage models, and interface protocols - helping encode DV best practices into our AI-driven flows. 
 - Independently define, drive, and coordinate validation, verification, and integration flows across multiple IPs, including checkpoints and collateral handoffs. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, design, and AI/ML leads to generate simulation- and emulation-ready collateral that scales across projects. 
 - Track emerging trends in semiconductor verification and AI-driven design automation to keep our methodology cutting-edge in quality, scalability, and throughput. 

What We'd Like to See

Qualifications & Skills: 

- Degree: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field. 
 - Tapeout Experience: 5+ years (10+ preferred) working on advanced-node tapeouts at top chip companies or fast-moving silicon startups. End-to-end silicon delivery is a strong plus. 
 - Verification Expertise: Deep expertise in verification/validation, emulation, and architectural and system-level verification of industry-standard IPs. Proven track record defining microarchitectural checkers and monitors, modeling IP and SoC validation platforms, and developing modular, reusable validation collateral. 
 - Coding: Strong skills in SystemVerilog, UVM, and C/C++ for test environments. Python strongly preferred. 
 - Subsystem Depth: Hands-on verification experience in at least one of the following areas: 
 - ARM/AMBA protocols (APB, AHB, AXI, and ideally ACE for coherent CPU interfaces)
 - CPU subsystems - boot, interrupts, debug, coherency
 - Memory controllers and PHY - LPDDR/DDR interfaces, controller-level verification
 - On-chip interconnect / NoC - routing, arbitration, QoS, bandwidth
 - NPU / ML accelerator cores - datapath, scratchpad memory, DMA engines
 - Security IPs and/or working with secure enclaves
 - Methodology: Hands-on experience with simulation and emulation flows and methodologies. Experience mapping IP and SoC designs to FPGA prototypes for fast functional verification. 
 - Execution: Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills with strong attention to detail. Ability to work independently and drive cross-functional alignment. 
 - Leadership: Ability and desire to lead the DV function over time as the team scales. 

Expected Exposure (beyond the baseline above): 

Candidates should also bring hands-on exposure to most of the following: 

- Microarchitecture: Working knowledge of the architecture and microarchitecture of complex digital subsystems, such as CPUs, XPUs, cache-coherency fabrics (NoCs/switches), memory hierarchies, and high-speed I/O (HSIO) protocols. 
 - Advanced Pre-Silicon Verification: Experience contributing to coverage-driven verification using advanced UVM environments, formal verification, and emulation to validate microarchitectural boundary conditions and corner cases. 
 - Post-Silicon Debug: Participation in post-silicon triage and debug, mapping observed silicon behavior back to RTL using logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and internal debug hooks. 
 - End-to-End Debug: A track record of isolating and resolving hard HW/FW/SW interaction bugs, performance bottlenecks, or protocol violations, in pre-silicon environments and/or post-silicon bring-up. 

Bonus: 

- SoC-level DV experience - bringing up full systems with memory controller + PHY + CPU connectivity, validating top-level integration. 
 - Deep experience with AMBA protocols, specifically ACE for coherent CPU-memory access. 
 - FPGA prototyping experience (ideally Xilinx Vivado/Vitis). 
 - Verification experience spanning multiple of: interconnects, CPU subsystems, ARM AMBA, memory controllers, NPUs. 
 - Tapeout experience at frontier AI chip startups (MatX, Groq, Cerebras, d-Matrix, etc. ) or tier-1 silicon companies (Apple, NVIDIA, Google, Qualcomm, Broadcom, AMD). 

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity stake
 - Fast-paced startup with autonomy and visible impact
 - Cutting-edge challenges at the intersection of AI and silicon design

data.title: QA Shopify Developer
data.description:
At Warner Music Group, We're a Global Collective Of Music Makers And Music Lovers, Tech Innovators And Inspired Entrepreneurs, Game-changing Creatives And Passionate Team Members. Here, We Turn Dreams Into Stardom And Audiences Into Fans. We Are Guided By Three Core Values That Underpin Everything We Do Across All Our Diverse Businesses

- Curiosity: We do our best work when we're immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 
 - Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans. 
 - Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we're committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises. 

Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it's signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights - technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog !

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences. 

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds - an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent. 

A Little Bit About Our Team

You'll be part of the team behind Warner Music Group's direct-to-consumer storefronts, the online stores where fans buy from some of the world's best-known artists and labels. It's a chance to do meaningful e-commerce work at scale, alongside experienced developers, and to grow your skills on a platform millions of fans rely on. 

Your role

We're looking for a detail-oriented QA Shopify Developer to own the quality of our Shopify storefronts. You'll join a mature Shopify environment with an established codebase and release process, and be responsible for making sure every change works before it reaches customers. 

This is a QA-first role, but not only QA. You'll also take on Shopify development tasks, and we want you to find the manual work in our testing process and replace it with automation. There's a learning curve here, and we'll support you with structured onboarding. The most important things you bring are hands-on Shopify experience, a sharp eye, and a genuine drive to learn. 

Here You'll Get To

- Own QA for theme releases and new features before they go live 
 - Build and maintain test plans, checklists and regression coverage for storefront functionality 
 - Test across browsers and devices, including mobile, checkout flows and key conversion paths 
 - Test for accessibility against WCAG standards, including keyboard navigation, screen reader behaviour, colour contrast and form labelling 
 - Write clear, reproducible bug reports and verify fixes 
 - Identify repetitive manual QA work and propose and build automation to replace it 
 - Pick up Shopify development tickets, from content and settings changes to theme fixes and small features, taking on more as you grow 
 - Work within Git and pull request workflows alongside other developers 
 - Document testing processes so they're repeatable

About You

- 1 to 3 years of hands-on Shopify experience at an agency or a brand running on Shopify 
 - A portfolio of Shopify work you can show us 
 - Solid understanding of Shopify themes: Liquid, sections, templates, theme settings and the Shopify admin 
 - Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, Liquid, JavaScript and TypeScript, plus familiarity with lightweight client-side frameworks such as Stimulus or Alpine. js 
 - Real QA experience: you've written test plans, run regression testing and filed bugs, and can walk us through how you approach testing a release 
 - Experience with at least one test automation tool, such as Playwright, Cypress or Selenium 
 - Experience using AI tools to automate testing or other workflows, with a project or example you can share 
 - Comfortable with Git and pull requests 
 - Highly detail-oriented, and someone who takes ownership of their work without needing to be chased 
 - Hands-on accessibility testing experience, with working knowledge of WCAG 2. 1 AA and tools such as axe, WAVE or a screen reader

We'd Love It If You Also Had

- Shopify Plus experience 
 - CI/CD experience, for example GitHub Actions 
 - Visual regression testing tools 
 - Performance testing, for example Lighthouse 
 - Shopify CLI or the Shopify Admin API

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Electrical Department Manager
data.description:
Overview

SSOE is seeking an experienced Electrical Department Manager to lead our Electrical Engineering Department in India. This role supports a large and dynamic U. S. -based client portfolio, including industrial and manufacturing facilities, semiconductor, battery, pharmaceutical, data center, healthcare, institutional, and commercial projects. 

As the Electrical Department Manager, you will be responsible for leading electrical engineering teams, staff, and projects across various locations while contributing to account management and business development activities. You will serve as a coach, leader, and mentor for department staff, ensuring the delivery of high-quality electrical design solutions on schedule and within budget. 

The successful candidate is a proven leader who communicates effectively across disciplines and cultures. You will serve as a technical liaison for the electrical design of complex, large-scale industrial facilities and fast-paced, team-oriented projects that support a variety of market needs. 

AI and Innovation

At SSOE, we don't just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you'll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows. 

Responsibilities

We are looking for a leader with a clear vision and thoughtful plan to: 

- Take care of and develop our people. 
 - Advance the Virtual Design and Construction (VDC) paradigm within electrical engineering. 
 - Continue the Visual Planning component of SSOE's Lean Operating Strategy and implement additional Lean practices. 
 - Build and develop teams of electrical professionals and future leaders in India. 
 - Evolve electrical deliverables beyond traditional Instruments of Service, upskilling talent as needed. 
 - Drive technical excellence, innovation, and continuous quality improvement across the department. 

The Ideal Leader Will Demonstrate

- Change Agility: Actively seeks new and first-time situations; tests and pilots improvements before implementation; leads teams confidently through new approaches. 
 - Mental Agility: Comfortable with complex technical problems and ambiguous environments; uses critical thinking and curiosity to develop effective solutions. 
 - People Agility: Demonstrates emotional intelligence, strong communication, and active listening; builds trust and provides a calming influence during a crisis. 

The following duties are typical of the position but are not all-encompassing. Responsibilities include those required to deliver quality electrical engineering services on schedule and within budget in a collaborative team environment. 

Leadership & Supervision

- Implement the Electrical Practice Leader's vision within the department. 
 - Coach, direct, coordinate, facilitate, and supervise Section Manager(s), Master Engineer(s), and department staff. 
 - Manage all evaluation and employee relations responsibilities: resource planning/staffing, hiring, development, promotion, and performance management. 
 - Provide leadership for a 20+ FTE team executing electrical design for U. S. projects. 
 - Demonstrate strategic thinking for long-term team development, including technical and soft skills. 
 - Leverage multi-market experience in at least two of SSOE's primary markets (Semiconductor, Battery, Pharma, Data Center, Manufacturing, General Building). 

Technical Oversight

- Ensure the technical competency and quality of work performed by staff through working knowledge of electrical engineering best practices and U. S. jurisdictional requirements. 
 - Provide technical leadership for electrical systems, including power distribution (low and medium voltage), lighting, fire alarm, grounding, and telecommunications systems. 
 - Verify that Electrical Discipline Captains define appropriate discipline work plans and monitor progress to ensure Quality, Budget, and Schedule (QBS) measures are met. 
 - Oversee the application of relevant electrical codes and standards (e. g. , NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE) as applicable to project requirements. 
 - Support technical problem-solving and provide escalation support for complex electrical engineering challenges. 

Standards & Process Improvement

- In coordination with the Electrical Practice Group Lead, develop, organize, and implement discipline and departmental standards, recordkeeping, and continuous improvements. 
 - Drive consistent use of standard design tools, calculation methods (e. g. , SKM, ETAP, AGi32), and deliverable templates. 
 - Ensure teams have the current tools, software, and technical reference materials to support project requirements. 
 - Champion the effective use of BIM, VDC, automation, and AI in electrical project delivery. 

Project & Resource Management

- Prepare and monitor project work schedules and projected workload forecasts. 
 - Collaborate with Project Managers to establish, monitor, and adhere to project budgets, adjusting as necessary to meet financial objectives. 
 - Collaborate with SBU leadership to develop and maintain financial KPIs for the department. 
 - Ensure electrical deliverables meet project scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements. 

Strategic & Business Development

- Implement strategic activities to achieve operational and corporate business objectives. 
 - Support client account maintenance and business development activities. 
 - Assist Project Managers in preparing proposals and making presentations. 
 - Identify opportunities to expand electrical engineering capabilities and market presence. 

Training & Development

- Identify strengths and weaknesses of department personnel to prioritize training needs. 
 - Develop and implement department training programs with assistance from the Training and Development Department. 
 - Mentor electrical engineers and emerging leaders, supporting succession planning and career paths. 

Technology

- Experience working within a virtual design environment with knowledge of electrical-specific software (e. g. , Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, and power system analysis tools). 
 - This role will require the use of AI or similar digital technologies to perform job functions. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering. 
 - Minimum of twenty (20) years of related experience with at least five (5) years of leadership experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading electrical engineering teams delivering projects for U. S. -based clients. 
 - Strong knowledge of U. S. electrical codes, standards, and design practices. 

Leadership Experience

- Ability to develop strategic plans for supporting company goals and for growth in the Practice. 
 - Experience leading diverse teams; experience with remote teams is preferred. 
 - Required experience working with an international workforce. 

Communication

- Demonstrated skill in cross-discipline and multi-national coordination and collaboration. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead and support multiple teams across locations.

As a Data Engineering Manager, you are a leader of builders. You are not just a people manager; you are a technical authority who has grown from the ground up in Data Engineering. 

Your mission is twofold: to accelerate the professional growth of your engineers and to steer your team toward building state-of-the-art AI and data solutions that business stakeholders trust to drive revenue. You will be responsible for a high-performing organization where technical excellence and business acumen are the standard. 

Key responsibilities: 

- People Leadership: Actively coach and mentor Data Engineers to grow their technical and leadership skills. You are responsible for the career trajectory and performance of your team.

Our platform is built on a state-of-the-art modern stack. You will oversee a landscape that leverages: 

- Processing & Analytics: High-scale processing via Azure Databricks, Python, and PySpark.

Qualifications: 

- Experience: Solid and progressive (several years) experience in Data Engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership or management role.

While our mission is driven by business outcomes, you will lead a team that plays with the industry's best tools to solve the world's most interesting data and AI challenges.

This is a position based at our GCC in Bangalore India. 

We look forward to receiving your application!

As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

data.title: Director of Software Architecture

Our Central Engineering Software group delivers support for Arm technologies across a wide variety of software projects and creates example software solutions to demonstrate real world applications. As a member of a large software engineering team you will help evolve our software strategy across all computing segments, including data centre, automotive, mobile, robotics, networking, home, laptops, TVs, embedded and IoT. You will drive adoption of new features and trends in core processing, accelerators, and system hardware, focusing on improved security, reliability, and performance. 

Responsibilities

- Understanding new Arm architecture and IP features, their implementation and what that means for existing software components and tools. Devising how to promote their benefits to software ecosystems and resolve issues that arise in their adoption.

Required Skills And Experience

- Knowledge of Arm based computer Architecture and the range of SoCs and devices that are created using Arm hardware IP.

Skills

data.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Data & AI
data.description:
At Warner Music Group, We're a Global Collective Of Music Makers And Music Lovers, Tech Innovators And Inspired Entrepreneurs, Game-changing Creatives And Passionate Team Members. Here, We Turn Dreams Into Stardom And Audiences Into Fans. We Are Guided By Three Core Values That Underpin Everything We Do Across All Our Diverse Businesses

- Curiosity: We do our best work when we're immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 
 - Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans. 
 - Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we're committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises. 

Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it's signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights - technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog !

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences. 

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds - an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent. 

The new Forward Deployed Engineering Team within the Data and Insights Organization in WMG Global Tech is a specialized capability that focuses on solving a diverse range of problems across our business. This team will partner with our Product Solutions team and work with our key business stakeholders across Warner Music Group to rapidly build and deploy automation and solutions using data and AI. If you love working directly with customers on a variety of different problems while using world-class data platforms to create awesome solutions, and you've got strong software engineering and data fundamentals, this role might be a great fit. 

We are seeking a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our organization. As an FDE, you will work directly with our most important business stakeholders across labels and global functions to deliver rapid solutions leveraging data and AI. Strong candidates will thrive when partnering with non-technical customers, have great product instincts, lots of empathy, and can intersect AI solutions with their pain points to turn painful tasks that take weeks into workflows that take minutes. This role entails full stack solution engineering, including data pipelining and interop, backend development in Python, dashboard and Streamlit app development, and leveraging Databricks and Snowflake AI tools such as Genie and Cortex to create solutions in hours that used to take days. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a world-class team using best-in-class AI tools to take the music business to the next level. 

What You'll Do

- Deliver Impactful Solutions for Diverse Stakeholders: Proven capability to step into different problem spaces and work with diverse people to turn work that takes weeks into minutes. 
 - Full-Stack Engineering: Ability to flex across backend, frontend, data pipelines, AI tools, Python, React. When you aren't a pro at something, you can use AI effectively to deliver and you know how to make sure that the engineering stays excellent along the way. 
 - AI Solutions Delivery: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to design, build, and deploy production solutions to accelerate non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Product Sense and Impact: Ability to rapidly understand and develop a solution without having curated requirements. You can step into a problem space with little context, rapidly understand what needs to be done, and deliver impact. 
 - Empathy and Customer Communication: Strong ability to communicate in non-technical language to stakeholders from entry to executive level. Proven ability to both manage expectations and keep customers up to date. 
 - AI Solutions Engineering: Familiarity working with AI tools such as Gemini, Cortex Code, and Genie Code, and you can wield them to turn solution delivery from weeks into hours. 
 - Be Curious and Adaptable: You are eager to explore new technologies and you are happy to flex across a variety of problems and domains by the day. You are comfortable with dozens of different problems for different stakeholders at any given time. 
 - Stay Aligned: Proven ability to contribute to standards and leverage existing tools and systems to ensure the FDE solutions are aligned with the Data and Insights engineering roadmap. 
 - Architecture Standards & Playbooks: Demonstrated expertise in establishing system frameworks like the Agent Development Kit (ADK), authoring operational playbooks, and drafting technical guidelines. 1 2 
 - Reusable Assets Contribution: Strong background in modular architectures, ensuring custom-built implementations are published as reusable internal marketplace assets instead of isolated, unmanaged components. 

Who You Are

- Experienced, Scrappy, and Creative: You have at least 6 years of software engineering experience. An ideal candidate will have exposure to customers, experience with Python, experience with data pipelining (e. g. , ETL) and either Snowflake and/or Databricks (we build on both but one is sufficient for candidates). Ideally, you've already used Genie Code or Cortex Code, Notebooks, and Streamlit to some extent to deliver solutions. You're imaginative and can think of ways to rapidly solve problems. 
 - Biased to Action and Impact: You have a strong focus on the customer with a bias to action to deliver value quickly. You are deeply motivated when you see pain points to fix them. You can take a manual, scrappy workflow that involved copy-pasting between tools and use AI to make it feel seamless. 
 - Lifelong Learner: You have a passion for learning and yearn for feedback, valuing the opportunity for daily growth. 
 - Mission-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist's ability to grow their career and get paid. 

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world's premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands. 

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound. 

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the "Apply" link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter. 

Don't be discouraged if you don't hear from us right away. We're taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG. 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too. 

WMG is committed to inclusion and diversity in all aspects of our business. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and will evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law (genetic characteristics or cancer), physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Since 1792, we've been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people's lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands - including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon - is trusted by customers around the globe. We're active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It's what you'd expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that's dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today - while creating an even better tomorrow. Let's paint the future together. 

For more information please visit www. akzonobel. com

© 2026 Akzo Nobel N. V. All rights reserved. 

Job Purpose

The IT Engineer - Agentic AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and continuously optimizing enterprise-grade Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions across global business environments. The role combines the responsibilities of Functional Engineer AI and Technical Engineer AI to translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven products and services using Azure AI platforms, large language models, orchestration frameworks, and modern application technologies. The position focuses on implementing secure, observable, and reliable AI ecosystems leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Agent Service, Semantic Kernel, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, vector databases, APIs, and enterprise integrations. The role also supports React. js and modern user interface development for AI-enabled applications, establishes AI evaluation criteria and observability standards, and ensures effective human-in-the-loop controls. Responsibilities include troubleshooting hallucinations, integration failures, and model performance issues while supporting Agile and DevOps delivery practices to accelerate enterprise-scale AI transformation initiatives. 

Key Activities

Story specification: Translate business objectives, process requirements, and stakeholder expectations into detailed functional and technical designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans for agentic AI and intelligent automation initiatives. Collaborate with business teams, architects, and delivery stakeholders to align AI capabilities with enterprise priorities. Development & delivery: Lead and support the end-to-end delivery of enterprise AI initiatives using Azure-native AI services, orchestration frameworks, APIs, RAG architectures, and modern application technologies. Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, security, governance, documentation, and coding standards. Develop and review AI workflows, reasoning agents, integrations, React. js user interfaces, and automation components while enforcing testing and deployment conventions. Contribute to solution approvals and production deployment readiness. Testing: Define and execute testing strategies for autonomous systems, reasoning loops, AI safety guardrails, and enterprise integrations. Support functional testing, business acceptance testing, and validation of observability, traceability, and model performance metrics. Verify production readiness and ensure AI solutions meet operational, security, and quality expectations. Incident management: Monitor production AI environments for performance, security, reliability, and compliance issues. Conduct root cause analysis for hallucinations, orchestration failures, integration incidents, and degraded model behavior. Coordinate corrective actions, deploy fixes, improve dashboards and monitoring frameworks, and identify opportunities for automation and process optimization. Project support: Own and contribute to project deliverables in Agile, DevOps, or waterfall delivery models. Collaborate with Project Managers, Scrum Masters, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to ensure timely and high-quality delivery of AI solutions. Support planning, estimation, documentation, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement activities. 

Experience

- Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline. 
 - Professional experience ranges from 0-1 years for entry-level engineering profiles through 6+ years for advanced engineering and leadership-oriented levels depending on MM1-MM3 maturity classification. 
 - Strong technical expertise in Python development, AI application engineering, and enterprise integration technologies. Working knowledge of React. js, Node. js, REST APIs, orchestration frameworks, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Agent Service, Semantic Kernel, Retrieval-Augmented Generation architectures, vector databases, and cloud-native application development. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, MLOps practices, model monitoring, observability tooling, automated testing, DevOps delivery, and Agile ways of working. Ability to evaluate AI model quality, implement human-in-the-loop controls, troubleshoot hallucinations and reasoning failures, and optimize enterprise AI solutions for performance, security, and scalability. 
 - Capability expectations differ across MM1-MM3 levels and include progression from supporting development activities and issue resolution to independently leading complex AI engineering initiatives, mentoring engineers, contributing to governance and safety standards, and driving enterprise AI transformation outcomes. 

At AkzoNobel we are highly committed to ensuring an inclusive and respectful workplace where all employees can be their best self. We strive to embrace diversity in a context of tolerance.
