For this reason we train and educate on the implications of our Unconscious Bias in order for our TA and hiring managers to be mindful of them and take corrective actions when applicable. In our organization, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

data.title: Senior DevOps & Platform Engineering Lead
data.description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!

Overview

TNS Automation Development is seeking a senior, hands-on engineering leader to own and evolve the platforms, infrastructure, and software delivery capabilities behind our network automation strategy. Our automation ecosystem supports more than 70, 000 network devices. This role combines deep technical ownership with leadership across platform reliability, cloud architecture, DevSecOps, release management, and operational excellence. You will partner with Automation Developers, Network Engineers, Security, Global Systems, cloud teams, and business stakeholders to build a scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable automation ecosystem. 

Responsibilities

What You Will Own

Platform Engineering & Operations

- Own the architecture, deployment, operation, and lifecycle of network automation applications and supporting services. 
 - Design and operate containerized applications on Kubernetes using Helm, Argo, and Terraform. 
 - Own the Nautobot platform stack, including Python/Django, Celery, uWSGI/NGINX, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, AWS, and GitLab CI/CD. 
 - Lead platform upgrades, plugin lifecycle management, performance tuning, capacity planning, resiliency, and observability improvements. 

DevOps & Software Delivery

- Build and manage application images, containers, and deployment workflows. 
 - Own GitLab standards, branching strategy, runners, CI/CD pipelines, release promotion, and software delivery practices. 
 - Establish reliable release processes across development, test, and production environments. 

Cloud, Security & Risk

- Partner with Global Systems and cloud teams to evolve AWS infrastructure, hosting models, scalability, disaster recovery, and operational support. 
 - Own and manage AWS infrastructure supporting network automation platforms, including IAM roles and policies, EKS, EC2, VPC networking, security groups, S3, load balancing, and platform monitoring. 
 - Embed DevSecOps practices, including SAST, dependency scanning, container scanning, and infrastructure security validation. 
 - Ensure platform and deployment practices align with corporate security policies and audit requirements. 

Technical Leadership

- Serve as the senior technical authority for platform engineering and DevOps within the Automation team. 
 - Set engineering standards and guardrails, mentor developers, and influence the future of network automation at TNS. 

Qualifications

Required Experience

- 10+ years of progressive IT engineering experience, including 5+ years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering. 
 - Proven experience deploying and operating production applications on Kubernetes. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, Helm, Docker, Git, GitLab administration, runners, and CI/CD pipeline design. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS experience including IAM, EKS, EC2, VPCs, S3, security controls, monitoring, and cloud networking. 
 - Hands-on Experience operating distributed application platforms using Kubernetes, Celery, Redis, and containers. 
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and security scanning across the software lifecycle. 
 - Experience supporting highly available production applications with demanding operational requirements. 
 - Ability to lead architecture decisions, solve complex platform problems, and guide engineers through implementation. 

Preferred Experience

- Nautobot, NetBox, or comparable network source-of-truth platforms. 
 - Network automation and orchestration, including Ansible. 
 - Python and Django applications; PostgreSQL or MongoDB. 
 - GitLab Runner architecture and management; Argo-based deployment workflows. 
 - Enterprise platforms operating in regulated environments. 

What Success Looks Like

- Within the first 12 months, you will: 
 - Lead the transition of the Nautobot AWS/Kubernetes platform from vendor-managed operations to a TNS-owned and operated service, including architecture, deployment, upgrades, security, monitoring, and lifecycle management. 
 - Standardize GitLab workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release management. 
 - Provide clear technical leadership for platform engineering and automation infrastructure. 
 - Lead the AWS architecture and migration approach for applications, services, and infrastructure moving from on-premises and legacy environments. 

For this role in the United States, we anticipate paying $125, 000k - $155, 000K. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. TNS offers a competitive benefit package. 

If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about!

TNS is an equal opportunity employer. TNS evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.

As a Technical Lead, you will serve as a subject matter expert and strategic driver within the System Test Engineering organization. 

This role demands a balance of deep technical proficiency in networking and automation with the leadership capabilities required to influence architectural decisions, mentor engineering talent, and oversee complex, cross-functional testing initiatives. . 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electronics Engineering, or a related field; 10-14+ years of professional experience in the system testing of networking technologies. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience with Network Admission Control (NAC) technologies, with specialized proficiency in RADIUS and 802. 1x protocols. 
 - Proven track record of architecting and scaling automation solutions using Python and other industry-standard frameworks. 
 - Extensive experience in designing and managing automated testing environments, including the use of advanced simulators and testing tools. 
 - Demonstrated ability to architect, implement, maintain, and debug AI-driven test automation frameworks to improve efficiency and coverage. 
 - Expert-level capability in diagnosing and resolving complex network integration issues in large-scale environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- A consistent history of delivering high-quality, mission-critical products by providing technical guidance to multi-functional teams under aggressive timelines. 
 - Deep understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking protocols, with a focus on system-level architecture, formal verification, and emulation environments. 
 - Expertise in AAA, TACACS, LDAP, PKI, certificate management, DNS, NTP, SSH/SSL, FIPS, HTTP, and enterprise password management. 
 - Proficiency in Python, Java, Golang, Perl, TCL, or shell scripting, coupled with strong expertise in Linux systems administration. 
 - Hands-on experience with network automation, security infrastructure, cloud-native technologies, Docker containers, and microservices architectures. 
 - Skilled in REST API and OpenAPI testing, with the ability to define comprehensive test strategies and automation roadmaps. 
 - Exceptional analytical and debugging skills, with the ability to lead root-cause analysis for systemic technical challenges. 
 - Superior communication, collaboration, and organizational skills. Proven ability to mentor junior engineers, foster a culture of technical excellence, and drive execution in a self-motivated, strategic manner. 
 - Experience in defining and executing performance testing strategies using tools such as JMeter or Locust to ensure system scalability and reliability. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and
 - be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https: //careers. cisco. com or cisco. wd5. myworkday. com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

Job Purpose

The Power Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing business applications, workflow automations, and data-driven solutions using Microsoft Power Platform technologies, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and related Microsoft ecosystem tools. The role supports the organization's digital transformation initiatives by streamlining business processes, improving operational efficiency, enhancing reporting and analytics capabilities, and enabling scalable low-code/no-code solutions aligned with business objectives. 

The position works closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and automation/AI teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, develop innovative solutions, integrate enterprise systems, and ensure secure, reliable, and user-friendly applications and automations. The role also contributes to governance, best practices, and continuous improvement within the Power Platform environment. 

The IT Engineer - Power Platform Engineer reports to an IT Team Lead or Domain Lead depending on the Agile or DevOps organizational structure. The position collaborates closely with External Consultants and Vendors, Project Managers and Scrum Masters, IT Business Partners, Enterprise and Solution Architects, Global Process Owners/Global Process Design Leads, Process Coaches, and cross-functional technology and business teams. The role has no direct or indirect reports but may coordinate contributors and delivery activities within enterprise AI programs and projects. 

Key Activities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain business applications using Microsoft Power Apps (Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps). 
 - Develop and optimize automated workflows and business process solutions using Power Automate to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort. 
 - Create interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI to support business intelligence and decision-making. 
 - Integrate Power Platform solutions with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, Azure services, SQL databases, and third-party applications through APIs and connectors. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and translate functional needs into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Customize and configure Dataverse environments, entities, forms, views, security roles, and business rules. 
 - Ensure applications and workflows adhere to security, governance, compliance, and data protection standards. 
 - Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues related to applications, workflows, integrations, and reports in a timely manner. 
 - Participate in solution architecture discussions and recommend best practices for Power Platform implementation and optimization.

 - Stay updated with new Microsoft Power Platform features, AI capabilities, Copilot innovations, and industry best practices.

 - Work collaboratively with IT, data, security, and business teams to drive digital transformation initiatives and continuous process improvement.

data.description:
Business Area: 

Seniority Level: 

Mid-Senior level

Job Description: 

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world's largest enterprises. 

The Cloudera IT team is looking for a talented, motivated, and passionate Sr. Staff Platform Operations Engineer to join our Technical Operations organization. In this role, you will help design and run the internal platform that our engineers and business teams rely on every day, owning the deployment, reliability, and automated management of our Linux-based infrastructure and core IT services across on‐premise and cloud. As a technical leader and subject matter expert, you'll combine deep Linux systems experience with infrastructure-as-code, automation, and security-first thinking to build a highly available, compliant, and scalable foundation for the company. 

As a Sr. Staff Platform Operations Engineer you will: 

- Architect, deploy, and provide senior-level operational support for our on-premise and cloud-based Linux infrastructure and core IT services (e. g. , virtualization, baremetal, storage, DNS), ensuring high availability and reliability. 
 - Develop, maintain, and champion our Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation frameworks using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and Foreman/MaaS to manage and deploy platform services. 
 - Implement and automate system-level security best practices, including patching, hardening, and configuration management, ensuring compliance and resilience from the ground up. 
 - Build and automate deployment pipelines for IT infrastructure services (e. g. , system images, configuration, platform services) using tools like GitHub/Git, Ansible, and scripting tools. 
 - Serve as a technical Subject Matter Expert (SME), working with IT Systems, CloudOps, Security, and Engineering teams to design and implement robust, scalable, and optimal solutions. 
 - Participate in a shared on-call rotation to support mission-critical IT services (with clear documentation and runbooks provided). 
 - Create and maintain accurate documentation for automation, operational audits, and compliance. 
 - Design, implement, and administer enterprise storage platforms, including Dell PowerStore and Pure Storage arrays, ensuring capacity, performance, data protection, and high availability for critical workloads. 
 - Mentor junior team members. 

We are excited if you have (Required Qualifications): 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or 8+ years of equivalent experience in a large-scale enterprise environment. 
 - Solid experience managing hybrid infrastructure, with deep expertise in on-premise environments (virtualization, OpenStack, networking) and a strong understanding of core public cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP) and containerized platforms (Kubernetes). 
 - Deep, expert-level Linux systems administration experience (e. g. , Red Hat, Rocky, Ubuntu) and mastery of common Command Line Interface (CLI) tools and services. 
 - Strong hands-on skills with Python and shell scripting, used for systems automation, tooling, and integration. 
 - Proven experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible) and version control (GitHub/Git). 
 - Hands-on experience administering enterprise storage arrays, ideally including Dell PowerStore and Pure Storage FlashArray (provisioning, performance tuning, upgrades, and troubleshooting). 
 - A security-first mindset and experience designing, building, and operating secure, automated infrastructure. 
 - Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls), including public cloud equivalents. 

You may also have: 

- Certifications such as Red Hat (RHCE), Terraform, or public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Knowledge of enterprise security principles, cryptography, PKI, and operational security practices. 
 - Experience operating in regulated/high-governance/compliance environments (e. g. , FedRAMP, PCI, ISO27001, SOC2, etc. ). 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools. 
 - Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes). 
 - Project management experience. 
 - Previous experience mentoring junior team members. 

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. 

What you can expect from us: 

- Generous PTO Policy 
 - Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
 - Flexible WFH Policy 
 - Mental & Physical Wellness programs 
 - Phone and Internet Reimbursement program 
 - Access to Continued Career Development 
 - Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages 
 - Paid Volunteer Time
 - Employee Resource Groups

data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
data.description:
Role Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a hands-on Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our AI-native product development team at onsemi and own end-to-end quality and release certification for a full-stack platform built on Next. js, React, TypeScript, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, GraphQL, Airflow, MCP-based AI agents, Kubernetes, Helm, and Docker. This is a full-stack testing role covering UI, API, data, async job, and AI-agent layers, with accountability for certifying that each release meets functional, non-functional, and reliability bars before reaching production. The candidate should build durable automation frameworks and make heavy, responsible use of AI coding agents to design test strategy, generate and maintain suites, and triage failures faster. 

Success Expectations

You should independently own end-to-end quality for the platform: building and maintaining a full-stack automated test pyramid (unit, API, integration, E2E, non-functional, and AI-agent evaluation), certifying releases against clear, evidence-based exit criteria, using AI coding agents responsibly to accelerate test authoring and triage, and partnering with engineering to continuously reduce defect escape rate without slowing delivery. 

Responsibilities

- Own test strategy and automation across the stack: unit/component tests (Vitest, React Testing Library), API/integration tests (pytest, pytest-django, GraphQL), and UI-driven end-to-end tests (Playwright) against real workflows. 
 - Own release certification: define exit criteria, run and triage full regression suites (including sequential, long-running workflow integration tests), and give a clear go/no-go signal per release. 
 - Maintain functional coverage for core workflows: project/variant management, GDS and model linking, test bench execution, regression dispatch and reporting, compliance/RTM tracking, sharing/permissions, and notifications. 
 - Build test coverage for the AI Agent Workspace: prompt/response evaluation harnesses, tool-call correctness, contract tests for MCP-based agent tool servers, RAG pipeline retrieval/grounding accuracy, agent memory and session-persistence correctness, agent regression/eval suites, and guardrails against unsafe agent actions. 
 - Design and execute non-functional testing: API/GraphQL performance and load testing, resilience/failure-injection testing for async job pipelines, and baseline security testing (authN/authZ, RBAC, input validation). 
 - Validate the decoupled async execution model end-to-end - Airflow-orchestrated job dispatch, the containerized GDS/layout processing engine, and the Windows-hosted execution runner that drives external EDA tool runs - through result ingestion, including monitoring for stuck or failed jobs. 
 - Own visual and functional parity testing between the design prototype and the production frontend. 
 - Integrate and maintain automated quality gates in CI/CD, including flake detection, test data seeding/cleanup, and environment readiness checks. 
 - Use AI coding agents daily to generate/maintain tests, analyze failures, and turn bug reports into reproducible automated tests - validating AI output rather than accepting it blindly. 
 - Practice spec-driven testing: convert specs and acceptance criteria into test plans, traceable cases, and regression checklists; track quality metrics and report release readiness to stakeholders. 

Qualifications

- 3 to 5 years in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles, with demonstrable ownership of release certification for a production system. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Playwright (or equivalent) for UI-driven end-to-end testing of React/Next. js apps, including async state and long-running workflows. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with API/backend test automation (pytest, pytest-django, or equivalent), including REST and GraphQL testing. 
 - Working knowledge of component/unit testing with Vitest, Jest, or React Testing Library. 
 - Solid understanding of relational databases, test data management, and seeding/cleanup for repeatable automated runs. 
 - Experience testing asynchronous, job-queue-based, or event-driven systems (Redis, background workers, Airflow or similar orchestration pipelines). 
 - Experience designing non-functional test strategies: performance/load, resilience/chaos testing, and baseline security testing. 
 - Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm, and CI/CD pipelines as quality gates. 
 - Strong, demonstrable experience using AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to generate and maintain test automation, with the judgment to validate AI-generated tests. 
 - Understanding of AI-agent/LLM application testing: prompt/response evaluation, tool-call verification, and agentic regression/guardrail testing. 
 - Excellent defect triage and cross-functional communication skills; ability to make an independent, defensible release go/no-go call. 

About Us

onsemi (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world's most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world. 

More details about our company benefits can be found here: 

https: //www. onsemi. com/careers/career-benefits

About The Team

We are committed to sourcing, attracting, and hiring high-performance innovators, while providing all candidates a positive recruitment experience that builds our brand as a great place to work.

data.description:
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. About Skyworks

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out of the box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates. 

Skyworks offers the industry's broadest Timing product portfolio of crystal oscillator, clock generator, clock buffer, jitter attenuator and network synchronizer products. Our patented technology combines best-in-class frequency flexibility with the lowest jitter in the industry, delivering quick-turn, customized solutions that simplify board design, eliminate discrete components, and maximize system performance. 

Position Overview

The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre-silicon design to post-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. In this role, the ability to quickly debug and resolve performance issues will be critical to delivering world-class products to our customers. 

We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential. 

Position Responsibilities

- Support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office with new IC bring-up, validation, and characterization. 
 - Test and debug system and block functionality of new timing ICs. 
 - Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications
 - Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization. 
 - Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization. 
 - Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts. 
 - Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports. 
 - Own post-processing the characterization data, conducting a detailed analysis (we use JMP for this purpose), and then reviewing the analyzed data with the IC design and marketing teams. 

Required Experience And Skills

- Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's with 3 years of experience. 
 - Strong EE fundamentals; experience with PLLs, synthesizers, and jitter strongly preferred
 - Background in validation, test, or characterization of IC devices
 - Extensive hands-on experience with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum/phase noise analyzers, power supplies, etc. )
 - Ability to troubleshoot and debug hardware and software
 - Experience developing automated test systems and validation infrastructure
 - Proficiency in programming for test/automation (Python, . NET preferred, or similar)
 - Experience with test frameworks and data analysis tools (JMP, MATLAB, or equivalent)
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to cross-functional teams

At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. 

We are looking for SoC/ASIC Digital Design Engineer with experience in Design for Test (DFT). An intimate knowledge and experience in scan chain insertion, compression scan technologies, memory built-in self-test (MBIST) and automatic test pattern generation (ATPG) is required for this position. Should follow systematic quality metrics driven ATPG pattern generation. It is highly desirable for candidate to possess hands-on knowledge of synthesis, verification and debugging Verilog testbenches. 

- Must be able to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense classified clearance
 - Prior 5-15 years of professional experience in SoC/ASIC Digital Design with focus on Design for Test (DFT)
 - Should possess intimate knowledge of DFT insertion flows
 - Basic scan chain insertion using synthesis or other software tools
 - Experience in compression scan insertion, LBIST and other scan technologies
 - Intimate knowledge of memory build-in self-test (MBIST)
 - Expertise in Automatic Test Pattern Generation (ATPG) to achieve design test coverage goals
 - Debug and Analysis of failures to improve fault coverage
 - Verification of ATPG testbenches and debugging root cause of simulation mis-compares
 - Working knowledge of JTAG 1149. 1/6, IEEE1500 and IEEE1687
 - Knowledge of timing analysis and equivalency checks would be added bonus
 - Ability to work in collaborative team environment
 - Prior experience with Cadence tools and flows is highly desirable
 - Should be able to finish DFT tasks independently
 - Strong problem-solving skills. Exhibit discipline, thoroughness, and methodical approach in solving problems
 - Ability to work with stakeholders across cross-functional teams - Architecture, Design, Internal and External Customers
 - Self-driven and committed individual who can work in a fast-paced project environment

We're doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can't.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader with deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems, relational databases, cloud platforms, and modern identity architectures. data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Device Identity and Access OrganizationThe Device Identity and Access organization is at the forefront of Okta's Zero Trust vision. As a foundational pillar within Okta Research and Development (ORD), our mission is to transform the device itself into a secure, trusted, and effortless identity factor. We are the teams responsible for ensuring users can seamlessly interact with their work from any endpoint, anywhere in the world. 

  

Our organization is comprised of engineers who thrive at the intersection of deep client-side platform engineering and massive-scale distributed systems. The work we do secures millions of enterprise endpoints globally, prevents modern identity attacks, and fundamentally changes how people work by making world-class security completely invisible to the end user. 

OpportunityWe seek a highly impactful and influential Software Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in distributed systems, particularly Java, to architect, build, and scale the critical server-side software and services at the heart of our security and identity platform. This is a high-visibility, hands-on opportunity to define the architectural vision, pioneer new capabilities, and drive the technical strategy to solve complex, company-wide challenges and shape the future of Okta's device identity ecosystem. You will act as a key technical leader-a player-coach and force multiplier-by setting the technical standard, mentoring and coaching engineers, and partnering with engineering leadership and product management to translate strategic business objectives into actionable, scalable technical roadmaps. This role requires an engineer who believes in designing for massive scale, rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and an iterative process to build high-quality enterprise software. 

What you'll be doing

 - Extensive experience designing, building, and securing RESTful APIs for large-scale systems.

 - Proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) to accelerate the development lifecycle. Nice-to-haves

 - Experience in cloud security, identity, and/or authentication protocols. 
 - Understanding of Identity and Access Management protocols and technologies (FIDO, U2F, WebAuthn, SSO, SAML, OAuth, Federation, etc. ). 
 - Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, secure coding practices, and certifications like CISSP or Security+.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa's all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria's largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country's point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. 

About the role

As an Engineering Manager, you will drive the successful delivery and execution of projects within your teams. You will manage end-to-end technical planning, ensuring that product requirements are translated into actionable tasks, while orchestrating collaboration between various stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, QA, and UX. This role requires a deep understanding of software design and development and the ability to plan, execute, and deliver product features in a timely and predictable manner. You will also be responsible for maintaining high technical standards, managing team bandwidth, and ensuring project milestones are met with efficiency and accuracy. 

What you'll get to do

- Own end-to-end delivery and execution across cross-functional teams within your product area, ensuring predictable and high-quality outcomes. 
 - Evaluate business and product requirements for technical feasibility and architectural alignment, translating them into well-defined EPICs and technical user stories. 
 - Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Engineers to continuously refine, groom, and prioritize the backlog. 
 - Plan and drive sprint execution with clearly defined goals, using project planning tools to establish timelines, delivery milestones, and surface dependencies early. 
 - Champion engineering processes and rituals that enable strong collaboration, accountability, and team efficiency. 
 - Monitor team velocity and capacity to optimize resource allocation, proactively balancing bandwidth against delivery commitments. 
 - Coordinate cross-team dependencies and stakeholder alignment to remove bottlenecks and maintain smooth execution. 
 - Stay hands-on in critical initiatives by guiding design decisions, enforcing sound design patterns, and participating in code reviews to maintain high engineering quality. 
 - Ensure robust monitoring, alerting, and observability for all owned services, consistently meeting defined SLIs and SLOs. 
 - Partner with Product Managers to define, track, and publish post-release product metrics, driving transparency and continuous improvement. 

To succeed in this role, you should have

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 8-10 years of experience as a Software Developer, Software Engineer, or in a similar hands-on technical role. 
 - 5+ years of strong experience building production systems using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Minimum 3 years of proven engineering leadership experience managing high-performing teams. 
 - Solid grasp of Agile methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and iterative delivery. 
 - Demonstrated ability to translate complex product requirements into well-structured EPICs, user stories, and tasks. 
 - Strong backend engineering expertise; exposure to frontend technologies is a plus. 
 - Experience with project planning and tracking tools to visualize and manage delivery timelines. 
 - Familiarity with engineering, product health metrics, and monitoring tools to drive data-informed decisions. 
 - Hands-on capability to debug complex production issues, lead incident response, and conduct blameless RCA. 
 - Good understanding of modern deployment practices, including CI/CD pipelines, release management, and associated metrics. 
 - Ability to drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders, both technical and non-technical. 
 - Excellent risk management, dependency tracking, and stakeholder communication skills. 
 - Proven track record of improving team velocity, delivery predictability, and engineering excellence. 

Generic Skills

- Problem-solving: Ability to assess complex problems, find solutions, and make sound decisions. 
 - Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and stakeholder reporting. 
 - Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment, adjusting strategies as needed. 
 - Attention to Detail: Meticulous in documenting technical requirements and ensuring all aspects of a project are accounted for. 

Supervisory skills

- Team Management: Experience in managing and mentoring engineers, ensuring team growth and performance. 
 - Resource Allocation: Ability to assess bandwidth and manage resource distribution to optimize team performance. 
 - Feedback: Conduct regular performance reviews, providing constructive feedback and fostering a growth-oriented environment. 
 - Stakeholder Management: Lead project status reviews, manage expectations, and ensure smooth communication between teams and leadership. 

What we can offer you

- Culture - We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We've built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human. 
 - Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks. 
 - Compensation - You'll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, paid leave, plus other benefits. 

What to expect in the hiring process

- A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters. 
 - A live coding and code review session. 
 - A system design and technical discussion round. 
 - A project planning, execution, and product thinking round. 
 - A behavioral and technical interview with the hiring manager. 

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

data.title: Staff SW Engineer (7 - 9 years of exp in Python, React / Angular, strong GenAI solution development, Claude, LLM)
data.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. 

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale - tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. 

Join Visa and do work that matters - to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. 

Overview

Job Description

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Corporate Generative AI Technologies team. In this role, you will help build, and scale enterprise-grade Generative AI and agentic applications. This is a senior, hands-on engineering role for someone who brings strong system design judgment, full-stack product engineering depth, and the ability to translate complex business workflows into scalable, reliable AI-enabled automation solutions. 

You will work on platforms and applications that use AI-native application patterns, including large language models, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, tool orchestration, API integrations, ETL pipelines, and data systems to transform business processes into intelligent, reliable, and scalable workflows. You will help solve hard engineering problems such as decomposing complex workflows into reusable agents, designing secure human-in-the-loop systems, and building production-grade GenAI applications that can be monitored, evaluated, governed, and continuously improved. 

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will operate with autonomy, ownership, and technical judgment while collaborating closely with your manager and the broader engineering team to align on technical direction. You will be responsible for building high-quality software while also influencing system design decisions, architectural direction, engineering standards, and best practices across the team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and scale enterprise-grade GenAI and agentic applications, with a strong focus on maintainable, secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready architecture. 
 - Own delivery of GenAI subsystems; lead design reviews; mentor I4/I5 engineers. 
 - Apply strong system design judgment to build full-stack, production-grade applications with robust API design, workflow orchestration, secure data flows, observability, and operational readiness. 
 - Build modern frontend experiences using React and established frontend patterns, including component-based architecture, state management, reusable UI components, accessibility, performance optimization, and seamless integration with backend APIs and AI-enabled services. 
 - Design and implement scalable backend services using Python, Node. js, and/or Java, including secure APIs, asynchronous processing, background jobs, authentication, authorization, logging, error handling, and system resiliency. 
 - Work with databases like PostgreSQL, Redis, vector databases, and related technologies, including schema design, indexing strategies, query optimization, transaction management, caching patterns, migrations, and data access patterns. 
 - Implement backend capabilities for AI-enabled and agentic workflow automation, including intent routing, agent orchestration, tool execution, API integrations, data retrieval, multi-step execution, workflow state management, human approval flows, guardrails, auditability, and enterprise system integration. 
 - Develop AI-native capabilities using OpenAI, Anthropic, and related LLM APIs/SDKs, including prompt orchestration, tool/function calling, structured outputs, streaming responses, model routing, and evaluation patterns. 
 - Apply deep knowledge of modern LLM capabilities to make informed engineering decisions around model selection, context management, latency, cost, reliability, output quality, safety, and user experience. 
 - Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation solutions, including ingestion pipelines, ETL workflows, embeddings, vector database integration, retrieval strategies, relevance ranking, grounding, and retrieval quality evaluation. 
 - Build and deploy cloud-native applications using containers, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, and operational automation. 
 - Work closely with engineering teammates and cross-functional partners to align with team priorities, translate ambiguous requirements into proof-of-concepts, then evolve them into production-quality solutions through shared ownership and hands-on collaboration. 
 - Implement observability and operational excellence for GenAI applications, including end-to-end tracing, workflow telemetry, model evaluation, and monitoring to ensure secure, reliable, and production-ready AI systems. 

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. 

Qualifications

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production-grade applications. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - Hands-on experience in developing and deploying GenAI based enterprise solutions, and a good understanding of how to integrate model capabilities into production applications. 
 - Hands-on experience with React and backend development using Python, Node. js, Java, or similar languages. 
 - Strong technical judgment and system design experience, with the ability to evaluate tradeoffs across scalability, security, reliability, maintainability, performance, cost, and delivery speed. 
 - Familiarity with multi-agent GenAI solutions that incorporate agentic behaviors using A2A and MCP protocols. 
 - Experience with Redis, Postgres, vector databases, embedding models, and RAG pipelines. 
 - Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and version control systems. 
 - Proven ability to lead cross-functional AI initiatives, including PoC development, stakeholder alignment, and enterprise rollout. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to business stakeholders. 

Technical Skills

- Languages & Frameworks: Python, FastAPI, LangGraph
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, ECS
 - DevOps: Git, CI/CD pipelines
 - Anthropic / OpenAI SDKs, MCP, A2A is a plus
 - Databases & Storage: Pinecone, Redis, PostgreSQL
 - Monitoring & Governance: Prometheus, Grafana, audit logging, access control
 - Frontend: ReactJS, HTML, CSS, JavaScript. 

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Overview

SSOE Group is seeking a talented Senior Electrical Engineer to support projects within our Automotive and Manufacturing Business Unit. This role involves direct client interaction, multidisciplinary coordination, technical leadership, and the successful execution of projects while ensuring quality, budget, and schedule objectives are met. 

AI and Innovation

- 8-12 years of extensive experience in backend software development, with significant experience in architecting and leading complex, large-scale enterprise platforms.

Acting as a tech lead and solution architect, you will collaborate across global teams to design end-to-end workflows, drive Agile development cycles, oversee quality assurance, and champion scalable CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications:

Key Competencies

This person will also ensure quality compliance and liaise with Project teams where required, closely work with the Associate Quality Excellence (India) to provide source support and guidance to our Project Leaders, Quality leads, and their teams deliver an effective quality management framework across their project programmes. 

Responsibilities

- Ensure that our people follow our way of working, the requirements of the Project Life Cycle (PLC) and Integrated Management System (IMS)

 - Use quality management tools and techniques to promote continual improvement and quality awareness 
 - Predict quality performance using trends and reports, lead actions to address risk elsewhere in the business 
 - Provide quality management support and assistance, working closely with the project teams

Why does it matter to our Business?

How do I know when I am successful at what I do?

- Reduction of complaints and improvement in project teams compliance with WSP way of working. 
 - Building strong relationships with project leads and Quality Managers

Key Competencies

- Strong Analytical Skills

 - Excellent Communication Skills

BGV:

 - Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process - including documents uploaded - is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner". 

About Us

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

With approximately 4, 000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73, 000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

At "WSP" we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise. 

www. wsp. com

We are

data.description:
Job Description

Senior Demo Platform Architect - Contact Center and Customer Experience

Position Overview: We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements. 

Core Daily Activities

- Own and Optimize Demo Environments - Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk. 
 - Develop New Demo Use Cases - Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities. 
 - Support Custom Demo Requests - Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations. 
 - Maintain Product and Release Readiness - Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio. 
 - Drive Automation and Standardization - Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery. 
 - Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices - Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments. 
 - Support Customer-Facing Activities - Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients. 
 - Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral - Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials. 
 - Engage with Vendors and Partners - Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use. 
 - Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance. 
 - Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios. 
 - Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team. 
 - Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations. 
 - Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio. 
 - Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction. 
 - Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments. 

Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience. 
 - Experience: Minimum of 8-10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk. 
 - Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS. 
 - Demo Development: Demonstrated experience creating technical demonstrations, reusable use cases, prototypes, proof of concepts, or reference implementations that translate technical capabilities into compelling business scenarios. 
 - Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability. 
 - Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment. 
 - Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent credentials in contact center platforms. 
 - Industry Knowledge: Experience designing and demonstrating omnichannel contact center solutions, including voice, chat, messaging, AI-driven automation, agent assistance, Workforce Engagement Management, including workforce and quality management, and contact center reporting and analytics tools. 
 - Customer Engagement: Experience delivering technical demonstrations, supporting customer discussions, and responding to detailed technical questions during customer or prospect engagements. 
 - Agile Methodologies: Experience working within Agile and DevOps frameworks, including source control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices. 

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based. 

The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love. 

Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. 

As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law. 

Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we're proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here. 

Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e-mail to peopleandplaces@zendesk. com with your specific accommodation request.

data.title: Software Engineer - Python , Networking Protocols - 4 to 8 years
data.description:
Meet The Team

The Cisco Crosswork Network Controller quality engineering team helps ensure that a highly scalable, microservices-based SDN controller delivers reliable automation for IP transport networks. Crosswork Network Controller brings service and device lifecycle management, telemetry-driven insights, workflow automation, and intent-based closed-loop operations into one integrated solution for multivendor environments. Our team owns service provision and monitoring testing, validating customer-relevant workflows, solution integration, scale, resiliency, upgrades, and release readiness across the platform and its applications. We partner with development, product management, customer-facing, and operations teams to identify risk early, automate repeatable validation, and deliver dependable releases. 

Your Impact

- Plan and execute service provision and monitoring test strategies for Crosswork Network Controller releases, translating customer and solution use cases into comprehensive end-to-end validation. 
 - Build and maintain Python-based automation for GUI, REST API, platform, network-device, and service workflows to improve coverage and execution efficiency. 
 - Validate integrated solution behavior across installation and upgrades, device onboarding, service provisioning, topology, telemetry, high availability, scale, and failure recovery. 
 - Reproduce complex defects, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with engineering teams to drive timely resolution and prevent regressions. 
 - Communicate quality status and release risk through clear test plans, execution results, defect analysis, and continuous improvement of CI/CD quality gates. 

Minimum Requirements: (Must Have)

- Strong Python automation skills with experience designing and maintaining scalable test frameworks, libraries, and scripts for system and end-to-end validation. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and JSON-based integrations. 
 - Strong IP networking fundamentals, including routing protocols, MPLS, Segment Routing, TCP/IP, and L2/L3 VPN services, with the ability to configure network devices, validate control- and data-plane behavior, and troubleshoot multivendor environments. 
 - Hands-on quality engineering experience designing and executing functional, integration, regression, upgrade, resiliency, scale, and end-to-end tests for distributed network-management or automation products. 
 - Strong Linux/Unix, API, and platform troubleshooting skills, including log analysis, service-health validation, defect isolation, and release verification across clustered or containerized environments. 
 - Ability to work in an cross-functional environment, collaborating with developers, product managers, customer-facing teams, and quality engineers to define acceptance criteria, automate workflows, improve coverage, and communicate release risk. 

Optional Skills: (Good to have)

- Experience with Cisco Crosswork, Cisco NSO, SR-PCE, model-driven telemetry, NETCONF/YANG, gNMI, SNMP, or related network-automation technologies is a plus.

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our mission is to prevent "denied entities" from transacting with Amazon businesses. We screen over a billion events every day and deal with unique scaling and TPS challenges. - Building large-scale, high-availability, low-latency distributed systems.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out of the box thinking. Position Overview

The IC Validation team leads all post-silicon activities, including chip bring-up, validation, and characterization of new timing devices. You will play a key role in our New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle, as our products cross from pre-silicon design to post-silicon validation to ensure exceptional product quality and performance. In this role, the ability to quickly debug and resolve performance issues will be critical to delivering world-class products to our customers. 

We seek candidates who demonstrate a passion for learning, initiative, curiosity, and engineering ingenuity. A positive attitude and a strong disposition for teamwork are essential. 

Position Responsibilities

- Support our Timing Design team based out of the Skyworks Bangaluru office with new IC bring-up, validation, and characterization. 
 - Test and debug system and block functionality of new timing ICs. 
 - Perform silicon characterization through the development of robust and reusable tests to determine device datasheet specifications
 - Lead the design and development of high-speed PCBs (EEVBs), including discrete analog circuits, used for validation and characterization. 
 - Assemble and maintain test setups in the laboratory to support validation and characterization. 
 - Define, develop, and/or acquire software and/or hardware tools in support of silicon test efforts. 
 - Develop automation scripts to automate data collection, decrease data collection times, ensure repeatable measurements, and generate reports. 
 - Own post-processing the characterization data, conducting a detailed analysis (we use JMP for this purpose), and then reviewing the analyzed data with the IC design and marketing teams. 

Required Experience And Skills

- Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering with 8+ years of relevant experience, or a Master's with 6 years of experience. 
 - Strong EE fundamentals; experience with PLLs, synthesizers, and jitter strongly preferred
 - Background in validation, test, or characterization of IC devices
 - Extensive hands-on experience with lab instrumentation (oscilloscopes, signal generators, spectrum/phase noise analyzers, power supplies, etc. )
 - Ability to troubleshoot and debug hardware and software
 - Experience developing automated test systems and validation infrastructure

Some careers have more impact than others.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering

Principal responsibilities

The Performance Testing Engineer will be responsible for defining and executing performance testing for HSBC Open Banking Cloud solutions, ensuring services meet non-functional requirements for scalability, resilience and stability. The role will work closely with engineering, SRE/DevOps, and product teams to identify bottlenecks early, drive performance improvements, and embed performance testing into CI/CD pipelines. 

- Define performance testing strategy, approach and success criteria aligned to Open Banking non-functional requirements (throughput, latency, error rates, capacity and scalability). 
 - Design, build and maintain automated performance test suites (load, stress, endurance/soak, spike), integrating execution into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Create realistic workload models using production-like usage patterns, including API-level test scenarios and data design suitable for performance testing.

data.description:
Position Title: Associate Director - App Engineering

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 43812

About The Role. 

We are seeking an experienced Associate Director, Application Engineering (MES) to provide technical leadership for McCain's Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) strategy and implementation. This role will be instrumental in building and scaling a new MES capability, with a primary focus on the deployment, optimization, and long-term sustainability of the Parsec TrakSYS platform across manufacturing operations. 

As a senior technology leader, you will guide solution architecture, technical standards, integration strategies, and application engineering practices while partnering closely with manufacturing, operations, and enterprise technology teams to deliver scalable and reliable MES solutions that drive operational excellence. 

What You'll Be Doing. 

- Provide technical leadership for the design, implementation, support, and continuous improvement of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES). 
 - Serve as a subject matter expert for the Parsec TrakSYS platform, including configuration, customization, extension development, and platform administration. 
 - Define and evaluate MES architecture, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with long-term business objectives. 
 - Review technical designs, custom development efforts, and coding standards to ensure quality, performance, and supportability. 
 - Lead the integration of MES solutions with ERP, automation, historian, quality management, and other enterprise systems. 
 - Partner with manufacturing stakeholders to understand operational requirements and translate them into effective technology solutions. 
 - Drive application engineering best practices, technical governance, and system lifecycle management. 
 - Analyze complex and highly customized MES environments, identifying opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve sustainability. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical team members, fostering knowledge sharing and capability development across the organization. 
 - Support strategic planning and roadmap development for McCain's MES ecosystem and digital manufacturing initiatives. 

What You'll Need To Be Successful. 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 
 - 15+ years of experience in MES, manufacturing applications, manufacturing IT, or related industrial technology environments. 
 - Deep hands-on expertise with Parsec TrakSYS, including implementation, configuration, customization, extension development, and production support. 
 - Minimum 2-3 years of direct experience working with Parsec TrakSYS or comparable enterprise MES platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and production systems within industrial environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and providing architecture oversight for complex enterprise solutions. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server, including database design, optimization, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. 
 - Experience integrating MES platforms with ERP, automation systems, historians, quality systems, and other operational technologies. 
 - Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, technical design reviews, coding standards, and application lifecycle management. 
 - Proven ability to assess complex, customized solutions and recommend improvements for scalability, maintainability, and long-term sustainability. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Experience mentoring technical teams and building organizational capabilities through coaching and knowledge transfer. 

About The Team.

Job Description

About Compliance Engineering

The Core Engineering is a global team of more than 300 engineers and scientists who work on the most complex, mission-critical problems. We build and operate a suite of platforms and applications that prevent, detect, and mitigate regulatory and reputational risk across the firm. 

Our engineers have access to the latest technology and massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, leveraging modern frameworks to build responsive, intuitive front-end and Big Data applications. The firm is making a significant investment to uplift and rebuild the Compliance application portfolio. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Vice President (VP), Full-Stack Engineer to join our technology team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and technical execution. You will be responsible for architecting, designing, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance full-stack applications. 

As a VP-level engineer, you will maintain a strong hands-on presence-actively writing code, contributing to system and application design, reviewing implementations, mentoring engineers, and driving engineering excellence across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will partner closely with business, product, and engineering stakeholders to build modern platforms that are reliable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards, drawing on your architecture and design background to strengthen technical solutions. 

Experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and Large Language Model (LLM) integrations is expected for this role to help build intelligent, AI-enabled engineering solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Architecture
 - System Design: Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure full-stack applications, microservices, and APIs that align with enterprise standards. 
 - Technology Strategy: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry trends (including AI-assisted development) to continuously modernize our frontend and backend tech stack. 
 - Standards & Governance: Establish and enforce coding standards, architectural principles, and security best practices across frontend and backend systems. 
 - Design Decisions: Bring a strong architecture and design background to modular design, integration patterns, security, performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Hands-on Engineering
 - Full-Stack Development: Write clean, maintainable, and high-performance code across both frontend user interfaces and backend services using Java, Spring Boot, React or Angular, and Python. 
 - Backend Development: Design and implement scalable microservices using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - ETL Pipeline Engineering: Build and maintain robust ETL/ELT workflows using Spring Batch. This includes configuring components for complex data transformations and high-volume ingestion. 
 - API Design & Security: Develop and secure RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless data exchange between internal systems and external partners, ensuring low latency and high availability. 
 - Database Management: Optimize database schemas, queries, and data pipelines across relational (e. g. , PostgreSQL, DB2, Oracle) and non-relational (e. g. , MongoDB, Cassandra) databases. 
 - AI & Intelligent Automation: Apply hands-on experience in Generative AI, machine learning, and large language model (LLM) integrations to build intelligent features, automate workflows, and enhance user and operational outcomes. 
 - Team Mentorship & Collaboration
 - Mentorship: Mentor engineers and promote a culture of technical excellence, strong design thinking, continuous learning, and operational discipline. 
 - Code Reviews: Participate in and lead code reviews and technical design discussions to improve quality, maintainability, and consistency across teams. 
 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders to convert requirements into sound technical designs and delivery plans. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

Education & Experience

- Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in full-stack engineering, architecture, or related roles, with a strong track record of building enterprise-grade applications and implementing large-scale, enterprise-level data solutions. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field. 

Technical Skills

- Backend Expertise: Deep hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building scalable, secure, and maintainable backend services. 
 - Spring Ecosystem: Deep proficiency in Spring Boot and Spring Batch. Must understand job partitioning, multi-threaded steps, and fault-tolerance policies (skip/retry). 
 - Frontend Expertise: Strong front-end development experience using React or Angular to build responsive, user-focused web applications. 
 - Python Development: Solid Python development experience for automation, services, scripting, analytics workflows, or platform enablement. 
 - AI & Machine Learning: Hands-on experience with Generative AI, machine learning, and LLM-based solutions, including practical use of AI APIs, prompt-driven workflows, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled application features. 
 - Architecture & Design: Strong architecture and design background, with knowledge of microservices, API design, secure coding, and distributed systems patterns. 
 - Messaging & Streaming: Experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures and messaging-based integrations using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ for real-time data triggers. 
 - SQL Mastery: Advanced SQL and database skills, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning across SQL and NoSQL technologies. 

Interpersonal Skills

- Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills in complex technical environments. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders. 
 - Collaborative working style with experience driving cross-functional initiatives and influencing technical direction. 
 - Commitment to engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of quality and delivery.

At Goldman Sachs, we commit to our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
