data.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. 

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7, 000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. 

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. 

About Our Team

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems that power a global travel platform serving millions of users daily. We own mission-critical domains across inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms. 

Our systems run with high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations, powered by modern technologies such as Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike, along with strong foundations in CI/CD, automation, and observability. 

We ship fast-often dozens of releases a day-and design systems that are resilient, self-healing, and built to scale globally. 

The Opportunity

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end-to-end - from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands-on coding, system design, and technical ownership - accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
 - Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end-to-end, within your service or team
 - Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
 - Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for

 - Make independent architectural and technical trade-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
 - Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team

What We're Looking For

Technical

 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs & system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency

Nice to Have

 - Exposure to event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)

 - Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer
data.description:
About Gravitee

Since 2015, Gravitee has grown into a global force, recognized as a 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for API Management. What started with four developers challenging the complexities of APIs has evolved into a revolutionary platform powering API and event stream ecosystems worldwide. We drive digital transformation for top enterprises - from Michelin to Roche to Blue Yonder - offering unmatched control over APIs and event streams. 

Now, we are leading the next evolution: AI Agent Management. Our platform brings security and governance to the agentic ecosystem - with our Agent Gateway for A2A protocol communications, native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, and multi-agent, multi-LLM control. We are building the infrastructure that lets enterprises unlock the full potential of AI, securely and at scale. 

Our rapid growth and leadership in API management are fueled by our team's commitment to excellence and our core values: 

- Passion: We bring excitement to everything we do, constantly innovating to stay ahead of the curve. 
 - Hold Nothing Back: We go above and beyond to help customers and teammates succeed, holding ourselves to the highest standards. 
 - Professionalism: We believe in clear, respectful communication and prioritize the needs of our team and customers. 

Join us on this journey. Be part of a team that is redefining what is possible in API management, and shaping the future of digital transformation. The possibilities are endless - be a part of the revolution!

The Role & Why It Exists

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be part of a Platform Team dedicated to making Gravitee's products best in class in terms of both product and infrastructure. You will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud infrastructure that powers Gravitee's platform, while also supporting our customers with exceptional technical expertise. 

This is a hands-on, critical role in our organization. The right candidate will enjoy problem solving in a highly specialized and technical way - from delivering production-ready Kubernetes-based environments to investigating complex customer issues. 

As Gravitee expands into AI Agent Management, the Platform team plays a critical role in ensuring our infrastructure can support AI workloads, agent orchestration, and the demanding performance requirements of real-time AI gateway operations. 

What You Will Be Doing

Your Responsibilities Will Include, But Are Not Limited To

- Participate in delivering Gravitee NextGen Cloud infrastructure, including environments that support AI Gateway and Agent Management workloads
 - Deliver production-ready, Kubernetes-based, customer-facing environments - not just POCs
 - Assist the support team to help customers have the best experience possible with our products
 - Work with other team members to develop and maintain new infrastructure features
 - Share your knowledge (tech and non-tech) during internal Gravitee TechTalks
 - Lead investigation of support tickets and work collaboratively to resolve customer issues
 - Create knowledge articles to complete documentation and enable customers to better understand product use cases
 - Be innovative within the team to help improve processes and tools, including exploring AI-driven automation for operations

AI & Automation Mindset

At Gravitee, We See AI As a Force Multiplier For Engineers, Not a Replacement For Solid Engineering Fundamentals. We Expect You To

- Be open and proactive in using AI-assisted tools (e. g. , AI coding assistants, troubleshooting aids, automation helpers) to accelerate day-to-day work
 - Use AI thoughtfully to improve existing processes, reduce manual toil, and increase reliability in operations and support workflows
 - Experiment with AI-driven approaches to problem solving, documentation, and incident analysis, while maintaining a strong critical mindset
 - Understand the limits of AI tools and apply engineering judgment to validate, refine, and productionize outcomes
 - Contribute ideas on how AI can be safely and effectively integrated into our platform, infrastructure, and internal tooling

AI at Gravitee is not about shortcuts - it is about working smarter, faster, and more sustainably at scale. 

Essential Skills

The right candidate will possess at least the following skills: 

- 5+ years of professional experience in infrastructure management
 - Fluency with creating and managing Kubernetes clusters and Helm-based deployments
 - Strong understanding of infrastructure and deployment automation
 - Experience with Terraform, Docker, and certificate management (ZeroSSL, Let's Encrypt)
 - Experience with continuous delivery tools (Argo Workflows, ArgoCD, Helm Charts)
 - Cloud platform experience (Azure, AWS, GCP)
 - Observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus)
 - Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning
 - Patient, resilient problem-solver with great attention to detail

Desired Skills

Additionally, these skills are not required but preferable: 

- Experience with API Management or Identity and Access Management platforms
 - Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements and GPU workload orchestration
 - Experience supporting AI Gateway or LLM-serving infrastructure
 - Knowledge of networking, service mesh, and traffic management patterns

Core Values

At Gravitee, We Believe Strongly In Living Our Core Values As a Team And As a Company. We Do Not Just Write Them - We Live Them

- Passion: We bring excitement to everything we do, constantly innovating to stay ahead of the curve. 
 - Hold Nothing Back: We go above and beyond to help customers and teammates succeed, holding ourselves to the highest standards. 
 - Professionalism: We believe in clear, respectful communication and prioritize the needs of our team and customers. 

At Gravitee, You'll Get. . . 

- Excellent medical coverage to keep your body and mind healthy
 - Pension and 401k program options for all locations
 - Stock option plan for employees
 - 25 days holiday/vacation in addition to in-country national holidays
 - 3 mental health days per year with an allowance toward a mood-boosting activity of your choice
 - Birthday off to celebrate your day
 - Professional development allowance to invest in your career growth
 - Quarterly outings and annual offsites in exciting locations
 - Hybrid culture with options to work from one of our hubs
 - Access to cutting-edge AI development tools and a culture that embraces innovation
 - A meaningful, progressive, global company culture that is as fun as it is hardworking
 - Endless growth opportunities

data.title: Principal Cloud Engineer
data.description:
Powering the world's payments ecosystem
ACI powers the payments ecosystem - globally, and you power ACI. You'll innovate, collaborate, and grow in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers - in all roles and levels - are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments. 
As a Principal Cloud Engineer in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team dedicated to powering the world's payments ecosystem. This role is focused on designing, automating, and evolving cloud platform capabilities that support ACI's enterprise infrastructure strategy and next-generation payment solutions. AWS, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and continuous compliance are key focus areas for this role. 
Job Summary
ACI Worldwide is seeking a highly experienced Principal Cloud Engineer to provide technical leadership for enterprise cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, automation, and cloud governance initiatives. This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader with AWS, Kubernetes, EKS, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, Platform Engineering, Cloud Security, and Automation expertise who can drive technical strategy, influence engineering direction, and mentor engineering teams across the organization. The ideal candidate will bring a software-defined mindset and the ability to architect, automate, and orchestrate cloud solutions at scale. 
Key Responsibilities
- Define and drive cloud architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards across enterprise platforms. 
- Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, highly available cloud infrastructure solutions. 
- Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and platform engineering best practices. 
- Architect and implement AWS and Kubernetes-based solutions, including Amazon EKS environments. 
- Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment workflows, and cloud operational frameworks. 
- Lead cloud governance, security, compliance automation, and operational excellence initiatives. 
- Provide technical leadership across engineering teams and serve as the escalation point for complex cloud infrastructure challenges. 
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security teams to align technology investments with business objectives. 
- Mentor engineers and promote engineering excellence, innovation, automation, and cloud-first strategies. 
- Drive enterprise cloud modernization and continuous compliance initiatives through automated controls and evidence generation. 

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field. 
- 12+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering. 
- Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale cloud infrastructure solutions. 
- Strong experience leading architecture, automation, and cloud transformation initiatives. 
- Experience influencing technical direction and mentoring engineering teams. 
- Experience in Payments, Financial Services, FinTech, or other regulated industries preferred. 

Technical Expertise
- Expert-level experience with AWS Cloud Services, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Cloud-Native Infrastructure. 
- Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or equivalent technologies). 
- Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, platform automation, and DevOps practices. 
- Experience with Containerization Technologies, Kubernetes Orchestration, and Cloud Platform Operations. 
- Strong understanding of Cloud Networking, Security, Compliance, Reliability Engineering, and Governance. 
- Experience implementing automated configuration management and secure cloud deployment frameworks. 
- Experience developing pipeline-driven infrastructure delivery and enterprise cloud automation solutions. 
- Strong understanding of scalability, performance optimization, operational resilience, and security best practices. 
- Experience evaluating and adopting emerging technologies, including AI-powered engineering tools. 

AI & Emerging Technologies
- Proven experience evaluating and integrating AI/ML capabilities into cloud platforms and engineering operations. 
- Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and AI-driven automation concepts. 
- Experience leveraging AI-powered cloud services from AWS, Azure, OpenAI, or equivalent providers. 
- Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve cloud operations, infrastructure management, compliance automation, and engineering productivity. 
- Experience establishing governance, security, privacy, and responsible AI practices within enterprise environments. 
- Demonstrated use of AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate delivery, automation, and platform reliability. 
- Ability to drive technical strategy and architectural decisions related to AI adoption within cloud engineering organizations. 

Professional Skills
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. 
- Strong strategic and architectural thinking with a business-outcome mindset. 
- Ability to influence technical direction without direct authority. 
- Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent. 
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. 
- Ability to balance technical depth with enterprise-wide impact. 

Preferred Qualifications
- Advanced AWS, Kubernetes, or Cloud Platform Certifications. 
- Experience leading enterprise cloud transformation initiatives. 
- Experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, and cloud governance frameworks. 
- Knowledge of continuous compliance and automated audit evidence generation. 
- Windows administration experience is considered a plus. 
- Industry thought leadership, conference speaking, publications, or technical community contributions. 

Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Infrastructure as Code, Cloud Automation, Platform Engineering, and Cloud Security with the ability to architect and scale AI-enabled cloud platforms, driving innovation while ensuring security, compliance, reliability, and business value. data.description:
Why Valtech? We're the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world's most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience. 

The opportunity

At Valtech, you'll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries. 

We Are Proud Of

- The work we do and the innovation we drive 
 - Our values of share, care and dare 
 - A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy 
 - Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFRA & PWA) Technical Lead , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what's possible. You bring 8+ YEARS of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact. 

You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are

- A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo 
 - A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing 
 - Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data 
 - Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Roles & Responsibilities

- Define and own the target SFCC architecture (cartridges, SFRA controllers/pipelines, OCAPI/SCAPI usage, composable storefront services) in line with the applicative architecture 
 - Translate roadmap items (checkout revamp, hyper-personalization, PLP/PDP review, digital product passport, cross-border commerce) into technical solution designs 
 - Lead and review development delivered by SFRA and PWA/composable developers, enforcing coding standards, performance and security best practices 
 - Own integration design between SFCC and PSP, tax/fraud, PIM, DAM, OMS/ERP and search providers via the middleware layer 
 - Produce and validate technical estimates and impact analyses for evolutions and projects, including performance, security and multi-locale/cross-border considerations 
 - Own environment strategy: sandbox/staging management, release pipelines, and performance/monitoring tooling 
 - Perform code/design reviews before releases, ensuring quality gates, load/performance testing and security compliance are respected 
 - Mentor developers and contribute to Division-level design authority and technical communities 
 - Provide technical leadership during peak trading events (product launches, promotional campaigns, seasonal sales)

Must Have Qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications: 

- Strong hands-on architecture and development experience with Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud, including SFRA and composable/headless storefronts (PWA Kit or equivalent) 
 - Expert-level JavaScript/Node. js, ISML templating, cartridge architecture and OCAPI/SCAPI 
 - Experience designing integrations with PSPs, tax/fraud services, PIM/DAM and OMS/ERP systems via middleware 
 - Strong understanding of eCommerce performance, SEO and security best practices in a high-traffic, revenue-critical context 
 - Experience leading technical teams and managing release/deployment processes for eCommerce platforms 
 - Ability to produce clear technical specifications, estimates and architecture documentation 
 - Excellent English communication skills; French or Italian an advantage

Nice To Have Qualifications

- Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud Architect or Developer certification 
 - Experience with composable/headless commerce implementations (React-based storefronts) 
 - Experience with multi-country/cross-border eCommerce platforms 
 - Experience in luxury or retail omnichannel commerce environments

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn. 

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we're intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we're creating a more equitable Valtech for all. 

The Benefits

This is a fulltime position based in Bengaluru. 

Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer

- Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent) 
 - Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs 
 - Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process. 

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential. 

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud! Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech. com. 

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know. 

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world. 

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L'Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more. 

At Valtech, we don't just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate. 

Are you ready to create what's next? Join us.

data.title: BDR Manager
data.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. 
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. 

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31. 8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4, 000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Most BDR manager jobs are a dead end if you care about marketing. You book meetings, you hit a number, you repeat. 

This one is not that. This team sits inside Demand Generation, not Sales. You own the humans and the plays that turn demand into pipeline, and you work shoulder to shoulder with performance marketing, SEO, and lifecycle on the same funnel. If your goal is to grow into demand gen or growth marketing, this is the fastest seat in the building to do it from. We are specifically hiring someone who wants that path, not someone who wants to manage a dialer forever. 

You run Sprinto's BDR function end to end: the entire inbound engine, and the net-new intent plays we are building from scratch. You own the number across SMB and mid-market, the team that hits it, and the systems (sequences, routing, reporting, AI) that make it repeatable. 

This is a growth role by design. The intent funnel, the AI automation, the campaign-level conversion work, and the reporting are all demand gen muscles. As you prove them, the path opens toward owning a channel (lifecycle, paid, or intent/ABM) or a broader demand gen mandate. 

We will invest in that deliberately: exposure to campaign planning, budget thinking, and the full funnel, not just the BDR slice. If you show up curious about why a campaign converts and not only how many dials it took, you will move fast here. 

Where you'll leave your mark

- Hitting the number. Carry and hit the demo and pipeline number across both the SMB and the mid-market motion. 
 - Make the inbound engine efficient. Move the engine from volume to conversion. Lift conversion rates campaign by campaign and hold the gains, not just for a spike month. 
 - Build a net-new demos engine. Stand up an intent-based funnel that produces demos predictably, turn at least one intent signal into a repeatable documented playbook, and diversify pipeline beyond the top-priority campaigns so growth isn't riding on a couple of plays. 
 - Raise outreach quality. Improve response rates and the quality of the pitch on live calls, not just activity volume. 
 - Put AI to work inside the team. Automate the manual ops (lead assignment, reporting) end to end, build real-time reporting leadership can trust, and extend coverage with AI so inbound doesn't go dark on weekends. 
 - Build the talent engine. Turn the BDR team into a farm system for Associate AEs. The goal: a repeatable pipeline that brings BDRs in and graduates them into AAEs inside 12 months

What You'll Own Day To Day

- Build and lead the team. Recruit, ramp, and train BDRs across inbound and outbound. Run recurring 1: 1s, live call reviews, and feedback that changes what happens on the next call
 - Run the operating rhythm. Weekly reviews against pipeline, activity, qualification, and conversion targets. Scorecards over vibes
 - Forecast honestly. Own pipeline predictability on both volume and value, so leadership can actually plan on your number
 - Own the playbook. SOPs, sequences, scripts, email pitches, and qualification criteria. Build them, keep them sharp, kill what stops working
 - Watch ramp and productivity. Time to productivity for new hires, activity levels, meeting quality, and opportunity conversion. Know where every rep is and why
 - Build the culture. Accountability, recognition, honest feedback, and a career path people can actually see. This is also what feeds the AAE bench
 - Work across functions. With content marketing on webinars, messaging, campaign follow-up, and events. With AEs and Sales on target accounts, outbound execution, and handoff quality. With RevOps on the tooling and the tech stack

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- 3-5+ years in BDR/SDR, with at least 1-2 years managing or leading a team (or a strong senior IC ready to step up) 
 - You have carried and hit a pipeline number, and you can explain exactly how you did it 
 - You think in funnels and conversion rates, not just activity counts 
 - You are genuinely curious about marketing: campaigns, positioning, channels, the whole funnel 
 - You are AI-forward: you have already used AI to make outreach or ops faster, or you are itching to 
 - You write well. Punchy, plain, no fluff. We care about this a lot 
 - Comfortable in HubSpot and modern outbound/sequencing tooling

Nice to have

- Experience selling compliance, security, or developer/infra tooling 
 - Built an outbound motion or intent play from scratch before 
 - Comfort with data: light SQL, spreadsheets, or a BI tool

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
 - Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
 - We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1, 000 annually to help you level up your skills
 - We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
 - Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
 - Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35, 000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: High Speed IO Validation Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing - an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that understand the world. Doing what has never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. 

NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design Group is the team that gets every GPU, SoC, and CPU silicon program from first power-on to high-volume production. We are hiring an HSIO Validation Engineer to own characterization and qualification of high-speed I/Os - PCIe, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, USB, UFS, and Ethernet - on brand-new silicon serving datacenter, AI, and client markets. Your bench is where silicon meets the signal - where every link train, jitter sweep, eye diagram, and protocol corner gets exercised before the part ships. You drive characterization and debug for IO interconnects across silicon, board, firmware, and driver - designing tests that anticipate rack-scale deployment so marginality surfaces at die-and-board scale, never in a rack. Your decisions show up in link margin, BER, power per lane, and the go/no-go calls that gate samples and production. 

What You Will Be Doing

- Own end-to-end characterization and validation of high-speed IO - PCIe, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, USB, UFS, Ethernet - from silicon die through package and board, on NVIDIA GPUs, CPUs, and SoCs. 
 - Develop and execute validation test plans for silicon and SoC-level HSIO features - bring-up, corner qualification, stress, productization, and structured DOE across PVT, board, cable/connector, thermal, and firmware variables - left-shifting silicon failures before deployment. 
 - Drive power characterization and optimization across IO interconnects under workload-representative stimuli (MLPerf-class patterns at silicon/board level) - analyze trade-offs across V/F, lane config, and protocol state - and feed back into design, firmware, and binning. 
 - Drive systematic root-cause analysis for complex HSIO bugs - isolating contributions across silicon, package, board, firmware, and driver, with platform/thermal/mechanical partners when system context matters. Convert rack-observed failures into silicon/board reproducers so future spins fix the root cause upstream. 
 - Assess manufacturing and yield implications of HSIO margin distributions - identify gaps in scaling from chip to product, and feed back into binning and design. 
 - Develop and improve validation methodologies, automation frameworks, and margin-tracking infrastructure - increase efficiency and coverage as platform complexity grows. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electrical or Computer Engineering (or equivalent), with 8+ years in post-silicon HSIO validation, characterization, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Deep understanding of high-speed serial link protocols (PCIe Gen5+, NVLink, NVLink-C2C, UCIe, CXL) and the underlying SERDES architecture - equalization, link training, electrical characterization - with strong signal integrity and jitter knowledge. 
 - Strong SI and PI fundamentals - S-parameters, eye diagrams, channel margin, crosstalk, return loss, PDN noise, jitter decomposition - and validation experience across silicon and platform boundaries (CoWoS/interposer/substrate, board), translating rack-environment effects into silicon/board characterization. 
 - Hands-on with lab instrumentation (DSOs, BERTs, VNAs, protocol/logic analyzers, TDR), DOE/shmoo/margin-trending, and Python-based test automation - with a track record of driving cross-functional debug across chip, package, board, firmware, driver, and system teams. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Hands-on experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6 or NVLink validation on production silicon - link training, equalization tuning, BER margining, or compliance debug. 
 - Prior SERDES, mixed-signal, or analog circuit design experience - sufficient to independently form hypotheses, design Sim-to-Si correlation experiments, and propose silicon/system-side fixes during debug. 
 - Track record of translating rack-environment conditions (thermal, connector reliability, neighbor noise) into silicon/board characterization - finding marginality at die-and-board scale before it appears in the field. 
 - Comfortable using AI productivity tools (Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) to compress log triage, regression analysis, scripting, and reporting workflows.

data.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer, Developer Productivity and Cloud Automation - GeForce NOW
data.description:
GeForce NOW is NVIDIA's Cloud Gaming service, streaming games at the highest quality to any and every user, regardless of their device type and capabilities - low-end PCs, Macs, TV or mobile devices. Using the most sophisticated GPUs and NVIDIA proprietary software, GeForce NOW transforms the gaming experience with always up-to-date games on always the latest hardware, a streaming experience rivaling that of a local PC, and near-instant launch - just click and play! For more details, see http: //www. geforce. com/geforce-now . 

Our mission empowers every GeForce NOW engineer to deliver confidently by removing obstacles, catching issues early, and turning deployments into a strength rather than a liability. We handle pipelines using GitLab's CI platform and Jenkins, along with Flux CD and Argo CD rollouts, StackStorm event-driven automation, HashiCorp Vault for credential storage, and automation across multi-cloud environments. This is the Kubernetes-native deployment platform paired with its automation system and the backend services and APIs that support it. We deliver zero-downtime global rollouts with automatic drift detection. Our reliable staging environments replicate production accurately. We provide cloud automation for bare-metal and multi-cloud environments. If a GFN service ships, runs, or self-heals, you build the infrastructure behind it. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and develop backend microservices and REST/gRPC/MCP APIs that power the deployment platform, zone reservation/lease system, and developer self-service tooling
 - Extend the platform with dynamic delivery, automatic rollback, drift detection, and automated zone bootstrapping
 - Build and stabilize prod-like staging environments/zones so teams catch regressions early
 - Develop and sustain GitOps pipelines (Flux CD, Argo CD) across on-premises and Nvidia GFN Cloud/AWS/Azure/GCP
 - Develop Kubernetes CRDs and operators in Go for scheduling, auto-scaling, and compliance across data centers 
 - Build backend integrations and control-plane services connecting CI/CD, observability, and automation systems into a unified platform experience
 - Automate dedicated hardware and multiple cloud platform configurations using Terraform, Ansible, and Vault
 - Implement monitoring solutions including Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, and ELK, paired with SLO/alerting for early detection
 - Integrate automation tools - runbooks, StackStorm bots, anomaly-triggered remediation, and Slack self-service release bots

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience with 12+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps, with deep expertise in Kubernetes, GitOps (or equivalent), and production-grade cloud-native CI/CD pipelines
 - Expert Kubernetes: CRDs, operators, multi-cluster management, and security hardening (CIS, PCI/SOC 2)
 - Proficiency in Flux CD or Argo CD, GitLab CI, and Jenkins; Go or Python for control plane development
 - Experience handling Vault, Terraform, Ansible, and Helm in both on-premises and cloud environments
 - Experience in developing and scaling RESTful, gRPC, MCP APIs and backend services. 
 - Experience running hybrid multi-cloud and bare-metal at production scale, and owning a platform roadmap end-to-end. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Backstage or similar internal developer portals for self-service tooling
 - Comprehensive expertise covering backend services as well as platform and infrastructure engineering
 - Daily use of AI-assisted tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) - we use these daily
 - Hybrid infrastructure spanning on-premises GPU clusters and public cloud

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us.

data.title: Staff Engineer (L1, L2, L3 Testing, NOS/SDK testing, Python Automation)
data.description:
About Marvell

Marvell's semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities. 

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead. 

Your Team, Your Impact

The Switch Software Quality Assurance Team is responsible for validating the Marvell switch platform, ensuring functionality, performance, and reliability across multiple SDK and NOS solutions. 

What You Can Expect

- Develop test strategies for the product features. 
 - Develop test processes and ensure the processes are followed. 
 - Be on top of developments in the storage technology and implement state of the art testing techniques and methodologies. 
 - Develop test cases according to test strategy. 
 - Review test results and bug reports for accuracy and completeness. 
 - Execute test cases and document test results in qTest. 
 - Develop test automation using Python. 
 - Measure and improve the code coverage through test improvement. 
 - Report bugs in Jira with thorough documentation, test logs and traces. 
 - Develop test scripts for testing firmware on simulation platform. 
 - Understand protocols and firmware design to develop effective test cases. 
 - Participate in peer code reviews and test plans. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor/Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related fields and 3-10 years of related professional experience. 
 - Strong understanding of switch Layers (L1-L4) networking 
 - Experience with Ethernet switching architectures, packet forwarding, and network ASIC pipelines. 

Software and Test Frameworks

- Proficiency in Python for test automation (Pytest, Robot Framework, etc. ). 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub CI, or similar) and test automation integration. 
 - Familiarity with traffic generation tools (IXIA, Spirent, TRex, Scapy). 
 - Knowledge of Linux environments, shell scripting, and low-level debugging. 
 - Experience with source control (Git) and issue tracking systems (Jira, etc. ). 
 - Experience with switch SDKs (low-level deriver)
 - SAI (Switch Abstraction Interface) - advantage
 - Exposure to hardware abstraction layers and SDK-to-driver interactions. 

QA And Testing Skills

- Proven experience in test strategy, test plan design, and coverage analysis for SDK-level or embedded systems. 
 - Expertise in functional, integration, regression, and performance testing. 
 - Familiarity with SDK API validation, packet verification, and traffic-based test automation. 
 - Understanding of release qualification processes for network devices. 
 - Strong cross-functional communication with development, validation, and release teams. 

Strategic & Process-Oriented Skills

- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies. 
 - Ability to define and improve QA processes and standards. 
 - Experience integrating QA into CI/CD workflows and continuous quality monitoring. 
 - Understanding of test coverage analysis tools and defect trend analysis. 

Soft Skills

- Excellent written and verbal communication - able to document test plans, results, and strategy clearly. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset. 
 - Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in problem-solving. 
 - Comfortable working in cross-site / multi-timezone teams. 

Advantage

- Experience with SAI/SONiC
 - Understanding of network operating systems (e. g. , SONiC or similar). 
 - Familiarity with hardware validation labs and testbed management. 
 - Exposure to hardware bring-up, firmware, or bootloader testing. 
 - Prior experience working in semiconductor or network equipment vendors. 

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success. 

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We're dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it's like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. 

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews. 

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process. 

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U. S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U. S. Department of Commerce and/or the U. S. Department of State. Except for U. S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

data.description:
Company Description

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones Gracenote's Data Platform is the central hub for millions of pieces of TV entertainment data used daily by clients and partners worldwide. It provides the critical services that structure and model data for our editorial, ingest, and delivery systems. This data powers entertainment solutions for the top cable, OTT, CE, and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers. 

The Director of DevOps & Platform Engineering Gracenote India will be central to the success of our infrastructure, cloud platform, and engineering enablement teams across geographies. This role is fundamental to the growth and technical excellence of the Gracenote engineering organization as a whole. Key goals of this role are to establish technical rigor, operational efficiency, and a robust platform engineering culture.  - Own and evolve the in-house observability stack based on Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, and related telemetry tools to ensure end-to-end visibility across microservices and data pipelines.

 - Coordinate and maintain a strong talent pipeline. 
 - Continuously assess, streamline, and improve DevOps processes, incident management workflows, and infrastructure reliability standards. 
 - Ensure strict adherence to toolings, governance, and security best practices within the Product Development Lifecycle. 
 - Represent the India DevOps and Platform Engineering organization in cross-functional engagements (e. g. , Product, Software Engineering, Architecture, and Data Science). 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering. 
 - 12+ years of experience working in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Proven track record in people management, team building, and leading multi-disciplinary DevOps teams in a global environment. 
 - 8-10 years of hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD tools, Infrastructure as Code (e. g. , Terraform, CloudFormation), and scripting (Python, Shell, Go, etc. ).

Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen. com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen. com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

data.title: Senior Golang Developer
data.description:
Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. 

Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery-from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively. 

We are looking for a Senior Go Developer to design and develop high-performance, secure, and reliable software components for enterprise-scale data collection and processing systems. You'll be building software that runs across Windows and macOS, processes high-frequency events, securely buffers and transmits data, and integrates with cloud-based data platforms - with production-grade engineering practices throughout. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance applications and background services in Go, following clean architecture and production-grade engineering practices. 
 - Build multi-threaded and concurrent processing components using goroutines, channels, synchronization primitives, worker pools, and efficient memory-management techniques. 
 - Develop reliable event collection, processing, batching, compression, serialization, and transmission mechanisms for high-volume telemetry and event data. 
 - Implement robust local persistence and encrypted buffering - supporting offline operation, checkpointing, retry queues, recovery, and protection against data loss. 
 - Develop secure integrations with cloud platforms and data services using REST APIs, HTTPS, SDKs, and other integration mechanisms. 
 - Implement enterprise-grade authentication and security mechanisms, including RSA key-pair authentication, JWT/OAuth, TLS, certificate validation, encryption, and secure credential handling. 
 - Design resilient distributed-client behavior - idempotency, duplicate prevention, exponential-backoff retries, acknowledgement handling, failure recovery, rate limiting, and network resilience. 
 - Develop efficient data-processing capabilities across formats such as JSON, Parquet, and Protocol Buffers. 
 - Optimize applications for CPU, memory, disk I/O, network utilization, startup time, and long-running stability using Go profiling and diagnostic tools. 
 - Develop and support cross-platform software for Windows and macOS, including interaction with OS APIs, system services, file systems, networking, and OS-native security facilities. 
 - Build comprehensive unit, integration, performance, stress, resilience, and security tests. 
 - Implement production-grade logging, metrics, health monitoring, diagnostics, and telemetry - ensuring sensitive information is never exposed through operational logs. 
 - Contribute to application packaging, versioning, configuration management, automated deployment, upgrade, rollback, and enterprise software-distribution strategies. 
 - Provide senior-level technical leadership through architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and mentoring. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 7+ years of software development experience with strong hands-on expertise in Golang. 
 - Advanced knowledge of Go concurrency - goroutines, channels, mutexes, contexts, synchronization, and worker-pool patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, memory management, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience building long-running services, agents, system utilities, telemetry applications, or distributed client applications. 
 - Strong experience with REST APIs, HTTPS, TLS, JSON, authentication, and secure API integration. 
 - Experience implementing RSA/public-key cryptography, JWT/OAuth, certificate-based authentication, and secure credential management. 
 - Experience with local persistence, caching, queueing, batching, compression, retry, and failure-recovery patterns. 
 - Knowledge of Parquet or similar columnar/binary data formats and high-volume data-processing patterns. 
 - Strong experience with unit testing, integration testing, mocking, profiling, debugging, and performance testing in Go. 
 - Good understanding of CI/CD, Git, code-quality tooling, dependency management, vulnerability scanning, and secure SDLC practices. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms and cloud SDK integration. 
 - Experience with Windows and/or macOS system programming, enterprise endpoint software, or large-scale telemetry systems. 
 - Familiarity with C/C++ or . NET interoperability, Windows APIs, macOS APIs, or OS-level encryption and key stores. 
 - Experience with MSI/MSIX packaging and enterprise device-management platforms. 

When you join Solvd, you'll. . .

 - Be part of a global team with equal opportunities for collaboration across continents and cultures. 
 - Thrive in an inclusive environment that prioritizes continuous learning, innovation, and ethical AI standards. 

Ready to make an impact?

If you're excited to build things that matter, champion responsible AI, and grow with some of the industry's sharpest minds. Apply today and let's innovate together. 

Solvd is an equal opportunity employer.

Job Description: Quality Team Leader - Criminal Verifications

Department: Quality Assurance - Criminal Verifications (Public Records)

Location: Remote

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday (Night Shift)

Reporting To: Quality Manager / Operations Manager

Role Overview

The Quality Team Leader - Criminal Verifications will lead a team of Quality Coaches/Auditors supporting US criminal background screening and public records research. The primary mandate is to deliver 100% audit coverage, ensure 100% feedback delivery and closure on every audited transaction, and drive weekly calibration sessions with Operations and fellow Quality Coaches so that court record interpretation and reportability decisions are applied consistently across the account. 

Key Responsibilities

Audit Coverage & Feedback (Primary)

- Ensure 100% audit coverage across all criminal verification transactions, researchers, court types, and jurisdictions in scope
 - Ensure 100% feedback closure - every audit finding is communicated to the researcher and their Team Leader within the defined TAT, with acknowledgement captured
 - Maintain audit logs, error trackers, and feedback registers with full traceability (auditor, date, jurisdiction, defect type, severity, root cause, corrective action)
 - Track repeat and researcher-specific errors; drive individual improvement plans in partnership with Operations
 - Monitor coverage dashboards daily and escalate any gap that threatens the 100% target

Calibration & Consistency

- Own and run weekly calibration sessions with Operations leadership, Quality Coaches, and Training
 - Prepare calibration case sets covering felony/misdemeanor calls, disposition edge cases, identifier matching, and record reportability
 - Publish agendas, capture minutes, and track action items to closure
 - Measure and report inter-auditor agreement/variance; drive corrective action where auditors or Ops interpret rules differently
 - Maintain a living decision log / FAQ so calibration outcomes become documented standards and SOP updates

Quality Team Management

- Manage, coach, and develop a team of Quality Coaches/Auditors dedicated to criminal verifications
 - Allocate audit volumes by jurisdiction and researcher, monitor auditor productivity, and ensure daily/weekly audit targets are met
 - Conduct one-on-ones, performance reviews, and skill development plans for the quality team
 - Certify and re-certify auditors through calibration results and accuracy checks

Criminal Verification Domain Quality

- Audit accuracy and completeness of research across local, county, state, and federal US court portals, as well as vendor/court runner and database sources
 - Validate correct review and interpretation of court dockets and legal documentation, including: 
 - Charge levels (felony, misdemeanor, infraction)
 - Case types (criminal / civil)
 - Case statuses and dispositions (convicted, dismissed, acquitted, deferred, pending, expunged/sealed, etc. )
 - Identifier matching (name, DOB, address, and other PII match logic) to prevent false positives and false negatives
 - Verify correct application of client reportability rules, adjudication matrices, and jurisdiction-specific reporting restrictions
 - Ensure criminal records are documented, classified, and reported accurately and within TAT

Compliance & Governance

- Ensure adherence to FCRA, state reporting restrictions, ban-the-box and seven-year rules, client SOPs, and internal criminal screening guidelines
 - Maintain confidentiality and data integrity while handling sensitive criminal record and PII data
 - Support internal, client, and regulatory audits with documented, evidence-backed audit trails
 - Flag critical/fatal defects - misreported convictions, missed records, wrong-subject matches - for immediate escalation and containment

Continuous Improvement

- Perform root cause analysis on defect trends by jurisdiction, court type, researcher, and client program; drive CAPA to closure
 - Partner with Training to convert recurring defects into refresher modules, checklists, and updated SOPs
 - Identify process gaps, search-logic issues, and automation opportunities that reduce error leakage
 - Track effectiveness of improvement actions through pre/post accuracy movement

Stakeholder Management

- Act as the quality point of contact for Criminal Operations, Training, Compliance, and Client Services
 - Present quality performance, jurisdiction risk areas, and defect trends in operational and client reviews
 - Manage quality escalations, disputes, and rebuttals with objective, evidence-based resolution
 - Support dispute/reinvestigation reviews where consumer challenges relate to reported criminal records

MIS & Reporting

- Publish daily/weekly/monthly quality dashboards covering coverage %, accuracy, defect categories, and feedback closure
 - Track and report critical vs. non-critical error rates, auditor variance, and calibration outcomes
 - Analyze trends, forecast risk, and recommend corrective actions to leadership

Mandatory Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

- Hands-on experience in US criminal / public records background verification is mandatory
 - Prior experience in quality auditing of criminal verification transactions
 - Minimum 18 months of experience as a Quality Coach (on paper)
 - Total experience of 3-6 years in BGV / KPO / Quality Assurance
 - Demonstrated experience running audits, feedback cycles, and calibration sessions
 - Strong understanding of US legal terminology, court hierarchy, and court documentation
 - No employment gaps exceeding 5-6 months
 - Willingness to work in US Shift (Night Shift)

Skills & Competencies

- Strong working knowledge of US court websites, court structures, and public record systems
 - Sound grasp of quality frameworks - sampling methodology, defect classification, RCA, CAPA
 - Working knowledge of FCRA and state-level criminal reporting restrictions
 - Excellent analytical, interpretation, and attention-to-detail abilities
 - Strong coaching and feedback delivery skills; able to influence without direct authority
 - Clear written and verbal communication for audit documentation and stakeholder reviews
 - Ability to remain objective and evidence-driven in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

Technical Skills

- Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (pivots, lookups, dashboards) and MIS reporting
 - Familiarity with BGV platforms and quality audit tools is an advantage
 - Strong data handling, trend analysis, and presentation skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Audit coverage - 100%
 - Feedback delivery and closure - 100% within TAT
 - Weekly calibration completion and inter-auditor variance within threshold
 - Accuracy / quality score movement of supported criminal research teams
 - Critical (fatal) error rate - missed records, wrong-subject matches, misreported dispositions
 - Defect leakage to client and dispute/reinvestigation volumes
 - Repeat error reduction and RCA/CAPA effectiveness
 - Auditor productivity and certification compliance
 - Client satisfaction and audit escalation resolution
 - Team engagement and retention

data.description:
Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We're committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that's welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us. 

Overview

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures, and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U. S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability, and community impact. Boeing's team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company's core values of safety, quality, and integrity. At Boeing, we are all innovators on a mission to connect, protect, and explore. From the seabed to outer space, you'll learn and grow, contributing to work that shapes the world. Find your future with us. 

Technology for today and tomorrow

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace. 

People-driven culture

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts - enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people's careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing. 

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace. 

Position Overview

Boeing India - Engineering, Test & Technology (ET&T) is looking for Director, Boeing India ET&T - SAMPI (Safety, Air worthiness, Mechanical, Propulsion & Interiors) and Quality . This position is based out of the Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC), Bangalore. 

Position Responsibilities: 

- Executive leader for Structures and Mechanical systems, responsible for all aspects of execution and people management for that organization. Chief engineer for the Structures and Mechanical systems across all of Boeing India.

As the local execution leader at India, this leader will be accountable to BCA, BDS and BGS programs for projects / Statement of Works (SoW) being executed at India and also to enterprise functional leaders for functional talent, knowledge curation, integration and continuous improvement.

 - Responsible for execution of over 40+ projects related to SAMPI, design, development, sustainment and support services apart from process & tools for commercial, defense and space products for US stakeholders and India customers. 
 - Translate Strategy to Action: Functional leadership as well as BIETC strategies to action. By executing strategy, build capabilities, secure & execute SoW, manage cost, quality and schedule, attract/develop & retain talent, manage stakeholders across businesses. 
 - Provide in-country liaison engineering support for effective execution of work statements by suppliers. Develop and execute integrated organizational plans, policies and procedures and guide the development of business and technical strategies, goals and objectives

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

 - Experience working across multiple functions and regions within a Global company·

data.title: Software Validation Engineer - ASIC
data.description:
Location: Bangalore, India

Company: QFocus AI

Domain: Embedded AI

Description

We are seeking a versatile and independent C++ Software Engineer to join the AI Infrastructure Silicon Validation team. This role focuses on writing robust software to test, validate, and stress-test AI infrastructure platforms. You will use your strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) foundation to build validation applications, integrate with hardware vendor SDKs (including NVIDIA CUDA), and independently deliver reliable testing code. 

Key Responsibilities

- Write Validation Software: Design, implement, and maintain test applications in C++ to validate the performance and correctness of AI infrastructure. 
 - SDK & API Integration: Successfully integrate and utilize third-party SDKs and low-level APIs, specifically including CUDA, to interact with compute hardware. 
 - Apply Clean OOP Principles: Build reusable, modular, and easily maintainable validation frameworks using proper modern object-oriented design patterns. 
 - Independent Execution: Take ownership of assigned validation features from technical requirements through to delivery, debugging, and documentation with minimal supervision. 
 - Test & Debug: Identify software bugs, memory issues, and api integration edge cases in a Linux-based engineering environment. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong C++ & OOP: Solid proficiency in core C++ (including modern standards like C++14/C++17) with a deep understanding of classes, inheritance, polymorphism, and memory management. 
 - API/SDK Experience: Demonstrated ability to read documentation, pick up new technical SDKs quickly, and implement them-specifically CUDA APIs. 
 - Proficiency with POSIX Multi-threading
 - Linux Environment: Comfortable developing, compiling (e. g. , CMake/Make), and running applications in a standard Linux environment. 
 - Independent Problem Solver: Proven track record of working autonomously to complete coding tasks, write clean test code and troubleshoot issues. 

Desired Experience

- Experience writing unit tests or automated validation suites. 
 - Basic familiarity with multi-threaded programming or concurrent execution concepts. 
 - Familiarity with Python for basic scripting or test automation wrappers. 
 - 6+ years of hands-on experience working in complex (preferably) HW-SW projects with tight schedules.

We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world's air travel industry. 

You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2, 500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. As a Senior Business Automation Architect (ServiceNow Agentic AI) you will lead the design and implementation of AI-driven automation solutions on the ServiceNow platform. 

This role focuses on designing governed, scalable agentic AI solutions that combine workflow automation, data, and AI agents to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Agentic AI
data.description:
Location: Bangalore (Quarterly visit for 2 weeks)

Function: Software Engineering

Reports to: Director, Packaging Intelligence

About The Role

Esko is building Agentic AI as a shared platform capability that enables product teams to create reliable AI-powered workflows without independently rebuilding common foundations. The platform team provides reusable capabilities, engineering patterns, and production foundations; product teams retain ownership of their domain applications and customer experiences. 

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role combining line management with substantial direct technical contribution. You will lead and develop the Agentic AI team, help shape the platform's technical direction, and take end-to-end ownership of substantial technical areas. Success will be measured not only by what the team ships, but by the quality, adoption, and leverage the platform creates across Esko. 

You will work closely with product engineering, architecture, cloud platform, security, compliance, product management, and design to translate shared needs and legitimate domain differences into coherent platform capabilities. You will also contribute to Esko's broader AI direction and participate in customer or industry discussions where your technical perspective is valuable. 

What You Will Do

- Lead and develop the Agentic AI engineering team through clear goals, regular feedback, coaching, performance management, career development, and thoughtful allocation of ownership. 
 - Contribute directly to the design, implementation, and operation of substantial areas of Esko's shared Agentic AI platform. 
 - Help shape the platform's technical direction, architecture, interfaces, and engineering quality bar in collaboration with the wider platform and architecture community. 
 - Translate recurring product and engineering needs into reusable platform capabilities, while accommodating legitimate domain differences without creating product-specific forks. 
 - Establish strong engineering practices for reliability, security, observability, evaluation, performance, and compatibility for consuming teams. 
 - Work directly with product engineering teams to support adoption of the shared platform and help them take domain-specific agentic capabilities from exploration into production. 
 - Create an environment in which engineers can experiment, learn, challenge assumptions, and make evidence-based technical decisions while remaining accountable for production outcomes. 
 - Define and use meaningful measures of platform adoption, quality, operational performance, delivery effectiveness, and team development to guide priorities and improvement. 

What We Are Looking For

- Strong production software engineering experience in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language, including designing, building, and operating reliable systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers, including line management, coaching, performance feedback, and creating meaningful technical ownership. 
 - Experience building a platform, API, or shared service used by multiple teams, with sound judgement about abstractions, interfaces, compatibility, and operational responsibilities. 
 - Experience designing or building production AI systems using large language models, tool use, or agentic workflows, together with a practical understanding of their limitations and risks. 
 - A track record of taking uncertain or early-stage technical ideas through evaluation, implementation, and adoption as dependable production capabilities. 
 - Ability to balance platform coherence with legitimate product and domain differences, and to make clear technical trade-offs when needs conflict. 
 - Experience collaborating across product engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, and business functions in a global organization. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineering, product, and leadership audiences. 
 - Undergraduate, Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science / Machine Learning / Data Science / Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience in packaging graphics, prepress, CAD, or the wider graphic arts industry. 
 - Experience building or operating multi-tenant SaaS or cloud platform capabilities. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation, observability, security controls, governance, or other production foundations for agentic systems. 

What Success Looks Like

- Delivery of solutions conforming to agreed specifications and architecture that leverage agentic AI to solve valuable customer problems in a way that is explainable and repeatable - resulting in measurable productivity improvements. 
 - Teams across the business ship AI-powered capabilities that solve valuable customer problems by leveraging a shared foundation, rather than "re-inventing the wheel". 
 - Providing adequate space for ideation - and inspiration for team members to try new approaches, technologies and techniques. 
 - Team members are set meaningful, measurable goals - with training and development plans created to facilitate their ongoing personal and career development. 
 - Delivery of initiatives occurs in line with Esko's Software Development Lifecycle and in accordance with company policy and security best practices. 
 - The Agentic AI platform grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one-off, team-specific solutions. 
 - A class-leading set of capabilities provide a powerful base for Esko cross-functional teams to transform the value of our software using cutting-edge AI technologies. 

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. This position combines people leadership, product delivery, architecture oversight, and strategic technology management. The successful candidate will lead a team of engineers and collaborate with business stakeholders, clinical scientists, data management teams, biostatisticians, and digital product teams to transform fragmented clinical data into trusted, reusable, and AI-ready data assets.

Clinical Data Platform Leadership

Artificial Intelligence & Generative AI

- Lead implementation of AI-powered solutions that improve clinical trial efficiency, data review, patient insights, and operational decision-making.

 - Lead architecture reviews, technical design decisions, project execution, and risk mitigation activities.

People Leadership

- Build, develop, and retain high-performing Data Engineering and AI teams. 
 - Establish engineering excellence practices, technical standards, and career development frameworks. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Lead workforce planning, vendor management, hiring, and capability development activities.

- Ensure compliance with GxP, Computer System Validation (CSV), HIPAA, GDPR, J&J Data Privacy Standards, and AI Governance requirements.

About Us. . 

Dyson is a global technology company powered by ingenuity and relentless curiosity. We reimagine everyday products through radical innovation-from vacuums and hair care to air purification and robotics. Our teams thrive on challenge and continuous improvement. 

As we expand into new markets, our technology function is central to Dyson's future-ensuring every solution scales securely and delivers best-in-class experiences for millions of people. Here, architecture isn't just about systems. It's about unleashing ideas, shaping outcomes, and making a real difference. 

Join a community that celebrates disruption, values diverse perspectives, and empowers you to lead at the edge of possibility.
