Roles And Responsibilities - Shift Leads

The Shift Lead is responsible for supervising and guiding a team of customer service agents during a specific shift. They ensure operational efficiency, adherence to service standards, and delivery of high-quality customer support while acting as the primary point of escalation for the team. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team Management & Supervision
 - Lead and manage a team of Customer Service Representatives, ensuring all performance metrics (FRT, AHT, CSAT/NPS, Quality, Schedule Adherence) targets are consistently met. 
 - Supervise and guide agents to achieve performance targets and service level agreements (SLAs). 
 - Monitor agent attendance, adherence to schedules, and productivity during the shift. 
 - Provide real-time coaching, guidance, and feedback to agents to enhance performance. 
 - Assist in onboarding and training new team members as required. 
 - Facilitate the smooth transition of new agents by actively supporting their event handling, ensuring they quickly grasp comprehensive process knowledge. 
 - A Shift Lead must always be present on the floor during the shift. 
 - Maintain floor decorum and foster a professional work environment. 
 - Operational Oversight & Floor Support
 - Ensure smooth execution of daily operations, including queue monitoring, call/event assignments in coordination with ENS, and workload distribution. 
 - Oversee Reach and Talk desk platforms, managing queues efficiently. 
 - Monitor real-time metrics such as call volume, wait times, abandoned calls, and service levels to maintain operational efficiency. 
 - For resolutions provided during the call, the Agent retains primary ownership. The Shift Lead is designated as the secondary responsible party for validating the resolution and ensuring proper process adherence. 
 - Proactively Logging in to assist all LOBs during high call volume. 
 - Ensure breaks are punched in by associates on Talk desk. 
 - Shift Leads must maintain a shift-end tracker capturing all delay reasons, including half-day instances and any reasons leading to excess AUX usage. 
 - Send the shift-end report to @GCC-ERS-ENS using the format in the attached tracker. 
 - Customer Service Excellence
 - Ensure agents deliver high-quality customer interactions aligned with company policies and customer expectations. 
 - Handle complex or escalated customer issues as needed. 
 - Ensure 100% accuracy in documentation of regular agent audits, call dispositions, and customer interaction records while enforcing strict adherence to client-specific standards. 
 - Follow up on detractor cases and send appropriate communication to the concerned associate. 
 - Assist with escalation calls and emails, ensuring prompt resolution. 
 - Reporting & Documentation
 - Generate shift reports, including key performance indicators (KPIs), service levels, and agent performance, for management review. 
 - Track and document operational incidents, escalations, and resolutions. 
 - Monitor the ERS Admin email distribution list and ensure timely action. 
 - Queue & Notification Management
 - Actively monitor queues and notifications to ensure timely responses and prevent delays. 
 - Communicate critical alerts and updates to relevant stakeholders promptly. 
 - Coaching & Development
 - Conduct coaching sessions for BQ associates when directed by Team Leads. 
 - Deliver real-time feedback to associates to drive performance improvement. 
 - Collaboration & Communication
 - Serve as a bridge between management and agents to communicate updates, policies, and operational changes. 
 - Collaborate with Team Leads, workforce management, quality, and coaching teams to ensure smooth operations across all shifts. 
 - Continuous Improvement
 - Identify opportunities for process improvement, enhanced agent efficiency, or better customer service outcomes. 
 - Provide suggestions to management for operational or workflow enhancements. 
 - Foster a culture of learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Software Engineer to work on Qualys' next-generation data platform and middleware. Working alongside a very talented team of engineers and architects, you will be responsible for prototyping, designing, developing and supporting a highly scalable SaaS based cloud security data platform. Be the face and developer advocate of the stack you own and contribute back to open source community if any enhancement needed to fit in Qualys ecosystem.

You will be constantly in the hunt for better solutions out there to resolve the current scaling, availability and cost effective alternative solutions.

data.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

Chalhoub Group's Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail. 

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. 

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality - bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse - the Group's innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally. 

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future proofing. Today, it brings together over 16, 000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. 

Sustainability is at the core of the Group's strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women's Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the Data Engineering capability across data platform engineering, data pipelines and processing, data operations, BI and reporting, and data quality engineering, delivering reliable cloud data infrastructure and trustworthy analytics for the business. 
 - Lead the Data Engineering capability, owning data platform engineering across the cloud data platform (Google BigQuery), storage, compute, and data access layers on GCP. 
 - Own data pipelines and processing, engineering robust ETL/ELT ingestion pipelines (Python, Apache Airflow, dbt, Airbyte) and batch and streaming processing from source systems into the data warehouse. 
 - Own data operations, including pipeline monitoring, job orchestration and scheduling, incident resolution, and the reliability and uptime of data ingestion (DataOps). 
 - Own BI and reporting, developing semantic layers (Looker, LookML), reporting models, and dashboards (Power BI, SQL) to deliver actionable business intelligence. 
 - Own data quality engineering, implementing automated data testing, data validation, anomaly detection, and cleansing logic to ensure accuracy and data integrity. 
 - Own engineering leadership, capability and team development, engineering practices, and continuous improvement across the data engineering team. 
 - Remain hands-on: plan, design, execute, and document data validation and automated data testing across integrated data systems for assigned scope. 
 - Use Claude Code for AI-assisted development to accelerate pipeline and query development while maintaining quality. 

What You'll Need To Succeed

- 10 years of data engineering experience, including experience leading or mentoring engineers. 
 - Strong expertise in Google BigQuery, cloud data warehousing, data access control, and GCP. 
 - Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT (Python, Apache Airflow, dbt, Airbyte), batch and streaming processing, and DataOps (pipeline monitoring, job orchestration, incident resolution). 
 - Proficiency in BI and reporting (Looker, LookML, Power BI, SQL, dashboard design) and data quality engineering (data validation, automated data testing, anomaly detection). 
 - Familiarity with Claude Code for AI-assisted development. 

What We Can Offer You

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day. 

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts. 

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations. 

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity. 

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

data.title: Team Lead - RF Systems
data.description:
Job Description

Description: 

Lead and grow a high-performing team of 5 RF and physical layer (PHY) systems engineers, driving the technical execution, performance evaluation, and system-level ownership of next-generation wireless modems. In this role, you will act as the core technical focal point while balancing people management, roadmap execution, and cross-functional alignment. 

Your responsibilities include: 

- Team Leadership & Development: Manage, mentor, and scale a team of 5 engineers, fostering technical excellence, career growth, and a collaborative engineering culture. 
 - Technical Ownership & Direction: Guide the team's technical strategy for RF/baseband/PHY system definition, performance characterization, and system-level troubleshooting. 
 - Cross-Functional Execution: Serve as the primary technical and managerial bridge between your team and RFIC design, algorithm, software, and firmware departments. 
 - Framework & Automation Oversight: Oversee the development of advanced Python and MATLAB environments used for automated data analysis, I/Q processing, and system performance evaluations. 
 - Roadmap & Resource Planning: Prioritize project tasks, define technical milestones, and ensure high-quality deliverables across all system development and evaluation phases. 

Job Requirements

Requirements-Must Have

- Experience: 10+ years of engineering experience in wireless communications, with a proven track record of leading technical teams or managing engineering talent in an RF/PHY domain. 
 - Leadership Capability: Demonstrated experience managing or tech-leading a small-to-mid-sized engineering team (around 3 to 8 direct reports), with strong skills in mentoring and project execution. 
 - RF & PHY Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of wireless modem architectures, digital communications, and RF chain performance (Noise Figure, IP3, return loss, Superheterodyne/Zero-IF architectures). 
 - Programming & Tooling Proficiency: Strong background in Python and/or MATLAB for data analysis, automation, and algorithm evaluation. 
 - Lab & Measurement Acumen: Hands-on familiarity with RF test equipment (spectrum analyzers, signal generators, VNAs, power meters) and system-level debugging methodologies. 
 - Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to align cross-functional teams and present technical roadmaps to leadership. 

Nice to Have

- Digital Communications & Impairments: Practical knowledge of I/Q modulation (QAM, PSK), Digital Predistortion (DPD), Automatic Gain Control (AGC), and Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) characterization. 
 - Engineering Mindset: Pragmatic problem-solving approach, strong system-level perspective, and experience thriving in fast-paced multidisciplinary environments.

data.description:
Head of Engineering: Options

About Keyrock

Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation. 

Today, we rock with over 200 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Madrid, Brussels, Singapore , New York and Paris, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight. 

We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks as well as asset and wealth management. Keyrock is looking to expand and establish itself as a full-service capital markets and asset & wealth management financial institution through both organic innovation and inorganic growth. 

But we're more than a service provider. We're an initiator. We have been pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading systems, and champions of its use in the industry. We upgrade Web3 ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives. 

At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it. 

Mission statement

We are looking for a Head of Engineering / Engineering Lead with strong experience in systematic options trading to lead our Options Engineering team. 

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the Options Engineering team, driving continuous improvement across the trading infrastructure, and supporting the evolution of our systematic options trading platform. This includes areas such as automated quoting, execution, risk controls, pricing workflows, and production reliability. 

We are primarily looking for candidates based in European time zones or the US East Coast time zone. 

We are looking for someone who can: 

- Lead and grow an Options Engineering team of around 7 engineers
 - Bring hands-on experience in systematic options trading, ideally including options market-making, automated quoting, execution, and risk management
 - Own and evolve an existing Rust-native systematic options trading platform
 - Provide strong technical direction across trading infrastructure, system design, performance, reliability, and risk controls
 - Work pragmatically through complex engineering and trading-system challenges
 - Partner closely with trading, quant, product, risk, and infrastructure stakeholders
 - Balance technical leadership with people leadership, delivery ownership, and operational discipline

Required Experience

- 7+ years of experience in systematic trading, options market-making or low-latency trading systems
 - Strong hands-on experience with Rust, C++, or C
 - Willingness to become deeply proficient in Rust, if not already
 - Strong understanding of algorithmic options trading, including automated quoting, execution, pricing, risk controls, and market data workflows
 - Experience building or maintaining low-latency trading systems, ideally within options or derivatives markets
 - Experience working with SQL databases in production environments, with PostgreSQL preferred
 - Familiarity with functional testing, component testing, and production-grade validation practices
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, service boundaries, and production reliability
 - Strong knowledge of gRPC and experience working with Node. js-based services is preferred
 - Previous experience with crypto exchange connectivity and/or FPGA technologies is strongly preferred

Leadership & Working Style

- Strong team player with the ability to lead, mentor, and guide engineers
 - Pragmatic approach to problem-solving, system design, and implementation
 - Able to balance latency, reliability, safety, complexity, and delivery speed
 - Comfortable making technical decisions under uncertainty
 - Demonstrates outside-the-box thinking while staying grounded in practical delivery
 - Communicates clearly and effectively, especially in unfamiliar or ambiguous contexts where clarity is critical
 - Able to work closely with traders, quants, risk, product, and infrastructure stakeholders
 - Strong ownership mindset, especially for production trading systems

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who's driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes. 

Our offer

- A competitive salary package
 - Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
 - The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance. 

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

data.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Network Operational Intelligence(Maersk)

Job Level 4 (Senior Software Engineer)

This position will be based in Bangalore

A. P. Moller - Maersk

A. P. Moller - Maersk is the global leader in container shipping services. The business operates in 130 countries and employs c. 80, 000 staff. An integrated container logistics company, Maersk aims to connect and simplify its customers' supply chains. 

We Offer

Joining Maersk will embark you on a transformational journey with great opportunities for career development within a global organization. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, engineer and run our capabilities for the Network Automation and Orchestration Tools stack for network and perimeter products and platforms that enable highly distributed global business for site, fleet, asset and IoT connectivity, required to deliver against our strategy. You will be exposed to a wide and challenging range of needs and opportunities requiring you to engage closely with stakeholders across all levels within Maersk as you mature and evolve our Ops Intelligence capabilities for Network Ops Intelligence to become world class. 

The Brief

A globally focused shipping and transportation organisation is continuing to drive an ambitious and complex change and transformational programme to deliver a service of excellence for its customers and clients worldwide. The Global CTIO has a mandate from the Maersk board to lead the Technology transformation of Maersk which will enable the Maersk business strategy to become the global integrator of container logistics through digitising the Maersk business processes and customer engagement. 

The Technology Function is fundamental to enable the company's transformation and in response to this demand, our in-house technological capability is growing exponentially. We are recruiting world class talent to ensure that the technology services are modernised to enable Maersk to become a logistics integrator leveraging a competitive advantage through technology. 

Why this job matters?

The Network Ops Intelligence Engineering function is essential to our transformation, it is a central team within Network Architecture & Engineering, responsible for the delivery of product roadmaps, technical vision and quality across Fulfilment and Assurance that underpin our network and perimeter capabilities and products. 

Reporting to the Senior Network Ops Intelligence Engineering Manager you will serve as a Senior Software Engineer, ensuring that our systems and tools for the network Ops Intelligence realise business value. Your role is responsible for technical design and delivery of solutions across the network Ops Intelligence applications landscape from Planning to analytics driven AIOps. All built to industry leading standards and running seamlessly across various cloud and on-prem platforms, allowing frictionless and seamless operations of our network and perimeter platforms. 

Scope

The Network Ops Intelligence team at Maersk is responsible for enabling, automating, and enhancing the management of data networks across Core, Edge, and Cloud locations (offices, warehouses, terminals, vessels, data centres, cloud environments, etc. ), and is expanding into AI-driven network operations - building intelligent, autonomous systems for observability, assurance, and decision-making. 

This role sits at the intersection of deep software engineering and applied AI: designing and building production-grade platforms and tools, and infusing them with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agentic frameworks to transform how networks are operated. 

Key areas include but are not limited to: 

- Automation & Orchestration: Design and implementation of workflows and systems to automate provisioning, configuration, monitoring, and assurance of network services. 
 - AI-Augmented Operations: Develop agentic AI solutions using LLMs, orchestration frameworks and vector stores to enable intelligent automation, natural language interfaces, and autonomous troubleshooting. 
 - Tooling & Platform Development: Build scalable internal tools for network inventory, monitoring, telemetry collection, event correlation, and intent-based management. 
 - Intelligent Observability & Insights: Use GenAI to augment monitoring and assurance - alert summarization, root cause inference, change impact prediction, and knowledge extraction from telemetry, syslogs, traps, and alarms. 
 - Prompt Engineering & Reasoning: Design structured/dynamic prompts, chains, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows for context-aware insights from large-scale network data. 

Our mission is to drive network intelligence, automation, and operational excellence by bridging infrastructure with software and AI - building LLM-based platforms that are autonomous, explainable, and user-friendly. 

Specific Job Requirements

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (8+ years) with a product mindset - a strong software engineering foundation combined with hands-on applied AI/LLM engineering experience. The role holder will demonstrate deep expertise in Python-based platform development and in building LLM-powered systems for production use. 

Software Engineering Expertise

- Advanced Python proficiency: Mastery of Python syntax, data structures, OOP principles, and AI/NLP libraries (LangChain, LangGraph, Transformers, OpenAI SDK, HuggingFace, LlamaIndex). 
 - Web frameworks: Hands-on expertise with FastAPI, Flask, or Django for backend service development; ability to lead projects and mentor developers. 
 - API development leadership: Design and development of secure, high-performance RESTful APIs, with strong understanding of authentication mechanisms and integration patterns. 
 - Databases & ORM: In-depth experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) and ORM frameworks (SQLAlchemy, Django ORM). 
 - Microservices & Docker: Architecting modular, scalable, resilient microservices-based systems with containerization. 
 - CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub workflows, Jenkins, automated build/test/deploy pipelines. 
 - Testing & quality: TDD discipline with PyTest/unittest; strong focus on code quality, maintainability, and reproducibility. 
 - Algorithms & problem-solving: Design, analysis, and optimization of algorithms; strategic problem-solving for complex challenges. 

AI & Agentic Engineering Expertise

- Hands-on LLM experience: Building applications with foundation models (OpenAI, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral, Gemini) via APIs and self-hosted/open-weight models. 
 - Agentic AI systems: Designing autonomous/semi-autonomous agents with multi-step reasoning, tool/function calling, planning, memory, and state management - using LangGraph, LangChain, or similar frameworks (e. g. , AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool integration). 
 - Prompt engineering & RAG: Structured prompts, few-shot and chain-of-thought techniques, embedding models, vector stores (FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid search, chunking strategies, and re-ranking for retrieval pipelines. 
 - LLMOps & evaluation: Systematic evaluation of LLM outputs - golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing of prompts/chains; observability and tracing of agent workflows (e. g. , LangSmith, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry for GenAI); handling hallucination mitigation, fallback mechanisms, and graceful degradation. 
 - Fine-tuning & model adaptation: Familiarity with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT), instruction tuning, and when to choose fine-tuning vs. RAG vs. prompting. 
 - Structured outputs & tool integration: Function calling, JSON-schema-constrained generation, and integrating LLMs securely with APIs, databases, and monitoring platforms. 
 - MLOps & inference infrastructure: Containerized AI workloads, GPU orchestration, batch vs. streaming inference, model serving (e. g. , vLLM, Triton), token/cost optimization, caching, and rate limiting. 
 - AI security & governance: Data privacy, PII redaction, prompt-injection defenses, guardrails frameworks, role-based access, auditability, and responsible/ethical deployment of LLM systems at enterprise scale. 
 - Multi-modal & emerging capabilities: Experience with multi-modal models (text + logs/metrics/diagrams), streaming responses, and voice/chat interface design. 

In this role, you will: 

- Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Network SMEs, and Engineers to gather requirements and identify AI opportunities in telemetry analysis, event correlation, configuration analysis, and operational summarization. 
 - Own end-to-end development of network tooling services across telemetry, topology, configuration management, and orchestration - and augment them with GenAI capabilities. 
 - Architect and deploy agent-based systems that integrate with network management platforms and decision-support systems. 
 - Design and implement prompt flows, vector-based search, and retrieval pipelines to contextualize large-scale telemetry and logs. 
 - Build natural-language interfaces enabling intelligent self-service for operations teams (querying, reasoning, diagnostics, root cause analysis). 
 - Design, implement, and publish high-performance APIs serving Maersk's network operations ecosystem. 
 - Drive architectural decisions; mentor engineers on software engineering best practices and on LLM usage, architecture, evaluation, and security in production. 
 - Support program delivery with estimation, planning, and risk assessment; participate in capacity planning, performance optimization, and reliability initiatives. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging GenAI models, agent frameworks, and tools for Ops Intelligence use cases. 

Added advantage

- Experience in network operations, network automation, observability, or infrastructure monitoring. 
 - Experience with time-series/telemetry data platforms (Kafka, Prometheus, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch). 
 - Exposure to Kubernetes for orchestrating microservices and AI workloads

The Candidate

To be considered for this opportunity candidates will have the following skills: 

- Demonstrates excellent communication skills with ability to communicate effectively at all levels within the organisation reaching out when needed to resolve issues. 
 - Shows strength in negotiation both internally and externally to ensure successful resolution of issues prior to escalation, ensuring that the wider business imperative is not undermined. 
 - A clear understanding of the business imperatives and how they align with the wider company strategy. 

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements. 

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk. com.

data.title: Staff Engineer (Core & MLOps)
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Engineer (Core & MLOps) based in India. 

This role offers the opportunity to shape foundational infrastructure powering large-scale web data products and distributed engineering teams. You'll own the architecture of core control and context planes that enable services and AI-driven workflows to operate reliably and efficiently. Working across Kubernetes, Kafka, Java, Python, gRPC, and multi-cloud infrastructure, you'll tackle complex distributed systems challenges at production scale. You'll establish engineering standards, reliability practices, and service contracts that influence multiple product squads. The role combines hands-on architecture with technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional alignment. In a globally distributed, remote-first environment, you'll have significant autonomy to solve challenging infrastructure problems and influence long-term platform strategy. 

Accountabilities

- Architect and evolve the control and context planes, advancing service and schema registries, SLO enforcement, health-aware routing, automated canary releases, and operational feedback loops. 
 - Own the service chassis and golden path, maintaining and improving multi-language Java and Python client libraries, standardized workload specifications, Helm charts, and deployment pipelines. 
 - Define and govern inter-service contracts, including gRPC and Protocol Buffer definitions, API gateway transcoding, versioning policies, and schema evolution standards. 
 - Operate and improve the core platform infrastructure across Kubernetes, Terraform, HAProxy/Nginx, Confluent Kafka, real-time billing pipelines, Valkey, and database modernization initiatives. 
 - Lead architectural strategy through Requests for Discussion (RFDs) covering workflow orchestration, gateway orchestration, multi-cluster routing, automated failover, and other critical platform initiatives. 
 - Establish reliability engineering practices, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, fault isolation, and automated weighted canary deployments. 
 - Participate in shared infrastructure on-call rotations, lead incident post-mortems, and convert operational insights into platform improvements. 
 - Mentor engineers across multiple squads, review architectural proposals, and establish engineering practices that make reliable software development more consistent and efficient. 

Requirements

- 10+ years of experience building scalable distributed backend systems, with a strong track record of creating internal platforms or core libraries adopted across engineering organizations. 
 - Advanced Java expertise, including reactive frameworks such as Vert. x or Netty, combined with strong Python proficiency. 
 - Deep experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers, including schema evolution and backward compatibility in mission-critical systems. 
 - Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes at scale, Terraform, and event-streaming platforms such as Kafka. 
 - Experience designing automated telemetry pipelines, materialized views, feature stores, or other feedback systems that use production data to dynamically improve system behavior. 
 - Strong reliability engineering background, including SLO/SLI definition, blast-radius analysis, fault tolerance, and rigorous service contracts. 
 - Exceptional technical writing skills and the ability to communicate complex architectural concepts clearly while driving alignment across teams. 
 - Strong written and interpersonal communication skills suited to a globally distributed, remote-first environment. 
 - A curious, continuous-learning mindset with an interest in evaluating new technologies, architectures, and engineering approaches. 
 - Experience with Temporal, DBOS, or similar durable execution platforms is a plus. 
 - MLOps experience, including model serving, performance monitoring, or production drift detection, is advantageous. 
 - Familiarity with zero-trust networking and service meshes such as SPIRE, mTLS, Cilium, Istio, or Envoy is beneficial. 
 - Experience building developer tooling such as CLIs, SDKs, or project generators is a plus. 
 - Experience with large-scale web scraping or crawling, or contributions to distributed-systems and data-extraction open-source projects, is advantageous. 

Benefits

- Fully remote, remote-first working environment with flexible working hours. 
 - Freedom and flexibility to work from the location where you are most productive. 
 - Opportunity to work on core infrastructure supporting large-scale web data pipelines and distributed systems. 
 - Exposure to cutting-edge open-source technologies, tools, and evolving AI and web data infrastructure. 
 - Opportunities to attend conferences and connect with colleagues across the globe. 
 - Collaboration with a diverse, multicultural, and globally distributed engineering community. 
 - High level of autonomy and organizational trust. 
 - Opportunities to influence platform architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy across multiple teams. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. 

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Help Build the Next Generation of Cloud-Scalable Security Products

Have a passion for software security? Excel at implementing public cloud at scale? Desire to build analytics/reporting over a data platform ingesting massive amounts of data? This may well be the role for you. Our Communication and Collaboration Security products are cutting edge solutions that empower Mimecast customers to Work ProtectedTM at tremendous scale. 

About Mimecast

Mimecast is a leading cybersecurity company that helps organizations protect their people, data, and communications from today's most sophisticated threats. With over 42, 000 customers worldwide, we analyze more than 18 billion security events daily to stop attacks before they cause harm. Mimecast DMARC Analyzer is a cloud-based service that simplifies the complex process of implementing and managing DMARC (Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting & Conformance) policies for an organization's email domains. It provides visibility into who is sending emails using an organization's domain, helps identify legitimate versus fraudulent senders, simplifies DMARC policy enforcement, and ultimately protects the brand from domain spoofing and email fraud. 

AI-First Engineering at Mimecast

Mimecast is an AI-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI-powered development tools to accelerate innovation, improve code quality, and solve complex cybersecurity challenges at scale. We are looking for technical engineering leaders who embrace these technologies or are eager to master them quickly. Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI tooling and AI-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer with expertise in Java, AWS cloud technologies, and email security protocols like DMARC, SPF, and DKIM, API based email protection. The ideal candidate will lead the design and development of secure, scalable systems while ensuring robust email authentication and protection. This role requires a strong technical leader who can drive innovation, mentor teams, and implement best practices for email security and cloud-native development. 

What You'll Do

- Architect and develop scalable, secure, and high-performance systems using AWS services (e. g. , Lambda, S3, API Gateway, RDS). 
 - Optimize cloud infrastructure for cost-efficiency, performance, and scalability. 
 - Implement CI/CD pipelines for seamless deployment and integration. 
 - Lead the development of backend systems using Java and frameworks like Spring Boot and Micronaut. Design and implement microservices architecture with RESTful APIs. 
 - Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, processes, and procedures. Ensure code quality through unit testing, code reviews, and adherence to best practices. 
 - Collaboration: Work closely with Product Management, Architecture, UX, other Developers and SDETs to implement new product features with high quality and on time. 
 - Database Management: Design and manage databases, ensuring efficient data storage, retrieval, and security. 
 - Mentorship: Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement. 
 - DevOps & Deployment: Participate in DevOps activities, including CI/CD pipeline setup, automated testing, and deployment processes. 

What You'll Bring

- Architecture experience at scale: Building and operating production systems, and engaging with product early in the cycle. Time as a Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, Product Architect, Staff Engineer, or equivalent. Comfortable owning architecture across multiple teams. 
 - Define and drive the technical strategy for the engineering team, ensuring alignment with business goals. Mentor and guide engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend their adoption to maintain a competitive edge. 
 - At Mimecast, we leverage the latest technologies, including the AI revolution. Expertise with AI tools (like Cursor, Claude) that enhance productivity is highly desired. 
 - Hands-on expertise in Java development, with a strong understanding and experience in building scalable backend systems. Experience in development of microservices using frameworks like Spring Boot, Micronaut, etc. 
 - Experience in CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, ensuring efficient delivery of high-quality software. 
 - Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation. 
 - Demonstrable ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment, mentoring junior team members and contributing to a positive team culture. 
 - Experience in troubleshooting and debugging of customer issues. 
 - Good to have experience in software security, security reviews and secure coding practices. 

Ideally You Should Have Experience/Expertise With

- Java development in a cloud-service or micro-service approach. 
 - Strong object-oriented programming skills following SOLID principles. 
 - Experience building REST/HTTP microservices in Spring/Spring Boot/Micronaut. 
 - Experience using and modifying Gradle based CI/CD pipelines, Terraform. 
 - Experience with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes). 
 - Experience in AWS, particularly DynamoDB, S3/CloudFront, ElastiCache/Redis, OpenSearch, ECS, EC2, load balancing and ASGs, CloudWatch. 
 - Experience building high volume, scalable, distributed backend services. 
 - Familiarity with SMTP, DNS, Domain and Email Security is a plus. 

What We Bring

Join us to accelerate your career while working with cutting-edge technologies and contributing to impactful projects for our customers. You will be immersed in a dynamic environment that recognizes and celebrates your achievements. Mimecast offers formal and, on the job, learning opportunities, maintains a comprehensive benefits package that helps our employees and their family members to sustain a healthy lifestyle, and importantly - working in cross functional teams to build your knowledge!

We believe in 'growth that's good, we have 'a culture that cares' and we are on a 'mission that matters'. 

Belonging at Mimecast

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That's why we're committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone - unless they're a cybercriminal, of course. 

We're proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we'd encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups. 

We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won't affect your application. 

Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law. 

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.

We are seeking an experienced Senior RF IC Test Development Engineer to lead Automated Test Equipment (ATE) hardware and software development for complex RF integrated circuits on the Teradyne UltraFLEX platform. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop robust test solutions, optimize test coverage and cost, drive characterization activities, and enhance manufacturing test efficiency and yield. 

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

- Lead ATE hardware and software development for complex RF IC products using the Teradyne UltraFLEX platform. 
 - Collaborate with design, product, validation, and manufacturing teams to develop comprehensive test plans that maximize test coverage while minimizing test cost. 
 - Lead RF IC characterization activities on ATE and analyze test results to ensure product quality and performance. 
 - Work closely with development teams to define Design-for-Test (DFT) requirements and implement effective test strategies. 
 - Develop innovative test methodologies and debug silicon-related issues during product development and production. 
 - Drive continuous improvements in test time reduction, multisite optimization, throughput enhancement, and yield improvement. 
 - Provide regular project updates and technical status reports to core team members and stakeholders. 
 - Support new product introduction (NPI) activities and production test readiness. 

Your profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience in semiconductor test development with a proven track record in RF IC test solutions. 
 - Strong expertise in Automated Test Equipment (ATE) development, including both hardware and software. 
 - Hands-on experience with the Teradyne UltraFLEX platform. 
 - Deep understanding of DFT methodologies, including MBIST, JTAG, SCAN, and IDDQ. 
 - Experience in silicon debug, failure analysis, and vector translation from standard formats to ATE environments. 
 - Strong knowledge of RF measurements, characterization, and production test optimization. 
 - Proven ability to drive yield enhancement, test cost reduction, and throughput/site-count optimization. 
 - Expertise in RF IC testing, characterization, and semiconductor product development. 
 - Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) and production test readiness. 
 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to develop robust, scalable, and high-quality test solutions for complex semiconductor products. 

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization. 

As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener. 

Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone. 

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.

data.title: Developer 3 ( AWS , Python , Linux )
data.description:
Job Description

At Arctic Wolf, we're not just navigating the cybersecurity landscape - we're redefining it. Our global team of dedicated Pack members is driving innovation and setting new industry standards every day. Our impact speaks for itself: we've earned recognition on the Forbes Cloud 100, CNBC Disruptor 50, 

Fortune Future 50, and Fortune Cyber 60 lists, and we recently took home the 2024 CRN Products of the Year award. We're proud to be named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape for Worldwide Managed Detection and Response Services and earning a Customers' Choice distinction from Gartner Peer Insights. Our Aurora Platform also received CRN's Products of the Year award in the inaugural Security Operations Platform category. Join a company that's not only leading, but also shaping, the future of security operations. 

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. 

We're looking for a Developer 3 to be part of making this happen. 

About The Role

You'll work on the software stack that runs inside Arctic Wolf's network sensors - physical appliances and

virtual sensors deployed across customer environments. The team owns everything from the on-sensor Go

services and Python tooling, to the AWS infrastructure that manages, monitors, and upgrades sensors at

scale. You'll write code that ships inside customer networks, runs 24/7 without human intervention, and

needs to be correct the first time. 

What You'll Do

- Build and maintain on-sensor Go and Python services - daemons, config managers, upgrade

pipelines, and tunneling infrastructure

- Own AWS infrastructure used for sensor management: ECS services, CloudFormation stacks, EC2

instances, S3 artifact pipelines, and CloudWatch observability

- Improve and extend the CI/CD platform: Jenkins pipelines, Docker build environments, Robot

Framework cell tests that spin up virtual sensors on AWS/Azure/VMware and validate end-to-end

behaviour

- Debug hard problems: kernel networking (eBPF/XDP, Suricata, iptables), multi-platform VM

orchestration, Ansible-based sensor provisioning, and production incidents traced through

CloudWatch Logs Insights

- Contribute to sensor upgrade and deployment automation (Ansible, Debian packaging, 

manifest-driven rollouts)

- Work across the full stack - from BPF maps pinned on a sensor's kernel to ECS services in AWS

serving REST APIs to the portal

What We're Looking For

- 3-5 years of professional software development experience
 - Strong AWS hands-on experience: EC2, ECS (Fargate + EC2 launch types), S3, CloudWatch (Logs, 

Metrics, Alarms), CloudFormation or CDK, IAM

- Proficiency in Python - writing production services, CLI tooling, and test automation (Robot

Framework or pytest)

- Comfort with Linux systems programming: systemd, networking (iptables, interfaces, routing), 

Debian packaging, shell scripting

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) and Docker-based build

environments

- Strong debugging skills - able to trace a production problem from a CloudWatch log through to a

root cause in code

Nice to Have

- Ansible for fleet configuration and provisioning
 - Networking depth: VLANs, SPAN/TAP modes, DHCP, tunneling protocols (FRP, WireGuard)
 - eBPF/XDP or kernel networking (Suricata, nmap, packet capture)
 - Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, or Azure for infrastructure testing
 - Familiarity with sensor/appliance software or embedded Linux

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2024), Best Places to Work - USA (2021-2024), Great Place to Work - Canada (2021-2024), 

Great Place to Work - UK (2024), and Kununu Top Company - Germany (2024). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7, 000 customers worldwide and more than 2, 000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry. 

Our Values

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that-by protecting people's and organizations' sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk- we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here. 

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 

All Wolves Receive Compelling Compensation And Benefits Packages, Including

Equity for all employees

Flexible time off and paid volunteer days

RRSP and 401k match

Training and career development programs

Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services

Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services

Fertility support and paid parental leave

On-Camera Policy

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews.

data.title: Deputy General Manager - BESS and C&I Engineering
data.description:
Key Responsibilities & Areas of Ownership

A. Technology Strategy & Product Architecture Strategic Focus: 

• Define multi-year technology roadmaps, platform architectures, and design principles across utility-scale enclosures and C&I cabinet systems. 

• Drive platform standardization and modularity across electrical, mechanical, and thermal subsystems to maximize reusability across active projects. 

• Formulate strategic design adaptation plans that align product architectures with regional manufacturing capabilities and supply chain ecosystems. 

B. Product Platform Development & Design Adaptation Strategic Focus: 

• Oversee the release and governance of comprehensive engineering packages, including General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Single Line Diagrams (SLD), Bills of Materials (BOM), structural layouts, and harness schematics. 

• Direct the design and evolution of C&I ESG cabinet platforms, ensuring rapid adaptability to customer requirements and regional site constraints. 

• Enforce strict Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) governance and Engineering Change Order/Request (ECO/ECR) workflows to ensure zero discrepancy between design and production. 

C. Supplier Industrialization & Technical Qualification Strategic Focus: 

• Drive formal technical evaluation and Design Qualification (DQ/IQ/OQ frameworks) for critical infrastructure, including battery racks, LV/MV distribution panels, HVAC/thermal units, Fire Suppression Systems (FSS), containers, and wiring harnesses. 

• Set engineering quality benchmarks, technical acceptance criteria, and defect-prevention standards across the supply base. 

• Provide technical engineering sign-off for dual-sourcing initiatives to guarantee part interchangeability, supply resilience, and regional content optimization. 

D. Manufacturing Enablement & System Integration Strategic Focus: 

• Lead multi-disciplinary integration across battery modules, Power Conversion Systems (PCS), thermal management, and master control architectures. 

• Oversee prototype builds, Design Validation Testing (DVT), and Process Validation Testing (PVT) to ensure production readiness. 

• Author and approve Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) protocols, Work Instructions (WI), and quality control checkpoints to maximize production yield. 

E. Regulatory Certification & Compliance Engineering Strategic Focus: 

• Guarantee total regulatory and safety compliance with global certification frameworks (including UL 9540, UL 9540A, IEC 62619, IEC 61439, NFPA 855) and regional grid codes (such as CEA requirements). 

• Direct technical representation during external certification audits, managing technical deviations and securing sub-assembly test approvals. 

• Enforce strict New Product Introduction (NPI) gate governance, archiving validation dossiers prior to commercial product release. 

F. Value Engineering & Economics Optimization Strategic Focus: 

• Lead structured Value Analysis and Value Engineering (VAVE) initiatives to optimize structural, electrical, and thermal subsystem costs without compromising performance or safety factors. 

• Analyze field performance and warranty data to proactively re-engineer components, eliminate design-related field failures, and improve long-term system reliability. 

• Collaborate with executive leadership to track total product cost targets and implement continuous design improvements. 

Candidate Requirements & Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's / Master's / Ph. D. in Electrical, Electronics, Power Electronics, or Energy Systems Engineering. 

• Professional Experience: 15 to 20+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), C&I Energy Storage, Solar Inverters, Power Electronics, or EV Infrastructure. 

• Executive Leadership: Proven track record of heading multi-disciplinary engineering organizations (electrical, mechanical, thermal, control integration, compliance, and NPI teams). 

• Deep System Architecture: Comprehensive mastery of BESS subsystem architecture-including racks, enclosures, liquid/air HVAC, Fire Suppression Systems (FSS), high-voltage distribution, PCS integration, and BMS communication. 

• Regulatory & Certification Expertise: Demonstrated success governing product compliance against UL 9540, UL 9540A, IEC 62619, IEC 61439, IEC 61000, NFPA 855, and regional grid connection codes. 

• Engineering Governance & Tools: Strong proficiency in CAD modeling oversight, FEA/CFD thermal analysis, Single Line Diagrams (SLD), GA drawings, BOM management, and PLM enterprise systems. 

• Process & Operational Excellence: Solid background in Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), DVT/PVT prototype validation, FMEA, VAVE, and supplier qualification frameworks.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Full Stack
data.description:
Description

Articore runs Redbubble, TeePublic, Dashery, and Frankly Wearing, some of the largest creator marketplaces in the world. 

You'll lead one or more of Articore's dedicated Tiger Team's in India. Those are small, high-leverage teams that go after Engineering's most urgent strategic and tactical cross-cutting initiatives across our four marketplaces. Rather than owning a single product roadmap, you'll pick up whatever the business's highest-priority initiative is at a given time, execute it fast, then move to the next. 

You'll work closely with the SVP and Director of Engineering and peers across the wider engineering organization to keep delivery moving, and play an active role in shaping the culture, ways of working, and day-to-day effectiveness of the team. This is a lead-from-the-front role, dropping into unfamiliar systems, shipping alongside your engineers, and handing things off cleanly when the initiative ends. We expect thisteam to build AI-first. Agentic coding tools, AI-assisted review, and AI in the product itself are default parts of how work gets done

Leading an engineering function, you will make an impact across three main areas of Delivery, People, and Technology. 

Delivery

- Lead delivery for the team while contributing hands-on: setting direction, unblocking, and managing dependencies to land product and technical objectives
 - Absorb and re-scope quickly when the team's priority target changes. Tiger teams follow the business's most urgent need, not a fixed backlog
 - Own sprint discipline end to end: a groomed, ready backlog, work sized and scoped before it's committed, a consistent cadence, and throughput the team and its stakeholders can plan against
 - Partner with engineering leadership and adjacent teams to align roadmaps, distribute workstreams effectively, enable knowledge transfer, and land cross-team initiatives
 - Run delivery across time zones: design workstreams, handoffs, and written communication so the team stays effective against partner teams and stakeholders in Melbourne and New York, decisions and context are captured in writing rather than lost in a call, and neither side sits blocked waiting
 - Agree scope, definition of done, and handoff terms with the team that owns the domain before work starts, coordinating closely with the domain PM
 - Evolve team processes and reporting to make delivery reliable and predictable as the team scales
 - Build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement - clear expectations, visible progress, and steady gains in delivery outcomes

People

- Own performance, development, and feedback for the engineers on your team - including reviews, growth plans, and career conversations
 - Coach through the work - pairing, design review, and code review are your primary teaching tools
 - Provide regular, actionable feedback tied to OKRs and individual growth goals
 - Calibrate with engineering leadership and counterparts in other teams to ensure consistent standards, expectations, and growth opportunities
 - Build and sustain a healthy team dynamic - clear expectations, psychological safety, and strong engagement inside and outside the team

Technology

- Steward your domain's architecture and technical direction, ensuring solutions meet business objectives and align with our Engineering Principles, Tech Radar, and architecture standards
 - Establishes patterns and guidelines for an AI-first team: Agentic coding tools, AI-assisted review, and AI in the product itself. 
 - Champion responsible operational ownership of your team's systems - fit-for-purpose support, observability, and reliability for the demands each system faces
 - Continuously assess team capabilities against the technical demands of the roadmap, and close gaps through hiring, training, or rotation

Requirements

- 7+ years of experience managing engineering teams, ideally in consumer or marketplace settings
 - Deep experience building web applications with Ruby, Ruby on Rails, and PostgreSQL.

data.title: Principal Engineer
data.description:
The role

This is a new role, and there is exactly one of it. You sit next to the CTO - not under a layer of managers - and your roadmap is whatever is currently hardest, riskiest, or most ambiguous in a ~60-engineer organization. 

One week that means reading a CERT-In kernel advisory in the morning and having a remediation rolling across EKS and Docker Swarm fleets by evening. Another week it means settling a whiteboard argument about sender-constrained tokens by shipping a working OpenResty/Lua prototype. You are the person the CTO trusts to walk into any codebase, any incident, any vendor pitch, or any client security review and come back with the truth and a plan. 

There are no direct reports, by design. Influence here is earned through working code, sharp writing, and judgment - not headcount. 

What you'll actually do

• Parachute engineering. Take the gnarliest cross-team problems - performance cliffs, data-integrity scares, migration landmines, one-tenant-only prod mysteries - and drive them to root cause and closure, hands on keyboard. 

• Zero-to-one prototypes. Turn the CTO's "what if" into a working spike in days, not quarters: internal platforms, security primitives, AI-powered workflows. Some get killed. That's the point. 

• Technical due diligence. Run build-vs-buy and vendor/OSS evaluations (PAM tooling, observability, AI platforms, databases) and write the decision memo that survives both engineering scrutiny and an auditor. 

• Security and compliance engineering. Threat-model features before they ship, respond to CVEs and advisories across the fleet, and design controls that satisfy RBI and SOC 2 auditors without strangling developer velocity. 

• AI leverage. Push our agentic-coding rollout, LLM MR-review pipelines, and self-hosted model experiments further. Measure honestly. Kill what doesn't earn its cost. 

• Architecture pressure-testing. Review designs for multi-tenancy, session and token security, BFF-layer hardening, and PostgreSQL at scale (Patroni, PgBouncer, replication and lock behavior) before problems become incidents. 

• Stand in for the CTO. Client security reviews, incident bridges, internal design debates - when he can't be in the room, you are the room. 

You must have

• Principal-grade depth - typically 8+ years shipping and operating production systems, with the scar tissue to prove it. 

• Genuine polyglot fluency. Production work in at least four of: PHP (Laravel), TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Lua. You pick up a new language over a weekend and it shows in code review on Monday. 

• Deep Linux and infrastructure chops. Kubernetes (EKS) and container internals, Docker Swarm realities, HAProxy/OpenResty, Cloudflare Zero Trust, and the ability to debug from strace all the way up to Grafana dashboards. 

• PostgreSQL beyond CRUD. Replication topologies, connection pooling behavior, lock contention, and what actually happens under load. 

• A security instinct. OWASP is table stakes. You can reason about mTLS, token binding, IDOR/BOLA, key custody, and - crucially - what an RBI or SOC 2 auditor will ask about your design. 

• An AI-native workflow. You already use agentic coding tools daily, know precisely where they break, and can teach others to get leverage without losing rigor. 

• Sharp technical writing. RFCs, decision memos, postmortems. Half this job is making hard decisions legible to engineers, auditors, and the board. 

• Ownership under ambiguity. You can be handed a question, not a ticket, and return with the answer, the fix, and the prevention. 

Nice to have

• BFSI or fintech domain depth: loan origination, credit underwriting flows, payments, or core banking integrations. 

• Fleet-scale CI/CD on self-hosted GitLab; supply-chain security (SBOMs, dependency tracking, CERT-In reporting). 

• Hands-on experience self-hosting LLMs or building evaluation harnesses for AI in production. • Open-source contributions anywhere in our stack.

data.title: Software Engineering PMTS - Cloud Security
data.description:
Description

Come join our growing Hyperforce Enterprise Security organization. We are chartered with architecting, implementing, and operating security solutions that protect Salesforce's complex, multi-cloud technology landscape at scale. 

As a Principal Member of Technical Staff, you will provide technical leadership in building the next generation of infrastructure security and developer security guardrails. You will work across the software development and deployment lifecycle to identify security risks early, build scalable controls, and enable secure-by-default engineering practices without compromising developer velocity. 

Our team operates at the intersection of cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and runtime security. We build and operate security guardrails that identify and prevent high-risk security issues from source code and Infrastructure as Code through CI/CD and into runtime environments. 

You will be expected to operate at both strategic and hands-on technical levels, defining architecture and technical direction while also diving deeply into complex engineering problems, writing production-quality code, and driving solutions from concept through deployment and operation. 

This role is an opportunity to shape security capabilities that operate at significant scale across Salesforce infrastructure and to influence how security is embedded throughout the engineering lifecycle. 

Responsibilities

- Act as a technical leader and subject matter expert for infrastructure security and security guardrails, providing architectural direction across teams. 
 - Design and build scalable shift-left security capabilities that identify security risks in source code, Infrastructure as Code, containerized workloads, and deployment configurations before they reach production. 
 - Architect and build shift-left security controls that identify security risks early while providing developers with actionable findings and straightforward remediation paths. 
 - Design scalable policy-as-code and security enforcement frameworks for consistent security controls across multiple gates and environments. 
 - Drive risk-based security engineering by identifying exploitable, high-impact, and meaningful security risks rather than treating all scanner findings equally. 
 - Design mechanisms for security finding correlation, prioritization, deduplication, and enforcement when signals originate from multiple security systems. 
 - Lead architecture and implementation of Kubernetes admission control and workload security capabilities. 
 - Define technical strategies for reliability, scalability, performance, observability, fault tolerance, and operational readiness of security services. 
 - Establish and evolve SLIs, SLOs, telemetry, rollout strategies, and operational practices for critical security services. 
 - Own technical outcomes across the complete lifecycle - requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production readiness, rollout, and ongoing operations. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve security coverage, automation, detection quality, enforcement, and developer experience. 
 - Establish engineering standards and best practices for reliability, scalability, observability, testing, and operational readiness of security services. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization. 
 - Influence technical strategy and roadmap decisions across teams and drive initiatives from concept through production. 
 - Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code. 
 - Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale. 
 - Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably. 
 - Critically evaluate code (human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, security engineering with significant experience designing and delivering large-scale production systems. 
 - Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, or Python, with the ability to design, implement, debug, and review production-quality systems. 
 - Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud security, including experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure. 
 - Strong understanding of CI/CD architecture and DevSecOps, including deployment pipelines, security gates, policy enforcement, and automation. 
 - Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience designing distributed, highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems. 
 - Strong understanding of security engineering concepts including vulnerability management, configuration security, policy enforcement, workload security, identity/access controls, and risk assessment. 
 - Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous security problems, identify the core technical challenge, and drive an architecture and implementation to completion. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architectures and trade-offs to senior technical and business audiences. 
 - Preferred Qualifications
 - Deep experience in cloud-native security, DevSecOps, infrastructure security, or application security. 
 - Experience building security platforms/services or guardrails that operate at large enterprise scale. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes Admission Controllers, admission policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or similar policy enforcement technologies. 
 - Experience with policy-as-code and security-as-code frameworks. 
 - Experience with IaC security and tools such as Checkov, OPA, Terraform security scanning, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of container and workload security, including Seccomp, Linux security mechanisms, container isolation, and runtime security. 
 - Experience building systems that correlate security signals from multiple sources and prioritize findings based on risk, exploitability, exposure, and business impact. 
 - Experience with vulnerability management, cloud security posture management, container security, or automated security remediation. 
 - Experience designing developer-facing security products with a strong focus on actionable findings, low friction remediation, and developer experience. 
 - Experience designing security controls across the complete lifecycle: source → IaC → CI/CD → deployment → admission → runtime. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, workload architecture, and distributed systems.

data.description:
Description

Articore runs Redbubble, TeePublic, Dashery, and Frankly Wearing, several of the largest creator marketplaces in the world - Redbubble's catalog alone exceeds 40 billion SKUs. As a Software Engineer here, you'll design, implement, and maintain the systems that power both marketplaces, working closely with your engineering manager, tech lead, and product partners to ship work that matters across your domain. 

The Artist team owns the artist-facing experience across Redbubble and TeePublic - from onboarding and the upload flow through to the artist site, self-serve tools, communications, and the tax and royalty systems that keep artists paid and compliant. The team works across a Ruby on Rails codebase with a React/TypeScript layer for richer interactions. Day-to-day, the team balances feature delivery with a steady stream of BAU and compliance work (e. g. tax reporting, regulatory changes), in close partnership with Product, Legal, and the artist community itself. 

Core Responsibilities

- Feature development and platform integration: Design, code, test, and deploy software across the team's systems. Lead small to medium-sized initiatives that solve complex problems at scale, in line with Articore's Engineering Principles and architecture standards. 
 - BAU maintenance and system health: Maintain and uplift existing services, manage tech debt responsibly, and ensure systems are well monitored with up-to-date documentation, under the guidance of the Tech Lead. 
 - Delivery collaboration and technical leadership: Participate in discussions on technical approach and feasibility, collaborate with team leads on discovery and scoping, translate business requirements into technical spikes and deliverables, and participate in team ceremonies including standups, planning, retrospectives, and showcases. 
 - Coaching and people development: Coach and support less experienced engineers in technical development, good engineering practices, and Articore values. 
 - Innovation and roadmap input: Learn new tools, techniques, and technologies to shape opportunities for the business, and provide input into the team's technology roadmap to enable sustainable delivery against company objectives. 

Requirements

- 5-7+ years backend engineering experience, with proficiency in Ruby and/or Go
 - Strong Ruby on Rails experience, including server-rendered views with ERB in a production codebase
 - Solid React and TypeScript skills, with experience building and maintaining component-driven front-end applications
 - Comfortable working across the full front-end stack - from Rails controllers and ERB templates through to modern React components - and choosing the right tool for the job
 - Nice to have: experience working with Stimulus. js, Turbo, and Ruby View Components
 - Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and analytics instrumentation (e. g. Amplitude, RudderStack) in a product experimentation context
 - Experience working with microservices and/or monolith architectures. The team owns a mix of standalone services and a monolith, and is actively migrating components between them, so comfort operating across both patterns is valuable. 
 - Experience using AI tooling in your day-to-day workflow, and curiosity about applying it more deeply. 
 - Demonstrated effectiveness operating in a global company, with the communication, discipline, and async judgment required to keep work moving across time zones. 
 - Curiosity and willingness to explore - the team owns a broad surface area of services across two marketplaces. The right person is energised by digging into systems they haven't seen before rather than deterred by it. 
 - Ability to work independently on features end-to-end with the team's support, from technical spike and scoping through to deployment. 
 - Solid testing and code quality practices, with the ability to uphold engineering standards and contribute to documentation and system health under the guidance of the Tech Lead. 
 - Collaborative and inclusive - engages well across disciplines, gives and receives feedback openly, pairs willingly, and takes real interest in helping less experienced engineers grow.

Continuous Improvement & Standardization

 - Supports quality reviews and continuous refinement of engineering processes. 

Job Requirements

To succeed, you will need

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical or Instrumentation Engineering. 

- Min. 10 years of relevant industry experience in electrical and instrumentation engineering, preferably within compressor or process package projects.

Technical & Digital Skills

Required

Leadership Competencies

Cultural Behaviours (How the Role Creates Value)

Hybrid working model with a combination of remote work and on‐site presence in Vadodara office, India. 

Diverse by nature and inclusive by choice

Bright ideas come from all of us. The more unique perspectives we embrace, the more innovative we are. Together we build a culture where difference is valued and we share a deep sense of purpose and belonging.
