Job Description: SIT Automation Engineer - MyWorldPanel

This role is responsible for supporting the quality assurance of the MyWorldPanel platform through automation, functional validation, and collaboration with cross-functional delivery teams. The position is suited to a candidate with strong testing fundamentals, practical automation experience, and the ability to work effectively in an Agile delivery environment. 

Core Technology Stack

Key technologies and tools relevant to this role include Azure DevOps, Selenium, Java, API testing, basic database validation, CI/CD pipelines, and Microsoft Copilot. 

Role Overview

The SIT Automation Engineer will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and stability of the MyWorldPanel platform during ongoing delivery and migration activities. The role is responsible for designing, maintaining, and executing automated tests, while also supporting manual and exploratory testing where required. Working closely with developers, analysts, and quality assurance colleagues, the successful candidate will help deliver high-quality releases in a fast-paced Agile environment. 

The role also requires a basic level of AI literacy, including the ability to use tools such as Microsoft Copilot or similar solutions to support productivity in testing activities. Candidates should be comfortable using clear prompts, interpreting AI-generated outputs, and validating results to ensure accuracy and relevance to business requirements. 

Project Context

MyWorldPanel is a global consumer panel research platform that captures and analyses shopping behavior data to generate actionable business insights. Given its scale, complexity, and multi-region usage, robust quality assurance is essential to ensure reliable system performance and accurate data delivery.

data.title: QA Engineer 2 - DPP
data.description:
We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

QA Engineer - DPP

Role Overview

We are looking for a QA Engineer to support the quality, reliability, and integrity of DPP deliverables across data ingestion, transformation, APIs, and downstream reporting. The successful candidate will review requirements and acceptance criteria, design and execute manual and automated tests, validate end-to-end data flows and business rules, and work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify defects early, reduce delivery risk, and support high-quality releases. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Planning & Design

Review requirements, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation to create clear, traceable test scenarios and test cases for each User Story. 

Review test coverage with relevant stakeholders and maintain the regression suite to ensure ongoing support for business-critical DPP functionality. 

Test Execution & Defect Management

Execute manual and automated tests to validate new features, regression scenarios, and data transformations across the DPP platform. 

Record defects and data issues with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, and impact assessment to enable efficient triage and resolution. 

Work closely with Engineering and Data teams to support root-cause analysis, validate fixes, and confirm production readiness. 

Validation & Closure

Retest resolved defects and confirm that acceptance criteria, business rules, and quality expectations have been met before closure. 

Maintain accurate defect reporting, status tracking, and quality documentation to support transparent delivery decisions. 

Data Integrity & ETL Validation

Validate the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of extracted, transformed, and loaded data across the DPP platform. 

Confirm that processed data aligns with business rules, acceptance criteria, and reporting expectations. 

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve QA processes, tooling, and automation to increase efficiency and test effectiveness. 

Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous learning within the wider QA and delivery teams. 

Technical Skills & Tools

Mandatory Tools: 

Azure DevOps (Test Management & Release Support): Plan and execute DPP test cycles, manage test evidence and defects, support release readiness, and contribute to quality sign-off across delivery pipelines. 

Azure DevOps (Defect Tracking & Traceability): Log, triage, and track defects and data issues, maintain traceability to User Stories, data changes, and releases, and work with Engineering and Data teams on root-cause analysis and fix validation. 

SQL (Data Validation): Write and execute queries to validate data transformations, reconciliations, referential integrity, and data quality rules across staging and curated layers. 

Postman & Swagger (API Testing): Validate API contracts, schemas, authentication and authorization, error handling, and payload accuracy using Swagger/OpenAPI specifications; create and maintain collections for smoke and regression testing. 

Databricks & Azure Data Factory: Support validation of transformation logic, pipeline outcomes, and orchestration processes. Databricks is the primary platform used in DPP, while Azure Data Factory knowledge remains valuable as an additional skill aligned to broader ETL requirements. 

Programming & Frameworks: 

Python or Java: Experience using one or both languages for test automation, API checks, and data validation scripting. 

PyTest / Robot Framework / Contract Testing / Automated Data Checks: Familiarity with test frameworks and data-quality tooling to support DPP regression coverage and ongoing monitoring. 

KPIs & Success Metrics

Test Execution Delivery: Complete planned DPP test execution within agreed sprint timelines, with clear evidence and status visibility. 

Defect Detection Rate: Identify and log at least 90% of critical defects (data quality issues, pipeline failures, and API contract breaks) before release. 

Defect Turnaround Time: All defects are triaged, prioritized, and assigned within 24 hours of discovery. 

Coverage & Traceability: Maintain end-to-end coverage of User Stories, acceptance criteria, core business rules, and key data scenarios, with clear traceability across testing and release activity. 

Data Quality & Integrity: Ensure validated datasets meet transformation rules, reconciliation checks, and agreed quality tolerances for the DPP platform. 

Status Reporting: Provide weekly QA status updates covering test progress, defect trends, data quality outcomes, pipeline/API risks, and release readiness. 

Continuous Improvement: Propose at least one process or tooling improvement per quarter (e. g. , automation, data-quality checks, or pipeline monitoring) to strengthen DPP quality. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Candidate Profile

- Proven experience in QA or software testing within data-driven platforms, ideally involving ETL processes, APIs, and reporting or analytics solutions. 
 - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues across data, APIs, and application behavior. 
 - Strong SQL knowledge is essential, including the ability to write and execute queries for data validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to work effectively across Product, Engineering, and Data teams. 
 - High attention to detail and a strong commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality outcomes. 

Nice-to-have Skills

- Experience testing modern data platforms, data pipelines, or cloud-based analytics solutions. 
 - Exposure to automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, or quality gates within engineering workflows. 
 - Understanding of API standards, data contracts, and integration testing practices. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery environments with cross-functional product and engineering teams.

Talents Needed For Success

We're reinventing the market research industry. Let's reinvent it together. 

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow's success starts with today's market intelligence. We empower the world's leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. 

Senior QA Test Engineer - Shop & Scan (Automation & AI-Enabled)

Overview

Role Purpose

Ensure high-quality delivery of the Shop & Scan platform by designing, automating, and executing robust test

scenarios across the full product lifecycle. This role combines functional validation, automation engineering, 

and AI-assisted testing practices to maximise regression coverage, accelerate feedback cycles, and improve

release confidence. 

Project Context

Shop & Scan is a consumer research platform where household members scan purchases through a mobile

application, generating valuable behavioural insights. The QA role is critical to ensuring seamless end-to-end

user journeys, accurate reward processing, and secure, reliable platform behaviour. 

Role Scope

This role acts as the primary QA owner for Shop & Scan, defining and driving the quality approach across

functional, automated, and AI-assisted testing practices. The scope extends beyond execution to include test

strategy, automation framework maturity, regression optimisation, defect prevention, release readiness, and

continuous improvement. In a lean Agile environment, the role requires strong autonomy, sound judgement, 

and close collaboration with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure quality is embedded

early in the delivery lifecycle. 

Testing Process

- Quality Planning & Test Design

The role analyses User Stories and technical requirements, challenges ambiguity early, and ensures clear, 

testable acceptance criteria are in place for each delivery item. 

Comprehensive test scenarios are designed across functional, negative, and edge-case coverage, with

appropriate preconditions, test data, and reusable test assets to support efficient execution. 

The role maintains and evolves the regression test suite in line with product priorities, ensuring traceability

between requirements, coverage, defects, and release outcomes. 

- Automation Strategy & Framework Ownership

The role is responsible for developing and maintaining automated test coverage for regression testing, critical

business flows, and API validations. Automation must remain maintainable, scalable, and aligned with sprint

delivery, with a continuous focus on improving coverage, execution efficiency, and release of confidence. 

- Test Execution, Defect Management & Release Support

The role oversees execution of planned testing across automated, manual, exploratory, sanity, and release

validation activities, ensuring risks, blockers, and quality concerns are surfaced promptly and managed

proactively. Defects are logged with clear and structured evidence, including reproducibility detail, expected versus actual

behaviour, business impact, and severity assessment to support efficient triage and resolution. 

- Clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence
 - Actual versus expected results and impact on users or business flows

The role works closely with developers and stakeholders through defect triage, prioritisation, retesting, and

release readiness assessments to support informed go/no-go decisions. 

- AI-Enabled Testing Practices

The role leverages AI tools to support test case generation from requirements, optimise regression test

selection, identify coverage gaps, and improve exploratory testing efficiency. It also contributes to the

adoption of practical AI-driven QA approaches across the team where they add measurable value. 

- Validation, Quality Sign-off & Continuous Improvement

Following defect resolution or delivery completion, the role validates outcomes across impacted areas and

ensures fixes meet the agreed quality standard before closure. 

The role also identifies process, tooling, and coverage improvements to strengthen QA maturity over time

and improve overall delivery quality. 

QA Responsibilities: 

- Own the end-to-end QA approach for Shop & Scan, ensuring test coverage is aligned to business

priorities, delivery risks, and release objectives. 

- Drive automation adoption and framework improvement to increase regression efficiency, 

repeatability, and release confidence. 

- Collaborate with product owners, developers, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, 

shape quality standards, and embed QA early in the delivery lifecycle. 

- Provide quality visibility through clear reporting on risks, defects, test progress, and release

readiness. 

- Champion best practice in test design, defect management, AI-enabled testing, and continuous

improvement to support a high-quality, scalable product. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Required Qualifications: 

- Typically 4+ years of experience in software QA across functional testing, regression testing, and release validation activities. 
 - Hands-on experience with test automation using at least one modern framework such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress. 
 - Experience working within Agile delivery teams and collaborating effectively with developers, product owners, business analysts, and business stakeholders. 
 - Strong defect management, analytical, communication, and prioritisation skills. Good understanding of API testing, web and mobile application testing, and quality assurance best practices. 

Candidate Profile: 

- The successful candidate will bring a blend of strong QA fundamentals, automation capability, and modern testing awareness, with the confidence to operate independently and influence quality outcomes across the product lifecycle. 
 - Core QA Skills: Strong experience in functional testing and regression testing, test design, defect management, and working within Agile or Scrum delivery environments. 
 - Automation Skills (Mandatory): Hands-on experience with at least one modern automation framework such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress, with the ability to design, maintain, and evolve automated test suites for critical business journeys. 
 - API & Technical Testing: Experience with API validation tools such as Postman or Newman, plus working knowledge of SQL for data validation and debugging tools or logs for issue investigation. 
 - AI & Modern Testing (Preferred): Awareness of AI-assisted QA tooling and a practical interest in using AI for test generation, coverage optimisation, and smarter exploratory testing practices. 
 - Tools & Delivery: Practical experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, and familiarity with integrating test automation into CI/CD-oriented delivery processes. 
 - Product & Domain Understanding: Good understanding of web and mobile application testing fundamentals, ideally within consumer-facing applications or data-driven platforms. 
 - Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, ownership mindset, and clear communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Additional Advantage: Exposure to performance testing concepts, experience with consumer-facing or data-led platforms, and familiarity with distributed delivery teams across Europe and India. 
 - This profile is suited to a hands-on QA professional who can balance day-to-day delivery support with continuous improvement, automation advancement, and strong stakeholder engagement.

data.description:
Lead Full Stack Developer - AI-Forward Development (. NET & Angular)

Saisystems Health is hiring a Lead Full Stack Developer with 9+ years of . NET and Angular experience, a US healthcare background and a track record of AI-forward engineering to lead technical delivery on ECM, our enterprise claims management platform. 

About the role

The Lead owns technical direction and delivery quality for an ECM squad: setting architecture and coding standards, reviewing critical changes, mentoring developers, and still shipping hands-on code across Angular, . NET and T-SQL. Roughly half the role is hands-on engineering; the rest is design, review, planning and people leadership. 

The product. ECM manages the full claim lifecycle for US healthcare provider organisations: patient and encounter capture, coding and charge entry, eligibility, a configurable business-rules engine, clearinghouse claim transmission, ERA/835 payment posting, denial and AR work queues, patient statements, credentialing and executive reporting. 

The engineering problem. ECM is a mature, high-volume, multi-tenant SaaS platform with tens of millions of claim and transaction rows, external BI consumers on the same database, and scheduled automation alongside the API. The Lead decides how new features and modernisation - performance, observability, test coverage, security hardening and debt reduction - are sequenced in a system that cannot stop running. 

Why AI-forward. The Lead sets how the team uses AI: which tools and workflows are approved, how AI-assisted code is reviewed, and where AI measurably improves throughput and quality - while keeping PHI and secrets out of external tools. 

Key responsibilities

Technical leadership and architecture

- Own the technical design of features and modernisation work across Angular, ASP. NET Core and Azure SQL; write design notes and lead design reviews. 
 - Define and enforce coding standards, layering (controller → interface → service → stored procedure), API contracts and Angular/NgRx patterns. 
 - Lead decomposition of oversized services and components, and plan incremental refactoring without disrupting production. 
 - Drive database performance: indexing strategy, execution-plan analysis, Query Store regressions and locking against concurrent BI reads. 
 - Shape the architecture of healthcare integrations - X12 EDI (837, 835, 277CA, 999), clearinghouse SFTP, ERA auto-posting and payer interfaces. 

AI-forward engineering leadership

- Set the team's AI development practice: approved tools, prompting and context-management techniques, and agentic workflows for multi-file changes, test generation and migration. 
 - Define review standards for AI-assisted code, with added scrutiny for stored procedures, EDI processing and production data paths. 
 - Identify, prototype and measure AI use cases in the workflow and the product (for example, test-case design, code review assistance, denial analysis or document extraction) within approved, HIPAA-compliant tooling. 
 - Coach developers on effective, verified AI use and share reusable prompts and playbooks across teams. 

Delivery and quality

- Break down epics into estimable work with the Development Manager and product owners; own sprint technical commitments. 
 - Review pull requests on critical paths and run pre-merge impact assessment across develop → QA → UAT → staging → production. 
 - Raise unit and integration test coverage (xUnit, Moq, Jasmine/Karma) and partner with QA on regression strategy. 
 - Lead diagnosis of production incidents using Application Insights, logs and Query Store; run root-cause reviews and track fixes. 
 - Maintain a prioritised technical-debt backlog and balance it against feature delivery. 

People and collaboration

- Mentor and grow developers through pairing, code review and design feedback; contribute to hiring and onboarding. 
 - Act as the technical point of contact for US-based product and business stakeholders, translating requirements into clear designs and realistic estimates. 
 - Communicate status, risks and trade-offs clearly in writing for asynchronous, cross-time-zone work. 

Security and compliance

- Ensure HIPAA and secure-by-default practices are designed in: minimum-necessary data access, audit logging, secrets in Key Vault, least-privilege access and no PHI in logs, tickets or AI tools. 
 - Review designs for audit, access-control and data-retention requirements. 

Required qualifications

Experience

- 9+ years of professional software development, with deep full stack experience in . NET and Angular on production systems. 
 - 3+ years in a technical lead, tech lead or senior-lead role - owning design, code review and delivery for a team of developers. 
 - 3+ years working on US healthcare software - revenue cycle management, medical billing, claims, practice management, EHR or payer systems. 

. NET, database and architecture

- Expert C# and ASP. NET Core Web API (. NET 6 or later), with EF Core and/or Dapper; strong grasp of layered architecture, SOLID and dependency injection. 
 - Advanced SQL Server / T-SQL: designing schemas and indexes, tuning complex stored procedures, reading execution plans and resolving locking and blocking at scale. 
 - Proven experience refactoring and modernising a large, live codebase incrementally. 

Angular

- Expert Angular (12+) with TypeScript, RxJS and NgRx or another Redux-style store; able to set front-end architecture and standards for a team. 

AI-forward engineering

- Demonstrated daily use of AI development platforms - Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT / Codex, Cursor or similar - including agentic workflows on a large codebase. 
 - Experience introducing or standardising AI tooling for a team, with clear review and verification practices. 
 - Can show examples of measurable gains (throughput, test coverage, defect reduction) from AI-assisted work, and of catching flawed AI output. 

Healthcare domain

- Strong knowledge of the claim lifecycle: charge entry, claim submission, adjudication, remittance, denials and AR follow-up. 
 - Hands-on experience with HIPAA X12 transactions (837, 835, 277CA, 999) and CMS-1500 / UB-04 claim formats. 
 - Working understanding of the HIPAA Priv

Leadership and practice

- Git, pull-request workflow and CI/CD on Azure DevOps or similar; experience defining branching and release processes. 
 - Track record of mentoring developers and leading design and code reviews. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication with US-based stakeholders. 
 - Willing to work from the Pune office full time. 

Preferred qualifications

- Experience integrating LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI) into . NET applications - prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured output, evaluation and cost control - within HIPAA-compliant boundaries. 
 - Experience shipping AI features in RCM, such as denial prediction, coding assistance, document extraction or claim scrubbing. 
 - Deep Microsoft Azure experience: App Service, WebJobs, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, Redis, Application Insights, Entra ID; infrastructure-as-code (Bicep or Terraform). 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, message-driven design and background-job orchestration. 
 - EDI tooling such as EdiFabric; clearinghouse onboarding and payer connectivity. 
 - Observability practice: structured logging (Serilog), distributed tracing, SLOs and alerting. 
 - Reporting or BI exposure (Power BI, SSRS) and designing for concurrent BI workloads. 
 - Certifications (any of): Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), or healthcare coursework such as AAPC or HFMA. 

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field - or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. What you have built, shipped and led counts more than the credential. 

Core competencies and success measures

Leadership competencies

- Technical judgement - makes sound trade-offs between speed, quality and risk in a live, regulated system. 
 - Evidence over assertion - backs decisions on performance and impact with measurements. 
 - Production respect - weighs every change for its effect on live claims, payments and data. 
 - Multiplier mindset - raises the team's output through mentoring, standards and shared AI practice, not just personal output. 
 - Clear written communication - design notes, status and risk updates that work across time zones. 

Compliance, security and responsible AI use

- ECM processes Protected Health Information (PHI). All engineers complete HIPAA training and are bound by Saisystems Health security and confidentiality policies. 
 - The Lead is accountable for the team following these rules and for raising compliance risks early. 
 - No PHI, patient data, credentials, production connection strings or confidential business data is ever entered into an external or unapproved AI tool. 
 - AI is an accelerator, not a substitute for engineering judgement; accountability for correctness stays with the engineer and the reviewing Lead. 
 - AI-generated code is reviewed to the same standard as hand-written code, with added scrutiny for stored procedures, EDI processing and production data paths. 
 - Secure-by-default habits: no PHI in logs, tickets, screenshots or non-production data; least-privilege access; secrets in Key Vault, never in source. 
 - Employment is subject to a background check and a signed confidentiality agreement. 

Equal opportunity: Saisystems Health is an equal opportunity employer. HR to confirm the standard EEO statement and any compensation or benefits wording before posting.

As an Senior Java Engineer/Tech Lead you will work on building high-performance, scalable backend systems that power mission-critical enterprise and SaaS applications. First level manager who owns a specific module within the Kapture suite of products, ensuring system stability and delivering as per business requirements, including engaging with clients and other internal teams as required

• You are skilled at writing clean, testable, and maintainable code • You can clearly articulate your technical ideas and design decisions

You will have an advantage if you:

Why should you be interested?

Here's what you will gain from this role: 

• The opportunity to work on large-scale, real-world SaaS products

• Exposure to global clients and complex enterprise use cases

• A collaborative environment with highly skilled engineers and architects

• Strong ownership, learning, and career growth opportunities

 - Track team productivity, utilization, quality and SLA performance. 
 - Conduct regular quality checks and review analytical deliverables before client submission. 
 - Identify delivery risks and proactively communicate them to stakeholders. 
 - Manage escalations and coordinate resolution of critical issues. 
 - Establish standard operating procedures, documentation and quality-control processes. 
 - Ensure business-critical reports and dashboards have appropriate validation and controls. 

7. Process Improvement & Automation

- Identify opportunities to improve existing analytics processes and workflows. 
 - Standardize recurring reports, dashboards and analytical processes. 
 - Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual effort and improve turnaround time. 
 - Quantify productivity and efficiency improvements resulting from automation. 
 - Develop reusable analytics frameworks, templates and reporting standards. 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring quality or delivery issues. 
 - Promote continuous improvement across the analytics function. 

8. Project & Resource Management

- Estimate effort and timelines for new analytics requirements. 
 - Support resource planning and capacity management across projects. 
 - Prioritize work based on client requirements, business impact and SLA commitments. 
 - Track project progress, dependencies, risks and deliverables. 
 - Manage scope and identify requirements that may require additional effort or change requests. 
 - Coordinate with internal teams such as Category Management, Platform Operations, Seller Operations, Ad Operations, Design and other functions when required.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Analytics & BI

Data & Automation

Client & Business Skills

 - Strong presentation and storytelling skills. 
 - Ability to communicate complex analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

Leadership

- Experience managing or mentoring an analytics/BI team.

Preferred Experience

data.title: Senior Director, MTS
data.description:
Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it's consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future. 

Job Description

Gracenote, the content data division of Nielsen, powers innovative entertainment experiences for leading media companies worldwide. Our advanced entertainment metadata and connected IDs enable seamless content navigation and discovery, helping consumers connect to the content they love and explore new favorites. With a global presence, Gracenote delivers both global and localized video, audio, automotive, and sports content solutions across the Americas, Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Some of the biggest names who trust Gracenote are Jio, Amazon, NBC, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Samsung, Sony, and more. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a visionary and results-driven Director of Engineering to lead our high-impact engineering organization at Gracenote. In this role, you will be responsible for defining technical strategy, building scalable architectures, driving platform modernization, and leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams (including Engineering Managers and technical leads). 

You will lead the evolution of next-generation metadata processing pipelines-integrating modern data platforms, automated web crawling, content curation, real-time metadata serving, and AI/Machine Learning solutions. You will collaborate closely with Product, Data Science, and Global Business leadership to ensure our technology directly powers market-leading media solutions. 

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Technical Vision

- Define Engineering Strategy: Drive long-term technical vision and architectural direction for Gracenote's core metadata, ingestion, and serving platforms. 
 - Platform Modernization: Lead initiatives to platformize metadata processing pipelines, transitioning legacy flows into modern, intelligent, high-performance distributed architectures. 
 - AI & Data Science Integration: Partner with Data Science and AI teams to integrate machine learning, NLP, computer vision, and GenAI capabilities into core operational processes, content ingestion, and data enrichment pipelines. 

Team Leadership & Organizational Excellence

- Scale High-Performing Teams: Lead, mentor, and build an engineering organization of Engineering Managers, Architects, and Software Engineers. 
 - Culture & Retention: Foster an inclusive culture based on Nielsen values-promoting innovation, continuous learning, technical rigor, and high associate retention. 
 - Talent Management: Oversee succession planning, performance management, career growth frameworks, and talent pipelines (including university relations and new joiner programs). 

Business & Stakeholder Alignment

- Product & Strategy Collaboration: Partner directly with Product Management, Data Science, and cross-functional executives to align engineering deliverables with key business metrics and strategic revenue drivers. 
 - Global Execution: Coordinate across local and global stakeholders to ensure seamless integration, high productivity, and successful delivery of high-visibility projects. 

Operational & Technical Execution

- System Scale & Reliability: Ensure overall system health by defining Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)-focusing on high availability, fault tolerance, low latency, recoverability, and scalability across global delivery APIs. 
 - Process Improvement & Automation: Drive agile methodologies and apply an automation-first mindset to software delivery, CI/CD, testing automation, and operational monitoring. 
 - Engineering Governance: Establish robust quality assurance standards, operational cadences, and continuous process optimization across the Product Development Lifecycle. 

Qualifications

Basic / Required Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 

Experience

- 13+ years of total software development and engineering experience, with a proven track record of designing scalable, high-performance systems. 
 - 5+ years of direct management experience, including managing managers, technical leads, and multi-disciplinary global engineering teams. 

System Architecture & Tech Stack

data.title: Full Stack Developer (.NET & Angular)
data.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer - AI-Forward Development (. NET & Angular)

Saisystems Health is hiring an AI-forward Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of . NET and Angular experience and a US healthcare background to build and modernise ECM, our enterprise claims management platform

About the role

This is a hands-on full stack role where AI-assisted engineering is part of the job, not an optional extra. You will own tickets end to end - from design conversation through testing to production support - using AI coding assistants and agents to deliver faster while holding the quality and compliance bar of a regulated healthcare product. 

The product. ECM manages the full claim lifecycle for US healthcare provider organisations: patient and encounter capture, coding and charge entry, eligibility, a configurable business-rules engine, clearinghouse claim transmission, ERA/835 payment posting, denial and AR work queues, patient statements, credentialing and executive reporting. 

The engineering problem. ECM is a mature, high-volume, multi-tenant SaaS platform with tens of millions of claim and transaction rows, external BI consumers on the same database, and scheduled automation running alongside the API. The work mixes new feature delivery with deliberate modernisation - performance, observability, test coverage, security hardening and technical-debt reduction - in a system that cannot stop running. 

Why AI-forward. We use AI across the engineering lifecycle and want engineers who already work this way: using agents and assistants to understand a large codebase, scaffold and refactor code, generate tests, review SQL and document changes - and who can explain every line they commit. 

Key responsibilities

Front end (Angular)

- Build and enhance Angular screens - data grids, forms, multi-step claim and payment workflows, filters, dashboards and exports - that stay usable on large result sets. 
 - Work within a large existing codebase using NgRx state management, RxJS and component-driven design, refactoring incrementally rather than rewriting. 
 - Implement role-driven UI that respects access control and minimum-necessary display of sensitive data. 

Back end (. NET) and database

- Implement ASP. NET Core Web API endpoints and service-layer logic (controller → interface → service) over stored procedures. 
 - Write and tune T-SQL procedures, views and queries against tables with tens of millions of rows; design indexes and read execution plans. 
 - Reason about locking and concurrency against simultaneous BI reads and scheduled background jobs. 
 - Build and maintain healthcare integrations: inbound and outbound X12 EDI (837, 835, 277CA, 999), clearinghouse SFTP exchange, ERA auto-posting and payer interfaces. 

AI-forward development

- Use AI coding assistants and agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex or similar) daily for codebase exploration, scaffolding, refactoring, unit-test generation, SQL and code review, debugging and documentation. 
 - Treat all AI output as a draft: review, test and understand it before committing; apply extra scrutiny to AI-assisted changes to stored procedures and production data paths. 
 - Identify and prototype practical AI use cases in the product and the development workflow - for example, test-case design, requirement clarification and release notes - within approved, compliant tooling. 
 - Share prompts, workflows and lessons learned so the whole team gets faster. 

Quality, operations and compliance

- Diagnose production issues using Application Insights, logs and Query Store, and fix root causes. 
 - Write unit tests for new logic (xUnit, Moq, Jasmine/Karma) and partner with QA on regression coverage. 
 - Participate in code review as author and reviewer, and assess pre-merge impact across the develop → QA → UAT → staging → production pipeline. 
 - Follow HIPAA and secure-by-default practices: no PHI in logs, tickets, screenshots or AI tools; secrets in Key Vault; least-privilege access. 
 - Contribute to performance, quality and technical-debt work alongside feature delivery. 

Collaboration

- Work from written requirements with US-based product and business stakeholders, ask clarifying questions and give realistic estimates. 
 - Write clear design notes, PR descriptions and status updates that support asynchronous, cross-time-zone work. 

Required qualifications

Experience

- 5+ years of professional full stack development with . NET and Angular in production systems. 
 - 2+ years working on US healthcare software - revenue cycle management, medical billing, claims, practice management, EHR or payer systems. 

. NET and database

- Strong C# and ASP. NET Core Web API (. NET 6 or later); comfortable with Entity Framework Core and/or Dapper. 
 - Working SQL Server / T-SQL: can write a non-trivial stored procedure, read a query plan and explain why a query is slow. 

Angular

- Strong Angular (12+) with TypeScript, RxJS and component-driven design; able to work in a large existing codebase without rewriting it. 

AI-forward engineering

- Demonstrated daily use of at least one AI development platform - Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT / Codex, Cursor or similar - for code generation, refactoring, test writing, debugging and documentation. 
 - Effective prompting and context management on a large, unfamiliar codebase, not just generic snippets. 
 - Verification discipline: can explain every line committed, and can show examples of catching and correcting flawed AI output. 

Healthcare domain

- Working knowledge of the claim lifecycle: charge entry, claim submission, adjudication, remittance, denials and AR follow-up. 
 - Familiarity with HIPAA X12 transactions (837, 835, 277CA, 999) and CMS-1500 / UB-04 claim formats. 
 - Understanding of HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule obligations and how they shape logging, access control and data handling. 

Engineering practice

- Git, pull-request workflow and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or similar). 
 - Ability to work from written requirements, ask good clarifying questions and give realistic estimates. 
 - Willing to work from the Pune office full time. 

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with agentic AI workflows (for example, Claude Code or Copilot agents) for multi-file changes, test generation or code migration. 
 - Experience integrating LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI) into . NET applications - prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured output and evaluation - within HIPAA-compliant boundaries. 
 - Exposure to AI use cases in RCM such as denial prediction, coding assistance, document extraction or claim scrubbing. 
 - Microsoft Azure services: App Service, WebJobs, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, Redis, Application Insights, Entra ID. 
 - NgRx or another Redux-style state library; SignalR or other real-time patterns. 
 - EDI tooling such as EdiFabric; SFTP and clearinghouse integrations. 
 - xUnit / NUnit / Jasmine-Karma testing experience. 
 - Reporting or BI exposure (Power BI, SSRS). 
 - Certifications (any of): Microsoft Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204), Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), or a healthcare credential such as AAPC or HFMA coursework. 

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field - or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. What you have built and shipped counts more than the credential. 

Core competencies and success measures

Ways of working

- Evidence over assertion - claims about performance or impact are backed by a measurement or a source reference. 
 - Production respect - the system handles live claims and money; changes are weighed for their effect on real data before merge. 
 - Clear written communication - design notes, PR descriptions and status that someone outside your head can follow. 
 - Cross-time-zone collaboration - close work with US-based product and business stakeholders; asynchronous clarity matters as much as meetings. 
 - Continuous learning - keeping current with AI tooling as it changes how this work is done. 

Compliance, security and responsible AI use

- ECM processes Protected Health Information (PHI). All engineers complete HIPAA training and are bound by Saisystems Health security and confidentiality policies. 
 - No PHI, patient data, credentials, production connection strings or confidential business data is ever entered into an external or unapproved AI tool. 
 - AI is an accelerator, not a substitute for engineering judgement; accountability for correctness stays with the engineer. 
 - AI-generated code is reviewed to the same standard as hand-written code, with added scrutiny for stored procedures and production data paths. 
 - Secure-by-default habits: no PHI in logs, tickets, screenshots or non-production data; least-privilege access; secrets in Key Vault, never in source. 
 - Design decisions account for audit, access control and data-retention requirements of a regulated product. 
 - Employment is subject to a background check and a signed confidentiality agreement. 

Equal opportunity: Saisystems Health is an equal opportunity employer. HR to confirm the standard EEO statement and any compensation or benefits wording before posting

data.title: Content Team Lead
data.description:
About Logbase

Logbase builds a suite of apps that help Shopify merchants increase average order value and solve complex logistics problems. We serve 75, 000+ merchants and are one of the fastest-growing companies in this space. We are moving upmarket toward larger Shopify Plus and Advanced merchants, and content is a big part of how those merchants find us, trust us and choose us. 

The role

We are looking for a Content Lead to own the content engine end to end. That means content at every stage of the funnel, from website and landing pages and blogs that bring in merchants, to customer showcases that help larger merchants decide, to ebooks and whitepapers that go deeper. You will anchor the existing team, lead them to their success, and expand the team as needed with hiring or working with external flex teams, and report on what the content is actually delivering. 

What you will do

- Run the content engine. Plan, produce and publish a steady mix of website and landing pages, blogs, customer showcases and case studies, ebooks and whitepapers, with a clear view of which piece serves which stage of the funnel. 
 - Lead the team. Manage content creators and freelance writers, set quality standards, review work and keep the calendar on track. 
 - Scale with agencies. Brief, manage and evaluate external content agencies so that volume grows without quality slipping. 
 - Own the numbers. Track performance for every content type, work out what is working and what is not, and share clear metrics and recommendations with management on a regular cadence. 
 - Work across marketing. Partner with Product Marketing on case studies and feature content, and with the wider team so content reflects how merchants actually talk about their problems. 
 - Keep improving. Use data to decide what to make more of, what to fix and what to stop. 

What you bring

- 5 to 7 years of experience in content operations. 
 - Demonstrated experience running a content engine that produces a variety of formats across the funnel: website and landing pages, blogs, customer showcases, ebooks and whitepapers. 
 - Experience leading a team of content creators. 
 - Experience working with external agencies to scale content. 
 - An analytical mindset. You use data to understand what content works and what does not, and you can explain it plainly to management. 
 - Experience in B2B SaaS. 
 - Strong writing and editorial judgement. 

Good to have

- Experience with Shopify or Shopify app SaaS. This is a big plus. 

What success looks like

Content that is published on schedule, produced at a consistent quality, and tied to results that management can see. You will be expected to report on output and on the impact of that output, not only on volume. 

Location and relocation

This is an in-office role at our Coimbatore office. If you are based elsewhere, we can help with relocation. 

How to apply

Please include samples of your content with your application. Send work that shows the range of what you have run, such as a blog, a customer story and a longer piece like an ebook or whitepaper, and tell us which results you were accountable for.

data.title: Cisco CVP / IVR Applications Tester
data.description:
Cisco CVP / IVR Applications Tester

Assurant Contact Center Transformation Development POD

POD Mission

The Contact Center Transformation Development POD will design, build, integrate, test and continuously improve Assurant's next-generation contact-center capabilities across voice, IVR, routing, agent desktop, recording, quality management, data, conversational AI and customer experience. 

The POD should operate as a persistent Agile product team rather than a traditional project team, with shared accountability for: 

- Customer experience 
 - First Contact Resolution 
 - Call containment and self-service 
 - Reduced transfers 
 - Reduced Average Handle Time 
 - Agent experience 
 - Contact-center reliability 
 - Faster release cycles 
 - Automation 
 - Data-driven optimization 
 - Compliance and recording 
 - Platform resilience 
 - Technical debt reduction 
 - Migration from legacy contact-center capabilities 
 - AI and conversational automation

Cisco CVP / IVR Applications Tester

Role Summary

The Cisco CVP / IVR Applications Tester will be responsible for validating IVR call flows, Cisco CVP applications, integrations, routing behavior, self-service journeys and customer experience scenarios within Assurant's contact-center transformation program. 

The tester will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners and contact-center stakeholders to ensure IVR applications are functionally accurate, reliable, compliant, resilient and aligned with customer self-service and agent handoff requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Review business requirements, call-flow designs, user stories and acceptance criteria for IVR/CVP applications. 
 - Prepare detailed test scenarios, test cases and test data for DTMF, speech, routing and self-service journeys. 
 - Validate Cisco CVP applications, Cisco Call Studio/VXML flows and integrations with ICM/UCCE routing. 
 - Test end-to-end customer journeys including authentication, customer lookup, policy/claim lookup, payments, status inquiries and escalation to live agents. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, system, smoke and production validation testing for IVR releases. 
 - Verify backend integrations through REST APIs, SOAP services, databases and middleware where applicable. 
 - Validate prompt playback, dynamic prompts, error messages, fallback handling, retry logic and no-input/no-match scenarios. 
 - Test text-to-speech, speech recognition and conversational AI integrations where applicable. 
 - Validate call routing, transfer logic, queue handling, skills mapping and context passing from IVR to agent desktop. 
 - Execute negative testing, exception testing, timeout handling and edge-case validation across IVR journeys. 
 - Verify logging, telemetry, transaction tracing and reporting events required for monitoring and analytics. 
 - Identify, document, track and retest defects using standard defect management tools. 
 - Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot issues related to call flows, routing, integrations and environment dependencies. 
 - Support test execution across SIT, UAT, pre-production and production validation phases. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, defect triage and release readiness discussions. 
 - Ensure testing supports contact-center goals such as improved containment, reduced transfers, better customer experience and reliable self-service completion. Required Technical Skills

- Strong experience in IVR/CVP application testing. 
 - Hands-on understanding of Cisco CVP, Cisco Call Studio, VXML and IVR call-flow behavior. 
 - Knowledge of Cisco ICM/UCCE routing concepts, call routing and agent transfer flows. 
 - Experience in functional, regression, integration, system and UAT testing. 
 - Ability to create test scenarios, test cases, test data and test execution evidence. 
 - Experience validating REST APIs, SOAP services, XML, JSON and backend integrations. 
 - Good understanding of DTMF, speech recognition, prompts, TTS, call transfers and telephony testing concepts. 
 - Experience using defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, ALM or similar tools. 
 - Basic SQL knowledge for test data validation and backend verification. 
 - Ability to analyze logs, call traces and transaction details for troubleshooting defects. Preferred Skills

- Experience testing conversational AI, virtual assistants or NLP-enabled IVR flows. 
 - Exposure to Nuance, Google or other cloud speech services. 
 - Experience with contact-center platforms, call recording, quality monitoring and reporting systems. 
 - Knowledge of automation testing concepts for APIs, regression suites or IVR validation. 
 - Exposure to tools such as Postman, SOAP UI, Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Understanding of AWS/Azure services and microservices-based integrations. 
 - Ability to support production validation, incident analysis and release readiness checkpoints. Success Measures

- Test case coverage across critical IVR customer journeys. 
 - Defect detection quality and timely defect reporting. 
 - Reduction in production defects for IVR/CVP releases. 
 - Successful validation of self-service completion and containment scenarios. 
 - Accuracy of routing, transfer logic and agent context handoff validation. 
 - Timely completion of SIT, UAT, regression and production validation cycles. 
 - Quality of test evidence, traceability and release sign-off inputs. 
 - Improved reliability of IVR journeys, backend integrations and customer experience flows.

Edifecs - QA Lead
data.description:
QA Lead - EDIFECS

Healthcare EDI & Core Admin Platform

Location: Hyderabad

Tech Stack: Edifecs (SpecBuilder, XEngine, Transaction/EDI Gateway, Encounter Management), QA Tools (JIRA, ALM, Postman, SoapUI), MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, X12 EDI (270/271, 834, 835/837, 275, 276/277), AI-Assisted Testing

Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytically strong Lead QA Analyst with hands-on EDIFECS experience to validate, test, and quality-assure the EDI integration layer of our large healthcare core administration platform. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for EDIFECS trading partner configurations, transaction maps, and validation rules covering X12 transactions (270/271, 834, 835/837, 275, 276/277). 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing of EDIFECS configurations and EDI transaction flows across development, UAT, and production-support environments. 
 - Validate inbound and outbound EDI transaction processing - including segment-level and element-level compliance against HIPAA X12 implementation guides and payer companion guides. 
 - Test and certify trading partner onboarding configurations, including acknowledgment flows (999, 997, TA1, 277CA) and connectivity validation (AS2, SFTP). 
 - Identify, document, and track defects using JIRA or equivalent tools; work closely with the EDIFECS development and configuration team to facilitate timely resolution. 
 - Collaborate with the onsite lead and client stakeholders on requirements clarification and design validation
 - Validate SpecBuilder specs, maps, and custom validation/business rules against defined requirements and companion guide standards. 
 - Perform database validation across MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Oracle to verify EDI transaction data integrity at the persistence layer. 
 - Support production defect triage and troubleshooting - analyzing transaction failures and rejections, identifying root causes, and validating fixes. 
 - Create and maintain QA documentation including test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, and defect reports. 
 - Collaborate with the onsite lead, EDIFECS configuration team, and client stakeholders on requirements clarification, test scope definition, and sign-off. 
 - Participate in configuration and code reviews from a quality and testability perspective. 
 - Support broader platform modernization and regression testing initiatives by providing EDI/EDIFECS QA subject matter expertise. Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field. 
 - 8-10 years of experience in healthcare EDI/integration QA, with strong hands-on experience testing EDIFECS configurations (SpecBuilder, XEngine, Transaction/EDI Gateway). 
 - Strong working knowledge of core HIPAA X12 EDI transactions: 270/271, 834, 835/837, 275, and 276/277 - including segment and element-level validation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to write detailed test plans, test cases, and traceability matrices for EDI/integration testing. 
 - Experience validating trading partner onboarding flows, acknowledgment handling (999/997/TA1/277CA), and connectivity channels (AS2, SFTP). 
 - Hands-on experience with defect management and test management tools (JIRA, HP ALM, or equivalent). 
 - Ability to query and validate data in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Oracle databases to verify backend EDI transaction integrity. 
 - Experience with API/EDI testing tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or similar for validating transaction payloads. 
 - Strong analytical and debugging skills for diagnosing EDI transaction failures and rejections in high-volume production environments. 
 - Good written and verbal communication skills for collaborating with onsite leads, developers, and client stakeholders. AI Knowledge & AI-Assisted Testing (Required)

- Daily, practical use of AI coding/assistant tools to accelerate EDIFECS test case generation, test data creation, and defect analysis. 
 - Able to critically review and validate AI-generated test cases, assertions, and configurations for correctness before execution. 
 - Understanding of secure and compliant AI tool usage, including never entering PHI, member data, or other sensitive information into prompts or external AI tools. 
 - Able to identify where AI-driven automation can improve day-to-day EDI testing, regression coverage, or defect triage efficiency. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with health plan/payer core administration systems (e. g. , Facets, QNXT, HealthRules) from a QA/testing perspective. 
 - Familiarity with CAQH CORE operating rules and their testing implications. 
 - Exposure to automated testing frameworks applicable to EDI/integration testing pipelines. 
 - Experience with mainframe or cloud-based integration patterns supporting EDI processing. 
 - Relevant certifications: EDIFECS product certifications, ISTQB, or equivalent QA certifications.

data.title: Software Engineer (Cybersecurity Integrations) - Armis
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

This isn't a role for someone who just builds standard API connectors. As a Cybersecurity Integration Engineer (Conventional and AI native), you will be bridging the gap between conventional security stacks and next-generation, AI-driven insights. You will design and deploy standard integrations and intelligent agents that do more than move data; they transform raw, fragmented telemetry into a cohesive, actionable risk posture. You will be the creator of automated reasoning within our integration layer, ensuring that our customers don't just have data-they have the right insights and actionable intelligence. 

You will work alongside the team to redefine and transform how integration is developed in Armis. 

What You'll Do

- Collaborate with senior engineers to build and maintain scalable, resilient integrations (APIs, webhooks, streaming data) across the security ecosystem. 
 - Implement modern design patterns and best practices to support AI-native integration workflows and automated threat handling. 
 - Assist in troubleshooting customer friction points and systematically resolve edge cases within integration services. 
 - Contribute to reusable libraries and data-mapping frameworks to enable standard connections across enterprise security tools. 
 - Partner with cross-functional R&D and Product teams under technical guidance to implement features that improve automated risk management. 
 - Help enhance existing integration components to support low-code and self-service capabilities. 

Qualifications

Requirements

- 2 to 5 years of Python engineering expertise with a focus on building production-grade, maintainable codebases. Cyber Security experience is a plus
 - Deep networking fundamentals, including strong knowledge of TCP/IP and L3-L7 protocols. 
 - Experience with high-throughput, enterprise-scale distributed systems, Async and synchronous programming. 
 - A product-minded approach: you don't just write code; you solve critical problems for our customer base. 
 - Preferred: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Kafka/message queues, and LLM-powered application development (RAG, agentic workflows). 
 - Bring a proactive "can-do" attitude combined with a mindset focused on continuous learning and innovation. 
 - In accordance with our hybrid work policy, this position requires on-site office attendance a few times each week. 

Additional Information

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance.

data.title: Head/Manager – Product Delivery | PQC, QKD & AI
data.description:
What if your next role wasn't just to deliver a product - but to build the product, build the team, and eventually lead the business around it?

We are looking for a hands-on technology & delivery leader to help us build and take to market a next-generation security platform at the intersection of: 

PQC + QKD + AI + 5G Core + Defense Communication

This is not a traditional Delivery Manager role. 

We are looking for someone who can start by owning execution, work closely with our engineering teams, engage with Carrier and Defense customers - and, over time, potentially take broader ownership of the product and business. 

What You Will Own

- Take products from engineering → productization → customer deployment → delivery. 
 - Work closely with AI, cryptography and quantum engineering teams today, and customer teams tomorrow. 
 - Translate customer requirements into engineering and product priorities. 
 - Build the processes, teams and partnerships required to scale the business. 

Who We Are Looking For

- 12-20 years of experience across Telecom, Cybersecurity, Networking, Defense or Deep Tech. 
 - Proven experience taking complex technology from R&D / prototype to production and customer deployment. 
 - Deep-tech startup experience is a big plus - yes, we know that's rare!
 - Comfortable working across PQC / Cryptography, QKD / Quantum, AI/ML and Telecom / Network Security. You don't need to be an expert in all of them - we have engineering teams for that!
 - Most importantly: technology depth + customer orientation + entrepreneurial ownership. 

Why This Could Be Interesting

You will be working on a platform designed for Carrier and Defense markets, at the intersection of some of the most important emerging security technologies. 

You will have direct exposure to: 

Technology - Product - Customer - Business

And if you are the person who can make that journey happen, the long-term opportunity is much bigger than the title you join with. 

Chennai | On-site (Willing to travel anywhere tomorrow)

We are looking for someone already in Chennai or genuinely willing to relocate to Chennai. 

We're building this hands-on, and we believe the person leading delivery should be close to the technology, the team and eventually the customers. 

Compensation

A combination of: 

Competitive take-home compensation + long-term stake / ownership component

The exact structure will depend on experience, leadership potential and the role you ultimately grow into. 

One last thing. . . 

We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already done everything. 

We are looking for someone who has built difficult things, knows how to get things done, can earn customer trust, and wants to build something of their own. 

Join us as the person who builds the product today. 

Grow into the person who leads it tomorrow. 

Interested? Reach out to : chandra@sequr. in

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
About the Role

The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and inspiring his or her team to achieve their performance metrics. Your role will involve strategizing, project management, part staff management. Your collaborative attitude and interpersonal skills will help you thrive as an Engineering Manager. 

Job Title: Engineering Manager Location: Mohali, India Reports To: Director of Engineering - Digital Engineering (or relevant Engineering Lead) Department: Digital / Digital Engineering Role Summary We are hiring Engineering Managers to join our Digital Engineering organization. This is a generalist engineering leadership role with strong backend depth, responsible for leading teams building and operating business-critical digital products across multiple brands and markets. Depending on assignment, the role may span backend services and APIs as well as web and mobile delivery. 

Responsibilities

- Key Responsibilities
 - 1) Platform & Service Ownership (Backend-First, Full-Stack Aware)
 - Own one or more core platform domains (e. g. , ordering, catalog/menu, pricing, payments, loyalty, customer identity, integrations, CMS) delivered via APIs and services. 
 - Drive end-to-end accountability across architecture, delivery roadmap, quality, and production reliability. 
 - Lead system design and architectural trade-offs (latency, resiliency, data consistency, cost, security, time-to-market). 
 - Establish and evolve service contracts (API standards, versioning, backward compatibility), integration patterns, and domain boundaries. 
 - Improve performance and availability through pragmatic engineering practices (profiling, caching, DB tuning, queueing/eventing where appropriate). 
 - Ensure predictable releases and operational readiness (zero/low downtime deployments, feature flags, progressive rollout, rollback strategy). 
 - 
 - 2) Engineering Leadership & Team Effectiveness
 - Lead and scale a cross-functional team (Backend, Web, Mobile, QA, DevOps/SRE, Tech Leads as applicable). 
 - Build a high-performance culture: clear ownership, delivery discipline, quality mindset, and continuous improvement. 
 - Coach and grow engineers through regular feedback, career development, mentoring, and performance management. 
 - Partner with Talent Acquisition and peers to hire strong backend engineers (and full-stack/mobile talent when needed). 
 - Create team clarity via planning rituals, capacity management, prioritization, and engineering excellence standards. 
 - 
 - 3) Delivery, Reliability, and Operational Excellence
 - Own delivery outcomes: scope definition, estimation, sequencing, risk management, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment. 
 - Ensure high engineering quality: automated testing strategy, code review discipline, CI/CD hygiene, and secure-by-default patterns. 
 - Drive observability maturity: SLI/SLO alignment, logging/metrics/tracing, alerting quality, incident response, and post-incident learning (RCA). 
 - Partner with SRE/Platform teams to meet availability, latency, and scalability targets for peak events and business cycles. 
 - 
 - 4) Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management
 - Collaborate with Product, Brand/Commercial teams, Operations, Finance, Security, and external partners to align on priorities and delivery. 
 - Communicate trade-offs clearly, including options, impacts, timelines, and cost/risk implications. 
 - Influence technical direction through proposals that balance business outcomes and long-term platform health (including tech-debt strategies). 

Qualifications

- Required Qualifications & Skills
 - 12+ years of overall experience with 3-5+ years in engineering leadership/management roles. 
 - Strong backend engineering foundation: service architecture, API design, data modeling, distributed systems fundamentals. 
 - Experience leading teams building production-grade, high-availability systems (microservices and/or modular service architectures). 
 - Proven ability to deliver across multiple stakeholders and competing priorities in a product environment. 
 - Solid understanding of cloud and modern ops practices (Azure/AWS/GCP fundamentals, CI/CD, observability, security basics). 
 - Strong communication skills: can translate between engineering detail and business outcomes. 

Required Skills

- Technical exposure (expected at architectural level; hands-on is a plus): 
 - Backend: Node. js or similar backend stacks, REST/GraphQL, asynchronous patterns (queues/events), caching, relational + NoSQL basics
 - Web/Mobile: ability to manage delivery across React-based web and native or cross-platform mobile stacks (iOS/Android/Flutter/React Native)
 - Data & integration: third-party APIs, aggregator/partner integrations, idempotency, retries, reconciliation patterns

Preferred Skills

- Preferred / Nice-to-Have
 - Experience in consumer digital platforms (QSR, retail, e-commerce, marketplaces, logistics). 
 - Experience leading distributed teams across geographies/time zones. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant, multi-brand, multi-market platforms and complex integration ecosystems. 
 - Familiarity with compliance/security practices relevant to consumer platforms and payments.

data.title: QMS Manager
data.description:
Position Overview

The Senior Manager - QMS is a strategic leader responsible for driving the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the organization's Quality Management System. This role ensures compliance with global quality standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations while fostering a culture of quality excellence across the enterprise. The position involves leading cross-functional teams, managing audits, and influencing organizational strategy to achieve world-class quality performance. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Leadership in Quality Management Systems

- Define and execute the organization's QMS strategy aligned with business objectives and global standards. 
 - Oversee implementation and maintenance of QMS in compliance with ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 26262, ISO 13485, ISO 14001, and other relevant standards. 
 - Champion continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging Lean, Six Sigma, and best practices to enhance process efficiency and product quality. 
 - Establish governance for documentation control, standardization, and quality assurance across all functions. 2. Compliance, Certifications & Regulatory Affairs

- Ensure adherence to international standards and regulatory requirements including RoHS, SEMI, AS9100, and customer-specific mandates. 
 - Lead certification audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections; act as the primary liaison with external auditors and certification bodies. 
 - Drive timely closure of audit findings through robust Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) systems. 
 - Monitor global regulatory trends and proactively update organizational policies to maintain compliance. 3. Customer Quality & Relationship Management

- Serve as the senior quality representative in customer interactions, audits, and technical reviews. 
 - Build strong relationships with key customers by addressing quality concerns, presenting performance metrics, and demonstrating commitment to excellence. 
 - Implement Voice of Customer (VoC) programs and integrate feedback into quality improvement initiatives. 4. Leadership & Team Development

- Mentor and develop quality teams to build strong technical and leadership capabilities. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning within the quality function. 
 - Drive cross-functional engagement to embed quality principles across operations, engineering, and supply chain. 

Technical Expertise: 

- Deep knowledge of ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 26262, ISO 13485, ISO 14001 standards. 
 - Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks including RoHS, SEMI, and industry-specific requirements. 
 - Expertise in audit management, documentation control, and CAPA systems. 

Core Competencies

- Strategic Quality Leadership
 - Advanced QMS & Compliance Management
 - Customer Relationship & Satisfaction
 - Risk Management & Regulatory Compliance
 - Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis
 - Excellent Communication & Influencing Skills
 - Team Development & Cross-functional Collaboration

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Quality Management; Master's degree preferred. 

Certifications (Preferred): 

- Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Lead Auditor (ISO/IATF), Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent. 

Experience: 

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Quality Management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within manufacturing or engineering environments. 
 - Proven track record of managing QMS implementation, audits, and compliance at a global scale.

data.title: Team Lead-Presales
data.description:
About The Company

We, RentoMojo, were founded by IITM alums and serial entrepreneurs who worked out of almost every major city in India

in his first five years of corporate career. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of

finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle. 

"The spending youth, especially the millennials & Gen Z's prefer staying light, desire flexibility and are value conscious. 

Willing to experiment with new stuff across categories that make life simpler and not boring, these generations are also

sensitive to our planet's sustainability. Our customers and employees identify with what we do '', is what Geetansh

Bamania, our Founder and CEO has to say. 

RentoMojo caters to the needs of the working professionals which is unmet due to nonavailability of furnished rental flats

by offering furniture and appliances on rental basis, thus, providing more flexibility than owning the expensive furniture and

appliances. 

Currently, we have 130, 000+ subscribers with a typical rental period of 1214 months. The current market size (as per a

recent report by Grant Thornton) is estimated to be US$ 4. 1 Billion and expected to grow to US$ 13 Billion by 2025. 

With 1000+ people operations, the company has a presence in 16 cities across India. Looking back, Rentomojo has not only

made a new market of lease which never existed for the consumer, they have also become market leaders in the consumer

rental industry. Unlike the norm, they are now seeing a reverse trend wherein a version of ours is being copied in the US

and UK. We are a profitable company and are excited about exponentially growing the profits of the company in months

and years to come. 

Five Pillars Of Our Culture

Zoom InZoom Out : 

- We zoom in and go micro; our focus would be doing better in everything, including things we already do well. 
 - We zoom

out a lot for creating successful pilots that can potentially scale into a lot of value add in the future, like strengthening our

offline presence. 

Enterprising Mindset: If you are bold enough, you will have life changing growth opportunities here. 

- We will continue to expand the responsibilities of hungry and willing people. If you are ready to do what you have never done, you will find roles that you have never managed. 
 - Growing people from within was a significant contributor to the Fortune employers choice award that we won in 2022

and more importantly that's one of the biggest reasons of our success & continued momentum

Frugality: Measure Twice and Cut once. 

- It is always easy to spend more money to get more done, but it lacks any form of challenge. We have to grow and become

better without a proportionate increase in cost. 

- For every penny that we spend or that we put up to spend, expect a lot of discussions, debates and conversations. 

Planning is going to be important, data has to be the foundation, detailing will be a must and world class execution is the

only way we will move forward in this journey. 

Accountability: Less Why, more How. 

- We will always have more to bite than we can chew, we will always have to make choices and prioritize while we

progress. We can have hundreds of reasons behind why something can not be done, but we have to remain focused on the

how of things. The focus on how will help us find ways to get done, what needs to get done. 

Think, decide, play and act for the long term. 

- The only time we will make short term decisions is when they help us in the longer term. To me, the long term is all about

consistency and not intensity. 

Recent Media Coverage: YourStory , Dec 2022

The Core Team

Geetansh Bamania - Founder & CEO

Ketan Krishna - People & Governance Head

Prabhat Verma - VP of Engineering, Data & Product
