OVERVIEW

APEXX is an independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform. Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem: acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation. Our routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost. We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome. 

We're backed by MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds. 

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer in Bengluru to help build and run the core of that platform. 

This role covers everything in orchestration - payment flows, routing, connectors, tokenisation, webhooks and reconciliation - and how we run the platform: reliability, on-call, CI/CD and shared engineering practices. We build it, we run it, and done means released, not dev-complete. 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own core payment flows end to end: authorisation, capture, refund, void and MIT/recurring across card and APM rails, from design doc to production and beyond. 
 - Evolve our routing and recovery logic: rules-based and data-driven routing, decline cascading, Smart Split and outage failover - making sure a retry never becomes a double charge. 
 - Build and maintain connectors to acquirers, APMs and BNPL providers: normalise responses, handle API version drift and design for partner outages. 
 - Design for correctness under failure: idempotency, timeouts, ambiguous payment states, asynchronous notifications and webhooks, and reconciliation against settlement files. 
 - Protect cardholder data: work within our tokenisation and vault services, HSM-backed cryptography and PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls, keeping PCI scope as small as possible. 
 - Run the platform: join the on-call rotation, define and track SLOs and service dashboards, write runbooks, lead incidents and blameless RCAs, and improve our GitLab CI/CD and AWS estate (ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3). 
 - Raise the bar with the team: write technical design docs, give high-quality code reviews, mentor engineers and help us modernise our stack, including our move to Java 17 and newer Spring Boot. 
 - Work across the business with Product, Solutions, Support and our UK colleagues, turning merchant and partner needs into reliable systems. 

ABOUT YOU

- Significant experience building and running production backend services in Java and Spring Boot, or a comparable JVM or backend stack and a willingness to move to ours. 
 - A strong grasp of distributed-systems failure modes: retries, idempotency, timeouts, concurrency, eventual consistency, and how to reason about "we don't know if it happened". 
 - Solid PostgreSQL skills (schema design, transactions and isolation, query tuning) and practical use of Redis or similar caches. 
 - Hands-on AWS experience and comfort with CI/CD, containers and infrastructure-as-code. 
 - You've owned services in production: on-call, debugging with logs, metrics and traces, leading incidents and writing up what the team learned. 
 - Clear written communication: design docs, runbooks, RCAs and merge request descriptions that others can act on. 
 - You use AI coding tools productively and critically: you know when to trust the output, and you verify it with tests and review before it ships. 
 - You help the people around you get better through review, pairing and mentoring. 

NICE TO HAVE

- Payments experience: card acquiring, 3DS2/SCA, network tokens, APMs/BNPL, settlement and reconciliation, or payment orchestration. 
 - Working knowledge of PCI DSS, HSMs and key management, or OAuth2/mTLS for partner integrations. 
 - Observability tooling, SLO-based alerting, or analytics stacks such as Snowflake or QuickSight. 
 - Experience in a Scale-up or Fintech working with UK or global teams. 

HOW WE HIRE

Four conversations: 

- a talent screen, 
 - a conversation with the hiring manager, 
 - a hands-on technical session and
 - a system design session. 

Before your first interview, we'll send you a short guide on how to prepare for each round. You're welcome to use your own AI tools in both technical rounds - we're interested in how you think, verify and decide. Once a decision is made, every candidate receives a written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them. 

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation that recognises your skills, experience and impact. 
 - Generous time off: annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work. 
 - Work From Anywhere: up to 90 days a year from eligible locations, subject to our policy. 
 - Comprehensive health insurance for you and your loved ones. 
 - Personal accident insurance for when it's needed most. 
 - Enhanced family leave: enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies. 
 - Learning & growth: opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX. 

WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers. We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2. 

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. 

We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies.

data.title: Technology Architect
data.description:
Project Role : Technology Architect

Project Role Description : Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs. 

Must have skills : Automotive Digital Cockpit Solutions

Good to have skills : NA

Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary: 

Leads a squad of engineers delivering a defined slice of the vehicle abstraction stack - for example, the VHAL core and property store, the SOME/IP-to-VHAL bridge, or the Car Framework extensions. Translates the architecture into concrete designs, owns the squad's technical quality and delivery commitment, and remains a hands-on contributor on the hardest parts of the codebase. 

Roles & Responsibilities: 

Design & Hands-on Engineering: 

- Produce detailed design documents for assigned components: class/interface design, threading and concurrency model, property-config data model, error and timeout semantics, memory ownership. 
 - Personally implement or co-implement the most complex or risk-bearing parts: the IVehicle AIDL service skeleton, subscription manager, VehiclePropertyStore concurrency, the vsomeip client integration, the CAN signal-to-property mapping engine. 
 - Own the vendor property ID allocation scheme and the property-config JSON/ARXML generation pipeline for the squad's domain. 
 - Define and enforce the squad's performance budgets: property get/set latency, callback fan-out cost, IPC overhead, boot-time contribution, memory footprint. 
 - Android property operations to real vehicle interfaces. ( Common API, SOME/IP, CAPI style plugin, Handler Integration), Sync/Async Boardnet communication understanding. 
 - Release Management on Component artifactory and App Store. 
 - Complete Automotive domain knowledge. 

Integration & Cross-team: 

- Drive integration with the vehicle network layer: agree signal catalogues with the E/E and Tier-1 teams, resolve semantic mismatches (units, ranges, signal validity/error qualifiers, timeouts, not available handling). 
 - Own the SOME/IP contract for the squad: service/instance/method/event IDs, vsomeip configuration, service discovery behaviour, serialisation alignment with CommonAPI or the OEM IDL, E2E protection where applicable. 
 - Coordinate with app and framework teams consuming the properties review their CarPropertyManager usage patterns for subscription-rate and error-handling correctness. 

Team Leadership: 

- Break down features into level-appropriate tasks assign, estimate and track to sprint and milestone commitments. 
 - Run code review as the final gate for the squad's merge maintain the review standard (no unreviewed vendor-partition or SELinux change). 
 - Mentor engineers own their technical growth plans and provide performance input. 
 - Own the squad's defect triage, root-cause analysis discipline, and technical debt backlog. 

Quality & Compliance: 

- Own VTS coverage for the squad's HAL surface and ensure new properties ship with tests. 
 - Author and review SELinux policy for the squad's services and device nodes ensure no permissive domains or blanket allow rules reach production. 
 - Ensure ASPICE traceability: requirement , design , code , test linkage for the squad's deliverables. 

Professional & Technical Skills: 

- 10+ years total, 6+ years in Android platform/AOSP, with demonstrable VHAL or comparable HAL ownership. 
 - Advanced HAL implementation skills: has written or substantially modified an AIDL/HIDL HAL, including VINTF manifest entries, init. rc service definition, and vendor/system partition placement. 
 - Advanced C++ (17 or 20): RAII, move semantics, std: : concurrency, lock-free or carefully-locked shared state, profiling with perf/simpleperf, sanitizers (ASan, TSan, UBSan). 
 - Strong Java and Kotlin for Car Framework and system-service work understands Binder threading, oneway semantics, and SystemServer lifecycle. 
 - Strong AOSP skills: Soong modules, repo workflows on a multi-manifest tree, incremental builds, lunch targets, flashing/fastboot, adb-based debugging, dumpsys, bugreport analysis. 
 - Solid SELinux: writing . te files, file contexts, hwservice contexts, property contexts, diagnosing denials from audit2allow while resisting the temptation to over-grant. 
 - Practical onboard-network experience: SocketCAN, candump/cansend, DBC files, CAN-FD framing, Automotive Ethernet basics, Wireshark analysis of SOME/IP traffic. 
 - Working experience with SOME/IP stacks (vsomeip, CommonAPI or a commercial equivalent) and their configuration model. 
 - C++. Java, Kotlin, Rust, Python , Bash

Good to have: 

- Experience leading a distributed team across time zones. 
 - Exposure to HIL/SIL test rigs and restbus simulation (CANoe, CANalyzer, or equivalent). 
 - Experience migrating a HIDL VHAL to the AIDL VHAL interface. 

Additional Information: 

- The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in Automotive Digital Cockpit Solutions. 
 - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. 
 - A 15 years full time education is required.

TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

We are looking for a Data Engineering Operations Lead to join our growing Data Engineering and Analytics Practice who will drive building next generation suite of products and platforms by designing, coding, building, and deploying highly scalable and robust data solutions. The team reports to the Head of Data Engineering & Analytics and is part of the wider Global Technology function. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week. 

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

The role exists to own and manage the internal function responsible for development, support and operation of our ingestion pipelines as well as the assets created and owned by the team across our cloud (GCP) and on-premises environments. As Data Engineering Operations lead, you will be responsible to ensure the quality and robustness of the developed pipelines, operational resilience, SLA compliance for all of our main data assets created by our team. As a lead engineer most of your time will be spent on hands-on engineering work with expected ~25% spent on operational activities. 

Responsibilities Include

- Own and manage daily Data Engineering operations, including data ingestion workflows, pipeline monitoring, and incident resolution. 
 - Oversee end-to-end pipeline health - proactively monitor, triage, and resolve failures, bottlenecks, and data quality issues across all ingestion layers. 
 - Organize and prioritize the engineering operations function's daily workload - assign tasks, track progress, and remove blockers to ensure smooth operational delivery. 
 - Maintain and improve ingestion pipelines from various data sources into data lakes, warehouses, and real-time streaming systems. 
 - Act as the first point of escalation for pipeline failures, SLA breaches, and data anomalies - driving root cause analysis and permanent fixes. 
 - Define and enforce operational standards - runbooks, alerting thresholds, on-call procedures, and incident management practices. 
 - Coordinate with upstream data providers and downstream consumers to manage dependencies and communicate pipeline status. 
 - Lead daily stand-ups and work organization for the function under the wider Data Engineering practice. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers on operational best practices, debugging, and pipeline development. 
 - Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and product partners to onboard new data sources and meet ingestion SLAs. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in pipeline reliability, observability, and efficiency. 
 - Implement best practices in data governance, data quality monitoring, and compliance across all pipelines. 
 - Design, build, test, and deploy Data solutions at scale, including data lakes, data warehouses, and real-time analytics. 
 - Lead technical delivery on use cases, plan and delegate tasks to junior team members, and oversee work from inception to final product. 

Required Knowledge And Experiences

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related field
 - 10 years of data engineering experience with at least 3 years in lead roles. 
 - 6+ years of experience in Big Data technologies (e. g. , Spark, Hive, Hadoop, Databricks). 
 - Excellent knowledge of data engineering concepts and best practices. 
 - Proven experience leading, mentoring and supporting junior team members. 
 - Ability to lead technical deliverables autonomously and guide junior data engineers. 
 - Ability to organize and manage daily engineering workload - task assignment, prioritization, and delivery tracking. 
 - Strong attention to detail and adherence to best practices and defined policies. 

Essential Technical Skills

- Advanced proficiency with Apache Spark (PySpark) including tuning and performance optimisation experience. 
 - Proficiency in Python, Pandas (Scala/Java knowledge is desirable). 
 - Working knowledge of Apache Hive. 
 - Strong SQL knowledge and experience (T-SQL, working with SQL Server, SSMS, GCP BigQuery). 
 - Expertise in designing and implementing scalable data pipelines and ETL processes using the GCP data stack, including BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, Cloud Functions, Dataproc (Spark). 
 - Experience with batch, real-time streaming, and ETL processes, including incident resolution and pipeline recovery. 
 - Experience building and managing ETL workflows using Apache Airflow, including DAG creation, scheduling, and error handling. 
 - Source control with Git. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD concepts and experience designing CI/CD for data pipelines. 
 - Knowledge of Delta Lake concepts and common data formats, Lakehouse architecture. 
 - Software engineering principles including OOP, design patterns, SDLC, Agile, TDD, and performance optimization. 

Desirable Technical Skills

- Experience designing logical data models and physical data models, including data warehouse and data mart designs. 
 - Relevant certifications (e. g. Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer). 
 - Experience with streaming services such as Kafka is a plus. 
 - R & Sparklyr experience is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of MLOps concepts, AI/ML lifecycle management, and MLflow. 
 - Harness experience is a plus. 

We're also looking for the preferred skills below. Whether you are proficient or could use

some brushing up, we're happy to support your career development and growth in:

data.title: Sr Principal Software Engineer (AI, Sierra,  Cloud,)
data.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most. 

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. 

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8, 000 organizations in over 100 countries - moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day. 

Sr Principal Software Engineer - Genesys Cloud AI & Industry Solutions

Role Overview

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer and employee experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data, and AI to deliver personalized experiences, automate complex business processes, and improve operational efficiency. 

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer with deep, hands-on Genesys Cloud experience to design and build the next generation of AI-powered applications and industry solutions on the Genesys Cloud platform. 

This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering role. The ideal candidate combines deep Genesys Cloud engineering expertise with hands-on experience building advanced conversational or agentic AI applications using Genesys AI, Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore. ai, or similar platforms. 

The ideal candidate has extensive experience developing applications and integrations on Genesys Cloud and understands how to combine Genesys Cloud APIs, Architect, AI capabilities, experience orchestration, data, and enterprise systems to create production-grade solutions. 

A major focus of this role will be translating industry-specific business processes and customer challenges into reusable AI solutions. You will build AI applications, Digital Teammates, solution accelerators, and industry solutions for areas such as financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, telecommunications, and the public sector. 

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Innovations, customers, and partners to turn emerging Genesys AI capabilities, external AI technologies, and industry requirements into scalable, repeatable, and productized solutions that can be deployed across multiple customers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build production-grade applications and industry solutions on Genesys Cloud, leveraging Genesys Cloud APIs, SDKs, events, integrations, AI capabilities, and platform services. 
 - Develop AI-powered customer and employee applications using Genesys Cloud AI capabilities, including AI Studio, Virtual Agent/Agentic Virtual Agent capabilities, Copilot, Architect, knowledge, and Experience Orchestration. 
 - Translate industry-specific business processes and use cases into scalable AI applications, combining Genesys Cloud capabilities with enterprise systems, data, knowledge, AI models, and agentic technologies. 
 - Build reusable industry solution accelerators, Digital Teammates, AI agents, workflows, and application components that can be configured and deployed across multiple customers within an industry. 
 - Develop industry solutions addressing complex business challenges across financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, telecommunications, and public sector environments. 
 - Design sophisticated Genesys Architect flows and orchestration patterns across voice, digital, AI, workflows, data, and enterprise applications. 
 - Build integrations using Genesys Cloud Platform APIs, Data Actions, event-driven architectures, webhooks, and external APIs. 
 - Integrate Genesys Cloud with industry and enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft, AWS, CRM, ITSM, ERP, knowledge, healthcare, financial services, and workflow platforms. 
 - Build agentic applications and multi-agent workflows where AI agents can reason, retrieve information, invoke tools and APIs, execute business processes, and collaborate with human employees. 
 - Apply modern conversational and agentic AI patterns learned from platforms such as Genesys AI, Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore. ai, and similar technologies to build differentiated solutions on Genesys Cloud. 
 - Design AI applications that combine LLMs, enterprise knowledge, tool/API calling, workflow orchestration, business rules, and enterprise systems of record. 
 - Create reusable solution patterns that encapsulate industry workflows, business rules, integrations, AI capabilities, and best practices, accelerating time to value for customers. 
 - Work with industry experts, customers, Product, and Engineering teams to identify high-value use cases and convert them into repeatable, productized solutions. 
 - Build prototypes and MVPs using emerging Genesys Cloud AI and other AI technologies and rapidly convert successful concepts into scalable, production-ready industry applications. 
 - Design applications for enterprise-scale requirements including security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, compliance, and governance. 
 - Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, code reviews, and mentorship while remaining a hands-on builder and contributor. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline. 
 - 10+ years of software engineering, application development, or solution architecture experience. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on Genesys Cloud experience, including designing, developing, integrating, and deploying applications on the platform. 
 - Deep understanding of Genesys Cloud architecture, APIs, Architect, routing, conversations, integrations, Data Actions, and event-driven capabilities. 
 - Strong hands-on experience developing enterprise applications using modern programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience building AI-powered applications, conversational AI solutions, virtual agents, or agentic applications using enterprise AI platforms and modern AI technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of modern AI architectures including LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, orchestration, multi-agent systems, conversational AI, and agentic workflows. 
 - Demonstrated experience building reusable enterprise or industry solutions, rather than only one-off customer implementations. 
 - Experience translating complex industry business processes and use cases into technical architectures and production applications. 
 - Experience building applications using REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, event streams, microservices, and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Experience integrating Genesys Cloud with enterprise applications such as CRM, ITSM, ERP, knowledge, and workflow platforms. 
 - Experience translating AI capabilities into production-grade applications and reusable solutions, including integrations with enterprise APIs, knowledge systems, workflows, and business applications. 
 - Experience taking solutions from prototype/MVP through production deployment and operation. 
 - Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership while remaining deeply involved in architecture, design, coding, prototyping, debugging, and implementation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Genesys Cloud AI capabilities, including AI Studio, Virtual Agent/Agentic Virtual Agent, Copilot, Predictive Engagement, knowledge capabilities, and Experience Orchestration. 
 - Hands-on experience building production AI applications using Cognigy, Sierra, Decagon, Kore. ai, or similar enterprise conversational and agentic AI platforms. 
 - Experience developing custom applications and reusable solutions using the Genesys Cloud Developer Platform and APIs. 
 - Experience with Genesys Cloud CX voice and digital channels, including routing, Architect flows, bots, messaging, and agent experiences. 
 - Experience designing AI agents that combine conversational intelligence, reasoning, knowledge retrieval, tool/API calling, workflow orchestration, and business-process execution. 
 - Experience building agentic AI applications that integrate LLMs with enterprise APIs, knowledge systems, CRM/ITSM platforms, workflow engines, and other systems of record. 
 - Experience designing or developing industry-specific AI applications and reusable solution accelerators for financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, telecommunications, travel and hospitality, or public sector. 
 - Understanding of industry-specific business processes, regulatory requirements, data models, and enterprise application ecosystems. 
 - Familiarity with AI development and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including AI services such as Amazon Bedrock. 
 - Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ecosystems. 
 - Experience taking AI applications from prototype through enterprise production, including security, scalability, observability, governance, and reliability. 
 - Experience working in innovation teams, rapid prototyping environments, or customer co-creation programs. 

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means being able to take an industry business problem or use case and rapidly turn it into a working, production-quality AI application built on Genesys Cloud. 

More importantly, the goal is not simply to solve the problem for one customer. You will identify the common business process, integrations, AI capabilities, and orchestration patterns and turn them into a reusable industry solution that can be deployed across many customers. 

You should be equally comfortable understanding an industry business process, discussing architecture, working with Genesys Cloud APIs, designing an Architect flow, writing application code, integrating enterprise systems, connecting AI models and agents, implementing tool/API calling, debugging interactions, and demonstrating the finished solution to customers and executives. 

You should also be able to bring experience and architectural patterns from leading conversational and agentic AI platforms and apply those concepts effectively within the Genesys Cloud ecosystem. 

This is not a traditional high-level architecture role. We are looking for a hands-on Principal Engineer who knows Genesys Cloud deeply and can combine its AI, orchestration, API, and integration capabilities with modern agentic AI technologies to build the next generation of AI-powered industry solutions. 

Working at Genesys

- AI at enterprise scale - Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8, 000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
 - A flexible-first culture - Join a global team of nearly 7, 000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
 - Growth in the AI era - Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
 - Time to recharge and give back - Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
 - Recognized globally - Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report. 

What Happens After You Apply

You will build AI applications, Digital Teammates, solution accelerators, and industry solutions for areas such as financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, telecommunications, and the public sector. 

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Innovations, customers, and partners to turn emerging Genesys AI capabilities, external AI technologies, and industry requirements into scalable, repeatable, and productized solutions that can be deployed across multiple customers.

 - Experience translating complex industry business processes and use cases into technical architectures and production applications.

Description

- Python Expertise: 4+ years of professional backend software engineering experience with deep knowledge of asynchronous Python (asyncio), design patterns, and robust API development (FastAPI, Flask).

data.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World. 

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world's most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50, 000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. 

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. 

Job Description

Job Summary

West Region Operations & Technical Delivery Lead

AECOM is seeking a highly experienced Operations & Technical Delivery Leader with 15-20 years of experience to lead operations, technical delivery, and project governance across the West Region and all AECOM sectors, including Buildings & Places, Transportation, and Energy & Water. The role will lead Project Managers and multidisciplinary teams, ensuring consistent governance, technical excellence, operational efficiency, and successful delivery across the regional project portfolio. The individual will work closely with Sector Leaders and Operations Managers to support growth, resource optimization, risk management, client satisfaction, and business performance. 

Responsibilities: 

- Regional Operations & Governance: Lead overall operational governance across West Region projects and sectors, ensuring consistent processes, standards, risk management, and delivery excellence. 
 - Project & Technical Leadership: Provide oversight to Project Managers and technical teams across the full project lifecycle-from pursuit and contract award through design, delivery and close-out. 
 - Financial & Operational Performance: Drive key KPIs including revenue, billing, collections, profitability, utilization, EAC/ETC, project margins, and cash flow. 
 - Growth & Client Development: Partner with Sector Leaders to support pipeline development, strategic pursuits, client relationships, and regional growth objectives. 
 - Resource & People Leadership: Optimize regional resources, support workforce planning, develop talent, and strengthen multidisciplinary collaboration across sectors and offices. 
 - Risk, Quality & Compliance: Ensure effective project governance, technical assurance, contractual compliance, quality, safety, and proactive management of project risks and escalations. 
 - Delivery Excellence: Drive standardization, technical excellence, innovation, digital delivery, and continuous improvement across the regional portfolio. 
 - Leadership & Reporting: Provide senior leadership with clear visibility of operational, financial, project, people, and client performance, including corrective actions where required. 
Experience: 

- 15-20 years of relevant experience in engineering, design, project delivery, or technical leadership within the AEC industry. 
 - Significant experience in the design and delivery of data centers, mission-critical facilities, hyperscale facilities, colocation facilities, or other complex critical infrastructure projects. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams on large and complex projects. 
 - Strong understanding of the complete project lifecycle, from feasibility and concept through detailed design, construction, commissioning, and handover. 
 - Demonstrated knowledge of critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical, controls, fire protection, civil, structural, and digital/BIM systems. 
 - Experience with projects delivered through EPC, design-build, traditional design-bid-build, or other integrated delivery models. 
 - Experience working with global and geographically distributed design and delivery teams. 
 - Proven ability to manage technical risks, interfaces, scope, quality, schedule, and client expectations. 
 - Experience supporting business development, proposals, technical presentations, and client pursuits. 
 - PMP or other relevant professional certification is preferred. 
Why Join AECOM: 

AECOM is a global leader in engineering, design, and construction services, offering exceptional career opportunities and a collaborative, high-performance work environment. data.title: QA Associate - Prior Authorization
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a QA Associate - Prior Authorization to join our team and ensure the quality, accuracy, and compliance of our prior authorization processes. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing, auditing, and improving prior authorization workflows, with a focus on validating that all prior authorization requests are processed in accordance with industry guidelines and company standards. You will work closely with healthcare teams, insurance payers, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure that our prior authorization system runs efficiently, delivers high-quality outcomes, and supports patient care. 

Responsibilities: 

● Quality Auditing: Perform regular audits of prior authorization requests to ensure they meet required medical necessity criteria and insurance guidelines. 

● Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to enhance the quality and efficiency of the prior authorization process and collaborate with the team to implement improvements. 

● Documentation Review: Ensure that all prior authorization documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant with healthcare regulations (e. g. , HIPAA, payer-specific requirements). 

● Compliance Monitoring: Monitor the accuracy and compliance of prior authorization requests in line with internal policies and external regulations. 

● Collaboration with Teams: Work closely with healthcare providers, insurance payers, and internal teams to resolve any issues, denials, or discrepancies in prior authorization requests. 

● Reporting & Tracking: Maintain detailed records of audits, tracking the outcomes of quality assurance checks, and report findings to management. 

● Trend Analysis: Identify recurring issues or bottlenecks in the prior authorization process and work with the team to address systemic challenges. 

● Continuous Improvement: Support ongoing training for the team to ensure understanding and adherence to quality standards in prior authorization practices. 

● Feedback & Recommendations: Provide feedback to internal teams to improve the accuracy, completeness, and efficiency of prior authorization submissions. 

● Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations such as HIPAA, SOC 2, and any payer-specific guidelines or standards during all stages of prior authorization processes. 

Qualifications

● Experience: Minimum of 0-2 years of experience in prior authorization processes, healthcare administration, or quality assurance in a regulated environment. 

● Knowledge of Healthcare & Insurance: Strong understanding of insurance policies, reimbursement processes, medical necessity criteria, and regulatory standards affecting prior authorizations. 

● Attention to Detail: High level of attention to detail and the ability to accurately review and process complex documentation. 

● Process-Oriented: Strong ability to follow defined procedures and standards while identifying areas for improvement. 

● Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in using EMR systems (e. g. , Epic, Cerner) and prior authorization platforms. Familiarity with QA tracking tools and reporting systems , Cover My meds , Evicore. 

● Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with healthcare teams and external stakeholders. 

● Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, able to identify issues and propose practical solutions. HIPAA & Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of HIPAA regulations and healthcare compliance standards. 

● Preferred Certifications: Certification in Healthcare Administration, Medical Coding, or Quality Assurance is a plus.

Whether you're working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores-TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you'll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family-a Fortune 100 company and the world's leading off-price retailer. 

Job Description

Staff Engineer (Quality/Test Automation Engineer) - Enterprise Business Technology (EBT) Team

Discover a workplace with an inclusive culture and abundant career growth opportunities at TJX India, a Fortune 100 NYSE-listed company. Join our truly global IT Organization that collaborates seamlessly across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia in a challenging, collaborative and a team-based environment. 

The Enterprise Business Technology team is responsible for delivering and supporting global solutions across Human Capital Management (HCM), Corporate Financial Systems, Site Solutions and Compliance, and Corporate Responsibility & Sustainability. We advance TJX's strategic and operational objectives by implementing and managing a portfolio of SaaS platforms, commercial off‐the‐shelf applications, and custom-built solutions that provide critical capabilities for our business. Our partners across the organization rely on these systems to achieve business goals, maintain operational excellence, and meet regulatory and compliance requirements. 

Our team consists of over 100 Associates located across the globe, with plans to increase it now through expansion in our India office. Expanding TJX's presence in India will bring knowledge and expertise, local leadership and decision making, enabling us to deliver the right work, at the right time, in the right way. 

We are seeking a highly skilled, goal-oriented Staff Quality Engineer to join our team. As a Staff Quality Engineer, you'll provide technical leadership and strategic direction for enterprise‐scale quality engineering across multiple applications and domains. This role designs and drives end‐to‐end test automation strategies, advances automation frameworks (including Tricentis Tosca), AI use cases, and influences how quality is embedded throughout the SDLC using DevSecOps best practices. Acting as a subject‐matter expert, you'll partner with Product, Engineering, Business, and Enterprise Automation teams to identify complex automation opportunities, guide architectural decisions, and prove new technologies through POCs. Beyond hands‐on automation, you'll mentor and coach QE engineers, lead complex defect triage and quality planning, and ensure alignment between quality outcomes, platform roadmaps, and enterprise delivery goals. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test cases using Tricentis TOSCA. 
 - Analyze business and technical requirements to identify and prioritize automation opportunities. 
 - Deliver end‐to‐end automation coverage across functional, regression, and integration testing. 
 - Maintain, enhance, and optimize reusable TOSCA modules, components, and automation assets. 
 - Execute automation test suites, analyze results, and perform defect triage and root‐cause analysis. 
 - Collaborate closely with Development, Product, Business, and cross‐functional testing teams to ensure high‐quality delivery. 
 - Support automation activities during releases, including validation and sign‐off. 
 - Maintain test artifacts, execution reports, dashboards, and supporting documentation. 
 - Conduct proof‐of‐concepts (POCs) for complex automation scenarios. 
 - Communicate QE status, progress, issues, risks, and mitigation plans clearly and timely to the key stakeholders and broader team. 
 - Partner with the Enterprise Test Automation Team to define and refine automation frameworks and approaches. 
 - Review and provide first‐level signoff on automation output to ensure accuracy and completeness. 
 - Maintain and expand automation regression suites across multiple applications and functional domains. 
 - Develop QE project plans and track quality‐engineering progress against established milestones. 
 - Coach and mentor QE team members, contributing to capability development and best‐practice adoption. 
 - Perform highly complex testing to ensure systems are implemented and functioning as designed. 
 - Create comprehensive test plans and test cases for complex projects using business requirements and technical design documentation. 
 - Execute complex test cases both manually and through automation as needed. 
 - Lead defect triage for complex issues, including assessment, documentation, and retesting; act as a subject‐matter expert in specialized testing areas. 
 - Lead future automation technology enablement and AI use cases to drive efficiency and acceleration of delivery. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent IT experience
 - 10+ years in IT, with 8+ years in QA automation and development. 
 - Strong proficiency in Tosca, CI/CD integration (Jenkins), cloud technologies, version control (Git), and test data management.

About Role

- We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the global YourCause engineering organization at Blackbaud. This leader builds and develops a strong engineering leadership team, balances rapid growth with the reliability that large enterprise customers expect, uses AI to accelerate delivery and raise quality, and holds the organization to a high bar for technical excellence and operational reliability. 

About The Team

- YourCause is Blackbaud's corporate social responsibility platform and is a key part of Blackbaud's product portfolio. Teams plan and deliver on a SAFe cadence with a monthly release train. You report to the Senior Director of Engineering for YourCause and Financials & Grantmaking and partner daily with the pillar's Product leader. 

What You'll Do

- Build, mentor, and inspire diverse, high-performing engineering teams and leaders across application development, fostering an inclusive environment where individuals thrive and grow. 
 - Cultivate a culture of continuous learning and innovation - leveraging AI to accelerate delivery and improve quality, and encouraging the team to actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve to enhance product capabilities and operational efficiency. 
 - Shape and execute technical strategy in close partnership with Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, and other key stakeholders, aligning technology roadmaps with business priorities and adapting to evolving industry practices. 
 - Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery by guiding teams to plan with clarity, mitigate risks early, and experiment responsibly, while fostering clear accountability for commitments. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery from development through operations, embedding security, reliability, and automation, and serve as the engineering escalation point for production-impacting incidents and key customer events, including root-cause communication to enterprise customers. 
 - Build a data-driven culture where metrics inform decisions and shape strategic change. 
 - Partner with Security, Compliance, and Payments to meet the control obligations that come with moving money to nonprofits at scale and handling employee data for global enterprise customers: payment controls, nonprofit vetting and sanctions screening, SOC reporting, and data privacy. 
 - Serve as the engineering counterpart to our largest enterprise customers on integrations, data services, and commitments, alongside Product and Customer Success. 
 - Play a hands-on role in shaping the India site as it scales - helping build the culture, talent, and operating rhythm that will define it for years to come. 

What You'll Bring

- 15+ years of relevant professional experience, including 10+ years in engineering leadership roles and direct experience managing managers. 
 - 7+ years delivering SaaS solutions at scale, with proven expertise in end-to-end delivery from development through operations meeting customer expectations and operational SLAs. 
 - Experience leading large, globally distributed engineering organizations, including people managers, and overseeing teams of 40+ engineers and architects. 
 - Strong ability to communicate a clear technical vision and influence strategic decisions, bridging complex engineering concepts with business priorities for stakeholders at every level. 
 - Demonstrated fluency with AI-driven development tools and practices, and a track record of leading teams through adoption and embedding AI into their workflows. 
 - Experience leading teams in SAFe or a comparable agile framework. 
 - Experience building enterprise B2B SaaS used by large corporations, including enterprise integrations (single sign-on, HRIS and payroll), multi-tenant scale, and seasonal peak load, strongly preferred. Experience with payments or money-movement systems is a plus.

data.description:

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist

In This Role, You Will

- Own service readiness and operational governance by defining and tracking NFRs and maintaining runbooks, SOPs and operational artefacts 
 - Oversee operational readiness reviews to confirm production standards are met and risks are managed before release 
 - Deliver continuity through backup and restore and DR planning including regular testing, validation of RTO and RPO targets and remediation actions

 - Reduce operational toil through automation for checks, patch orchestration, reporting and evidence capture using PowerShell, Bash, Ansible and Python

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: 

- Bring substantial experience in platform engineering, infrastructure or cloud operations, SRE or production support with strong incident, problem and change management discipline 
 - Demonstrate hands-on experience operating GCP infrastructure at scale including IAM, networking and observability 
 - Show strong Kubernetes experience, ideally GKE, including cluster lifecycle management and troubleshooting

 - Build and maintain automation using PowerShell, Bash, Ansible and Python

We are looking for a skilled Java Full Stack Developer with 4-6 years of hands-on experience to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in core Java and enterprise application development, along with practical exposure to AI/ML integration, such as working with LLM-based APIs, AI-assisted coding tools, or embedding intelligent features into applications. This is a great opportunity to grow technical depth while working on modern, scalable systems that blend traditional backend engineering with emerging AI capabilities. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain Java applications using monolithic and microservices. 
 - Write clean, efficient, and well-tested code following best practices and design patterns
 - Collaborate with team members to translate business requirements into technical solutions
 - Integrate AI/ML capabilities into existing or new applications (e. g. , LLM APIs, recommendation engines, intelligent automation, chatbots, or AI-assisted features)
 - Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions
 - Work with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and cloud deployment

Required Skills & Experience

 - Hands-on experience with Spring / Spring Boot framework
 - Experience with RESTful API design/development; exposure to microservices architecture is a plus
 - Proficiency with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and/or NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra)
 - Working knowledge of message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar) is a plus
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
 - Working knowledge of containerization tools like Docker, exposure to Kubernetes is a plus

 - Building or integrating AI-powered features (chatbots, recommendation systems, intelligent search, document processing)
 - Basic understanding of ML concepts or prompt engineering is a plus
 - Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design
 - Experience with version control systems (Git) and Agile/Scrum methodologies
 - Working knowledge of at least one frontend framework - React or Angular - for building or integrating with UI layers
Soft Skills

- Good problem-solving and analytical thinking
 - Strong communication skills to collaborate across cross-functional teams
 - Willingness to learn and adapt to evolving AI-driven development practices
 - Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Educational Qualification

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

We believe great work begins with great people. That's why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work-because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. 

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights-personally and professionally. 

One Team

From day one, you'll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. 

What You'll Do

Lead the service transformation teams

Build and manage small, high-ownership squads responsible for converging duplicated product capabilities into shared, domain-oriented services. Own the delivery cadence, quality, and predictability of a multi-year transformation executed in steady quarterly increments with clear boundaries, owners, and cutover plans. 

Turn architecture into shipped services

Partner with principal engineers and staff engineers to translate target architecture, service boundaries, migration seams, and compatibility strategies into sequenced, executable plans your teams can implement safely. Your job is to make the architecture real: prioritized, staffed, de-risked, and delivered. 

Establish the base service tier

Drive the standards for how shared services are designed, contracted, versioned, documented, and consumed, so that every ABC application - and the AI agents and partners building on top of them - can rely on one consistent capability layer. Ensure services are designed for both human and machine consumption from day one, with structured contracts that agents can use reliably. 

Protect compatibility and business continuity

Convergence only counts if customers never feel it. Lead teams through incremental strangler-style migrations, staged cutovers, dual-running periods, and post-cutover hypercare. Existing behavior, reporting, and integrations keep working until each consumer has safely moved. 

Modernize the application foundations

Guide the movement of business logic out of legacy, database-centric implementations into testable, cloud-native services on our target stack. Retire duplicated builds, legacy dependencies, and aging infrastructure as consumers cut over. 

Raise the bar for engineering quality

Build quality in as a system, not a stage. Establish a software-factory approach where every change moves through automated validation loops - layered validators for scope, contracts, parity, runtime behavior, and user experience - that produce evidence of correctness rather than claims of completion. Design the pipeline so that failures are detected, diagnosed, and corrected in-loop before work integrates, and so that each converged service ships with a durable, inspectable evidence trail. The goal is simple: ship quality software, quickly. 

Drive AI-native ways of working

Enable your engineers to use AI across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation. Turn promising individual uses into repeatable team practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation. 

Make AI the way your team works: engineers direct agents across code comprehension, design exploration, implementation, migration analysis, test generation, and documentation, and the factory's validation gates - not manual inspection - prove every change correct. Turn what works into repeatable factory practices, so a small squad can credibly take on a portfolio-scale transformation. 

Hire and grow strong engineers

Recruit, coach, and develop engineers who are comfortable working across legacy code and modern service design. Set clear expectations, give honest feedback, and build a culture of ownership, craft, and follow-through. 

Partner across the program

Work closely with product, program leadership, principal engineering, SRE, security, and data teams to sequence domains by customer impact and technical dependency, surface risk early, and keep cross-team commitments visible and managed. 

What This Is Not

This is not an architecture-only or people-only role. You are expected to engage credibly with design and delivery detail, challenge weak technical assumptions, and be accountable for outcomes - while your engineers own the code. 

This is not a greenfield platform build. The value of this work is measured by safely converging live, revenue-critical systems onto shared services, not by producing new frameworks. Decisions must balance long-term platform quality with migration safety, business value, and the realities of changing production applications. 

This is not a big-bang rebuild or a customer migration program. The transformation is evolutionary: systems stay releasable throughout, and customers experience better capabilities, not disruptive migration events. 

What You Bring

Proven engineering leadership

Substantial experience leading backend or platform teams delivering complex, high-throughput production systems, with direct accountability for delivery, quality, and team health. 

Service transformation depth

Experience decomposing monoliths, extracting services, and defining domain boundaries, ownership models, and migration strategies within complex existing environments - and delivering those migrations to production. 

Credible backend and distributed-systems fluency

Enough hands-on depth - in Java and Spring or comparable enterprise backend ecosystems - to review designs, ask the hard questions, spot risk in implementation plans, and unblock your teams. You don't need to write the code, but you need to earn the room. 

Migration safety instincts

You understand compatibility strategies, staged rollout, data migration, dual-running, rollback, and the operational realities of moving live traffic and data between systems while preserving historical, reporting, and audit needs. 

Quality and operational discipline

You treat automated testing, code review, observability, dependency health, secure coding, and production validation as essential parts of how software gets built - and you hold that bar for your teams. 

People development

You hire well, coach deliberately, develop engineers into stronger versions of themselves, and manage performance honestly and with care. 

Cross-functional execution

You create clarity across teams, communicate technical risk in business terms, sequence work against dependencies, and help stakeholders converge on decisions they can execute. 

An opportunity-focused approach to AI-assisted engineering

You actively look for ways AI can expand your team's leverage across code comprehension, implementation, refactoring, test generation, and planning - and you help turn those into repeatable practices that make strong engineers more effective. 

Bonus Points

Experience modernizing large Java and Spring estates, including runtime and framework upgrades. 

Experience with Oracle or other enterprise relational databases, Kafka or similar messaging systems, and complex data migration or reporting dependencies. 

Experience delivering shared or platform services consumed by multiple product teams, including versioning, deprecation, and consumer migration done well. 

Experience with cloud migrations (especially AWS) and decommissioning legacy infrastructure or data centers. 

Experience designing APIs and services for agentic or LLM consumption (MCP or similar frameworks). 

Experience leading teams through the adoption of AI coding assistants or agents in day-to-day engineering. 

What Success Looks Like

The base service tier becomes real

Shared services ship on a steady, predictable cadence. Each is adopted across every in-scope ABC application, and the duplicated product-specific builds behind them are retired - reducing cost, complexity, and maintenance burden with every domain delivered. 

Convergence advances without destabilizing the business

Every cutover has clear boundaries, sequencing, ownership, safety controls, and hypercare. Customers never experience a migration event; they simply get a better, more consistent platform underneath the products they already use. 

The platform compounds

New capabilities are built once and land everywhere. Products, AI agents, and partners all consume the same well-governed capability layer, and each converged domain makes the next one faster and safer to deliver. 

The team gets stronger

Engineers grow in scope and skill, quality practices become consistent, AI leverage becomes normal working practice, and the team becomes a model for how ABC delivers complex platform change. 

Why This Matters

Everything ABC is building - the unified member experience, embedded AI, the agent ecosystem, and the open platform - stands on the shared service tier this role delivers. The transformation succeeds only if these services are well-designed, safely landed, and genuinely adopted. 

This role connects platform strategy with team leadership and hands-on delivery. Done well, it turns a portfolio of parallel products into one platform: capabilities built once instead of three times, engineering effort shifted from duplication to innovation, and a foundation strong enough to carry everything ABC builds next. 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: 

- Purpose led company with a Values focused culture - Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
 - Time Off - competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
 - 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect - once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
 - Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500, 000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
 - Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
 - Best Life Perk - we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
 - Premium Calm App - enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
 - Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don't just build technology-we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement. 

ABC'S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn't just the right thing to do-it's a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness. com. 

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients. 

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at abcfitness. com

data.title: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA
data.description:
Position: Senior Testing Lead - Automation, Performance, Security & Functional QA

Location: Hyderabad ( 8 PM to 5 AM IST)

Work Type: Full-Time/Onsite

Experience: 8+ Years

PETADATA is looking for a highly experienced Senior Testing Lead with 8+ years of experience to own the overall quality strategy, build and scale test automation, and lead functional, performance, security, API, and data-validation testing for a data migration platform operating across cloud and on-premise environments. 

Roles & Responsibilities Quality Strategy & Leadership

- Own and define the overall QA and testing strategy across functional, automation, performance, security, and data-integrity testing. 
 - Establish quality gates, release criteria, testing standards, metrics, and reporting. 
 - Identify and prioritize testing efforts based on business and technical risk, especially data-correctness risks. 
 - Build and manage the quality function with minimal supervision. 
 - Mentor developers and QA engineers and promote a quality-first engineering culture. 
 - Partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, Architecture, Security, and Implementation teams. 

Test Automation

- Design and build test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Develop automated UI, API, integration, and regression testing solutions. 
 - Use tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, and REST/API automation frameworks. 
 - Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Build scalable regression suites that improve release velocity and confidence. 
 - Use programming languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java for automation. 

Functional & Migration Testing

- Own end-to-end functional testing across supported CRM platforms and migration scenarios. 
 - Test standard and custom objects, relationships, transformations, mappings, and edge cases. 
 - Design test scenarios based on real-world customer data migration use cases. 
 - Validate migration correctness from source to destination. 
 - Test multi-tenant behavior, configuration, and tenant data isolation. 
 - Identify defects and ensure issues are properly investigated, resolved, and prevented from recurring. 

Data Validation & Integrity

- Build automated source-to-target data validation frameworks. 
 - Validate: 
 - Record counts 
 - Field-level accuracy 
 - Data mappings 
 - Relationships and associations 
 - Transformations 
 - Deduplication 
 - Overall data integrity 
 - Use SQL and programmatic validation techniques to verify migration results. 
 - Ensure migrated customer data remains complete, accurate, and consistent. Performance Testing

- Design and execute load, stress, scalability, and performance testing. 
 - Test large data volumes and high numbers of concurrent migrations. 
 - Establish performance baselines, benchmarks, and SLAs. 
 - Identify performance bottlenecks and work with Engineering and Architecture teams to resolve them. 
 - Use tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust. 
 - Integrate appropriate performance testing into the CI/CD pipeline. 

Security Testing

- Perform and coordinate security testing across the application and platform. 
 - Test tenant isolation and ensure no cross-tenant data access is possible. 
 - Validate authentication and authorization controls. 
 - Perform input validation and abuse-case testing. 
 - Integrate SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD. 
 - Coordinate penetration testing with internal security teams and external security vendors. 
 - Support security and compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001 through appropriate testing evidence. 

Technical Quality & Delivery

- Ensure software is secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready. 
 - Establish automated quality checks throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with developers to identify defects early. 
 - Review testing approaches and improve overall engineering quality. 
 - Support both cloud and on-premise deployments. 
 - Help establish reliable test environments using cloud, containers, and infrastructure automation. 

Note: Should be highly self-directed, comfortable building the QA function from the ground up, and able to work effectively with distributed engineering teams across required time zones. 

Note: Should be able to work independently and work in USA time zones

Required Skills

- 8+ years of professional QA / Test Engineering experience. 
 - Strong experience leading QA strategy and quality engineering for software products. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Proficiency with Playwright, Cypress, and/or Selenium. 
 - Strong API and REST testing experience. 
 - Strong programming experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience with functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Strong experience with performance/load testing using JMeter, k6, Gatling, Locust, or similar tools. 
 - Working knowledge of security testing, including OWASP, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, SAST, DAST, and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Strong SQL and data-validation experience. 
 - Experience validating source-to-target data integrity across multiple systems. 
 - Strong understanding of data migration, ETL, integration, or data-intensive applications. 
 - Experience testing multi-tenant SaaS applications. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with on-premise/customer-deployed software is preferred. 
 - Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar CRM platforms is a plus. 
 - Familiarity with Docker, containers, and IaC is a plus. 
 - Exposure to chaos/resilience testing or contract testing is a plus. 
 - Experience supporting SOC 2 / ISO 27001 or other compliance audits is preferred. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication, leadership, ownership, and decision-making skills. 
 - Ability to independently establish testing processes, frameworks, quality standards, and release criteria. 

Education

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. 

Candidates must attend phone/video calls and in-person interviews as required. After selection, candidates will undergo background checks on Education and Experience. 

Please email your resume to pavanm@petadata. ai

After carefully reviewing your experience and skills, one of our HR team members will contact you about the next steps.

data.title: Founding AI Voice Engineer
data.description:
[TW] Every 40 seconds, someone in the world dies by suicide. 

But long before that moment, there are often hundreds of smaller moments. 

A night when you can't sleep. 

A breakup. 

Anxiety before work. 

The feeling that you're losing control. 

Or simply a moment when you need someone to talk to and nobody is there. 

A therapist might be available in 6 month. 

A friend might be asleep. 

And sometimes, you don't want to talk to either. 

We believe there should always be someone there. Someone you can talk to at 2: 37 in the morning. That's what we're building. 

A voice-first AI companion for mental health and personal development, available to anyone, anywhere. 

And we're looking for a Founding AI Voice Engineer to build it with us from zero. 

What you own

You own the technology behind the product end-to-end: 

- Build and ship iOS & Android apps
 - Build real-time voice-to-voice AI agents for affective full duplex dialogue
 - Select and integrate the right LLMs and voice models
 - Build RAG, memory and context systems
 - Develop AI personas, behavior and conversational logic
 - Implement guidelines, guardrails and safety systems
 - Translate psychological frameworks into AI behavior together with experts
 - Build evaluation, monitoring and testing systems
 - Own backend, infrastructure and deployment
 - Optimize latency, quality, reliability and inference cost
 - Take the product from prototype → production → scale

Experience with clinical AI, mental health or digital health is not required, but a strong advantage. 

Who we're looking for

You've done this before. 

We're not looking for someone who wants to get into Voice AI. 

We're looking for someone who has already: 

- Built real-time speech-to-speech / voice-to-voice AI agents
 - Deployed them into real-world production environments
 - Worked hands-on with STT, LLM and TTS pipelines and/or native speech-to-speech models
 - Solved latency, interruptions, turn-taking and streaming
 - Built agents capable of handling long, dynamic conversations
 - Worked with LLM orchestration, RAG, memory and context management
 - Owned systems beyond the prototype - including deployment, monitoring, reliability and scale

You understand the difference between a voice demo that works for five minutes and a production voice agent people can actually use every day. 

How we workThis is early stage. 

No engineering team behind you. 

No product manager writing tickets. 

No six-week planning cycles. 

Plan in the morning. ship until the evening. 

We want someone who: 

- Works extremely hard
 - Moves extremely fast
 - Operates independently
 - Takes full ownership
 - Figures things out without waiting for instructions
 - Can go from idea to production
 - Cares deeply about what we're buildingYou will have enormous freedom and enormous responsibility. 

The missionWe are not trying to replace therapists. We want to make mental support and personal development available to anyone with a smartphone, regardless of geography, income or time of day. 

If we get this right, we can build something millions of people turn to when they need mental support and advice. 

If that's something you want to spend the next few years building, we want to hear from you.

data.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. 

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. 

A Brief Introduction To The Team

Expedia is transforming the way people search for and book travel. We create seamless and unforgettable experiences for traveller's, while driving success for our travel partners. At Expedia Group, the Book to Trip team plays a pivotal role in turning travel bookings into memorable journeys. We focus on delivering a secure, seamless booking experience and providing an always-on trip companion that enhances every traveler's journey, while maximising value for our partners and Expedia. As a core part of this broader team, the Reservations team manages bookings and provides reservation services across all Expedia Group point of sale. The platform is built on a modern microservices architecture and operates in the cloud using Amazon Web Services (AWS), ensuring scalability, resilience, and extensibility. We are currently driving a key initiative to make the reservation platform more flexible for product servicing, while continuing to uphold the highest standards of performance and reliability. 

In This Role, You Will

- Design, build, and evolve backend services in Java for core lodging reservations, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance in a high-revenue, business-critical domain. 
 - Lead migration of functionality from legacy monolithic systems and stored procedures into well-structured, Spring Boot-based microservices, including supporting API design, low-level design, and data modeling. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of service components in production, including implementation, deployment, monitoring, and incident resolution using cloud platforms and observability tools such as Datadog and Splunk. 
 - Analyze and improve interactions with RDBMS-backed data stores, refactoring database logic away from stored procedures into robust service layers while maintaining correctness and system integrity. 
 - Collaborate with engineers across levels to drive technical decisions, code quality, and best practices in backend engineering, ensuring solutions remain maintainable and extensible across adjacent domains. 
 - Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‐enabled tools and solutions in the development lifecycle and production workflows to improve engineering velocity, quality, and operational outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 6+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on backend engineering using Java in production environments. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and implementing backend services, including system design (with low-level design), API contracts, and data modeling for RDBMS-backed applications. 
 - Practical exposure to at least one major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and associated services for deploying, running, and monitoring backend services at scale. 
 - Demonstrated responsibility for owning and supporting backend components in production, including working with monitoring, logging, and alerting systems such as Datadog or Splunk. 
 - Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products in the context of backend service development, testing, or operations. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep expertise in Java-based microservice development using frameworks such as Spring Boot, including experience modernizing legacy or monolithic systems into service-oriented architectures. 
 - Strong RDBMS experience that goes beyond basic CRUD usage, including working with stored procedures, performance tuning, and systematically migrating database-resident logic into application services. 
 - Experience building and operating large-scale, business-critical backend systems in a cloud environment (such as AWS), with a track record of using observability tooling to drive operational excellence and reliability. 
 - Demonstrated use of AI-augmented development or operations (for example, code-generation assistants, intelligent alerting, or anomaly detection) and the ability to safely integrate AI/ML‐enabled solutions into backend services to improve developer productivity, system stability, or customer outcomes. 

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https: //expedia. service-now. com/askeg?id=job_accommodation. 

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels. com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease. 

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup. com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https: //careers. expediagroup. com/jobs/. 

Equal Opportunity
