data.description:
Senior Software Engineer - Managed Threat Response

Bengaluru, India

About Mimecast

Mimecast is a leading cybersecurity company that helps organizations protect their people, data, and communications. With over 42, 000 customers worldwide, Mimecast has a long history of excellence in Data Archiving and eDiscovery and is recognised as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving Solutions. 

We are pioneers in Human Risk Management, recognizing that people are both an organization's greatest asset and its most significant security vulnerability. Our platform addresses the human element of cybersecurity through advanced threat detection, awareness training, Incydr risk management, and data governance. Our Governance, Compliance & Insight products play a critical role in this mission, ensuring that communications data is archived, discoverable, and compliant, enabling organizations to manage the risk that stems from human actions. 

AI-First Engineering at Mimecast

Mimecast is an AI-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for leaders who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working. 

Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Our Mihra AI agent delivers 7x faster threat response for customers, and we're recognized as "Agents of Change" in Human Risk Management. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI tooling and AI-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide. 

The driving force behind Collaboration Security at Mimecast

Dive into the forefront of innovation with our Managed Threat Response engineering team, where we build the platforms that detect, investigate, and remediate threats on behalf of our customers. Our products leverage the latest technologies and advances in Artificial Intelligence to stay one step ahead of cybercriminals - and we build them the same way. 

Why Join Our Team?

"At Mimecast we process over a billion emails and collaboration events every day, and our team is what stands between our customers and the threats hiding in that traffic. We are building an engineering team where AI is how the work gets done - not a side experiment. This role is for someone who has already made that shift and can pull a team along with them: lead the design, set the quality bar, and show others what good looks like. " - Hiring Manager

What You'll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer you will lead the engineering design for significant features and system areas across Mailroom and Threat Portal, with contributions into our Managed Email Incident Response and Remediation products. You will work as an AI-first engineer and deliberately raise the level at which the team around you does the same. Your responsibilities will include: 

- Lead the engineering design for significant system areas, from framing the problem through to a system running reliably in production. 
 - Design distributed components that stay available and scale horizontally, reasoning about failure modes - race conditions, partial failure, data consistency - before they reach production rather than after. 
 - Produce design documents others can build from, and model disciplined practice: comprehensive test coverage, proactive observability, and clear technical documentation. 
 - Use agentic AI development tools as your primary working method, and build out the team's practice around them - reusable workflows, context and prompt patterns, evaluations - so that AI is used rigorously rather than as a shortcut. 
 - Own the quality of everything you merge, regardless of what produced it, and set the standard the team applies when reviewing AI-generated code. 
 - Balance technical trade-offs against product and delivery commitments, and make that reasoning visible to Product and Engineering leadership. 
 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers deliberately through pairing, design review, and code review, and align stakeholders behind a technical direction the team can execute with confidence. 
 - Lead during critical incidents spanning multiple services - diagnosis, clear communication, and the preventive work that follows - and monitor resource usage for cost savings that do not compromise performance or reliability. 
 - Work with Product, Support, and other engineering teams to drive cross-team collaboration, and engage in Agile activities: backlog refinement, planning, design and code reviews, demos, and retrospectives. 

What You'll Bring

We are looking for a strong engineer first. Depth in any single framework or tool matters far less to us than how you think, how fast you learn, and the quality of what you and the people around you ship. 

- Deep expertise and system-level design judgement. Command of your core stack plus fluency in adjacent systems, and a track record of designing components whose failure modes, cost profile, and cross-service effects on reliability and security you thought about up front. 
 - A track record of shipping and owning. Around six or more years building production software, including system areas you owned through multiple iterations, real incidents, and the architectural changes that followed. 
 - Proven AI-first development practice, applied to others as well as yourself. Demonstrable day-to-day development with agentic coding tools rather than occasional autocomplete, plus evidence that you deliberately raised someone else's practice - workflows, tooling, patterns, or standards that others adopted and kept using. We work in Cursor, but we care that you have built this way, not which tool you used. 
 - Critical judgement over AI output. A working understanding of where these tools fail - hallucinated APIs, plausible-but-wrong logic, silent security and performance regressions - the discipline never to merge code you cannot explain, and the credibility to hold a team to that line. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one modern backend language, and evidence that you have picked up others quickly. Our stack is primarily Python and Django; deep experience is welcome, but demonstrated ability to become productive fast matters more. 
 - Practical platform skills. Relational data modelling and query performance (PostgreSQL or similar), distributed building blocks such as caching (Redis) and search engines (Elasticsearch), containerisation, CI/CD pipelines, and foundational AWS services. 
 - Influence, deliberate mentorship, and clear written communication. You bring others with you rather than working around them, you explain technical concepts credibly to non-technical stakeholders, and you collaborate well across a team distributed over multiple time zones. 
 - Nice to have: front-end experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular or React; Java; prior work in cybersecurity or email security; and hands-on experience building LLM-backed application features such as retrieval, tool use, or evaluation harnesses. 

What We Bring

Join our Managed Threat Response team to accelerate your career journey, working with cutting-edge technologies on projects that have real customer impact. You will be given first-class AI development tooling and the time and mandate to get genuinely good with it: we treat AI engineering capability as a skill we invest in and measure, and we judge engineers on the outcomes they ship and the quality they sustain - not on lines of code written. 

Mimecast offers formal and on-the-job learning opportunities and maintains a comprehensive benefits package that helps our employees and their family members sustain a healthy lifestyle. We believe in 'growth that's good', we have 'a culture that cares' and we are on a 'mission that matters'. 

Our Hybrid Model: We provide you with the flexibility to live balanced, healthy lives through our hybrid working model that champions both collaborative teamwork and individual flexibility. Employees are expected to come to the office at least two days per week, because working together in person: 

- Fosters a culture of collaboration, communication, performance and learning
 - Drives innovation and creativity within and between teams
 - Introduces employees to priorities outside of their immediate realm
 - Ensures important interpersonal relationships and connections with one another and our community!

Belonging at Mimecast

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That's why we're committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone - unless they're a cybercriminal, of course. 

We're proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we'd encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups. 

We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won't affect your application. 

Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law. 

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.

Strength in Trust

OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down-it should accelerate what's possible. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‐Ready Governance PlatformTM, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer with a passion for solving problems to join our agile Product Engineering team at OneTrust. Senior Software Engineers own the delivery of complex features end-to-end and are a go-to technical resource for their immediate team. 

Your Mission

Execution & Delivery

Quality & Craft

Mentorship

- Support the ramp-up and growth of Associate and Software Engineers on your team. 

You Are

A seasoned, fully-capable engineer who requires minimal day-to-day direction and only needs general guidance on genuinely new assignments. You proactively surface risks and ambiguity rather than waiting to be asked. You work independently on established types of work, taking ownership from design through delivery with limited need for oversight. You're not afraid to ask for input mainly when facing unfamiliar or ambiguous problems, where the right approach isn't yet obvious. Your passionate about flagging risks and open questions during planning or design, before they turn into issues later in the process

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field 
 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience on Core Java, Spring, Spring boot, hibernate, microservices and Kafka messaging. Also looking at experience on agentic platforms like Microsoft foundry, agent core, google vertex, Bedrock. 
 - Demonstrated experience owning complex features end-to-end in either frontend or backend systems 
 - Familiarity with a public cloud provider (Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS)

 - Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Devin, Windsurf, or similar) in a professional setting, with genuine enthusiasm for applying AI to accelerate and elevate day-to-day engineering work. 

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. 

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. 

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust. com/careers. 

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube
 - @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview. You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form. 

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. data.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Product Area Focus

Location: Noida/ Bangalore (Hybrid)

Summary Of Role

Sumo Logic's microservices architecture, hosted on AWS, ingests petabytes of data daily across many geographic regions in support of our planet-scale observability and security products, serving hundreds of millions of queries a day against thousands of petabytes of data. At that scale, every inefficiency - in code, architecture, or infrastructure - compounds into real cost. 

This role sits within the Product SRE organization, working alongside your global SRE team on your product area's reliability roadmap - with a mandate that leads with code as much as operations. You'll find where Sumo's systems are spending more compute, storage, or engineering time than necessary, and fix it in the code and architecture, not just the infra config, while also carrying the fuller SRE mandate - reliability, security posture, and improving the day-to-day experience of the engineers within your product area. You'll be part of a team that blends SRE and backend software engineering skillsets, partnering closely with product engineering teams across your product area. 

This is an engineering role - the work is about shipping code, architecture, and system-level changes that improve unit economics, not managing cost dashboards, tagging, or reserved-instance/savings-plan purchasing. 

What You'll Do

- Continuously discover cost and efficiency opportunities through production profiling, telemetry, cost data, capacity trends, and system-level analysis - across algorithmic inefficiencies, resource-heavy code paths, and architectural decisions - and turn ambiguous problems into prioritized engineering initiatives. 
 - Apply performance and capacity engineering techniques to understand CPU, memory, storage, network, and I/O behavior under real production workloads, and optimize the resulting resource footprint. 
 - Write production-grade code to implement the optimizations you identify - JVM/GC tuning, algorithmic and resource-efficiency improvements, re-architecting inefficient services - in systems that process petabytes of data daily. 
 - Define and track engineering efficiency metrics such as cost per GB ingested, cost per query, cost per event, resource utilization, or cost per customer workload, and translate the work into measurable impact for engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from problem discovery through design, implementation, rollout, and measurement - influencing teams where you don't have direct ownership - and help establish engineering patterns and practices that make cost and efficiency a continuous part of the development lifecycle. 
 - Partner with engineering teams in your product area to prioritize changes, and with developer infrastructure and Global SRE to align with the broader reliability roadmap. 
 - Participate in the SRE responsibilities for different product areas - SLOs, on-call, incident response, and blameless RCA - using those experiences to identify systemic reliability, performance, and efficiency improvements. 

What You'll Have

- B. Tech, M. Tech, or equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of industry experience with a demonstrated track record of ownership. 
 - Strong CS fundamentals - comfortable with algorithmic complexity, data-structure performance characteristics, and system design at scale. 
 - Ability to author production-ready code in at least one OO/systems language (Java, Scala, Go, C++, or similar) - depth of engineering ability matters more than which language. 
 - Experience with distributed systems and microservice architectures in production. 
 - Demonstrated track record of independently identifying ambiguous performance, scalability, or cost problems and driving engineering changes that produced measurable improvements in production. 
 - Strong ability to reason quantitatively about system behavior, capacity, performance, and cost, and use production data to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes. 
 - Working fluency with cloud infrastructure (AWS compute, storage, networking) - enough to reason about cost and architectural tradeoffs. 
 - Comfort moving across the stack, from application code to the infrastructure it runs on, to find root causes of inefficiency. 

Nice to have

- JVM tuning and GC optimization experience at scale. 
 - Exposure to cost-attribution/FinOps practices or tooling. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, or modern CI/CD tooling. 
 - Prior SRE experience - on-call, SLOs, incident response. 
 - Experience with streaming technologies (Kafka, Kafka Streams) or observability/security platforms. 

Why this role

- Visibility - Cost/efficiency work maps directly to metrics the business already tracks. 
 - Scope you define - you identify where the opportunities are rather than executing a fixed backlog. 
 - Real scale - systems ingesting petabytes of data daily and serving hundreds of millions of queries. 

About Us

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness-combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www. sumologic. com. 

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

data.description:
Description

Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon - the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future. 

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase - and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day. 

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product - we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership. 

We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build - the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design, build, and own software end to end - working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations. 
 - Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems. 
 - Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide. 
 - Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them. 
 - Own operational excellence for what you build - monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience. 
 - Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent. 

A day in the life

Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters. 

About The Team

Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on - and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers - a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
 - Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering in Test (SDET) to lead our quality engineering and test automation organization supporting endpoint management, device management, and enterprise SaaS platform solutions. 

This leader will be responsible for managing SDET and automation engineering teams, driving quality strategy, defining test architecture, expanding automated validation capabilities, and ensuring the delivery of secure, scalable, and highly reliable software.

Required Qualifications

 - Make explicit build vs buy vs reuse decisions for each use case, factoring in total cost of ownership and time-to-value.

 - Protect architectural integrity, with the authority to delay or reshape delivery where necessary to avoid unsustainable technical or cost debt. 
 - 
 - 3. Agentic system design & control 
 - Define how agents are scoped, constrained, monitored and governed within the organisation's risk appetite. 
 - Enforce non-negotiable principles, including: 
 - Scope containment and least-privilege access. 
 - Human-in-the-loop checkpoints for material or irreversible decisions. 
 - Failure-mode mapping and safe-fallback behaviours. 
 - Audit trails and traceability. 
 - Reversibility of actions where possible. 
 - 
 - 
 - 4. Operational responsibilities 
 - Define technical evaluation frameworks - how output quality, safety and business impact (including cost and efficiency) are measured before and after deployment. 
 - Ensure monitoring, alerting and observability are in place before go-live, including quality, latency, usage, cost and incident signals. 
 - Own technical risk assessments for every use case, with special emphasis on regulatory, privacy and safety risk. 
 - Review and approve all technical designs produced by Developers, ensuring alignment with architecture, security, cost and quality standards. 
 - Manage technical dependencies with data, infrastructure and security teams, ensuring smooth integration and sustainable operations. 
 - Lead technical incident response where AI solutions are implicated, ensuring root causes are addressed and learnings are fed back into patterns and standards. 
 - Continuously optimise model, infrastructure and integration choices for cost-effectiveness without compromising safety or required performance.

 - Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with a proven ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and navigate competing priorities. 

About The Job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way. 

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. 

We build intuitive, consistent search tools across Google Workspace (e. g. , Gmail, Drive, Chat, Calendar) to help over a billion users find content quickly, reliably, and confidently. We are driving a major strategic shift from keyword matching to advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) search leveraging semantic retrieval, natural language understanding, multi-modal search, and contextual recommendations to shape the future of productivity and collaboration. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of workspace search for over a billion active users. 

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products- Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world. 

Responsibilities

- Advocate a culture of data-driven improvement. Oversee system debugging, performance tuning, and technical debt management to ensure robust and reliable production environments.

 - Foster a high-performing and engineering culture. Provide active coaching, performance feedback, and personalized career development to empower engineers at all levels.

Job Title: Electronics & Controller Specialist

Location: Hyderabad (Onsite)

Working Days: 6 Days a Week

Client: Refroid Technologies (https: //www. refroid. com)

Company: At Refroid Technologies, we are pioneering next-generation liquid cooling solutions that redefine how data infrastructure operates. From hyperscale data centers to high-performance edge environments, our modular and efficient systems are engineered to reduce energy consumption, maximize performance, and contribute to a greener planet. 

Role Overview

The Electronics & Controller Specialist will be responsible for the design, development, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and validation of electronic control systems used in Refroid's cooling and thermal-management products. 

The role will involve close collaboration with Mechanical, Thermal, Electrical, Firmware/Software, Product Development, Manufacturing, Quality, and Service teams to develop reliable controller and electronics solutions for cooling equipment. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in programable logic controllers, industrial automation, sensors, control systems, PCB/electronics, communication protocols, instrumentation, and product testing. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Electronics Architecture & Product Development

- Design and develop electronic control systems for cooling and thermal-management products. 
 - Define electronics architecture for CDUs, cooling systems, pumps, valves, fans, sensors, actuators, and monitoring systems. 
 - Select appropriate microcontrollers, processors, sensors, communication interfaces, drivers, relays, power supplies, and other electronic components. 
 - Develop system-level block diagrams, schematics, wiring/interface diagrams, and electronics architecture documentation. 
 - Participate in new product development from concept through prototype, validation, and production release. 
 - Support Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Reliability (DFR) activities. 2. PLC-SCADA & Control Systems

- Develop and integrate programable logical controllers for cooling and thermal-management applications. 
 - Develop control logic for: 
 - Pumps
 - Fans
 - Valves
 - Compressors
 - Temperature control
 - Pressure monitoring
 - Flow control
 - Liquid level monitoring
 - Safety interlocks
 - Alarm and fault conditions
 - Implement closed-loop control strategies where applicable. 
 - Design, configure and deploy intuitive HMI screens and SCADA systems for real time monitoring. 
 - Work with PID/control algorithms for temperature, pressure, flow, and other process parameters. 3. Sensors & Instrumentation

- Select, integrate, calibrate, and troubleshoot sensors used in thermal-management systems. 
 - Experience with sensors such as: 
 - Temperature sensors
 - Pressure sensors
 - Differential pressure sensors
 - Flow sensors/meters
 - Humidity sensors
 - Liquid level sensors
 - Current/voltage sensors

data.title: Lead Mobile SDET
data.description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences. 

At OneSpan we are looking for a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) - a strong software engineer who specializes in test - to architect and own our QA automation frameworks and strategy across the entire Mobile Security Suite (MSS) SDK portfolio. Our Mobile Security Suite (MSS) spans multiple SDKs across iOS, Android, and server-side platforms (. NET and Java). 

This is a hybrid role: part hands-on automation engineer, part technical lead. You will work alongside our Android automation developer, manual QA engineer, and feature developers, contribute directly to test automation across all MSS SDKs, and design the frameworks, tooling, strategy, and roadmap that take our QA practice to the next level. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead Test Strategy: Assess current automation coverage across all MSS SDKs (iOS, Android, server-side), identify gaps, and define the testing strategy, tooling, and project setup needed to close them. 
 - Contribute Hands-On: Design, write, and maintain automated tests across iOS, Android, and server-side SDKs - using AI coding tools and partnering with feature developers on platforms where you need extra language or domain support. 
 - Own the Pipelines: Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines (YAML), Bash scripts, and Gradle builds across our multiple SDK pipelines to run automated suites, stand up local/test servers, and integrate with real-device testing cloud solutions. 
 - Drive Planning & Reporting: Prepare quality and coverage reports, and bring recommendations and next steps to quarterly planning with engineering leadership. 
 - Mentor the Team: Guide the automation developers, feature developers, and QA engineers who contribute to automation; help formalize processes, code review standards, and best practices. 
 - Keep Growing: Stay current with mobile and server-side testing tools and frameworks; proactively identify and fill missing skills or tooling gaps on the team. 

Required Technical Skills

- Automation Leadership: 6+ years in software test automation, including experience defining test strategy and leading or mentoring other engineers. 
 - Framework Architecture: Proven track record designing, building, and maintaining test automation frameworks and harnesses from the ground up - abstraction layers, reusable components, test data and fixtures - not just writing tests against an existing suite. 
 - Mobile Automation Expertise: Deep hands-on mobile test automation in at least one mobile stack - iOS (Swift, XCTest/XCUITest) or Android (Kotlin, Compose Test/Espresso/UI Automator) - with the ability to extend to the other and to server-side, using AI coding tools and feature-developer support to bridge gaps. 
 - Test Infrastructure: Builds and owns the test infrastructure that runs the suites, including integration with the third-party real-device cloud services we use for tests that need real hardware. 
 - CI/CD & Scripting: GitLab CI and YAML pipeline authoring, Bash scripting, Gradle. 
 - Version Control: Git and standard branching / pull request workflows. 
 - Comfortable working across a multi-language, multi-platform codebase and picking up a new language or framework when a project requires it. 

Nice to Have

- Server-Side: Java, Spring or Spring Boot, JUnit 4 and JUnit 5. 
 - . NET / C# experience, to extend automation coverage to . NET-based server components. 
 - Experience testing security-sensitive SDKs (e. g. , anti-tampering, threat detection, RASP) or working in a regulated / security-conscious product environment. 
 - Prior experience leading or building a QA automation function from an early stage. 

Soft Skills

- Strong leadership and mentoring instincts, with the ability to influence without formal authority. 
 - Clear communicator, comfortable presenting test strategy, status, and risks to management. 
 - Analytical and gap-driven - able to look at a large, multi-platform codebase and identify where quality risk actually lives. 
 - Eager to learn and self-directed in closing skill or tooling gaps.

You will architect and ship production-grade agentic solutions, mentor junior team members, and set technical direction for GenAI initiatives across the organization. 

Experience -8 to 12 yrs

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and productionize multi-agent systems - including planning, tool calling / function calling, memory, and orchestration - using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel. 
 - Develop RAG pipelines end-to-end: document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search (Azure AI Search / FAISS / pgvector), re-ranking, and grounding for agent knowledge. 
 - Integrate agents with enterprise systems and APIs via tool/function calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar connector patterns. 
 - Build and maintain LLM evaluation frameworks for agentic workflows - task-completion metrics, hallucination detection, trajectory analysis, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and A/B testing. 
 - Implement guardrails, safety, and governance for agents: prompt-injection defense, content filtering, role-based tool permissions, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and audit logging. 
 - Fine-tune and optimize LLMs where needed (LoRA/PEFT, prompt optimization, model routing, latency/cost trade-offs) on Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry. 
 - Design, build, and evaluate classical ML models (classification, regression, forecasting, NLP) where they complement agentic workflows. 
 - Own LLMOps/MLOps for the platform: experiment tracking, prompt versioning, CI/CD, observability and tracing (LangSmith, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry), drift monitoring, and retraining strategies. 
 - Collaborate with data engineers on data quality, availability, and governance across Azure Data Lake, Databricks, and Synapse Analytics. 
 - Translate ambiguous business problems into agentic AI solutions; present architecture decisions and results to senior stakeholders. 
 - Mentor junior data scientists, lead code/design reviews, and champion engineering best practices. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. 
 - 8-10 years of professional experience in data science / ML, with at least 3 years building LLM or GenAI applications in production. 
 - Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent (at least one in production). 
 - Strong understanding of LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, agent memory, and multi-agent orchestration. 
 - Expert-level Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, async programming, API development with FastAPI). 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure services: Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, Azure ML, Azure AI Search, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or Synapse. 
 - Experience with vector databases and embeddings (Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS, or pgvector). 
 - Solid grounding in classical ML: supervised/unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and hyperparameter tuning; experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale data. 
 - Proven MLOps/LLMOps experience: MLflow, prompt/model versioning, CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), and production monitoring. 
 - Ability to evaluate and mitigate LLM-specific risks: hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, and cost/latency constraints. 

Good to Have

- Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), OpenAI Assistants/Agents SDK, or Anthropic tool-use APIs. 
 - Microsoft certifications: AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer), DP-100 (Azure Data Scientist Associate). 
 - Experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Phi) using LoRA/QLoRA and serving via vLLM or Azure ML endpoints. 
 - Familiarity with observability/tracing for agents: LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or OpenTelemetry. 
 - Knowledge of containerization and deployment: Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Azure Container Apps. 
 - Big data experience with Apache Spark (PySpark) via Azure Databricks. 
 - Experience with knowledge graphs, graph RAG, or semantic layers for agent grounding. 
 - Contributions to open-source GenAI/agentic projects or published technical content.

data.title: Lead Data Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Data Engineer

Overview

Mastercard powers the global economy by enabling secure, seamless, and intelligent payments across the world. Behind every transaction is a sophisticated technology ecosystem that processes billions of payment events with speed, resilience, and precision. 

As a Lead Data Engineer within the Data Collection & Engineering (DC&E) organisation, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling Mastercard's next-generation data platforms and analytical ecosystems. You will develop high-performance, cloud-enabled data pipelines that power Mastercard's enterprise data warehouse and lakehouse environments, enabling advanced analytics, business intelligence, regulatory reporting, and data-driven decision making across the organisation. 

This role offers a unique opportunity to solve large-scale data engineering challenges, work with cutting-edge big data technologies, and contribute to a modern cloud transformation programme supporting global payment processing platforms. 

Role

Data Engineering & Development

- Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality, secure, scalable, and resilient data pipelines using Apache Spark, Java/Scala across Hadoop and cloud-native object storage platforms. 
 - Build and maintain batch and near real-time data processing frameworks capable of supporting petabyte-scale workloads. 
 - Develop reusable engineering components and frameworks that accelerate data product delivery while maintaining enterprise standards. 

Architecture & Platform Engineering

- Design and implement a "build once, run anywhere" architecture supporting seamless deployment across on-premises and public cloud environments without code changes. 
 - Implement data lineage, metadata management, data cataloguing, data quality controls, and observability capabilities across the data ecosystem. 
 - Collaborate with architects and platform teams to establish scalable design patterns and engineering best practices. 

Cloud Modernisation

- Contribute to migration initiatives moving legacy ETL and data warehouse workloads from on-premises environments to cloud-native architectures. 
 - Leverage cloud services such as Amazon S3, EMR, Glue, and related data services to improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Drive adoption of modern lakehouse and distributed compute architectures. 

Delivery & Technical Leadership

- Lead end-to-end development activities including requirement analysis, solution design, coding, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers through code reviews, technical coaching, and engineering best practices. 
 - Partner with product owners, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions within committed timelines. 

Operational Excellence

- Troubleshoot complex production incidents and perform root cause analysis to identify and implement long-term remediation strategies. 
 - Ensure compliance with Mastercard's engineering, security, quality assurance, and operational governance standards. 
 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve performance, automation, monitoring, and process efficiency. 

Innovation

- Evaluate emerging data technologies and conduct proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives to determine their applicability within Mastercard's data ecosystem. 
 - Contribute to engineering innovation and continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation. 

All About You

Required Experience

- 10-12 years of experience delivering enterprise-scale Data Warehouse, Data Lake, or Data Lakehouse solutions. 
 - Proven experience implementing multiple end-to-end data engineering projects within large-scale distributed computing environments. 
 - Hands-on experience migrating ETL and analytics workloads from on-premises platforms to cloud-native environments. 

Technical Expertise

- Strong development experience using: Apache Spark, Scala or Java, Hadoop ecosystem technologies, Object Storage platforms
 - Experience building orchestration and workflow solutions using: Apache Airflow/ Apache NiFi and Similar enterprise scheduling frameworks
 - Strong SQL expertise and experience with Relational and NoSQL database technologies: Oracle/ SQL Server, Cassandra, Dynamo DB etc. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud platforms, preferably AWS: Amazon S3, EMR, AWS Glue, Cloud-native data services

Professional Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Experience operating within Agile delivery environments. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate within geographically distributed and matrix-based teams. 
 - Self-starter with strong ownership, accountability, and execution focus. 
 - Ability to learn emerging technologies quickly and apply them effectively to business challenges. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Guest Advisory Lead
data.description:
About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely. 

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers. 

Atlys is changing that. 

We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early. 

The Role

We're looking for a Guest Advisory Lead to lead a high-performing customer-facing team that turns traveller interest into confident decisions and successful conversions. 

You'll be responsible for leading, coaching, and developing the Guest Advisory team, while ensuring every customer receives clear, thoughtful, and personalised guidance. You'll set the standard for customer conversations, drive team performance, and ensure consistent ownership of the customer journey from the first interaction through conversion. 

This is a leadership role for someone who combines strong communication, commercial instinct, people management, and operational discipline, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. 

The Job

- Team Leadership & Performance: Lead, coach, and motivate the Guest Advisory team to consistently achieve customer experience and conversion goals. 
 - Customer Engagement: Oversee customer interactions across calls, chats, and email, ensuring travellers receive relevant guidance based on their travel needs. 
 - Conversion & Sales: Drive team performance across lead qualification, follow-ups, objection handling, and conversion while maintaining a customer-first approach. 
 - Coaching & Development: Conduct regular coaching, feedback, and performance reviews to improve communication, product knowledge, sales skills, and overall team effectiveness. 
 - Customer Experience: Ensure the team delivers clear, empathetic, and accurate guidance on Atlys products, visa processes, timelines, and next steps. 
 - Quality & Process Management: Monitor customer conversations and lead journeys to maintain high standards of quality, accuracy, ownership, and follow-through. 
 - Performance Tracking: Track key team metrics, identify performance gaps, and take proactive actions to improve productivity, conversion, and customer experience. 
 - Customer Insights: Identify recurring customer questions, objections, and pain points and turn these insights into actionable improvements for the team and business. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Fulfilment, Product, and other teams to resolve customer issues, improve processes, and strengthen the overall customer journey. 
 - Data & Operations: Ensure lead, customer, and interaction data is accurate and up to date, while maintaining strong operational discipline across the team. 

The Ideal Candidate

You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You

- Have 2+ years of experience in sales, pre-sales, customer success, customer experience, or another customer-facing role, with experience leading or mentoring a team. 
 - Have a strong track record of driving conversions, managing customer journeys, and achieving performance targets. 
 - Communicate clearly and confidently, with the ability to coach others and simplify complex information into easy, human conversations. 
 - Are empathetic and persuasive without being pushy, with a strong understanding of customer needs and buying behaviour. 
 - Are comfortable using data and performance metrics to identify opportunities and improve team outcomes. 
 - Are proactive, organised, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. 
 - Have strong ownership and problem-solving skills, and can step in to handle complex customer situations when required. 
 - Enjoy building teams, developing people, giving feedback, and creating a high-performance culture. 
 - Are comfortable working a 6-day schedule, with Monday to Friday in-office and a rotational WFH shift on either Saturday or Sunday. 

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure. 

What You Can Expect

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work. 

Here's What You Can Expect

- Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create. 
 - Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us. 
 - A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off. 
 - Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together. 
 - Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft. 
 - Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible. 
 - Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software. 
 - An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator. 

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront. 

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

Company Description ActionAid Association (AAA) is a national organization and an affiliate of the ActionAid International federation, a global movement advancing human rights and working to end poverty and injustice. Active in India since 1972, AAA operates through 12 regional offices across 25 states and one union territory, partnering closely with communities. As a non-profit, AAA focuses on building people's agency and solidarity at local, national, and international levels. Its vision is a world without poverty, patriarchy, and injustice, where every person enjoys the right to live with dignity. AAA's mission is to work with poor and excluded communities in their struggles to eradicate poverty, patriarchy, and injustice. 
Role Description The Team Leader - Face-To-Face Fundraising is a full-time, hybrid role based in Bengaluru South, with some work-from-home flexibility. In this role, the Team Leader will recruit, train, and supervise a team of face-to-face fundraisers, ensuring fundraising targets and quality standards are met. Day-to-day responsibilities include planning and executing fundraising activities in public spaces and events, setting individual and team goals, and monitoring performance and donor acquisition metrics. The Team Leader will support fundraisers in engaging potential donors, explaining AAA's mission and programs, and securing regular contributions in a professional and ethical manner. The role also involves coordinating schedules, maintaining accurate reports and donor records, collaborating with internal teams for campaigns and materials, and ensuring compliance with organizational policies and local regulations.

- Candidates should possess strong leadership and team management skills, including mentoring, performance monitoring, and conflict resolution. 
 - Candidates should possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage diverse audiences and build long-term donor relationships. 
 - Candidates should possess fundraising, sales, or field outreach skills, including goal setting, negotiation, and closing commitments. 
 - Candidates should possess organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage schedules, locations, reporting, and campaign execution. 
 - Candidates should possess basic data entry and reporting skills, with comfort using spreadsheets or CRM tools to track donor information and team results. 
 - Previous experience in fundraising, sales, non-profit work, or community outreach is highly desirable. 
 - A demonstrated commitment to social justice, human rights, and gender equality is beneficial. 
 - Minimum educational qualification: a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, preferably in social sciences, management, communications, or a related field. 
 - Ability to work in a hybrid model, be on the field in Bengaluru South regularly, and adapt to changing campaign needs.

data.title: Principal AI Architect
data.description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE

You will own the complete architecture for private and sovereign AI deployment at Trianz. This is not a cloud-API-consumption role. You will design the system that runs large language models inside customer environments -- choosing the right models, designing the serving topology, setting CPU and GPU routing policies, and ensuring the entire stack is secure, sovereign, and provider-agnostic. This is a pure IC role with architectural authority over how AI runs in production. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Design the complete private LLM serving architecture: model selection, serving framework (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton), and runtime topology. 
 - Define intelligent CPU vs GPU routing policies: which model sizes and prompt types route to which compute tier based on latency, cost, and throughput targets. 
 - Architect multi-cloud model serving: AWS, Azure, GCP -- provider-agnostic, no managed AI lock-in. 
 - Design on-premises serving for enterprise customers: RedHat OpenShift, VMware -- containerised model serving on customer hardware. 
 - Architect per-tenant model isolation, data-residency compliance, and air-gapped sovereign deployment patterns. 
 - Define the release architecture for model versions: rollout, staged deployment, rollback, and promotion gates. 
 - Design the LLM governance framework: model behaviour monitoring, inference audit logging, guardrail architecture. 
 - Design the DevSecOps pipeline architecture and self-service deployment automation standards. 
 - Evaluate open-source models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Phi) against closed models for specific enterprise use cases. 
 - Produce architecture sign-off documents and review all AI system designs before implementation. 

MUST HAVE

- Deployed LLMs to production in a real enterprise environment -- not just API consumption. 
 - Hands-on with vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or Triton in a production serving context 
 - Designed CPU cluster inference (Intel Xeon / AMD EPYC) for open-source models. 
 - Kubernetes at production scale (EKS, AKS, GKE, or OpenShift) -- not just local k8s. 
 - Designed multi-cloud, provider-agnostic AI architectures. 
 - Experience with model quantization (GPTQ, AWQ, GGUF) and routing trade-offs 
 - 8+ years in AI/software architecture with at least 3 years in production LLM systems. 

GOOD TO HAVE

- Experience with RedHat OpenShift for on-premises model serving. 
 - Familiarity with NVIDIA Dynamo, SGLang, or custom inference schedulers. 
 - GPU FinOps -- cost modelling for mixed CPU/GPU inference fleets. 
 - Sovereign AI or regulated-industry deployment experience. 
 - Intel OpenVINO or AMD ROCm for CPU-optimised inference. 

Company Overview

Trianz is an applied AI solutions company that accelerates customer business transformation through AI powered "Transformation Services as a Software Model". With 25+ years of transforming enterprises, we've evolved to a product-led, platform-driven organization serving global enterprises across Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare, Hi-Tech, Manufacturing, and other industries. 

With global presence across 4 continents, our platform portfolio under the unified Concierto brand delivers end-to-end transformations including solutions for Migrate, Manage, Maximize, Modernize, Insights & Agentic AI, and SecOps - delivered through strategic partnerships with leading hyperscalers. 

We're building the premier innovation-led organization in the digital transformation space through AI-first methodologies and data-driven excellence - RevolutionAIzing Transformations.

As AI continues to transform software engineering, you will also be encouraged to leverage AI-powered development tools, automation, and emerging AI capabilities to improve engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance code quality, and solve real-world engineering problems.

 - Architect and evolve event-driven systems using async messaging, queues, pub/sub, and streaming patterns to support high-scale, low-latency applications. 
 - Build and optimize RESTful and/or gRPC APIs that power web, mobile, and third-party integrations. 
 - Contribute across the stack when required, collaborating with React and Node. js services to deliver cohesive product features. 
 - Develop cloud-native services deployed on AWS, leveraging Kubernetes and Docker for containerized infrastructure. 
 - Optimize application performance, throughput, scalability, and reliability as product usage and customer scale increase. 
 - Implement strong testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and performance testing. 
 - Drive observability best practices including structured logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing, and alerting. 
 - Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to improving engineering standards and best practices. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-term systemic fixes. 
 - Design and implement AI-powered engineering workflows that improve software delivery velocity and engineering productivity. 
 - Develop agentic workflows capable of interacting with code repositories, ticketing systems, deployment pipelines, and engineering platforms. 
 - Evaluate and integrate modern AI technologies, frameworks, and tooling into the engineering ecosystem. 
 - Identify bottlenecks across the SDLC and implement AI-driven solutions that improve efficiency, quality, and developer experience. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-native software engineering practices and continuously improve engineering effectiveness across teams. 

REQUIREMENTS: 

Role: Lead Backend Engineer (Product Engineering) - final role will depend on candidate experience, credentials and interview outcomes

Experience: 8 - 18 Years

Education: Preferred - B. Tech/B. E/M. Tech/M. E/MCA/M. S

Technology Stack: 

(A) Core Engineering: 

Golang, Microservices, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, REST APIs, gRPC, System Design (HLD/LLD), Performance Optimization, Testing Frameworks, AI-Powered Development Tooling

(B) Good/Nice to Have: 

ReactJS, NodeJS, GraphQL

OTHER REQUIREMENTS: 

- Strong hands-on experience building production-grade backend systems in SaaS or product-based organisations. 
 - Deep expertise in Golang, including concurrency patterns, goroutines, channels, memory management, profiling, and performance optimization. 
 - Proven experience designing and operating scalable microservices and distributed systems. 
 - Strong understanding of API design, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and system reliability principles. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, or similar databases, including schema design, indexing, and query optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native application development. 
 - Strong experience implementing and improving CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, logging, tracing, fault tolerance, and production reliability.

data.description:
Who We Are Looking For

As an Engineering Manager for NIKE STORES Engineering team, you will be part of a highly visible, Engineering team passionate about aligning strategic objectives with tactical demands. You will be instrumental in creating a team with a strong focus on instilling trust, effective collaboration, high performance culture and mindset to exceed business expectations and outcomes. Ability to navigate in a complex matrixed organization and lead the team towards successful delivery and individual career growth. In this role we are looking for a high performing Engineering Manager to play a critical role in building Retail Commerce & NIKE CASH product capabilities. 

A successful Software Engineering Manager focuses on strategic impact, people management, knowledge management, business understanding and partnership, product thinking, and team empowerment and autonomy. You bring informed perspectives on AI and agentic engineering, and the ability to reason about architecture and platform trade-offs even when you are not writing production code daily. 

It is the Software Engineering Manager's responsibility to educate and align your reports on Nike's goals and objectives. Understanding Nike's strategies and objectives and communicating them to your reports will guide their overall success. 

In this role you will field the best team and be directly responsible for the well-being of your development squads. With regards to hiring, the Software Engineering Manager will decide the number, necessary budget and technical competencies of the development squads in their domain. This includes partnering with Nike's Talent Acquisition team and external suppliers to apply the best candidates given the needed capacity. 

As a people manager you will also coach, guide and drive your squad members. You will provide a culture of learning to ensure that team members are well equipped to successfully deliver working software. This includes preparing your team members for technology and strategic shifts within the broader Global Technology organization. 

You will develop the work plans, technical priorities and partner with Product Managers, Program Managers and Program to validate the correct amount of new product work and technical investment-balancing near-term delivery with 2-3 year strategic horizons, portfolio simplification, and

build/buy/partner/platform decisions. Finally, in your role you will be expected to resolve technical issues and business issues as necessary. In some cases, you may need to escalate these decisions to your leaders, but the Software Engineering Manager is expected to have the confidence and empowerment to make the right technical and commercial decisions. 

You will apply business and commercial acumen-understanding P&L and value drivers, cost of technology, ROI, marketplace dynamics, and vendor economics-to ensure engineering investments align with Nike's strategic priorities. You will model change and learning agility, staying current with emerging technologies (including AI and agentic systems) and preparing squads for shifts in tools, platforms, and ways of working. 

What You Will Work On

- Provide engineering leadership and best practices to continuously build new platforms and deliver working software. 
 - Contribute towards establishing best practices; drive collaborative review of design, code, test plan and dataset implementation performed by other engineers in support of delivering high quality product features. 
 - Responsible for driving excellence in Dev/Ops such as continuous integration, deployment, and improvement, test automation, instrumentation and observability, SLAs, high-availability, and improvement of ops metrics. 
 - Disseminate technical knowledge to the team members on emerging ideas through multiple forums (e. g. , user groups, tech talks, design reviews, internal blogs).

 - Make Hiring decision

 - Collaborate with upstream and downstream technical teams across Geos to develop integrations to provide a seamless flow from planning to delivery. 
 - Participating in the construction of new features and identifying areas for improvement proactively. 
 - The squad you lead will work on innovating, architecting, designing, and implementing highly available, scalable systems, focusing on highly visible marketing initiatives. 

Key Competencies

- Provide technical leadership and guidance to ensure high the delivery of high-quality work
 - Understands the pros and cons of different resourcing models and identifies the model that will provide the best results
 - Identifies opportunities to improve operational and squad-level processes
 - Develops resource plans to best apply engineering resources to the business priorities
 - Understands and tracks budgeting changes throughout the fiscal timeline
 - Develops technical roadmaps and partners with product to ensure an appropriate amount of technical investment at the squad level
 - Develops the technical, personal and communication competencies of every member of the development squad
 - Prepares and delivers performance management, performance ratings and annual pay reviews for all reporting full time employees
 - Develops trusting relationships by ensuring that squads deliver on commitments
 - Communicates relevant Nike strategies and objectives to the team in way that helps guide their success
 - Demonstrates depth in AI and agentic engineering concepts, tools, and operating models; guides teams on when and how to apply them responsibly in retail contexts
 - Brings technical depth across architecture, APIs, cloud, distributed systems, data, security, observability, and resilience; evaluates trade-offs with clarity and credibility

We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions-creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth-turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection. 

Position Summary

We are seeking talented Principal Engineers to lead the architectural vision and evolution of our SaaS platform into a modern, resilient, and AI-powered ecosystem. This role plays a critical part in shaping our long-term technology strategy, providing cross-team technical leadership, and ensuring our platform is secure, scalable, performant, and data driven. Principal Engineers work across product domains to design efficient, future-proof solutions that align with strategic objectives, proactively reducing technical roadblocks and coordinating dependencies across teams. 

A primary focus of this role is driving the technology roadmap for multiple banking products performing check imaging related services ensuring that they continue to evolve as a single unified, extensible platform of services with a shared architecture serving the needs of our customers who leverage our SaaS or Single Tenant Hosted offerings or choose to deploy in their own managed environments. We expect you will promote consistency, operational efficiency and accelerated innovation working with the multiple teams building this overall product platform or leveraging it thru integration of its services in more enriched offerings. You will work closely as well with Product Management and Engineering leadership along with Enterprise Architecture to deliver the check imaging services platform and to evolve it alongside other platforms and offerings within Candescent overall. Your involvement will extend into all areas of functional and non-functional requirements inclusive of DevOps and how we successfully operate our SaaS and Single Tenant Hosted offerings. You will apply your knowledge of financial document and check imaging devices and standards and their demands on solution architectures ensuring Candescent's imaging services platform delivers the best possible service levels with exceptional cost optimization. This is a highly collaborative and strategic role for a forward-thinking engineer who is passionate about building and sustaining platforms for scale and delivering long-term impact. This title may also be called Architect. 

Key Areas of Responsibility

- Define and drive platform architecture strategy focused on scalability, modularity, security, and resilience

data.title: Principal Engineer
data.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2, 500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories. 

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows-including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence-we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence. 

Principal Engineer - Backend

About Payoneer

Payoneer empowers businesses, professionals, and enterprises to participate in the global economy by enabling seamless cross-border payments and financial services. Our technology powers critical financial workflows at global scale, with a strong focus on reliability, security, scalability, and innovation. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Principal Engineer - Backend to provide technical leadership across Payoneer's backend engineering organization and help shape the next generation of our distributed financial systems. 

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture with strong product thinking and organizational influence. 

As a Principal Engineer, you will work on some of Payoneer's most complex technical challenges, define architectural direction, drive engineering excellence, and enable multiple teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient systems. 

The role also requires an AI-first mindset in identifying opportunities to use AI and agentic technologies to improve how we build, operate, and evolve our products and engineering systems. You will also help explore and build systems using emerging protocols and technologies such as MCP (Model Context Protocol). 

What You'll Do

- Define and drive the technical and architectural vision for large-scale backend systems and distributed platforms. 
 - Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and fault-tolerant distributed systems supporting Payoneer's global financial infrastructure. 
 - Solve complex technical problems spanning multiple systems, services, teams, and domains. 
 - Drive architectural decisions and establish engineering patterns, standards, and best practices across teams. 
 - Lead the evolution of backend platforms toward greater scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and developer productivity. 
 - Act as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering leadership, product leaders, and other stakeholders. 
 - Work closely with engineering teams to identify and address systemic technical challenges and technical debt. 
 - Champion an AI-first approach to software engineering, identifying opportunities to leverage LLMs, AI agents, automation, and intelligent developer tooling across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Explore, prototype, and drive adoption of emerging AI technologies, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-based architectures, where they can create meaningful business or engineering value. 
 - Partner with teams across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, data, and other functions to solve complex cross-domain problems. 
 - Influence technical strategy across multiple engineering teams and organizational boundaries, without relying solely on direct authority. 
 - Mentor and coach engineering leads, senior engineers, and architects, helping raise the technical bar across the organization. 
 - Help develop the next generation of technical leaders through architecture reviews, design discussions, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing. 
 - Establish and promote practices around engineering excellence, system design, reliability, security, testing, observability, and operational readiness. 
 - Lead technical initiatives that require coordination across geographically distributed and cross-functional teams. 
 - Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously evaluate how they can improve Payoneer's engineering capabilities. 

What We're Looking For

- Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and backend platforms. 
 - Strong expertise in backend engineering, system architecture, APIs, microservices, data-intensive systems, and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed transactions, messaging, event-driven architectures, and scalability. 
 - Proven experience leading architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or complex technology domains. 
 - Strong track record of taking ambiguous, complex problems and translating them into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Experience operating systems at significant scale with strong requirements around availability, performance, security, and reliability. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, observability, production operations, and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Experience with AI/LLM technologies and a demonstrated interest in building AI-first engineering systems and workflows. 
 - Familiarity with AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, agentic workflows, or similar emerging AI technologies is highly desirable. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence engineering and product decisions across organizational boundaries. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and technical leaders. 
 - Strong product mindset and the ability to balance technical excellence with business outcomes. 
 - Comfortable working in a globally distributed, cross-functional engineering environment. 

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means having an impact beyond the systems you directly build. 

You Will: 

- Shape the architecture and technical direction of critical Payoneer platforms. 
 - Enable multiple engineering teams to build and operate better distributed systems. 
 - Raise the technical bar through mentorship, architecture leadership, and engineering practices. 
 - Help Payoneer adopt an AI-first engineering culture and identify high-value opportunities for AI and agentic technologies. 
 - Drive successful adoption of emerging technologies such as MCP where appropriate. 
 - Improve the scalability, reliability, security, and efficiency of our platforms. 
 - Become a trusted technical partner to engineering, product, and business leadership.
