data.description:
Location: Satna, Madhya Pradesh, India

Ensure quality and manufacturing excellence in cables

Are quality, manufacturing excellence, and sustainable infrastructure important to you? As a Process/Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring that cables sourced from strategic supply chain partners meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. This is an opportunity to work directly at a supplier manufacturing facility, representing NKT on-site and contributing to critical cable solutions that support the global energy transition. Do you want to help ensure quality performance for infrastructure projects shaping a greener future?

Monitor manufacturing quality and process performance

As NKT's resident technical representative at a strategic supplier facility, you will oversee manufacturing activities, verify compliance with specifications, and support quality assurance processes. You will work closely with supplier and NKT teams to ensure products are manufactured according to approved processes, quality plans, and customer requirements while supporting efficient production and delivery performance. 

Your Responsibility Will Be To

- Monitor daily cable manufacturing activities and critical production processes
 - Verify machine settings, process parameters, and work instructions
 - Ensure compliance with NKT specifications, quality plans, and industry standards
 - Investigate quality deviations and support corrective actions using structured methodologies
 - Support Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma improvement activities while monitoring manufacturing KPIs

This is a resident position based at a supplier manufacturing facility in Satna, Madhya Pradesh, India. You will report to the relevant NKT function and collaborate closely with supplier and cross-functional teams. Limited travel is required. 

Quality-minded engineer with collaborative approach

You are a detail-oriented and motivated professional who enjoys working in a manufacturing environment and maintaining high quality standards. You are comfortable managing your own tasks while building productive relationships across teams and cultures. You approach challenges methodically, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and contribute positively to a collaborative working environment. You value continuous improvement and take a structured approach to identifying and resolving issues. 

You Also Have

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Materials Engineering
 - Minimum 5 years of experience in manufacturing, process engineering, or quality engineering
 - Experience within cable manufacturing or related industrial environments
 - Knowledge of quality management systems, SPC, process capability, FMEA, and root cause analysis
 - Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification

Contribute to greener infrastructure and global growth

We aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths-even if you don't meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment. 

This role offers the opportunity to work at the centre of manufacturing operations, supporting quality performance for critical cable projects that contribute to the green transition. You will be part of an international and collaborative environment where you can develop your technical capabilities, expand your professional experience, and work closely with colleagues and partners across functions and locations. 

Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!

We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 31st of October 2026. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail. We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions. 

Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!

About NKT

Join a diverse and international team within NKT's Grid Solutions business, supporting the delivery and operation of reliable power grids worldwide. We deliver HVAC onshore cable systems and provide specialist service for AC and DC cable systems onshore and offshore. As a global organisation with operations across Europe, Australia, the United States, and the Middle East, Grid Solutions works closely with customers around the world and across the full lifecycle of power cable systems. 

At NKT, we are all Connectors. We connect to develop leading power cable technologies that enable the world's transition to renewable energy - and we stay connected to grow as people and professionals. As a company, NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and plays a key role as the world moves towards clean energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling reliable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology, building the infrastructure from the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. 

NKT is headquartered in Denmark, operates from more than 30 countries worldwide, and employs 6, 500 people globally. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3. 6 billion in 2025. NKT - We connect a greener world. www. nkt. com

data.title: Lead Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Principal Lead Software Engineer (AI-Native)

Location: Hyderabad, India

Employment: Full-time · Early-stage, founder-led company

Compensation: As per Market Standards for this role

About Us

We are an early-stage company building applied AI products for complex professional workflows, including healthcare and legal. 

Our focus is practical: software that professionals can trust and use in their daily work. That requires more than an impressive AI demo-it requires reliable engineering, thoughtful user experiences, strong data foundations, and disciplined validation. 

We operate with a small team, direct founder involvement, and AI-assisted development as standard practice. Specific product details will be shared during the interview process. 

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader who can own multiple AI products end-to-end-not just an AI component, backend service, or prototype. 

You will take products from requirements and architecture through implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. The work spans AI-powered applications, voice and document workflows, knowledge systems, and the shared infrastructure supporting them. 

You will work directly with the founder, who leads product direction, priorities, and customer requirements. You will own engineering execution and technical decisions, enabling the founder to focus on product rather than daily code reviews, debugging, and integration management. 

This is a player-coach role: you will write production code, lead a small engineering team, and remain accountable for whether the complete product actually works. 

What You Will Own

- End-to-end product delivery. Turn product requirements into working applications across the frontend, backend, AI layer, data systems, and infrastructure. Own the complete user journey-not merely whether individual components run. 
 - Architecture and technical decisions. Choose appropriate technologies, define clear interfaces, and make practical build-versus-buy decisions. Build reusable capabilities across products without creating unnecessary abstraction or complexity. 
 - Applied AI engineering. Build and integrate LLM-powered features, retrieval and knowledge workflows, structured outputs, and speech or voice capabilities. Know when to use a model, conventional software, deterministic validation, or human review. 
 - Independent verification and release quality. Establish automated tests, AI evaluation suites, regression checks, and end-to-end acceptance tests. Reproduce failures, investigate root causes, and demonstrate fixes with evidence. Establish effective code review and quality gates without relying on the founder as the default reviewer. 
 - Reliable data and production systems. Turn imperfect source data into validated, traceable, versioned datasets and services. Own deployment, observability, error handling, recovery, latency, and operating costs. 
 - Security and responsible implementation. Build appropriate access controls, sensitive-data handling, audit trails, and safeguards. Work with domain experts to translate professional requirements into testable engineering behavior. 
 - Team leadership and execution. Break work into achievable milestones, delegate clearly, review critical changes, mentor engineers, and resolve integration blockers. Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs early-with working demonstrations and honest quality results. 

What We Are Looking For

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 4+ years owning architecture and technical decisions for production systems and 2+ years leading or mentoring engineers. 
 - Demonstrated full-stack ownership. You have personally delivered complete products across APIs, databases, user interfaces, integrations, and cloud infrastructure-not only contributed to a narrow layer. 
 - Production AI experience. You have shipped at least two AI/LLM-powered products or substantial features into real use. You can explain the reliability, evaluation, latency, cost, and operational trade-offs you encountered. 
 - Strong implementation skills. Expert-level Python, strong React/TypeScript, solid SQL and data-modeling skills, and hands-on experience with cloud deployment, CI/CD, and security fundamentals. 
 - Evidence of self-verification. You can show or explain a test or evaluation system you built, the failures it caught, and how you determined that a release was ready. 
 - Practical AI-native development experience. You actively use tools such as Claude Code or equivalent to accelerate delivery, while independently reviewing, testing, and taking responsibility for the resulting code. 
 - Independent engineering judgment. You can work through incomplete requirements, inspect actual data before making assumptions, diagnose unfamiliar failures, and make sensible decisions without constant technical supervision. 

Experience That Helps

Healthcare or legal experience is valuable, but not mandatory. Relevant experience includes: 

- Healthcare software, clinical workflows, EHR/EMR integrations, or applications handling sensitive health information. 
 - Legal technology, law-firm workflows, document-heavy professional systems, or confidential client information. 
 - Speech and voice products, including streaming transcription, speaker separation, multilingual audio, or code-switching. 
 - Founding-engineer roles, small-team product ownership, or products built for the Indian market. 

Our Technical Environment

Backend and data: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, vector search, Redis. 

AI: LLM APIs, retrieval/RAG, structured outputs, evaluation frameworks, and speech integrations. 

Frontend: React and TypeScript. 

Infrastructure: Cloud services, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, and automated quality gates. 

Development: AI-assisted coding, supported by engineering review and testing. 

You do not need prior experience with every tool. You do need the depth to own the system and learn unfamiliar parts without making the founder the integration layer. 

What Success Looks Like

Products work end-to-end in realistic user workflows-not just in isolated demos. Releases are supported by reproducible tests and meaningful quality evidence. Failures are identified and addressed before customers or the founder become the primary testers. 

The team delivers against clear milestones, raises risks early, and improves its ability to work independently. The founder can focus on what to build and why, while trusting you to lead how it is built, verified, and operated. 

What We Offer

Principal-level scope across multiple products, direct partnership with the founder, and the opportunity to shape architecture, engineering standards, and a growing team. 

You will have substantial technical ownership and a hands-on role in turning early products into dependable production systems. 

How to Apply

Send your résumé or LinkedIn profile to dinesh@astroum. ai, along with brief answers to these three questions: 

- What is a production system you personally owned end-to-end? Explain what you built, the decisions you made, and one decision you would change today. 
 - How do you verify your work without depending on someone else to catch your mistakes? Describe a test or evaluation harness you built, a serious failure it caught, and how you verified the fix. 
 - What have you recently shipped using AI-assisted development? Explain how you used the tools, where their output was wrong or incomplete, and how you made the final result production-ready. 
 - Public code, demos, or architecture examples are welcome but not required. Anonymized examples are fine; please do not share confidential employer or client material.

 - Exposure to various manufacturing processes - forging, hot and cold extrusion, cladding, HIP, induction bending etc. 
 - Exposure to welding codes and practices - ASME IX and API 1104. 
 - Exposure to NDE codes and practices - UT, PAUT, PT, RT, MPI per ASME V. 
 - Confidence to work globally, to escalate and to communicate directly with Senior leadership. 
 - Ability to manage the engineering projects within specified schedule and budget. Demonstrated organization and project planning skills. 
 - Accuracy, dependability, ability to manage schedule and prioritize work for self and others in team. 
 - Ability to design complex engineering plans and review design work for systems and products. 

Skills

Problem-solving Tools and Continuous Improvement Techniques

data.description:
Senior Software Engineer- DevOps for Workflow Innovation in Barco Control Rooms @Barco

BCR (Barco Control Rooms)

The Barco Control Rooms business unit is making workflow and visualization solutions for the Control Room market since 1994 to help operators collect, visualize and share critical information for optimal mission-critical decision making. Today, we are still the number one choice for control room professionals who want to stay on top of their situational awareness with 12000+ installations for critical infrastructure and critical operations. 

Senior Software Engineer - DevOps for Workflow Innovation @ Barco

We are seeking a hands-on DevOps Engineer to join the Barco CTRL Workflow Innovation team and support the development of a new AI-driven product from the ground up. The ideal candidate must have strong experience in GCP, cloud-native DevOps, and AI/MLOps practices, with proven ability to build reliable platforms, automation, CI/CD workflows, and deployment infrastructure for data and AI product capabilities. You will work with a globally distributed team to enable scalable, secure, and production-ready delivery of intelligent workflow solutions for Barco Control Rooms. 

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer - DevOps in the Workflow Innovation team, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the cloud-native engineering foundation required to develop, test, deploy, and operate AI-driven product capabilities for Barco Control Rooms. This is not a classical DevOps role focused only on build pipelines and deployments; it requires hands-on experience with AI/MLOps, cloud infrastructure, data/AI workloads, automation, observability, and secure production operations. The role will also support deployment patterns where AI capabilities may need to run closer to the operational environment, including Edge AI scenarios, hybrid cloud-edge architectures, and efficient inference workflows for mission-critical control room use cases. You will collaborate with cloud partners, product owners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, and validation teams across locations to enable fast, reliable, and secure delivery of workflow innovation capabilities. 

- Build and maintain cloud-native DevOps and AI/MLOps infrastructure for the Workflow Innovation product on GCP. 
 - Design and implement CI/CD workflows for backend services, data pipelines, AI/ML components, model integration, and GenAI-enabled capabilities. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, environment management, configuration, and deployment workflows using infrastructure-as-code practices. 
 - Enable deployment and operation of AI/ML workloads, including model serving, inference workflows, RAG-based components, vector search services, and related data/AI services. 
 - Support cloud-to-edge deployment and operational patterns for AI capabilities, including lightweight model packaging, inference deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management for Edge AI scenarios. 
 - Establish observability, monitoring, logging, alerting, reliability, and cost-awareness practices for cloud-native Data & AI product capabilities. 
 - Support secure handling of product data, secrets, access control, compliance needs, and cloud security best practices. 
 - Work closely with Data & AI engineers and product teams to improve developer experience, release readiness, test automation, and operational reliability. 
 - Guide and mentor fellow colleagues in DevOps, cloud, and AI/MLOps practices while contributing to technical discussions and engineering excellence. 

Qualifications and Experience

Education

We are seeking experience with the following technologies/domains: 

B. Tech. /B. E. /M. E. /M. Tech. in Computer Science/AI Engineering

Experience

- 6-9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud platform engineering, SRE, AI/MLOps, or related product engineering roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with GCP is required, including relevant cloud-native compute, storage, networking, IAM, observability, and deployment services. 
 - Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for cloud-native applications, backend services, data pipelines, and AI/ML workloads. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI/MLOps practices, including model deployment, model serving, inference workflows, experiment tracking, model versioning, and release automation for AI-enabled product features. 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and environment automation using tools such as Terraform, Helm, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Good understanding of cloud security practices, including IAM, secrets management, network security, secure deployment patterns, and least-privilege access. 
 - Experience setting up monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, SLO/SLA-oriented reliability practices, and incident response workflows. 
 - Exposure to data and AI platforms or services such as BigQuery, Vertex AI Vector Search, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub, vector databases, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience supporting RAG-based applications, GenAI-enabled services, model APIs, or AI inference platforms is highly desirable. 
 - Exposure to Edge AI concepts, hybrid cloud-edge deployments, on-device or near-device inference, model optimization, and operational constraints such as latency, reliability, connectivity, and resource usage is desirable. 
 - Good programming and scripting experience using Python, Bash, or similar languages, with ability to build automation and internal tooling. 
 - Understanding of DevSecOps practices, automated testing, quality gates, vulnerability scanning, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices. 
 - Ability to collaborate with cloud partners, architects, Data & AI engineers, developers, product owners, and validation teams across geographies. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset, ownership, operational discipline, and willingness to explore and adopt new technologies in AI, DevOps, and cloud engineering.

data.title: Automation Control Engineer
data.description:
About Agratas

Agratas is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons. We design, develop and manufacture high-quality, high-performance, sustainable batteries applied to multiple use cases in the mobility and energy sectors, to match our customers' requirements. 

Agratas is a scale-up business with a start-up mentality, driven by our pursuit of green growth and technological progress. 

We develop next-generation battery technologies at our state-of-the-art R&D Innovation Hubs in India and the UK. 

The Opportunity

We are seeking Automation and Control Systems Engineer to join our dynamic team in the battery manufacturing industry. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, development, implementation and maintaining automation systems and control strategies to optimize manufacturing processes, improve efficiency, and ensure high-quality production of battery cells. This role requires a deep understanding of automation technologies, control systems, and manufacturing processes within the battery industry. 

Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities

Automation Design & Engineering

- Lead and participate in automation design reviews with machine suppliers and OEMs. 
 - Review Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Sequences of Operations, Control Philosophies, and Network Architecture Documents. 
 - Define and enforce automation architecture standards across all equipment categories. 
 - Ensure all supplier-delivered automation systems comply with Agratas engineering standards. 
 - Develop reusable control strategies and templates that can be applied consistently across projects and facilities. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of Agratas automation standards and engineering guidelines. PLC Software Development

- Develop, modify, simulate, and troubleshoot PLC programs across multiple platforms. 
 - Configure machine sequences, interlocks, alarms, recipes, and machine state models. 
 - Support machine simulation and offline testing activities prior to equipment delivery. 
 - Review and audit supplier software to ensure compliance with Agratas coding standards. 
 - Work across Siemens TIA Portal, Mitsubishi GX Works, and Beckhoff TwinCAT platforms. OPC UA & NodeSet Development

- Develop OPC UA Information Models aligned to the Agratas data architecture. 
 - Generate and validate OPC UA NodeSets for all automation equipment categories. 
 - Define telemetry structures, alarm hierarchies, and namespace structures. 
 - Review and validate supplier-generated NodeSets for structural and semantic correctness. 
 - Support vendor onboarding and alignment to Agratas standards. 
 - Maintain namespace governance and version control for all published NodeSets. PLC-SCADA-MES Integration

- Define and document PLC-SCADA-MES interfaces, including data exchange specifications. 
 - Configure communication layers between PLC, SCADA, and MES systems. 
 - Develop telemetry, status, alarm, and production data structures for consumption by higher-level systems. 
 - Validate data mapping and end-to-end integration across all system layers. 
 - Support Ignition SCADA configuration and MES integration activities. Functional Safety

- Support machine safety reviews, HAZOP activities, and risk assessments. 
 - Validate safety architecture during design review phases. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot safety PLCs and safety-rated networks. 
 - Validate safety functions (e-stops, safety interlocks, safe motion, STO) during FAT and site commissioning. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable safety standards including IEC 13849, IEC 61508, and ISO 10218. FAT, SAT & Commissioning

- Author FAT and SAT protocols, IQ/OQ documentation, and commissioning plans. 
 - Execute FAT activities at supplier facilities, covering PLC logic, safety functions, alarms, OPC UA, SCADA interfaces, and robot interfaces. 
 - Lead SAT and IQ/OQ activities at manufacturing sites. 
 - Support installation, start-up, troubleshooting, and performance optimization during commissioning. 
 - Manage punch-list items and ensure timely closure of outstanding actions. Supplier & Vendor Management

- Manage multiple equipment suppliers simultaneously across concurrent projects. 
 - Track technical actions, design review deliverables, and supplier milestones. 
 - Review and approve supplier documentation: FDS, IO Lists, Tag Lists, Alarm Lists, Telemetry Lists, Node Sets, FAT Reports, and software backups. 
 - Ensure timely closure of design review actions and escalate risks as appropriate. 
 - Represent Agratas in supplier technical meetings and design reviews. Documentation & Standards

- Develop and maintain Functional Design Specifications, Control Philosophies, and IO Lists. 
 - Author and manage Alarm Lists, Telemetry Lists, and Network Architecture Documents. 
 - Produce FAT/SAT Protocols, Commissioning Reports, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). 
 - Contribute to the ongoing development of the Agratas Automation Standards Library. 

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

- 6+ years of experience in Automation & Control Systems engineering within a Li-Ion Battery Manufacturing or similar high-tech manufacturing environment. 
 - Excellent proficiency in programming and testing PLC (Siemens TIA Portal (S7-1500), Mitsubishi GX Works (Q-Series / iQ-R), Beckhoff Twin CAT 3), Structured Text (ST) / Ladder / FBD
 - Expertise in Ignition SCADA systems, HMI configuration, and information systems
 - Knowledge of Industrial Cybersecurity, control network architecture, and communication protocols (Ethernet, EtherCAT, CC Link, Profibus, ProfNet, Modbus, OPC UA etc. )
 - Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and excellent documentation skills
 - Experience with advanced automation technologies such as robotics, AGVs (Automated Guided Vehicles), and machine vision systems in manufacturing
 - Ideally the ability to code in Phyton, visual basic and or C++

Role Specific Qualifications/Certifications

- Bachelor's degree in Automation & Control Engineering, electrical engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field. Master's degree or certifications in automation systems is a plus. 
 - Certification in Automation and Control Systems is highly desirable. 
 - Experience with advanced technologies such as vision systems, machine learning algorithms, or AI-powered automation is a plus. 
 - Knowledge of battery manufacturing processes or similar high-precision production environments is beneficial.

data.description:
OVERVIEW

With annual sales of about CHF 14. 8 billion in fiscal year 2024/25, the Zurich-based Barry Callebaut Group is the world's leading solutions provider of high-quality chocolate experiences across the full spectrum of chocolate, cocoa, cacao coatings and non-cocoa alternatives - from sourcing and processing cocoa beans to crafting premium chocolates, fillings and decorations. 

At Barry Callebaut, we integrate global expertise with the strength of global talent to drive innovation and efficiency across our global operations. Our Global Business Services (GBS) center, located in Hyderabad, India, plays a pivotal role in ensuring seamless delivery across 60 production facilities worldwide, contributing to annual sales of about CHF 14. 8 billion in fiscal year 2024/25. As a distinct global capability hub, GBS India is uniquely positioned to enhance strategic & operational excellence. 

In India, we are cultivating a high-performing team that brings specialized capabilities and forward-thinking solutions to our global network. Our professionals lead strategic, transformative initiatives that are shaping the future of the chocolate industry while advancing global careers. By leveraging the promising talent pool, leadership, and business insights, we drive digital innovation, process excellence, and sustainability - contributing meaningfully to our mission of making sustainable chocolate the norm. 

Job Description

This role is responsible for deploying and embedding Food Safety and Quality by Design (FSQR) across the regional cocoa, chocolate, compound, and chocolate alternatives portfolio. It ensures that all new product developments, product and process changes are designed, risk-assessed, validated, and implemented in line with global standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations. 

Operating with high autonomy, the role translates global strategy into robust regional execution, ensuring FSQR principles are fully understood and applied by R&D, Commercial and Operations, while driving a strong First Time Right culture. The role is a key technical partner in NPI/stage-gate governance and change management, influencing decisions in a complex matrix environment

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

Strategy Deployment & Regional Leadership

- Implement the global Food Safety and Quality by Design strategy within the region, ensuring alignment with regional business and customer needs. 
 - Act as the regional FSQR by Design expert for cocoa/chocolate/compound categories, providing practical and technical guidance across projects. 
 - Deploy Quality by Design tools, methodologies and frameworks consistently across the product lifecycle. 
 - Drive First Time Right execution by embedding preventive, risk-based thinking into design and development
 - AMEA specific: Quality by design role to be back up for Customer Value and vice versa

New Product Development (NPD) & Stage-Gate Leadership

- Represent FSQR as a core decisionmaker in regional NPI and stage-gate meetings. 
 - Ensure FSQR requirements (food safety, quality, regulatory, customer) are clearly defined, understood and embedded from the concept stage. 
 - Challenge and guide R&D and Commercial teams to ensure feasible, compliant and customer-fit solutions. 
 - Ensure all projects are supported by robust risk assessments, validation plans, and post-launch reviews. 

Change Management Excellence

- Lead FSQR input into product and process change management, ensuring structured Quality by design application. 
 - Ensure all changes are assessed using a risk-based approach, with clear documentation, validation, and governance. 
 - Drive cross-functional alignment to manage impacts on manufacturing, raw materials, customer specifications, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Support high-impact or complex changes with clear risk mitigation and escalation where needed. Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Influence

- Strongly influence and align stakeholders across R&D, Commercial, Operations and FSQR. 
 - Translate FSQR requirements into clear, actionable guidance for R&D and Commercial teams to enable effective decision-making. 
 - Act as a bridge between technical and commercial functions, ensuring risks, constraints and trade-offs are well understood. 
 - Build strong regional partnerships and ensure consistent communication across stakeholders. 

Customer & Category Focus

- Ensure a deep understanding of customer requirements, specifications and application needs. 
 - Apply strong category expertise in cocoa, chocolate and compound to anticipate risks and ensure product performance. 
 - Partner with Commercial teams to embed customer expectations into product design and decision-making. 
 - Ensure consistent delivery of products that are safe, compliant and fit for purpose. 

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

- Establish and execute regional FSQR design governance, including stage-gate reviews and decision protocols. 
 - Ensure compliance with internal standards and applicable regulatory and food safety requirements. 
 - Conduct and validate risk assessments, design reviews, and mitigation plans. 
 - Maintain visibility of medium- and high-risk projects, enabling risk-based decision-making. 
 - Ensure documentation supports robust and defensible outcomes. 
 - Capability Building & Culture

- Train and coach teams on FSQR by Design principles and practical application. 
 - Build a strong understanding of FSQR across R&D, Commercial and Operations. 
 - Promote a First Time Right and Proactive Risk Management Culture. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in FSQR tools, processes and ways of working

Collaboration & Organizational Integration

- Collaborate closely with global FSQR teams to align standards and share best practices. 
 - Drive cross-regional consistency while adapting to local market needs. 
 - (AMEA specific) Act as back-up for Customer Value role and vice versa. 

EDUCATION, LANGUAGE, SKILLS

- Bachelor's or master's degree in food science, Food Technology or equivalent
 - Strong technical expertise in cocoa, chocolate, compound and/or related categories
 - Proven experience in NPD, stage-gate processes and change management
 - Experience in FSQR, regulatory and risk assessment frameworks
 - Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholders and influence cross-functional teams
 - Experience in customer-facing or commercially linked roles is a strong advantage
 - Audit, certification and regulatory compliance experience preferred
 - Fluent English; additional languages are an asset
 - Willingness to travel

ESSENTIAL EXPERIENCE & KNOWLEDGE / TECHNICAL OR FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES

- 15+ Years of experience as Quality Manager and additional roles in Regional or Global Quality functions 
 - Practical experience in an agile organization to handle complexity and ambiguity
 - Problem solving, issue management, stakeholder management

TECHNICAL / FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES

- knowledge and understanding of certifications and customer expectations

INTERPERSONAL / LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

- Being able to influence stakeholders and navigating through different audiences

PERSONAL STYLE / ATTITUDE / MOTIVATION

- Lead by Barry Callebaut values

At Barry Callebaut, we are committed to Diversity & Inclusion. United by our strong values, we thrive on the diversity of who we are, where we come from, what we've experienced and how we think. Senior Software Developers collaborate with Business and Quality Analysts, Designers, Project Managers and more to design software solutions that will create meaningful change for our clients. They listen thoughtfully to understand the context of a business problem and write clean and iterative code to deliver a powerful end result whilst consistently advocating for better engineering practices. By balancing strong opinions with a willingness to find the right answer, Senior Software Developers bring integrity to technology, ensuring all voices are heard. 

For a team to thrive, it needs collaboration and room for healthy, respectful debate. Senior Developers are the technologists who cultivate this environment while driving teams toward delivering on an aspirational tech vision and acting as mentors for more junior-level consultants. You will leverage deep technical knowledge to solve complex business problems and proactively assess your team's health, code quality and nonfunctional requirements. 

Job responsibilities

- You will learn and adopt best practices like writing clean and reusable code using TDD, pair programming and design patterns
 - You will use and advocate for continuous delivery practices to deliver high-quality software as well as value to end customers as early as possible
 - You will work in collaborative, value-driven teams to build innovative customer experiences for our clients
 - You will create large-scale distributed systems out of microservices
 - You will collaborate with a variety of teammates to build features, design concepts and interactive prototypes and ensure best practices and UX specifications are embedded along the way. 
 - You will apply the latest technology thinking from our Technology Radar to solve client problems
 - You will efficiently utilize DevSecOps tools and practices to build and deploy software, advocating devops culture and shifting security left in development
 - You will oversee or take part in the entire cycle of software consulting and delivery from ideation to deployment and everything in between
 - You will act as a mentor for less-experienced peers through both your technical knowledge and leadership skills

Job Qualifications

Technical Skills

- You have five or more years* of experience
 - You have experience using one or more development languages (Java or Kotlin) with experience in Object-Oriented programming
 - You are well versed with React/Flutter and AWS. 
 - Good to have skills like Lambda, K8, Camunda, Postgres or other databases. 
 - You can skillfully write high-quality, well-tested code 
 - You are comfortable with Agile methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP), Scrum and/or Kanban
 - You have a good awareness of TDD, continuous integration and continuous delivery approaches/tools
 - Bonus points if you have working knowledge of cloud technology such as AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and Docker

Professional Skills

- You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed
 - Presence in the external tech community: you willingly share your expertise with others via speaking engagements, contributions to open source, blogs and more
 - You're resilient in ambiguous situations and can approach challenges from multiple perspectives

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys. 

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions. 

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers. 

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment. 

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we're pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we've delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let's be extraordinary. 

See here our AI policy.

Mainframe Test Engineer - Core Banking
data.description:
Project Description: 

We are seeking an experienced Test Analyst with a strong background in the banking domain, particularly in retail banking and Signature mainframe Core Banking Software Application. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing test strategies and plans for business-critical banking applications. The role demands in-depth domain knowledge, excellent analytical skills, and hands-on experience with legacy systems. 

Responsibilities: 

- Understand business and system requirements for Core banking (Retail) products and services. 
 - Design and document test strategies, test plans, test cases, Test Summary Report and test data based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Execute manual and automated test cases across various phases of testing - System, Integration, and UAT. 
 - Perform backend testing on mainframe systems, including validation of batch processes and data. 
 - Participate in requirement and design reviews to identify and mitigate potential quality issues early. 
 - Work closely with business analysts, developers, and project managers to ensure high-quality delivery. 
 - Analyze test results, raise clear and concise defects when appropriate
 - Lead defect triage meetings and manage defect lifecycle through resolution. 
 - Provide test estimates, track progress, and report testing metrics. 
 - Ensure compliance with QA processes and standards. 
 - Mentor junior test analysts and support knowledge sharing across teams. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to carry out test design review to ensure comprehensive test coverage. 
 - Automate manual test cases as part of the sprint and build a robust Automation Test Suite. 

Mandatory Skills Description: 

- 5+ years of experience in QA/testing with a focus on Retail Banking/Financial Services. 
 - Solid understanding and hands-on experience in Signature Mainframe Core Banking Software Applications. 
 - Strong mortgage domain knowledge, including origination, servicing, underwriting, and regulatory compliance. 
 - Experience in data migration testing
 - Experience of working on Critical production issues. 
 - Experience with batch job testing, file validations, and data reconciliation. 
 - Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools like qTest, JIRA. 
 - Strong SQL skills for data validation and test data preparation, Test plan and Test summary report preparation. 
 - Exposure to Agile, Waterfall, SDLC methodologies. 
 - Ability to work independently and lead testing efforts for projects. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

Nice-to-Have Skills Description: 

- Knowledge of working with various automation tools and/or other comparable technologies like TOSCA, Selenium or Playwright.

data.description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We're optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our consultants serve clients worldwide. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes. 

Job Description

We are hiring a Staff DevOps Engineer for the AI Factory product team at Mumbai, responsible for architecting, scaling, and standardizing the cloud and platform foundations that power AI-driven products and internal platforms. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with org-level technical influence. The Staff DevOps Engineer operates beyond a single product or squad, shaping platform strategy, reliability standards, CI/CD foundations, and cloud cost governance across the AI Factory. The role is hands-on where it matters most, while also acting as a technical authority and escalation point for complex infrastructure, deployment, and reliability challenges. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and evolve cloud-native platform foundations supporting AI Factory products and internal platforms

- Define and enforce DevOps standards across environments: CI/CD, deployment patterns, observability, security, and cost controls

- Design scalable infrastructure patterns for multi-service, multi-environment systems

- Act as the final escalation point for complex infrastructure and reliability issue

- Own architecture and best practices across AWS / GCP / Azure (multi-cloud exposure)

- Design highly available, secure, and cost-efficient infrastructure

- Drive reliability engineering practices: SLOs, SLIs, incident response, post-mortems, and resilience planning. 

- Identify systemic risks early (capacity, cost, security, scaling) and address them proactively

- Architect and standardize CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)

- Enable safe, repeatable deployments across products and teams

- Improve developer experience by reducing friction in build, test, and deployment workflows. 

- Support release strategies such as blue-green, canary, and rollback mechanisms

- Stay hands-on with critical infrastructure code, platform refactors, and high-impact improvements

- Review infrastructure designs and pipeline changes for correctness, simplicity, and long-term sustainability

- Build foundational tooling that enables multiple teams to move faster and safer

- Partner closely with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and Product teams to align platform capabilities with delivery needs

- Mentor senior DevOps and Platform engineers through reviews, architecture discussions, and coaching

- Act as a multiplier, improving outcomes across teams without direct people management

Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 8 -12 years in DevOps / Platform / Infrastructure Engineering. 

- Proven experience operating at Staff / Principal-like scope (multi-team, platform-level impact). 

- Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure). 

- Deep knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (cluster design, scaling, security). 

- Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

- Infrastructure automation and scripting using Python, Bash, or similar. 

- Experience with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK / Loki). 

- Strong understanding of networking, IAM, secrets management, and cloud security fundamental. 

- Excellent communicator, able to translate technical trade-offs to engineering leadership and Stake holders. 

- Comfortable owning triage, incident decisions, and conducting RCAs. 

Additional Information

What Success Looks Like

- Thinks in systems, not just features. 

- Acts as a force multiplier for technical teams. 

- Drives clarity in ambiguous technical situations. 

- Chooses long-term maintainability over short-term hacks. 

- Communicates complex ideas with precision and calm authority.

What We Offer

- A dynamic and collaborative team environment with diverse projects. 

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

Job Description

Job Summary

This role is for an Automation Systems Engineer responsible for executing automation-related projects and qualifying systems to ensure reliable and efficient operations. The position involves coordinating with vendors and OEMs to manage project schedules, resolve implementation challenges, and maintain system performance. The engineer will plan for hardware redundancy, monitor component obsolescence, and implement upgrades and replacements as needed. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- To ensure that compliance (regulatory, statutory and legal) are understood, implemented and monitored on daily basis. To adhere to principles of Good Engineering Practices (GEP). 
 - Data backup management of all systems at site as per predefined schedule. 
 - Execute user management of all systems at site. 
 - Perform GxP assessments and ensure all the systems are GxP complaint
 - Ensure all the systems are in validated state throughout the life cycle as per the regulations. 
 - Modification of logic as per user requirement with Documentation and Qualification. 
 - Carrying out system Annual Maintenance Contractor (AMC) along with vendor or coordinate with vendor to upkeep the system healthy at all times. 
 - Involve and execute all the DCS projects at site, Upgrade and qualify the system as and when required. 
 - Maintenance of control system against job orders. 
 - Execution of planned maintenance actions through collaboration with stake holders. 
 - Undertake any modifications / improvements required for overall efficiency and reduce future chances of breakdowns to achieve maximum up time of the equipment, control system and meet production requirements. 
 - To initiate the modifications and new projects within the plant as per site objective. 
 - Evaluate the instrumentation & automation requirement, review technical specifications of the instrumentation, and coordinate with Supply Chain Management (SCM) procurement of indented material. 
 - Guide Supply Chain Management (SCM) with vendor information to ensure availability of materials on time for maintenance and new modifications. 
 - Ensure site preparedness for external / internal auditors from automation prospective and take actions on observations to be in compliant. 
 - Provide necessary training to production and Engineering Services Department (ESD) team. 
 - Provide review & checks from technical perspective on projects. 
 - Provide technical support to projects team, production and Quality Assurance initiating against job order & plant requirement. 
 - Follow SAP maintenance module and closing job orders in System Application Product (SAP). 
 - To bring about improvement in machinery availability, time bound repair of instruments (along with relevant records). 
 - Responsible for priority assessment and decision marking as it related to trouble shooting diagnostics, assembly, repair and a protective maintenance of system and instruments in a cost effective manner. 
 - To reuse and recycle instruments, etc. where ever possible. 
 - Investigation calibration failures and failure between preventive maintenance and taking the corrective action. 
 - To co-ordinate with the production team in identifying and implementing automation projects as per site objectives. 
 - To maintain records / documents as per Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). 
 - Trouble shooting with an objective of finding permanent solution. 
 - To ensure the facility is as per site objectives at all times. 
 - To ensure Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) implementation in his area as per Quality Management System (QMS). 
 - To meet Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) targets for their area. 

Qualifications

Educational qualification-Diploma/ Graduation in Electronics, Electrical, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, or related field is mandatory

Minimum work Experience- 6-8 years of experience

Skills & attributes -

Functional Skills-

• Design Codes

• Engineering Drawings

• Technical documentation

• Troubleshooting (Problem Solving)

• Vendor Management

• Control System Design

• Commissioning Qualification Validation (CQV)

•Automation Resident Skills

• Corrective And Preventive Action (CAPA)

• Lean Methodologies

• Root Cause Analysis

• Total Productive Maintenance

Behavioural Skills

• Problem-Solving Mind-set

• Collaboration and Stakeholder Coordination

• Attention to Detail and Process Discipline

Critical exposures

• Experience in maintaining and troubleshooting automation systems used in injectable manufacturing is desired

• Exposure to supporting validation activities for automated systems, ensuring compliance with cGMP and regulatory standards is preferred. 

• Experience with OEM-provided control systems including communication signals (e. g. , PLC, SCADA, DCS), sensors, actuators, and automation panels is preferred. 

• Experience in integrating automation solutions with existing manufacturing processes, including MES, batch control, and interlocks for safety and efficiency is desired. 

Additional Information

About the Department

Global Manufacturing Organisation (GMO)

At Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, we are dedicated to making a meaningful impact on global healthcare through precision manufacturing and innovation. With a legacy of excellence, we are a leading force in the pharmaceutical industry. 

We operate 19 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants across Hyderabad, Vizag, Baddi, Mexico, Shreveport, and Mirfield, comprising 8 OSD facilities, 3 Injectables facilities, and 8 API facilities. 

Benchmarking manufacturing processes and continuous operational excellence are at the core of our capability to deliver quality medicines to our patients in 66 countries. We manufacture a portfolio of complex APIs and 1, 150+ drug master files across key therapy areas such as Oncology, Cardio-vascular, Central Nervous System and Anti-Diabetes. he World Economic Forum has recognised our largest manufacturing facility in Bachupally, Hyderabad, as part of its Global Lighthouse Network. We aspire to be the most efficient pharma operations in the world. Our productivity improvement and digitalisation efforts are key to staying competitive, meeting business imperatives, and meeting our ambitious ESG goals. Building such 'factories of the future' is integral to innovation and to build. 

Benefits Offered

At Dr. Reddy's we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs. 

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy's are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself. 

Our Work Culture

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy's why they come to work every day and they'll say, because Good Health Can't Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we're always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

data.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Insurance Domain)
data.description:
Inviting applications for the role of Forward Deployed Engineer- Insurance- Life 3

About the Role

Genpact is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the intersection of client operations, engineering, and AI product delivery for our Insurance and Financial Services portfolio. This is a hands-on, embedded engineering role - you will work directly inside client environments (or client-facing pods) to rapidly design, build, and iterate on agentic AI, automation, and data solutions that solve real operational problems: claims processing, underwriting workbenches, policy servicing, cash application, submission intake, and back-office transformation. 

Unlike a traditional delivery or pre-sales role, the FDE is expected to write code, configure platforms, and ship working solutions in close partnership with client business and IT stakeholders - compressing the gap between problem discovery and production deployment. 

What You'll Do

· Embed directly with client teams (Insurance carriers, TPAs, FinServ operations) to understand workflows, pain points, and data landscapes firsthand - not through requirements documents alone. 

· Rapidly prototype and productionize AI-enabled solutions: agentic workflows, LLM-based extraction/classification, RPA + AI hybrid automations, and API-first integrations. 

· Own the full build lifecycle - from architecture and proof-of-concept through UAT, hypercare, and steady-state handover - often with minimal dedicated engineering support. 

· Translate ambiguous business asks (e. g. , "reduce submission turnaround time, " "automate cash application matching") into scoped technical designs and working prototypes within days, not months. 

· Integrate with core insurance/FinServ systems - policy admin systems, claims platforms, document management, CRM (Salesforce), and legacy mainframe/ODS environments. 

· Partner with Solution Architects, Automation Architects, and AI Architects to ensure builds align to enterprise patterns (event-driven architecture, canonical data models, API-first integration). 

· Instrument solutions for measurable outcomes: FTE release, STP rate, FPY, cycle time reduction, and defect/UAT pass-rate tracking. 

· Act as the technical credibility layer in CXO/client governance forums - able to demo live builds, defend architecture choices, and respond to technical objections in real time. 

· Drive from pilot to scale: once a build proves value with one client/process, generalize it into a reusable asset or platform capability. 

· Provide technical inputs into RFP/proposal responses and BaFO (Best and Final Offer) stages when needed. 

What We're Looking For

Experience & Domain

· 10-15 years in software/solutions engineering, with at least 5-7 years working directly in Insurance (P&C, Life, Group Benefits) and/or Financial Services operations or technology. 

· Demonstrated experience deploying solutions into live client environments - not just internal R&D or lab settings. 

· Working knowledge of insurance domain processes: underwriting, claims, policy servicing, submissions, cash/reconciliation, or loss run processing. 

Technical Skills

· Strong hands-on coding ability (Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript; SQL fluency mandatory). 

· Practical experience building with LLMs/agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent) and RAG architectures. 

· Experience with RPA and intelligent automation platforms (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate) and where to use automation vs. AI vs. workflow engines. 

· API integration and iPaaS experience (MuleSoft or equivalent); understanding of event-driven architecture and Canonical Data Models. 

· Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and standard MLOps/LLMOps practices for deploying and monitoring models in production. 

· Comfortable working with legacy and modern data layers alike - mainframe extracts, ODS, CDC pipelines, and modern data warehouses. 

Ways of Working

· Bias for building over documenting - comfortable operating with incomplete specs and iterating live with client stakeholders. 

· Able to context-switch between deep technical work and CXO-facing conversations in the same day. 

· Strong ownership mindset: will independently drive a build from whiteboard to production without waiting for a formal handoff. 

· Experience operating in a multi-client, multi-workstream delivery environment, balancing competing priorities and governance cadences (QBRs, UAT tracking, RAG status reporting). 

Nice to Have

· Prior experience in a professional services, systems integrator, or BPO transformation environment. 

· Exposure to change management frameworks (Prosci ADKAR, Kotter) for driving adoption of AI/automation solutions. 

· Prior forward-deployed, solutions engineering, or field engineering title at a product or AI company. 

Education

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; advanced degree a plus.

data.title: Identity Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Description

The Identity Governance Administration Automation Engineer is responsible for administering, automating, and continuously improving the enterprise's Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) environment, with a focus on Saviynt. This role ensures that access certification, provisioning, and entitlement management processes are secure, auditable, and efficient across the enterprise and its Operating Companies (OpCos). 

This role acts as both a platform administrator and an automation engineer, building and maintaining workflows that connect Saviynt to enterprise identity sources, target applications, and downstream systems. The engineer partners closely with Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Audit teams to ensure identity lifecycle events - joiner, mover, leaver, and access certification - are governed, automated, and evidenced consistently across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. 

The role is hands‐on and execution‐focused while embracing the Ralliant Business System (RBS) by embedding operational discipline, staff training, and continuous improvement into tools, workflows, and standard work so endpoint management is scalable, measurable, and repeatable. The role operates in service to the enterprise and operating companies, ensuring standardized identity governance practices while adapting to regional and business-specific needs. 

Key Responsibilities

- Administer and support the Saviynt Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform, including application onboarding, connector configuration, and control library management. 
 - Design, build, and maintain automated identity lifecycle workflows (joiner, mover, leaver) across Active Directory, cloud directories, and business applications. 
 - Configure and enforce access certification campaigns, segregation of duties (SoD) controls, and role-based access (RBAC) policies to manage least-privilege access at scale. 
 - Develop and maintain Saviynt connectors and integrations using REST APIs, SCIM, and native connector frameworks to onboard new applications and OpCo environments. 
 - Develop PowerShell, Python, and REST API scripts and workflows to automate provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement reconciliation tasks. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve provisioning, reconciliation, and workflow failures, including connector errors, data mismatches, and approval routing issues. 
 - Support authentication and authorization integrations across Active Directory/LDAP, SAML, OAuth 2. 0, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and Single Sign-On (SSO) to ensure accurate identity data flows into governance processes. 
 - Monitor and analyze Saviynt, system, and integration logs, supporting SIEM integration, performance monitoring, and incident response for governance-related events. 
 - Apply identity governance best practices and support compliance with frameworks such as SOX, PCI-DSS, NIST, and ISO 27001, including audit evidence generation and reporting. 
 - Partner with Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Audit teams to integrate identity governance solutions across enterprise and OpCo environments. 
 - Document procedures, configurations, and control workflows, and train end users and control owners on certification and access request processes. 
 - Continuously improve governance workflows and dashboards, applying RBS principles to drive measurable reductions in manual effort and audit findings. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree recommended; equivalent experience considered. 
 - 10+ years of experience in identity governance, identity and access management, or systems administration, with 5+ years hands-on experience with Saviynt (Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud or Saviynt IGA) or relevant experience. 
 - Strong understanding of identity governance architecture, including access certification, role mining, SoD controls, and entitlement management. 
 - Proficiency in REST APIs, SCIM, and connector development for onboarding applications into an IGA platform, across on-premises and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Experience with Active Directory/LDAP, SAML, OAuth 2. 0, MFA, and SSO as identity sources feeding governance and provisioning workflows. 
 - Scripting experience in PowerShell and Python, with working knowledge of REST APIs and Saviynt SDKs/APIs. 
 - Working knowledge of JSON, including reading, structuring, and troubleshooting JSON payloads for connector configurations, API requests, and workflow integrations. 
 - Experience with log analysis and SIEM integration, incident response, and root cause analysis for governance and provisioning issues. 
 - Knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOX, PCI-DSS, NIST, ISO 27001) and zero trust security principles. 
 - Saviynt certification preferred; cloud platform or security certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, CISSP, CISM, Security+) a plus. 
 - Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, control owners, and auditors. 
 - Ability to operate effectively across enterprise and OpCo environments, balancing global consistency with local context across multiple time zones and culture. 
 - Alignment with Ralliant values and the Ralliant Business System (RBS), including continuous improvement, transparency, and ownership.

Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. data.title: Engineering Manager – GPU Orchestration & AI Inference Platform
data.description:
About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks. 

Position Summary

The Engineering Manager will lead the India engineering team building PulseAI, Gruve's on-premises, Kubernetes-native GPU orchestration and AI inference platform. This is a hands-on role: you will balance day-to-day delivery and people management with real technical involvement - reviewing designs and code, and unblocking engineers - while working closely with the Lead Architect / Product Owner to turn technical designs and JIRA backlogs into shipped, quality-tested increments. You will also grow a high-performing engineering team.

- Lead and grow a team of engineers delivering PulseAI, Gruve's on-premises, Kubernetes-native GPU orchestration and AI inference platform

 - Stay hands-on - review designs, participate in architecture discussions, read and review code, and unblock engineers on FastAPI/PostgreSQL backend, React frontend, and RKE2/OpenShift deployment issues
 - Translate technical design documents and JIRA stories into clear, sequenced execution plans for the India engineering team

 - Coordinate closely with the external development vendor and internal architecture leadership to align delivery timelines, resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain quality standards

 - Partner with QA to plan release readiness, support UAT cycles, and ensure milestone sign-off criteria are met before delivery
 - Manage risk and dependency tracking across concurrent workstreams (Model Deployment, Observability & Metrics, Secrets Management, GPU Quota/Billing) and escalate blockers early
 - Contribute to technical decision-making on multi-tenant isolation, GPU resource quota enforcement, and identity/SSO federation as the platform evolves
 - Report on team velocity, delivery risk, and capacity to the Lead Architect / Product Owner and other stakeholders

Basic Qualifications

- Education: B. E / B. Tech or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline
 - Experience: 10-15 years in software engineering, with at least 2-3 years in a engineering manager/ tech-lead capacity leading a team of 5-10 engineers
 - Demonstrated hands-on proficiency in at least one backend stack (Python/FastAPI or equivalent) and one frontend stack (React or equivalent), with the ability to review code and unblock engineers directly
 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes-native application development and deployment (RKE2, OpenShift, or vanilla K8s)
 - Experience managing delivery for complex, multi-service platforms (preferably virtualisation and control planes)

 - Proven experience hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers, including performance management
 - Comfort working across India/US team structures and coordinating with external delivery vendors or partners
 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical design detail and delivery status for architecture and product stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with GPU-based infrastructure management and control platform, AI/ML inference platforms, or LLM serving stacks will be an solid added advantage
 - Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architecture, RBAC models, and quota/billing systems will be an added advantage
 - Experience with PostgreSQL schema-per-service architectures and event-driven or workflow automation tools (e. g. , n8n) will be an added advantage
 - Exposure to Prometheus/Grafana-based observability stacks will be an added advantage
 - Prior experience managing or coordinating with offshore/nearshore development vendors will be an added advantage

At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. You'll set the architecture and lead a team of developers. You'll also partner with operations, risk and compliance to ship customer journeys that are secure, resilient and audit-ready. You'll still review code and help unblock the hardest problems. 

What you'll do

- Lead a team of Amazon Connect and integration developers: plan and prioritize work, set engineering standards, review code and mentor engineers. 
 - Own the solution architecture across voice, chat and digital channels, including flows, Lex bots, Lambda services and integrations with core banking, CRM and fraud systems. 
 - Build security and compliance in by design (PCI DSS scope reduction, encryption, PII redaction, least-privilege access, audit trails) and represent the platform in audits and risk reviews. 
 - Design for resilience and scale, covering multi-region and disaster recovery strategy, capacity planning and service quotas. 
 - Establish CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and release controls that fit a regulated change-management process. 
 - Turn business goals like containment, average handle time and first-contact resolution into a technical roadmap, estimates and delivery plan. 
 - Partner with the AI/LLM team to introduce generative AI safely (agent assist, summarization, intelligent self-service) within model risk and AI governance requirements. 
 - Act as the escalation point for major production incidents and lead root-cause analysis. 
 - Manage technical relationships with AWS, implementation partners and third-party vendors. 

What you'll bring

- 8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years designing and delivering Amazon Connect solutions in production. 
 - 2+ years leading development teams, with ownership of delivery, code quality and mentoring. 
 - Financial services experience delivering contact center or customer servicing platforms for a bank, insurer, lender, payments provider or similar regulated business. 
 - Deep AWS expertise across Lambda, Lex, DynamoDB, API Gateway, Kinesis, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, KMS and EventBridge, plus infrastructure as code. 
 - Strong grasp of regulatory and security requirements for financial contact centers (PCI DSS, data protection, call recording, complaint handling) and experience working alongside risk, compliance and InfoSec. 
 - Ability to explain architecture trade-offs clearly to senior business and technology stakeholders. 

Preferred

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional. 
 - Experience leading a migration to Amazon Connect from Avaya, Cisco, Genesys or NICE. 
 - Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud Voice or other CRM-integrated agent desktops. 
 - Experience delivering generative AI features in a contact center, such as Amazon Q in Connect, Contact Lens post-contact summaries or Amazon Bedrock-powered self-service. 
 - Background in WFM/QM tooling and contact center analytics. 

VRIZE INC, a Global IT Services company, is committed to delivering end-to-end IT solutions and services to its customers worldwide. We offer business-friendly solutions across industry verticals that include Banking, Financial Services, Healthcare & Insurance, Manufacturing, and Retail. The company has strategic business alliances with industry leaders such as Qlik, Python, IBM, Microsoft, Docker, Sisense, Competera, Snowflake, Node, and Tableau. The company has undertaken projects in Asia and America encompassing the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software and infrastructure service with world-class technology capabilities to deliver "business-friendly solutions" across industry verticals. The company is headquartered in Florida, USA. Our continuous success will depend to a large extent, on our ability to remain at the forefront of developments in the field of information technology.

data.title: Software Engineer - Java & Kubernetes
data.description:
About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we're on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We're looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team. 

What You'll Do

Our team builds and maintains the core backend architecture and orchestration engines that power our high-scale production systems. We bridge traditional backend software engineering with modern cloud-native deployment and automated workflow pipelines. 

In this role, you will be exposed to enterprise-scale distributed systems, container orchestration at scale, and end-to-end data pipeline automation. You will use your Java expertise to build robust backend microservices while leveraging Python and Apache Airflow to orchestrate complex scheduled workflows. By deploying and managing these components within Kubernetes, you will ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and smooth deployment cycles. 

Your work directly controls how our core application logic and automated workflows run in production. By keeping our Kubernetes deployments resilient and our Airflow pipelines performing efficiently, you ensure seamless service uptime, rapid deployment of new features, and reliable data delivery for end users. 

The day-to-day

- Feature Integration & Development: Writing clean, scalable, and well-tested Java code to build and extend core backend microservices. 
 - Workflow Orchestration: Designing, building, and maintaining Apache Airflow DAGs and Python scripts to automate multi-step processing jobs and background tasks. 
 - Kubernetes Orchestration: Writing and updating Kubernetes manifests and Helm charts to manage application pods, service configurations, and scaling strategies. 
 - Continuous Deployment: Automating build, test, and release processes to support zero-downtime continuous deployment to production users. 
 - Operations & Monitoring: Troubleshooting container performance, monitoring cluster health, and resolving production bottlenecks across Java services and Airflow runners. 

What You'll Need

- Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional software development experience. 
 - Core Language: Strong proficiency in Java and its ecosystem, with a solid understanding of object-oriented programming. 
 - Orchestration: Hands-on commercial experience with Docker and Kubernetes (K8s). You should be comfortable managing pods, deployments, services, and configurations. 
 - Workflow Tools: Practical experience building and maintaining pipelines in Apache Airflow. 
 - Secondary Language: Proficiency in Python for scripting, data processing, and Airflow DAG creation. 
 - Version Control & CI/CD: Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , GitHub Actions). 

What Will Help You On The Job

- Ability to work on distributed remote agile teams with a high degree of self-motivation and ability to work independently. 
 - Exposure to GraalVm is an additional plus
 - Experience with cloud platforms GCP 
 - CI/CD and Devops exposure is a strong plus
 - Travel Requirement: Up to 10%

EEO Statement

Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. data.title: Head of Product Development and Technology
data.description:
About BioGenex
BioGenex designs, develops and commercializes molecular pathology systems for tumor diagnosis, prognosis, precision medicine and life science research. Its business combines automated molecular pathology workstations with antibodies, probes, detection systems, retrieval solutions, histology stains, reagents and consumables for immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, fluorescence in situ hybridization, multiplex staining, microRNA and related tissue-based applications. BioGenex serves pathologists, histotechnologists, clinical and reference laboratories, biotechnology and pharmaceutical organizations, and academic researchers. 

About the Role
BioGenex is looking for a Technical / Functional Head to direct product development and technical operations across molecular pathology, laboratory automation and regulated diagnostic systems. The role will align scientific R&D, engineering, software and firmware, verification and validation, manufacturing transfer and technical program management around a common product roadmap. 

The position is accountable for converting business, customer and clinical needs into reliable, compliant and commercially relevant products from concept through lifecycle support. The incumbent will set technical priorities, allocate resources, manage portfolio risks, develop leaders and communicate decisions to senior leadership. This is not a coding position, but it requires the ability to guide software teams, review architecture and development plans, assess technical risks, and ensure appropriate verification, validation and release controls. 

Key Responsibilities
· Define and execute the product and technology strategy, roadmap and investment priorities, including decisions on external technologies, collaborations and strategic partnerships. 

· Translate clinical needs, pathology laboratory workflows, customer feedback and business priorities into clear product requirements and development programs. 

· Direct scientific product development across histology, FFPE workflows, IHC, ISH, FISH, multiplex staining, RNA and miRNA detection, and related tissue-based applications, ensuring appropriate analytical performance and scientific evidence. 

· Lead integrated systems development across mechanical engineering, electronics, thermal control, fluidics, motion control, embedded firmware, product software, reagents and consumables. 

· Lead product software and firmware through qualified managers, with oversight of architecture, development planning, cybersecurity, interfaces, testing, configuration management, release control and maintenance.
