data.title: Vice President, Service Resilience
data.description:
About AssetMark

AssetMark is a leading wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial advisors. AssetMark's mission is to enable financial advisors to make a profound difference in the lives of their clients. Over 10, 000 advisors partner with AssetMark for our investment offerings, innovative technology, advanced services, and expertise, which they use to delight their clients and grow their businesses. We are an integrated team of technologists, investment professionals, and operations experts working together to advance wealth management. 

Position Summary

The Vice President of Service Resilience is the senior leader responsible for establishing and advancing Site Reliability Engineering and Observability across all AssetMark systems. 

This role will define the strategy, operating model, technical standards, and roadmap required to make AssetMark's applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, data services, networks, and critical integrations more reliable, resilient, observable, performant, and supportable. 

Based in Hyderabad with a global mandate, the VP will build and direct a high-performing team and work closely with Cloud and Infrastructure Engineering, Application Engineering, Data, Security, Identity and Access Management, Service Management, and business leaders across time zones. 

This is a highly visible technical leadership position. The successful candidate must combine deep expertise in observability and SRE with strong executive presence, strategic thinking, innovation, and the ability to influence engineering practices across the organization. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Service Resilience Strategy: Define and execute a multi-year Service Resilience strategy for all AssetMark systems. Establish service tiers, reliability objectives, production-readiness expectations, dependency standards, and an SRE operating model that makes resilience an engineering responsibility rather than a post-incident activity. 
 - Strategy, Leadership and Team Development: Build and lead the Service Resilience function, including its strategy, operating model, service catalog, technology roadmap, engineering standards, governance practices, budget, vendors, and delivery partners. Recruit, mentor, and develop SRE, Observability, Performance, and Resilience Engineering talent. 
 - Observability Platform and OpenTelemetry: Own the enterprise observability strategy and platform architecture. Establish standards for metrics, logs, traces, distributed tracing, profiles, events, dashboards, alerting, and service-health reporting. Lead adoption and governance of OpenTelemetry, including instrumentation standards, semantic conventions, collectors, exporters, telemetry pipelines, context propagation, data quality, retention, and cost management. 
 - APM and End-to-End Monitoring: Lead the use of Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, KQL, Prometheus, Grafana, and enterprise APM platforms such as Dynatrace, Datadog, New Relic, AppDynamics, Splunk, Elastic, or comparable technologies. Create a consistent view of application, API, database, cloud, network, infrastructure, user-experience, and critical-business-transaction health. 
 - SRE Engineering and Reliability Standards: Establish and mature practices for Service Level Indicators, Service Level Objectives, Service Level Agreements, error budgets, capacity planning, performance engineering, load testing, availability engineering, dependency management, service reviews, operational readiness, and toil reduction. Coach engineering teams on designing services that are measurable, resilient, recoverable, and supportable. 
 - Performance, Capacity and Resilience Engineering: Establish performance, capacity, and resilience engineering practices across applications, Azure, infrastructure, networks, databases, and critical integrations. Lead capacity planning, dependency analysis, load testing, failure testing, disaster-recovery exercises, resilience game days, and recovery validation. 
 - Incident, Problem and Recovery Engineering: Partner with Major Incident and Problem Management teams to improve technical response, diagnosis, recovery, and prevention. Establish runbooks, playbooks, escalation paths, dependency maps, blameless postmortems, corrective-action governance, and repeatable recovery practices. Provide technical leadership during high-severity incidents and executive escalations. 
 - Azure and Cloud Service Reliability: Provide reliability leadership across Azure and cloud-hosted services. Partner with Cloud and Infrastructure Engineering to establish standards for monitoring, scaling, availability, resiliency, backup, recovery, and operational supportability across Azure compute, storage, databases, networking, containers, applications, and platform services. 
 - Service Mapping and Dependency Management: Create an end-to-end view of business services, application dependencies, infrastructure components, data stores, networks, identity services, vendors, and external integrations. Establish service ownership and dependency information that supports faster diagnosis, impact analysis, risk management, and executive communication. 
 - Automation, AI and Innovation: Promote observability-as-code, reliability-as-code, automated runbooks, self-healing capabilities, and automated remediation. Evaluate responsible uses of AI and AIOps for anomaly detection, event correlation, alert triage, root-cause analysis, knowledge management, predictive capacity planning, and operational productivity, with appropriate security and human oversight. 
 - Reliability Governance and Executive Reporting: Establish executive dashboards that communicate system health, reliability trends, risk, incident performance, SLO attainment, error-budget consumption, MTTD, MTTR, repeat incidents, change-related failures, toil, and roadmap progress. Use reliability data to inform engineering priorities and investment decisions. 
 - Security, Risk and Compliance: Embed security, privacy, and compliance requirements into observability and SRE practices. Partner with Cybersecurity, IAM, Cloud, and Application teams to ensure telemetry, access, logging, incident response, data retention, and recovery processes support organizational risk requirements. 
 - Financial and Vendor Management: Own planning and optimization for observability, APM, monitoring, telemetry, reliability, and related platform costs. Manage strategic vendors, contracts, renewals, service performance, commercial negotiations, and technology investments. 
 - Cross-Functional Delivery: Partner with Cloud and Infrastructure Engineering, IAM, Cybersecurity, Applications, Data, Architecture, Service Management, vendors, and business leaders to translate reliability goals into secure, resilient, measurable, and adopted engineering practices. 

Organizational Scope

The VP will lead a Hyderabad-based global capability across the following areas: 

- Site Reliability Engineering: SRE, service health, SLOs, error budgets, operational readiness, reliability reviews, and reliability improvement programs. 
 - Observability Platform Engineering: OpenTelemetry, telemetry pipelines, APM, Azure Monitor, dashboards, alerting, logging, tracing, and monitoring standards. 
 - Performance and Capacity Engineering: Performance testing, capacity planning, application analysis, dependency management, and platform performance. 
 - Resilience Engineering: Failure testing, disaster recovery, recovery validation, resilience assessments, game days, and service continuity. 
 - Reliability Automation: Automated runbooks, self-service, observability-as-code, remediation, reporting, and operational productivity. 

Required Qualifications

- Experience: Typically 15 or more years of progressive experience in software engineering, infrastructure, cloud, operations, SRE, Observability, or related disciplines, with significant experience leading enterprise technology functions. 
 - Leadership: Significant experience leading global technical teams, developing managers and engineers, building new capabilities, and directing delivery through a strategic roadmap. 
 - Service Resilience: Demonstrated success establishing or maturing SRE, Observability, APM, reliability, performance, or production-engineering capabilities at enterprise scale. 
 - OpenTelemetry and APM: Deep experience with OpenTelemetry, instrumentation, collectors, telemetry pipelines, metrics, logs, traces, distributed tracing, dashboards, alerting, APM, and application-performance analysis. 
 - Azure and Monitoring: Strong hands-on experience with Azure and Azure monitoring capabilities, including Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, KQL, and related cloud services.

 - Executive Presence: Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move between strategy, business impact, and technical detail. 
 - Innovation: Demonstrated ability to be innovative and forward thinking, evaluate emerging technology, and turn practical ideas into measurable improvements in reliability and engineering productivity. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Observability Platforms: Experience with Dynatrace, Datadog, New Relic, AppDynamics, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, Elastic, Azure Managed Prometheus, Azure Managed Grafana, or comparable platforms.

 - Industry: Experience within financial services or another highly regulated enterprise environment, including audit, regulatory examination, and remediation activities. 
 - Certifications: Relevant certifications in Azure, cloud architecture, SRE, ITIL, cybersecurity, or comparable disciplines. 

Leadership and Accountability Model

The VP serves as the enterprise service owner and engineering authority for Service Resilience, SRE, Observability, APM, performance, capacity, and resilience engineering practices. The role establishes the strategy, standards, roadmaps, technical operating model, and executive reporting. Application, platform, data, and business owners retain accountability for their services, while Cloud and Infrastructure Engineering, IAM, Cybersecurity, and Service Management provide complementary platform, identity, security, and operational capabilities. 

What Success Looks Like

The successful VP will transform Service Resilience from distributed monitoring and operational activity into an integrated enterprise capability. Critical AssetMark services will have clear ownership, service tiers, SLIs, SLOs, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, dependency maps, production-readiness standards, and measurable reliability roadmaps. 

OpenTelemetry and common observability standards will provide consistent visibility across applications, APIs, Azure, infrastructure, networks, databases, user experience, and critical business transactions. Mean Time to Detect, Mean Time to Respond, Mean Time to Restore, repeat incidents, alert noise, change-related failures, and operational toil will improve. 

Reliability and error-budget data will influence engineering roadmaps and release decisions. Resilience testing, disaster recovery, performance engineering, and failure analysis will become routine practices. The Hyderabad team will become a global center of excellence for Service Resilience, Observability, and SRE, using automation and responsible AI to improve resilience and operational insight.

data.title: Lead SDET
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead SDET based in India. 

This is a senior technical leadership role responsible for quality governance across frontend, middleware, and backend layers of a complex onboarding platform. 

You will shape test architecture, API contract testing, data modelling, and quality standards across a multi-layered technical environment. 

The role focuses on independently validating quality at every system layer rather than relying on assumptions made upstream. 

You will establish delivery standards, evidence requirements, quality gates, and traceability practices that support reliable technical outcomes. 

Working closely with QA Analysts, SDETs, and Test Operations teams, you will coordinate execution, resolve dependencies, and address cross-layer discrepancies. 

Your work will help transform detailed technical evidence into clear, traceable findings and stakeholder-ready deliverables. 

This opportunity is well suited to an experienced QA leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong governance, communication, and mentoring skills. 

Accountabilities

- Provide technical governance across frontend, middleware, and backend testing layers. 
 - Establish and enforce QA delivery standards, evidence requirements, review processes, and quality gates. 
 - Review frontend constraint dictionaries and FSM/state-model outputs for completeness, consistency, and technical quality. 
 - Review API schema reconstructions, network evidence, and tracer replay outputs for technical quality and traceability. 
 - Coordinate with QA Analysts, SDETs, and Test Operations Associates to align technical execution with project timelines. 
 - Review test architecture decisions, validation approaches, and coverage strategies across the different testing layers. 
 - Coordinate dependency resolution, evidence rework, and cross-layer reconciliation throughout the engagement. 
 - Serve as the escalation point for cross-layer technical discrepancies and evidence-quality issues. 
 - Compile and quality-check raw technical evidence dossiers produced by different workstreams. 
 - Identify evidence gaps, inconsistencies, and areas requiring rework before materials are handed off to client stakeholders. 
 - Report on delivery health, technical risks, evidence quality, dependencies, and unresolved gaps. 
 - Prepare the technical evidence package for handoff to the client team responsible for final modelling and logic-gap assessment. 
 - Support technical readouts by ensuring findings are clearly connected to and traceable through empirical evidence. 
 - Mentor and guide SDETs and QA Analysts while maintaining consistent technical standards across the engagement. 

Requirements

- 8+ years of proven experience in QA leadership roles spanning multiple testing layers, including frontend, middleware, and backend. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in API contract testing architecture and governance. 
 - Practical experience with knowledge graph or entity-relationship data modelling and its application to testing and data traceability. 
 - Strong understanding of layered system architectures and the importance of independently validating quality at each layer rather than relying on upstream assumptions. 
 - Strong track record of technical delivery governance, including establishing standards, review processes, and quality gates. 
 - Deep technical grounding across manual testing, test automation, and systems-level testing, with the ability to guide teams across different QA disciplines. 
 - Experience mentoring or managing SDETs and QA Analysts. 
 - Excellent cross-functional leadership, stakeholder communication, and technical coordination skills. 
 - Experience leading complex, multi-week technical QA, API validation, or security-assessment engagements is strongly preferred. 
 - Experience establishing evidence and traceability models across complex technical workflows is preferred. 
 - Familiarity with knowledge graphs, entity-relationship models, or structured technical dependency and evidence modelling is preferred; deep knowledge-graph engineering expertise is not required. 
 - Strong ability to synthesize complex technical evidence into concise, stakeholder-ready findings and handoff materials. 
 - Ability to identify technical risks, manage dependencies, resolve discrepancies, and maintain quality across multiple workstreams.

 - Contractual position with a 4-month project duration.

data.title: Software Development Manager, Prime Benefits
data.description:
Description

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead a team of software engineers building and scaling Amazon Family platform capabilities. You will own the technical direction and delivery for a significant portion of the Amazon Family charter, manage and grow a team of SDEs and QAEs, and partner closely with product, design, and partner teams across BPC. 

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives on developing engineers, driving technical excellence, and delivering customer-facing products at Amazon scale. 

Key job responsibilities

People leadership: Manage, mentor, and grow a team of ~10-15 SDEs and QAEs. Own hiring, performance management, career development, and team health. 

Technical delivery: Drive the design, development, and operation of scalable, reliable, secure platform services for Amazon Family. Ensure high standards for code quality, operational excellence, and system availability. 

Roadmap ownership: Partner with product management to define and deliver the multi-quarter roadmap. Translate business goals into technical strategy and executable plans. 

Cross-team collaboration: Work with partner teams across BPC and the wider Amazon ecosystem to integrate family-sharing capabilities into their products. 

Operational excellence: Own the operational posture of your services - on-call, incident response, COE follow-through, and continuous improvement of monitoring and resilience. 

Stakeholder management: Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership and stakeholders across geographies. 

A day in the life

No two days are identical, but a typical day for this SDM might look like: 

- Morning: Start with a review of your services' operational health - overnight alarms, on-call handoff notes, and key dashboards. Join the daily stand-up with your engineers to unblock work and align on priorities. 
 - Mid-morning: Dive into a design review for a new family-sharing capability, coaching a senior engineer through trade-offs on scalability and data privacy. Follow up with 1: 1s, focusing on career growth and individual development. 
 - Midday: Sync with product and partner teams to align on roadmap sequencing and dependencies. Overlap hours with distributed stakeholders often fall in this window. 
 - Afternoon: Balance strategic work - refining the multi-quarter roadmap, reviewing a hiring pipeline, or drafting a technical narrative - with tactical support for your team. Jump into an incident review or COE deep-dive when needed. 
 - Ongoing: Throughout the day, you're removing blockers, making prioritization calls, mentoring engineers, and ensuring your team is building the right things the right way. You protect your team's focus while keeping delivery on track and stakeholders informed. 

The role blends people leadership, technical depth, and cross-geography collaboration. Success means your team is healthy and growing, your services are reliable and secure, and Amazon Family customers get delightful, trustworthy experiences. 

About The Team

The Benefits, Pricing & Constructs team is central to Amazon Prime's north star vision of creating Earth's most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program. We drive profitable growth through four key levers: increasing potential value through new benefits, making members aware and excited about Prime's value, innovating new Prime constructs to reach new segments, and growing Amazon's long-term free cash flow through strategic benefit partnerships and pricing decisions. 

Amazon Family Tech builds the platform capabilities that enable businesses to share their product features with family members. data.title: Quality Engineer
data.description:
About The Company

Bridge AI is a pioneering technology company dedicated to advancing artificial intelligence solutions that empower businesses and individuals alike. Our innovative platform integrates AI agents, web applications, APIs, and databases to deliver seamless, intelligent experiences. Committed to pushing the boundaries of AI capabilities, Bridge AI fosters a collaborative environment where creativity, technical excellence, and continuous learning drive our success. Our team comprises passionate professionals who are dedicated to shaping the future of AI technology and making a meaningful impact across various industries. 

About The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic senior Quality Engineering leader to take ownership of end-to-end quality assurance, release sign-off, and automation strategy across our diverse platform ecosystem. This pivotal role involves overseeing the quality of AI agents, web applications, APIs, and databases, ensuring that our products meet the highest standards of reliability, safety, and performance. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in leading quality initiatives, driving automation-first approaches, and managing complex testing frameworks, particularly within AI and agentic systems. 

This role blends quality ownership, automation leadership, release authority, and product-aligned execution. You will start by establishing robust manual and exploratory testing foundations, then systematically drive automation initiatives-including AI agent validation, critic agents, evaluation frameworks, and safety guardrails. Your leadership will influence the entire product lifecycle, ensuring that quality is embedded into every stage from development to deployment. This is not a passive QA role; it requires proactive engagement, strategic thinking, and accountability for production quality outcomes. 

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience in quality engineering, with a strong background in manual and exploratory testing. Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC, test planning, traceability, and defect management is essential. Candidates should have extensive API testing experience using tools such as Postman or REST clients, along with proficiency in automation frameworks and scripting languages. 

Expertise in UI automation (Playwright, Selenium, Cypress), API automation (pytest, requests, REST Assured), and database validation using SQL is required. Experience designing and maintaining end-to-end automation frameworks, along with CI/CD pipeline integration (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins), is highly valued. Familiarity with testing LLMs and AI agents-including understanding agent workflows, tool invocation, RAG pipelines, and safety validation-is crucial. 

Strong Python skills for automation, utilities, and validation are necessary, as well as knowledge of MCP servers, agent tools, and orchestration. Cloud exposure in GCP, AWS, or Azure within QA or automation contexts will be advantageous. Candidates should demonstrate a passion for innovation in AI testing methodologies and possess excellent collaboration skills to work effectively across teams. 

Responsibilities

End-to-End Quality Ownership & Release Sign-Off

- Own quality outcomes across the full delivery lifecycle, ensuring products meet defined standards before release. 
 - Act as the release authority, making go/no-go decisions based on comprehensive validation and testing results. 
 - Define and enforce quality gates across features, AI agents, and release cycles to mitigate risks. 
 - Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to balance development speed with quality assurance. 
 - Proactively reduce production defects through automation, validation, and rigorous testing strategies. 

Automation-First Quality Strategy

- Define and execute the automation roadmap covering UI, API, database, and agentic systems. 
 - Build and maintain hybrid automation frameworks utilizing Python and modern testing tools. 
 - Drive CI/CD-integrated automated testing pipelines to ensure continuous quality delivery. 
 - Expand automation coverage to replace repetitive manual testing, increasing efficiency and reliability. 
 - Guide and mentor Quality Engineers in automation implementation and best practices. 

Agentic AI & LLM Quality Engineering

- Take ownership of quality assurance for AI agents, tool calls, and multi-step workflows. 
 - Validate agent behavior, reasoning paths, tool invocation correctness, and hallucinations or unsafe outputs. 
 - Define and implement agent evaluation frameworks, including benchmarks and scoring rubrics. 
 - Collaborate with Critic Engineers to design critic agents, automated validation, and ground-truth datasets. 
 - Lead innovation in agent testing methodologies to improve safety, robustness, and grounding accuracy. 

Manual, Exploratory & Scenario-Based Testing

- Drive high-quality manual and exploratory testing efforts where automation is not yet feasible. 
 - Design comprehensive test scenarios covering edge cases, failure modes, and real-world scenarios. 
 - Develop strong test data strategies and oversee defect lifecycle management. 
 - Utilize manual testing strategically to complement automation efforts, ensuring thorough coverage. 

Product-Aligned Ownership

- Partner with Product Owners to align testing and quality criteria with product acceptance standards. 
 - Participate actively in sprint planning, refinement, and release discussions to embed quality into feature design. 
 - Ensure that quality considerations are integrated early in the development process rather than added post-development. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Work closely with Product, Engineering, AgenticOps, RAG, and AI teams to ensure cohesive quality strategies. 
 - Act as the single quality voice across delivery discussions

data.title: Senior Silicon Product Definition Engineer
data.description:
NVIDIA has transformed computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we're defining the next era of computing, where GPUs power the computers, robots, and autonomous vehicles that understand the world. NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design Group (SCG) gets every GPU, SoC, and CPU program from first power-on to high-volume production. We sit at the crossroads of architecture, design, marketing, operations, and productization, serving Datacenter, Server, Gaming, Robotics, Automotive, and Embedded markets. 

We are hiring a Senior Silicon Product Definition Engineer to turn complex silicon and system data into decisions that maximize performance, power efficiency, yield, and quality. You will define product configurations, identify limiting constraints, and drive optimization from early bring-up through production. This is not a pure data-analysis or validation-only role-you will connect silicon behavior, platform requirements, market needs, and manufacturing realities to determine how products are productized. The exceptional hire uses AI deliberately to compress analysis and debug cycles. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Own product-definition analysis across performance, power, yield, and quality, using large silicon datasets to identify product opportunities, risks, and trade-offs. 
 - Drive product-specific configurations by isolating frequency- power and thermal-limiting constraints and translating findings into silicon, firmware, BIOS, driver, and platform changes. 
 - Build statistical models, automation, and visualization workflows that improve decision quality. 
 - Partner with Tools and Methodology teams to left-shift data modeling, test procedures, and closed-loop analysis infrastructure from post-silicon learning into future programs. 
 - Lead multi-functional root-cause closure with architecture, design, validation, software/firmware, applications engineering, manufacturing, and operations teams from bring-up through production. 
 - Evaluate performance-per-watt, process-voltage-temperature behavior, yield, and quality trade-offs, and drive productized fixes through implementation and confirmation. 
 - Translate complex silicon and system signals into crisp, decision-ready options that give executive leadership clarity on product configuration, performance targets, and program-impacting risks. 
 - Own and deliver BIOS-level VF settings across thermal, power, and frequency domains - debugging issues and driving fixes through cross functional teams to close on Power, Thermal, Performance, Yield and Quality gaps. 

What We Need To See

- BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering. 
 - 5+ years of experience in silicon product definition, post-silicon characterization, product engineering, or performance and power analysis for GPU, CPU, SoC, or other complex silicon products. 
 - Hands-on experience with silicon bring-up, performance-per-watt analysis, optimization across process, voltage, and temperature conditions. 
 - Strong programming and data-analysis skills using Python and one or more of Perl, JMP, SQL, or equivalent tools, with practical knowledge of statistics and large-dataset manipulation. 
 - Strong technical foundation in digital design, circuit analysis, computer architecture, critical-path analysis, process technology, and transistor/device physics. 
 - Working knowledge of the system stack, including firmware, BIOS, drivers, operating-system behavior, and software applications that influence silicon performance and power. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive ambiguous technical issues to root-cause closure across globally distributed, multi-functional teams. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate complex technical issues into crisp, decision-ready options for executive leadership. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Track record of defining and shipping product configurations that measurably improved performance, power efficiency, yield, quality, or time to market. 
 - Experience with advanced process nodes and high-complexity GPU, CPU, AI accelerator, automotive, or datacenter products. 
 - Experience building reusable product-definition methodologies, statistical models, or automation adopted across multiple silicon programs. 
 - Proficiency with AI productivity tools such as Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, or equivalent to accelerate analysis, debug, drafting, and decision-making workflows-with clear outcomes and appropriate guardrails. 
 - Comfort navigating ambiguity, building technical structure in speed-of-light silicon programs, and collaborating with global teams from diverse cultural backgrounds. 

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered one of the world's most desirable technology employers. We welcome you to join our team and help define the next era of accelerated computing.

data.title: Hardware Engineer, Silicon Power & Productization
data.description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. As an NVIDIAN, you will address challenges spanning architecture, silicon, firmware, software, and production - and excellent judgment matters as much as technical depth!

Every major NVIDIA silicon product family-from the chips powering AI and datacentre systems to gaming, professional, embedded, and automotive platforms-passes through our productization work on its way to production. 

NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design Productization team works from pre-silicon strategy and feature development through bring-up, characterization, correlation, and optimization. Our charter spans power & performance modelling, bring up & tuning of power & and thermal controllers; and system-level optimization that ultimately shape how NVIDIA products are configured, binned, specified, and shipped. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Drive silicon power productization from pre-silicon planning through bring-up and production, including test strategy, feature readiness, characterization, and optimization. 
 - Partner with architecture and design teams to identify improvements, validate features, and help translate them into production-ready solutions. 
 - Characterize and tune controller behavior across workloads, operating conditions, silicon variation, and product power and thermal limits. 
 - Build power and performance models and characterization methodologies that decide silicon binning, product specifications, productization decisions, and customer guidance.

data.title: QAE II,  Business Operations Business Operations
data.description:
Description

Amazon Business customers place orders that arrive by the pallet: a school district ordering 2, 000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking a floor. Amazon Business Operations builds the systems that get those orders sourced, consolidated and delivered on the date the customer asked for. When one of these orders goes wrong it does not just degrade a page: a dock appointment is missed, an operator recovers the order by hand, and an enterprise reconsiders how much of its spend comes to Amazon. 

We are building a new engineering team in Hyderabad dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and this is its first quality engineering hire. There is no existing test practice to inherit. You will decide what good looks like for every service the team launches. 

Key job responsibilities

As a Quality Assurance Engineer on this team, you will: 

Own feature quality end to end: design test plans, execute test cases, run bug triage, coordinate with product and engineering stakeholders, and give release sign-off. 

Build and maintain automated test coverage inside the team's framework so that regression testing does not grow with the codebase. 

Test operator-facing tooling and machine learning assisted decision flows, where correctness means the recommendation a human acts on is right, not only that the service returned a response. 

Validate integrations with Amazon supply chain and fulfilment systems, including the data correctness that inventory, transportation and delivery promises depend on. 

Set the quality bar for a new team: definition of done, quality metrics, and production monitoring that catches problems before an operator does. 

You will work directly with the engineers building the service, the product manager writing the requirements, and the Amazon Business Operations teams who use what you ship. If you want ownership of quality for a product line from its first commit, this is that role. 

A day in the life

You will sit with the engineers building the service, not apart from them. A typical day mixes writing and running test cases for the feature in the current sprint, extending automated regression coverage in the team's framework, and triaging yesterday's defects with the SDE who owns the code. You will review requirements with the product manager before a story enters the sprint, so acceptance criteria are testable rather than aspirational. You will spend time with the Amazon Business Operations teams who use the tooling, because they will tell you which failures actually hurt. Before a release ships, your sign-off is the gate. 

About The Team

Amazon Business Operations builds the systems and processes behind business buying at Amazon, from quoting a large order to landing it on a customer's dock. This is a new engineering team inside it, dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and you are joining at the start. We work in small teams with direct ownership, we measure ourselves on what changed for the customer, and we expect engineers to argue about design in writing. Expect high autonomy, close contact with the operators and customers you build for, and problems that have not been solved anywhere in Amazon yet. 

Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
 - Experience in automation testing
 - Experience in manual testing
 - Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
 - Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
 - Experience scripting or coding
 - Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
 - Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
 - Experience in penetration testing and exploitability-focused vulnerability assessment
 - Knowledge of overall system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance in a database environment
 - Experience debugging, diagnosing, and troubleshooting complex, production software issues

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.description:
Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently.

Job Description

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers' systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations. 

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists. 

Key team values: 

- Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
 - Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
 - Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
 - Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay aheadAbout the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365. 

- Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc. ) for multi-tenant SaaS environments. 

- Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven). 

- Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles. 

- Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems. 

- Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability. 

- Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization. 

- Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization. 

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built. 

You will be successful in this role if you: 

- Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer. 

- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

- Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture. 

- Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives. 

- Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers. 

- Are able to make data-driven decisions. 

- Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from. 

- Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push. 

Qualifications

We are looking for: 

- 7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements. 

- 5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants. 

- Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems. 

- Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns. 

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns. 

- Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e). 

Technical Skills and Experience: 

- Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc. ). 

- Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling). 

- Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing. 

- Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs. 

- Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production. 

- Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms. 

- CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation). 

- OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking). 

- Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin). 

Additional Information

What You'll Get: 

- Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
 - Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes. 
 - Career development and mentorship
 - A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heartPlease be advised that Jitterbit does not: 

- Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms. 
 - Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact. 
 - Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process. 
 - Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages.

data.title: Senior Controls Automation Engineer
data.description:
Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Controls & Automation Engineer to support the development, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of PLC/HMI control systems for Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) and CAFS / INERT Fire Suppression Systems. 

This is a hands-on role focused on PLC software development, HMI configuration, FAT/iFAT/SAT execution, commissioning and operational support across supplier facilities, JCI sites and project locations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC software using Siemens TIA Portal & Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience. 
 - Configure and support HMI/SCADA applications such as WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or similar platforms. 
 - Execute and support Pre-FAT, FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities. 
 - Implement and verify Cause & Effect Matrices, interlocks, alarms, shutdowns and control sequences. 
 - Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, I/O, instrumentation and communication issues. 
 - Support controlled software updates, testing and issue resolution. 
 - Work closely with engineering teams, suppliers and client representatives to achieve project milestones. 

Essential Requirements

- Degree in Electrical, Automation, Control or Instrumentation Engineering. 
 - Minimum 5 years' hands-on PLC programming experience. 
 - Strong experience with Siemens TIA Portal and Studio 5000 (mandatory). 
 - HMI development experience with WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or equivalent. 
 - Proven experience delivering FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities. 
 - Knowledge of industrial communications including Profinet, Modbus TCP/IP and Ethernet/IP. 
 - Experience implementing control philosophies, Cause & Effect requirements, interlocks and permissives. 

Desirable Experience

- Oil & Gas, Marine or Offshore projects. 
 - Fire Suppression Systems, HPU packages or safety-related control systems. 
 - Functional Safety awareness (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511). 
 - OT Cyber Security awareness (IEC 62443).

Join us as a Principal Engineer

- This is a challenging role that will see you design and engineer software with the customer or user experience as the primary objective
 - You'll be playing a major role in the engineering centre of excellence, collaborating to improve the bank's overall software engineering capability
 - You'll gain valuable stakeholder exposure as you build and leverage relationships, as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents
 - We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do

As a Principal Engineer, you'll be creating great customer outcomes via engineering and innovative solutions to existing and new challenges, and technology designs which are innovative, customer centric, high performance, secure and robust. You'll be defining, creating and providing oversight and governance of engineering and design solutions with a focus on end-to-end automation, simplification, resilience, security, performance, scalability and reusability. 

You'll Also Be

- Defining and developing architecture models and roadmaps of application and software components to meet business and technical requirements, driving common usability across products and domains
 - Working with the various feature teams to produce software rapidly and of high quality which adds value to the business
 - Determining the design and delivery approach for all of the platform's software throughout its life
 - Working within a platform or feature team along with software engineers to design and engineer complex software, scripts and tools to enable the delivery of bank platforms, applications and services, acting as a point of contact for solution design considerations

The skills you'll need

You'll come with fifteen years of extensive experience in software engineering roles, with strong expertise in distributed systems and real‐time, high‐throughput, low‐latency platforms . We'd also like to see significant and demonstrable experience of implementing programming best practice, especially around scalability, automation, virtualisation, optimisation, availability and performance. 

You'll Also Need

- Deep hands‐on knowledge of microservices, event‐driven patterns, cloud platforms (AWS), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and modern API frameworks
 - Proven delivery experience in large‐scale platform engineering or architectural leadership roles
 - Strong understanding of performance engineering, resilience patterns, observability, and operational excellence
 - Ability to influence at senior levels and lead without formal authority

Job Description

The Opportunity

Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world's greatest health threats. 

Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. Each Tech Center is supported by a focused group of leaders who invest in the well-being of our people and work together across locations to optimize global connections and continuously share and improve best practices. 

- This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (at least 3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on engineering leader to join the Veeva Platform Center of Efficiency as Associate Director, Veeva Platform Engineering Lead. Reporting to the Director, Center of Efficiency, this role leads engineering execution across the enterprise Veeva Platform ecosystem, with India as the primary location and Prague, Budapest, and Barcelona also considered. 

Unlike traditional Vault-specific leadership roles, this position operates at the Veeva Platform level and requires an enterprise-first mindset. The successful candidate will work across multiple Veeva Vault domains, driving consistency, reuse, engineering standards, and platform-wide best practices that maximize business value across the broader Veeva ecosystem. 

The ideal candidate combines deep Veeva expertise, strong integration and engineering leadership, platform thinking, and hands-on technical capability. This is a player-coach role requiring both leadership execution and technical engagement while leading a multidisciplinary team of engineers and specialists and enabling AI-driven ways of working. 

What Will You Do In This Role

- Lead engineering execution across the Veeva Platform ecosystem, ensuring successful delivery of platform priorities, backlog commitments, and roadmap-aligned initiatives. 
 - Translate platform engineering strategy into executable plans and measurable outcomes in partnership with the Center of Efficiency (CoE) & Center of Strategy (CoS) Leadership. 
 - Manage and develop a multidisciplinary team including Integration Engineers, Veeva Configuration Specialists, Quality Engineers, Business Analysts, Release Managers, and AI Engineers. 
 - Partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, business stakeholders, Vault teams, vendors, and matrix teams to prioritize, plan, and deliver high-quality platform capabilities.

 - Balance divisional requirements with enterprise platform objectives, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, reusable, and aligned with long-term platform goals.

 - Lead platform security initiatives including MFA enablement, authentication modernization, OAuth adoption, and remediation of platform risks and technical debt. 
 - Manage vendors and matrix teams to deliver high-quality outcomes in a complex global environment.

 - Deep expertise on architecture, implementation, platform activities & functional knowledge on multiple Veeva Vault domains such as Quality, Clinical, Regulatory, Safety, Medical, or related Veeva applications, with demonstrated ability to operate beyond individual Vault boundaries in a multi-Vault platform ecosystem. 
 - Strong experience delivering enterprise integrations using Veeva APIs, MuleSoft, event-driven architectures, API-led connectivity, and modern integration patterns. 
 - Experience implementing secure integration and authentication patterns, including OAuth, authentication modernization, and enterprise security best practices. 
 - Experience working in GxP-regulated environments with an understanding of compliance, validation, quality, and operational risk requirements. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business leaders across multiple organizations. 
 - Experience managing Agile delivery processes, engineering backlogs, prioritization, demand management, and roadmap-aligned execution. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance strategic objectives with hands-on technical leadership in a player-coach capacity. 
 - Experience across multiple Veeva Vault domains rollout strategy
 - Veeva Vault Platform Administrator Certification, and/or a Vault Development / Platform Developer track certification (or demonstrable equivalent hands-on experience). 
 - Experience leading platform modernization, transformation, or engineering excellence initiatives. 
 - Knowledge of AI-assisted software engineering, GenAI technologies, and emerging AI delivery practices. 
 - Experience with ITIL disciplines including Incident, Change, and Problem Management. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms, DevOps practices, and enterprise architecture principles. 
 - Experience building and scaling engineering teams within global, matrixed organizations. 
 - Experience within the pharmaceutical or life sciences domain. 
 - Any vault-specific Veeva certification (Clinical, RIM, QMS, Safety, Medical). 
 - Experience with Veeva Vault Java SDK. 
 - Builds and operationalizes a high-performing Veeva Platform Engineering delivery team. 
 - Delivers strategic platform backlog initiatives and roadmap-aligned engineering commitments. 
 - Drives platform-wide adoption of reusable patterns, standards, and best practices. 
 - Advances platform security through authentication, modernization, and remediation of platform risks and technical debt. 
 - Optimizes release management processes across the Veeva ecosystem. 
 - Partners effectively and build trust with Vault teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and platform leadership. 
 - Accelerates engineering productivity through AI-enabled ways of working. 
 - Promotes enterprise-first thinking and helps evolve the Veeva Platform into a scalable, secure, and reusable enterprise capability.

data.title: FS RISK CONSULTING-FSRM - CSTC-CREDIT RISK QUALITY ASSURANCE-QUALITY CONTROL-MANAGER
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Risk Consulting - Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) - Capital, Stress Testing & Credit risk management (FSRM) - Manager

Description

EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls. 

Within EY's Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking experienced Credit Risk and Quality Assurance professionals to join the QA Managed Services team supporting Wholesale Credit Quality Assurance (WCQA) activities, where the role involves: 

- Independently reviewing credit portfolios and assessing underwriting quality in line with regulatory and internal policy expectations
 - Executing end-to-end QA processes within a managed services operating model while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs, quality standards, and governance frameworks
 - Executing and/or leading Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) and associated testing across credit lifecycle activities
 - Providing credible challenge to underwriters and portfolio teams on credit decisions, documentation quality, and process adherence 
 - Generating thematic, portfolio-level insights beyond case-specific observations to identify operational and control weaknesses, training gaps, and process deficiencies, thereby supporting continuous improvement and strengthening overall credit risk management practices. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Perform periodic Quality Assurance Reviews (QARs) across wholesale lending credit risk activities, including underwriting & credit analysis, credit documentation quality, and overall process adherence. 
 - Assess the accuracy and appropriateness of risk ratings, financial analysis, and credit decisions
 - Deliver consistent, objective assessments using defined QA methodologies, sampling frameworks, and standardized review protocols. 
 - Review credit memos, financial models, covenant structures, and approval workflows
 - Identify and document process gaps, control weaknesses, and quality deficiencies, with a strong focus on thematic trends and systemic issues to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Provide credible challenge to Business/Portfolio Leads and Underwriters on underwriting quality, analytical rigor, and adherence to policies and standards, with appropriate escalation of material issues. 
 - Support the effective identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of wholesale credit risks, ensuring alignment with risk appetite and established risk governance frameworks. 
 - Translate policy and standard requirements into testing strategies and standardized test scripts and support planning efforts to enable efficient and scalable QAR execution. 
 - Prepare high-quality QA deliverables, including QAR workpapers, review summaries, scorecards, and management reports, highlighting key findings, emerging risks, and actionable recommendations. 
 - Generate portfolio-level insights and management information (MI), contributing to governance reporting and enabling informed decision-making by QA leadership. 
 - Track and manage corrective actions and remediation efforts, including follow-ups and validation of issue closure, supported by root cause analysis to minimize recurrence of findings. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, maintaining strong working relationships to ensure alignment on QA scope, findings, and continuous enhancement of QA frameworks and protocols. 

Qualifications, Certifications And Education

Must-have: 

- CA or Bachelor's/master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
 - 7-10 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: wholesale credit underwriting, credit risk management, loan review, credit quality assurance, or internal audit/assurance covering credit processes
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale credit risk lifecycle, including underwriting, monitoring, and credit risk governance (policies, standards, and process adherence)
 - Solid knowledge of risk management and control frameworks relating to corporate or counterparty credit risk; exposure to problem credit assessment and risk mitigation is an added advantage
 - Ability to evaluate credit processes and control design, identify quality gaps, and assess effectiveness of controls within a QA or review function
 - Proven capability to review and challenge credit work products, including credit analysis, underwriting rationale, risk identification, and monitoring approach, with clear documentation of QA conclusions
 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured QA reports and articulate thematic insights for senior stakeholders
 - Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working effectively with 1LoD/2LoD teams and stakeholders to drive issue resolution and continuous improvement
 - Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in credit risk management, QA review, and workflow automation. 
 - Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills

Nice to Have Skills: 

- Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, or equivalent
 - Experience building/testing QA test scripts, review checklists, or testing strategies mapped to policy requirements
 - Exposure to portfolio analytics / sampling / scoping methodology for QA coverage
 - Exposure to data analytics tools, reporting dashboards, or workflow tools
 - Experience in managed services or offshore delivery models
 - Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Description

Job Summary

We are seeking a Staff Engineer - Performance Engineering to provide technical leadership and drive performance engineering excellence across multiple products and platforms within Merchandise Solutions. This role will be responsible for defining performance strategies, establishing performance engineering standards, driving observability practices, and partnering with Product, Development, QA, SRE, and Architecture teams to ensure applications are scalable, reliable, and performant. 

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in performance testing, bottleneck analysis, observability, and performance optimization, while serving as a trusted advisor and mentor across engineering teams. The role requires significant hands-on experience with NeoLoad, Splunk, AppDynamics/Application Insights, performance engineering best practices, and modern software architectures. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and execute enterprise performance engineering strategies, standards, and best practices across multiple products and teams. 
 - Partner with Product Management, Architects, and Engineering teams on NFR requirement gathering, workload modelling, capacity planning, and performance benchmarking. 
 - Design and execute load, stress, endurance, scalability, and reliability testing using NeoLoad and other enterprise performance engineering tools.

 - Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on performance testing, analysis, scripting, monitoring, and troubleshooting. 
 - Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, observability practices, and performance engineering methodologies. 
 - Influence architectural decisions and provide recommendations to improve scalability, resiliency, and overall system performance. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Minimum 10+ years of experience in Performance Engineering, Performance Testing, or related engineering disciplines. 
 - Strong expertise with NeoLoad and enterprise performance testing methodologies. 
 - Experience with performance monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, App Insights, Dynatrace, or equivalent. 
 - Extensive experience performing end-to-end performance testing lifecycle activities, including NFR analysis, workload modelling, test planning, execution, monitoring, troubleshooting, and reporting. 
 - Strong experience in identifying performance bottlenecks and implementing optimization recommendations. 
 - Advanced understanding of system architectures, cloud environments, distributed systems, APIs, databases, and integrations. 
 - Strong experience with REST API performance testing and API monitoring. 
 - Strong experience creating and supporting bulk test datasets and complex performance test scenarios. 
 - Strong experience writing and optimizing SQL queries. 
 - Experience using Git/GitHub, source control practices, and performance testing asset management. 
 - Experience working within Agile / SAFe environments utilizing JIRA and Confluence.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience integrating performance testing into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Azure DevOps. 
 - Experience implementing observability and monitoring standards across organizations.

 - Experience mentoring engineers and building organizational performance engineering capabilities.

Nice to Have
