The Role

We are looking for an exceptional engineer and problem solver who can solve problems where the solution is not obvious or already known. 

This is not a conventional Software Engineer or Data Scientist role. 

You will work at the intersection of software engineering, algorithms, data science, machine learning, AI and distributed systems, taking extremely complex business problems from ambiguity to production. 

You should be able to understand the problem, develop the algorithmic or mathematical approach, design the architecture, write critical code and ultimately make the system work at scale. 

What You Will Do

- Solve highly complex software, data science and optimization problems. 
 - Design scalable, production-grade systems from scratch. 
 - Build advanced algorithms rather than relying only on existing libraries. 
 - Develop ML, predictive, recommendation, optimization, anomaly/fraud detection and decision systems. 
 - Build AI-native products using LLMs, RAG, agents and human-in-the-loop architectures. 
 - Work with large-scale, noisy and incomplete datasets. 
 - Design distributed, real-time and high-volume systems. 
 - Move ideas through research → prototype → architecture → production → scale. 
 - Personally write and review critical code. 
 - Act as a technical authority for difficult engineering and AI problems. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and data scientists without becoming a purely managerial leader. 

What We Are Looking For

Deep expertise across several of these areas: 

Software Engineering

- Python plus Java/C++/Go or equivalent
 - Algorithms & data structures
 - Distributed systems
 - Backend architecture
 - APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure
 - Performance and scalability

Data Science & AI

- Machine learning and statistical modeling
 - Optimization and forecasting
 - Recommendation/ranking systems
 - Anomaly and fraud detection
 - Deep learning
 - LLMs, RAG and AI agents
 - ML system design and production deployment

Strong mathematical and algorithmic thinking is essential. 

The Person We Want

Imagine receiving a problem involving: 

50M+ events, noisy data, conflicting business constraints, real-time decisions, prediction and optimization, with no existing solution that completely solves the problem. 

We want the person who can break that problem apart, determine what requires algorithms, ML, optimization or conventional software, architect the solution and then actually build it. 

We particularly value people who have: 

- Built technically difficult products from scratch
 - Developed proprietary algorithms
 - Built systems operating at significant scale
 - Taken complex ML systems into production
 - Published research or filed patents
 - Worked deeply across both software engineering and data science

What This Role Is NOT

We are not looking for someone whose primary experience is: 

- Standard ML notebooks and dashboards
 - Basic CRUD development
 - Calling LLM APIs
 - Managing engineers without coding
 - Copying existing architectures
 - Depending on AI-generated code without understanding it

AI tools are encouraged. Technical dependency on them is not. 

How We Will Interview

No interview based primarily on memorized questions. 

Candidates will be evaluated through: 

- Technical Depth - Deep dive into the hardest system you have personally built. 
 - Problem Decomposition - Solve an ambiguous, complex real-world problem. 
 - System & Algorithm Design - Architect a production solution. 
 - Hands-On Exercise - Build an important component of that solution. 
 - Technical Leadership - Defend your decisions with senior leadership. 

Success

We are not hiring someone simply to write more code. 

We are hiring someone who increases the level of problems our organization is capable of solving.

Solution Validation & Customer Engagement

- Understand customer deployments, business requirements, architectures, and large-scale operational environments to develop comprehensive validation strategies. 
 - Drive validation efforts for customer solutions and complex networking deployments. 
 - Collaborate with customers, field engineers, solution architects, sales engineers, and services teams to validate real-world networking solutions and operational readiness. 
 - Participate in technical design workshops and architecture reviews to improve reliability, scalability, observability, and serviceability. 
 - Translate customer requirements into repeatable, solution-focused validation frameworks. 
 - Present technical findings, risk assessments, quality recommendations, and executive-level updates to customers and internal stakeholders. 
 - Participate in cross-functional initiatives that improve customer outcomes and product quality.

 - Architect, develop, and evolve scalable automation frameworks supporting functional, integration, system, resiliency, scale, performance, and solution validation.

 - Promote quality engineering methodologies that improve time-to-market and engineering productivity.

data.title: Technical Consultant - Cloud -Performance Engineer,Jmeter,,Application Monitoring
data.description:
Scope

- You own performance. You define, measure, break, and fix how the system behaves under real-world conditions. You ensure the product scales, stays stable, and performs predictably-before customers find out it doesn't. 

Our Technical Environment

- Performance Engineer with expertise in JMeter
 - Java and Data structures
 - Understanding of Linux Operating System and shell scripting

What You'll Do

- As a Performance Engineer, you serve as a specialist in the engineering team that supports the team with following responsibilities. 
 - Participate in design and development of skeleton/stub components for the successful integration tests. . 
 - Develop automation utilities and scripts that help to automate mundane tasks. 
 - Participate in status meetings with Project stakeholders on need basis. 
 - Gather and validate the NFR's shared by customers/stakeholders. 
 - Mentor the team members on Performance test activities as the need arises. 
 - Analyse the Performance test runs and report defects and share the findings. Prepare and review Performance Test reports

Must Have

What we are looking for: 

- 1-3 years of experience as Performance Tester/Engineer on Java based application deployed on-prem/on-cloud with expertise in JMeter as automation tool. 
 - Hands-on with performance tools JMeter / Gatling / k6, APM tools, log analysis, profiling tools. 
 - Understanding of metrics needed performance certification of a Java application
 - Understanding of Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)
 - Linux perf commands & Shell scripting
 - Telegraph, Influx, Grafana for Application monitoring. 
 - Thread Dump analysis, GC logs analysis, Heap dump analysis. 
 - A strong and innovative approach to problem-solving and finding solutions
 - Excellent communicator (written and verbal, formal and informal)
 - Flexible and proactive/self-motivated working style with strong personal ownership and problem resolution
 - Ability to multi-task under pressure and work independently with minimum supervision. 
 - Ability to prioritize under pressure
 - Ability to learn on the job and apply the knowledge to achieve results. 

Good To Have

- Java and Data structures
 - SQL knowledge. 
 - Tomcat/Netty
 - Understanding of REST API's
 - Experience working/administering Azure or any other cloud service provider
 - Hazelcast or any IMDG ( In Memory Data grid) or REDIS, (Nice to have)
 - Kafka or any messaging systems. 
 - Understanding of Microservices architecture
 - Ecommerce and Retailer domain understanding
 - Understanding of Kubernetes architecture and administration

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success - and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

data.title: Engineering Excellence Manager
data.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Description

Job Description

Engineering Excellence Manager

Industrial Automation and Control

As Engineering Excellence Manager, you will raise the quality, consistency and repeatability of the industrial automation and control solutions we engineer for our customers. You will lead the engineering standards, design practices, trusted content and quality gates that our project teams work to, and you will hold the organisation accountable for applying them across process, discrete and hybrid engagements. Your remit covers engineering governance, design assurance, continuous improvement and technical competency development, so that every project starts from content rather than a blank page. 

You will have the Engineering Standards and Trusted Content, Design Assurance and Quality, Engineering Continuous Improvement, and Technical Competency and Training functions reporting to you. You will build a engineering chain, assuring the development of technical resources, and preparing the structure to support new delivery strategies as our automation and digital transformation portfolio grows. You will be responsible for resource development, with Engineering Domain Expertise Management. 

You will report to the Director of Engineering Delivery and have a hybrid schedule working in Pune, India. 

Your Responsibilities

Under your leadership, the following functions will have the following responsibilities -

Technical Competency and Training

- Lead a team of Technical Leads and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across automation domains, providing direction, coaching, performance development, and succession planning to provide a strong and sustainable technical organisation. 
 - Establish clear ownership and accountability for domain expertise, ensuring that SMEs maintain deep technical knowledge aligned with current and latest technologies. 
 - Provide leadership and oversight to the Technical Lead and SME community, ensuring technical decision-making, knowledge sharing, and understanding of engineering practices across projects, industries, and regions. 
 - Be a final escalation point for complex technical challenges and cross-domain engineering decisions that require expert judgement and resolution. 

Engineering Standards and Trusted Content

This department will be responsible for governing the usage of Trusted Content and standard templates in project execution, and will be the focal point for resolving all critical engineering problems. It will define, publish and version-control the engineering standards, design templates and reusable control libraries built on Logix controllers, FactoryTalk software and Rockwell Automation reference architectures, so that engineers across the region design from the same proven baseline. 

Design Assurance and Quality

This department will maintain engineering quality control by using our Global Quality Management System in the design and delivery of our projects and services. It will operate design reviews and quality gates across the full lifecycle, from functional design specification through factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing and handover, and will confirm that deliverables meet the applicable functional safety, cybersecurity and industry standards including IEC 61511, IEC 62443, ISA-88 and ISA-95. 

Engineering Continuous Improvement

This department will help use Lean, Six Sigma, Agile and other quality methodologies within the engineering community. It will ensure that productivity projects are identified and executed through the year for measurable results, reducing engineering effort per deliverable without conceding quality. It will also introduce tooling that raises productivity, including configuration-driven code generation, automated testing, emulation and disciplined version control, and will own the lessons-learned process so that an issue surfaced on one project becomes standard practice on the next. 

Technical Competency and Training

This function is responsible for managing the competency needs of the engineering organisation and for the programmes that feed it. It will maintain a competency framework covering process, discrete, hybrid, safety and information solutions disciplines with clear proficiency levels, run technical training, certification and mentoring from graduate trainee through to technical lead, and work with engineering managers to close skill gaps against the forward order book. 

Technical Authority and Customer Engagement

You will act as the senior technical authority for PLC, HMI, SCADA, drives, motion and safety applications, reviewing complex or high-risk designs covering network topology, controller sizing, redundancy strategy, functional safety and industrial cybersecurity before they reach the customer. You will guide the adoption of Rockwell Automation platforms in delivery engagements, including Studio 5000, FactoryTalk View, FactoryTalk Optix, PlantPAx and Emulate3D, support proposal engineering with technical solution reviews and estimating norms, and represent engineering quality in customer design reviews, audits and escalations. 

All the above roles will work with the relevant global teams to make this happen. 

The Essentials - You Will Have

- You will have a bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Control Systems or Mechatronics Engineering. 
 - You will have 15 or more years in industrial automation engineering, including experience leading engineering teams, technical governance or an engineering excellence function. 
 - You will be Six Sigma certified. 
 - You will understand process and discrete automation and the relevant control systems, with hands-on design and commissioning background across PLC, HMI, SCADA and drive systems. 
 - You will have overseen engineering standards, design reviews or quality systems in a project delivery environment. 
 - You will display, communication, partner management. 
 - You will have experience building technical teams while promoting a culture of collaboration, innovation, and learning. 
 - Expertise in managing diverse technical expert teams across multiple industries, technologies, and geographical regions. 

What You Will Be Measured On

- Provide a quarterly engineering excellence update to leadership. 
 - Fulfilment of important talent development plans across the engineering population. 
 - Manage turnover of necessary technical talent no higher than the turnover of the location. 
 - Lead engineering quality management and reduce rework hours and defects found at site acceptance testing. 
 - Conduct the monthly engineering governance meetings, including the design review board, the trusted content and standards review, and engineering quality reporting. 
 - Grow the reuse of control modules and templates across industry segments and report adoption. 
 - Support employee engagement, retention, and career development outcomes within the Technical Lead and SME organisation. 
 - Maintain a pipeline of technical talent through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and career progression of Technical Leads and SMEs. 
 - Improve technical competency maturity across the organisation through measurable growth in certifications, domain expertise, and technical capability development. 

What We Offer

Our benefits package includes . . . 

- Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm
 - Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
 - Company volunteer and donation matching programme - Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation. 
 - Employee Assistance Program
 - Personalised wellbeing programs through our OnTrack programme
 - On-demand digital course library for professional development
 - and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

data.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Position Summary

Team Lead - Chemical and Pulp & Paper Engineering

Pune/Noida-India

As Team Lead for Chemical and Pulp & Paper Engineering, you will provide dedicated leadership for a growing team of approximately 10-12 engineers. You will be accountable for project execution, resource planning, stakeholder engagement, and team development while supporting safe, high-quality, and predictable engineering delivery for customers in the Chemical and Pulp & Paper industries. 

You will report to the Engineering Manager and work in a hybrid capacity from one of our India either Pune/Noida offices. 

Your Responsibilities

Lead and develop a team of approximately 10-12 engineers, including work allocation, coaching, capability development, performance support, and succession planning. 

Own engineering project execution across the Chemical and Pulp & Paper portfolio, ensuring delivery commitments, technical quality, schedule, cost, safety, and scope are effectively managed. 

Plan and balance engineering resources across projects, proposals, site activities, and priority changes, proactively addressing capacity, competency, and delivery risks. 

Engage with business leaders, project teams, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders to clarify expectations, align priorities, resolve escalations, and provide transparent execution updates. 

The Essentials - You Will Have

Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Control, Automation, Chemical, or equivalent relevant professional experience. 

Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams and delivering industrial automation or control-system projects, with accountability for execution, resource planning, and stakeholder management. 

Ability to travel to customer sites and project locations as required. 

The Preferred - You Might Also Have

 - Help embed standards and governance by driving adoption, auditing how we work, and turning gaps into actions we own or items for the program tech roadmap

At Mastercard, our industry expertise is enhanced by our commitment to being a force for good in the world and to doing well by doing good. Mastercard relies on our global workforce to help us achieve our goal of building a sustainable, inclusive global economy. The Mastercard Way encourages us, connects us with the behaviors that represent the essence of not only what we do but who we are as an organization. Cultivating an environment for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views and experiences drives a global and collaborative culture of inclusion and sense of belonging. 

MasterCard is recruiting a Vice President of Software Engineering to lead software engineering teams developing advanced technologies and applications that are revolutionizing payments. MasterCard software engineering teams leverage Agile development principles, advanced development and design practices, and an obsession over security, reliability, and performance to deliver solutions that delight our customers. 

Are you passionate about software engineering?

Are you fanatical about building large scale, distributed systems the right way?

Do you want to help software engineers to build better quality software faster?

Do you firmly believe that code talks, and just about anything else walks?

Do you want to join a Company that offers a competitive benefits-and rewards program that attracts, develops and retains the most talented employees around the world?

Do you want to join an inclusive culture where employees, in all their diversity, feel valued, respected and who can bring their authentic selves to work? Learn more at Mastercard's Corporate Sustainability Report. 

Key Responsibility

- Release Quality & Platform Stability

Own end‐to‐end release quality, safeguarding customer experience and platform trust across all deployments. 

Establish and enforce rigorous testing standards, release readiness criteria, and go/no‐go decision frameworks. 

Drive risk management and defect containment strategies, including early detection, root‐cause analysis, and preventive actions. 

Lead quality governance across development, testing, and production operations-ensuring predictable, stable releases. 

Champion engineering accountability for production health, incident reduction, and operational excellence. 

Partner with Product, Operations, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to ensure resilience, observability, and recoverability. 

- Modernization & Technology Evolution

Define and execute the technology modernization roadmap, reducing technical debt while improving scalability, resilience, and efficiency. 

Lead Transformation Initiatives Including

Legacy platform modernization

Cloud‐native and hybrid architectures

Microservices, API‐first, and event‐driven systems

Drive continuous improvement in engineering productivity, deployment velocity, and cost efficiency. 

Ensure architectural consistency, security, and compliance across platforms and regions. 

Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies aligned with long‐term business and platform strategy. 

- AI & Intelligent Automation Leadership

Drive AI adoption across the engineering organization, embedding intelligence into development, testing, operations, and decision‐making. 

Sponsor AI‐enabled Capabilities Such As

Test automation and intelligent defect detection

Predictive analytics for risk and capacity management

AI‐assisted development and productivity tools

Partner with business and data leaders to ensure AI delivers measurable outcomes, not experimentation alone. 

Establish responsible AI practices-governance, explainability, security, and ethical use. 

- Engineering Leadership & Culture

Lead, mentor, and inspire senior engineering leaders and managers across geographies. 

Build a culture of quality-first engineering, ownership, continuous learning, and innovation. 

Develop strong succession planning, upskilling strategies, and cross‐functional talent mobility. 

Foster collaboration across Product, Architecture, Operations, Security, and Business stakeholders. 

- Executive Partnership & Stakeholder Management

Act as a trusted engineering partner to senior executives, providing clear visibility into risk, quality, delivery, and modernization progress. 

Communicate complex technical topics in a concise, executive‐ready manner. 

Manage strategic vendor and partner relationships to ensure delivery excellence and innovation. 

About You

You are a hands-on, technical and people leader able to manage directly and through others. 

As a technically astute leader, your recognized subject matter expertise allows you regularly dive deep into everything your teams do. 

Your leadership style is based on building trust with your team, your peers, and your management. 

You are high-energy, detail-oriented, proactive, and adaptive and can work in a dynamic environment. 

You possess strong communication skills - both verbal and written - and can get your point across efficiently to a wide range of audiences. 

You are obsessed with results, and effectively communicate objectives and how success will be measured to your teams and other stakeholders. 

You have strong decision-making skills, and you have a bias for action rather than drawn-out analysis because you understand that most decisions are not irreversible. 

You regularly lead retrospection, and continually improve as a result. 

You have strong collaborative and organizational skills and you value transparency over avoiding scrutiny. 

You understand how to guide a team member's career including performance evaluation, coaching, and motivation. 

You are an experienced manager able to evaluate and coach other managers. 

You are experienced in distributed system design and implementation, and have a good understanding of how high-performance, high-reliability, large-scale distributed systems are built and operated. 

You have expert level knowledge of software development processes, and you practice Agile at an advanced level. 

You have experience and knowledge of Test Driven and Domain Driven Development (TDD / DDD). 

You are an experienced user of one or more Application Lifecycle Management tools (e. g. , Rally, Jira). 

You have good Payments/Card industry knowledge, and you can read and understand a business case. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Staff Engineer – Observability Platform
data.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world's leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500, 000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration-enabling users to create better APIs, faster. 

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman. com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman. 

P. S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our Observability team. This role is ideal for a highly technical engineer who thrives on uncovering the truth behind complex system behaviors, diagnosing difficult production challenges, and driving platform-wide improvements. 

As a Staff Engineer, you will operate as a force multiplier across engineering teams, helping Postman build world-class observability capabilities while improving reliability, performance, and developer productivity. You will partner closely with Infrastructure, Platform, Product, Security, and Data teams to identify systemic issues, establish operational excellence, and ensure engineering teams have the visibility they need to operate at scale. 

What You'll Do

- Drive the technical vision and architecture for Postman's observability platform. 
 - Design and build scalable solutions for metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and operational analytics. 
 - Investigate complex production issues, identify root causes, and drive long-term corrective actions. 
 - Partner with engineering teams to improve service reliability, availability, performance, and operational maturity. 
 - Establish observability standards, best practices, and instrumentation frameworks across the company. 
 - Build tooling and automation that enable faster incident detection, diagnosis, and resolution. 
 - Leverage telemetry data to uncover performance bottlenecks, capacity risks, and reliability gaps. 
 - Drive cross-functional initiatives focused on platform health, operational excellence, and engineering productivity. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and help raise the technical bar across the organization. 

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years of software engineering experience with significant exposure to distributed systems and cloud-native architectures. 
 - Strong expertise in observability domains including monitoring, logging, distributed tracing, telemetry pipelines, and incident management. 
 - Experience operating large-scale production systems with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and performance. 
 - Deep understanding of system debugging, root-cause analysis, performance optimization, and production operations. 
 - Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, Python, Node. js, or similar. 
 - Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk, Honeycomb, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Ability to influence technical direction across teams without direct authority. 
 - Strong communication skills and a data-driven approach to problem-solving. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building internal developer platforms or observability platforms at scale. 
 - Exposure to AIOps, intelligent alerting, anomaly detection, or AI-powered operational tooling. 
 - Experience driving reliability initiatives across multiple engineering organizations. 
 - Background in SRE, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Developer Productivity. 

Why This Role Matters

The Observability team sits at the center of Postman's engineering ecosystem. Success in this role means creating the visibility, insights, and operational intelligence that enable every engineering team at Postman to build and operate reliable products with confidence. 

This is a high-impact Staff Engineer position for someone who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges, driving engineering excellence, and uncovering the signals that help teams make better decisions. 

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We're building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves. 

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom. 

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. data.title: Senior Data Engineer - Vice President - Python Development
data.description:
Technology

Join a small, high-impact engineering team in Citi Markets Technology building the data foundation for greenfield Generative AI products across asset classes. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer who combines deep Python expertise with strong engineering judgement and a practical understanding of how to build reliable, high-performance data platforms. 

The role goes beyond constructing ETL pipelines. You will help define how billions of records from diverse Markets data sources are collected, validated, transformed, governed, and made available to production AI applications with consistently low retrieval latency. 

If you want to work on ambitious data engineering problems, shape a platform from the ground up, and help define how data is engineered for production AI in Markets, this is the role for you. 

The Team

We are a fast-moving team specialising in Generative AI within Markets Technology. We build greenfield products that span multiple asset classes and solve real business problems using modern AI and data engineering approaches. 

Our applications depend on a robust and well-designed data foundation. That means creating pipelines and serving layers that can process billions of records while preserving data quality, provenance, security, and operational reliability. 

The team is still small enough for every engineer to have genuine influence. Data engineering is a core part of the product architecture, not a downstream support function. 

The Role

As a Vice President in the team, you will be a hands-on senior engineer responsible for designing and building the data foundation for greenfield Generative AI products across Markets, including our conversational AI platform. 

You will develop production-grade data pipelines and services, primarily using Python, to ingest, validate, transform, enrich, and serve data from a wide range of internal and external sources. You will help create a curated, high-performance data-serving layer that enables low-latency retrieval by our AI and application services. 

You will contribute directly to code while also shaping architecture, engineering standards, data models, quality controls, and operational practices. We are looking for someone who can make pragmatic technology choices, challenge assumptions, and take long-term ownership of the platform. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and evolve the data architecture supporting Generative AI products across Markets
 - Develop scalable Python pipelines that ingest, validate, transform, enrich, and integrate billions of records from diverse sources
 - Build curated, queryable datasets and high-performance serving layers for low-latency application access
 - Design and optimise the application's data storage strategies, initially centred on PostgreSQL and Parquet
 - Select suitable processing approaches for each workload, from efficient in-process and columnar processing to distributed frameworks where required
 - Optimise ingestion, transformation, storage, indexing, and query performance
 - Establish robust controls for data quality, reconciliation, lineage, schema evolution, idempotency, and recovery
 - Build production observability into data pipelines, including metrics, logging, alerting, and operational diagnostics
 - Design solutions that respect data classification, entitlements, access controls, and security requirements
 - Contribute directly to code, architecture reviews, technical standards, and the wider engineering direction of the team
 - Build automated tests and CI/CD pipelines that enable reliable and repeatable delivery
 - Collaborate closely with AI engineers, software engineers, architects, product partners, and Markets stakeholders
 - Use AI-assisted engineering tools, including Devin and GitHub Copilot, to improve development quality and productivity

What We're Looking For

- Extensive hands-on experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a closely related discipline
 - Deep practical expertise in Python and the ability to build maintainable, production-grade software
 - A proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale data platforms or data-intensive applications
 - Strong SQL skills and extensive experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL
 - Experience with data modelling, indexing, partitioning, query optimisation, and database performance tuning
 - Strong knowledge of the Python data ecosystem, including libraries such as pandas, PyArrow, SQLAlchemy, and NumPy
 - Practical experience working with columnar formats such as Apache Parquet and selecting efficient storage and serialisation strategies
 - Experience processing large-scale datasets using technologies such as Apache Spark, Dask, Polars, or equivalent frameworks
 - Strong understanding of ETL and ELT architecture, including incremental processing, idempotency, failure recovery, and schema evolution
 - Experience implementing automated data quality controls, reconciliation, lineage, monitoring, and operational alerting
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design, testing, maintainability, code review, and CI/CD
 - Experience deploying and operating services on container platforms such as Kubernetes or OpenShift
 - Understanding of data governance and security practices, including encryption, masking, classification, entitlements, and fine-grained access control
 - The ability to operate in ambiguity, take ownership, and influence the technical direction of a product
 - Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to engineering

What Makes This Role Different

This is not a role focused on maintaining legacy ETL jobs or moving data between systems without understanding how it will be used. 

You will help build the data foundation of a new generation of AI products in Markets. The engineering challenges include integrating complex datasets, processing billions of records, delivering consistently low retrieval latency, and meeting the quality, security, and reliability standards expected of production financial systems. 

The role offers the opportunity to influence the architecture from an early stage, work closely with AI and application engineers, and take genuine ownership of a platform that is central to the product. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect
 - Familiarity with Generative AI applications, retrieval architectures, LLMs, agentic systems, or structured evaluation
 - Experience building data foundations for search, retrieval, analytics, machine learning, or AI applications
 - Knowledge of financial instruments, trading concepts, and data structures within FX, Equities, or other capital markets domains
 - Experience working with temporal, reference, market, or transactional data
 - A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline, or equivalent professional experience

Join us as an Infrastructure Engineer VP at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences. As a part of the team, you will deliver technology stack, using strong analytical and problem solving skills to understand the business requirements and deliver quality solutions. You'll be working on complex technical problems that will involve detailed analytical skills and analysis. This will be done in conjunction with fellow engineers, business analysts and business stakeholders. 

To be successful as an Infrastructure Engineer VP you should have experience with: 

- Demonstrated expertise in Block Storage technologies (SAN, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, multipathing, zoning) with the ability to troubleshoot performance, connectivity, and availability issues end-to-end. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with File Storage platforms (NAS protocols such as NFS/SMB, permissions, snapshots, replication, scalability) and proven ability to optimize performance and resilience.

 - Strong observability vision and execution, including defining metrics/logs/traces for storage and backup services, building dashboards, alerting strategies, and using telemetry to prevent incidents before they impact customers. 
 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills with a consistent track record of working across infrastructure, application, cybersecurity, and service management teams to deliver outcomes and influence operational best practices. 

Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include

- Experience automating storage and backup operations using Python/PowerShell, API integrations, or infrastructure-as-code approaches to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.

This is a full-time, hands-on role where you will own the core infrastructure and systems that enable us to discover customers' data landscape, handle sensitive data like names, address securely and to clean and catalog them into training-ready datasets. 

That path covers connectors and on-prem agentic discovery components, secrets and PII scrubbing, scale and cost efficient ingestion and clearance for use in model training. You lead a small team of 3-4 engineers and raise the quality bar in your pod. 

What you'll own

- Connectors and extraction - You'll build connectors for common SaaS and databases (Google Workspace, Slack, Postgres/MySQL, Jira, MongoDB) and for specific tools such as Razorpay, GreytHR, Keka, Zoho and LeadSquared. The rule is to build only where no good open-source connector or clean export exists. 
 - On-prem scanning - You'll build a CLI or agent that runs at the data owner's end to sample and estimate the value of their data without shipping all of it to us. 
 - Clearance pipeline - Secrets detection across full git history, fail-closed. PII redaction for code and conversational data, including Indian identifiers (PAN, Aadhaar, GSTIN, IFSC, UPI). Measurable recall and precision. 
 - Lineage - Every output record must trace back to its raw source, and every lot must be revocable. 
 - Delivery - Packaging, sampling for buyers, and supporting the supply and BD teams on data questions. 

You have

- 8+ years in backend or data engineering, with at least 2 years leading up to 4 or more engineers. 
 - You've built ingestion or ETL pipelines that run in production. 
 - Hands-on work with sensitive data such as PII, financial or health data, including redaction, masking or access controls. 
 - The judgment to decide what to build and what to adopt. 

Nice to have

- Experience with Presidio, gitleaks/TruffleHog, dlt or Airbyte. 
 - Knowledge of DPDP, GDPR, HIPAA or SOC 2. 
 - You've shipped software that runs in customers' environments. 

This is not a pure people-management role. You'll write code, review everything, and personally own the hardest problems in the pod.

 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas

 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing

Observability & Debuggability

Test Data & Environment Management

Incident & Operational Support

Qualifications

data.title: Manager, Engineering
data.description:
About Tekion

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3, 000 people across North America, Asia and Europe. 

Summary

We're looking for an Engineering Manager who is equally fluent in technical depth and people leadership - someone who can drive architectural decisions, grow senior talent, and deliver complex platform capabilities in a fast-moving, distributed environment. This role oversees project execution, team performance, and cross-functional collaboration, while fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement

Responsibilities

- Lead and grow a team of 10+ engineers (including senior ICs and potentially Tech Leads), owning hiring, performance, and career development
 - Drive end-to-end delivery of platform components - from architecture and design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration
 - Engage credibly in system design and architecture reviews; set and enforce engineering quality standards across the team
 - Partner closely with Product, Design, QA, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
 - Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and systemic risks before they become incidents
 - Foster a high-ownership engineering culture - model code quality, rigorous testing, and thoughtful operational practices
 - Write high-quality code and taking responsibility for their task. 
 - Coordinate across US-India distributed teams, ensuring alignment, velocity, and clear communication across time zones
 - Mentor and develop engineers at all levels

Requirements

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years in engineering leadership managing teams of 7+ engineers
 - Strong Java and Spring Boot backend expertise; hands-on ability to engage in design reviews and code-level discussions
 - Experience building and operating distributed microservices and event-driven architectures on AWS at scale
 - Proficiency with multi-database stacks: MongoDB, MySQL/PostgreSQL, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Redis or similar
 - Strong problem-solving and technical troubleshooting skills; experience diagnosing and resolving production-scale performance issues
 - Proven track record of recruiting and developing senior engineering talent in competitive markets
 - Excellent cross-functional communication - comfortable working directly with Product, Design, and executive stakeholders
 - Experience delivering in high-ambiguity, fast-paced SaaS environments with evolving platform dependencies

Good to Have

- Prior experience managing both backend and frontend engineering disciplines (React, Angular) within the same org
 - Experience with automotive retail technology, dealership workflows, or adjacent domains
 - Exposure to AI/ML platform development or integrating LLM-based capabilities into production systems

Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice here.

data.title: Sr. Engineering Manager
data.description:
The Director of Finance Technology and Cloud Engineering will lead a portfolio of applications supporting financial reporting, expected credit loss, general ledger processing, reconciliation, disbursements, tax reporting, planning, profitability, treasury, and financial risk management. 

These Applications Consolidate Information From Multiple Source Systems And Support Legal-entity And Enterprise-level Reporting Across Several Markets. They Produce Financial Analyses Such As

- Actual results compared with plan and forecast
 - Month-over-month movements and explanations
 - Credit loss provision movements and scenario comparisons
 - Reconciliation breaks, ageing, and root-cause analysis
 - Daily cash position and liquidity checks
 - Product, dealer, and customer-segment profitability
 - Interest income sensitivity and financial stress scenarios
 - Forecast accuracy and reserve adequacy assessments

The application portfolio operates in a regulated financial environment and must meet applicable financial reporting, audit, security, data lineage, and internal control requirements. These include Sarbanes-Oxley requirements, Internal Control over Financial Reporting, Current Expected Credit Loss standards, and International Financial Reporting Standard 9, where applicable. 

The successful candidate will provide technology and product leadership across application development, cloud modernization, artificial intelligence adoption, major regulatory programs, and production operations. This position requires strong engineering judgment, knowledge of financial systems, experience leading managers and large technical teams, and the ability to communicate effectively with executive stakeholders. 

Technology and product leadership

- Own the technology strategy, product roadmap, architecture governance, and engineering delivery for a portfolio of business-critical finance applications. 
 - Lead the development of new product capabilities and enhancements using modern full-stack engineering practices, including Java, Spring Boot, application programming interfaces, microservices, Angular, and React. 
 - Review and approve major architecture and technical design decisions. Establish appropriate delegated approval authority for lower-risk changes. 
 - Maintain strong engineering governance through design reviews, code reviews, automated testing, performance engineering, and production-readiness assessments. 
 - Partner with Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Risk, and Audit stakeholders to ensure that financial calculations, reports, controls, and data lineage meet business and regulatory requirements. 
 - Establish controls for calculation accuracy, allocation and attribution logic, rounding and precision, recalculation, restatement, and traceability to authoritative source data. 

Major program delivery

- Lead technology delivery for major transformation and regulatory programs, including banking capabilities, funding initiatives, and core system modernization. 
 - Develop integrated delivery plans that address regulatory milestones, dependencies, data conversion, testing, operational readiness, and business adoption. 
 - Resolve competing priorities across financial close activities, regulatory programs, cloud modernization, security remediation, and product enhancements. 
 - Communicate delivery commitments, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to senior business and technology stakeholders. 

Cloud and platform modernization

- Define and execute the modernization roadmap for applications and databases moving to Google Cloud. 
 - Oversee the use of Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, Pub/Sub, Terraform, identity and access management, and workload identity capabilities. 
 - Lead database modernization initiatives, including the migration of Microsoft SQL Server workloads to PostgreSQL, while preserving financial results, data integrity, performance, and auditability. 
 - Plan production cutovers around financial close calendars. Ensure that each critical release has tested deployment, rollback, reconciliation, and business-continuity procedures. 
 - Maintain supported versions of application runtimes, databases, infrastructure components, and security controls. 

Generative AI and intelligent automation

- Define and deliver responsible generative AI and agent-based solutions that improve software engineering, testing, documentation, operational support, and finance processes. 
 - Oversee solutions involving large language models, tool-enabled agents, retrieval-augmented generation, and governed financial data. 
 - Establish controls for AI testing, evaluation, human approval, access management, data protection, explainability, monitoring, and audit trails. 
 - Identify use cases that deliver measurable efficiency or quality improvements without compromising financial controls, security, privacy, or regulatory obligations. 

Security, resilience, and production operations

- Be accountable for the security, resilience, availability, and support model of the finance application portfolio. 
 - Establish and monitor service-level objectives, recovery time objectives, recovery point objectives, vulnerability remediation targets, and operational risk indicators. 
 - Ensure that disaster recovery and business-continuity plans are documented, tested, and improved based on results. 
 - Oversee application support for month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities through a sustainable, appropriately staffed operating model. 
 - Lead the response to significant incidents, including executive communication, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and prevention of recurrence. 
 - Represent Technology in internal audits, external audits, regulatory reviews, and control examinations. Ensure that findings and remediation actions are completed within agreed timelines. 

People, stakeholder, and financial leadership

- Serve as the primary technology partner for senior Finance leaders and other executive stakeholders. 
 - Lead a large organization comprising engineers, technical leads, managers, and external delivery partners. 
 - Hire, coach, assess, and develop team members. Build an inclusive culture focused on engineering quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Maintain succession and knowledge-continuity plans for all critical applications and leadership roles. 
 - Manage the portfolio budget, workforce plan, supplier performance, capacity allocation, and investment priorities. 
 - Establish performance measures covering delivery predictability, product quality, control effectiveness, operational resilience, security, employee development, and business outcomes. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - At least 15 years of experience in enterprise technology, software product development, or application engineering. 
 - At least 7 years of experience leading engineering teams, including experience managing engineering managers, technical leaders, or multidisciplinary delivery teams. 
 - Strong technical background in enterprise application development using Java, Spring Boot, application programming interfaces, microservices, and modern web technologies. 
 - Demonstrated ability to review and guide architecture, technical designs, code quality, performance, and production-readiness decisions. 
 - Experience leading complex application or database migrations to a public cloud environment without compromising data integrity, reporting consistency, financial calculations, or operational continuity. 
 - Experience with Google Cloud or a comparable public cloud platform. Relevant experience should include container platforms, serverless computing, data platforms, managed relational databases, infrastructure as code, identity and access management, and production cutover planning. 
 - Experience delivering generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, or agent-based solutions into production with appropriate testing, governance, human oversight, monitoring, and audit controls. 
 - Experience leading finance, accounting, treasury, risk, tax, or regulatory reporting applications in a controlled or regulated environment. 
 - Understanding of financial data controls, calculation accuracy, reconciliation, data lineage, audit evidence, and production support during financial close periods. 
 - Experience working directly with senior business and technology executives to establish priorities, make trade-offs, manage risks, and document decisions. 
 - Experience managing budgets, strategic suppliers, workforce plans, and large delivery portfolios. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technology and operational risks to nontechnical stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in banking, lending, automotive finance, captive finance, or another regulated financial services organization. 
 - Experience with Current Expected Credit Loss requirements, International Financial Reporting Standard 9, Sarbanes-Oxley controls, or Internal Control over Financial Reporting. 
 - Experience with Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, Pub/Sub, Terraform, workload identity, zero-trust security principles, and cloud identity and access management. 
 - Experience migrating Microsoft SQL Server databases to PostgreSQL. 
 - Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, large language model evaluation, agent tool use, and AI governance. 
 - Experience with event-driven and reactive architecture, Docker, continuous integration and continuous delivery, test-driven development, and application performance optimization. 
 - Familiarity with engineering and security platforms such as GitHub, Tekton, Cloud Build, SonarQube, Checkmarx, FOSSA, 42Crunch, and Cycode. 
 - Familiarity with operational monitoring and observability platforms such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Prometheus, and Grafana. 
 - Experience establishing service-level objectives and leading disaster recovery, resilience, and business-continuity testing. 

Leadership capabilities

 - Ability to lead through managers and empower technical experts

 Utilize in-depth specialty knowledge of applications development to analyze complex problems/issues, provide evaluation of business process, system process, and industry standards, and make evaluative judgment: Augment human analytical capabilities with AI-powered data analysis and pattern recognition to rapidly assess complex scenarios and inform robust decision-making. 

 Recommend and develop security measures in post-implementation analysis of business usage to ensure successful system design and functionality: Use AI-driven security analysis tools to continuously monitor applications for vulnerabilities, predict potential threats, and recommend adaptive security control.

data.title: DFT Architect
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for an experienced DFT Architect to lead Design-for-Test strategy, architecture definition, and implementation for complex ASIC/SOC designs across advanced technology nodes. The ideal candidate will drive end-to-end DFT architecture including scan, MBIST, compression, boundary scan, and at-speed test methodologies while collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve high test coverage, quality, and silicon bring-up success. 

What You'll Do

- Define and own SOC-level DFT architecture and test strategy for complex semiconductor designs. 
 - Lead implementation of scan insertion, ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, boundary scan, and test compression methodologies. 
 - Drive DFT planning and integration aligned with power, timing, area, and test coverage goals. 
 - Collaborate with RTL, Physical Design, Verification, and Product Engineering teams for seamless DFT integration and signoff. 
 - Analyze and resolve DFT-related timing, routing, and testability challenges. 
 - Support silicon bring-up, debug, diagnosis, yield analysis, and production test optimization. 
 - Develop and enhance DFT automation flows, methodologies, and reusable infrastructure. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across projects. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, VLSI, or related field. 
 - 14+ years of experience in ASIC/SOC DFT implementation and architecture. 
 - Strong expertise in scan, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG, compression, and low-power DFT methodologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with industry-standard DFT tools such as Siemens Tessent, Synopsys DFT Compiler/TestMAX, or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of RTL design, timing, physical design constraints, and silicon debug. 
 - Experience with advanced technology nodes and large SOC integration. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills using Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell. 
 - Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Good to Have

- Experience with automotive safety standards such as ISO 26262. 
 - Exposure to chiplet-based architectures and 3D IC testing methodologies. 
 - Knowledge of diagnosis-driven yield improvement and silicon analytics. 

Success in This Role Looks Like

- Delivery of robust DFT architectures with high test coverage and efficient manufacturing test cost. 
 - Successful silicon bring-up with minimal DFT-related issues. 
 - Improved DFT methodology scalability, automation, and execution efficiency. 
 - Strong technical leadership and contribution to organization-wide DFT best practices. 

About TYLsemi, Inc. 

The Opportunity

The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?

That's what we solve. TYLsemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale. 

This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path. 

Why Now

The Market Window

The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years: 

- Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies. 
 - Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually. 
 - IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself. 
 - Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing. 

Culture & Team: How We Work

No Politics, No Bureaucracy

There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater. 

- If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it. 
 - No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management. 

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

- US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
 - India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products

We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines. 

This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win. 

What We Value

- Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it. 
 - Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here. 
 - Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware. 
 - Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results. 

The Ask

If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits. 

We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us. 

Here's Why You Should

- The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building. 
 - The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo. 
 - The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue. 
 - The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI. 

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters. 

Or stay comfortable. No judgment. 

But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk.

data.title: Senior Salesforce Tester
data.description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company's patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www. azurity. com. 

Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization. 

About The Role

Our Digital team at Azurity is building new capabilities utilizing cutting-edge Salesforce technologies. We are seeking a dynamic, self-driven, hands-on team member who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. 

The Senior Salesforce Tester is responsible for testing and validating Salesforce applications to ensure quality, performance, security, and regulatory compliance across Azurity's commercial and medical business processes. This role focuses on Salesforce platforms supporting HCP/HCO engagement, sales operations, patient support programs, regulatory requirements, and commercial excellence initiatives. 

The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA teams to identify defects, improve functionality, and maintain compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA regulations. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Planning & Strategy

- Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Salesforce applications. 
 - Ensure comprehensive coverage for functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and define testing strategies. 
 - Participate in test estimation, release planning, and risk assessment activities. 

Functional & Regression Testing

- Conduct manual and automated testing of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud functionalities. 
 - Validate HCP/HCO engagement processes, KOL management, consent management, patient support workflows, and compliance-related business processes. 
 - Perform end-to-end validation of business workflows, data integrity, and system configurations. 
 - Verify territory alignment, call planning, sample management, omnichannel engagement, and commercial operations processes. 
 - Execute regression testing to ensure system stability across Salesforce releases and deployments. 

Integration & Data Testing

- Test integrations with third-party pharmaceutical platforms including IQVIA, Veeva, MedPro, SAP, Snowflake, and MDM solutions. 
 - Validate Salesforce APIs (REST and SOAP) and perform API testing using Postman. 
 - Verify Data Cloud integrations, data ingestion, transformation, and synchronization processes. 
 - Ensure data accuracy, completeness, reconciliation, and security across integrated systems. 
 - Support testing of end-to-end data flows between Salesforce and enterprise applications. 

Compliance & Security Testing

- Ensure HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements are met across Salesforce solutions. 
 - Perform role-based security testing, user access validation, permission testing, and audit trail verification. 
 - Validate electronic records controls, consent management processes, and sensitive data protection requirements. 
 - Support compliance documentation and validation activities as required for regulated systems. 

Performance & Automation Testing

- Use Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or similar automation tools to automate Salesforce test cases. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain reusable automated test suites. 
 - Perform performance and scalability testing to assess system stability under peak workloads. 
 - Identify bottlenecks, optimize test execution, and validate Lightning Web Component (LWC) performance. 
 - Utilize basic Python scripting where applicable to support automation and data validation activities. 

Defect Tracking & Collaboration

- Document, manage, and track defects using JIRA, X-Ray, or similar test management tools. 
 - Work closely with developers and business analysts to troubleshoot and resolve issues. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and release readiness activities. 

Continuous Improvement & Best Practices

- Stay current with Salesforce releases, platform enhancements, testing tools, and industry best practices. 
 - Implement CI/CD testing methodologies leveraging Copado and Salesforce DevOps processes.

data.title: Software Quality Engineer
data.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and. . . To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale-faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. 

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA's product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build-and how we build it. 

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a passionate Quality Engineer with strong software development, automation, and AI skills. You will build frameworks, tools, and intelligent solutions that improve product testability, accelerate defect detection, and enable quality throughout the software development lifecycle. 

Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for desktop, web, API, and system-level testing. 
 - Develop reusable software tools, libraries, APIs, and utilities that improve testability and engineering productivity. 
 - Partner with developers to review designs, improve code testability, and drive Shift-Left quality practices. 
 - Integrate automated validation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Apply AI and intelligent algorithms to generate tests, analyze logs, identify failure patterns, and accelerate root cause analysis. 
 - Automate the collection, transformation, and reporting of test results and quality metrics. 
 - Build actionable dashboards using Power BI or similar reporting tools. 
 - Support DevOps, continuous testing, and release-readiness initiatives. 

Required Skills And Qualifications

- Strong software development experience using C#, Java, Python, TypeScript, or a similar programming language. 
 - Strong understanding of OOP, OOD, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and clean coding practices. 
 - Experience developing automation frameworks, developer tools, APIs, libraries, or test infrastructure. 
 - Experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, WinAppDriver, or Coded UI. 
 - Experience with API testing frameworks such as RestAssured, Postman, SoapUI, JUnit, or TestNG. 
 - Knowledge of REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, SQL, Git, and web-service technologies. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD platforms. 
 - Hands-on exposure to Generative AI, AI-assisted coding, prompt engineering, LLM APIs, intelligent test generation, or log and failure analysis using AI. 
 - Strong debugging, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills. 
 - Good communication and collaboration skills. 

Minimum Qualifications

Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. 

Use of AI Statement

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews-whether virtual or in person-is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. 

We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. 

KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
