Position Overview

AMHS Engineers are responsible for planning, designing, enabling, and supporting the operation of the Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS) in collaboration with global vendors. This includes maintaining high system uptime, improving material flow efficiency, and ensuring seamless integration with fab manufacturing operations. This role is to own End-to-End Project Management from Design to comissioning of the AMHS system at foundry. 

The role requires strong troubleshooting ability, hands-on exposure to automation tools, and close collaboration with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, and IT teams to enhance productivity and factory performance. 

Key Responsibiities

- AMHS Planning, Design & Integration
 - Work with global AMHS vendors to plan, design, and implement AMHS solutions for the fab. 
 - Contribute to improving AMHS hardware and software performance, including MCS, controllers, OHT/OHB systems, stockers, and sorters. 
 - Support layout design, standards adoption, and continuous improvement for AMHS deployments. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Partner closely with Manufacturing, Quality, and Engineering teams to identify automation improvement opportunities. 
 - Support cross-functional initiatives to enhance production efficiency, material flow, and system reliability. 
 - Collaborate with IT to resolve system-level issues affecting automation and data communication. 
 - Operational Support
 - Provide consistent operational support to ensure high uptime and reliability of all AMHS subsystems. 
 - Monitor AMHS performance post-release to production to ensure compliance with safety, quality, and operational standards. 
 - Conduct routine and preventive maintenance activities to sustain long-term system performance. 
 - Participate in shift pass-down meetings and provide clear documentation of issues, corrective actions, and system updates. 
 - Troubleshooting & Repair
 - Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues for: 
 - Overhead Hoist Transport (OHT) systems
 - Overhead Buffer (OHB) units
 - Stockers & Sorters
 - Vision and traceability systems
 - Controllers & communication modules
 - Lead troubleshooting during production-critical situations while maintaining composure under pressure. 
 - Process Excellence & Documentation
 - Implement 6S practices and maintain spare parts inventory to support smooth operations. 
 - Share lessons learned with engineering and production teams to enhance issue resolution processes. 
 - Support Continuous Improvement Programs (CIP) and conduct quality checks for system enhancements. 

Essential Atrributes

- 10+ years hands-on experience adjusting, testing, commissioning, or maintaining Daifuku or Muratec AMHS systems
 - Experience in working at semiconductor fabs, 24x7 manufacturing, or other high-automation industrial environments is beneficial. 
 - Strong willingness to learn AMHS standards, layout concepts, and operations support methodologies. 
 - High proficiency in troubleshooting automation systems across hardware and software layers. 
 - Ability to diagnose root causes and implement long-term corrective solutions. 
 - Excellent teamwork and icollaboration skills. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication abilities for technical and non-technical discussions. 
 - Enthusiastic about learning new technologies, tools, and automation platforms. 
 - Adaptable to fast-paced, dynamic manufacturing environments. 
 - Good organizational and time-management skills; able to juggle multiple priorities.

Job Responsibilities

Job title: 

Specialist Durability

Job Introduction

Durability Systems Engineer is responsible for ensuring that a system can withstand its intended operating conditions throughout its design life. This role combines simulation (virtual validation) and testing (physical validation) to Durability. 

Major Responsibilities

- Perform Fatigue analysis with FEMFAT, ncode, Hyper life for powertrain components
 - Deep simulation understanding of Dynamic Analysis for Vibration test. (Sine and Random signals)
 - Deep simulation understanding of Thermo-mechanical analysis with Abaqus (CREEP and Plastic strain)
 - Perform Mounting fatigue strength analysis. 
 - Able to perform Mechanical shock and Cylinder test explicitly. 
 - Development of test specifications, test procedure and test reports.

data.title: Infrastructure Technical Lead
data.description:
About Invicta-Tech

Invicta-Tech is a digital design and construction advisory firm specialising in BIM and technology-driven delivery for complex projects across KSA and the GCC. We work with contractors, consultants and asset owners to turn models, drawings and point clouds into measurable, client-ready deliverables aligned with ISO 19650, project EIRs and BEPs. 

Our work spans BIM production (LOD 200-500), model coordination and clash management, BIM automation and asset handover, across infrastructure & landscape, airports, hospitality, giga projects, industrial and logistics facilities. Our delivery team is based in Hyderabad. 

About the role

We are hiring an Infrastructure Technical Lead to own technical delivery of landscape and infrastructure works packages on live KSA projects. You will be the technical face of the project to the client. You lead design discussions, take submissions through review and approval, and run the team of BIM modellers and engineers who produce the work. 

This is a hands-on leadership role on live projects. You will take over work already in progress in your first week. You need to pick up quickly where a design stands, what the client has commented on, and what is due next. 

What you will do

Design and technical ownership

- Lead the design of infra works: all wet & dry utilities, smart cities integration, ICT/Security, irrigation, storm water, sewer, potable water, FLS, power, telecom, street lighting ducts and networks, and roads, grading and levels. 
 - Make and defend technical decisions on layouts, levels, routing, sizing and interfaces with buildings and other disciplines. 
 - Make sure designs meet client requirements, project standards and the applicable KSA authority and utility requirements. Client coordination and approvals

- Be the client's technical point of contact on your packages. 
 - Lead design review meetings and workshops. Present design intent clearly. 
 - Prepare and manage design submissions. Take them through client and authority review to approval. 
 - Track every client comment to close-out: respond, revise, resubmit. Keep a clean comment and revision log. Team leadership

- Lead a team of BIM modellers and infrastructure engineers. Break down the work, set priorities and assign tasks. 
 - Review drawings and models before anything goes to the client. You own the quality bar. 
 - Coach the team on design standards, Civil 3D and BIM workflows, and handling client comments. Delivery, quality and coordination

- Own the deliverables schedule for your packages. Hit submission dates. 
 - Coordinate with architecture, structure and MEP teams to resolve interfaces and clashes. 
 - Keep drawings, models and design documentation consistent and correctly revised. 
 - Flag delivery risks to the partners early, each with a proposed fix. 

What we are looking for (must-have)

- B. E. /B. Tech in Civil Engineering. M. E. /M. Tech is a plus. 
 - 10+ years in infrastructure or external works design, with at least 4 years on projects in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC. 
 - Strong hands-on AutoCAD Civil 3D (corridors, grading, pipe networks, surfaces) and AutoCAD. 
 - Working knowledge of Revit and BIM-based delivery. 
 - A track record of taking external works designs through client and authority approvals in the Gulf. 
 - Experience leading a team of modellers or engineers on live deliverables, including reviewing their work. 
 - Clear written and spoken English. You will write comment responses, prepare reports, and any relevant documentation requested from client and lead client meetings. 

Good to have

- Experience on giga projects or large master plans in GCC. 
 - Navisworks and clash coordination experience. 
 - Knowledge of KSA authority and utility standards and submission processes. 
 - Model-based quantity take-off. 
 - Familiarity with ISO 19650 and BIM execution plans (BEP, MIDP). 

How you will be measured

- Submissions on your packages go out on time and complete. 
 - Client comments close fast, with few repeat comments on the same issue. 
 - Designs reach approval in fewer revision cycles. 
 - The team's work passes your review before it reaches the client. 

What we offer

- Technical ownership of live Saudi projects from day one. 
 - A small, senior team. Your judgement directly shapes delivery. 
 - Room to build and lead the infrastructure practice as the firm grows. 
 - Competitive compensation based on experience in the range of 1, 50, 000 to 2, 50, 000 INR per month. 

Location and work mode

Hyderabad, India. Full-time, on-site with the delivery team. 

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV. In your application, tell us briefly about one infra work package you took through approval in KSA or the GCC: your role, the team size, and what you would do differently.

data.title: Engineering Lead - Data Security
data.description:
About SARC and DataSurity

DataSurity is SARC's Privacy compliance platform, now signing its first enterprise clients. It helps Indian regulated companies, mostly banks, NBFCs and PSUs, run privacy compliance as software instead of spreadsheets. 

SARC is a 40-year-old advisory firm with 100+ partners and 500+ professionals across India, the UK, the UAE, Singapore and the USA. Its practices cover cybersecurity, data protection, regulatory advisory and RegTech. 

The Role

You will own DataSurity's engineering: its architecture, its build and its security. You will lead a lean team of engineers. 

- Own the architecture. Make and write down the technical decisions: data model, module boundaries, identity, tenancy and client APIs. 
 - Run the build. SLDC. Decide which changes need an independent review. Make sure tests prove what they claim, for example by removing a check and confirming its test fails. 
 - Lead the team. Set work, review it and grow the engineers and contractors. Direct AI coding sessions with the same care as people: clear briefs, stated rules, reviewed output. 
 - Own security. Client data isolation, sign-in and SSO, signed tokens, key management, logging without personal data, monitoring and incident response. Be ready for a bank's security review. 
 - Lead client integration. Run technical sessions with clients' teams, answer CISO questionnaires, and design each client's integration: web SDK, server-to-server APIs and, later, mobile SDKs. 
 - Run the environments. Staging, demo and production, deploys, backups and releases. 
 - Shape the roadmap and help hire the next engineers. 

What you bring

- Min 8 to 12 years in engineering, including building a security or privacy product from the ground up: DLP, DSPM, data discovery, CASB, consent management or identity. Built, not used or sold. 
 - Data security depth. You know how sensitive data is found, classified and protected, and what makes a detector precise rather than noisy. 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS architecture. You have kept many clients' data apart in one system (for example Postgres row-level security), and built sign-in, SSO, signed tokens and key management. 
 - Still hands-on. You write and review code, ideally TypeScript and Node, with solid SQL and Postgres. 
 - Team leadership. You have led 3 to 8 engineers, including contractors, and set a review culture others follow. 
 - Fluent with AI coding tools, such as Claude Code. You can brief them, check their work, and catch what they get wrong. 
 - Clear communicator. You can hold your own with a bank's CISO, and write short, plain documents. 

Strong Plus

- Data Protection, Privacy, Leakage and Data Security
 - Mobile security: native SDKs and device-bound keys on Android and iOS. 
 - AWS in India: hosting, backups and data-residency setups for regulated clients. 

Location: South Delhi - In Office

data.title: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer - DevOps
data.description:
Job Summary: 

We're looking for a Senior Staff Platform Engineer to join our Developer Productivity & Platforms group. This role blends traffic engineering (API gateway, CDN, service-to-service routing) with core responsibilities, including automation, observability, reliability engineering, CI/CD workflows, and internal tooling that accelerates developer efficiency. 

You'll own critical systems responsible for managing API traffic - both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service communication) - across a global, multi-cloud environment. You'll architect resilient routing systems, edge integrations with CDNs, and observability hooks that ensure everything you build is secure, debuggable, and automated. 

This is a hands-on role with high visibility and impact. You'll work across platform, SRE, and developer experience teams to ensure the infrastructure is reliable, observable, and developer-friendly - from traffic routing to deployments to production operations. 

One of your key responsibilities will also be to design and build a unified traffic abstraction layer - a foundational platform that maps backend services deployed across various compute environments to their respective configurations on CDNs (e. g. , Akamai, Fastly). This framework will centralize control over routing, metadata inventory, configuration tracking, and automated failover across CDNs. This capability does not currently exist and will be built from the ground up. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Own the technical vision and long-term evolution of the API Gateway and traffic platform supporting both north-south (external ingress) and east-west (internal service-to-service) traffic, operating at scale across a multi-cloud environment. 
 - Architect and drive a unified traffic abstraction layer that decouples backend services from CDN-specific implementations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare), enabling centralized policy control, metadata-driven routing, automated multi-CDN failover, and future extensibility. 
 - Set architectural standards and design patterns for ingress, traffic routing, and API management, influencing multiple teams and ensuring consistency, security, scalability, and reliability across the organization. 
 - Lead complex, cross-team initiatives spanning networking, platform, SRE, security, and observability teams to deliver resilient, cloud-agnostic ingress solutions that account for varying network topologies, latency characteristics, and failure modes. 
 - Design and govern CI/CD and GitOps workflows for critical traffic infrastructure, defining best practices for safe deployments, progressive rollouts, automated validation, and rollback strategies across environments. 
 - Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity using Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes, establishing reusable modules, golden paths, and guardrails that enable teams to deploy and operate traffic components safely and independently. 
 - Build and evolve foundational tooling and services (primarily in Go or Python) that improve visibility, control, scalability, and operational efficiency of API traffic systems at scale. 
 - Define observability strategy and standards for ingress and internal traffic systems, including metrics, logs, tracing, and SLOs; partner closely with observability and SRE teams to ensure systems are diagnosable and production-ready by default. 
 - Act as a technical multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, reviewing high-impact designs, unblocking teams, and raising the overall quality bar for platform engineering and distributed systems practices. 
 - Anticipate future needs and risks, proactively identifying scaling limits, security gaps, and reliability concerns, and driving strategic investments before they become production issues. 

Skills and Attributes to Success: 

- Expert-level programming capability in Go or Python, with a track record of designing and delivering production-grade platforms, internal tooling, and services that operate reliably at scale; able to make pragmatic trade-offs between performance, maintainability, and velocity. 
 - Deep, hands-on experience with API Gateway platforms in large-scale production environments, including ownership of architecture, rollout strategies, failure handling, and long-term evolution of ingress and traffic management systems. 
 - Strong understanding of CDN architectures and integrations (Akamai, Fastly, Cloudflare or similar), including cache strategies, request routing, edge security, failover mechanisms, and best practices for high-availability API delivery across regions and providers. 
 - Advanced proficiency with infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration, leveraging Terraform, Kubernetes, and Helm to design reusable modules, define platform standards, and enable self-service while maintaining strong operational and security guardrails. 
 - Deep knowledge of networking and distributed systems fundamentals, including TLS termination, L4/L7 routing, traffic shaping, rate limiting, retries, circuit breaking, and failure isolation, with the ability to reason about system behavior under load and partial failure. 
 - Proven ability to design systems with observability, automation, and resiliency as first-class concerns, defining metrics, logs, traces, SLIs/SLOs, and automated remediation strategies in partnership with SRE and observability teams. 
 - Strong architectural judgment and systems thinking, able to navigate ambiguity, evaluate multiple solution paths, and influence technical decisions across teams through design reviews and technical leadership. 
 - Demonstrated ability to operate as a technical multiplier, mentoring senior engineers, raising engineering standards, and helping teams ship safer, faster, and more reliable systems. 

Preferred Education & Experience: 

- B-Tech or M-Tech in Computer Science or a related technical discipline from a reputed university. 
 - 9+ years of experience in Infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles focused on production traffic, automation and API delivery. 

About Us

Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies. 

JioStar is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. data.title: Senior Principal Engineer
data.description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan's global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India's deep pool of technical talent with Banyan's long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work. 

Senior Principal Engineer

Technical Lead / Architect, TechGrove AI Engineering Pod

You are the kind of engineer other engineers want to build with. You have spent your career going deep on production systems, and you have reached the point where your judgment shapes architectures, raises teams, and makes hard problems look simple. This is the most senior technical seat in the pod, and it is unapologetically hands-on. 

As Technical Lead and Architect, you own the architecture for an OpCo's modernized applications and set the engineering bar the whole pod builds to. You operate as a player/coach: designing complex systems, writing meaningful code, and running rigorous reviews of work produced by both engineers and AI agents. You treat agentic development as a first-class part of the architecture, not a novelty, and you define how the pod gets the most out of it without ever compromising quality or security. 

If you want your decisions to matter, your code to ship, and your standards to lift an entire team, this is built for you. 

About the PodA TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan's AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match. 

A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan's India-based TechGrove. 

What You Will Do
 - Own the architecture: Define and own the end-to-end software architecture for the pod's applications, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, resilient, and cloud-native across AWS and Azure. 
 - Own the frontend architecture: Set the frontend architecture: state management, a scalable library of reusable components, design-system integration, and the patterns, standards, and performance budgets the pod builds against. 
 - Lead the technical direction: Serve as the highest technical authority and escalation point in the pod. Set design patterns and standards, and make confident architectural decisions amid ambiguity. 
 - Stay hands-on: Operate as a player/coach. Make significant code contributions, lead complex designs, and deliver thorough code reviews of work from both engineers and AI agents. 
 - Lead AI-native development: Define how the pod uses agentic tooling such as Claude Code across the SDLC, establishing patterns for AI-assisted design, implementation, testing, and review that maximize velocity while protecting quality and security. 
 - Set the quality bar: Define and enforce engineering excellence: clean code, Domain-Driven Design, modern design patterns, Twelve-Factor principles, meaningful test coverage, and application security. 
 - Build secure and reliable systems: Embed secure-by-design principles and cloud-native observability so applications run fast, stay available, and stay safe in production. 
 - Mentor and raise the team: Coach senior engineers, grow the technical capability of the team (human and agentic), and foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. 
 - Partner with the OpCo: Work with the OpCo's technical leadership and existing teams to align architecture with their landscape, integrate with existing systems, and transfer knowledge. What You Bring
 - Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, with significant time in Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Architect roles leading the architecture of complex, production systems. 
 - Production experience on BOTH AWS and Azure (required): You have personally designed, built, and run production software on both AWS and Azure. This dual-cloud depth is essential: you are the technical authority who sets cloud architecture regardless of which target cloud an OpCo runs on. Hands-on depth includes containers (Docker/Kubernetes), serverless (Lambda and Azure Functions), and Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform. 
 - Architectural depth: Deep command of modern architectural patterns (microservices, event-driven, distributed systems), DDD, and design patterns, with a record of turning business objectives into technical solutions at enterprise or B2B scale. 
 - Hands-on technical depth: Current, real coding ability. A player/coach who contributes code, leads design, and delivers thorough reviews, including of AI-generated work. 
 - AI-native engineering: Demonstrated fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development tooling (Claude Code or similar) and a clear, practiced approach to architecting and delivering software in an AI-native team. 
 - Modern tech stacks: Hands-on production experience with at least two of: . NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java. 
 - Frontend architecture: Deep expertise in modern frontend architecture with React. js and Next. js: state management, scalable and reusable component design, design-system strategy, and frontend performance at scale. 
 - DevSecOps: Strong command of CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and modern DevSecOps practices. 
 - Communication and leadership: You align technical and business stakeholders, lead under competing priorities, and bring calm and clarity to fast-moving teams. Nice to Have
 - Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS at scale. 
 - A track record leading application modernization or re-platforming of large enterprise or B2B applications. 
 - GenAI architecture experience: RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, multi-agent frameworks, MCP servers and tools, context engineering, and vector databases. 
 - Experience leading embedded or client-facing engineering teams. 
 - Working knowledge of GCP, in addition to AWS and Azure. What Success Looks Like
 - First 90 days: You understand the OpCo's landscape, have set the architectural direction and engineering standards, and the pod is shipping against them with a clean, AI-native workflow. 
 - First 6 months: The architecture is proven in production, quality and delivery metrics are trending up, and the team's technical capability, human and agentic, has visibly grown under your leadership. Why TechGrove, Why Banyan
 - Permanent home, long-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip. 
 - Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the "what"; the pod owns the "how. "
 - AI-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build. 
 - Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you. 
 - Growth and excellence: A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time. Should You Apply?We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that. 

We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes. 

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment.   

Protect yourself by following these steps: 

- Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware. com email address. 
 - Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process. 
 - If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond - instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware. com and/or report it to the platform where you received it. Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

data.description:
Role Description

Information Security Engineer Role

Overview

We are seeking a talented and experienced Security Engineer with a strong focus on Python and security automation to join our Information Security team. The ideal candidate will be adept at developing and implementing automated security solutions to protect our systems and data, as well as reviewing, validating, and hardening code and workflows produced by AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude, GitHub Copilot) and agentic systems. This role requires a proactive individual who can work independently and collaboratively to enhance our security posture in an environment where both humans and AI agents write and operate code. In addition, proficiency and experience using a SOAR for automation and security incident response is required. 

Key Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and maintain security automation scripts and tools using Python to a high standard of reliability and efficiency, including reviewing and hardening code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Integrate security tools and solutions, including developing and managing APIs, to automate security processes and workflows. 

Conduct security assessments and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential threats. 

Monitor security systems and respond to incidents with automated solutions, implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Tines, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect) to streamline response activities. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement security controls, and write clear technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for tools and processes. 

Govern enterprise use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), including tenant restrictions, access scoping, and compliance/audit logging. 

Design and enforce security controls for agentic AI systems, including tool-permission boundaries, prompt injection defenses, and agent identity/access governance. 

Utilise Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for threat detection and Kusto Query Language (KQL) to analyse security data. 

Implement CI/CD pipeline automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e. g. , Terraform, Ansible) to ensure secure code deployment and infrastructure provisioning. 

Skills And Experience Required

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field. 

Proven experience as a Security Engineer or in a similar role, with a focus on Python and security automation. 

Strong programming skills in Python, with experience developing automation scripts and tools, as well as reviewing and validating code generated by AI coding assistants. 

Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and vulnerability scanners. 

Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes). 

Experience with API development and integration, including RESTful APIs. 

Proficiency in implementing and managing SOAR platforms (e. g. , Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR, Splunk Phantom, IBM Resilient, Cyware, Microsoft Logic Apps, ThreatConnect). 

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for endpoint security. 

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with strong written and verbal communication, including writing technical documentation (SOPs, write-ups, user guides) for technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Experience securing AI/LLM-based agentic systems, including prompt injection defense, tool-permission boundaries, and agent identity governance. 

Experience governing enterprise AI coding assistants (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), including compliance/audit logging, tenant restrictions, and CI/CD supply-chain hardening against AI-related risks. 

Desirable

Proficiency in Kusto Query Language (KQL) for querying and analysing security data. 

Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, or GIAC. 

Experience with DevSecOps practices and CI/CD tools (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD). 

Understanding of network protocols and security architecture. 

Familiarity with the OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (e. g. , tool misuse, agentic supply-chain risk, unexpected code execution, human-agent trust exploitation). 

Experience with AI red-teaming and evaluation methodologies for agentic and LLM-based systems. 

Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) security and other agent-tool integration risks. 

Skills

AI Security, Python, Cloud Security, IDS/IPS, LLMs, Vulnerability Assessment, SOAR, Container Security, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
The Opportunity

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Care Interactions team, you will shape and build the systems that enable Hinge Health's care teams to communicate with members and deliver personalized musculoskeletal care at scale. Care Interactions is part of CareHub, Hinge Health's internal care-delivery platform used by physical therapists, health coaches, physicians, care managers, and other clinical teams. 

The team owns core communication and care-delivery capabilities, including in-app messaging, video visits, scheduling-related experiences, clinical notes, care plans, and the CareHub interaction record used for coordinated care. You will provide technical leadership across these complex, workflow-heavy domains, helping the team build reliable, secure, and intuitive products that reduce fragmented tools and repetitive administrative work so care team members can focus on clinical judgment and member connection. 

CareHub is evolving toward an AI-first platform. In this role, you may help build AI-assisted capabilities for visit preparation, documentation, summarization, contextual recommendations, and follow-up workflows. You will contribute to systems that are clinically useful, observable, resilient, and safe, with appropriate human oversight for decisions that affect care delivery. 

You will partner closely with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and other engineering teams to take problems from discovery through production. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact, workflow-heavy products where thoughtful technical decisions can improve care-team efficiency, member experience, and Hinge Health's ability to deliver care at scale. 

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will write production code, lead architecture and design reviews, participate in operational response, and coach engineers toward stronger technical ownership. 

What You'll Accomplish

- Deliver large projects that introduce new product capabilities, often acting as a maintainer for key code repositories. 
 - Break down complex problems into manageable tasks, ensuring steady and predictable delivery while identifying and resolving root causes of incidents. 
 - Collaborate with your team to roadmap and execute ambitious technical strategies, balancing short-term and long-term trade-offs. 
 - Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing. 
 - Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features, contributing to Hinge Health's AI-driven care platform. 
 - Proactively improve the maintainability, availability, and performance of the team's features, and contribute to the team's overall architecture and developer tooling. 
 - Communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical partners, and document solutions for future reference. 

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week. 

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA. 

- Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e. g. , 8am in San Francisco is 8: 30pm in Bengaluru). 
 - Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT). 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field
 - 10+ years of non-internship full time professional software development experience
 - 4+ years of experience with at least one software programming language
 - 4+ years of experience in the full software development life cycle
 - 3+ years of work experience with react JS and Node JS/ Typescript
 - 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making
 - Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot, Cursor, LangChain, LangGraph
 - Experience delivering large software projects or features in a production environment. 
 - Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e. g. , Python, Java, JavaScript, etc. ). 

Preferred Qualifications

- A platform-as-product mindset: understanding internal users and consumers, defining clear contracts, improving developer experience and adoption, and measuring platform outcomes. 
 - Strong backend and distributed-systems fundamentals, including latency, throughput, availability, capacity, backpressure, consistency, resilience, and failure-mode analysis. 
 - Experience integrating large language models or generative AI services into production workflows with appropriate evals, validation, observability, and failure handling. 
 - Experience defining and maintaining SLOs and SLAs, using error budgets, service-health metrics, alerting, on-call practices, incident response, and root-cause analysis to improve reliability. 
 - Experience improving observability through metrics, structured logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with practical knowledge of cache design and invalidation, database performance KPIs, query and index tuning, connection pools, and capacity management
 - Experience with headless CMS integrations, webhook-driven systems, vendor adapters, content delivery networks, or publishing pipelines. 
 - Experience with durable workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal, or comparable workflow technology. 
 - Experience with media processing tools such as ffmpeg, adaptive bitrate video, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, or caption formats such as WebVTT. 
 - Experience with event streaming, such as Kafka, and CI/CD automation, such as GitHub Actions. 
 - Experience working in healthcare, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or otherwise high-trust environments. 
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers or serving as a technical lead for a platform, migration, or cross-functional launch. 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we're using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare - starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1. 7 billion people worldwide. With an AI-powered human-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. Inviting bright minds

Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture? We are focused on knowledge sharing and collaboration across competence areas and geographies, and we aim for a strong diversity among our employees. This enables us to collaborate on a broad range of projects, and we firmly believe that cross-collaboration leads to creative and longstanding solutions.

www. ramboll. com/wte

Job Description

 - High level review of Electrical SLD, MCC/ VFD schematics. 
 - Lead the design and review of SCADA/DCS/PLC/PMS/EMS architectures, OT networks, OT/IT integration, industrial communications, and power management systems. 
 - Ensure functional safety and cybersecurity compliance through IEC 61508/61511/62443 implementation, HAZID/HAZOP/LOPA/SIL studies, risk assessments, and FAT/iFAT/SAT verification.

Working at Ramboll

To work at Ramboll means being part of a people organisation. We are focused on knowledge sharing and collaboration across competence areas and geography, and we aim for a strong diversity among our employees. This enables us to solve a broad range of projects, and we firmly believe that cross-collaboration leads to creative and longstanding solutions. data.title: RC - REGULATORY COMPLIANCE - Clinical - CA - Veeva - Manager
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY- GDS Consulting - Enterprise Risk (ER) - Regulatory Compliance - Manager - Veeva Clinical - Configuration Analyst

As part of our EY-ER- Regulatory Compliance team, you will help the clients by understanding their business needs and delivering solutions in accordance with the EY guidelines & methodologies. As a Regulatory Compliance Manager actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. In line with our commitment to quality, you'll consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for a seasoned and strategic Veeva Vault Clinical Manager to lead high-impact digital quality initiatives within the pharmaceutical domain. This opportunity is ideal for professionals who blend deep platform expertise with leadership and consulting acumen, and who thrive in regulated, client-facing environments. If you're passionate about driving transformation through technology and mentoring high-performing teams, this role is for you. 

Role Overview

As a Veeva Clinical Manager, you will be responsible for leading implementation and management of Veeva Vault Clinical Suite to support global clinical trials. You act as the bridge between business stakeholders, clinical operations teams, and technical teams to ensure the platform is configured to meet business and regulatory requirements. Beyond implementation you will provide strategic guidance to clients drives process improvements, manages project delivery and ensure clinical operations are streamlined through Veeva's capabilities. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-end-end implementation and deployment of the Veeva Vault Clinical Suite (eTMF, CTMS, Study Startup). 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate clinical business requirement into scalable Veeva solutions. 
 - Design and configure Veeva Vault applications, including workflows, lifecycles, security, roles, permissions, and business rules. 
 - Provide strategic consulting on clinical operations processes and recommend best practices aligned with industry standards. 
 - Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and deliverables to ensure successful project execution. 
 - Lead cross functional teams comprising business analysts, configuration specialists, developers, testers and validation teams. 
 - Oversee system integrations with EDC, e-consent, RIM, Safety, ERP, and other enterprise applications. 
 - Plan and manage data migration, ensuring data integrity and compliance throughout the migration lifecycle. 
 - Ensure CSV activities are completed in accordance with GxP, 21 CFR part 11, EU Annex 11, and ICH-GCP requirements. 
 - Drive User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, release management, and production deployment activities. 
 - Mentor and coach team members, promote knowledge sharing, and support capability development. 
 - Drive continuous improvement by leveraging new Veeva Vault features, AI enabled capabilities, automation, and industry best practices. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Proven proficiency in configuring the Veeva Vault platform, including objects, fields, roles, workflows, lifecycles, and reporting tools. 
 - Familiarity with Veeva APIs, Vault Loader, and other integration tools for data migration and system interoperability. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, contributing to iterative development and continuous improvement. 
 - Solid understanding of GxP compliance, CSV/CSA methodologies, and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements in validated environments. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with excellent communication, client interaction, and documentation skills. 

Must-Have Skills & Attribute

- 8-12 years of experience in clinical operations, clinical systems, or life sciences consulting, with 3-5 years of hands-on experience implementing and configuring the Veeva Vault suite. 
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end clinical trial processes, including study startup, site management, Monitoring. 
 - Proven experience in Veeva Vault configuration, including lifecycle workflows, Metadata, SDK based enhancements. 
 - Extensive knowledge of global clinical regulations and standards including ICH-GCP, FDA 21 Part 11, EU annex 11 , GxP, ALCOA+ , GDPR, and inspection readiness requirements. 

Good-to-Have Skills & Attributes

- Exposure to business development activities, including client engagement, proposal support, and solutioning. 
 - Solid understanding of GxP regulations, including FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11. 
 - Ability to contribute to thought leadership, offering innovative insights and best practices in Vault implementation. 
 - Strong command of Gamp5 methodology, software development lifecycle (SDLC), computer system validation (CSV), IQ, PQ, OQ, risk-based validation and change control with regulatory environment. 
 - Experience designing implementation clinical workflows, lifecycle management, TMF quality, review, milestone tracking, issue management. 
 - Experience in process optimization and operational efficiency initiatives, aligning technology with business outcomes. 
 - Strategic mindset with the ability to align Vault capabilities with digital transformation goals. 
 - High attention to detail, with strong analytical and critical thinking skills. 
 - Adaptability to evolving regulatory landscapes and business priorities. 
 - Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities in complex, fast-paced environments. 

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. 

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
 - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Silicon Validation Manager
data.description:
Kandou is a semiconductor company pioneering high-performance interconnect and chip-to-chip communication solutions. Our engineering teams push the boundaries of what is possible in silicon design, validation, and system integration. We are looking for a seasoned Silicon Validation Lead to join our R&D organization and drive end-to-end validation of complex SoC platforms. 

Silicon Validation Manager

Location: Hyderabad

Department: Silicon Engineering / Hardware Validation

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

As the Silicon Validation Director/Manager, you will own the full lifecycle of silicon bring-up and validation for next-generation SoC platforms that integrate PCIe, CXL, DDR5, RISC-V processors, Memory Fabric, PCIe Switch, and Caliptra Root of Trust (RoT) subsystems. You will lead a cross-functional validation team, define test strategies, and act as the primary technical interface between design, architecture, firmware, and system teams to ensure first-pass silicon quality and robust production readiness. 

Key Responsibilities

Silicon Bring-Up & Validation

- Lead pre- and post-silicon validation for complex SoCs encompassing PCIe Gen 4/5/6, CXL 1. 1/2. 0/3. 0, DDR5 memory subsystems, RISC-V processor cores, Memory Fabric, PCIe Switch, and Caliptra RoT IP. 
 - Drive silicon bring-up from power-on through full functional validation, characterization, and compliance testing. 
 - Develop and own comprehensive silicon validation plans, test coverage matrices, and sign-off criteria aligned with tapeout and production milestones. 
 - Execute and manage compliance and interoperability testing against PCIe, CXL, JEDEC DDR5, and relevant security/RoT standards. 

Test Architecture & Strategy

- Define test infrastructure architecture: board-level bring-up environments, FPGA prototypes, simulation correlation, and lab automation frameworks. 
 - Drive development of validation collateral including test plans, test suites, regression frameworks, and pass/fail criteria for all integrated subsystems. 
 - Establish coverage tracking dashboards and triage processes to systematically reduce validation escapes. 

Debug & Root Cause Analysis

- Lead deep-dive debugging of complex multi-layer failures spanning RTL, firmware, hardware, and system software. 
 - Utilize protocol analyzers, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and CXL/PCIe test equipment (e. g. , Teledyne LeCroy, Keysight, Spirent) to isolate and characterize issues. 
 - Author and maintain detailed bug reports, failure analysis documents, and errata for silicon revisions. 

Team Leadership & Collaboration

- Lead and mentor a team of validation engineers; set technical direction, review deliverables, and foster a culture of engineering rigor. 
 - Collaborate closely with RTL design, DV, firmware, and software teams to ensure seamless hand-off from pre-silicon simulation to physical silicon validation. 
 - Interface with external IP vendors, OEM/ODM partners, and compliance labs for interoperability and certification activities. 
 - Represent the validation team in architecture reviews, design reviews, and program planning meetings. 

Process & Continuous Improvement

- Champion test automation and CI/CD integration for regression management. 
 - Drive lessons-learned processes across silicon spins and contribute to validation methodology improvements. 
 - Establish and maintain lab safety, equipment inventory, and test asset management best practices. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - 18+ years of hands-on silicon validation or hardware validation engineering experience, with at least 6 years in a Manager/Lead or staff-level role. 
 - Deep expertise in PCIe (Gen 4/5/6): protocol-level knowledge, compliance testing, physical layer characterization, and debug. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with CXL (1. 1 / 2. 0 / 3. 0): memory semantic protocols, device types (Type 1/2/3), coherency mechanisms, and interoperability testing. 
 - Extensive experience validating DDR5 memory subsystems: timing margins, signal integrity, JEDEC compliance, and RAS features. 
 - Solid experience with RISC-V processor bring-up, ISA compliance validation, and core/cluster debug using JTAG and hardware debug probes. 
 - Hands-on experience with Memory Fabric architectures: bandwidth/latency characterization, coherency validation, and fabric stress testing. 
 - Experience validating PCIe Switch silicon: multi-port topologies, QoS, hot-plug, and error-handling scenarios. 
 - Experience with Caliptra Root of Trust or equivalent security subsystem validation: secure boot, firmware attestation, cryptographic engine verification, and DICE/RoT compliance. 

Technical Skills

- Protocols: PCIe Gen 4/5/6, CXL 1. 1/2. 0/3. 0, DDR5, AXI, APB, AMBA
 - Processor: RISC-V (RV64GC, RISC-V Debug Spec), JTAG
 - Security: Caliptra RoT, Secure Boot, DICE, TPM concepts
 - Interconnect: Memory Fabric, PCIe Switch, NoC fundamentals
 - Instrumentation: Protocol analyzers, BERT, oscilloscopes, VNAs
 - Automation: Python, Tcl, Bash, PyATS, Robot Framework
 - EDA / Debug: Signal Tap, ChipScope, OpenOCD, GDB

What we offer

- Opportunity to work on cutting-edge, industry-defining interconnect and semiconductor technology. 
 - Collaborative, high-trust engineering culture with direct access to architecture and design teams. 
 - Competitive compensation, equity participation, and comprehensive benefits. 
 - Flexible work arrangements and a commitment to continued technical growth. 

Kandou is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.description:
At Kandou, we are redefining the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by significantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems - a critical barrier to scalable adoption. 

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption significantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency - unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale. 

Kandou's architecture is not just an incremental improvement - it's a foundational shift in how AI hardware is built for the future. 

We are actively seeking a Software Architect either based in Hyderabad OR Bangalore. 

Responsibilities: 

- Architect CMIS 5. x stack (DataPath State Machine, VDM, I2C/MCTP, FW-SW interface)
 - Lead host interop tests for hyperscalers (Meta, AWS, etc. ), build test matrix and regression suite
 - Develop manufacturing test orchestration (ATE integration, yield analytics, on-chip stimulus)
 - Build telemetry pipeline from FW to host/cloud (formats, compression, SDK APIs)
 - Own customer SDK and tools (C/Python, CLI, log analysis), release management
 - Ensure standards compliance (CMIS 5. x, OSFP MSA, SFF-8024, OIF)
 - Travel: Up to 25% (customer engagement, manufacturing, standards)

 - Self-motivated, with strong sense of ownership and responsibility

data.description:
About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance Test Analyst with strong Oracle Fusion Finance testing expertise to join our testing team. This role will serve as the primary liaison between offshore testing teams and onshore Test Leads, combining hands-on test delivery with test coordination, governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring offshore testing activities are planned, coordinated, executed, and reported effectively while maintaining high quality standards across all testing deliverables. 

This role combines approximately 80% hands-on testing and quality assurance activities with 20% coordination, communication, and governance responsibilities. 

Key Responsibilities Offshore-Onshore Coordination & Communication

- Act as the primary point of contact between offshore test teams and onshore Test Leads. 
 - Participate in governance, status, and project meetings. 
 - Communicate testing priorities and requirements to offshore resources. 
 - Consolidate offshore progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers. 
 - Provide clear and concise status updates to onshore stakeholders. 
 - Coordinate and track queries between offshore and onshore teams. 
 - Ensure agreed actions are understood and executed by offshore teams. 
 - Maintain efficient communication channels and minimize unnecessary escalations. 

Test Coordination & Governance

- Support detailed planning and coordination of offshore testing activities. 
 - Break down testing scope into manageable work packages. 
 - Monitor progress against milestones and delivery timelines. 
 - Identify and escalate risks that may impact testing schedules. 
 - Coordinate test data, environment readiness, and testing dependencies. 
 - Ensure consistent quality standards across testing deliverables. 
 - Review and quality assure test cases and supporting evidence. 
 - Highlight resource and capacity constraints proactively. 

Test Analysis, Preparation & Execution

- Execute and support complex Oracle Fusion Finance test scenarios. 
 - Review requirements and identify required test coverage. 
 - Develop, review, and maintain test cases and test scripts. 
 - Support end-to-end business process testing. 
 - Identify gaps and recommend additional testing where necessary. 
 - Ensure accurate documentation of testing activities and outcomes. 

Defect Management

- Review defects before escalation to ensure completeness and quality. 
 - Ensure defects contain sufficient detail to support investigation. 
 - Participate in defect triage sessions and defect review meetings. 
 - Identify recurring issues and potential root causes. 
 - Escalate critical defects, risks, and blockers promptly. 

Reporting & Tracking

- Maintain accurate test execution status in Azure DevOps (ADO). 
 - Consolidate and report offshore testing progress. 
 - Track defects, risks, dependencies, and blockers. 
 - Participate in daily stand-ups and status meetings. 
 - Provide visibility into resource utilization and testing capacity. 

Required Skills & Experience Oracle Fusion Finance Testing

- Professional testing qualification (ISTQB or equivalent preferred). 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience testing ERP Financials, preferably Oracle Fusion Finance. 
 - Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and controls. 
 - Proven experience in functional system testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing support. 

Oracle Fusion Finance Modules

Experience Across Multiple Oracle Fusion Finance Modules, Including

- General Ledger (GL)
 - Accounts Payable (AP)
 - Accounts Receivable (AR)
 - Cash Management
 - Fixed Assets
 - Expenses
 - Intercompany
 - Tax
 - Budgetary Control
 - Financial Reporting

Business Process Knowledge

Strong Knowledge Of End-to-end Finance Processes, Including

- Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
 - Record-to-Report (R2R)
 - Order-to-Cash (O2C)

Communication & Stakeholder Management

This is a critical requirement for the role. 

The Successful Candidate Should Demonstrate

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. 
 - Experience working with UK-based or other international stakeholders. 
 - Ability to explain testing and technical issues to non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills. 
 - Ability to consolidate detailed testing information into concise management updates. 
 - Confidence in escalating risks, issues, and blockers appropriately. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in large-scale ERP transformation or Oracle Fusion implementation programs. 
 - Experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for test management and defect tracking. 
 - Experience coordinating distributed offshore and onshore testing teams. 
 - Exposure to Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery methodologies. 

Why Join Us?

- Work on enterprise-scale Oracle Fusion Finance transformation programs. 
 - Collaborate with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams. 
 - Contribute to high-impact finance transformation initiatives. 
 - Opportunity to combine hands-on testing expertise with leadership and coordination responsibilities.

data.description:
Company Overview

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential. 

Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone's best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3, 000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. 

Job Overview

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and business-focused Senior Quality Analyst to join our growing team and play a critical role in delivering high-quality Salesforce and Conversational ITSM solutions. 

The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring that business requirements are thoroughly validated, tested, and implemented in alignment with customer expectations. This role goes beyond traditional testing and requires someone who can understand business processes, challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and ensure that the delivered solution truly addresses business needs. 

You will work closely with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Developers, Architects, and Client Stakeholders to validate Salesforce, Agentforce, ITSM, and enterprise integration solutions throughout the delivery lifecycle. 

If you enjoy being the quality gatekeeper, ensuring business value realization, and advocating for the customer experience, this role is for you. 

Key Responsibilities

Business Validation & Quality Assurance

- Act as the quality champion for all functional and business solution deliveries. 
 - Ensure business requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria are complete, testable, and aligned with customer expectations. 
 - Analyze BRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, and Solution Designs to identify ambiguities, gaps, and risks before development begins. 
 - Validate that delivered functionality addresses the intended business outcomes and process requirements. 
 - Ensure quality is built into every phase of the delivery lifecycle rather than being treated as a final activity. 

Test Planning & Execution

- Develop comprehensive test strategies and test plans for Salesforce, ITSM, Agentforce, and integration-based solutions. 
 - Create detailed: 
 - Test Scenarios
 - Test Cases
 - Traceability Matrices
 - Test Data Requirements
 - Defect Reports
 - UAT Support Documentation
 - Execute functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing activities. 
 - Validate Salesforce configurations, customizations, workflows, automations, and integrations. 
 - Ensure all business scenarios, exception handling, and edge cases are adequately tested. 
Salesforce & ITSM Solution Testing

- Test solutions developed on: 
 - Agentforce
 - Enterprise Service Management (ITSM) Platforms
 - Validate business processes such as: 
 - Incident Management
 - Service Request Management
 - Knowledge Management
 - Employee Service Processes
 - Customer Service Workflows
 - Case Management
 - Verify conversational and AI-powered workflows to ensure accurate business outcomes and user experience. 
Integration & End-to-End Validation

- Validate integrations across Salesforce and enterprise applications. 
 - Test APIs, data synchronization, workflow orchestration, and middleware integrations, including MuleSoft-enabled solutions. 
 - Ensure data accuracy, consistency, security, and business process continuity across systems. 
 - Perform end-to-end validation for complex business processes spanning multiple platforms. 

UAT & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Partner with Business Analysts and Product Owners to establish clear acceptance criteria. 
 - Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities. 
 - Facilitate defect triage sessions and help prioritize business-critical issues. 
 - Collaborate with client stakeholders to validate delivered solutions and ensure business readiness. 
 - Participate in sprint reviews, showcase sessions, and production readiness assessments. 

Continuous Improvement

- Identify process improvement opportunities within testing and quality practices. 
 - Contribute to test automation strategies and quality engineering best practices. 
 - Recommend enhancements that improve customer experience, business efficiency, and platform reliability. 
 - Promote a quality-first culture across business and technology teams. 

Required Qualifications

Must Have

- 5 to 8 years of Quality Assurance and Testing experience in enterprise application environments. 
 - Strong experience testing: 
 - Enterprise Service Management or ITSM Platforms
 - Strong understanding of business process validation and requirement-based testing. 
 - Experience creating and executing detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios. 
 - Experience supporting Agile and Scrum-based delivery teams. 
 - Strong knowledge of defect management, root cause analysis, and quality governance processes. 
 - Experience performing integration and end-to-end testing across enterprise applications. 
 - Excellent analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing Salesforce transformation programs. 
 - Experience validating ITSM or Enterprise Service Management implementations. 
 - Experience working with API integrations, middleware solutions, and MuleSoft-based integrations. 
 - Knowledge of test automation frameworks and automation strategies. 
 - Exposure to Agile testing, DevOps, and Continuous Testing methodologies. 
 - Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce Business Analyst, or Quality Engineering certifications. 

Added Advantage

- Experience testing Agentforce implementations and conversational service experiences. 
 - Exposure to AI-powered workflows, virtual agents, copilots, or conversational platforms. 
 - Experience validating Generative AI-driven business processes and service automation workflows. 
 - Knowledge of enterprise service delivery processes and operational support models. 

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking professionals who: 

- Think from a business value perspective rather than just a testing perspective. 
 - Challenge requirements and proactively identify gaps before they impact delivery. 
 - Have a strong customer-first mindset and advocate for user experience and quality. 
 - Can confidently work with Business Analysts, Developers, Architects, and Client Stakeholders. 
 - Have exceptional attention to detail and a passion for delivering defect-free solutions. 
 - Thrive in fast-paced environments where innovation and continuous learning are encouraged. 
 - Want to be part of a growing organization building next-generation Salesforce and Conversational ITSM solutions. 

Why Join Us?

- Be part of a strategic initiative focused on building Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Agentic Service Platforms. 
 - Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, Salesforce, AI, MuleSoft, and Enterprise Service Management solutions. 
 - Collaborate with experienced business, technology, and product teams driving large-scale transformation programs. 
 - Play a critical role in ensuring customer success and quality excellence. 
 - Join a growing organization where quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction are key pillars of success. 
 - Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model across Kochi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad. 

Join Us

If you are a Senior Quality Analyst who believes that quality is about ensuring business outcomes and not just finding defects, and you are passionate about validating innovative Salesforce, Agentforce, and ITSM solutions, we would love to hear from you. Join us and help deliver world-class Conversational and AI-powered service experiences that delight our customers. 

Compensation

Estimated Pay Range: 

Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location. 

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees. 

We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.

Please be advised of the following official Milestone Technologies recruitment policies: 

Official Communication Channels

All legitimate email communications from our recruitment team will originate ONLY from the domains: @milestone. tech. We do not use generic email services (e. g. @gmail. com, @yahoo. com, @outlook. com) or unofficial third party messaging apps to conduct formal business.

data.title: Principal Technical Architect
data.description:
Job Title: 

Principal Software Engineer - Java Architect, Microservices, Cloud, Springboot

Overview

The Real time Payments (RTP) program is driving the global shift toward instant, account to account payments, enabling secure, low latency, and highly resilient payment services across multiple live markets worldwide. 

RTP platforms operate as mission critical financial infrastructure, supporting high transaction volumes, strict regulatory expectations, and near zero downtime requirements. The program spans multiple products and shared services, deployed across diverse market and customer environments, while adhering to Mastercard's enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards. 

Engineering within RTP is focused not only on feature delivery, but on building scalable, resilient platforms that can evolve safely over time-through strong architecture, disciplined engineering practices, and a relentless focus on non functional excellence. 

Role

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to provide hands on technical execution and leadership for one or more RTP products and platform capabilities across multiple markets. 

This is a senior individual contributor role for a deeply experienced engineer who: 

• Owns the design and implementation of complex services or subsystems

• Stays close to the code on complex and high risk areas

• Is deeply hands‐on and leads by technical excellence

• Contributes meaningfully to architecture and product design aspects

• Owns key implementation decisions including all non-functional aspects across performance, scalability, reliability, security, and observability

The role combines strong technical depth with engineering leadership with end‐to‐end ownership for delivery quality, correctness, and maintainability in their area of responsibility. 

Key Responsibilities

The role spans five core dimensions, with ownership across end to end technical outcomes. 

1. Design & Technical Execution

• Own the architecture and detailed design for one or more RTP products or platform capabilities across markets. 

• Define and enforce reference architectures, design patterns, and engineering standards (e. g. , microservices, event driven architecture, domain driven design). 

• Design, build, and maintain high‐quality software components and services for RTP products. 

• Lead and participate in technical design reviews, ensuring alignment with RTP and enterprise architecture principles. 

• Make clear, well reasoned technology and design trade offs, balancing delivery speed, risk, and long term maintainability. 

• Own end‐to‐end delivery of complex features or subsystems, from design through production. 

• Translate functional and non‐functional requirements into robust technical implementations. 

• Ensure solutions adhere to RTP architecture standards and engineering best practices. 

2. Hands‐on Engineering & Code Quality

• Remain hands on for critical components, complex problem areas, prototypes, and reference implementations. 

• Lead by example in code quality, testing discipline, and maintainable design. 

• Perform and participate in code reviews, raising the bar for engineering quality. 

• Drive high quality implementations for low latency, high throughput, distributed systems. 

• Support teams in solving deep technical problems across application, messaging, data, and platform layers. 

3. Non Functional Excellence (NFR Ownership)

• Design and implement solutions that meet defined performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements. 

• Define and enforce measurable non functional requirements, SLIs, and SLOs. 

• Ensure production readiness through strong observability (metrics, logs, traces), capacity planning, and failure mode design. 

• Proactively identify and remediate architectural, capacity, and resilience risks. 

• Support performance testing, capacity validation, and production readiness activities. 

• Actively participate in incident analysis and remediation when issues arise. 

4. Cross Market Consistency & Platform Evolution

• Drive cross market alignment, preventing architectural and Technology drift and duplicated solutions. 

• Promote reuse of patterns, components, and learnings across RTP markets and shared services. 

• Contribute to and influence the technology roadmap, including platform evergreening and technical debt reduction. 

• Act as a trusted technical partner to product, operations, and governance forums. 

5. Engineering Leadership & Bar Raising

• Mentor senior engineers and technical leads; raise the quality of design reviews, code reviews, and technical decision making. 

• Influence engineering culture toward ownership, quality, and operational excellence. 

• Support hiring and technical assessments, helping set the bar for senior technical talent. 

• Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders. 

All About You

Experience & Technical Expertise

• 16+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant time spent designing and building distributed systems at scale. 

• Proven experience owning architecture and design for complex, business critical platforms. 

• Strong hands on expertise with microservices and event driven architectures. 

• Deep understanding of performance engineering, scalability patterns, resilience design, and failure handling. 

• Solid experience with observability, production diagnostics, and operational readiness.
