data.title: QA Engineer - O2C & Enterprise Billing Testing
data.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

We are looking for a highly analytical and technically proficient QA Engineer to take ownership of our Opportunity-to-Cash (O2C) and Enterprise Billing testing. In this role, you will act as a quality gatekeeper for the financial systems that drive our business. 

You will join the BOBA Frameworks QA team - a small, high-ownership team embedded in the Finance engineering organization - where quality directly impacts revenue accuracy and customer trust. 

You will not just be executing test cases; you will be mapping out complex data flows that span across Salesforce CPQ, our middleware, our Billing Platform, our payment gateways (Braintree), and our NetSuite ERP. If you are a critical thinker who understands the financial domino effect of a failed sync, loves unraveling usage-based billing logic, and thrives in cross-functional collaboration, we want you on our team. 

What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)

- End-to-End Pipeline Ownership: 
 - Execute comprehensive test strategies for our entire Opportunity-to-Cash lifecycle. 
 - Trace data payloads from the moment an order is created in Salesforce CPQ to the moment the final journal entry hits NetSuite. 
 - Complex Billing Lifecycle Validation: 
 - Take ownership of testing our Enterprise Billing Platform. 
 - Rigorously validate invoice generation, taxation (Avalara), proration, discounts, credits, tiered and usage-based pricing models, credit memo issuances, and dunning (collections) workflows. 
 - Test Plan & Coverage Ownership: 
 - Own and maintain structured test plans in Xray for all buying programs (PAYG, Savings Plan, Volume Plan). 
 - Ensure traceability from requirements to execution across every billing lifecycle stage. 
 - Payment Gateway & Ledger Allocation Testing: 
 - Take ownership of end-to-end payment flows through Braintree. 
 - Validate successful authorizations, settlements, and complex edge cases like partial refunds on multi-invoice payments. 
 - Ensure funds are accurately handled (e. g. , proper allocation vs. unallocated amounts) and invoice statuses remain correct across systems. 
 - Usage & Consumption Testing: 
 - Deep-dive into our usage-based billing models. 
 - Simulate high-volume usage data, validate tier drawdown logic, and ensure overages are calculated with absolute precision. 
 - Cross-System Integration Testing: 
 - Perform robust integration testing across our financial tech stack. 
 - Validate API payloads, investigate failed background syncs, and ensure data integrity between Salesforce, Billing Platform, NetSuite, and Braintree. 
 - Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis: 
 - Investigate system logs and identify exactly where a data sync broke down. 
 - Provide developers with clear, actionable reproduction steps beyond just reporting bugs. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: 
 - Act as the bridge between Engineering, Product, and Finance. Partner with business stakeholders to understand complex revenue rules and translate them into foolproof test scenarios. 
What Success Looks Like (Your First Year)

- Day 30 - Architecture & Ownership: You've mapped the full Quote-to-Cash pipeline end-to-end: Salesforce CPQ → Boomi/PASS provisioning → Billing Platform → NetSuite → Avalara & Braintree. You've taken full ownership of the Xray test repository and can explain which test cases cover which buying program, workstream, and billing lifecycle stage without being asked. 
 - Day 60 - Independent Execution: You independently execute QA for a complete enterprise billing lifecycle - from contract activation through invoice approval, tax calculation, and payment processing - and close it without escalation. You've begun triaging Billing Platform → NetSuite sync failures and Boomi provisioning errors on your own, and you understand the difference between a defect and expected system behavior. 
 - Day 90 - Primary Sign-Off: You are the QA gate for all cross-system financial deployments. Engineering ships nothing that touches CPQ, Billing Platform, or NetSuite without your sign-off. You've established a defect triage process in Jira and Xray that gives Engineering and Finance a shared, real-time view of quality - eliminating the back-and-forth that slows down deployments. 
 - Year 1 - Measurable Impact: Critical post-deployment data sync errors between CPQ and NetSuite have dropped measurably. Every active buying program - PAYG, Savings Plan, and Volume Plan - has standardized, Xray-tracked test coverage for usage-based billing, commitment invoicing, contract lifecycle boundaries, and edge cases. The team ships faster because QA is a multiplier, not a bottleneck. 

What You Bring To The Table (Required Experience)

- O2C Domain Expertise: 4+ years of QA experience with a heavy focus on Quote-to-Cash / Order-to-Cash business processes. You understand the "why" behind financial transactions, not just the "how. "
 - Salesforce CPQ: Hands-on experience configuring and testing quotes, product bundles, amendments, and contract renewals within Salesforce CPQ. 
 - Enterprise Billing Platforms: Proven experience testing complex billing systems such as BillingPlatform, Zuora, or similar financial engines. 
 - Payment Processing & Gateways: Hands-on experience testing enterprise payment gateways (Braintree heavily preferred; Stripe or Adyen acceptable). You possess a deep functional understanding of payment lifecycles (Auth, Capture, Settle, Refund) and how gateway actions impact Accounts Receivable (AR) balances. 
 - Integration Middleware: Familiarity with provisioning and event-driven middleware (Boomi or equivalent). You can read a payload log and identify where in the chain a sync broke. 
 - Test Management & Agile Tools: Proficient in Jira for defect tracking and Agile workflows, with strong hands-on experience using Xray as a test management tool. You know how to navigate structured test plans, manage test executions, and maintain strict traceability between bugs, test cases, and product requirements. 
 - Usage-Based Models: Familiarity with testing consumption-based pricing, tiered pricing, drawdown models, and metered billing logic. 
 - Integration & API Verification: Experience validating data transfers between systems (using tools like Postman or validating middleware logs). You know how to prove a system sent the right data even if the UI hasn't updated yet. 
 - Taxation & Compliance Tools: Familiarity with enterprise taxation calculation software like Avalara. 

Who You Are (Soft Skills)

- A System-Level Thinker: You understand that missing a prerequisite step - like failing to approve a usage invoice before uploading the next month's consumption - breaks the entire downstream flow. 
 - Self-Driven Investigator: When a test fails, you don't just throw it back to Dev. You dig into the documentation and logs to help figure out exactly what went wrong. 
 - Exceptional Communicator: You can clearly explain a complex API sync failure to an engineer, and then turn around and explain the business impact of that failure to a Finance Manager. 
 - Detail-Obsessive Under Ambiguity: Financial test data is rarely clean. You know how to set up a controlled test environment, isolate variables, and still reach a confident pass/fail verdict even when upstream systems are noisy.

Our hiring process

Renesas is hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test with strong Python skills to develop and execute automated and manual test solutions for software, hardware, and firmware products. Experience with hardware, electronics, or SW/HW interface is a big plus. 

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate market-leading digital controller solutions powering AI, client, and server applications. Responsibilities include test planning, automation, debugging, test execution, and driving product quality across the development lifecycle.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or similar

Experience: 3-7years of Software QA experience, including 3+ years testing software integrated with hardware/firmware. 

Technical Proficiency:

data.title: Lead Software Engineer – C# .NET Sortation & Labeling Systems
data.description:
Lead Software Engineer - C# . NET Sortation & Labeling Systems

Job Location - Pune (Hybrid)

About Williams-Sonoma, Inc. 

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization. 

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide. 

Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide. 

Role Overview

The Lead Software Engineer will lead the design, development, and delivery of a Windows-based sortation and labeling platform that integrates with PKMS/WMS systems, PLCs, and material handling equipment (MHE) across our distribution network. The system processes TCP socket messages for carton lifecycle events, persists data to enterprise databases, and coordinates downstream services. This role requires deep hands-on C#/. NET expertise, subject-matter depth in warehouse automation and MHE, and close collaboration with cross-functional business, DC operations, and third-party vendor teams such as Savoye, Opex, Honeywell Intelligrated, Boxer, and bagger/print-and-apply solution providers. 

Impact of the Role

• Provide technical leadership for the sortation and labeling domain - designing, developing, and leading delivery of high-throughput, low-latency Windows services and desktop applications. 

• Own application health in production - monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root-cause resolution during peak fulfillment periods. 

• Partner with Distribution Center operations, Supply Chain, and third-party MHE vendors to translate operational requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

• Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve DC operations, production support, and business-user productivity. 

• Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team. 

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

• . NET Framework 4. 8 and Visual Studio 2022. 

• Socket-based services and Windows Service hosts. 

• Integration with sortation devices, PLCs, MHE controllers, and WMS/PKMS via TCP. 

• ZPL label print pipelines and event-forwarding mechanisms

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership for the sortation and labeling domain - designing, developing, and leading delivery of high-throughput, low-latency Windows services and desktop applications. 

• Design and maintain TCP socket server/client components for high-volume carton lifecycle messaging with PKMS/WMS and MHE controllers. 

• Implement multithreading and asynchronous programming patterns for performance, responsiveness, and predictable throughput under peak volumes. 

• Build and maintain desktop UI using WPF and coordinate with Windows Service hosts for end-to-end operational workflows. 

• Lead integrations with PLCs, serial devices, scanners, print-and-apply, and material handling equipment, ensuring robust error handling, retry logic, and consistent state across data stores. 

• Own ZPL label workflows and print pipelines, including label design, throughput tuning, and printer/applicator fault recovery. 

• Define and enforce engineering standards for secure coding, unit testing, Git branching strategy, and code quality. 

• Lead deployments, IIS configuration, and CI/CD automation, including automated testing and release readiness. 

• Own application health in production - monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root-cause resolution during peak fulfillment periods. 

• Partner with Distribution Center operations, Supply Chain, and third-party MHE vendors to translate operational requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

• Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve DC operations, production support, and business-user productivity. 

• Drive Agile delivery - sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking - adhere to IT change management, and mentor engineers to raise the bar across the team. 

Qualifications

• 10-15 years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a technical lead or staff-level role. 

• Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale . NET applications in a retail, supply chain, or logistics environment. 

• Demonstrated experience as an individual contributor with strong ownership, self-direction, and vendor coordination. 

• Experience delivering in Agile environments using Jira for sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking. 

• Strong knowledge of warehouse management, sortation, labeling, and Distribution Center operations. 

• Hands-on experience integrating with PKMS, Manhattan WMOS, or comparable WMS platforms. 

• Experience leading third-party vendor integrations, integration platforms, and enterprise web services. 

• Strong business acumen with the ability to align technology solutions to throughput, accuracy, and cost goals. 

• Subject-matter expertise in material handling equipment and warehouse automation, with hands-on integration experience across one or more OEM solution sets: Savoye, Opex, Honeywell Intelligrated, Boxer, and bagger / print-and-apply systems. 

• Deep understanding of MHE process flows - induction, singulation, scanning, sortation, diverts, put walls, unit sortation, carton and bag creation, weigh-in-motion, and label print-and-apply.

Role Summary

We are hiring a Lead Data Engineer for a strongly Python-first profile, complemented by solid depth across Databricks, data modelling, T-SQL, 

and data architecture. You will design, build, and own production-grade Python codebases and frameworks at the core of our Databricks

Lakehouse platform, while also setting technical direction on pipeline architecture, data modelling, and platform performance, and mentoring

a team of engineers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and own production-grade Python codebases for the data platform - ETL/ELT pipelines, reusable internal packages, 

schema validation, and testing frameworks (pytest, CI/CD). 

- Write clean, well-tested, performant Python: apply OOP, concurrency (multiprocessing/asyncio), decorators, and generators to solve real

pipeline-scale problems. 

- Profile and optimize slow Python pipelines end to end - from algorithmic/code-level fixes to migrating heavy workloads onto

Databricks/Spark when Python alone won't scale. 

- Set and enforce Python engineering standards across the team: code reviews, packaging/versioning, structured logging, and exception

handling patterns. 

- Design and deliver Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion pipelines on Databricks - Delta Lake, Structured Streaming/Auto Loader, and Unity

Catalog governance. 

- Own dimensional data modelling decisions - star/snowflake schema design and SCD strategy - for the platform's core data models. 
 - Write and review advanced T-SQL for platform workloads - window functions, MERGE/upsert logic, and execution-plan-based

performance tuning. 

- Partner with Data Architects and stakeholders on ETL vs. ELT, orchestration, and cost/performance trade-offs across the platform; mentor

Data Engineers and Senior Data Engineers through design and code reviews. 

Must-have Qualifications

8-12 years in data engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical leadership or mentoring capacity. This role carries a strong Python emphasis, 

Complemented By Hands-on Depth In

Python & Data Engineering (Primary Focus)

- Strong hands-on Python: OOP, generators, decorators, concurrency (multiprocessing/asyncio), exception handling, and unit testing

(pytest). 

- Experience building production ETL/ELT pipelines, schema validation, and reusable internal Python packages/frameworks. 
 - Proven ability to profile, debug, and optimize Python code for performance at data-pipeline scale. 

Databricks & Lakehouse

- Deep, hands-on Databricks experience: Delta Lake (ACID, time travel, OPTIMIZE/ZORDER/VACUUM), Structured Streaming, Auto Loader, 

and Unity Catalog. 

- Experience tuning Spark jobs at scale - data skew, cluster sizing/autoscaling, and cost optimization. 

Data Modelling & Warehousing

- Strong grounding in dimensional modelling: star/snowflake schema, SCD Types 1/2/3, fact/dimension grain, and conformed dimensions. 
 - Working knowledge of Data Vault modelling and Kimball vs. Inmon trade-offs. 

T-SQL

- Advanced T-SQL: window functions, MERGE/upsert patterns, indexing strategy, and execution-plan-based query tuning. 

Data Architecture

- Proven experience designing Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architectures and evaluating ETL vs. ELT and batch vs. streaming trade-offs. 
 - Experience with orchestration (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, or ADF) on Azure or AWS. 

GOOD TO HAVE

- PCEP / PCAP (Python Institute) or equivalent Python certification. 
 - Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional (or equivalent) certification. 
 - Experience with data governance/compliance (GDPR/HIPAA) and cost-governance (FinOps) practices. 
 - Prior experience formally leading or mentoring a team of 3+ engineers. 

EDUCATION

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Soft Skills

Strong stakeholder communication; able to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering and business audiences; comfortable owning

ambiguous, enterprise-scale design decisions end to end.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

About Slack

Slack is your Digital HQ - bringing people, apps, customers, and AI agents together in one place. Millions of people use Slack every day to communicate, collaborate, and get work done. As work becomes increasingly distributed and AI-powered, Slack is redefining how teams operate and achieve at scale. In this AI era, Slack's mission remains making people's work lives simpler, more pleasant, and more productive. 

The Team

The Slack Mobile team builds Slack's mobile experiences, from core messaging to AI and everything in between. 

We operate at the intersection of product innovation, mobile platform excellence, and large-scale engineering. The features and systems we build support millions of daily users and require deep investments in performance, reliability, accessibility, and user experience. 

The Role

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to help shape the future of Slack's mobile product. As a Prototyping Engineer, you'll embed as a leader on greenfield, zero-to-one initiatives. You'll influence product and design direction through engineering work that builds and ships the first versions of newly-imagined, fully working product features. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and fellow mobile engineers to help innovate some of the biggest new product opportunities for Slack, with experiences that are intuitive, performant, and reliable for millions of users worldwide. 

What You'll Do

Role

This is a role for a self-directed, creative engineer who can operate with high velocity and strong independent judgment, combining hands-on technical leadership with broad organizational influence. We are looking for someone who can start from an ambiguous problem, no defined path, and competing priorities, and work through that to frame the problem, align stakeholders on what matters most, and move quickly from idea to working prototype to a shipped experience. You will: 

- Shape the future of Slack on mobile by leading the engineering development of experiences used by millions of users every day, spanning multiple teams and the broader organization. 
 - Lead the most complex, ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from early technical exploration through production rollout and long-term evolution. 
 - Lead feature prototyping to define the mobile user experience for Slack's biggest opportunities. 
 - Partner closely with Product and Design to shape experiences that balance user needs, technical constraints, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Influence engineering decisions beyond your immediate team through technical leadership, product reviews, and mentorship. 
 - Set and evangelize best practices for mobile feature development and operational excellence across the broader engineering organization. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and contribute to the growth of the broader mobile engineering community within Slack. 
 - A related technical degree required. 

What We're Looking For

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building complex, high-craft Android applications at scale. 
 - Proven track record of moving outside of organizational boundaries to start new initiatives, prototype the path to production, and reorient the organization to support the new initiative. 
 - Experience working in fast-paced environments, whether at a start-up, in an incubator, or on a zero-to-one team inside a larger enterprise. 
 - Proven track record of leading large, ambiguous, org-spanning technical initiatives with significant business impact. 
 - Deep expertise in Kotlin framework and modern Android development. 
 - Strong understanding of Android architecture, application lifecycle, concurrency, networking, and performance optimization. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence product and technical direction through expertise and collaboration, driving alignment across executive stakeholders, Engineering/Product/Design leadership, and multiple teams. 
 - A bias toward ownership, execution, and continuous improvement, with the judgment to prioritize the highest-leverage work across the organization. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture patterns. Experience with Combine Concurrency (async/await, actors), and dependency injection frameworks (e. g. Needle, Resolver). 
 - Experience leading large-scale new products, features, or product transformations spanning multiple teams or the whole org. 
 - Experience using research, usability testing, data, and experimentation to ground decisions and uncover opportunities. 
 - Contributions to open source projects or the Android community, or other external recognition of technical leadership. 
 - Experience building collaboration, productivity, messaging, AI, or enterprise software products. 
 - Excellent communication skills. 
 - Strong product intuition and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences. 

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. 

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

Posting Statement

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. 

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https: //www. salesforcebenefits. com. Prove Software Quality Across Global Regulated Enterprise Operations

Put every global software release through a higher standard of proof. Join Emapta as a QA & Validation Engineer, building automation and validation that protect regulated enterprise operations from defects, data risks, and compliance gaps. Strengthen worldwide release confidence while developing specialized expertise and a long-term global career among top 1% talent. 

Your Quality Gate to a Global Technology Career

- Employment Type: Full-time
 - Shift: Night Shift, Weekends Off
 - Work Setup: Hybrid | 105 B Wing Balaji Complex Chinchavali | India

Exciting Perks Await!

- Competitive package
 - Medical life insurance
 - Standard government and Emapta benefits
 - Well-equipped, modern, and accessible offices
 - Employee engagement initiatives
 - Mentorship and exposure to global leaders and teams
 - Diverse, inclusive, and supportive culture
 - Transparent performance management
 - Unlimited upskilling through Emapta Academy courses (Want to know more? Visit: https: //emapta. com/training-calendar/)

The Qualifications We Seek

- More than 3 years of production QA automation experience, with proven expertise in building robust automated UI and API test suites for complex B2B web applications
 - Strong hands-on programming skills in TypeScript or JavaScript, with experience using Playwright preferred or Cypress
 - Experience with modern unit testing frameworks, including Vitest or Jest
 - Strong SQL and relational database proficiency, with the ability to inspect complex relational schemas, write multi-table joins, and validate record integrity in PostgreSQL
 - Exceptional written technical English, with the ability to create clear, unambiguous, step-by-step test plans and validation protocols that third-party auditors or team members can execute independently without clarification
 - Meticulous, evidence-driven approach to capturing failure outputs, network payloads, console errors, and reproduction steps
 - Experience in regulated environments, including GxP, GAMP 5, Computer System Validation, or FDA 21 CFR Part 11, preferred
 - Functional familiarity with ERP, MES, or QMS domains, including Bills of Materials, Lot Genealogy, Inventory Valuation, CAPA, Deviations, and Electronic Signatures, preferred

Your Daily Tasks

End-to-End Automated Testing

- Design, build, and maintain a browser-level automated test suite from scratch using Playwright and TypeScript
 - Establish automated regression coverage across approximately 20 mission-critical workflows, including authentication and RBAC, order-to-cash, electronic batch records, quality deviations, contract lifecycle, and approval hierarchies

Post-Deploy Production Verification

- Build, maintain, and execute automated smoke and verification tests against production environments after every release
 - Serve as the required sign-off gate before production builds receive shipped status

GxP / 21 CFR Part 11 Protocol Execution

- Author and execute formal Installation Qualification, Operational Qualification, and Performance Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) test protocols
 - Capture tamper-evident runtime logs, screenshots, and supporting test artifacts
 - Log deviations accurately and maintain the requirements traceability matrix

Database & State Validation

- Navigate backend schemas and query PostgreSQL directly
 - Validate data isolation, tenant security, Row-Level Security (RLS), and transactional accuracy through database-level assertions rather than reliance solely on UI validation

Integration & Regression Testing

- Expand automated integration and unit test coverage across thin modules
 - Protect critical workflows against regressions within the continuous deployment pipeline using GitHub Actions

About the Client

Our client develops an AI-native enterprise operations platform that connects finance, manufacturing, supply chain, CRM, quality, sourcing, treasury, and product lifecycle management through a shared data model. They combine ERP functionality, workflow automation, and embedded AI to replace fragmented business systems. Their technology supports critical processes including production, inventory, financial management, CAPA, deviations, audits, lot traceability, and compliance records, giving complex organizations greater visibility, control, traceability, and intelligence across interconnected operations while creating a scalable foundation for global growth. 

Join the Top 1% Talent. A Better Career. A Better Life. 

Join us at Emapta, and let your professional journey flourish in the heart of India's vibrant culture!

Recognized as one of Asia's rising tech and outsourcing destinations, we offer a wealth of opportunities to showcase your talent to the world. At Emapta, we connect you with global clients, giving you international exposure without leaving the comfort of your home country. With over 1, 200 international clients and a decade of proven success, we provide a strong foundation for your career growth. Here, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning are part of everyday life, and work-life balance is more than just a promise-it's a reality. 

#EmaptaEra #EmaptaIndia
